### [1] [Generalized PINN-Based Inverse Estimation of Spatially Varying Heat Transfer Coefficients with Transfer Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14008)
*Pradipan Maitra,Jariful Hassan,Arijit Hazra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究提出广义边界表示与迁移学习策略，用于PINN反演射流冲击冷却中空间变化对流换热系数（HTC），证明广义表示可摆脱预设二次形式，迁移学习可大幅降低目标训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统PINN反演HTC多依赖预设二次形式边界，难以刻画空间变化的复杂HTC剖面；同时重复逆估计训练成本高。因此需要研究广义边界表示与迁移学习，以提升适用性并降低训练代价。

Method: 基于瞬态内部温度测量，推断分段线性（PWL）与神经网络边界估计器，并在Re=5000、10000、15000下与CFD-CHT参考HTC剖面对比。采用基于H^1半范数梯度正则的离散Adjoint-FEM作为独立逆方法对照。迁移学习考察两种源-目标条件：同Re不同噪声水平间迁移，以及受控高斯剖面问题到不同Re的CFD-CHT目标问题迁移。

Result: Re=5000、5%噪声下，二次、PWL与神经网络PINN的HTC剖面相对误差分别为5.08%、5.31%、5.19%；广义表示将Re=15000目标误差由二次PINN的16.76%降至14.41%和14.46%。迁移学习使固定Re迁移训练时间减少57.86-81.71%，高斯到CHT迁移减少50.59-84.94%。精度影响依目标而定：固定剖面PWL迁移与从头训练相差在0.30个百分点内，高斯到CHT迁移差异为0.10-1.52个百分点。

Conclusion: 广义PINN表示可在不预设二次形式下适应空间变化HTC剖面，迁移学习能显著降低重复逆估计的目标训练成本，但重构精度取决于源-目标兼容性。

Abstract: This study investigates generalized boundary representations and transfer learning for physics-informed neural-network (PINN) estimation of spatially varying convective heat transfer coefficients (HTCs) in jet impingement cooling. Piecewise-linear (PWL) and neural-network boundary estimators are inferred from transient interior-temperature measurements and evaluated against CFD-CHT reference HTC profiles at Reynolds numbers of 5000, 10000 and 15000. A discrete Adjoint-FEM formulation with gradient regularization based on the $H^1$-seminorm provides an independent inverse-method comparison. Transfer learning is investigated under two source-target conditions: transfer between noise levels at the same Reynolds number, and transfer from a controlled Gaussian-profile problem to CFD-CHT-derived target problems at different Reynolds numbers. For the representative Re = 5000 target with 5% measurement noise, quadratic, PWL, and neural-network PINNs achieve relative HTC-profile errors of 5.08, 5.31 and 5.19%, respectively, while generalized representations reduce the error for the Re = 15000 target from 16.76% for the quadratic PINN to 14.41% and 14.46%. Transfer learning reduces target-training time by 57.86-81.71% for fixed-Reynolds-number transfer and by 50.59-84.94% for Gaussian-to-CHT transfer. Its effect on reconstruction accuracy is target dependent: fixed-profile PWL transfer remains within 0.30 percentage points of scratch training, whereas Gaussian-to-CHT transfer produces differences of 0.10-1.52 percentage points across targets and representations. These results demonstrate that generalized PINN representations can accommodate spatially varying HTC profiles without a prescribed quadratic form, while transfer learning can substantially reduce target-training cost for repeated inverse estimation, with the resulting reconstruction accuracy depending on source-target compatibility.

</details>


### [2] [MDN-VJEPA: Multimodal Probabilistic Joint-Embedding World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13956)
*Yongchao Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MDN-VJEPA，将 VJEPA 的隐预测器实例化为混合密度网络，用高斯混合表示多模态未来，并在轨迹层面与多时域组合层面施加一致性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率化 JEPA（VJEPA）虽赋予预测概率语义，但通常以单一分布刻画未来，无法显式区分构成不确定性的多个互异未来模式；且在序列预测中缺乏轨迹级的时间连贯性与多时域传播的组合一致性。

Method: 将 VJEPA 的隐预测器实例化为混合密度网络（MDN），以高斯混合编码备选未来的模式、模式概率及模式内不确定性；针对序列预测引入两项结构约束：多模态未来在轨迹上的时间连贯性耦合，以及受 Chapman-Kolmogorov 方程启发的不同时序路径组合到同一时域时预测信念的一致性，从而形成"多模态预测—连贯多模态轨迹—组合一致多模态动力学"三层级。

Result: 受控实验表明：MDN-VJEPA 能较好恢复已知的分叉预测规律；在分叉未来下，保留完整多模态信念而非其条件均值可带来显著不同且更优的规划决策；轨迹级耦合与分布一致性提升了时间连贯性与多时域一致性。

Conclusion: 概率 JEPA 不应只保留未来的不确定性程度，还应保留哪些互异未来构成该不确定性、它们如何构成连贯轨迹，以及这些信念如何随时间组合。

Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) learn world models by predicting future representations rather than reconstructing observations. Variational JEPA (VJEPA) gives this prediction probabilistic semantics and permits flexible conditional predictive families. We propose MDN-VJEPA, a multimodal probabilistic JEPA that instantiates the latent predictor as a mixture density network (MDN), representing future states with a Gaussian mixture whose components encode alternative futures, their probabilities, and within-mode uncertainty. For sequential prediction, we address two additional structural requirements: multi-modal futures should remain temporally coherent across a trajectory, and predictive beliefs should remain consistent when propagated to the same horizon through different temporal path compositions, as motivated by the Chapman--Kolmogorov equation. Together, these considerations define a three-level hierarchy of multimodal prediction, coherent multimodal trajectories, and compositionally consistent multimodal dynamics. Controlled experiments show that MDN-VJEPA closely recovers known branching predictive laws, that retaining the complete multimodal belief rather than its conditional mean can lead to materially different and substantially better planning decisions under branching futures, and that trajectory-level coupling and distributional consistency improve temporal coherence and multi-horizon agreement. These results support a simple principle: a probabilistic JEPA should preserve not only how uncertain the future is, but which distinct futures constitute that uncertainty, how they form coherent trajectories, and how those beliefs compose through time.

</details>


### [3] [LACRM: LLM-Guided Mining of Directed Advertiser Competition Relationships in E-Commerce Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13959)
*Xiang Shi,Yitian Kou,Bing Li,Shengsheng Niu,Chun Gan,Linghui Meng,Jie He,Zhangang Lin,Ching Law*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 LACRM 框架，利用 LLM 驱动的角色分离画像、非对称多路径检索与 listwise 排序学习，构建带连续边强度的有向广告主竞争图，并在离线检索、多模型/人工评估及线上 A/B 实验中验证其有效性与商业价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商广告平台在优化决策时通常未建模广告主之间的外部性，而广告主实际表现高度受同用户竞争者的影响；这类竞争关系具有有向性、多面性与部分可观测性，现有交互图、分类规则和单一嵌入模型难以完整刻画，因此需要一个可复用的显式竞争信号。

Method: LACRM 采用三阶段流水线构建带连续边强度的有向竞争图：（1）LLM 驱动的角色分离画像，突破对称相似度限制；（2）基于该画像的非对称多路径检索，挖掘已实现与潜在竞争者；（3）结合时序竞价行为的 listwise learning-to-rank，精确建模有向竞争强度。

Result: 在工业级基准的离线检索实验中，LACRM 优于强有向 GNN 基线及消融变体；多 LLM 与人工研究证明所恢复的潜在竞争者反映真实市场竞争而非模型生成伪影；线上 A/B 测试中，LACRM 引导的竞价与激励分配分别提升广告收入 1.73% 与 1.14%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在大规模广告系统中显式建模竞争关系具有实际应用价值，LACRM 能有效捕捉广告主之间的有向竞争并带来可观的商业收益。

Abstract: In e-commerce advertising, ad platforms typically fail to model the externalities among advertisers when making optimization decisions: an advertiser's actual performance is largely shaped by rivals competing for the same users; these rivals typically operate in overlapping product categories and at comparable budget scales. However, capturing this rivalry as an explicit, reusable signal is challenging because it is directed, multi-faceted, and partially observable. Existing paradigms such as interaction graphs, taxonomy rules, and single-embedding models do not fully capture these properties. In this paper, we propose LACRM (LLM-driven Advertiser Competition Relationship Mining), a novel framework that constructs directed competition graphs with continuous edge intensities via a three-stage pipeline. LACRM moves beyond symmetric similarity through LLM-driven role-separated profiling, which enables asymmetric multi-route retrieval to uncover both realized and latent rivals. The framework further incorporates listwise learning-to-rank aligned with temporal auction behavior to accurately model directed competition intensity. In offline retrieval experiments on an industrial benchmark, LACRM outperforms strong directed GNN baselines and ablation variants. Multi-LLM and human studies provide complementary evidence that the recovered latent rivals reflect meaningful market competition rather than merely model-generated artifacts. In production A/B tests, LACRM-guided bidding and incentive allocation increase advertising revenue by 1.73% and 1.14%, respectively. The results demonstrate the practical value of explicit competition modeling in large-scale advertising systems.

</details>


### [4] [MRFlow: Mechanism-Structured Residual Flow Matching for Virtual Cell Perturbation Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13966)
*Haojie Yang,Ran Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MRFlow将虚拟细胞预测建模为单细胞测度间的条件传输，用变分隐空间、条件流匹配向量场及机制结构化仿射字典来实现扰动响应预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有单细胞模型多将每个扰动条件简化为平均表达偏移，这与扰动生物学本质不符：同一干预下可能共存稀有状态、耐药亚群及依赖上下文的不同效应量。

Method: 将对照与扰动细胞嵌入变分隐状态空间；在分离的小批量状态上构建贪心低成本监督；以条件流匹配向量场将对照群体传输至扰动群体。该场分解为两部分：机制结构化仿射字典（重组共享隐响应算子与低秩条件特异校正）及谱控残差场（刻画非线性细胞级变异）。遗传扰动用调控图GCN编码，化学扰动用Morgan指纹编码，二者接入同一条件动力学接口。

Result: 在八个基因与药物扰动基准上，MRFlow取得最高综合评分，同时在差异表达与分布类指标上保持有竞争力的原始性能。

Conclusion: 结果表明，隐分布传输是面向扰动感知的虚拟细胞建模的一种有原理依据且经验上有效的建模范式。

Abstract: Predicting cellular responses to chemical and genetic perturbations is a central test for AI virtual cells, yet many single-cell models reduce each condition to an average expression shift. This target is misaligned with perturbation biology: rare states, resistant subpopulations, and context-dependent effect sizes may coexist under the same intervention. MRFlow treats virtual-cell prediction as conditional transport between empirical single-cell measures. Control and perturbed cells are embedded in a variational latent state space, greedy low-cost supervision is constructed over detached minibatch states, and a conditional flow-matching vector field transports control populations toward perturbed populations. The field decomposes into a mechanism-structured affine dictionary, which recombines shared latent response operators with a low-rank condition-specific correction, and a spectrally controlled residual field for nonlinear cell-level variation. Genetic perturbations are encoded through a regulatory-graph GCN, chemical perturbations through Morgan fingerprints, and both enter the same conditional dynamics interface. Across eight gene and drug perturbation benchmarks, MRFlow attains the highest composite score while preserving competitive raw performance on differential-expression and distributional metrics. The results support latent distribution transport as a principled and empirically effective formulation for perturbation-aware virtual cell modeling.

</details>


### [5] [PRIME: Frequency-Aware Unified Pruning and Merging for MoE Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13982)
*Shanfeng Huang,Rongqian Zhang,Zhou Fang,Song Xiao,Hai Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PRIME，一个通过自适应剪枝与合并融合的MoE压缩统一优化框架，将剪枝-合并离散分配建模为基于频率加权代理目标的全局整数线性规划，实现联合决策并提升路由稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型虽能有效扩展大语言模型，但其庞大参数量带来严峻的部署内存挑战。现有压缩方法通常将专家剪枝与合并视为互不相关的操作，并依赖贪心启发式策略，容易导致不可逆的信息损失或表示污染。

Method: PRIME将离散的剪枝-合并分配步骤建模为针对频率加权代理目标的全局整数线性规划，联合选择剪枝与合并决策并考虑专家使用频率；通过固定代表分配下的误差界分析为频率感知目标提供理论动机，使公式倾向于选择高频专家作为聚类中心，从而促进路由稳定性。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和Qwen3.5-122B-A10B上的大量实验表明，PRIME在知识、代码、数学和长上下文任务中均保持较强准确率；合并模型的服务基准测试在vLLM中量化了专家压缩带来的内存与吞吐收益。

Conclusion: PRIME通过统一的剪枝-合并优化框架，克服了传统分离式贪心方法的局限，在保持下游任务精度的同时有效降低MoE模型的内存占用并提升服务吞吐，为MoE压缩提供了理论支撑与实践验证。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have emerged as an effective paradigm for scaling large language models, yet their massive parameter footprint poses severe memory challenges for deployment. Existing compression methods typically treat expert pruning and merging as disjoint operations and rely on greedy heuristics, often leading to irreversible information loss or representational pollution. In this paper, we propose PRIME, a unified optimization framework for MoE compression via adaptive PRunIng and MErging. PRIME casts the discrete prune-merge assignment step as a global Integer Linear Programming over a frequency-weighted surrogate objective, jointly selecting pruning and merging decisions while accounting for expert usage. We motivate the frequency-aware objective through an error-bound analysis under fixed representative assignments, and show that the formulation favors high-frequency experts as centroids, promoting routing stability. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B demonstrate that PRIME achieves strong accuracy retention across knowledge, coding, math, and long-context tasks, while serving benchmarks of merged models quantify the memory and throughput benefits of expert compression in vLLM.

</details>


### [6] [DoSA: Dots Sparse Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13990)
*Fanxu Meng,Taosong Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DoSA（Dots Sparse Attention），一种无损的方法，通过“证书”机制将 Top-K 稀疏注意力的评分计算条件化，在保持精确 token 选择的前提下加速 Indexer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏注意力只访问少量 key，但找到这些 key 仍需每个 indexer head 对每个 key 进行评分，计算开销大。目标是让这一评分过程条件化，同时不损失精度（保持精确的 token 选择）。

Method: 核心观察：Top-K 选择只需要足够证据来拒绝候选，而非其完整分数。方法用种子集给出获胜阈值的下界；用非负 head 投影与联合残差界给出正贡献的上界；用激活信息聚合给出负 head 所减量的幅度界。该“证书”将完整评分导向仍然合格的候选，并辅以精确分数过滤减少写回与选择开销。理论层面建立证书及其精确选择条件，并分析几何与选择间隔如何影响其有效性。

Result: GPU 实现使完整 Indexer 相比 SGLang 最高加速 2.74 倍，相比 LiteTopK 最高 1.69 倍（覆盖英文、中文与代码负载）。在 GLM-5.2 与 DeepSeek-V3.2 上的端到端评估中，首 token 延迟（TTFT）分别相比两个基线最高加速 1.94 倍和 1.50 倍。

Conclusion: DoSA 通过证据驱动的条件评分实现无损稀疏注意力加速，在 Indexer 与端到端推理上均取得显著提速，且保持精确选择。

Abstract: Sparse attention visits few keys, yet finding them can still require scoring every key with every indexer head. We introduce DoSA (Dots Sparse Attention), a lossless method for making this computation conditional while preserving exact token selection. Its central observation is that Top-K selection requires sufficient evidence to reject a candidate, not necessarily its full score. A seed set supplies a lower bound on the winning threshold. Nonnegative head projections and joint residual bounds upper-bound positive contributions, while activation-informed aggregation bounds the magnitude subtracted by negative heads. The certificate directs full scoring toward candidates that remain eligible; exact-score filtering further reduces writeback and selection work. We establish the certificate and its exact-selection conditions, and analyze how geometry and selection margins govern its effectiveness. Our GPU implementation accelerates the complete Indexer by up to 2.74 times over SGLang and 1.69 times over LiteTopK across English, Chinese, and code workloads. End-to-end evaluation on GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-V3.2 achieves up to 1.94 times and 1.50 times time-to-first-token speedups over the two baselines, respectively.

</details>


### [7] [Predict Before You Modify: Learning Improvement Dynamics for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13991)
*Zixuan Xie,Chang Xu,Yuhua Jiang,Li Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"预测式自进化"方法，通过可编辑的改进动态模型（IDM）在评估前预测修改的任务级结果并指导修正，评估后利用历史修改-结果数据更新IDM，实现预测知识跨代积累，在四个领域均优于HyperAgents。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化智能体仅在代价高昂的评估之后才能获得修改反馈，且聚合得分掩盖了不同失败之间所需修复方式的差异，导致反馈延迟、信息粒度粗糙、进化效率低。

Method: 引入可编辑的改进动态模型（IDM），在评估前预测所提修改的任务级结果并引导可选修正；评估后，用过去的修改及其观测结果来改进IDM，使预测知识跨代累积。系统由此同时改进任务求解、修改提议和效果预测三个环节。基于HyperAgents实现并在多语言编程、论文评审、机器人奖励设计、奥林匹克级数学评分四类任务上评测。

Result: 在四个领域均优于HyperAgents，跨代平均性能最高提升46%；在包含智能体进化和任务评估的同等token预算下优势仍成立，并能泛化到留出任务；随着IDM进化，预测精度提升，学到的预测知识可迁移以改进新领域的进化。

Conclusion: 将预测建模引入自进化循环，把"评估后反馈"前移为"评估前预测"，并将评估结果转化为可累积、可迁移的预测知识，是一条提升自进化智能体效率与泛化性的有效路径。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents improve through repeated cycles of modification and evaluation. However, existing methods receive feedback on modifications only after costly evaluations, and aggregate scores may obscure distinctions between failures that require different repairs. We introduce predictive self-evolution through an editable Improvement Dynamics Model (IDM). Before evaluation, the IDM predicts task-level outcomes of a proposed modification and guides an optional revision. After evaluation, past modifications and their observed outcomes are used to improve the IDM, allowing predictive knowledge to accumulate across generations. The system can thus improve how it solves tasks, proposes modifications, and predicts their effects. Building on HyperAgents, we evaluate this approach across multilingual coding, paper review, robotics reward design, and Olympiad-level mathematical grading. Our approach outperforms HyperAgents across all four domains, with up to 46% higher average performance over generations. Gains also persist under matched token budgets that include both agent evolution and task evaluation, and extend to held-out tasks. Forecast accuracy improves as the IDM evolves, and the learned predictive knowledge transfers to improve evolution in a new domain.

</details>


### [8] [Posterior Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13994)
*Chenrui Ma,Xi Xiao,Lin Zhao,Xinru Jiang,Tianyang Wang,Yanning Shen,Ferdinando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Posterior Flow Matching (PFM)，在流匹配框架中用高斯后验模型同时学习条件速度均值与逐分量方差，使单次模型评估即可给出传输预测与端点不确定性，并支持均值驱动 ODE 与后验驱动 SDE 两种生成方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配学习从噪声到数据的传输，但其均值预测无法直接反映中间状态处剩余的端点不确定性，缺乏可用的不确定性诊断信息。

Method: 以高斯后验建模条件速度的均值与逐分量方差；同一模型评估同时输出传输预测与端点不确定性；基于学习到的矩构建均值驱动的 ODE 与后验驱动的 SDE，其中 SDE 的局部噪声尺度随预测不确定性自适应调整。

Result: 在图像、点云、分子与动作生成任务上，PFM 提升了生成质量，并可在整个生成过程中提供端点后验读值。

Conclusion: PFM 将不确定性估计内嵌于流匹配的生成过程，使生成质量与过程可诊断性同时得到改善。

Abstract: Flow matching learns how to transport noise toward data, but its mean prediction does not directly report the endpoint uncertainty remaining at an intermediate state. This paper introduces Posterior Flow Matching (PFM), a general generative modeling framework that learns conditional velocity means and componentwise variances with a Gaussian posterior model. The same model evaluation supplies both a transport prediction and endpoint uncertainty, making posterior diagnostics available throughout generation. These learned moments support a mean-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) and a posterior-driven stochastic differential equation (SDE), whose local noise scales adapt to the predicted uncertainty. Across image, point-cloud, molecular, and action generation, PFM improves generation quality and provides endpoint-posterior readouts throughout generation.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning methods such as GRPO train large language model (LLM) agents by comparing rollouts for the same task. We ask: after repairing a student failure, when should control return to the student? We propose outcome-verified teacher-student handoff, instantiated in Verified Handoff for Group Policy Optimization (VH-GPO). The teacher provides enough support to reach a state from which the student can succeed, then returns control so that successful experience is again student-generated. Given an environment-verified teacher recovery, VH-GPO selects the earliest independently confirmed handoff point found within a bounded search budget. With Qwen2.5-1.5B, VH-GPO increases success rates over GRPO from 59.38% to 94.79% on ALFWorld and from 71.62% to 77.34% on WebShop. Improvements also hold with the 7B student, for which additional teacher and student output tokens amount to 1.77% and 2.61% of regular student rollout output tokens on ALFWorld and WebShop, respectively. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the key components. These results support using verified teacher assistance to repair failures while reinforcing the student's ability to complete tasks independently.

</details>


### [14] [PreSO: Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14001)
*Yuhang Yang,Mingxuan Xia,Chao Ye,Shuai Zhu,Shouqing Yang,Haobo Wang,Shenzhi Yang,Zhengqing Zang,Chenglong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PreSO方法，利用紧凑提示（hint）产生的表示偏移更具集中性和跨题方向一致性这一发现，将特权信息诱导的修正投影到跨题共享的低秩子空间，作为表示级自蒸馏目标。在五个竞赛级数学基准上，Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B分别较基座模型平均提升6.8、9.0、10.0个点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy自蒸馏（OPSD）借助以特权信息为条件的自教师，将RLVR的稀疏结果信号转化为稠密的token级监督。但教师的优势可能依赖学生推理时无法获得的信息，因此核心问题是：哪些特权变化值得蒸馏？即需要甄别可复用、可迁移的特权信息，避免把仅与具体题目相关、推理时不可得的解特定细节注入学生表示。

Method: 以跨题重复出现（cross-problem recurrence）作为可复用指导的经验线索。比较完整解答与紧凑提示所诱导的表示偏移，发现hint诱导的偏移更集中、跨题方向更一致。据此提出PreSO：(1) 在源头使用紧凑提示，限制解特定细节进入特权偏移；(2) 在目标端，从相关题目的偏移池中估计主导低秩子空间，将特权诱导的修正投影到该子空间，并加到学生无特权表示上，形成表示级蒸馏目标。该子空间作为重复结构的操作代理，而非可迁移/实例特定信息的严格分离。

Result: 在五个竞赛级数学基准上，PreSO在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B上均稳定优于强基线，较基座模型平均准确率分别提升6.8、9.0、10.0个点。除峰值准确率外，PreSO在每个模型规模上均取得最高的最终检查点平均分，且改进能持续到训练结束。

Conclusion: 以紧凑提示限制特权细节、并在跨题共享低秩子空间上投影特权修正，是一种有效的表示级自蒸馏策略；其收益不仅体现在峰值精度，更体现在训练的持续性与最终检查点表现上，说明筛选"值得蒸馏的特权变化"比无差别注入完整解答信息更优。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) uses a self-teacher conditioned on privileged information to turn the sparse outcome signal of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) into dense token-level supervision. Yet the teacher's advantage may depend on information unavailable to the student at inference, raising a central question: which privileged changes are worth distilling? We use cross-problem recurrence as an empirical cue for potentially reusable guidance. Comparing the representation shifts induced by full solutions and compact hints, we find that hint-induced shifts are more concentrated and directionally consistent across problems, and yield more sustained downstream gains despite revealing less information. Motivated by this association, we propose Privileged Representation Isolation for On-Policy Self-Distillation (PreSO). At the source, PreSO uses compact hints to limit the solution-specific detail entering the privileged shift. At the target, it estimates a leading low-rank subspace from shifts pooled across related problems, projects the privilege-induced correction onto this subspace, and adds it to the student's unprivileged representation to form the representation-level distillation target. The selected subspace serves as an operational proxy for recurring structure, rather than a guaranteed separation of transferable and instance-specific information. On five competition-level mathematics benchmarks, PreSO consistently outperforms strong baselines across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B, improving average accuracy over the base model by 6.8, 9.0, and 10.0 points. Beyond peak accuracy, PreSO attains the highest final-checkpoint average at every model scale, with improvements that persist through the end of training.

</details>

Conclusion: 示范中的"教学意图"会显著改变示范行为，贝叶斯建模能够刻画这一差异；区分showing与doing对IRL具有实际价值，有助于提升机器从人类示范中学习的效率。

Abstract: People often learn from others' demonstrations, and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) techniques have realized this capacity in machines. In contrast, teaching by demonstration has been less well studied computationally. Here, we develop a Bayesian model for teaching by demonstration. Stark differences arise when demonstrators are intentionally teaching (i.e. showing) a task versus simply performing (i.e. doing) a task. In two experiments, we show that human participants modify their teaching behavior consistent with the predictions of our model. Further, we show that even standard IRL algorithms benefit when learning from showing versus doing.

</details>


### [16] [Coding LLMs Can Be Harnessed to Learn Interpretable Models from Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14006)
*Aditya Kumar,Cassandra A. Cohen,William W. Cohen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种简单框架：给定带标签样本，反复提示编码LLM生成规则集中的下一条规则，从而学习可解释分类器。该方法在表格数据上与SOTA规则学习相当甚至更优（小样本尤甚），在文本任务上大幅领先（包括另一LLM规则学习器），并优于标准harness，还能产生新型可解释模型。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: A familiar line of reasoning runs as follows: language models are flexible approximators trained under a strictly proper loss, so scale brings them closer to Solomonoff induction, and their predictive success is evidence of that approach. Nor could the offered routes certify even that: finite evaluation cannot certify agreement on rarely reached contexts, perfect corpus fit selects the corpus law as prior, and asymptotic criteria cannot see the constants that carry Solomonoff's guarantee. Our lens is the Kraft inequality read for predictors. Every model has at most the same budget of predictive success, so Solomonoff's predictor, which leaves part of it unspent, differs from a language model not in having more of it but in where it spends it; on mutually singular families this is exact, and only full-mass Bayes mixtures reach the frontier. We then discuss what is inheritable, including in-context learning as amortised Bayesian inference; what survives within a context window; which Solomonoff-like properties a deployed system should have or avoid; and what served conditionals determine. A closing table states what common practices certify and what to report. Tests are developed in a companion paper.

</details>

Abstract: Large AI models increasingly rely on distributed GPU execution, yet it remains unclear whether established failure analysis methods transfer effectively to this setting. We introduce GF-Bench, a PyTorch-based framework and dataset for generating diverse failures in distributed GPU workloads. The framework supports extensible workload and fault-injection logic; based on this design, the current release targets failures visible in multi-GPU communication logs and provides 220 labeled two-GPU executions covering normal runs, CUDA out-of-memory fail-stop failures, and persistent straggler fail-slow failures. On parsed inputs, no method reliably detects both failure classes, and the highest overall F1 score is 0.667. Raw inputs raise the overall F1 score of in-context LogPrompt to 0.983, at 9.0x its average input-token usage and 8.7x its per-run cost. These results expose a substantial trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency: generic log parsing lowers operational cost but discards the distributed execution context required for accurate failure detection. TL;DR: 本文提出SIRNET框架，通过为预训练代理嵌入学习共享适配器，联合优化结果预测、处理倾向和分组代理边缘化任务，实现基于非结构化后处理代理变量的神经因果估计，并在合成、半合成及A4试验数据上验证了性能。

Abstract: Modern experiments increasingly produce rich post-treatment objects---such as text, images, and video---that may provide early surrogate signals for outcomes that are delayed, expensive, or observed only for a subset of participants. A pretrained encoder can turn such an object into a strong generic embedding, but the embedding is not trained for the estimation tasks required by a causal estimator and may emphasize information irrelevant to the causal target. We propose SIRNET, a Surrogate-Informed Representation adaptation framework for neural-NETwork-based causal estimation in the presence of unstructured post-treatment surrogates. Starting from pretrained surrogate embeddings, SIRNET learns a shared adapter jointly for outcome prediction, treatment propensity, and arm-specific surrogate marginalization, beyond the generic pretraining objective. The resulting covariate and surrogate representations provide a common interface for these nuisance tasks. The final treatment-effect estimate and confidence interval are obtained from cross-fitted orthogonal scores that attain the semiparametric efficiency bound under the stated nuisance-rate conditions. We also validate SIRNET's performance in synthetic and semisynthetic experiments, as well as the Anti-Amyloid in Asymptomatic Alzheimer's Disease (A4) trial, using frozen pretrained brain-MRI embeddings as surrogates for a long-term outcome.

*Yusuke Hayashi*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在概率PCA的所有75个设置中，变分间隙都能认证训练后的编码器，一致性介于0.76到0.97之间。在240个训练VAE中，由码率和数据集规模设定的下界提前排除了66个模型在码率侧认证的可能性，且这66个模型确实无一通过认证。

Conclusion: 标准训练报告不足以判定VAE编码一致性；利用ELBO的变分间隙与码率可对一致性给出可证明的界限。由此提出"Certify-or-Measure"协议，适用于任何将VAE作为码读取的流水线。

Abstract: Many systems read the latent space of a variational autoencoder (VAE) as discrete codes, and rely on each latent being read back as the code it was written as. Shannon (1948) took such a shared codebook as given; inside a VAE nothing enforces it. We prove that no item of a standard training report can reveal whether the written and read codes agree on encoded data. We construct two VAEs that reconstruct every input perfectly, infer exactly, and match on every per-example ELBO and every code histogram, yet agreement is one in the first and zero in the second. We then show that the ELBO's own terms bound how far a measured agreement can move: the variational gap bounds the shift to exact inference, and the rate bounds the shift to generation from the prior. For Gaussian posteriors, a mean-field encoder pays an exact price in the gap that depends on its choice of axes. On probabilistic PCA the gap certifies a trained encoder in all 75 settings we test, at agreement between 0.76 and 0.97. On 240 trained VAEs, a floor set by the rate and the dataset size rules out rate-side certification in advance for 66 models, and none of them certifies. The results yield a simple protocol, Certify-or-Measure, for any pipeline that reads a VAE as codes.

</details>

Abstract: Accurate day-ahead photovoltaic (PV) power forecasting requires both strong temporal modeling and adherence to physical PV system constraints. Purely data-driven models often ignore the underlying PV conversion process and may produce predictions that are outside the operational range of a PV system. In this paper, we propose a physics-informed state space framework that combines a differentiable PV conversion model with a selective state space backbone (PowerMamba). Our approach follows a physics-residual decomposition. The physics module provides a structured baseline based on solar geometry, irradiance, temperature effects, and inverter limits, while the state space model learns residual corrections from numerical weather prediction (NWP) inputs over a 24-hour horizon. Experiments on one year of utility-scale PV data show that the proposed method significantly improves forecasting accuracy, reducing RMSE by 38.5% and MAE by 45.8% compared to a physics-only baseline, and outperforming a purely data-driven model. Results further show that incorporating system-level physics provides the largest performance gains, while additional refinements offer only marginal improvements. Beyond accuracy, the model improves robustness by constraining predictions toward physical feasibility, reducing unrealistic predictions under corrupted measurements.

*Guan-Yi Jhang,Chiencheng Chiang,Wei-Kai Chen,Hui-Ching Yu,Hsu-Chao Lai,Hwai-Jung Hsu,Wang Chih-Chuan,Jhy-Cheng Huang,Jiun-Long Huang*

Abstract: Most existing sports datasets are individual-centric or ball-centric, focusing on individual player actions while ignoring interactions among teammates. In badminton doubles, tactical success is governed by rapid team formation and coordination, yet standard resources for modeling these player interactions are scarce. To bridge this gap, we present DShuttleNet, a comprehensive dataset for badminton doubles curated from elite BWF World Tour tournaments. Beyond trajectory data, DShuttleNet uniquely incorporates expert-labeled "Loss Reasons," transforming the dataset into a diagnostic tool for causal tactical evaluation. We formally define two geometry-driven representations, Teammate-Relative Angle (TRA) and Vertical Shot Angle (VSA), to characterize coordination and shot aggressiveness. To quantify interpersonal synergy, we introduce novel metrics, Court Coverage Efficacy Index (CCEI) and Threat Load Asymmetry Index (TLAI), which evaluate the often-overlooked non-hitting partner's role and defensive coordination. Experimental results demonstrate that conventional models suffer from underfitting when failing to incorporate these coordination-centric features, highlighting the critical importance and potential impact of releasing DShuttleNet. Dataset is available at: https://doi.org/10.34740/kaggle/dsv/16097938.

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调视觉模型在分布偏移（OOD）下性能下降，而现有权重合并方法存在局限：Model Soup通常依赖大量微调检查点，Model Stock采用固定几何合并规则，缺乏对OOD验证反馈的自适应能力，且往往需要额外梯度训练或增加推理开销。因此需要一个轻量、事后、能利用OOD反馈自适应调整的权重空间方法。

Method: 给定预训练初始化与两个在源数据上微调的检查点，构造重心候选权重，并沿每个候选与预训练模型相连的方向执行小型无导数搜索。方法借鉴基于单纯形的无导数优化（Nelder-Mead、Torczon多方向搜索），但针对神经网络权重合并的几何特性做了专门化。用少量一个或多个OOD数据集的小验证子集选择候选权重，再在其余留出部分、额外OOD基准和ImageNet验证集上评估鲁棒性-准确率权衡。

Result: 在CLIP ViT-B/32上的实验显示：所提搜索显著提升留出OOD数据（含ImageNet-A、ImageNet-R、ImageNet-Sketch）的表现，同时保持ImageNet准确率具有竞争力。所得权重还能提升对候选选择阶段未使用OOD数据集的迁移性能，优于原始微调检查点、朴素model soup与Model Stock。

Conclusion: 在锚定权重空间中进行轻量优化，为固定权重平均规则、几何合并或单模型选择提供了实用替代方案，表明无梯度的事后权重空间搜索可有效改善分布偏移下的鲁棒性且不增加推理成本。

Abstract: We propose Barycentric Anchored Search, a post-hoc weight-space procedure for improving fine-tuned vision models under distribution shift without additional gradient training or increased inference cost. Given a pre-trained initialization and two checkpoints fine-tuned on a source dataset, the method constructs barycentric candidate weights and performs a small derivative-free search along directions connecting each candidate to the pre-trained model. Candidate weights are selected using a small validation subset of one or more out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets; the selected model is then evaluated on the held-out portions of those datasets, on additional OOD benchmarks, and on the ImageNet validation set to quantify the robustness-accuracy trade-off. The method is inspired by simplex-based derivative-free optimization, including Nelder-Mead and Torczon multidirectional search, but is specialized to the geometry of neural network weight merging. Unlike Model Soup, which typically benefits from many fine-tuned checkpoints, and unlike Model Stock, which applies a fixed geometric merge, our approach uses only two fine-tuned checkpoints and iteratively adapts the merge using validation feedback from OOD data. Experiments with CLIP ViT-B/32 show that the proposed search substantially improves performance on held-out OOD data, including ImageNet-A, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-Sketch, while keeping ImageNet accuracy competitive. The resulting weights also improve transfer to OOD datasets not used during candidate selection, outperforming the original fine-tuned checkpoints, naive model soups, and Model Stock in our evaluations. These results suggest that lightweight optimization in anchored weight space provides a practical alternative to fixed weight-averaging rules, geometric merging, or single-model selection.

</details>


### [24] [CoEvoke: Evoking Multi-Agent Collaboration for Trajectory Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14021)
*Lin Wu,Shu Yao,Yuheng Wang,Jingru Fan,Huatao Li,Yihan Li,Liu Yixuan,Cheng Liu,Jian Chang,Zeyu Zhao,Aohua Zhang,Huiying Zhao,Shuyuan Zhu,Chen Qian*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协作训练需要包含检查、反馈与修复的轨迹，但常规任务求解rollout往往以立即通过或重复无效尝试告终，缺乏有效纠错信号，因此需要设计轨迹采集条件来获得纠正性监督。

Method: CoEvoke框架：通过受控扰动制造可恢复的困难，并用受限的、基于参考的引导来定向调查过程；在4130个软件工程与推理任务上构建4567条可重建轨迹，将公开交互与证据、决策和任务原生结果关联。随后在控制训练任务、决策记录数与更新次数的条件下，进行扰动增强的判官训练与SWE验证器训练。

Result: 2287对同任务实验显示，七个扰动组的反馈增益达47.72–100个百分点，引导效应较小且依赖模型；扰动增强判官训练将ACPBench-Hard成功率从35.38%提升至42.12%（+6.73点）；SWE验证器训练相比接口匹配的未训练参考提升7.60–9.40点。工作流与后训练评估在无扰动输入、无私有参考引导下保持任务求解拓扑。

Conclusion: 设计轨迹采集条件可获得纠正性监督，从而在冻结求解智能体的前提下改进协作决策，支持以采集条件设计驱动多智能体协作训练的思路。

Abstract: Training multi-agent collaboration requires trajectories of checking, feedback, and repair, yet task-solving rollouts may end in immediate approval or repeat unsuccessful attempts without useful correction. We introduce CoEvoke, a cross-domain framework that evokes these interactions during trajectory collection. Controlled perturbations create recoverable difficulties, while restricted reference-based guidance directs investigation. The resulting dataset contains 4,567 reconstructable trajectories over 4,130 software-engineering and reasoning tasks, linking public interactions to evidence, decisions, and task-native outcomes. Separate experiments over 2,287 same-task pairs show feedback increases of 47.72-100 percentage points across seven perturbation groups; guidance has smaller, model-dependent effects. With identical training tasks, decision-record counts, and updates, perturbation-enriched judge training improves ACPBench-Hard success from 35.38% to 42.12% (+6.73 points). SWE verifier training gains 7.60-9.40 points over interface-matched untrained references. ### [25] [OPMD: On-Policy Mechanism Distillation Beyond Output Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14022)
*Yingdong Shi,Zhihong Li,Changming Li,Jingyi Yu,Quan Li,Kan Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出On-Policy Mechanism Distillation (OPMD)，将on-policy蒸馏从仅监督输出空间扩展到对中间计算机制的监督，通过构建"学生兼容的教师"并沿学生自身轨迹内化中间状态，在三种师生设定下取得最优平均准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有on-policy distillation (OPD) 虽在学生自采样前缀上进行监督，但监督仍局限于输出空间，只传递"教师预测什么"，而无法监督产生这些预测的中间计算过程。而简单的表征匹配（representation matching）也不充分：师生表征可能存在几何差异，且即使隐状态对齐良好，也未必能被学生后续计算所利用。因此需要一种既传递中间计算、又兼顾学生可用性的监督方式。

Method: 提出OPMD：首先构建"学生兼容的教师"（student-compatible teacher），将教师表征转换为学生下游计算可用的中间状态；随后在on-policy轨迹上让学生内化这些状态，从而在输出监督之外实现机制层面的监督。

Result: 在所有评估的蒸馏基线中，OPMD在三种师生设定下均取得最高平均准确率，并可泛化到多教师蒸馏与跨家族监督微调（SFT）。进一步分析表明，机制监督带来更有效的推理，并切实改变了学生的中间计算与求解策略，证明其传递了超出输出监督的信息。

Conclusion: 结果确立了机制层面监督是推动on-policy蒸馏超越输出监督的有效途径，使学生能够学习并内化可用的内部机制。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves language-model by supervising a student on prefixes sampled from its own policy, but its supervision remains confined to the output space. Consequently, OPD transfers what a teacher predicts without supervising the intermediate computation that produces those predictions. Simply distilling intermediate representations like representation matching is insufficient since teacher and student representations may differ geometrically, and even well-aligned hidden states need not be usable by the student's subsequent computation. We introduce On-Policy Mechanism Distillation (OPMD), which transfers teacher-derived intermediate computation while explicitly accounting for its compatibility with the student. OPMD first constructs a student-compatible teacher that transforms teacher representations into intermediate states usable by the student's downstream computation, then it internalizes these states from on-policy trajectories. OPMD achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated distillation baselines in all three teacher--student settings, and generalizes to multi-teacher distillation and cross-family supervised fine-tuning. Further analyses show that mechanism supervision yields more effective reasoning and meaningfully alters the student's intermediate computation and solution strategies, supporting that it transfers information beyond output supervision alone. Together, these results establish mechanism-level supervision as an effective way to move on-policy distillation beyond output supervision, enabling students to learn inner mechanisms they can use and internalize.

</details>


### [26] [Historical Anchors for Scientific Forecasting on Human-Aware Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14023)
*Siu Tin Wu,Ryan C. Barron,Phoebe Upton Sanderbeck,Kim Ø. Rasmussen,George Tompkins,Maksim E. Eren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免未来标签的诊断指标QAA，用于选择路径采样预算并重排预测，提升科学连接预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学连接预测依赖从超图采样的路径训练嵌入，但性能对采样量高度敏感：过少导致表示不完整，过多反而削弱预测，而最优采样预算通常需等未来发现出现后才能确定。

Method: 提出Query–Anchor Agreement（QAA）诊断：无需未来标签或额外训练模型，比较模型对目标预测的候选与最相似于目标已知历史样例的候选，识别两种视角收敛点，用于选择采样预算，并融合两视角对预测重排（带锚点贡献上限的受限融合）。

Result: 在热电材料与COVID-19药物重定位基准、重复随机种子运行及三种采样策略下，QAA所选预算在广候选召回上平均仅落后事后最优选择1.86个百分点；受限融合在全部六种基准-策略设定中均提升广召回。

Conclusion: QAA可作为无需未来信息的有效采样预算选择与预测精化工具，稳健提升科学连接预测的候选召回。

Abstract: Predicting which scientific connections will form next can point researchers toward the most promising leads. One successful approach learns representations by sampling paths through publication networks, represented by a hypergraph, that connect scientific entities, concepts, and researchers, approximating how knowledge and expertise move through the literature. Sampled paths are then used to train an embedding model to forecast scientific connections such as a property of a material. Performance, however, depends strongly on how many paths are sampled: too little sampling yields incomplete representations, while further sampling can eventually weaken prediction quality. The best sampling budget is therefore often identifiable only after future discoveries are known. We introduce Query--Anchor Agreement (QAA), a diagnostic requiring no future labels or separately trained model. QAA can be used to select a sampling budget, and refine or re-rank the resulting forecast to improve forecasting scientific connections. QAA compares the candidates a model predicts for a target with those most similar to the target's known historical examples, and identifies when these two views converge. Across thermoelectric-material and COVID-19 drug-repurposing benchmarks, repeated random-seed runs, and three sampling policies, QAA-selected budgets fall on average 1.86 percentage points below hindsight-optimal selection for broad candidate recovery. Further, promoting candidates supported by both views, under a capped fusion that bounds the anchor contribution, improves broad recovery across all six benchmark-policy settings, which define the types of network walks used for sampling.

</details>


### [27] [Beyond a Better Score: Long-Horizon Agentic ML Development and Evaluation Protocol for Physics Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14024)
*Yue Ma,Lucas Venetoulias,Akbota Assan,Aobo Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SIDERIUS 智能体系统，通过合约化能力组合、多层科学评估协议与资源感知探索，推动 LLM 智能体在物理时间序列机器学习中从"刷分"转向长期有效的科学建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理时间序列数据（暗物质、中微子、引力波）中信号微弱、噪声复杂，ML 有潜力但现有 LLM 智能体系统主要被单一数值分数驱动，易出现走捷径、模式坍塌或钻评测空子等行为，产生高分但科学上无效的模型，因此需要超越分数、追求科学有效性的智能体方法。

Method: SIDERIUS 包含三部分：1）合约定义的可组合能力，支持灵活编排与人机协同（human-in-the-loop）；2）多层科学评估协议，可区分有效模型与不健康/钻空子模型；3）面向高计算成本科学 ML 的资源感知探索。

Result: 在 TIDMAD 基准上，使用 GPT 编排器的 SIDERIUS 达到最高有效模型提议率 63.8% 和最佳有效去噪分数 2.744；相同 GPT 模型使用通用 Codex 编码智能体时分别为 1.6% 和 -0.647。另在三个物理时间序列数据集上验证了可复用性与跨任务性能。

Conclusion: 智能体化科学 ML 的进展应超越单一分数，用智能体如何探索以及其产出模型是否可被信任为科学来衡量。

Abstract: Physics time-series data are central to fundamental discoveries involving dark matter, neutrinos, and gravitational waves. Machine learning has shown strong potential to recover weak scientific signals buried in complex noise. Recent LLM-agent systems further automate ML development, but existing approaches are often driven primarily by one or a few numerical scores. In pursuit of a better score, agents may exploit shortcuts, trigger mode collapse, or game the evaluation procedure, producing models that achieve high scores but are scientifically invalid. We introduce SIDERIUS, an LLM agent system designed to move beyond a better score toward scientifically valid, long-horizon ML development. SIDERIUS combines contract-defined composable capabilities for flexible orchestration and human-in-the-loop, a multi-layer scientific evaluation protocol that distinguishes valid models from unhealthy or gaming models, and resource-aware exploration for computationally expensive scientific ML. In our TIDMAD benchmark, SIDERIUS with a GPT-based orchestrator achieves the highest Valid-model proposal rate of 63.8% and the best valid denoising score of 2.744, compared with 1.6% and -0.647, respectively, for the same GPT model using the general-purpose Codex coding agent. We further benchmark SIDERIUS on three additional physics time-series datasets, demonstrating its reuse and performance across different tasks. Together, these results suggest that progress in agentic scientific ML should be measured beyond a better score, by how an agent explores and by whether the models it produces can be trusted as science.

</details>


### [28] [Contrastive Covariance Subspaces for Activation Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14025)
*Alexandros Xenos,Manos Plitsis,Niki Foteinopoulou,Yannis Panagakis,Ioannis Patras*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS)，通过对比方差目标求解低维子空间并对steering向量投影，以消除概念纠缠混淆，在12个模型-域设定上全面超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活steering通过向隐藏激活添加方向来控制大模型行为，但该方向常与无关混淆因素（如话题、写作风格）纠缠；这些混淆被一并注入残差流，损害生成质量。因此需要一种能"去混淆"、保留目标概念纯净信号的steering方法。

Method: Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS) 是一种免训练方法：通过求解对比方差目标，以闭式解获得低维子空间，并将steering向量投影到该子空间；该子空间保留目标概念变化的方向，抑制与其他类别共享的方向，从而消除混淆变化。

Result: 在3个LLM、4个steering域共12个设定中，CCS一致优于所有基线。AxBench与Emotion上相对最强基线提升48–70%和13–27%；较naive difference-of-means最高提升151%。玩具实验显示：植入话题混淆使未投影steering下降46%，CCS仅损失12%并逼近显式删除该方向的oracle。23名评分者、296条生成的人工研究复现了LLM评判排名；消融验证了各组件重要性及对混淆类数量的鲁棒性。此外CCS可扩展至多轮对话，保持概念表达与流畅性。

Conclusion: CCS通过闭式对比方差子空间投影有效去除概念混淆，显著且稳健地提升激活steering效果，并适用于多轮对话场景。

Abstract: Activation steering controls large language model behavior by adding a direction to hidden activations during inference. For steering to work well, that direction must be a pure signal for the target concept: any confound entangled with it, such as an incidental topic or writing style, is injected into the residual stream alongside the concept itself and degrades the generated text. We introduce Contrastive Covariance Steering (CCS), a training-free method that eliminates this confound variation. CCS projects steering vectors to a low-dimensional subspace obtained in closed form by solving a contrastive variance objective, which retains the directions along which the target concept varies while suppressing directions shared with the other classes. Across three LLMs and four steering domains, CCS consistently beats all baseline steering methods in all $12$ model-domain settings. The largest relative improvement occurs on AxBench and Emotion where we outperform the next strongest steering baseline by $48$ to $70\%$ and $13$ to $27\%$, respectively. Furthermore, CCS outperforms naive difference-of-means steering by up to $151\%$, showcasing the importance of deconfounding concepts. A toy experiment verifies our motivation on why: planting a topic nuisance into the training data reduces unprojected steering by $46\%$, whereas CCS loses only $12\%$ and recovers most of the gap to an oracle that explicitly deletes the planted direction. A human study with $23$ raters on $296$ generations reproduces the LLM judge's ranking. Our extensive ablation verifies the importance of our method's components and robustness to the number of nuisance classes. Finally, we extend our method to multi-turn conversations, where CCS sustains both concept expression and fluency, matching system prompt performance as other steering methods drift.

</details>


### [29] [Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14028)
*Luyang Zhang,Jialu Wang,Bebei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出组合数据选择（CDS）框架，将样本评分与子集选取分离并建模样本间非加性交互，进而提出 Mixture-then-Select 两阶段算法，在指令微调数据池上显著优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中 LLM 微调的数据池来自多个不同领域，评估覆盖多样任务，导致同一样本对不同任务帮助不同，且样本在训练中存在交互，子集价值不等于各样本价值之和。现有数据选择方法基本未处理这两点现实。

Method: 将问题形式化为组合数据选择（CDS）：把归因（如何给样本打分）与选择（选哪个子集）解耦，并建模样本间非加性交互。基于观察到的跨域互补性与域内冗余，提出 Mixture-then-Select 两阶段算法：先决定每个域的采样数量，再在各域内按归因分数排序选取样本。该框架还扩展到样本价格不同时的预算约束数据购买问题。

Result: 在真实指令微调数据池上发现显著的跨域互补性（联合效用超过各单样本之和）与域内冗余。Mixture-then-Select 比强基线提升 20%–54%，对归因方法稳健，并在不同模型与数据池规模下均有效。理论上，与最优子集的差距随选择规模线性增长且与数据池规模无关。

Conclusion: 在领域间分配选择额度是面向现代 LLM 实现更高效、更有效数据选择的有前景路径，CDS 框架为数据选择与预算受限的数据购买提供了统一视角。

Abstract: Data selection for LLM fine-tuning faces two facts about real training: data pools draw from many distinct domains, and evaluation spans diverse tasks. As a result, the same sample helps different tasks differently, and samples interact during training so that a subset's value is not the sum of its parts. Current data-selection methods leave these realities largely unaddressed. We formalize them as Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS), a framework that separates attribution (how samples are scored) from selection (which subset to pick) and models the non-additive interactions among samples. On a real instruction-tuning data pool, we find substantial cross-domain complementarity (joint utility exceeds the sum of singletons), alongside redundancy within domains. Inspired by this, we propose Mixture-then-Select, a two-stage algorithm that first decides how many samples to take from each domain, then ranks samples within each domain by attribution score. Theoretically, the gap to the optimal subset is linear in the selection size and independent of data pool size. Empirically, Mixture-then-Select outperforms strong baselines by 20 to 54%, is robust across attribution methods, and works across different models and data pool sizes. The framework also extends to the data purchasing problem under a budget constraint when sample prices vary. Our findings suggest that allocating selection across domains offers a promising path toward more efficient and effective data selection for modern LLMs.

</details>


### [30] [Can We Trust This Evaluation? Instance-Level Reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14029)
*Yang Ba,Michelle V. Mancenido,Rong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 SCUR（Structured Cross-fitted Uncertainty Risk），一种无标签方法，基于评委小组行为估计 LLM 作为评委评估中单个条目的可靠性，将小组不确定性、测量交叉熵与扰动敏感性三类信号融合为风险分数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-as-a-judge 评估通常将多位评委的决策聚合为多数投票，但小组决策并不能保证单个条目评估的可靠性，现有方法缺乏对实例级可靠性的无标签估计手段。

Method: 以潜在测量模型作为测量系统分析的骨干，SCUR 由此导出三类互补信号：小组不确定性、测量交叉熵和扰动敏感性，并将其组合为风险分数；采用交叉拟合（cross-fitted）策略，无需真实标签。

Result: 在五个真实基准上，通过多数投票错误排序、选择性信任和风险分层三类任务进行评估，SCUR 表现有效；并证明其在检测高一致性风险条目（其他 LLM-as-a-judge 方法的盲区）方面更有效。

Conclusion: SCUR 提供了一种标签无关的实例级评估可靠性估计方法，能够识别多数投票共识下仍存在风险的条目，弥补现有 LLM-as-a-judge 评估的盲点。

Abstract: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation commonly aggregates multiple judges' decisions into a majority vote, yet this panel decision process does not guarantee that the evaluation of an individual item is reliable. We propose Structured Cross-fitted Uncertainty Risk (SCUR), a label-free approach for estimating instance-level evaluation reliability based on the judge panel's behavior.   <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 在两种任务上取得性能提升：一是要求较高的状态跟踪形式，即在其余前缀已正确时的末 token 准确率；二是语言建模，即较早写入的信号需要在序列末尾被检索。

Conclusion: 循环步间残差映射的几何形式决定了循环结构能否有效跟踪状态；通过分块共形注入实现分组内旋转、赋予各组独立时间尺度，可在保持组内几何精确的同时提升状态跟踪与语言建模表现。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse one shared block across many recurrent steps, so depth becomes a quantity that can be spent at runtime rather than a stack of distinct layers.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Modern data pipelines increasingly combine human-created and human-curated data with AI-generated data for model training and evaluation. As datasets grow, they often add semantically redundant samples rather than expanding semantic coverage, which deteriorates the quality of the whole dataset. Existing diversity metrics primarily summarize lexical variation, entropy, or pairwise similarity, but provide limited characterization of the shape of the underlying data distribution. In this paper, we propose PLDiv, a diversity metric derived from persistence landscapes that quantifies the structural organization of a dataset from its geometric representation. PLDiv summarizes how data neighborhoods evolve as nearby samples progressively connect, producing an interpretable scalar measure of structural diversity without requiring task-specific supervision. Whether measuring intrinsic diversity in text generations or image embeddings, or detecting semantic collapse in instruction datasets and reasoning trajectories, PLDiv performs competitively against evaluated baselines and aligns strongly with diversity labels during semantic collapse. Consequently, it effectively supports applications in synthetic data monitoring, dataset construction, data augmentation, and generative model evaluation.

</details>

*Anish Diwan,Jan Peters,Oleg Arenz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将逆强化学习（IRL）的奖励更新置于占用度空间（occupancy space）视角下分析，提出用沿占用轨迹的平均Fisher信息对偶梯度做预条件，得到等价于旧奖励与新目标奖励凸插值的自然梯度式更新，并从镜像下降角度分析其收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典IRL通过拉格朗日优化、以梯度下降联合求解原始-对偶问题来获得最优奖励参数与最优策略。这种基于梯度的奖励更新视角影响深远，但只刻画了问题的一部分，忽视了占用度空间中的几何结构。作者希望从占用度空间几何出发，更完整地理解并改进IRL的奖励更新。

Method: 利用最优解及其在占用度空间中的几何已知这一洞见，作者证明沿e-测地线（占用度空间中的直线）趋向最优占用度的几何会直接影响IRL对偶问题在奖励参数空间中的梯度；据此提出以占用度轨迹上的平均Fisher信息对偶梯度进行预条件处理。

Result: 该预条件梯度恰好表现为旧奖励与新目标奖励的凸插值，从而得到计算开销很小的自然梯度式高效更新。进一步从镜像下降（MD）视角分析这些占用度空间的奖励更新，证明在由此产生的奖励上进行策略搜索可诱导策略上的近似熵镜像下降。

Conclusion: 论文给出了这类几何感知IRL算法的收敛性结果，表明占用度空间几何视角为IRL奖励更新提供了自然梯度式、计算高效且具理论保证的新框架。

Abstract: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) is classically solved using Lagrangian optimisation, by jointly optimising a primal-dual problem with gradient descent to obtain the optimal reward function parameters and corresponding optimal policy. While this algorithmic view of IRL has been highly influential, gradient-based reward updates only paint a partial picture, largely ignoring the geometry of the problem in occupancy space. In this paper, we present an occupancy-space view of reward updates in IRL. We leverage the insight that both the optimal solution and its geometry in occupancy space are known, and show that the geometry along the e-geodesic (straight line in occupancy space) toward the optimal occupancy directly affects the gradient of the IRL dual problem in reward parameter space. This perspective naturally suggests preconditioning the dual gradient with the average Fisher information along the occupancy trajectory. We show that this preconditioned gradient is just a convex interpolation of the old reward and a new target reward, yielding efficient natural-gradient-style updates with little additional computational overhead. We then analyse these occupancy-space reward updates from a Mirror Descent (MD) perspective, and show that policy search over the resulting rewards induces approximate entropic MD on the policy. Finally, we conclude with convergence results of such geometry-aware IRL algorithms.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Result: 没有选定的生成程序能持续或以超出蒙特卡洛不确定性幅度地优于Ridge LSMC；留出集的gap分数与Ridge相差在0.002以内。在六只一维看跌期权上，二项式参考显示Ridge处于最优的蒙特卡洛噪声范围内，估计差距的99%归因于对偶界松弛。结构化记忆在此消融中相比仅用分数的记忆无收益。

Abstract: LLM program-search agents are usually judged by the score that drives their search. No selected generated program improves on Ridge LSMC consistently or by more than Monte Carlo uncertainty; holdout gap scores lie within $0.002$ of it. On six one-dimensional puts, a high-precision binomial reference places Ridge within Monte Carlo noise of optimal and attributes 99\% of the estimated gap to dual-bound looseness, so this dual audits validity but cannot certify progress at the search's scale. Structured memory showed no benefit over score-only memory in this ablation. Whether search ``worked'' depends on reporting rules: retaining the initial reference, freezing selection before holdout, and counting failures.

</details>

*Yiyang Fu,Zihao Huang,Dongchen Han,Shukai Gong,Zhen Dong,Qiyang Min,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE，单一共享骨干内联合支持CR2/CR4/CR8三种压缩比，实现多轮交互中按轮灵活分配计算预算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮交互中各轮计算需求差异大：全程用高算力模型浪费算力，而在独立模型间路由又需在切换后重建模型专属历史状态，因此探索能否用单一共享模型支持可跨轮灵活分配的多种计算预算。

Method: 在共享骨干中联合支持token-to-concept压缩比2/4/8；用轻量全token模块降低与压缩比无关的开销，用比率专属边界路由器支持不同压缩级别，并通过跨比率训练实现同一上下文内的混合比率处理。

Result: PTBench与SFTBench上三种固定模式在全部6组对比中均优于算力匹配的MoE基线，并与独立训练的固定比率专家相当；CodeChat与CoSQL上混合比率推理改善精度-算力权衡，较大MoE分别提升5.87与2.68个百分点，FLOPs降低41.1%与12.3%；相同逐轮预算调度下，相较独立模型间路由再降FLOPs 78.4%与46.9%。

Conclusion: 单一共享模型可提供多种计算预算，实现跨轮次灵活算力分配。

Abstract: Large language models typically support different inference budgets through separate model sizes or fixed compute configurations. In multi-turn interactions, however, compute demand can vary substantially across turns. Using a high-compute model for every turn wastes computation, while routing among independent models may require rebuilding model-specific history states after switches. We therefore ask whether a single shared model can support multiple compute budgets that can be flexibly assigned across turns. We introduce Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE, which jointly supports token-to-concept compression ratios of 2, 4, and 8 (CR2/CR4/CR8) within a shared backbone. Lightweight full-token modules reduce compression-independent cost, ratio-specific boundary routers support distinct compression levels, and cross-ratio training enables mixed-ratio processing within the same context. Across PTBench and SFTBench, the three fixed modes outperform their compute-matched MoE baselines in all 6 comparisons while remaining competitive with independently trained fixed-ratio specialists. On CodeChat and CoSQL, mixed-ratio inference improves the accuracy--compute trade-off, outperforming the Large MoE by 5.87 and 2.68 percentage points while reducing FLOPs by 41.1% and 12.3%, respectively. Under the same turn-wise budget schedule, Multi-Ratio ConceptMoE further reduces FLOPs by 78.4% and 46.9% relative to routing among independent models. These results demonstrate that a single shared model can provide multiple compute budgets for flexible compute allocation across turns.

</details>


### [36] [RES-MR: Risk-Aware Reasoning for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14474)
*Cong Wang,Jin Li,Shoujin Wang,Yishuo Li,Huilin Gu,Wenpeng Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RES-MR框架，基于LLM的两阶段训练（可解释临床推理蒸馏+风险感知策略优化），实现兼具个性化安全性、可解释性与准确性的用药推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有用药推荐方法多为黑箱、可解释性差，且采用固定、与患者无关的安全约束，忽视个体风险承受能力的异质性，对弱势群体存在风险。

Method: RES-MR采用两阶段训练范式：(1)可解释临床推理蒸馏阶段，基于图检索获取患者特定知识，通过在合成推理轨迹上微调激发诊断能力；(2)风险感知策略优化阶段，利用解耦的药物因子构建患者特定参考原型（包含期望的治疗药物特征与需规避的风险特征），据此进行风险边界校准，并通过奖励塑形与裁剪引导模型输出安全推荐。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，RES-MR在准确性、安全性和可解释性方面均显著优于当前最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: RES-MR通过LLM驱动的风险感知推理框架，将个性化安全约束引入用药推荐，在提升可解释性的同时有效平衡疗效与安全，为临床决策支持提供了新思路。

Abstract: Medication recommendations seek to deliver personalized drug combinations based on patients' clinical information, where ensuring transparent decision-making and personalized safety are of paramount importance. However, existing approaches predominantly operate as ``black boxes'', offering limited interpretability and hindering clinician trust. Furthermore, they typically rely on fixed, patient-agnostic safety constraints, neglecting the heterogeneity of risk tolerance across individuals, which poses significant risks to vulnerable populations. To address these gaps, we propose \textbf{RES-MR}, a novel Risk-aware Reasoning framework for Explainable and Safe Medication Recommendation using LLMs. RES-MR follows a two-stage training paradigm: (1) an explainable clinical reasoning distillation stage to elicit diagnostic capabilities by fine-tuning on synthesized reasoning trajectories, grounded in patient-specific knowledge from graph retrieval; and (2) a risk-aware policy optimization stage to dynamically balance therapeutic efficacy with personalized safety. This stage employs disentangled drug factors to construct patient-specific reference prototypes that capture desired therapeutic drug features and risk features to avoid. These prototypes enable risk boundary calibration and guide the model toward safe recommendations via reward shaping and clipping. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that RES-MR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in terms of accuracy, safety, and explainability. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/wangcong2001/RES-MR.

</details>

*Md. Muqtadir Fuad,Md. Istiak Adnan,Ridwan Al Aziz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出混合物理信息、不确定性感知的三模块框架（正向质量模型、稀疏逆向重构、可行性约束排序），用于高维稀疏配方设计，并在工业纺织品染色场景下验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 构建三模块框架：Module A为多目标正向质量模型；Module B为稀疏逆向重构器；Module C为可行性约束排序层。在工业纺织染色场景中，采用按配方分组的交叉验证，结合多光源质量评估，融合工艺与生产信息、目标反射率、K/S值及光谱描述符进行验证。

Abstract: High-dimensional sparse recipe formulation in process industries involves nonlinear association of various covariates, bounded by sparsity constraints and multi-criteria tolerances. Traditional physics-based classical methods (such as Kubelka-Munk) fail to generate sparse candidate recipes properly due to their simplified assumptions and industrial process variations. This study proposes a hybrid physics-informed uncertainty-aware framework that is structured into three modules: (a) Module A, a multi-target forward quality model; (b) Module B, a sparse inverse reconstructor; and (c) Module C, a feasibility-constrained ranking layer. Then it has been validated in an industrial textile dyeing context with recipe-grouped cross-validation under multi-illuminant quality assessment comprising process and production information, target reflectance, K/S values, and spectral descriptors. Histogram Gradient Boosting (HGB) with spectral-only features ($R_λ$, K/S) and Gradient Boosting Regressor (GBDT) with recipe-process features outperforms other configurations with out-of-Fold MAE of 0.1655 and 0.1523 in the forward quality model. For inverse reconstruction, a component-wise median blend achieved a recipe-vector MAE of 0.0295. Exploratory conditional treatment effect (CATE) suggests an observational association that alkali adjustment reduces error for red and pale shades (CATE = -0.196). This framework provides a human-in-the-loop decision-support tool that minimizes costly laboratory trials across industrial formulation domains.

</details>


### [38] [From Prototype to Massing: Learning Graph Correspondence for Scalable Facade Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14098)
*Yiliang Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种以设计原型为可迁移逻辑来源的建筑立面articulation工作流：将原型与目标体量建模为异质属性图，用带实例局部三元组监督的孪生图注意力网络将二者片段嵌入共享度量空间，再通过多对一最近邻检索把原型Pattern路由到更大目标体量。同语料85/15留出集上原型到体量的top-1准确率达96.5%，对比原始特征基线76.5%；Rhino演示器可将预测对应关系转为可复用立面Pattern，并在四个已建成项目上验证了跨不同体量组织的适用性。其贡献不在于自动化立面生成，而在于一种以已解几何作为项目尺度传播计算规范的创作模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑尺度的立面articulation通常依赖人工处理，或依赖将设计意图编码为显式规则的参数化系统。本文希望探索一种互补工作流：让设计师创作的原型承载可迁移的articulation逻辑，从而把已解决的几何转化为项目尺度传播的计算规范，而非直接自动化生成立面。

Method: 将原型与目标体量表示为异质属性图；采用带实例局部三元组监督（instance-local triplet supervision）的孪生图注意力网络（Siamese graph attention network），把二者片段嵌入共享度量空间；随后使用多对一最近邻检索，将原型Pattern路由到更大的目标体量；并通过Rhino演示器把预测出的对应关系转换为可复用的立面Pattern。

Result: 在原始85/15同语料留出集（within-corpus holdout）上，原型到体量的top-1准确率为96.5%，而所报道的原始特征基线为76.5%。在四个已建成项目上的定性应用表明，该工作流可适用于不同的体量组织方式。

Conclusion: 该研究的贡献并非自动化立面生成，而是提出一种创作模型：已解几何作为项目尺度传播的计算规范；设计师创作的原型可提供可迁移的articulation逻辑，从而在建筑尺度上补充人工处理与显式规则参数化系统。

Most Multiple errors are same-class wrong-instance (45.6%); geometric miss (H2) is 59.6%, and wrong-category (H1) is 16.7%. A non-monotone H1 pattern does not appear under the default fixed-final protocol, and we retract it. Logit-free thresholds rank spatially hard queries poorly. If only agreement was logged, calibrate abstention on Multiple and report wrong-instance rates with H1.

Conclusion: 实现细节对最近邻搜索算法的性能评估具有实质性影响，可能改变算法优劣的结论；Cover Tree的默认参数与实践选择并非普遍安全，基准设计也会影响排名。RustKNN已开源于GitHub。

Abstract: Nearest neighbor search algorithms are widely used and have a long history, but we find that key implementation details are seldom reviewed in articles about them. These details can materially impact performance, and thus change the conclusions one makes about a given algorithm's superiority. In this article, we highlight these impacts by reviewing the Cover Tree as an example, producing RustKNN, a unified Rust implementation of three construction variants of the Cover Tree with three query modes. Our analysis reveals: (1) the optimal query strategy depends on $k$ and on the dataset (single-tree search is fastest at $k{=}1$ on three of our four largest datasets, while dual-tree search is fastest at $k{\ge}5$ on the three largest), and choosing the wrong query mode can cost up to a $7.5\times$ factor in runtime; (2) the cover tree base parameter, set to 2 in theory and 1.3 in practice, is not a safe default for dual-tree search: 1.3 is optimal on only one of seven datasets, and on covtype it is $1.6\times$ slower than the optimum; (3) among five micro-optimizations, only early-exit distance computation has a consistent effect, and that effect grows with dimension (none at $d{=}32$, $1.31\times$ at $d{=}54$, and $1.49\times$ at $d{=}784$); and (4) all-nearest-neighbor and held-out benchmarks yield different implementation rankings. Abstract: Hallucination detection is critical for ensuring the reliability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world deployments. While recent works, such as Semantic Entropy (SE) and Kernel Language Entropy (KLE), identify hallucinations by measuring semantic disagreement across multiple generated responses using Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, these methods depend on separately loaded NLI classifiers to estimate pairwise semantic similarity, introducing significant computational overhead. We propose Embedding Graph Kernel Entropy (EGKE), a variant of Kernel Language Entropy (KLE) that replaces its NLI-derived semantic graph with a Radial Basis Function (RBF) kernel applied to dense sentence embeddings generated by a BGE embedding model, while retaining KLE's graph Laplacian, heat kernel, and von Neumann entropy formulation unchanged. Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LLoPS（可学习低秩多项式草图），从多项式核近似视角为线性注意力提供原则性、灵活的框架，可证明地获得比现有方法更小的近似误差，并在广泛基准上取得最高性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Softmax attention in Transformers suffers from quadratic complexity in sequence length, making it impractical for long-context applications. Linear attention alleviates this issue by replacing the exponential kernel with alternative functions that enable linear-time computation. Among existing linear attention approaches, recent studies have shown that polynomial kernels are particularly effective, as they exhibit sparse and spiky behavior similar to softmax attention, which emphasizes large dot products while suppressing irrelevant interactions. However, the exact computation of high-degree polynomial kernels is infeasible for high-dimensional representations. As a result, prior work relies on approximate polynomial kernels. This introduces a non-negligible approximation error. In this paper, we show that, from the perspective of polynomial kernel approximation, existing linear attention methods are still suboptimal. We propose \textbf{L}earnable \textbf{Lo}w-Rank \textbf{P}olynomial \textbf{S}ketch (LLoPS), a principled and flexible framework for approximating polynomial kernels with linear attention. Our method learns a low-rank polynomial sketch that provably achieves a strictly smaller approximation error than existing approaches. Experiment results show that LLoPS achieves the highest performance across extensive benchmarks, comparing with various linear attention baselines.

</details>

Varying the number of importance samples then separates two mechanisms on Permuted MNIST. For EWC, the gain fell by about ten points per tenfold increase in samples, from 19.6 points with 10 samples to -0.4 with 1000, a variance effect. For MAS, a gain of about one point persisted at 1000 samples, consistent with a bias in the importance measure rather than noise. Shrinkage had no detectable effect for MAS on a domain-incremental CIFAR-100 benchmark. Abstract: Augmentation-based self-supervised learning can recover the content shared across views without separating its underlying factors into individual coordinates. We ask whether augmentations can be designed to make those factors identifiable. Our approach allows content factors to fluctuate across augmented views while preserving their mean for each source instance. Each instance receives a fixed, recorded set of augmentation strengths that controls how much its factors fluctuate. When factors respond differently to changes in these strengths, their patterns of variation provide information that distinguishes them. Under suitable decoder and support assumptions, we prove that these differences identify individual factors in a conditional Gaussian model, up to permutation, scaling, and translation. We then develop a learner that uses the recorded strengths to estimate these patterns jointly across instances, enabling learning from few views per instance. Synthetic experiments demonstrate near-perfect factor recovery through nonlinear mixing. Controlled dSprites experiments show improved coordinate alignment using augmentations that target known factors, even without telling the learner which augmentation corresponds to which representation coordinate. These results suggest a route to component identification in self-supervised learning: augmentation design can supply identifying information beyond shared content alone.

Abstract: Learning long-range dependencies with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is difficult because of the vanishing gradient problem. Gated recurrent neural networks like GRUs and LSTMs address this problem and are commonly explained by their ability to create additive copy paths through time. This explanation is correct, but incomplete: useful RNN gate values must themselves be learned, which is typically done with another RNN. We study this gate-learning problem through carefully controlled sequence classification tasks. Our analysis shows that gated architectures struggle when all training samples require long-range memory and thus equally suffer from the vanishing gradient problem. We intervene by adding short-dependency samples which let gated models learn solutions that capture long-dependency samples, but also generalize across different class labels. When properly learned, gated RNNs match or even exceed the test accuracy of modern architectures like Mamba and xLSTM. Overall, our results highlight gate learning as a central part of learning long-range memory and show how training data can support this process by exposing the same task over shorter dependencies.

Abstract: The inner workings of deep neural networks are still not well understood. The information bottleneck framework, which characterizes deep networks by the mutual information between their hidden representations and the network's input, has been used to identify compression of input information with respect to an input image and output labels. We instead study how much of a layer's own input is recoverable from the layer's output in convolutional neural networks (CNNs). A convolutional layer applies its filters to one input patch at a time, so we evaluate recoverability on sampled input patches with a reconstruction-based probe and not on the entire feature map. The probe's size thus depends on channels and kernel size and not on feature map size, which lets our method scale to deep CNNs with wide feature maps. For each layer, we compare pretrained, random, and reconstruction-optimized encoders, using linear and linear-plus-residual-MLP decoders. We measure recoverability as $R^2$ between input patches and their reconstructions on a held-out set.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

</details>

</details>

Abstract: We present ContinuousCloth, a continuous-time, physics-informed neural solver for deformable cloth dynamics that enforces a spring--mass ODE within a neural trajectory model. Unlike classical time-stepping simulators that return trajectories only on a discrete integration grid, ContinuousCloth supports querying at arbitrary timestamps and computing displacement, velocity, and acceleration via automatic differentiation. We evaluate ContinuousCloth along two dimensions. In a physics-only setting, ContinuousCloth achieves trajectory accuracy comparable to high-precision solvers across six diverse boundary-condition scenarios while reducing runtime by up to 17.4 times. When fused with sparse and noisy observations, the spring--mass ODE acts as a strong inductive bias for downstream tasks: interpolation and parameter estimation. That is, ContinuousCloth reduces interpolation error by 7.3 times over a data-only neural baseline in simulation and 2.4 times on real-world cloth sequences, and achieves 2.6 times lower parameter error than a differentiable-solver baseline under high-noise conditions, demonstrating consistent robustness under realistic measurement imperfections.

</details>


### [57] [On the Depth Transfer of Neural Optimizers via L-Smoothness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14344)
*Maximilian Wong,Chenyu Xu,Jiajin Li,Yiping Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于L-光滑性框架，证明逆深度残差分支缩放α=Θ(1/K)可使损失函数的Lipschitz常数与L-光滑性常数在固定宽度下与深度无关，从而为超参数跨深度迁移提供几何解释，并在GPT-2与ResNet上验证了学习率稳定迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高效扩展深度模型需要可预测的性能迁移，即通过低成本代理模型确定最优超参数，避免大规模训练的灾难性失败。然而现有深度迁移分析存在局限：与特定架构绑定且依赖启发式，仅用小规模模块验证，并依赖无穷深度动力学、特定初始化及特征学习判据，缺乏通用性。

Method: 将超参数迁移问题形式化为损失函数的Lipschitz常数与L-光滑性常数如何随深度K缩放。基于Xu等人的L-光滑性框架，量化逆深度残差分支缩放α=Θ(1/K)对两个常数的影响，并推导在固定宽度、有界参数域及任意p→q几何下的一致界。分析仅通过每个残差分支的Lipschitz与光滑性常数依赖该分支，因此适用于一般残差网络。

Result: 证明α=Θ(1/K)足以使Lipschitz与L-光滑性常数在固定宽度下与深度无关，且不依赖初始化或层间权重的相关性。由于光滑性常数控制下降不等式中的曲率惩罚项，该结果支持无需额外深度相关曲率修正的学习率缩放，为逆深度残差缩放提供了几何解释，并适用于AdamW、Muon和MOGA对应的算子范数几何。GPT-2（深度2–128）与CIFAR-100 ResNet（8–32残差块）的学习率扫描表明，Muon和MOGA在这些设定下呈现稳定的学习率迁移，深度增加64倍仍有共同最优学习率。

Conclusion: 逆深度残差缩放α=Θ(1/K)通过保持损失函数的Lipschitz与L-光滑性常数与深度无关，从几何角度解释了超参数迁移的可行性，为深度无关的学习率缩放提供了理论依据，并在Transformer与ResNet上验证了Muon、MOGA的稳定迁移特性。

Abstract: Scaling deep learning models efficiently requires predictable performance transfer across compute regimes. Establishing reliable hyperparameter transfer allows optimal training dynamics and structural choices to be discovered on low-cost proxy models, avoiding catastrophic failures during massive-scale training. Existing depth-transfer analyses are architecture-specific and heuristic: hyperparameter transfer is only justified through toy blocks, and both rely on infinite-depth dynamics, a specific initialization, and feature-learning criteria. Building on $L$-smoothness framework of Xu et al. (2026), we understand hyperparameter transfer as how do the Lipschitz and $L$-smoothness constants of the loss scale with the depth $K$? We show that inverse-depth residual branch scaling $α=Θ(1/K)$ is sufficient to make both constants depth-independent at fixed width, uniformly over the bounded parameter domain and for arbitrary $p\to q$ geometries. Because the bounds depend on each residual branch only through its Lipschitz and smoothness constants, the argument applies to general residual networks (including branches of block depth $\geq 2$ such as transformer and ResNet blocks) without assumptions on initialization or correlations between layer weights. Since the smoothness constant controls the curvature penalty in the descent inequality, our bounds motivate a learning-rate scale without an additional depth-dependent curvature correction for updates bounded in the prescribed norm. This provides a geometric explanation of inverse-depth residual scaling and its application to the operator-norm geometries associated with AdamW, Muon, and MOGA. Learning-rate sweeps on GPT-2 (depths 2--128) and CIFAR-100 ResNets (8--32 residual blocks) confirm that Muon and MOGA exhibit stable learning-rate transfer under these prescriptions, with a common optimal rate across a 64-fold increase in depth.

</details>

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对多类时序分类中 STL 公式推断"准确率高但公式满足性差"的问题，提出正满足率与码字满足率两个指标，并设计两阶段流程提升公式满足度与类条件覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多类分类中，高预测准确率并不保证推断出的 STL 公式能被真实类别一致地满足，即缺乏对"公式满足性"和"与完整类码字一致性"的度量与优化手段。
