Result: 在 naval、合成数据与机器人操作轨迹上的实验表明：分类准确率与公式满足性存在明显偏差；鲁棒性紧度与满足性之间存在数据依赖的权衡；类条件校准可缓解被池化校准掩盖的欠覆盖问题。

Conclusion: 准确率不足以衡量 STL 推断质量，需引入满足性指标；两阶段优化与类条件校准能在保证覆盖性的同时改善公式满足度，并揭示了鲁棒性-满足性的权衡关系。

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) inference provides interpretable formulas for time series classification. For multiclass classification, however, accurate predictions do not necessarily ensure that the inferred formulas are satisfied consistently with the true class. We introduce the positive satisfaction rate and codeword satisfaction rate to quantify satisfaction of required formulas and consistency with the complete class codeword, respectively. We develop a two-stage procedure that first learns discriminative formulas using a margin-based objective and then refines predicate thresholds toward a small positive robustness target while fixing the formula structure and temporal intervals. Satisfaction and ranking penalties discourage violations of required formulas and loss of class separation. The decoding loss is used as a nonconformity score and calibrated separately for each class, providing finite-sample class-conditional coverage under intra-class exchangeability. Experiments on naval, synthetic, and robot manipulation trajectories demonstrate discrepancies between classification accuracy and formula satisfaction. The results further reveal a data-dependent tradeoff between robustness tightness and satisfaction, while class-conditional calibration mitigates undercoverage that can be hidden by pooled calibration.

</details>


### [59] [The Sample Complexity of Multicalibration with an ERM Oracle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14363)
*Princewill Okoroafor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在只能通过ERM oracle访问假设类时，学习多校准（multicalibrated）预测器所需的样本复杂度，并刻画了oracle高效性的代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多校准是针对子群体（auditor类）的强校准概念。有限类所需样本量约ε^{-3}，但达到该速率的算法需要枚举整个类，对大规模类不可行。因此本文关心：当学习器只能通过ERM oracle访问类时，需要多少样本，以及计算限制带来的统计代价。

Method: 作者在ERM oracle访问模型下设计了学习算法，分析其样本复杂度与调用次数；并给出匹配的下界，区分oracle高效学习器、无限计算学习器，以及swap multicalibration设定。

Result: 算法使用Õ(d/ε^{3})样本和多项式次ERM调用（d为VC维），对ε的依赖对所有学习器最优；当d≥~1/ε时，任何仅用多项式次ERM调用的学习器需Õ(d/ε^{3})样本。无限计算仅需Õ(ε^{-3}+dε^{-2})，故维度项多出的1/ε因子是oracle高效的代价。Swap multicalibration的样本复杂度为Õ(d/ε^{3})。估计ordinary误差比估计swap误差更难：swap误差可用ERM oracle估计，而ordinary误差即使对线性时间ERM的类也NP难近似。

Conclusion: 在ERM oracle访问下，oracle高效多校准学习的样本复杂度对ε最优、对维度至多差一个1/ε因子，且该因子不可避免。存在某些类，学习多校准预测器比计算给定预测器的多校准误差在计算上更容易。

Abstract: A predictor is multicalibrated with respect to a class of subpopulations (formally, of functions on the inputs, called auditors) if, for every subpopulation in the class and every value the predictor outputs, the average outcome among the members of that subpopulation who receive that value is close to the value itself. For finite classes, about $\varepsilon^{-3}$ samples are necessary and sufficient to learn a predictor with multicalibration error $\varepsilon$, but the algorithms that attain this rate enumerate the class, which is impossible for the large classes of interest. We ask how many samples suffice when the learner accesses the class only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples and polynomially many ERM calls, where $d$ is the VC dimension of the class. Its dependence on $\varepsilon$ is optimal for all learners. When $d$ is at least about $1/\varepsilon$, every learner that can only access the class through polynomially many ERM calls needs $\tildeΩ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples. Learners with unlimited computation need only $\tilde{O}(\varepsilon^{-3}+d\varepsilon^{-2})$ samples, so the extra factor $1/\varepsilon$ on the dimension term is the price of oracle efficiency. For swap multicalibration, which allows a different function from the class for each predicted value, $\tildeΘ(d/\varepsilon^{3})$ samples are necessary and sufficient. For estimating the error of a given predictor, the ordinary notion is the harder one: the swap error can be estimated with an ERM oracle, whereas the ordinary error is NP-hard to approximate even for classes with linear-time ERM. Consequently, there are classes for which it is computationally easier to learn a multicalibrated predictor than to compute the multicalibration error of a given predictor.

</details>


### [60] [ConformalGuard: False-Positive-Controlled Action Gating for LM Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14365)
*Bishnu Bista,Dhanraj Haibatrao Jadhav,Vibha Choudhary,Gaurav Saxena,Arun Pandiyan Perumal,Arjun Subedi,Jignesh Ammineni*

TL;DR: 提出ConformalGuard校准层，为语言模型分类器提供有限样本的合法输入误报率控制，并实证比较保形校准与温度缩放等方法的实际差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型分类器被用于高风险决策场景，但验证集阈值无法对部署时的假阳性提供有限样本控制。

Method: 以模型无关的校准层包裹固定打分函数，对合法输入触发干预层级的比率进行有限样本控制；在公开邮件语料上，用微调BERT、Claude Sonnet 4和GPT-4o比较保形校准、温度缩放与等渗回归。

Result: 零样本API分数过于粗糙（10–11个唯一值），使温度缩放和等渗回归在低假阳性动作门控下与原始阈值操作等价。Claude上保形校准将FPR从0.040降至0.008，召回率从0.938降至0.875；GPT-4o确定性分数在1%操作点过于保守（召回0.564），三次随机平均将召回提升至0.732（FPR 0.005）；BERT在2%患病率下每万封邮件减少25个假阳性评论（95% CI [10,43]）。

Abstract: Language model classifiers are increasingly deployed for high-stakes decisions such as phishing screening, content moderation, and fraud triage, yet validation-set thresholds provide no finite-sample control of deployment-time false positives. We present ConformalGuard, a model-agnostic calibration layer that wraps a fixed scoring function with finite-sample control over the rate at which legitimate inputs trigger an intervention tier. Our contribution is empirical and operational, not a new conformal theorem: zero-shot LM API scores can be coarse enough (10--11 unique values here) to make temperature scaling and isotonic regression operationally identical to raw thresholding for low-FPR action gating. We compare these methods with conformal calibration for fine-tuned BERT, Claude Sonnet 4, and GPT-4o on public email corpora. For Claude, conformal calibration reduces FPR from 0.040 to 0.008 while recall falls from 0.938 to 0.875. For deterministic GPT-4o scores, the 1% operating point is too conservative to deploy (recall 0.564); three-run stochastic averaging raises recall to 0.732 at FPR 0.005. At 2% prevalence with BERT, conformal calibration removes 25 false-positive reviews per 10,000 emails (95% CI [10, 43]). The guarantee is legitimate-event-rate control under exchangeability; discrimination, workload effects, and robustness to shift remain empirical.

</details>


### [61] [History, Adaptation, and Hidden Gain: Two Prospective Tests of Learned Predictive Control in a Synthetic Neural Population](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14368)
*Mahesh Reddy Pagadala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在64个漏电积分-发放神经元的合成群体一步预测控制中，隐藏增益主要通过单参数在线输入增益估计被学习/补偿，而非网络自身的动作敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究学习型一步预测控制器能否跟踪隐藏的光敏增益参数s，以及历史信息、自适应ARX与网络控制之间的差距来源。

Method: 用两套前瞻性确认实验（第一套50株、11条件；第二套50新株、9灵敏度、2噪声水平）比较参数数匹配的神经网络（含/不含200ms输入-输出历史）、递推自适应ARX、带抗积分饱和的整定PI；并通过重估单一乘性输入增益、将其作为额外输入反馈给网络来检验。

Conclusion: 在该合成对象、主噪声水平下，单参数在线增益估计解释了基于历史网络与全自适应ARX之间的大部分差距，也解释了预测-控制不匹配；该归因在高过程噪声下不成立。

Abstract: We study learned one-step predictive control of a synthetic population of 64 leaky integrate-and-fire neurons whose light sensitivity is scaled by a hidden factor s, using two prospective confirmations on plants simulated only after the analysis was frozen. In the first (50 plants, 11 conditions), removing the 200-ms input-output history substantially worsened a parameter-count-matched neural predictor at low and moderate gain (s = 0.6, 0.8; RMSE rose by 2.47 Hz at s = 0.6, 97.5% CI 2.43-2.51). In secondary comparisons, recursively adapted ARX had the lowest mean error of the deployable controllers in 10 of 11 conditions, tuned PI with anti-windup matched or beat the network for s >= 0.7, and training for 10,000 rather than 900 epochs lowered prediction error but worsened control. Development work suggested the network's learned action sensitivity did not track the hidden gain. A second protocol (50 new plants, 9 sensitivities, 2 noise levels) confirmed three pre-specified predictions at the primary noise level. Re-estimating a single multiplicative input gain recovered 87% (95% CI 86-88%) of the benefit of full adaptive ARX. Supplying that online estimate to the network as an extra input reduced high-gain tracking error by 1.84 Hz [1.81, 1.88]. Longer training worsened the plain network by 1.09 Hz but improved the gain-input network by 1.07 Hz, a differential of 2.16 Hz [2.13, 2.20]. Under high process noise (sigma = 2.0) the effects shrank to about 0.04 Hz or less and gain-only adaptation recovered only 24% of the adaptive-ARX benefit. In this synthetic plant, at the primary noise level, one-parameter online gain estimation accounts for most of the gap between a history-based network and full adaptive ARX, and for its prediction-control mismatch.

</details>


### [62] [When More Memory Fails: Hidden Feasibility Holes in Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14369)
*Mahesh Reddy Pagadala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出 DTR（动态张量重物化）的可行性并非内存预算的单调函数，存在"可行性空洞"：某些预算会 OOM，而更小和更大的预算均可完成训练。作者用 simrd 复现公开 trace，在 InceptionV4、U-Net 和 ResNet-32 上定位到该类空洞，并对其中一个案例追踪到具体分配层面的因果链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人们通常预期：只要某内存预算足以完成 DTR 训练，增大预算也应继续可行（可行性单调）。作者要检验这一被广泛默认的假设是否成立。

Method: 使用 DTR 的参考模拟器 simrd 重放公开的 DTR 训练 trace；采用带日期修订的书面扫描协议与 0.01 步长的预算网格进行系统扫描，再以更细采样寻找空洞；对每个空洞做三次重复并保证由未修改的 simrd 复现；对特定的 InceptionV4 预算对（0.2343 与 0.235 倍峰值内存）逐分配追踪失败原因；最后测试两种简单的打分函数改动能否消除空洞。

Result: 在六条确认 trace 上，0.01 网格未发现 DTR 空洞，但因存在未解决的超时无法确立单调性；更细采样后在 InceptionV4（三处）与 U-Net（两处）发现空洞，另在 ResNet-32 开发 trace 上发现一处，且全部可重复并由未修改 simrd 复现。案例追踪显示：更大预算在某算子处避免了一次驱逐（小预算在该处差 173,479 字节），但其多保留的数据迫使后续驱逐一个三个算子后仍需的张量，重建该张量引发无法容纳的重计算级联；在同一预算下保持该张量常驻即可避免失败。两种简单打分改动均无法跨 trace 消除空洞，反而在某些 trace 上新增失败预算。

Conclusion: DTR 的记忆可行性不是单调的，存在可行空洞；空洞源于驱逐决策的级联效应而非简单的容量不足。简单的启发式打分改动不足以消除该现象。所有结论均来自模拟，未建模分配器，GPU 硬件行为尚未验证。

Abstract: Dynamic Tensor Rematerialization (DTR) trains neural networks under a memory budget by evicting tensors and recomputing them on demand. A natural expectation is that a budget large enough to complete training stays sufficient when it is increased. Using DTR's reference simulator, simrd, to replay the public DTR training traces, we show that this expectation fails. We call the exceptions feasibility holes: memory budgets at which an eviction policy runs out of memory although both a smaller and a larger budget complete, a form of non-monotone feasibility. Under a written sweep protocol with dated amendments, a 0.01-step budget grid shows no such hole for DTR on any of six confirmatory traces, although unresolved timeouts prevent it from establishing monotonicity. Finer sampling finds holes on InceptionV4 (three regions) and U-Net (two regions), in addition to one on the ResNet-32 development trace. Every hole is reproduced by three repeats and by unmodified simrd. For one InceptionV4 pair (0.2343 versus 0.235 of peak memory) we trace the failure to individual allocations. The larger budget avoids one eviction at an operator where the smaller budget was 173,479 bytes short. The extra data it carries forward forces a later eviction of a tensor needed three operators afterwards, and rebuilding that tensor triggers a recomputation cascade that cannot fit. Keeping that one tensor resident under the same budget prevents the failure. The two simple score changes we tested do not remove holes across traces; both add failing budgets on some traces. All results are from simulation, with no allocator model; behaviour on GPU hardware is untested.

</details>


### [63] [DPAL: A Test-Time Adaptation Loss for Financial Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14376)
*Wuzhou Lian,Haochun Wang,Yuefan Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DPAL（方向与价格感知自适应损失），在金融时间序列测试时自适应中将逐点收益拟合与方向、价格校准项结合，无需改动源预测器或适配器结构，在多数金融数据集上降低了重构价格的MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应（TTA）的适应目标主要关注单个时间步的预测误差，未能充分满足金融时间序列预测的需求；除逐点收益拟合外，收益方向（涨跌）与由收益序列重构的价格轨迹同样重要。

Method: 提出方向与价格感知自适应损失（DPAL），将逐点收益拟合与方向项、价格校准项组合，并直接嵌入现有TSF-TTA框架中使用，不修改源预测器，也不改变适配器架构。

Result: 在多个不同类型的金融数据集上，DPAL在大多数评估设置中降低了重构价格的均方误差（MSE）。

Conclusion: 在金融时间序列TTA中显式建模收益方向与价格轨迹能带来更优的适应效果，且该损失可作为通用模块即插即用地集成到现有TSF-TTA框架中。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables time series forecasters to update after deployment as new observations become available. However, adaptation objectives that focus primarily on prediction errors at individual time steps do not fully address the needs of financial time series forecasting. In addition to pointwise return fitting, return direction and the price trajectories reconstructed from sequences of returns are also important. To better account for these properties, we introduce Direction- and Price-Aware Adaptation Loss (DPAL), which combines pointwise return fitting with directional and price-calibration terms. We apply DPAL within existing TSF-TTA frameworks without modifying the source forecaster or the adapter architecture. Across a diverse collection of financial datasets, DPAL reduces reconstructed-price mean squared error in most evaluated settings.

</details>


### [64] [Clinical value claims in multimodal AI outpace supporting evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14395)
*Jiayu Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 审计177项多模态与单模态预测模型对比研究发现，若为每个数据源单独建模（完整基准比较），AUROC增益显著更小；排除最强单模态模型后增益可从0.046升至0.108。完整基准比较比例由系统综述中的69.1%降至近期研究的约46.0%；约22%评估决策效用、无人开展前瞻性验证，但多数研究仍宣称具有临床价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态预测模型通过增加影像、检验等数据源提升预测性能，但卫生系统需判断新增检测是否值得获取。因此需要评估既有研究是否公平地量化了多模态相对于单模态的真实增益，以及其结论宣称是否有验证证据支撑。

Method: 对177项比较多模态与单模态模型的研究进行审计：81项来自一项系统综述，96项来自2025—2026年PubMed记录的概率样本。以AUROC增益为主要指标，考察是否对每个数据源分别拟合模型（完整基准比较）、是否评估决策效用、是否开展前瞻性验证，并统计其临床价值宣称。

Result: 当研究为每个数据源单独拟合模型时，AUROC增益更小（校正后差值-0.030；95% CI，-0.056至-0.005）。在78项此类研究中，若剔除最强数据源的模型，平均增益由0.046升至0.108。完整基准比较的比例从系统综述研究的69.1%降至近期研究的约46.0%。约22%的研究评估了决策效用，无一开展前瞻性模型评估；但多数研究仍宣称具有潜在临床实用性或可改善诊疗（84.0%及约87.7%）。

Conclusion: 多模态模型报告的增量性能可能被高估，尤其在缺乏完整基准比较时；决策效用评估与前瞻性验证严重不足，而临床价值宣称却普遍存在。研究实践应强制对每个数据源单独建模比较，并配套决策效用与前瞻性验证，以避免对新增数据源价值的误判。

Abstract: Multimodal prediction models add a data source, such as imaging or an assay, to clinical information, and health systems must decide whether that added test is worth acquiring. We audited 177 studies comparing multimodal with unimodal models: 81 from a systematic review and 96 from a probability sample of 2025-2026 PubMed records. Gains in the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) were smaller when a study fitted a separate model for every data source (adjusted difference, -0.030; 95% CI, -0.056 to -0.005). Within 78 such studies, leaving out the strongest source's model would have raised the average gain from 0.046 to 0.108. This complete benchmarking fell from 69.1% of review studies to an estimated 46.0% of recent ones. An estimated 22% assessed decision utility and none evaluated a model prospectively, yet most claimed potential clinical usefulness or improved care (84.0% and an estimated 87.7%).

</details>


### [65] [To Cache or Not to Cache: Understanding and Mitigating Safety Incompatibility in Cross-Model KV Cache Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15721)
*Zhiwei Lin,Jiahao Liu,Yan Liu,Chengpeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性地评估了跨模型KV缓存共享的安全性影响，定义了“安全不兼容性”，发现其取决于模型对与复用配置，且value复用比key复用造成更大偏差；为此提出VReparo，通过离线学习逐层、逐KV头的仿射映射对齐sender与receiver的value张量，在保持85.62%的TTFT降低的同时，将平均攻击成功率从57.28%降至39.21%，StrongREJECT分数从0.4215降至0.2163。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨模型KV缓存共享可让receiver模型复用相关sender模型生成的prefix KV状态，从而减少prefill计算。已有方法主要优化延迟和生成质量，但其安全影响尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 作者在多种sender-receiver模型对和复用配置下系统评估KV复用带来的安全偏差，将偏离receiver原生安全行为定义为“安全不兼容性”。进而提出VReparo，离线学习逐层、逐KV头的仿射映射，在解码前将复用的sender value张量对齐到receiver原生对应的value张量。

Result: 安全不兼容性的方向和幅度取决于模型对与复用配置，value复用在所有评估模型对中造成的偏差显著大于key复用。在两对模型、全KV复用及最优选择性复用设置下，VReparo将HarmBench平均ASR从57.28%降至39.21%，StrongREJECT平均分从0.4215降至0.2163，同时保持平均85.62%的TTFT降低。

Conclusion: 跨模型KV缓存共享存在显著的安全隐患，且value复用是主要风险来源；VReparo通过轻量的仿射对齐可有效缓解该类安全不兼容性，同时基本保留其计算效率优势。

Abstract: Cross-model KV cache sharing reduces prefill computation by allowing a receiver model to reuse prefix KV states generated by a related sender model. Existing methods optimize such reuse for latency and generation quality, but its safety implications remain unclear. In this work, we systematically evaluate this issue across diverse sender-receiver pairs and reuse configurations. We refer to deviations from the receiver's native safety behavior as safety incompatibility. Our study shows that both the direction and magnitude of safety incompatibility depend on the model pair and reuse configuration, with value reuse causing substantially larger deviations than key reuse across all evaluated pairs. Furthermore, we propose VReparo, a technique that learns per-layer and per-KV-head affine maps offline to align reused sender value tensors with their receiver-native counterparts before decoding. Across two model pairs under full KV reuse and the state-of-the-art selective reuse setting, VReparo reduces the average HarmBench attack success rate (ASR) from 57.28% to 39.21% and the average StrongREJECT score from 0.4215 to 0.2163 upon our benchmarks, while retaining an average Time to First Token (TTFT) reduction of 85.62%.

</details>


### [66] [Sparse-TD-JEPA: Improving Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning With Sparse Latent Task Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14400)
*Duaa Nakshbandi,Zhiyu An,Wan Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 l1 稀疏惩罚集中奖励预测结构，实现 Sparse-TD-JEPA，在 65 个零样本 RL 任务上全面超越 TD-JEPA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于后继特征的零样本强化学习方法在离线无奖励数据上预训练任务编码器与后继特征预测器，测试时通过小规模标注数据的闭式线性回归恢复策略。作者指出一个被忽视的局限：当任务编码器产生稠密表示时，推断的奖励信号在状态空间上过于弥散，削弱了目标相关状态与背景之间的对比度，从而给策略提供更弱的引导信号。

Method: 引入 l1 稀疏惩罚，将奖励预测结构集中到任务编码器潜空间的一个更小有效子空间中。该惩罚仅在训练阶段施加，不需要改变网络架构，也不修改闭式推断过程。具体实现为 Sparse-TD-JEPA，即在 TD-JEPA（时序差分联合嵌入预测架构）基础上仅增加一行代码。

Result: 在 DeepMind Control (DMC) Suite 和 OGBench 的 65 个任务上评估，覆盖运动、导航、轨迹拼接、解谜与机械臂操作。Sparse-TD-JEPA 在全部 13 个领域级对比中均优于 TD-JEPA。DMC 上平均回报由 661±6 提升至 714±3；OGBench 上平均成功率由 38.0±0.8 提升至 48.4±2.3，在 antmaze 导航与拼接领域提升 13.4–18.0 个百分点。在 13 个领域中有 9 个取得已建立零样本基线中的最高平均性能。分析表明稀疏性带来了更锐利、更具任务信息量的推断奖励景观。

Conclusion: 稠密任务表示的奖励弥散问题可通过对潜空间施加 l1 稀疏惩罚有效缓解，且改动极小、无需架构或推断流程变更，显著提升零样本强化学习性能，说明稀疏性有助于形成更清晰、信息量更高的奖励结构。

Abstract: Successor-feature-based zero-shot reinforcement learning methods pre-train a task encoder and successor-feature predictor on offline, reward-free data, then recover a policy at test time by solving a closed-form linear regression over a small labeled dataset. We identify an underexplored limitation of this approach: when the task encoder produces dense representations, the inferred reward signal becomes diffuse across the state space, reducing the contrast between goal-relevant states and the background and providing a weaker signal for the policy to follow. We address this limitation by introducing an l1 sparsity penalty that concentrates reward-predictive structure into a smaller effective subspace of the task encoder's latent space. The penalty is applied only during training and requires no architectural change or modification to the closed-form inference procedure. We instantiate this approach as Sparse-TD-JEPA, a single-line of code addition based on Temporal-Difference Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (TD-JEPA) that significantly improved its performance in zero-shot reinforcement learning. We evaluate Sparse-TD-JEPA on 65 tasks across the DeepMind Control (DMC) Suite and OGBench, covering locomotion, navigation, trajectory stitching, puzzle solving, and robotic manipulation. Sparse-TD-JEPA improves over TD-JEPA in all 13 domain-level comparisons. On DMC, it increases the average return from 661 +- 6 to 714 +- 3. On OGBench, it increases the average success rate from 38.0 +- 0.8 to 48.4 +- 2.3, with improvements of 13.4-18.0 percentage points on the evaluated antmaze navigation and stitching domains. Overall, Sparse-TD-JEPA achieves the highest mean performance among established zero-shot baselines in nine of the 13 domains. Analysis further shows that sparsity produces a sharper and more task-informative inferred reward landscape.

</details>


### [67] [PotentialEP: Backprop-Free Training of CIFAR-Scale Generative Models via Equilibrium Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14409)
*Alex Gower*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文证明在预测编码网络的能量中加入单一线性注入项，使其可见层在弛豫后天然携带Energy Matching所需的梯度，从而可将预训练模型直接加载至该网络并通过弛豫采样，且可用Equilibrium Propagation无反向传播地训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流匹配模型生成图像需对速度场进行数百步顺序积分，这种计算不适合GPU却适合模拟神经形态基底——一次快速、低功耗的物理弛豫即可替代整个序列。然而要利用硬件弛豫，需要两样东西：一种计算本身即弛豫的生成算法，以及一种无需反向传播的训练方法（因为模拟硬件难以实现全局梯度传输）。Energy Matching通过时不变势能上的梯度下降弛豫进行采样，恰好满足第一点，但其所遵循的梯度本身需要每步一次反向传播。

Method: 作者证明：在预测编码网络能量中加入一个单一线性注入项后，该网络弛豫到的状态其可见层固有地携带Energy Matching所需梯度，误差在注入强度较小时趋于消失。由此，一个由反向传播训练的Energy Matching模型可原封不动地加载进该网络，仅靠弛豫完成采样。同时该网络也可通过Equilibrium Propagation进行无反向传播训练。

Result: 加载后的网络仅靠弛豫采样，在CIFAR-10与ImageNet-32规模上FID与原模型差距在0.04以内；Equilibrium Propagation复现反向传播参数更新的余弦相似度达0.9998，端到端训练在无条件CIFAR-10上FID为3.64，对比反向传播的3.54。这是首个用Equilibrium Propagation训练的CIFAR-10生成模型，也是首个由无反向传播规则达到有竞争力质量的工作。该质量不依赖组归一化或注意力：仅由卷积和逐点非线性组成的架构（均为模拟crossbar原生）经反向传播训练可达FID 3.51。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过为预测编码网络添加线性注入项，可将Energy Matching采样转化为纯弛豫过程，且能以Equilibrium Propagation无反向传播训练，在生成质量上逼近反向传播，并可用模拟crossbar原生架构实现，为在模拟神经形态硬件上高效低功耗生成建模提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Generating an image with a diffusion or flow-matching model typically involves integrating a velocity field for hundreds of sequential steps. That computation suits a GPU poorly and an analog neuromorphic substrate well, where one fast, low-power physical relaxation could replace the whole sequence. Two things are needed: a generative algorithm whose computation is a relaxation, and a way to train it without backpropagation, whose global gradient transport is hard to realise in analog. Energy Matching supplies the first, sampling by gradient-descent relaxation on a time-independent potential - but obtaining the gradient that descent follows is itself a backward pass, once per integration step. We prove that a predictive coding network with a single linear injection term added to its energy relaxes to a state whose visible layer carries that gradient inherently, with an error that vanishes for small injection strengths. An Energy Matching model trained by backpropagation can therefore be loaded into this network unchanged and sampled by relaxation alone, matching the original model's FID to within 0.04 at CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-32 scale. Abstract: Computational coarse-graining aims to replace a sequence of updates with a cheaper module while preserving task performance. We present a continuation-relative evaluation framework that assesses replacements through the computation that follows them, using downstream task quality and total execution cost as joint criteria. The framework distinguishes boundary representations, summaries of skipped computation, executed operations, and downstream loss. It makes interfaces and permitted deployment information explicit, combines fine-path references with directly trained controls using the same shortened architecture, and accounts for selection overhead. An exact loss decomposition separates replacement effects at a fixed downstream action from effects of changing that action. A finite construction shows how retained information can reduce the stipulated cost of zero-error prediction under fixed information and controller restrictions. Experiments in two frozen pretrained language models show that representation fidelity and task loss can favor different fitting objectives. In a prespecified comparison on a 1.7-billion-parameter model, next-token-loss training lowers in-distribution negative log-likelihood by 0.1901 nats per scored token compared with reconstructing the skipped blocks' output, using the same optimizer and update count. This ranking reverses in all nine paired comparisons under distribution shift. In a recursive expert prototype, the jointly adapted candidate lowers task error relative to frozen-bank and router-only baselines, but trails directly trained controls, and the tested input-only selectors fail the joint quality-cost criteria. Together, the protocol and studies provide explicit criteria and diagnostics for distinguishing useful computational replacement from local approximation gains within specified interfaces and evaluation settings.

</details>

Abstract: Multimodal learning offers the potential to improve predictions by integrating complementary information from heterogeneous data sources. However, multimodal datasets are frequently incomplete, raising important questions about how models should handle missing information. Although recent approaches increasingly rely on Transformer-based architectures for multimodal fusion, incomplete multimodal data introduces challenges such as missing modalities and intra-modal missingness, which motivate key architectural design choices, such as tokenization granularity. In addition, many datasets are longitudinal, with observations collected across multiple time points. The sequential nature of the Transformer architectures provides a natural framework for modeling such data, but introduces additional considerations, such as how temporal information should be represented. In this study, we systematically investigate these design choices using three different cancer datasets. We compare modality-level and feature-level tokenization and evaluate attention masking and imputation as strategies for handling missing information, both naturally occurring in the datasets and synthetically induced. We further investigate approaches for incorporating temporal information in our training process and how to model it. Experiments are conducted with unimodal and multimodal configurations, as well as different levels of missingness for binary survival classification and multiple time encoding strategies for discrete-time survival prediction. </details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多业务线平台通常只维护一个基础模型进行后训练，但业务线数量往往多于可维护的专家数量，因此业务线必须共享专家。然而业务线极少附带分类法来指明哪些线应共享专家。作者由此提出：在标准分组未知时，迁移探针（在一个源上训练、测量所有源上成对变化）能否发现有效的分组。

Method: 使用七个留有标签树的公开数据源（五个数学子领域、两类编程）替代业务线，将标签树的分组作为评估者持有、方法不可见的分组参照。在固定每源暴露与每专家预算下使用四个LoRA专家，从共享预热状态只训练一个区间，并依据各分配固定的路由规则进行路由，比较纯探针推导分组、无信息均匀默认（其绑定路由由单一专家服务所有线）与参照分组。

Result: 探针分组与均匀默认均未达到预设的2个百分点实用增益，且整体效用均低于参照（分别为-2.43和-2.54个百分点，95%区间低于零）。事后比较中，探针推导分组与均匀默认无法区分（+0.11个百分点，区间[-1.25,+1.54]）。

Conclusion: 在固定预算的LoRA后训练中，基于初始状态单源探针构建的分组，在迁移到更晚的训练状态、有限预算与指定路由后，并未带来探针所预示的优势。这表明初始态迁移探针预测的分组收益在真实后训练条件下难以兑现。

Abstract: A platform that post-trains one base model for many business lines often has more lines than experts it can maintain, so lines must share experts, yet lines seldom come with a taxonomy saying which should share. We ask whether transfer probes (train on one source, measure paired changes on all sources) can discover a grouping when the standard one is unknown. To test probes against a reference, we use seven public sources that do have a label tree (five mathematics subfields and two kinds of programming, standing in for business lines) and treat the tree's grouping as a label reference that the evaluator holds and the method does not. With four LoRA experts under fixed per-source exposure and per-expert budgets, we compare a purely probe-derived grouping and an uninformed uniform default (whose tied routing serves every line from one expert) against this reference. Trained once for one interval from a shared warm-up state and routed by a rule fixed by each allocation, neither reached the prespecified practical gain of 2 percentage points, and both had lower overall utility than the reference ($-2.43$ and $-2.54$ pp; 95\% intervals below zero). In a post hoc comparison, the probe-derived grouping was indistinguishable from the uniform default ($+0.11$ pp, $[-1.25,+1.54]$). In fixed-budget LoRA post-training, a grouping built from initial-state single-source probes thus did not deliver the advantage predicted from the probes once carried to a later training state, a finite budget, and specified routing.

</details>


### [72] [Target-ESS Tempered Policy Optimization (TETPO): Smooth Variance Control via Bridge Importance Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14440)
*Shayan Mohajer Hamidi,Kayhan Behdin,Wenhui Zhu,Aida Rahmattalabi,Jincheng Cao,Jelena Markovic-Voronov,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TETPO 方法，通过数据自适应的幂次 tempering 重要性权重来控制有效样本量，缓解异步强化学习中权重重尾导致的梯度方差与不稳定问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步强化学习后训练计算高效但本质上是离策略的：学习器更新所用的 rollout 由陈旧策略生成，需用重要性权重修正，而权重可能极度重尾，少数轨迹主导更新，导致有效样本量（ESS）崩塌、梯度方差与不稳定上升。现有稳定方法不论权重集中严重程度如何都施加固定干预，要么丢弃样本，要么在不自适应调整修正强度的情况下重加权。

Method: 提出 Target–ESS Tempered Policy Optimization（TETPO），将每个重要性权重 ρ 替换为 ρ^α，α∈[0,1] 为数据自适应指数：α=1 保留原始权重，α=0 则为均匀系数。对每个 prompt group，选取使 tempering 后权重满足目标 ESS 比例 κ 的最大 α——健康组几乎不 tempering，权重退化严重时加强 tempering。总体层面，tempered 系数是采样器与学习器策略之间几何桥（geometric bridge）的精确重要性权重。指数用一维二分法高效求解。

Result: 所得权重满足归一化权重离散度与加权梯度范数的确定性界，且与策略漂移无关；同时给出固定 α 下桥目标差异的界。幂次 tempering 不引入显式零权重掩码。在高陈旧度下的数学推理基准上，TETPO 优于强 on-policy 与 off-policy 基线。

Conclusion: TETPO 通过按实际权重集中程度自适应选择幂次指数，将重要性权重从硬性截断/丢弃转为连续 tempering，在保持理论保证（ESS 目标、确定性界、无零权重掩码）的同时，显著提升高陈旧度异步强化学习后训练的稳定性与性能。

Abstract: Asynchronous reinforcement-learning post-training of large language models is computationally efficient but inherently off-policy: the learner updates on rollouts generated by a stale policy, while correcting this mismatch requires importance weights that can be extremely heavy-tailed. A small number of trajectories may then dominate an update, collapsing the effective sample size (ESS) and increasing the variance and instability of the resulting gradient estimates. Existing stabilizers apply fixed interventions regardless of the realized severity of weight concentration, either discarding selected samples or reweighting them without adapting the correction strength. We introduce \emph{Target--ESS Tempered Policy Optimization} (TETPO), which replaces each importance weight $ρ$ by $ρ^α$ for a data-adaptive exponent $α\in[0,1]$: $α=1$ preserves the original importance weights, whereas $α=0$ assigns uniform coefficients. For each prompt group, TETPO selects the largest $α$ whose tempered weights satisfy a target ESS fraction $κ$, applying little tempering to healthy groups and stronger tempering when weight degeneracy is severe. At the population level, the tempered coefficients are exact importance weights for a geometric bridge between the sampler and learner policies. The exponent is efficiently found by one-dimensional bisection, while the resulting weights satisfy deterministic bounds on normalized-weight dispersion and weighted-gradient norm that are independent of policy drift, together with a fixed-$α$ bound on bridge-target discrepancy. Power tempering also introduces no explicit zero-weight mask. On mathematical-reasoning benchmarks under high staleness, TETPO outperforms strong on- and off-policy baselines.

</details>


### [73] [KV4-RL: Unlocking Faster Asynchronous Rollouts for RLVR with INT4 KV Cache Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14448)
*Sihwan Park,Sung-Yub Kim,Doohyuk Jang,Eunho Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出KV4-RL：校准无关的INT4 KV量化+对attention sink与近期上下文的INT8选择性保护，在RLVR异步rollout中实现1.80×累计rollout加速且精度损失小于0.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步rollout减少长尾生成的资源闲置，但持续并发将上下文处理压缩到更少的decode步，导致每步KV负载升高。作者刻画了这种"KV concentration"现象，并发现相比仅权重量化和权重-激活量化，KV cache量化能带来更大加速。然而INT4 KV rollout即便配合token级截断重要性采样（TIS）仍会损害学习效果，因此需要兼顾速度与学习稳定性的方案。

Method: 提出KV4-RL：将无校准的INT4 KV量化与对attention sink及近期上下文的有界数量位置进行INT8选择性保护相结合，以降低采样器不匹配，同时保留INT4的大部分加速收益。在Qwen3-8B-Base上进行400次GRPO训练迭代验证。

Conclusion: INT4 KV量化是RLVR异步rollout中比权重量化更有效的加速手段，但需配合对attention sink与近期位置的选择性INT8保护以维持学习质量；KV4-RL在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著提升训练效率。

Abstract: Asynchronous rollout improves the efficiency of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) by reducing under-utilization during long-tail generation. Sustained concurrency also concentrates context processing into fewer decode steps, increasing the KV workload per step. We characterize this \emph{KV concentration} and find that KV cache quantization delivers substantially greater acceleration than weight-only and weight-activation quantization in our matched-workload comparisons. However, INT4 KV rollout can degrade learning even with token-level truncated importance sampling (TIS). We propose \emph{KV4-RL}, which combines calibration-free INT4 KV quantization with selective INT8 protection of attention sinks and recent context. Protecting a bounded number of positions reduces sampler mismatch while retaining most of the speedup from INT4. Across 400 iterations of Qwen3-8B-Base GRPO training, KV4-RL achieves $1.80\times$ cumulative rollout speedup and $1.27\times$ cumulative full-iteration speedup over BF16 rollout, reaching $1.97\times$ rollout speedup over the final 50 iterations. Under a common BF16 evaluator, its final six-benchmark mean accuracy is within 0.5 percentage points of BF16-rollout training for both Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base.

</details>


### [74] [CodeLift: Your Test Suite Is Secretly a Dense SWE Curriculum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17224)
*Junjielong Xu,Huachao Zhu,Alyssa Wu,Zhichao Hu,Pinjia He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CodeLift，一种动态校准通过率奖励的强化学习方法，将测试套件转化为自适应课程，缓解二元奖励稀疏与通过率不可靠的问题，在 SWE 基准上稳定提升 pass@1/2/4/8。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练软件工程智能体普遍采用“全部测试通过”的二元奖励，但其奖励稀疏，无法区分部分正确补丁的差异。测试通过率是自然的替代方案，但本文发现它并非可靠的补丁质量指标：同一项功能可能由一个困难测试或一百个琐碎测试覆盖，而后者中多数可能是已被满足的 pass-to-pass 测试。

Method: CodeLift 在每次迭代中对测试与补丁进行分组：将“杀死相同补丁”的测试归为一组，将“通过相同测试”的补丁归为一组；随后给予被更少补丁组通过的测试组更高权重，从而降低多数简单测试的影响，聚焦仍然困难的部分。在同一次 rollout 内，CodeLift 对仓库快照施加相同评分规则，即便后续动作引入回归，也能为有用动作分配信用。

Result: 在 SWE 基准上的实验表明，CodeLift 相较于二元奖励与通过率基线，在 pass@1/2/4/8 上均取得一致提升。分析显示 CodeLift 提供了稠密、稳定的学习信号，并释放了测试套件中固有的课程结构。

Conclusion: CodeLift 通过动态校准通过率奖励，将测试套件转化为自适应课程，有效克服二元奖励稀疏与通过率失真的问题，为软件工程智能体的强化学习提供了更可靠、更稠密的学习信号。

Abstract: The pass-all-test binary reward has become a standard recipe for training software engineering agents, but its sparsity eliminates difference of partially correct patches. The test pass-rate is a natural alternative. However, we find that it is not a reliable indicator of patch quality. A functionality being tested can be covered by either one challenging test or one hundred trivial tests, where the majority might be already satisfied pass-to-pass tests. We introduce CodeLift, a reinforcement learning method that dynamically calibrates pass-rate rewards, turning the test suite into an adaptive curriculum. At each iteration, CodeLift groups tests that kill the same patches and patches that pass the same tests, then gives more weight to test groups that fewer patch groups pass. This reduces the impact of majority simple tests and focuses more on what is still challenging. Within each rollout, CodeLift applies the same scoring rule to repository snapshots, assigning credit to useful actions even when later ones introduce regressions. Experiments on SWE benchmarks show that CodeLift consistently improves pass@1/2/4/8 over binary and pass-rate baselines. Analyses show that CodeLift provides dense, stable learning signals and unlocks the inherent curriculum in the test suite.

</details>


### [75] [Learning to Extrapolate in Depth with Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14456)
*Huitao Yang,Jianhao Huang,Zixuan Wang,Baharan Mirzasoleiman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究循环Transformer中单块在不同深度间的可外推性，以全对图连通性为任务，揭示存在由单一有效参数控制的权衡，从而形成一个有限的外推窗口，并给出该窗口端点的显式表达及可解图难度的界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer在迭代中复用同一模块，因此一个关键问题是：在某一深度训练的模块能否安全地外推到更深深度。较难的图需要更长程的信息传播，使得这一外推问题尤为突出。

Method: 针对全对图连通性，作者在可交换性与对称正初始化的假设下分析总体训练，证明深度K的训练收敛到一个由单一有效参数支配的更新规则，该参数在图传播与拟合训练深度下未解决的结构之间取得平衡。

Result: 该权衡产生有限外推窗口：测试循环过少导致传播不足，过多则产生虚假连接。作者推导出窗口端点的显式表达，并对超出训练深度的可解图难度给出随训练深度与难度变化的界；当训练深度远超训练难度时，仅依据训练分布选择的测试深度也能在显著更难的图上保证恢复，且认证深度增益呈指数增长。实验验证了预测的窗口，并显示计算预算与初始化对最优训练深度的影响。

Conclusion: 循环Transformer的深度外推存在由传播与拟合权衡决定的有限窗口，其端点可显式刻画；合理选择测试深度可带来随训练深度指数增长的难度增益，且受计算预算与初始化影响。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse a single block across iterations, raising a natural question: how far can a block trained at one depth be safely extrapolated to greater depths? We study this question for all-pairs graph connectivity, where harder graphs require longer-range information propagation. We show that under exchangeability and symmetric positive initialization, population training at depth K converges to an update rule governed by a single effective parameter that balances graph propagation against fitting structure unresolved at training depth. This trade-off creates a finite extrapolation window: too few test-time loops provide insufficient propagation, while too many eventually create false connections. We derive explicit endpoints for this window and bound the graph hardness solvable beyond training as a function of training depth and hardness. In particular, a test depth chosen solely from the training distribution can guarantee recovery on substantially harder graphs, with a certified depth gain that grows exponentially as training depth outpaces training hardness. Experiments validate the predicted windows and show how compute budget and initialization affect the optimal training depth.

</details>


### [76] [Interaction-as-a-Judge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17895)
*Wayne Chi,I-Hung Hsu,Li Chen,Wei-Lin Chiang,Ion Stoica,Anastasios Nikolas Angelopoulos,Ameet Talwalkar,Chris Donahue,Cho-Jui Hsieh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Interaction-as-a-Judge 评估范式，让计算机使用代理（CUA）直接交互应用，同时提升交互式应用的评估与生成质量，并发布两个数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理生成网站、桌面应用、游戏等交互式应用，人类通过交互进行评估，但现有 LLM 自动化评估主要依赖代码分析和单元测试，与人机交互体验存在错位，导致 LLM 评审漏掉人类用户一眼可见的失败。

Method: 提出 Interaction-as-a-Judge：以 CUA 直接与应用交互进行评估。收集并发布两个互补数据集：6,858 对带有偏好标注的应用及对应代理轨迹，222 个经人工核验需求标签的应用。并以推理时自反馈修复和训练时奖励信号两种方式验证其对生成的作用。

Result: 相较非交互方法，偏好预测 65.6%→69.1%，需求验证 77.0%→81.6%，且交互质量越高性能越好（scaling 效应）。推理时五次尝试内修复 75.5% 的破损需求，代码自反馈仅 55.4%；训练时作为奖励信号，胜率较基模型提升 6.7pp，生成代码长度减少 35.7%，构建失败率降低 7.2pp。

Conclusion: 交互式评估能同时增强交互式应用的评估与生成，优于仅基于代码的评估与反馈信号，并提供正向交互 scaling 收益。

Abstract: Coding agents are tasked with producing sophisticated interactive applications such as websites, desktop applications, and games. While humans assess these applications interactively, current automated LLM evaluations primarily focus on code analysis and unit tests. This mismatch can cause LLM judges to miss failures that are immediately apparent to human users. We study Interaction-as-a-Judge, an evaluation paradigm where computer-use agents (CUAs) directly interact with an application. We demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can improve both \emph{evaluation} and \emph{generation} of interactive applications. To this end, we collect and release two complementary datasets: $6,858$ pairs of applications with human preferences and corresponding agent traces, and $222$ applications with human-verified requirement labels. Relative to standard non-interactive approaches, we find that Interaction-as-a-Judge improves evaluation in terms of predicting human preferences ($65.6\% \to 69.1\%$) and requirement verification ($77.0\% \to 81.6\%$). We also observe scaling benefits: across both preference alignment and requirement verification, higher-quality interactions improve performance. Finally, through both inference- and training-time experiments, we demonstrate that Interaction-as-a-Judge can also improve the quality of generated artifacts. At inference time, Interaction-as-a-Judge repairs $75.5\%$ of broken requirements within five attempts, compared to $55.4\%$ for code-only self-feedback. At training time, using Interaction-as-a-Judge as a reward signal improves win-rate over the base model by $6.7$pp while reducing both generated code length by $35.7\%$ and build failure rates by $7.2$pp compared to a code-only reward signal.

</details>


### [77] [A Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM) for Physically-Interpretable Rainfall-Evapotranspiration-Runoff Simulation Across Diverse Hydroclimatic Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14493)
*M Jawad,HV Gupta,MA Farmani,A Behrangi,GY Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出质量守恒、可解释的GCHM（基于MCP）降雨径流模型，在50个CAMELS流域验证，兼顾精度与物理一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动降雨径流模型难以解释，且未显式约束物理守恒定律。机器学习虽有进展，但缺乏质量守恒与可解释性。

Method: GCHM基于Mass-Conserving Perceptron，设五类储量状态：冠层截留、雪、土壤水、地下水、产流；用受约束门控控制降水分配、蒸散、下渗、渗漏、径流与基流，并学习情境依赖的过程关系。用NOAA AORC气象强迫与遥感植被、地表数据进行评估。

Result: 在50个CAMELS流域（融雪主导、近期降雨、历史降雨、干旱）评估，采用JKGE指标。GCHM复现多样水文气候下的径流动态（含干旱流域）；消融实验显示简化结构在湿润条件尚可，但难以刻画旱期流量持续性与退水；学习到的门控恢复出合理水文关系（融雪、径流、渗漏、蒸散），并与RNN基准比较。

Conclusion: GCHM兼具竞争性预测性能、质量守恒与可解释性，为水文建模与反事实分析提供基础。

Abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have improved rainfall-runoff prediction, yet most data-driven models remain difficult to interpret and do not explicitly enforce physical conservation laws. We present the Gated Catchment Hydrology Model (GCHM), a mass-conserving architecture based on the Mass-Conserving Perceptron (MCP). GCHM uses five storage states representing canopy interception, snow, soil moisture, groundwater, and streamflow generation. Constrained gates govern precipitation partitioning, evapotranspiration, infiltration, seepage, runoff, and baseflow while learning context-dependent process relationships.
  We evaluate GCHM across 50 CAMELS catchments spanning snowmelt-dominated, recent-rainfall, historical-rainfall, and arid regimes, using NOAA AORC meteorological forcing and remotely sensed vegetation and land-surface data. Performance is assessed using the Jawad-Kling-Gupta Efficiency (JKGE) metric, which accounts for stationary and non-stationary hydrologic behavior. We compare the full architecture with ablated variants and recurrent neural network benchmarks.
  GCHM reproduces streamflow dynamics across diverse hydroclimatic regimes, including arid catchments, while maintaining interpretable states and fluxes. Ablation experiments show that simplified architectures may perform adequately under wet conditions but struggle to represent flow persistence and recession during dry periods, when groundwater storage sustains low flows. Learned gates recover hydrologically plausible relationships governing snowmelt, runoff, seepage, and evapotranspiration. GCHM combines competitive predictive performance with mass conservation and interpretability, providing a foundation for hydrologic modeling and counterfactual analysis.

</details>


### [78] [DEFT: Disentanglement-Enhanced Fine-Tuning for EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14497)
*Yuqiu Deng,Muyun Jiang,Zongpeng Zhang,Mingqing Xiao,Yansen Wang,Peiliang Gong,Xinliang Zhou,Yi Ding,Ziyu Jia,Cuntai Guan,Chenyu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DEFT：一种即插即用的EEG基础模型微调适配器，将预训练token解耦为任务相关内容与受试者一致风格，仅用内容分支做预测，在多数据集和四种骨干上优于匹配微调基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG基础模型（EFMs）通过大规模多受试者预训练向下游任务迁移知识，提升了EEG表征学习。但其预训练嵌入常保留大量与受试者相关的变异，给下游分类器带来额外负担，在跨受试者场景尤为明显。

Method: DEFT为即插即用适配器，鼓励预训练token在分支上解耦为任务导向的内容与受试者一致的风格，并从内容分支进行下游预测。其"先分解后分类"设计通过四项机制实现：递归高斯细化、时间方差正则化、受试者感知对比学习与重构。

Result: 在多个EEG数据集与四种EFM骨干上的实验表明，DEFT优于相匹配的微调基线；进一步的消融与分析支持其内容/风格分支组织符合设计意图。

Conclusion: DEFT通过内容-风格解耦有效缓解EEG基础模型嵌入中的受试者变异问题，作为通用适配器提升跨受试者下游性能，且分支结构得到实证支持。

Abstract: EEG foundation models (EFMs) have improved EEG representation learning by transferring knowledge from large-scale multi-subject pretraining to downstream tasks. However, their pretrained embeddings often retain substantial subject-related variation, placing an additional burden on the downstream classifier, especially in cross-subject settings. To address this issue, we propose Disentangled EFM Fine-Tuning (DEFT), a plug-and-play adapter for EFM fine-tuning. DEFT encourages branch disentanglement of pretrained tokens into task-oriented content and subject-consistent style, then performs downstream prediction from the content branch. It instantiates this factorize-before-classify design with recursive Gaussian refinement, temporal-variance regularization, subject-aware contrastive learning, and reconstruction. Experiments across multiple EEG datasets and four EFM backbones show that DEFT improves matched fine-tuning baselines. Further ablations and analyses support the intended content/style branch organization.

</details>


### [79] [Rethinking Activation Functions: Reducing Bias Can Improve Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14500)
*Zirui Peng,Heyi Zheng,Ziming Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 常用激活函数普遍产生正值输出，形成"激活偏置"（非零激活后均值）。本文通过受控模型与大规模实验揭示：激活偏置会加速初期损失下降，但伴随过冲、非平滑轨迹和更陡峭的损失地形；降低激活偏置则初期学习变慢，却能获得更低的最终损失。该性质显著影响学习过程，应被纳入激活函数设计考量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReLU、GELU、Swish、Sigmoid 等主流激活函数输出以正值为主，导致激活后均值非零，即"激活偏置"。该现象虽普遍存在，其对学习动力学的影响却缺乏系统理解，且通常被忽视。作者旨在厘清激活偏置如何影响训练过程与最终性能，并推动其在激活函数设计中被显式考虑。

Method: 采用受控模型（controlled models）分析激活偏置对训练动力学的影响，观察初始损失下降速度、轨迹平滑性、过冲现象及损失地形陡峭程度；同时考察模型是否利用激活偏置分量中编码的任务相关信息。并在较大规模的视觉与语言模型上进行验证实验，检验激活偏置大小与后期性能之间的关系。

Result: 受控模型中，激活偏置加速初始损失下降，但伴随过冲、非平滑轨迹与更陡峭的损失地形，且这一早期优势与模型利用激活偏置分量中的任务相关信息相吻合。降低激活偏置会减慢初始学习，但最终达到更低的最终损失。在较大规模视觉与语言模型上呈现相似规律：较小的激活偏置与更好的后期性能相关。

Conclusion: 激活偏置这一看似微小的属性会显著改变学习轨迹：它带来早期训练优势，却可能损害最终收敛性能。因此，激活函数设计中应显式考虑并调控激活偏置，而非仅关注其形状或非线性形式。

Abstract: Many widely used activation functions, including ReLU, GELU, Swish, and Sigmoid, produce predominantly positive outputs, resulting in a nonzero post-activation mean that we term activation bias. Despite its ubiquity, the effect of activation bias on learning dynamics remains poorly understood. Using controlled models, we show that activation bias accelerates initial loss reduction but is accompanied by overshooting, non-smooth trajectories, and a steeper loss landscape. This early advantage also coincides with the model's use of task-relevant information encoded in the activation bias component. In contrast, reducing activation bias slows initial learning but ultimately yields a lower final loss. Experiments on larger vision and language models exhibit a similar pattern: smaller activation bias is associated with better late-stage performance. Thus, this seemingly minor property can substantially redirect learning and warrants explicit consideration in future activation function design.

</details>


### [80] [Query-Adaptive Neuron Steering for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14519)
*Yanxi Pan,Jingwen Wu,Yan Ma,Xiang Chen,Xinyi Zeng,Xuetong Wang,Yunyan Zhang,Yue Zhang,Yu Tian,Jianfeng Pan,Hongyi Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Q-NeuS，一种查询自适应的神经元引导框架，用Neu-GRPO训练轻量门控实现LLM推理时动态干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时激发LLM能力是重要挑战。现有上下文工程需塑造查询，固定引导直接干预计算，但预定义上下文与固定策略难以适配单个查询的多样知识与推理需求，故作者追问：LLM内部引导能否查询自适应？

Method: 预实验发现神经元激活具主题与层依赖性，放大主题相关神经元可提升性能。据此构建紧凑的主题引导候选神经元空间，并设计轻量Query-Adaptive Gate生成逐神经元调制系数。提出Neu-GRPO，将组相对优化用于训练该门控，以多组神经元干预配置的相对表现为奖励。基座LLM在训练与推理全程冻结，推理时无需任务或主题标签。

Result: 在多个LLM与基准上的大量实验表明，Q-NeuS持续提升模型性能，跨模型规模适用性强，并具跨基准迁移能力。

Conclusion: 查询诱导的内部激活可有效指导自适应引导，Q-NeuS为推理时激发LLM能力提供了一种无需标签、插件式且可迁移的神经元级干预方案。

Abstract: Effectively eliciting the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) at inference time remains an important challenge. Existing studies address this challenge through context engineering, which shapes user queries, or fixed steering, which directly intervenes in model computation. However, predefined contexts and fixed intervention strategies may not adequately accommodate the diverse knowledge and reasoning requirements of individual queries. This raises a natural question: Can internal steering in LLMs be made query-adaptive? In this work, we investigate whether query-induced internal activations can guide adaptive steering in LLMs. Our pilot studies reveal subject- and layer-dependent neuron activation patterns and show that amplifying subject-relevant neurons can improve model performance. Based on these findings, we propose Q-NeuS, a query-adaptive neuron steering framework that dynamically determines which neurons to modulate and by how much for each input. Specifically, Q-NeuS constructs a compact subject-guided candidate neuron space and employs a lightweight Query-Adaptive Gate to generate neuron-wise modulation coefficients. To learn effective intervention strategies, we introduce Neu-GRPO, which adapts group-relative optimization to train the Query-Adaptive Gate using the relative performance of multiple neuron intervention configurations. The base LLM remains frozen throughout training and inference, and no task or subject labels are required at inference time. Extensive experiments across multiple LLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that Q-NeuS consistently improves model performance and exhibits broad applicability across model scales and strong cross-benchmark transferability.

</details>


### [81] [Active Neural Matter: A Finite-Window Response Framework for Physical Systems and Distributed AI Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14549)
*Tianchi Chen,Shihua Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Active Neural Matter (ANM) 有限窗口响应框架，通过前向与逆向分析，量化状态为预测未来响应所需保留的历史信息，并给出近似行为误差下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理系统与分布式 AI 工作流普遍存在历史信息留存、延迟反馈与冲突信号问题，核心建模难题是：状态需保留多少过去交互信息才能解释未来响应。

Method: 采用有限窗口响应框架。前向分析利用系统动力学预测状态与输出对扰动的响应，分离传播与输出敏感性；逆向分析检验候选状态是否保留足够信息。固定系统与未来输入/交互规则后，同一状态下可区分响应的历史差异界定表示必须保留的区分；其分布分离度给出从该状态近似行为的最坏误差下界。并以不确定性界区分拒绝、固定容差内支持与未决三类情形。

Result: 延迟共识仿真在窄延迟范围内验证了响应幅度与相位的解析预测；群体行为展示了对所选可观测量量的依赖；精确延迟返回构造给出特定程序的充分状态。AI 研究识别出为复现观察响应分布，表示必须保留的交互历史与证据顺序区分；受控反馈任务中新历史测试为任务指令指定的状态提供有界支持，指令规则预测了全部观察动作。

Conclusion: ANM 将响应预测与可测信息需求相连接，区分行为保真度与任务正确性，并区分初始状态充分性与该状态的闭合演化律。

Abstract: Physical systems and distributed AI workflows can retain past information, receive delayed feedback and combine conflicting signals. These features pose a common modeling problem: determining what information about past interactions a state must retain to account for future responses. Active Neural Matter (ANM) addresses this problem through a finite-window response framework. Forward analysis uses each system's dynamics to predict state and output responses to perturbations, separating propagation from output sensitivity. Inverse analysis tests whether a candidate state retains enough information for these responses. With the system and future inputs or interaction rules fixed, distinguishable responses from histories assigned the same state identify distinctions the representation must preserve. Their distributional separation gives a lower bound on the worst-case error of approximating behavior from that state. Uncertainty bounds distinguish rejection, support within a fixed tolerance on tested comparisons, and unresolved cases. Delayed-consensus simulations check analytical predictions of response amplitude and phase over a narrow range of delays; flocking illustrates dependence on the chosen observable. An exact delayed-return construction establishes a sufficient state for a specified program. The AI studies identify distinctions in interaction history and evidence order that a representation must preserve to reproduce observed response distributions. Tests on new histories in a controlled feedback task provide bounded support for a state specified by the task instructions; the instructed rule predicts every observed action. ANM connects response prediction to measurable information requirements, separating behavioral fidelity from task correctness and initial-state adequacy from a closed evolution law for that state.

</details>


### [82] [PGSB: Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis for LoRA Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14558)
*Muqing Liu,Chongjie Si,Zhuoya Liu,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PGSB，一种用于LoRA模型合并的两阶段框架，先识别任务间共享方向，再结合预训练权重重新参数化，从而优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全量微调成本高，维护多个任务专属模型存储低效且无法形成统一多任务模型；现有LoRA合并方法将任务更新视为可直接比较对象，忽略更新方向的可靠共享性及相对预训练权重的重参数化问题。

Method: 提出Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis（PGSB）两阶段框架：第一阶段在任务专属LoRA更新中识别共享方向；第二阶段利用这些方向与预训练权重的交互进行重新参数化，构造更适合合并的基。

Result: 大量实验表明，PGSB在多个基准上持续优于当前最先进基线。

Conclusion: PGSB通过共享方向识别与预训练引导的重参数化，提升了LoRA模型合并效果，为多任务统一模型提供有效方案。

Abstract: Large pretrained models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, yet adapting them to multiple downstream tasks remains challenging: full fine-tuning is costly, while maintaining separate task-specific models is storage-inefficient and fails to produce a unified multi-task model. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) offers an efficient alternative for Model Merging by representing each task adaptation as a low-rank update over frozen pretrained weights. However, existing LoRA merging methods often treat task-specific updates as directly comparable objects and merge them in their original low-rank parameter spaces. This overlooks two key factors: which update directions provide reliable shared support across tasks, and how these directions should be re-parameterized with respect to the pretrained weights before merging. To address this limitation, we propose Pretrained-Guided Shared Basis (PGSB), a two-stage framework for LoRA model merging. PGSB first identifies shared directions among task-specific LoRA updates, and then re-parameterizes these directions using their interaction with the pretrained weights, producing a more suitable basis for merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSB consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple benchmarks. Codes are available at https://github.com/Kitschnada/Pretrained-Basis .

</details>


### [83] [Reward-Aligned Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14572)
*Yilan Chen,Zian Su,Manish Prajapat,Dingmin Wang,Rein Houthooft,Rui Song,Vijay Lingam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出奖励对齐蒸馏（RAD），一种双层框架，依据蒸馏信号对学生更新后奖励的预测影响来为每个token分配权重，从而在数学与代码任务上超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习能提升大语言模型推理能力，但计算昂贵且样本效率低；在线策略蒸馏（OPD）虽提供密集的token级监督，却对所有token一视同仁地蒸馏，未考虑教师偏好是否真正提升任务奖励。现有token选择方法依赖不确定性或师生散度等代理指标，未必能识别出真正提升奖励的监督信号。

Method: RAD是一个双层框架：通过临时优化器步进行微分，为每个token的监督信号打分，再以从初始token权重出发的投影上升更新token权重。所得权重可增强、抑制或反转单个蒸馏梯度贡献。另提出简化变体RAD-Simple。

Result: 在相同训练响应预算下，RAD在六个数学竞赛基准上，Qwen3-1.7B（非思考）平均准确率较最强基线提升6.5个百分点，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507提升2.5个百分点；RAD-Simple达到相当数学准确率。在LiveCodeBench-v6上，RAD以Qwen3-1.7B（非思考）和OLMo3-7B-Instruct分别取得54.69%和58.67% pass@1，超越最强基线8.7和6.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 结果表明，奖励引导的教师监督加权策略可跨模型家族与任务泛化，有效提升推理能力并改善蒸馏效率。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but remains computationally expensive and sample inefficient. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, yet standard OPD distills every token regardless of whether the teacher's preference actually improves task reward. Existing token-selection methods rely on proxies such as uncertainty or teacher--student divergence, which need not identify reward-improving supervision. We introduce Reward-Aligned Distillation (RAD), a bilevel framework that weights distillation signals based on their predicted effect on the student's post-update reward. RAD differentiates through a temporary optimizer step to score each token's supervision, then updates the token weights by projected ascent from the initial token weights. The resulting weights can strengthen, suppress, or reverse individual distillation-gradient contributions. At a matched training-response budget, RAD improves mean accuracy on six competition-math benchmarks over the strongest baselines by 6.5 percentage points for Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and 2.5 points for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507. RAD-Simple, a simplified variant, achieves comparable math accuracy at the same training-response budget. On LiveCodeBench-v6, RAD reaches 54.69\% and 58.67\% pass@1 with Qwen3-1.7B (non-thinking) and OLMo3-7B-Instruct, respectively, exceeding the strongest baselines by 8.7 and 6.4 points. These results support reward-guided weighting of teacher supervision across model families and tasks.

</details>


### [84] [LLM-Augmented Bayesian Optimization with Adaptive Policies for Chiplet Design Space Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14612)
*Hang Liu,Zhengfei Chen,Zhengrui Chen,Hao Geng,Yu Li,Qi Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LLM与贝叶斯优化协同的chiplet设计框架，支持2.5D/3D CPU-GPU异构架构仿真与自动优化，提升设计空间探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Chiplet技术是延续摩尔定律的关键路径，但其设计面临两大挑战：缺乏可快速评估chiplet异构系统的早期平台，以及设计参数与优化指标间关系复杂。

Method: 构建LLM与贝叶斯优化（BO）协同框架。扩展开源chiplet仿真器以支持图拓扑的3D设计评估；引入LLM生成高质量策略引导BO优化，依赖所提出的自适应方向性策略推理（ADPR）与探索增益感知微调方法；最终用策略引导的BO对复杂chiplet设计空间进行自动化高效探索。

Result: 在2.5D与3D chiplet上的实验表明，该框架提升了设计空间探索效率。

Conclusion: LLM与BO的协同框架可有效应对chiplet异构系统早期评估与优化难题，实现架构级仿真与自动化优化。

Abstract: Chiplet technology is a key approach for extending Moore's Law. However, its design process is constrained by two primary challenges: the scarcity of early-stage platforms for rapidly evaluating chiplet-based heterogeneous systems, and the complex relationships between design parameters and optimization metrics. To address these challenges, we propose a synergistic framework that integrates a Large Language Model (LLM) with Bayesian Optimization (BO), enabling architectural-level simulation and automated optimization for the 2.5D/3D CPU-GPU heterogeneous chiplets. We extend the open-source chiplet simulator to evaluate 3D designs by supporting graph topologies. Further, to enhance the exploration efficiency of BO, we introduce an LLM that generates high-quality policies to guide the optimization process, enabled by our proposed adaptive directional policy reasoning (ADPR) and an exploration gain-aware fine-tuning method. Finally, we use the policy-guided BO to perform an automated and efficient exploration of the complex chiplet design space. Experiments on 2.5D and 3D chiplet reveal that our framework improves design space exploration efficiency.

</details>


### [85] [From Rainfall to Road-Network Functionality: Transferable Graph Forecasting for Flood-Disrupted Transportation Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14622)
*Junyan Wang,Naiyu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出G-R2R——一种可迁移的时空图学习框架，将极端降雨引发的路网功能退化（RNF）建模为区域条件化、拓扑灵活的图预测问题，实现在未见路网上的节点级RNF预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极端降雨会迅速削弱路网功能，影响应急出行、可达性、疏散、物流与基础设施恢复。但既有洪水—交通影响模型多依赖本地标定、密集仿真流程或目标区域重训练，难以跨区域部署。

Method: G-R2R融合四项关键设计：以自我中心（ego-centered）子图采样、地形条件化图表示、区域条件化双层静态编码，以及动态降雨—路网特征学习；将静态地理与基础设施属性、降雨强迫和近期RNF状态融合，预测异质路网中的节点级RNF。

Result: 基于中国温州10个洪涝易发区的仿真RNF序列，在未见区域测试协议下，G-R2R优于代表性预测基线，固定未见区域基准下MAPE稳定为2.33%、R²为0.855；留一区域评估的稳定MAPE为2.30%–3.54%；消融实验支持地形条件化图表示与双层静态编码的贡献；台风Fitow历史事件回放中，无需目标区域重训练即可复现仿真参考RNF的主要时间轨迹与节点级空间格局。

Conclusion: 结果表明该方法可在本研究覆盖的区域路网范围内实现快速、可迁移的节点级RNF预测。

Abstract: Extreme rainfall can rapidly degrade road-network functionality (RNF), disrupting emergency mobility, accessibility, evacuation, logistics, and infrastructure restoration. Existing flood-transportation impact models are often difficult to deploy across regions because they rely on local calibration, intensive simulation workflows or target-region retraining. This study proposes G-R2R, a transferable spatiotemporal graph-learning framework that reframes rainfall-induced road-network disruption as a region-conditioned, topology-flexible graph forecasting problem for unseen transportation networks. The framework integrates ego-centered subgraph sampling, terrain-conditioned graph representation, region-conditioned dual-level static encoding, and dynamic rainfall-network feature learning. Static geographic and infrastructure attributes are fused with rainfall forcing and recent RNF states to forecast node-level RNF across heterogeneous road networks. G-R2R is evaluated using simulation-derived RNF sequences from ten flood-prone regions in Wenzhou, China, under unseen-region testing protocols. It outperforms representative forecasting baselines, achieving a stabilized MAPE of 2.33% and $R^2$ of 0.855 under the fixed unseen-region benchmark. Leave-one-area-out evaluation yields stabilized MAPE values of 2.30%-3.54%. Ablation analysis supports the contributions of the terrain-conditioned graph representation and dual-level static encoding. A historical-event replay of Typhoon Fitow further shows that G-R2R reproduces principal temporal trajectories and node-level spatial patterns of the simulation-derived RNF reference under observed rainfall forcing without target-region retraining. These results support rapid and transferable node-level RNF forecasting across the regional road-network domains represented in this study.

</details>


### [86] [TagBO: LLM-Driven Task-Aware Graph Bayesian Optimization for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14626)
*Xinzhe Yuan,Zimu Zeng,Zhuo Chen,Jianshu Zhang,Jinzong Dong,Jingyi Chen,Nanyang Ye,Huan Xiong,Qinying Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TagBO：将大语言模型导出的任务感知关系先验与描述符结构信息结合，用于混合变量贝叶斯优化，在化学与材料配方任务中提升样本效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现中的混合变量优化需在昂贵实验评估下探索大型组合空间，样本效率至关重要。现有贝叶斯优化依赖结构描述符定义类别变量相似性，隐含假设结构相似即性能相似，该假设在科学优化中常被违背，导致代理表示与优化目标错位。

Method: 提出TagBO（任务感知图贝叶斯优化）。不将LLM输出直接当作预测分数，而是视其为潜在含噪的任务感知关系先验来源，从LLM推理中提取粗粒度序数关系信号，构建面向科学优化的任务感知相似性结构；随后在形成的离散-连续联合表示空间上进行约束高斯过程贝叶斯优化。

Result: 在多种化学与材料配方任务上的实验表明，在固定评估预算下，TagBO对不同能力水平的LLM均能稳定提升样本效率。

Conclusion: 以LLM关系先验弥补结构描述符的语义偏差，将粗粒度序数信号与结构信息融合于统一表示空间，是提升混合变量科学优化样本效率的有效途径，且对LLM能力差异具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Mixed-variable optimization in scientific discovery often requires exploring large combinatorial spaces under costly experimental evaluations, making sample?efficient Bayesian optimization (BO) essential. However, existing BO methods typ?ically rely on structural descriptors to define similarity among categorical variables, implicitly assuming that structural similarity reflects similarity in task performance. In scientific optimization, this assumption is often violated, leading to surrogate representations that are poorly aligned with the optimization objective. To address this limitation, we propose TagBO (Task-aware Graph Bayesian Optimization), a method that integrates LLM-derived relational priors with descriptor-based struc?tural information for mixed-variable Bayesian optimization. Rather than directly using LLM outputs as predictive scores, TagBO treats LLM outputs as a potentially noisy source of task-aware relational priors and extracts coarse ordinal relational signals from LLM reasoning to construct task-aware similarity structures for scien?tific optimization. TagBO then performs constrained Gaussian process Bayesian optimization over the resulting joint discrete-continuous representation space. Ex?periments on diverse chemistry and materials formulation tasks demonstrate that TagBO consistently improves sample efficiency under fixed evaluation budgets across LLMs of varying capabilities.

</details>


### [87] [Ascent Conditions for Length-Normalized Single-Rollout Policy Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14670)
*Levin David Schwab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在有限轨迹模型中研究按轨迹长度归一化的策略梯度更新，推导出三结果softmax策略的精确上升阈值，并给出二元奖励下期望欧氏更新反而降低任务成功率的反例，同时提出三阶U统计量以实现无偏的一阶回报变化估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将每条轨迹的得分贡献除以其实现长度（长度归一化）会改变以奖励为中心的策略更新的方向，这一常见操作可能导致策略更新偏离上升方向，但缺乏对其失效条件的精确刻画。

Method: 构建有限轨迹模型，对三结果softmax策略推导精确的上升阈值；构造二元奖励反例分析期望欧氏更新；考察自然梯度上升在完全可控结果分布（确定性二元标签）与单参数限制下的表现；提出基于独立当前策略轨迹（每次请求一条）的三阶U统计量，用于无偏估计一阶回报变化，并与同样本plug-in估计器对比。

Result: 在反例中，期望欧氏更新会降低任务成功率；同样本plug-in估计器在批量大小2至49时期望符号相反；精确策略网格枚举确认了局部符号反转；自然梯度上升在完全可控分布下成立，但在单参数限制下可能失效；分支过程中长度归一化学习先损失回报，随后恢复并超过未归一化对照。

Conclusion: 长度归一化会改变甚至逆转策略更新的上升方向，其有效性依赖于阈值条件；三阶U统计量可无偏估计一阶回报变化，而常规plug-in估计器在小批量下存在期望符号错误。

Abstract: Dividing each trajectory's score contribution by its realized length can change the direction of a reward-centered policy update. In a finite trajectory model, we derive an exact ascent threshold for a three-outcome softmax policy and exhibit a binary-reward example in which the expected Euclidean update decreases task success. Natural-gradient ascent holds for fully controllable outcome distributions with deterministic binary labels, but can fail under a one-parameter restriction. A third-order U-statistic estimates the first-order return change without bias from independent current-policy trajectories, one per request. In the example, a same-sample plug-in estimator instead has the opposite sign in expectation for batch sizes two through forty-nine. Exact policy-grid enumeration confirms the local sign reversal. In a branching process, length-normalized learning initially loses return, then recovers and exceeds the unnormalized comparator. The analysis concerns the expected update field at the current policy.

</details>


### [88] [Triage-PiEvo: Evidence Admission for Principle-Evolving Scientific Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14683)
*Peize Li,Yingming Pu,Xingguo Xu,Yiming Cui,Yuansheng Gao,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将原则演化中"是否采纳新证据"建模为证据准入问题，提出 TRIAGE-PIEVO 框架：异常可立即引导搜索，但只有经独立验证的证据才能改写持久原则，被矛盾的原则予以撤回。在四个科学任务、三种基座模型上取得最优解质量（+7.5%~11.8%），仅用三分之一预算即可匹配最强基线满预算质量；在压力测试中拒绝全部被污染证据且不漏报真实机制；在三个外部研究框架中接入后错误证据采纳率下降超60%，验证得分提升31%~43%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于大语言模型的 AI Scientist 推动了科学发现，但受噪声观测影响效率低。现有原则演化智能体对每个异常都采取行动，却未厘清异常来源究竟是新机制还是评估假象，导致无效修订污染演化过程。因此需要一种机制，区分异常驱动的搜索与可写入持久原则的证据。

Method: 将修订形式化为"证据准入"：异常立即引导搜索，但只有经独立验证的证据才允许改写持久原则，且被反证的原则会被撤回。具体实现为 TRIAGE-PIEVO，将异常响应式搜索组合（search portfolio）与分阶段验证门（staged verification gate）配对，由后者独占控制进入原则状态的证据。

Result: （1）在四个科学任务、三种基座上取得最高平均解质量，较最强基线提升 7.5%~11.8%；在 Qwen3-235B 上以三分之一评估预算即达到最强基线满预算质量。（2）在构造的压力测试中，对损坏证据、隐藏来源证据和利用性证据零采纳，同时不遗漏任何植入机制。（3）原样接入三个外部研究框架，错误证据采纳率下降超过 60%，验证得分提升 31%~43%。

Conclusion: 通过将证据准入与搜索响应解耦，TRIAGE-PIEVO 有效抑制了无效修订对原则演化的偏置，在效率、鲁棒性与跨框架可移植性上均优于现有原则演化智能体。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based AI Scientists advance scientific discovery, yet they suffer from inefficiencies due to noisy observations. Existing principle-evolving agents act on every anomaly, leaving its source unresolved: a new mechanism or an evaluation artifact, so invalid revisions bias evolution. To address this, we formulate revision as evidence admission: anomalies steer search immediately, but only independently verified evidence may rewrite persistent principles, and contradicted principles are retracted. We realize this in TRIAGE-PIEVO , which pairs an anomaly-responsive search portfolio with a staged verification gate that alone controls what enters principle state. Across four scientific tasks with three backbones, TRIAGE-PIEVO (1) attains the highest average solution quality with +7.5%~11.8% over the strongest baseline per backbone, matching the strongest baseline's full-budget quality with one-third of the evaluation budget on Qwen3-235B; and additional stress tests and cross-harness deployment demonstrate that (2) in constructed stress tests, it admits none of the corrupted, hidden-source, or exploit evidence that ungated variants admit, while missing no planted mechanism, and (3) plugged unchanged into three external research harnesses, it cuts false evidence admissions by over 60% and raises verified scores by 31%~43%.

</details>


### [89] [One-Way Coupling via Patchwise Adaptive Normalization in Transformer Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14687)
*Emmanuel Gottlob,Hugo Thimonier,Ludovico Buizza,August Martens,Alexandre Gavaudan,Thiago Guzella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 PAdaNorm，将外生场按 patch 划分并与状态 token 对齐做自适应归一化，在三个 PDE 域上提升精度（最高16%）并保持物理约束，静态条件下可缓存嵌入，推理 FLOPs 每步降低最多36%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多物理系统存在单向耦合：外生场（如介质密度、障碍物几何）影响动力学但不受其影响。作者希望显式表征这些外生场，以提升基于 Transformer 的 PDE 代理模型的精度与计算效率。

Method: 基于空间自适应归一化，提出 Patchwise Adaptive Normalization（PAdaNorm）：将外生场划分为与状态 tokenization 对齐的 patch。采用受 Walrus 启发的 Transformer 架构，在三个不同领域的数据集上评估；当条件为静态时，一次性缓存条件嵌入并在整个 rollout 中复用；并对八种条件变体进行消融。

Result: 在三个 PDE 族上，60 步自回归 rollout 的平均长时程方差缩放 RMSE 与参数匹配基线相当或最多优 16%；更好地维持硬物理约束（如多孔介质中防止流入不可穿透固体区域）；静态条件下每步推理 FLOPs 相比参数匹配基线最多降低 36%；消融显示调制单一注意力轴（时间或空间）即可，跨块轻量共享 MLP 与逐块投影性能相当。

Conclusion: 显式表征外生场并通过与之对齐的 patch 自适应归一化，可同时改善 PDE 代理模型的精度、物理约束保持能力与推理效率；条件嵌入缓存与轻量共享投影是有效且经济的实现方式。

Abstract: Many physical systems exhibit one-way coupling: exogenous fields such as medium density or obstacle geometry influence the dynamics without being affected by them. We investigate how explicitly representing these fields can improve the accuracy and computational efficiency of transformer-based PDE surrogates. Building on spatially adaptive normalization, we introduce Patchwise Adaptive Normalization (PAdaNorm), which partitions exogenous fields into patches aligned with the state tokenization. We evaluate PAdaNorm on datasets from three different domains, using a Walrus-inspired transformer architecture. Across the three PDE families, PAdaNorm is on par with or up to 16% better than parameter-matched baselines in mean long-horizon variance-scaled RMSE on 60-step autoregressive rollouts. We also find that PAdaNorm better maintains hard physical constraints over long rollouts, such as preventing flow into impenetrable solid regions in porous media. When the conditioning is static, PAdaNorm caches the conditioning embeddings once and reuses them across the entire rollout, reducing inference FLOPs per step by up to 36% compared with parameter-matched baselines. An ablation over eight conditioning variants shows that modulating a single attention axis (temporal or spatial) suffices and that a lightweight shared MLP across blocks remains competitive with per-block projections.

</details>


### [90] [Accelerating Cross-Model LLM Inference via Attention Map Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14688)
*Zhan Jin,Yuze Luo,Bin Cui,Xupeng Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MapFlow系统，通过跨模型复用注意力图（而非KV状态）实现异构LLM服务的高效预填充复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM增强的数据工作流涉及多个异构模型在大量共享上下文（如模式、工具规范、交互历史、中间结果）上运行。前缀缓存虽可降低预填充开销，但现有方法因KV状态与模型特定架构紧密耦合，基本局限于同一模型内复用。

Method: MapFlow复用跨模型更具可迁移性的注意力图（捕捉token依赖模式），而非KV状态；结合部分重计算与跨层、跨头的轻量线性变换实现高效准确复用；并引入块级稀疏压缩与融合检索内核以支持长上下文。

Result: 实验表明，MapFlow降低了预填充延迟、提升了端到端服务效率，同时在多种异构模型对及多轮路由工作负载下保持生成质量。

Conclusion: 注意力图可作为异构LLM服务的有效可复用状态，尤其适用于前缀密集型数据工作流。

Abstract: LLM-augmented data workflows often involve multiple heterogeneous models operating over substantial shared context, such as schemas, tool specifications, interaction history, and intermediate results. Although prefix caching can reduce prefilling overhead, existing approaches are largely limited to reuse within the same model because KV states are tightly coupled to model-specific architectures. We present MapFlow, a system for efficient heterogeneous LLM serving via cross-model attention map reuse. Instead of reusing KV states, MapFlow reuses attention maps, which capture token dependency patterns and are more transferable across models. To enable efficient and accurate reuse, we combine partial recomputation with lightweight linear translation across layers and heads. To make attention reuse practical for long contexts, we further introduce block-level sparse compression and a fused retrieval kernel. Experiments show that MapFlow reduces prefilling latency and improves end-to-end serving efficiency while preserving generation quality across heterogeneous model pairs and multi-turn routing workloads. These results suggest that attention maps provide an effective reusable state for heterogeneous LLM serving, especially in prefix-heavy data workflows. Our code is available: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/MapFlow.

</details>


### [91] [Understanding Hidden Spatial Preferences in Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14696)
*Maria Bånkestad,Jens Sjölund*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 贝叶斯优化中高斯过程后验方差在边界附近偏大，导致基于方差的采集函数存在系统性边界偏好；本文将预测模型固定，通过空间权重场解耦并调控探索项的空间偏好，实验表明改变该偏好常能降低早期遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化用后验不确定性决定探索位置，但该不确定性并非空间中性：在有界域上，高斯过程后验方差通常在面、边、角附近更大，使基于方差的采集函数产生系统性边界偏好。这种空间偏好一般继承自代理模型，而非被当作探索策略的一部分主动选择，作者希望将其分离并加以控制。

Method: 保持预测模型固定，仅修改探索项的空间偏好：用空间权重场控制偏好，并借助神经代理模型摊销其构建成本。在此基础上对比三种替代性探索准则。

Result: 控制实验显示，高斯过程默认的边界偏好会改变域中哪些区域被探索、哪些最优值被找到；在标准基准函数和随机机器人推动任务上，三种替代探索准则往往能降低遗憾，尤其在优化早期。

Conclusion: 后验不确定性的空间结构并非中性默认设置：它塑造探索策略，并能实质影响优化性能，因此应被显式作为探索设计的一部分加以选择。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization uses posterior uncertainty to decide where to explore, but this uncertainty is not spatially neutral. On bounded domains, Gaussian-process posterior variance is typically larger near faces, edges, and corners, giving variance-based acquisition functions a systematic boundary bias. This spatial preference is usually inherited from the surrogate rather than chosen as part of the exploration strategy. We separate these roles by keeping the predictive model fixed and modifying the spatial preference of the exploration term. We control the preference with spatial weight fields and amortize their construction with neural surrogates. Controlled experiments show that the Gaussian process' default boundary bias changes which parts of the domain are explored and which optima are reached. We compare three alternative exploration principles and find, across standard benchmark functions and stochastic robot-pushing tasks, that they can often lower regret, particularly early in the optimization. The spatial structure of posterior uncertainty is therefore not a neutral default: it shapes the exploration strategy and can materially affect optimization performance.

</details>


### [92] [Linear-Time Non-Local Codec Placement for Machine Learning Model Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14703)
*Matteo Spallanzani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种将编解码算子放置到源计算图中的线性时间算法，通过图着色找到"绝对支配者"节点以学习参数化编解码算子，相比朴素局部放置减少24%–44%的建模操作数流量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧推理受限于模型存储与操作数流量，压缩操作数表示虽有帮助，但需要编解码算子；若朴素地放置编解码算子，会抵消压缩带来的流量收益。因此需要一种将编解码算子合理插入源计算图、使其与目标硬件兼容的放置方法。

Method: 对源计算图的边进行着色，使每个诱导子图弱连通，并具有一个极大节点——该节点同时后支配所有子图输入、支配所有子图输出，称为"绝对支配者"（absolute dominator）。该唯一节点即观察子图流量的自然位置，用于学习参数化编解码算子。算法时间复杂度与源图规模呈线性关系。

Result: 在四个模型上，相比朴素局部编解码放置，该算法将建模的操作数流量减少24%–44%，其中SigLIP上减少24%，SmolLM2上减少34%。

Conclusion: 通过图着色与绝对支配者定位，可在保证图与硬件兼容的前提下有效放置参数化编解码算子，以线性时间代价显著降低操作数流量，提升端侧推理的压缩收益。

Abstract: On-device inference imposes constraints on model storage and operand traffic and thus benefits from compressed operand representations, which mandate the use of encoding and decoding operators. However, naïve placement of codec operators can cancel the operand traffic gains sought from compression. In this work, I present an algorithm to place codec operators into a source computational graph to make it compatible with target hardware. The edges of the graph are colored so that each induced subgraph is weakly connected and has a maximal node that both postdominates all subgraph inputs and dominates all subgraph outputs; this unique node - dubbed the $\textit{absolute dominator}$ - is the natural location to observe the traffic flowing through the subgraph and learn parametric codec operators. The algorithm's time complexity is linear in the source graph's size. With respect to naïve local codec placement, the algorithm reduces modeled operand traffic by $24\%$-$44\%$ across four models, including $24\%$ on SigLIP and $34\%$ on SmolLM2.

</details>


### [93] [DeKoR: Decomposed Knowledge Routing for Efficient GNN--LLM Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14710)
*Peiyuan Li,Yongqi Huang,Jitao Zhao,Di Jin,Dongxiao He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeKoR：将LLM知识分解为局部与全局视图，通过离线蒸馏到轻量专家并结合自适应路由，实现高效、选择性的LLM-GNN知识融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM与GNN遵循不同学习范式，知识空间存在明显不匹配，融合困难；现有方法为有限性能提升付出了大量额外计算开销。

Method: DeKoR将LLM知识分解为互补的局部视图与全局视图，把LLM作为离线教师蒸馏进轻量级专家模型；再通过自适应路由器（adaptive router）为每个节点学习对各专家的依赖权重，从而实现选择性的知识融合。

Result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，DeKoR在节点分类与子图分类任务上均优于现有基线，兼具更优的有效性与效率。

Conclusion: 通过离线蒸馏与自适应路由实现高效选择性知识融合，可在有限计算开销下提升文本属性图学习性能。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for text-attributed graph learning by leveraging rich pre-trained knowledge and language understanding capabilities. Combining LLMs with Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) offers a promising paradigm for expanding the modeling capabilities of graph learning. However, LLMs and GNNs follow distinct learning paradigms, leading to a pronounced mismatch between their knowledge spaces. Such discrepancies make effective knowledge fusion nontrivial. Moreover, existing methods often incur substantial additional computation for only limited performance gains. To address these challenges, we propose DeKoR, an efficient framework for GNN and LLM knowledge fusion. To enable efficient knowledge transfer, DeKoR decomposes LLM knowledge into complementary local and global views and uses the LLM as an offline teacher to distill them into lightweight experts. To enable selective knowledge fusion, an adaptive router learns how much each node should rely on each expert. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that DeKoR outperforms existing baselines on both node and subgraph classification, achieving superior effectiveness and efficiency.

</details>


### [94] [Multi-Token Random-Walk Learning via Meeting-Triggered Information Exchange](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14716)
*Taichun Yeh,Xingran Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多令牌随机游走(RW)去中心化学习中两种信息交换策略(Average-Gradient与Average-Model),建立了完整图上的迭代复杂度下界,并揭示了两种策略在平均令牌损失与最优令牌损失上的不同表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RW去中心化学习多依赖单令牌,而多令牌可并行探索网络并在相遇时交换信息,但这种"相遇触发"交互的根本收益尚不明确。作者旨在量化多令牌带来的理论加速,并厘清不同交换策略的适用场景。

Method: 在完整图上研究多令牌RW学习,定义两种交换策略:Average-Gradient(相遇时平均随机梯度)与Average-Model(相遇时平均更新后的模型)。针对非凸、凸与强凸目标,推导两种策略的迭代复杂度下界,并与单令牌情形进行对比。

Result: 所建立的下界对两种交换策略均成立。相比单令牌学习,下界中的缩放因子在非凸与凸目标上降低m²倍,在强凸目标上随令牌数m指数级降低(m为令牌数)。数值实验显示:Average-Model取得更低平均令牌损失且对网络-令牌比N/m较不敏感;Average-Gradient取得更低最优令牌损失,但当N/m减小时存在并行探索与梯度干扰之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 多令牌RW学习相比单令牌在复杂度上具有显著优势,且两种交换策略各有侧重:Average-Model利于整体平均性能与鲁棒性,Average-Gradient利于获取最优个体性能但受梯度干扰制约。研究结果为多令牌去中心化算法的策略选择提供了理论依据与实践指导。

Abstract: Random walk (RW)-based algorithms are widely used in decentralized learning due to their low communication overhead and scalability. While most existing methods rely on a single token, multiple tokens can explore the network in parallel and exchange information upon meeting. However, the fundamental benefits of such meeting-triggered interactions remain unclear. In this work, we investigate multi-token RW learning under two information exchange policies: \textsc{Average-Gradient} and \textsc{Average-Model}, which average stochastic gradients and updated models, respectively, when tokens meet. We establish iteration complexity lower bounds for non-convex, convex, and strongly convex objectives on complete graphs, which apply to both exchange policies. Compared with single-token RW learning, the scaling factor in these bounds is reduced by a factor of $m^2$ for non-convex and convex objectives, and by an exponentially in $m$ for strongly convex objectives, where $m$ denotes the number of tokens. Numerical experiments reveal distinct behaviors of the two policies under two performance criteria: mean-token loss (the average loss across all tokens) and best-token loss (the minimum loss across all tokens). \textsc{Average-Model} achieves lower mean-token loss and is relatively insensitive to the network-to-token ratio $N/m$, where $N$ is the number of nodes. In contrast, \textsc{Average-Gradient} achieves lower best-token loss but exhibits a trade-off between parallel exploration and gradient interference as $N/m$ decreases.

</details>


### [95] [Integrating AIRL-Based Reward Estimation into a Control Method Using Fuzzy Inference and Policy Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14723)
*Seiji Ishihara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将基于AIRL的奖励估计机制集成到策略梯度与模糊推理相结合的基础模型中的模糊控制方法，通过共享参数实现判别器与生成器的同步更新，在车辆速度控制任务中获得泛化性强的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
