Two published models, CKGConv and GRIT, score lower on patterns they have not seen: on new graphs with fresh patterns both fall below this pattern-blind predictor, and withholding patterns from CKGConv's training lowers its accuracy on the test graphs that carry them. Training CKGConv with a new pattern in every graph raises its accuracy on fresh patterns by about 2 points, to the level of the pattern-blind predictor, at some cost on the reused patterns. The same kind of inference under the generator matches the best published result on CLUSTER and, without any training, scores above every published result we found on Minesweeper's released board. We recommend that synthetic benchmarks report scores on fresh templates beside reused ones, publish baselines built from their generators, and state how their metric is weighted and pooled.

</details>


### [130] [InCLAD: A Continual Learning Benchmark for Industrial Visual Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15032)
*Łukasz Marcjan,Dorota Wilk-Kołodziejczyk,Roberto Corizzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将工业异常检测重新定义为任务增量式的持续学习基准，用顺序出现的部件任务评估半监督检测器在图像级检测与像素级定位上的知识保持、适应与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工业异常检测基准大多是静态的，无法反映部署中检测系统需随时间从一个工业部件扩展到另一个部件的真实场景；且已有流水线多假设全监督缺陷标签或只研究孤立数据集，半监督检测器在异构部件序列上的行为尚不明确。

Method: 将持续工业异常检测建模为任务增量问题：每个部件定义为一个任务，学习目标保持半监督；把基准组织为相关部件级任务的序列，设计随机、由易到难、由难到易等多种场景，并在单数据集之外提出跨多数据集的挑战性场景；从图像级异常检测和像素级异常定位两个互补视角评估持续性能。

Result: 构建了覆盖多种任务顺序与跨数据集设置的持续工业异常检测基准，并给出图像级检测与像素级定位两方面的持续性能评估方案，可用于考察模型在顺序接触新部件时对全部部件性能的保持情况。

Conclusion: 通过将工业异常检测从静态训练/测试问题重新定义为持续基准，该工作为研究演化工业环境下的知识保持、适应与泛化提供了具体路径。

Abstract: Industrial anomaly detection benchmarks have advanced rapidly, yet they remain largely static and therefore underrepresent deployment settings in which inspection systems must be extended from one industrial component to another over time. In our setting, continual industrial anomaly detection is framed as a task-incremental problem: each component defines a task, while the learning objective remains semi-supervised. The goal extends beyond conventional anomaly detection, since models should preserve their performance on all components as they are sequentially exposed to new components. This framing is especially relevant because many existing industrial pipelines either assume fully supervised defect labels or study only isolated datasets, leaving open the question of how semi-supervised anomaly detectors behave across a sequence of heterogeneous components. We address this gap by organizing the benchmark as a sequence of related component-level tasks and by defining multiple scenarios, including random, easy-to-hard, and hard-to-easy. In addition to single-dataset continual scenarios, we propose challenging scenarios spanning across multiple datasets. We further evaluate continual performance from two complementary perspectives: image-level anomaly detection and pixel-level anomaly localization. By recasting industrial anomaly detection as a continual benchmark rather than a static train/test problem, our work establishes a concrete path toward studying knowledge retention, adaptation, and generalization in evolving industrial environments.

</details>


### [131] [Sparsity Saves Compute, Not Samples: Oracle Inequalities for Dense and Sparse Mixture of Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15039)
*Sagar Ghosh,Huy Nguyen,Alessandro Rinaldo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究Lipschitz参数化下MoE最小二乘估计的统计误差，给出稠密与稀疏(Top-k/Top-p)路由的oracle不等式及匹配的极小极大下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE及其稀疏变体广泛用于大规模系统，但自适应路由带来的统计代价尚不完全清楚，尤其是门控网络与专家均可学习时的估计误差理论刻画不足。

Method: 将MoE表示为Gated Hilbert Space中的gate–expert对，其范数分离路由与专家差异；用经验表示推导oracle不等式。对Top-k/Top-p不连续选择映射，按样本诱导的选择模式划分门控类处理；路由代价由选择器的Natarajan维控制。

Result: 稠密MoE (K个专家) 快速率约 Õ((K d_pr,e + d_pr,g)/n)；稀疏路由达到稠密率加可加路由代价。证明路由复杂度条件不可去除：仅参数Lipschitz不足以控制。线性softmax门控下路由代价与门控项同阶；线性专家下匹配下界为 K d_pr,e/n，速率在对数因子内最优。

Conclusion: 该工作首次在统一框架下刻画MoE自适应路由的统计代价，分离路由与专家误差，明确稀疏选择不连续性必须通过选择模式复杂度处理，并给出达到极小极大最优的估计速率。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models combine specialized experts through an input-dependent routing mechanism, and their sparse variants underpin many modern large-scale systems. Yet the statistical cost of adaptive routing remains only partially understood. We study the estimation error of least-squares MoE estimators when both the experts and the gating network are Lipschitz in their parameters. We represent each MoE as a gate--expert pair in a Gated Hilbert Space, whose norm $\|\cdot\|_Δ$ separates the contributions of routing and expert discrepancies. Using its empirical representation, we derive an oracle inequality with a fast rate of order $\tilde{\mathcal O}\big((Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}+d_{\mathrm{pr},g})/n\big)$ for dense MoEs with $K$ experts. For sparse Top-$k$ and Top-$p$ routing, the selection map is discontinuous in the gating parameters. We handle this by partitioning the gating class according to the selection patterns it induces on the sample. The resulting bounds match the dense rate up to an additive routing cost governed by the Natarajan dimension of the selector. We show that such a routing-complexity condition cannot be dropped: Lipschitz continuity in the parameters alone does not suffice. For linear softmax gating, the routing cost is of the same order as the gating term. Finally, for linear experts, we establish a matching minimax lower bound of order $Kd_{\mathrm{pr},e}/n$, showing that the rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [132] [Information-Theoretic Foundations of Online Temperature Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15043)
*Jin Sima,Nikolaos Papagiannis,Ananth Grama,Wojciech Szpankowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将LLM解码中避免重复退化生成的问题建模为在线熵最大化问题，提出EOS算法，在每个前缀上重新估计最优温度，并给出近最优的理论保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM解码中的重复退化生成是持续存在的失败模式，而标准补救方法（temperature、nucleus、top-k采样）都是静态启发式，缺乏理论依据与自适应能力。作者希望从信息论角度为动态、因果的解码策略提供最优性保证。

Method: 基于Kac引理与AEP，作者在一个保持输出合理性的交叉熵预算下最大化采样分布熵。离线解为温度采样，逆温度是预算的Lagrange乘子。在线设定下，条件分布p_1,p_2,...逐个揭示，q_t须由p_1,...,p_t因果决定，而预算耦合整个时间域。作者提出Entropic Online Sampling（EOS），在每个前缀上重新求解温度，以估计全局影子价格。另给出预算收紧（budget-tightened）的变体。

Result: EOS相对离线最优损失O(R log n)熵，同时预算超出O(R log n)，其中R为实例相关的漂移参数。预算收紧变体以相同速率精确可行。反向地，任何精确可行的在线算法至少损失Ω(R)，故EOS在log n因子内最优。当条件分布来自有限混合时，R=\tilde{O}(√n)。实验显示EOS能跟踪离线温度，并在熵指标上优于固定温度采样。

Conclusion: EOS为在线解码中的熵最大化提供了可证明近最优的因果算法，理论上将离线温度采样推广到在线设定，并刻画了在线与离线之间的固有差距；实验验证其有效跟踪离线最优并提升生成熵。

Abstract: Repetitive, degenerate generation is a persistent failure of LLM decoding, and the standard remedies (temperature, nucleus, and top-$k$ sampling) are static heuristics. By Kac's lemma and the AEP, a stationary source takes time exponential in its entropy to repeat a block. We therefore maximize the entropy of the sampling distributions under one cross-entropy budget that keeps the output plausible under the model. Offline, the solution is temperature sampling, with the inverse temperature as the budget's Lagrange multiplier. \emph{Our contribution is the online problem}: the conditionals $p_1, p_2, \dots$ are revealed one at a time, and the sampling distribution $q_t$ must be chosen causally from $p_1, \dots, p_t$ while the budget couples the entire horizon. The optimal temperature is thus a global shadow price that must be estimated from a prefix. We propose Entropic Online Sampling (EOS), which re-solves for the temperature on each prefix. We prove it loses $O(R\log n)$ entropy against the offline optimum while overshooting the budget by $O(R\log n)$, with $R$ an instance-dependent drift parameter. A budget-tightened variant is exactly feasible at the same rate. Conversely, every exactly feasible online algorithm must lose $Ω(R)$, so EOS is optimal up to a $\log n$ factor. When the conditionals are drawn from a finite mixture, $R=\tilde{O}(\sqrt{n})$. Experiments confirm that EOS tracks the offline temperature and beats fixed-temperature sampling in entropy.

</details>


### [133] [The Optimal Decoder is Tilted Temperature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15058)
*Nikolaos Papagiannis,Ananth Grama,Wojciech Szpankowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将解码建模为带熵下限与交叉熵上限约束的 pass@k 最大化问题，证明最优解为闭式"倾斜温度"采样规则，并给出在线(J-EOS)与离线(CTD)两种实现，在代码生成基准上优于标准与自适应解码基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大采样预算下LLM受益于更高采样温度，但"最优温度如何随预算变化"及"为何有效"缺乏理论解释。作者希望为温度调优提供原理性刻画，并统一温度采样、验证器贪婪解码与奖励倾斜策略等现有方法。

Method: 将解码形式化为pass@k最大化，约束为熵下限(防止多样性崩塌)与交叉熵上限(防止不合理性)；证明最优解是单一闭式条件采样规则——倾斜温度 q* ∝ (p e^{ηV})^{1/T}，其中倾斜来自衡量部分生成最终通过概率的验证器势V。在多样性预算随k按自然规则缩放的条件下，证明最优温度随k单调上升。对未知势V给出两种估计：在线J-EOS算法仅用二元通过/失败反馈联合跟踪两个约束乘子并学习V；离线情形下，当模型校准良好(log概率与正确性呈仿射关系)时，倾斜坍缩进指数项，最优退化为普通温度采样，CTD只需离线拟合一个标量，推理时零额外开销。据此设计面向代码生成的实用解码算法，并与CTD在HumanEval、MBPP上评测。

Result: 理论上证明最优温度随样本数k增大而增大，将经验做法转为定理；温度采样、验证器贪婪解码、奖励倾斜策略均为该规则的特例。校准条件下CTD等价于普通温度采样且无额外推理开销。在HumanEval、MBPP等基准上，所提解码算法与CTD优于标准及自适应解码基线。

Conclusion: 温度调优可由约束下的pass@k最大化原理导出，"温度随预算上升"具有理论依据；倾斜温度规则统一了多类解码方法，并可通过在线(J-EOS)或离线(CTD)方式落地，在代码生成任务上取得实证增益。

Abstract: Larger sample budgets benefit from higher sampling temperatures in LLMs, but what temperature tuning optimizes and why it works remain poorly understood. We seek to answer these questions: we pose decoding as pass@$k$ maximization subject to two constraints that encode critical decoding failure modes: an entropy floor preventing diversity collapse, and a cross-entropy ceiling preventing implausibility. We prove that this maximization takes the form of a single closed-form conditional sampling rule, the \emph{tilted temperature} $q^\star \propto \bigl(p e^{ηV}\bigr)^{1/T}$. Here, the tilt comes from a verifier potential $V$ that quantifies how likely a partial generation is to eventually pass. Ordinary temperature sampling, verifier-greedy decoding, and reward-tilted policies represent special cases. We further show that, under a natural rule for scaling the diversity budget with sample size $k$, the resulting optimal temperature increases with $k$, turning empirical choice into a theorem. The optimum still needs the unknown verifier potential, which we estimate using two design approaches. In the online setting, our J-EOS algorithm jointly tracks the two constraint multipliers and learns the verifier potential from binary pass/ fail feedback alone. In the offline setting, we show that when the model is calibrated, its log-probability tracks correctness up to an affine map. Under this condition, the tilt collapses into the exponent and the optimum reduces to ordinary temperature sampling. Calibrated Temperature Decoding (CTD) then fits one scalar offline and samples with zero additional inference-time overhead relative to temperature sampling. Building on these decision rules, we design a practical decoding algorithm for code generation and evaluate it alongside CTD on benchmarks including HumanEval and MBPP, showing improvements over standard and adaptive decoding baselines.

</details>


### [134] [Toward a Multimodal Foundation Model for Plasma State Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15076)
*Bin Xia,Chuanfei Dong,Boting Li,Yilan Qin,Zikang Xie,Sung Hyun Son,Adam J. Stanier,Jongsoo Yoo,Hantao Ji,Ahmed Diallo,Han Ding,John Wise*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向磁重联等离子体态重构的多模态基础模型概念验证：以250组VPIC合成模拟训练5.5M参数残差3D U-Net，从稀疏不完整诊断中重构磁场三分量与电子密度，并验证双向跨模态预测耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 等离子体实验的物理状态观测受限于诊断手段的稀疏性、异构性与不完整性，难以直接获得完整场量；同时FLARE等实验室磁重联装置需要从有限观测中重构等离子体态，因此探索统一的多模态基础模型具有必要性。

Method: 采用固定参考电子beta（β_e0=0.2）下的250组合成VPIC模拟（225训练、25独立验证），训练5.5M参数残差3D U-Net，从残缺观测重构三个磁场分量与电子密度。模型结合仅空间池化（保留全部24个时间帧）、全局时空自注意力与旋转位置编码；通过对磁场与密度模态在随机、网格、块状、时间等模式上独立掩码，实现稀疏感知、跨模态补全、密度超分辨与时间补全，且单一权重、无需任务特定重训练。

Result: 密度完全隐藏时，仅0.1%磁场空间可见度即可将密度中位NRMSE从约0.9降至0.1；观测密度在磁场缺失或极稀疏时能改善电流密度重构；无磁场观测时，约1%密度可见度接近全磁场观测下的密度重构精度，但电流结构仍更依赖直接磁场测量；完整磁场条件还能稳定缺失未来密度帧的补全。

Conclusion: 结果证实该仿真区内存在双向跨模态预测耦合，单一多模态模型可支持多种重构任务；但跨等离子体区制泛化及向实验测量的迁移尚未验证，仍属概念验证阶段。

Abstract: Plasma experiments observe coupled physical states through sparse, heterogeneous, and incomplete diagnostics. We present a proof of concept toward a multimodal foundation model for plasma state reconstruction during magnetic reconnection, motivated by the Facility for Laboratory Reconnection Experiments (FLARE). Using 250 synthetic VPIC simulations at fixed reference electron beta $β_{e0}=0.2$, with 225 training runs and 25 disjoint validation runs, we train a 5.5M-parameter residual 3D U-Net to reconstruct three magnetic-field components and electron density from incomplete observations. The model combines spatial-only pooling, which preserves all 24 temporal frames, with global spatiotemporal self-attention and rotary positional encoding. Independently masking magnetic and density modalities across random, grid, block, and temporal patterns enables sparse sensing, cross-modal completion, density super-resolution, and temporal completion with a single set of weights and no task-specific retraining. With density fully hidden, just 0.1% magnetic spatial visibility reduces median density NRMSE from approximately 0.9 to 0.1. Conversely, observed density improves current-density reconstruction when magnetic data are absent or extremely sparse. With no magnetic observations, roughly 1% density visibility approaches the density reconstruction accuracy achieved with fully observed magnetic fields, although current structure remains more dependent on direct magnetic measurements. Full magnetic conditioning also stabilizes completion of missing future density frames. These results demonstrate bidirectional cross-modal predictive coupling within this simulation regime. Generalization across plasma regimes or to experimental measurements remains untested.

</details>


### [135] [On the Theoretical Limits of Learning Unconstrained Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15078)
*Prajwal Ananth,Shuwen Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明：仅靠能量-力匹配训练机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）不足以保证准确的采样，预测误差与采样精度之间的关系在高维下指数病态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明放松物理归纳偏置可提升MLIPs的效率与精度，这引出一个根本性问题：仅用能量-力匹配目标是否足以保证MD采样的正确性。

Method: 通过理论分析，针对无约束假设类建立预测误差与采样精度之间的定量关系，并刻画两类失效机制：动力学陷阱（kinetic trapping）与平衡失配（equilibrium mismatch）；最后推导保证平衡精度及快速弛豫的条件。

Result: 证明在高维情形下，预测误差随维度指数衰减仍可能与近乎最大的全变差距离共存；且在局部、保对称模型中，小的逐原子误差可伴随随系统规模趋近最大值的分布差异。

Conclusion: 能量-力匹配不足以确保准确采样；需要全局能量控制条件来保证平衡精度，并需额外条件才能实现快速弛豫。

Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) accelerate molecular dynamics (MD) simulations by learning the energies and forces that govern atomic motion. Recent work has shown that relaxing physical inductive biases can improve computational efficiency and predictive accuracy, raising the question of whether energy-and-force matching alone is sufficient to ensure accurate sampling. We show that, for unconstrained hypothesis classes, the relationship between prediction error and sampling accuracy is exponentially ill-conditioned in dimension. In particular, prediction errors that decay exponentially with dimension can coexist with nearly maximal total variation distance between the learned and target distributions. We identify two failure mechanisms. The first is kinetic trapping, where relaxation to an accurate learned equilibrium requires exponentially long times, even when simulations are initialized from training configurations at which energies and forces are matched exactly. The second is equilibrium mismatch, where the learned stationary distribution itself remains far from the target. Under explicit assumptions, we show that equilibrium mismatch can persist even in local, symmetry-preserving models, where small per-atom errors coexist with a distributional discrepancy that approaches its maximum as system size increases. Finally, we establish global energy-control conditions that guarantee equilibrium accuracy and identify additional conditions required for rapid relaxation.

</details>


### [136] [Swarm Telepathy: Prefill-Free KV-Cache Transfer Across Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15095)
*Abdulrahman Alabdulkareem,Irene Tenison,Yang Zhang,Yada Zhu,Boris Katz,Dan Gutfreund*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SwaT，首个跨模型家族KV-cache传输方法，实现多智能体系统中无需预填充的通信，性能与速度均优于文本通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统依赖文本离散token通信，带宽受限且计算冗余；已有的KV-cache传输方法要么要求同家族模型，要么无法跨上下文，接收方仍需预填充文本。

Method: SwaT（Swarm Telepathy）实现跨家族KV-cache传输，结合KV-cache压缩技术，在智能体间通信中保持发送方与接收方模型冻结，仅需极少训练数据与算力。

Result: 相比文本通信平均准确率提升40%、墙钟时间快4倍；在12个LLM、6个家族、17个基准上表现优异；可将VLM的视觉能力迁移至纯文本接收方，即使仅用文本数据训练。

Conclusion: SwaT验证了跨家族、免预填充KV-cache通信的可行性，为多智能体系统提供高带宽、高效率通信范式，且训练成本极低（<50M token、<1 GPU-day）。

Abstract: LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.

</details>


### [137] [Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15097)
*Feiyu Qu,Zheng Huang,Andrea Zanette*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AnchorDLM框架，通过RL训练锚点生成器，联合优化控制片段的内容与位置，引导冻结的扩散语言模型生成，提升可控性与推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）为可控文本生成提供了新机遇，但其可控性——即在满足任务约束的同时保持原有能力——研究不足。DLM的双向注意力允许控制token从输出序列任意位置引导生成，但有效引导取决于控制内容与位置的兼容性，现有方法未联合优化二者。

Method: 提出AnchorDLM：锚点生成器为每个查询生成一个"锚点"，包含一个短输出片段及其位置；将该锚点作为控制token置于指定位置，用以初始化冻结DLM的输出序列并引导后续去噪。使用强化学习训练锚点生成器，以基于答案正确性和约束满足度的奖励，联合优化锚点内容与位置。并从离散流匹配（DFM）视角，将锚点放置解释为重塑引导生成的初始速度场。

Result: 在五个DLM骨干模型上，针对代码生成与数学推理任务的实验表明，AnchorDLM提升了可控性，并在多样基准上进一步带来推理性能增益。

Conclusion: AnchorDLM通过内容-位置联合优化的锚点引导机制，有效提升扩散语言模型的可控性并增益推理能力，为DLM可控生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer new opportunities for controllable text generation. However, their controllability, defined as the ability to satisfy task constraints while preserving their original capabilities, remains underexplored. DLMs' bidirectional attention allows control tokens to guide generation from arbitrary positions in the output sequence, but effective guidance depends on the compatibility between their content and placement. To this end, we propose AnchorDLM, a framework in which an anchor generator produces an anchor consisting of a short output fragment and its position for each query. The anchor is placed as control tokens at the specified position to initialize the output sequence of a frozen DLM and guide subsequent denoising. We train the anchor generator with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly optimize anchor content and placement, using rewards computed from the DLM's generated outputs based on answer correctness and constraint satisfaction. Moreover, through the lens of discrete flow matching (DFM), we interpret anchor placement as helping to reshape the initial velocity field that guides generation. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning across five DLM backbones show that AnchorDLM improves controllability and further yields gains in reasoning performance across diverse benchmarks.

</details>


### [138] [Random Feature Pruning for Multi-Class Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15101)
*Mohammad Amin Omidi,Babak Seyfe,Shahrokh Valaee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对W-RKS特征提取中大量随机特征冗余无效的问题，提出SEED-MAX算法，将特征选择建模为顺序嵌套模型选择问题，并结合F检验加速剪枝，在UCR数据集上实现约92%剪枝率且分类精度几乎不下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 加权随机厨房水槽（W-RKS）是监督学习中常用的特征提取技术，但其主要缺陷是提取的许多随机特征存在冗余且无效。本文旨在研究多类分类问题中减少此类特征冗余的高效方法。

Method: 将特征选择表述为顺序嵌套模型选择问题的一种变体，提出Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization（SEED-MAX）算法，递归计算经验风险以识别最简约但信息量最大的特征集；推导SEED-MAX正确特征选择概率的解析下界；进一步使用Fisher检验（F-Test）评估SEED-MAX保留的特征以提升剪枝速率。

Result: 推导出SEED-MAX正确特征选择概率的解析下界，且通过增加训练数据集规模可使该下界任意接近1；在UCR时间序列分类数据集上，SEED-MAX结合Fisher检验的顺序应用实现约92%的剪枝率，分类精度下降可忽略。

Conclusion: SEED-MAX及其与F检验结合的方法能有效减少W-RKS特征冗余，在保证分类精度的同时大幅剪枝，相关实现已开源。

Abstract: Weighted sums of random kitchen sinks (W-RKS) is a commonly used feature extraction technique for supervised learning tasks. A major drawback of this method is the redundancy and ineffectiveness of many extracted random features. This paper investigates efficient methods for reducing such redundancy in multi-class classification problems. We specifically formulate feature selection as a variant of the sequentially nested model selection problem and introduce the Successive Empirical Excess Risk Difference Maximization (SEED-MAX) algorithm. It recursively computes empirical risks to identify the most parsimonious yet informative set of features. We derive an analytical lower bound for the probability of correct feature selection by the SEED-MAX algorithm. This lower bound on the probability of correct feature selection can be made arbitrarily close to one by increasing the training dataset size. To further enhance the rate of pruning, we evaluate the features retained by SEED-MAX using the Fisher test (F-Test). Empirical evaluations on UCR time-series classification datasets show that the sequential application of SEED-MAX with the Fisher test achieves approximately 92 percent rate of pruning with negligible degradation in classification accuracy. Implementations of the SEED-MAX and SEED-MAX-F-Test methods are available at https://github.com/OmidiAmin/seed-max-ftest.

</details>


### [139] [RELAGRAM: Recursive Latent Graph Model for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15106)
*Vladimir Kirill Bickov,Neil Yorke-Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RELAGRAM，将潜在递归引入图组合优化，用于求解带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP），以极轻量参数取得有竞争力表现并展现零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在递归（latent recursion）已在数独、迷宫等结构化推理任务上验证有效，但其能否支撑神经路径规划（neural routing）尚不明确。本文旨在探索潜在递归在图组合优化中的适用性。

Method: RELAGRAM将CVRP实例编码为边令牌（edge tokens），使用紧凑的Transformer对令牌的潜在表示进行循环更新；输出头将答案状态映射为边热力图（edge heatmap），再由自回归解码器据此构造可行解。模型参数量仅0.53M。

Result: 在CVRP-100上，相对PyVRP参考解的间隙分别为：贪心解码13.4%、八重对称增强9.8%、256候选搜索8.3%。仅在CVRP-100上训练即可零样本泛化至CVRP-500与CVRP-1000，256候选搜索下间隙分别为15.6%和21.7%。

Conclusion: 结果表明潜在递归是神经路径规划的一条有前景的技术路线。

Abstract: Latent recursion repeatedly processes internal representations through the same neural network. Recent work has shown this approach to be effective on structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. However, whether latent recursion can support neural routing remains unclear. We introduce RELAGRAM (Recursive Latent Graph Model), a novel approach that brings latent recursion to graph combinatorial optimization. RELAGRAM encodes a capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) instance as edge tokens; a compact transformer recurrently updates the latent representations of these tokens. An output head maps the answer state to an edge heatmap, from which an autoregressive decoder constructs a feasible solution. On CVRP-100 instances, the 0.53M-parameter RELAGRAM achieves gaps to a PyVRP reference of 13.4%, 9.8%, and 8.3% under greedy decoding, eightfold symmetry augmentation, and 256-candidate search, respectively. Trained only on CVRP-100, RELAGRAM generalizes zero-shot to CVRP-500 and CVRP-1000, achieving gaps of 15.6% and 21.7% under 256-candidate search. Together, these results demonstrate that latent recursion is a promising approach to neural routing.

</details>


### [140] [scHFBiMamba: a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder for cardiac disease-state classification from single-nucleus RNA-seq data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15117)
*Ugo Lomoio,Pietro Hiram Guzzi,Pierangelo Veltri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 scHFBiMamba：双向 Mamba 自编码器+MLP，参数量减少约14.6倍，在多任务心脏单核转录组分类上优于稠密自编码器，并提供基因级可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估紧凑的双向状态空间自编码器能否在单核 RNA 测序数据上同时提升物种、细胞类型与疾病状态的联合分类性能，并获得可解释的基因归因；针对稠密去噪自编码器参数量过大（192.9M）的问题，探索更高效的替代架构。

Method: 在 Ruz Jurado 等的稠密去噪自编码器（DAE）+MLP 框架基础上，构建 scHFBiMamba：以双向 Mamba 自编码器（BiMambaAE）将16,545维基因表达谱映射到350维隐空间，仅需13.2M参数（约为稠密DAE的1/14.6），后接MLP分类头。在38,275个留出心脏细胞核上，用 McNemar 检验配合 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正比较6种编码器-分类器配置，并在冻结表征上评估9种分类器；通过将 SHAP 得到的差异解释基因与差异表达基因同 HF 相关 Gene Ontology 关键词比对，评估生物学相关性。

Result: BiMambaAE+MLP 取得最高综合 F1：13个输出汇总的 macro-F1 为0.966（DAE+MLP 为0.957），类别平均 macro-F1 为0.977（对比0.970）；显著提升细胞类型与疾病状态准确率（校正 p=7.1e-3 与 p=4.8e-6），物种 F1 达1.000。SHAP 差异解释基因的通路富集基准 F1 为0.105，高于差异表达基因的0.053。

Conclusion: 紧凑的双向状态空间自编码器在显著减少参数量的同时，可超越规模更大的稠密自编码器，实现心脏转录组的多任务联合分类；scHFBiMamba 兼顾高精度预测与可用于假设生成的基因级解释。代码已开源于 GitHub。

Abstract: To evaluate whether a compact bidirectional state-space autoencoder improves joint classification of species, cell type, and disease state from single-nucleus RNA-sequencing profiles in heart failure (HF), while yielding interpretable gene attributions. Building on the dense denoising autoencoder (DAE) and MLP framework of Ruz Jurado et al., we developed scHFBiMamba, combining a bidirectional Mamba autoencoder (BiMambaAE) with an MLP head. BiMambaAE maps 16,545-gene profiles to 350-dimensional latent representations using 13.2M parameters, about 14.6-fold fewer than the dense DAE (192.9M). We compared six encoder-classifier configurations on 38,275 held-out cardiac nuclei using McNemar tests with Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and assessed nine classifiers on frozen representations. Biological relevance was evaluated by comparing SHAP-derived differentially explained genes with differentially expressed genes against curated HF-related Gene Ontology keywords. BiMambaAE+MLP achieved the highest aggregate F1: pooled macro-F1 across 13 outputs was 0.966 versus 0.957 for DAE+MLP, and the mean category macro-F1 was 0.977 versus 0.970. It significantly improved cell-type and disease-state accuracy (adjusted p=7.1e-3 and p=4.8e-6, respectively), with species F1 of 1.000. SHAP-derived differentially explained genes achieved a pathway-enrichment benchmark F1 of 0.105 versus 0.053 for differentially expressed genes. Compact bidirectional state-space autoencoders can outperform substantially larger dense autoencoders for joint cardiac transcriptomic classification while reducing parameters. scHFBiMamba enables accurate multi-task prediction and hypothesis-generating gene-level interpretation. Code: https://github.com/UgoLomoio/scHFBiMamba.

</details>


### [141] [ShellElastic: Scalable Elastic Pretraining with Simultaneous Maximal Updates and Hyperparameter Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15124)
*Can Jin,Yan Kang,Yifan Gong,Chongjian Ge,Mingze Xu,Yuanjun Xiong,Dimitris N. Metaxas,Hongwu Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出弹性Transformer架构（含稠密核+壳层、块下三角结构）与μE参数化扩展，实现单次训练即得覆盖多推理预算的嵌套子网络，并保证所有子网络同步最大化更新与超参数可迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型需适配多样推理预算，但为每个预算单独训练模型会重复预训练成本。现有弹性模型（权重共享超网中训练嵌套子网络）面临三大障碍：每步计算量可变导致分布式扩展困难；超参数在不同模型规模间难以迁移；无法保证所有子网络同时获得最大化更新。

Method: 1) 设计弹性Transformer：将隐藏维度组织为稠密核与连续壳层，使每个隐藏矩阵呈块下三角结构；一次全宽前向包含所有子网络的精确隐藏状态作为前缀，从而联合训练保持固定计算图，单步开销约等于只训练最宽子网络。2) 提出μE：将最大更新参数化（μP）扩展到该弹性架构及其他弹性架构，其缩放规则可证明地令超网中所有子网络同时保持最大更新（μI），且在加宽超网或增加壳层后依然成立；实验验证在小规模非弹性代理上调好的超参数对弹性族与更大超网近似最优（μT）。

Result: 单次运行产生的子网络在同等参数量下优于MatFormer与全弹性基线，并接近需数倍训练步数分别训练的独立模型；超参数从非弹性小代理迁移至弹性族与更大超网仍近似最优。

Conclusion: 该工作通过块下三角弹性结构与μE参数化，解决了弹性训练的计算图可变、超参数迁移与子网络更新不均衡问题，以约等于训练最宽子网络的开销一次训练覆盖多推理预算，显著降低弹性模型的预训练成本。

Abstract: Foundation models need to support diverse inference budgets, yet training a separate model for each budget duplicates pretraining effort. Elastic models train several nested sub-networks inside one weight-shared supernet, but existing recipes face three obstacles: variable per-step workloads that hinder distributed scaling, limited hyperparameter (HP) transfer across model sizes, and no guarantee that all sub-networks are maximally updated at once. We present \Ours, an elastic transformer that organizes hidden dimensions into a dense core and successive shells, so that every hidden matrix is block lower triangular. One full-width forward pass contains every sub-network's exact hidden states as prefixes, so joint training keeps a fixed computation graph and costs about as much per step as training the widest sub-network alone. We further introduce \muE, an extension of maximal update parameterization (\mup) to \Ours and other elastic architectures. Its scaling rules provably keep all sub-networks of a supernet maximally updated simultaneously (\muI), and keep doing so when the supernet is widened or given more shells; sweeps confirm that HPs tuned on a small non-elastic proxy stay near-optimal for elastic families and larger supernets (\mbox{\muT}). A single \Ours run produces sub-networks that outperform MatFormer and fully elastic baselines at matched parameter counts, and approach separately trained models that together take several times the steps.

</details>


### [142] [To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15128)
*Vasileios Saketos,William Reveillard,Alexandre Proutiere,Sebastian Dalleiger,Ming Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在专家容量受限下，LLM与人类专家协作的在线延迟（deferral）决策问题，提出基于KL下置信界的学习算法KL-PBD，实现最优遗憾界，并在合成数据与真实问答数据集上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统常将LLM与人类专家结合，由LLM处理常规查询，把不确定的问题延迟给专家。但专家容量有限时，延迟决策不仅需考虑LLM可靠性，还需考虑专家队列的拥塞。且置信信号的可靠性初始未知，只能通过延迟查询获得的选择性、延迟反馈来学习。

Method: 将问题建模为在线序贯决策问题：每个查询观察到LLM答案的置信信号后，决定直接输出或延迟给容量受限的专家。提出KL-PBD算法，利用未知可靠性参数的Kullback-Leibler下置信界来指导延迟决策，以应对选择性观测和排队的延迟反馈。

Result: 对于K个置信层级和时域T，KL-PBD在每层准确率远离延迟边界时达到O(K log T)的gap-dependent遗憾，最坏情况下达到Õ(√(KT))遗憾。作者建立了匹配的下界，证明这些速率在对数因子内是最优的。在合成实例及GSM8K、NuminaMath、MedMCQA真实问答数据集上，使用Qwen LLM进行了实验验证。

Conclusion: 该工作为容量受限专家队列下的LLM延迟决策提供了理论最优的学习算法，兼顾可靠性与拥塞，并在理论与实验上验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions. For $K$ confidence levels and horizon $T$, \texttt{KL-PBD} achieves $O(K\log T)$ gap-dependent regret when the accuracy at every confidence level is bounded away from the deferral boundary, and $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{KT})$ worst-case regret. We establish matching lower bounds, showing that these rates are optimal up to logarithmic factors. Finally, we validate our approach on synthetic instances and real-world question-answering datasets, namely GSM8K, NuminaMath, and MedMCQA, using Qwen LLMs.

</details>


### [143] [When Dynamic Scaling Fails: A Scale-State Feedback Governs Recurrent-State Quantization in Linear-Attention and SSM LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15139)
*Yuhang Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究线性注意力与状态空间LLM中循环状态量化的失效机制，指出量化尺度与状态之间的反馈回路导致误差随解码步数累积，并提出应约束尺度而非定位离群值，同时报告比特宽度被认证的解码时域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力与状态空间LLM用固定大小的循环状态承载长上下文，量化该状态是降低长解码成本的自然手段。但状态每步都被重写，逐步量化器位于循环内部，误差会累积叠加，现有方法未揭示其失效机理。

Method: 将量化器尺度从与状态耦合改为绑定到全精度参考（yoking scale to full-precision reference）；对比离群值感知方案与朴素的持久缩放（persistent scaling）；尝试跨层比特分配及学习式分配；并在分片设置下评估。

Result: INT4初始时对合成召回无损，但约一千步后完全破坏。解除尺度耦合可彻底消除范数爆炸，却仅挽回5.4 nats中的1.8 nats，说明数值不稳定与功能退化是可分离的两类失效。残余问题是分辨率问题，离群值定位无法解决——所有离群值感知方案均劣于朴素持久缩放。跨层分配比特确有帮助，但在文章互斥划分下学习式分配退化为保护前几层的平凡规则。推至32K时，组内INT4的表现不优于直接丢弃状态。

Conclusion: 应当约束量化尺度而非定位离群值，并须报告比特宽度通过认证的解码时域（decode horizon），以刻画量化状态在长解码中的真实可用范围。

Abstract: Linear-attention and state-space LLMs carry long context in a fixed-size recurrent state, and quantizing that state is the natural way to cut its cost during long decode. Unlike a weight tensor, the state is rewritten at every step, so a quantizer applied at each step sits inside the recurrence and its errors compound. INT4 that leaves synthetic recall perfectly intact at the start destroys it a thousand steps later. The mechanism is a feedback between the quantizer scale and the state it is derived from. Yoking that scale to a full-precision reference removes the resulting norm explosion entirely, yet recovers only 1.8 of the 5.4 nats lost, so numerical instability and functional degradation are separable failures. The remainder is a resolution problem that locating outliers does not solve, since every outlier-aware scheme here loses to plain persistent scaling. Allocating bits across layers does help, but under article-disjoint splits a learned allocation collapses onto the trivial rule of protecting the first few layers. Run out to 32K, group-wise INT4 is worth no more than discarding the state. Contain the scale rather than locate outliers, and report the decode horizon at which a bit-width was certified.

</details>


### [144] [Compute-Optimal Scaling Laws for Spiking Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15146)
*Dan Saunders,Benjamin Ren,Catherine He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个SpikeGPT类脉冲语言模型的Chinchilla式IsoFLOP扩展研究：计算最优前沿指数为0.56，与稠密Transformer的0.50接近；损失差距分解为恒定的backbone成本（约0.16 nats）和随算力下降后趋稳的脉冲成本（0.34→约0.23 nats）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）以稀疏二值激活追求高能效语言建模，但脉冲语言模型的效率-精度权衡在大规模下缺乏系统性刻画，尤其缺少明确的计算最优配方。

Method: 开展首个针对脉冲语言模型的Chinchilla式IsoFLOP扩展研究：在FineWeb-EDU数据集上，扫描SpikeGPT族模型（RWKV骨干），宽度从384到1536，计算预算覆盖3×10^17至10^19 FLOPs；并与相同训练设置的非脉冲RWKV及Transformer基线对比。

Result: 计算最优前沿满足N_opt ∝ C^0.56，接近Hoffmann等对稠密Transformer报告的0.50，说明脉冲化不改变算力预算下参数与数据的权衡方式；与非脉冲基线相比，损失差距可分解为约0.16 nats、不随算力变化的backbone成本，以及从0.34降至约0.23 nats后趋于平稳的脉冲成本。

Conclusion: 给出了脉冲语言模型的首个计算最优配方，并量化了其稀疏性带来的精度代价；脉冲机制主要影响损失中的成本项，而非参数-数据的最优分配策略。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks target energy-efficient language modeling through sparse, binary activations, but the efficiency-accuracy tradeoff of spiking language models is uncharacterized at scale. We present the first Chinchilla-style IsoFLOP scaling study of a spiking language model, sweeping SpikeGPT-family models (RWKV backbone) from width 384 to 1536 across compute budgets from $3\times10^{17}$ to $10^{19}$ FLOPs on FineWeb-EDU. We report two findings. First, the compute-optimal frontier is $N_{opt} \propto C^{0.56}$, close to the 0.50 that Hoffmann et al. report for dense Transformers, so spiking does not change how parameters and data should be traded off under a compute budget. Second, against non-spiking RWKV and Transformer baselines trained the same way, the loss gap splits into a backbone cost of about 0.16 nats that does not change with compute and a spiking cost that falls from 0.34 to about 0.23 nats and then levels off. These results give the first compute-optimal recipe for spiking language models and quantify the accuracy cost of their sparsity.

</details>


### [145] [Sensor-Aware Joint Data Fusion and State Estimation under Sparse Multi-rate Distribution Grid Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15156)
*Pooja Algikar,Stefano Fenu,Kumarsinh Jhala,Siby Plathottam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种异质隐图ODE用于配电网多速率异构传感器下的状态估计(DSSE)，取代传统两阶段流水线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代配电网中本地储能与发电的加入使系统复杂度上升，运营商/聚合商无法直接监测，因此配电网状态估计(DSSE)需求日益增长。经典方法依赖时间同步与部分可观测性，而稀疏异构传感器的多速率监测通常只能依赖机器学习。

Method: 提出异质隐图ODE(heterogeneous latent graph ODE)，将测量函数与采样过程赋予类型并定位到特定母线；并搭配图-Transformer状态估计器，专门针对多速率异构传感器布局求解DSSE。

Result: 在多个IEEE标准拓扑上验证，在可观测性逐步退化的条件下证明了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该异质隐图ODE与图-Transformer估计器组合可有效应对多速率异构传感器布局及可观测性下降的DSSE场景，优于文献中常见的两阶段流水线做法。

Abstract: Distribution-system state estimation is a growing necessity for the modern power grid as the addition of local storage and generation add system complexity that an operator or aggregator is not able to directly monitor. Classical methods work well when all system elements are time-synchronized and at least partly observable, but multi-rate monitoring of sparse heterogeneous sensors typically relies on machine learning approaches. It is a common practice in the literature to structure this task as a two-stage pipeline, first fusing data from disparate sensors and then feeding the fused pseudo-measurements to a separately trained state estimator. We propose a heterogeneous latent graph ODE in which measurement functions and sampling processes are typed and localized on specific buses, paired with a graph- transformer state estimator solving DSSE specifically for multi-rate heterogeneous sensor placements, and demonstrate its effectiveness across multiple IEEE standard topologies as observability degrades.

</details>


### [146] [Beyond Adjacent Layers: Graph-Guided Layer Fusion for Compressing Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15159)
*Muhammad Usama,Yeoreum Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文挑战了深度压缩中"功能冗余是局部的"这一隐含假设，通过全对CKA相似度矩阵证明非相邻层存在更多高相似配对，并提出FCM方法利用谱社区检测聚类功能等价层进行层融合，在13个模型上取得优于ShortGPT等基线的压缩效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM深度压缩方法（如层评分或合并）仅对单层打分或只对相邻/连续层分组，隐含假设功能冗余是局部的。作者通过计算来自6个架构家族、13个LLM（1.6B-14B）的全对CKA相似度矩阵来验证该假设，发现非相邻层的高相似配对比相邻层多3.6-15.9倍，这一结构此前未被系统利用。

Method: 提出Fusion via Community Mining (FCM)：构建全L×L相似度图，用谱社区检测找出功能等价层的簇，保留每簇中Block-Influence最高的层，并应用LoRA恢复；通过仅在校准数据上计算的预设规则在余弦相似度与CKA相似度之间选择。

Result: 2x压缩下，FCM在13个模型中的12个上平均困惑度低于ShortGPT，10个显著更优（Welch t检验+Holm-Bonferroni校正，Qwen3-4B上最多降低50%），仅Mistral-7B为负（+13.4%）。与FlattenGPT、SWM、DeltaLLM在匹配校准与恢复下对比，FCM在13个模型中10个取得最佳困惑度（平均排名1.15），并在3个锚点模型上超过MKA。在20个零样本推理单元中15个匹配或超过ShortGPT，同时提升MMLU、LAMBADA、HumanEval pass@1及自由生成质量。2x压缩的Qwen2.5-7B在单张A100上参数减少46%、峰值VRAM降低42%、解码吞吐提升84%。谱分组比Fisher连续分割优41%、比均匀分区优51%，优势在2x至3x压缩区间及14B规模下持续扩大。

Conclusion: 功能冗余并不局限于相邻层，非相邻层间存在大量高相似配对；基于全相似度图的谱社区检测分组FCM能有效挖掘该结构，在多种模型规模与压缩比下持续优于现有深度压缩基线，并带来实际的效率收益。

Abstract: Existing depth-compression methods for large language models (LLMs) score layers individually or group only adjacent or contiguous layers, implicitly assuming that functional redundancy is local. We test this assumption by computing full pairwise Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) similarity matrices for thirteen LLMs from six architecture families (1.6B-14B parameters). Non-adjacent layers have 3.6-15.9x more high-similarity pairs than adjacent ones, a structure that prior similarity-based layer merging has not systematically exploited. We propose Fusion via Community Mining (FCM), which builds the full L x L similarity graph, uses spectral community detection to find clusters of functionally equivalent layers, keeps the highest-Block-Influence layer in each cluster, and applies LoRA recovery; a pre-specified rule computed only on calibration data chooses between cosine and CKA similarity. At 2x compression, FCM lowers mean perplexity below ShortGPT on twelve of thirteen models, significantly on ten (Welch's t-test with Holm-Bonferroni correction; up to 50% on Qwen3-4B), with Mistral-7B the only loss (+13.4%). Against FlattenGPT, SWM, and DeltaLLM under matched calibration and recovery, FCM gives the best perplexity on ten of thirteen models (mean rank 1.15), and it also outperforms MKA on three anchor models. FCM matches or exceeds ShortGPT on 15 of 20 zero-shot reasoning cells and also improves MMLU, LAMBADA, HumanEval pass@1, and free-form generation quality. The 2x-compressed Qwen2.5-7B has 46% fewer parameters, 42% lower peak VRAM, and 84% higher decode throughput on a single A100. Spectral grouping outperforms Fisher contiguous segmentation by 41% and uniform partitioning by 51%, and FCM's advantage grows beyond a 2x crossover up to 3x and persists at the 14B scale. Code: https://github.com/Usama1002/fcm-layer-fusion

</details>


### [147] [LexiCan: Lexicographic Canonicalization of Point Clouds for Machine Learning Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15171)
*Daniel Sanchez,Djordje Mihajlovic,Federica Valeau,Luka Benić,Raghuwansh Raj,Soutrik Sarangi,Snir Hordan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LexiCan是一种对3D点云（含分子构型）在O(3)/SO(3)下可证不变的规范化方法，在QM9、QM-sym上旋转不变误差约1e-6 Å，缓解不连续跳变且速度快数个数量级，并提升非不变模型在QM9性质预测与ModelNet40分类上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D点云存在旋转与排列歧义，需选取唯一轨道代表（canonicalization）以保留几何信息并适配Transformer等标准架构。但现有规范化在分子构型上出现不连续跳变，且在主流分子数据集上存在不可忽略的不变性误差，导致表示歧义。

Method: 提出LexiCan规范化方法：可证明在O(3)或SO(3)下具有不变性，并针对分子构型设计以缓解不连续跳变；同时在QM9与QM-sym上评估其旋转不变性与运行效率。

Result: 在QM9与QM-sym上旋转不变性误差约10^-6 Å；在QM-sym上缓解不连续跳变；运行速度比现有规范化快数个数量级；在QM9性质预测与ModelNet40形状分类中，非不变模型使用LexiCan优于使用该现有规范化。

Conclusion: LexiCan提供了理论上可证（O(3)/SO(3)）且在分子数据上数值近乎不变、跳变更少、效率更高的规范化方案，并能更好地支持非不变模型用于分子性质预测与3D形状分类。

Abstract: Canonicalization resolves the rotational and permutation ambiguity of 3D point clouds by selecting a unique orbit representative, maintaining their geometric information while allowing standard architectures, such as Transformers, to operate on them. Existing canonicalizations, however, exhibit discontinuity jumps on molecular configurations and non-trivial invariance errors in popular molecular datasets, which lead to ambiguity in their representation. To bridge this gap, we introduce LexiCan, a canonicalization that is provably invariant under either $O(3)$ or $SO(3)$, empirically invariant to rotations to within $\sim 10^{-6}$ angstroms on the QM9 and QM-sym molecular datasets, and mitigates discontinuity jumps on QM-sym, while running orders of magnitude faster than an existing canonicalization. Finally, non-invariant models perform better on QM9 property prediction and ModelNet40 shape classification with LexiCan than with that canonicalization.

</details>


### [148] [Only What You've Signed up For: Secure Workflows with Constrained Diffusion Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15177)
*Michael Cardei,Anjun Hu,Chenrui Ma,Francesco Pinto,Chawin Sitawarin,Chulin Xie,Ferdinando Fioretto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoDA框架，通过在扩散语言模型的去噪过程中强制任务相关的安全策略，抵御提示注入攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体AI系统承担日益复杂且高影响的�任务，提示注入攻击风险凸显。现有防御多依赖检测或推理注入的恶意指令，面对优化注入本身的自适应攻击仍然脆弱。扩散语言模型通过迭代精炼全序列预测，为生成全程施加更广范围的约束提供了新契机。

Method: 提出Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents（CoDA）框架，在扩散语言模型的去噪过程中直接执行任务相关的安全策略；在每个去噪步，将token分布投影到策略合规集合上，从而在生成过程中持续保持约束满足。

Result: 在多种最先进扩散语言模型家族上，针对静态与自适应提示注入攻击进行评测，攻击成功率大幅下降，同时任务效用具有竞争力，推理开销可接受。

Conclusion: 将安全策略约束嵌入扩散生成过程，而非依赖对恶意指令的检测或推理，为防御提示注入提供了有效且高效的新范式。

Abstract: As agentic AI systems take on increasingly complex and consequential tasks, securing them against prompt injection becomes critical. Existing defenses often rely on detecting or reasoning about injected malicious instructions and can therefore remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks that optimize the injection itself. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), an emerging framework for language generation, offer a new opportunity for security enforcement: by iteratively refining their sequence wide predictions, they enable broader-scope constraint enforcement throughout generation. This paper introduces Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA), a framework that enforces task dependent security policies directly within the denoising process of diffusion language models. At each denoising step, CoDA projects token distributions onto a policy-compliant set, maintaining constraint satisfaction throughout generation. We evaluate CoDA across state-of-the-art diffusion language model families under both static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks. Results demonstrate substantial reductions in attack success rate with competitive task utility and practical inference overhead.

</details>


### [149] [Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning based Topology-Agnostic Defense for Virtual Power Plants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15183)
*Pooja Algikar,Stefano Fenu,Kumarsinh Jhala,Siby Plathottam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向虚拟电厂（VPP）聚合分布式能源的混合式扰动型网络物理防御方法，将博弈论规划与无模型强化学习在贝叶斯信念更新框架下融合，实现无需馈线拓扑知识的攻击检测与防御，并在IEEE 13与123节点系统上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式能源经VPP聚合后扩大攻击面，协调性网络攻击可同时扰乱配电系统、输电网与市场运行；而现有网络物理防御策略普遍依赖电网模型与运行状态信息，第三方聚合商往往无法获取这些信息，因此需要一种拓扑无关的防御方案。

Method: 提出混合式扰动型网络物理防御：在贝叶斯信念更新框架下，将博弈论规划与无模型强化学习相结合。拓扑无关性定义为VPP不需访问馈线拓扑、线路参数、开关配置或完整系统状态。三项技术贡献：(1) 多输出高斯过程结合Hamiltonian Monte Carlo，用于离散攻击者类型推断、检测概率与检测置信度，建模信念分布；(2) 矩匹配高斯传播，将后验信念跨回合传递；(3) 自适应融合Stackelberg领导者（VPP）动作与探索的RL策略。理论上建立均衡存在性并推导回合级闭环效用上界，刻画攻击者信念不确定性与GT-RL动作一致性之间的关系。

Result: 在IEEE 13节点与123节点馈线及DER组合上的评估表明，在攻击者模型不确定与馈线重构条件下仍能有效检测，且无需任何显式馈线拓扑知识。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将双层博弈论规划、非参数贝叶斯推断与自适应强化学习相结合，是VPP网络安全的一个有前景的研究方向。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of distributed energy resources (DERs) aggregated by virtual power plants (VPPs) elevates cybersecurity risk by expanding the attack surface. A coordinated cyberattack has the potential to disrupt distribution-system, bulk-system, and market operations. Existing cyberphysical defense strategies largely assume access to grid network models and operating conditions, which may not be available to third-party aggregators. This paper proposes a novel hybrid, perturbation-based cyber-physical defense for VPP-operated DERs that blends game-theoretic planning with model-free reinforcement learning (RL) under a Bayesian belief-update framework. Topology agnosticism is defined from the VPP information and implementation perspective: the VPP does not require access to the feeder topology, line parameters, switching configuration, or full system state. This work advances the state of the art through three contributions: (1) a multi-output Gaussian process with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo for discrete attacker-type inference, probability of detection, and confidence of detection for modeling the belief distribution; (2) moment-matched Gaussian propagation of posterior beliefs across episodes; and (3) an RL policy that adaptively integrates Stackelberg leader (VPP) actions with exploration. Furthermore, we establish equilibrium existence and derive an episode-level closed-loop utility bound connecting attacker-belief uncertainty with GT-RL action alignment. Evaluations on IEEE 13- and 123-Bus feeders with DER portfolios demonstrate effective detection under attacker-model uncertainty and evaluated feeder re-configuration conditions, while requiring no explicit feeder-topology knowledge. Overall, the results indicate that combining bi-level game-theoretic planning, nonparametric Bayesian inference, and adaptive RL is a promising direction for VPP cybersecurity.

</details>


### [150] [DeltaNet-PC: Test-Time Memory Without Backpropagation Through Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15185)
*Todd Morrill,Richard Zemel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出DeltaNet-PC，将每步记忆更新ΔS_t视为隐变量而非待学习权重，从标准预测编码概率模型的log概率推导出PC原生序列记忆更新规则，并与线性注意力文献（如DeltaNet）建立联系，实现测试时对序列信息的完美记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时快速存储与检索序列信息是智能系统的基础能力，但现有Transformer和线性注意力变体依赖BPTT训练，存在内存开销大等缺陷；预测编码（PC）虽通过局部更新优化预测误差能量，却缺乏针对序列数据的测试时记忆机制。

Method: 将每步记忆更新ΔS_t建模为隐变量（而非缓慢学习的权重）；对标准PC概率模型取log概率，推导出PC原生的逐字序列记忆更新规则；将更新规则与线性注意力中的常见选择（如DeltaNet）进行理论关联与对比。

Result: 通过大量实证测试考察系统性质，包括扩展容量、内存占用、以及从证据推断上下文的能力（如bank指河岸还是银行）；DeltaNet-PC在存储单序列、多序列以及键值联想记忆对上均达到完美召回精度。

Conclusion: DeltaNet-PC证明PC可以原生支持测试时序列记忆，其更新规则与线性注意力机制存在理论联系，在多种序列记忆任务上实现完美召回，为摆脱BPTT内存瓶颈提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Test-time memorization of sequential information is a foundational capability for any intelligent system that needs to rapidly store and retrieve data, as demonstrated by the attention mechanism in large language models. However, Transformers and linear attention variants are trained via backpropagation through time (BPTT), which has drawbacks such as its enormous memory requirements. Predictive coding (PC), an algorithm that optimizes a prediction-error energy function with local updates, offers a compelling solution but still lacks test-time memory for sequential data. We develop a solution to this problem by treating the per-step memory update $ΔS_t$ as a latent variable, as opposed to a slow weight to be learned. By taking the log probability of a standard PC-based probabilistic model, we derive a PC-native solution for verbatim sequence memory, and relate our update rule to common choices in the linear attention literature (e.g., DeltaNet). We present an extensive set of empirical tests to probe our system's properties, including its scaling capacity, memory footprint, and ability to infer a context from evidence (e.g., bank (river) vs. bank (money)). We show how DeltaNet-PC can be used for storing single sequences of data, multiple sequences of data, and key-value associative memory pairs with perfect recall accuracy.

</details>


### [151] [Exploring Jailbreak Vulnerability Across Depth-Based Dynamic Inference in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15207)
*Lass Najmuldeen,Seyedhamidreza Mousavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了基于深度的动态推理对LLM越狱攻击鲁棒性的影响，发现浅层出口比深层出口更鲁棒，出口深度影响对抗后缀优化难度，且对抗后缀在各出口深度对效用影响一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM计算开销大且易受越狱攻击。深度动态推理可通过中间层生成输出来提升效率并灵活调整模型行为，但这种灵活性对越狱鲁棒性的影响尚属空白，本文旨在填补该研究缺口。

Method: 对基于深度的动态推理与LLM越狱鲁棒性之间的关系进行系统性实证研究，考察不同出口深度下的鲁棒性表现、对抗后缀优化特性以及效用变化。

Result: 1) 浅层出口对越狱攻击始终比深层出口更鲁棒；2) 出口深度影响对抗后缀优化难度，深层出口可达到更低的攻击损失；3) 对抗后缀在各出口深度对模型效用的影响基本一致。

Conclusion: 这些发现为设计对越狱攻击更具鲁棒性的动态推理方法提供了指导。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been shown to be computationally expensive and vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, in which adversarial prompts bypass safety alignment and induce harmful responses. To address this inefficiency, a range of techniques have been proposed to enable efficient LLM inference. Depth-based dynamic inference has demonstrated promising results by enabling outputs to be generated from intermediate layers. It offers the flexibility to adjust model behavior based on the available resource budget. However, how this flexibility affects the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks remains unexplored. In this paper, we address this gap via a comprehensive investigation into the impact of depth-based dynamic inference on the robustness of LLMs against jailbreak attacks. Specifically, we make the following key observations: 1) Shallow exits are consistently more robust to jailbreak attacks than deeper ones; 2) Exit depth affects how easily the adversarial suffix can be optimized, with deeper exits reaching lower attack loss; and 3) Adversarial suffixes affect utility uniformly across exit depths. These insights can help design dynamic inference methodologies that are more robust to jailbreak attacks. Code is available at https://github.com/LassNajmuldeen/balcony-jailbreaking

</details>


### [152] [Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of LLMs in Learnable Low-Rank Subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15225)
*Chuang Tong,Ling Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdaSub-ZO：一种在可学习低秩子空间中进行前向-only微调的零阶优化框架，通过从有限差分反馈迭代学习逐层投影矩阵以对齐任务相关下降方向，并引入子空间动量加速，显著降低梯度估计方差并加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶优化可用于大语言模型的显存高效微调，但在高维参数空间中方差很大。近期方法将扰动限制在随机低秩子空间中以缓解该问题，然而这些随机子空间往往与任务特定的下降方向不一致，导致优化效率受限。

Method: 提出AdaSub-ZO框架，包含两个核心设计：（1）不再依赖固定随机矩阵，而是从有限差分反馈中迭代学习逐层投影矩阵，使子空间跟踪任务感知的下降方向；（2）引入子空间动量加速机制，在演化的子空间基上平滑噪声梯度估计。

Result: 在自然语言理解任务上的大量实验表明，AdaSub-ZO优于现有零阶基线方法，显著降低梯度估计方差并加快收敛速度。

Conclusion: 在可学习低秩子空间中进行前向-only微调，能够有效缓解零阶优化在高维空间中的高方差问题，为LLM的显存高效微调提供了一种更对齐任务方向、收敛更快的方案。

Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). However, ZO optimization suffers from high variance in high-dimensional parameter spaces. While recent methods restrict perturbations to random low-rank subspaces, these subspaces often misalign with task-specific descent directions. We propose AdaSub-ZO, a novel forward-only fine-tuning framework in learnable low-rank subspaces. Instead of relying on fixed random matrices, AdaSub-ZO iteratively learns layer-wise projection matrices directly from finite-difference feedback to track task-aware descent directions. Furthermore, AdaSub-ZO incorporates a subspace momentum acceleration mechanism to smooth noisy gradient estimates across evolving subspace bases. Extensive experiments on natural language understanding tasks demonstrate that AdaSub-ZO outperforms existing ZO baselines, substantially reducing gradient estimation variance and accelerating convergence.

</details>


### [153] [EvolvAttack: Backdooring self Evolving VLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15244)
*Chuan Zou,Yang Xiang,Zexin Li,Xiaonan Luo,Simin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"自演化后门"攻击面：恶意载荷在初始VLM智能体中休眠，仅当视觉触发器与特定演化记忆状态共同出现时才激活，静态扫描几乎无法检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化机制让VLM智能体通过演化记忆持续适应，但也使恶意行为可能在部署后才出现。传统后门可用静态模型+触发输入检测，而自演化智能体的攻击需要触发器与演化记忆状态共同触发，静态清洁记忆扫描会误判其无害，因此存在新的、隐蔽的安全威胁。

Method: 提出记忆感知后门训练（memory-aware backdoor training）：将触发器激活与智能体演化记忆相耦合，仅在触发器与载荷相关记忆共现时激活载荷，否则保持良性行为。

Result: 在3种VLM骨干、4种智能体流水线，以及基于近因、语义、奖励的记忆演化机制上验证：攻击保持正常功能，演化前几乎不激活（攻击成功率0.5%），但在100次交互内攻击成功率超过95%。

Conclusion: 自演化后门是自演化智能体特有的隐蔽威胁，静态检测近乎失效，需针对记忆演化过程设计新的防御与检测方法。

Abstract: Self-evolving mechanisms let vision-language model (VLM) agents continually adapt through evolving memory, but they also allow malicious behavior to emerge only after deployment. We introduce a new attack surface, the self-evolving backdoor, whose payload stays dormant in the initial agent and is progressively activated as the agent evolves. Unlike conventional backdoors, which can be exposed by testing triggered inputs on a static model, our attack requires both a visual trigger and a sufficiently evolved memory state; static scanning with clean memory thus yields near-zero attack success and may deem the agent benign. We realize this through memory-aware backdoor training, which couples trigger activation with the agent's evolving memory while preserving benign behavior unless the trigger co-occurs with payload-related memory. Across three VLM backbones, four agent pipelines, and recency-, semantic-, and reward-based memory evolution, the attack preserves normal functionality and stays nearly inactive before evolution (0.5% attack success rate), yet exceeds 95% attack success within 100 interactions, revealing a stealthy threat unique to self-evolving agents.

</details>


### [154] [ObsSpec: Accelerating Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation Speculation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15246)
*Kyle Montgomery,Wang Zhang,Chenguang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ObsSpec 用一个 0.6B 世界模型在环境执行工具调用期间预测工具输出，使策略可提前开始下一轮生成；仅当预测与真实观测完全一致时才保留推测结果，从而保证 rollout 无损，并通过协同训练保持世界模型同步。在终端使用任务上，预测精确匹配率为 66.4%，速度约快 16 倍，使 8B 与 32B 策略的智能体延迟分别降低 9.3% 和 14.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型智能体在"模型生成—工具执行"之间串行交替，必须等每次工具调用完成才能开始下一步生成。在需要大批量多轮 rollout 的智能体强化学习中，这种串行执行造成显著的时间开销与资源闲置。本文试图打破这一串行瓶颈，在不损失 rollout 正确性的前提下，将策略生成与工具执行重叠起来以降低延迟。

Method: 提出 ObsSpec 观测推测（observation speculation）流水线：在环境实际执行工具调用期间，用一个小的世界模型（0.6B）预测该工具的输出，让策略提前开始下一轮生成。为保证无损，只有预测观测与真实观测完全一致时才保留这部分推测工作，否则回退到真实观测重新生成。同时采用协同训练（co-training）策略，随着策略的更新不断训练世界模型，使其分布跟上策略演化。

Result: 在终端使用（terminal-use）任务上，0.6B 世界模型的预测在 66.4% 的尝试中与真实观测精确匹配，并且返回速度约快 16 倍。基于这些预测，ObsSpec 使 8B 和 32B 策略的智能体延迟分别降低 9.3% 和 14.2%。在一系列受控实验中，作者刻画了在共享策略资源下 ObsSpec 能够降低智能体延迟的适用区间。

Conclusion: ObsSpec 通过小世界模型进行观测推测，在保证 rollout 无损的前提下有效降低智能体 RL 的延迟。由于它将策略生成与工具执行重叠，架构上与现有 RL 加速技术兼容，可叠加使用。代码已开源。

Abstract: Tool-using agents alternate between model generation and tool execution, waiting for each tool call to complete before starting the next generation. This sequential execution is costly during agentic reinforcement learning (RL), which requires large batches of multi-turn rollouts. We introduce ObsSpec, an observation speculation pipeline for agentic RL that uses a small world model to predict tool outputs while the environment executes, allowing the policy to begin its next generation early. ObsSpec retains speculative work only when the predicted and actual observations match exactly, making rollout collection lossless, while co-training keeps the world model up to date as the policy learns. On terminal-use tasks, predictions from a 0.6B world model exactly match actual observations in 66.4% of attempts and arrive roughly 16 times faster. Using these predictions, ObsSpec reduces agent latency by 9.3% and 14.2% for 8B and 32B policies. Across controlled experiments, we characterize the regimes in which ObsSpec reduces agent latency under shared policy resources. Finally, because ObsSpec overlaps policy generation with tool execution, it is architecturally compatible with existing techniques for accelerating RL. Code is available at https://github.com/kylemontgomery1/verl-recipe/tree/obsspec/obsspec.

</details>


### [155] [Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15250)
*Md. Johir Raihan,Zahra Zamanzadeh Darban,Yueyang Liu,Flora D. Salim,Levin Kuhlmann,Mahsa Salehi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CARMA——基于相关性感知重建的变分自编码器，通过分离时间潜在空间与相关性潜在空间，显式建模通道间依赖，提升多变量时间序列跨通道异常检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于重建的检测器将时间动态与通道间结构压缩到单一纠缠表示中，缺乏显式机制区分通道间依赖与正常时间依赖，导致对"各通道单独正常但联合行为异常"的跨通道异常检测率偏低。

Method: CARMA为重建式VAE，含两个互补潜在空间：时间潜在捕捉序列动态，相关性潜在以窗口的两两Pearson相关系数为显式监督目标进行重建；两者在信号解码器中融合，异常由重建误差判定。

Result: 在TSB-AD-M基准（17个数据集、180条序列）上对比29种基线方法，在多种无阈值与范围感知指标上显著优于全部基线，VUS-PR达0.4929。

Conclusion: 消融实验表明：移除相关性分支会降低性能；无监督地增加第二个潜在空间仅恢复部分增益；对相关性潜在施加显式相关性目标可补足剩余增益，并在异常处产生更尖锐的误差响应。

Abstract: Reconstruction-based detectors for multivariate time series anomaly detection typically learn a single entangled representation of normal behavior and flag anomalies based on reconstruction error. However, real-world anomalies are not only isolated spikes in a single channel but also disruptions in the relationships between channels, where each sensor individually appears normal, but their joint behavior deviates from the norm. Because these models compress both temporal evolution and inter-channel structure into this single space, they lack an explicit mechanism to isolate such inter-channel dependencies from normal temporal dependencies, leading to lower detection rates for cross-channel anomalies. We propose CARMA (Correlation-Aware Reconstruction for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection), which is a reconstruction-based variational autoencoder with two complementary latent spaces: a temporal latent that captures sequential dynamics, and a correlation latent that is trained to reconstruct the window's pairwise Pearson correlations. Both representations are fused in the signal decoder, and anomalies are detected from the reconstruction error. We evaluate CARMA on the TSB-AD-M benchmark suite (17 datasets, 180 series) against 29 baseline methods, and show that it significantly outperforms all of them across multiple threshold-free and range-aware metrics, achieving a VUS-PR of 0.4929. Ablations show that removing the correlation branch degrades performance, that adding a second latent without supervision recovers only part of the gain, and that supervising the correlation latent with an explicit correlation target accounts for the rest and produces a sharper error response at anomalies.

</details>


### [156] [LeHami: Symplectic Latent Dynamics for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15267)
*Romina Yalovetzky,Randall Balestriero,Yann LeCun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA（LeHami），用作用条件Hamiltonian流与精确辛leapfrog积分替换标准预测器，保证 rollout 中相空间体积守恒，避免潜分布收缩，提升长时程预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: JEPA 直接在潜空间学习世界模型，但无约束的自回归预测器在长时域 rollout 中可能导致潜分布收缩（latent contraction）。作者希望引入几何结构，在推理时提供对收缩、稳定不动点与潜状态合并的保证，而不只依赖表示正则化。

Method: Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA（LeHami）：将标准预测器替换为作用于结构化潜状态 (q, p) 的作用条件 Hamilton 流，并用精确辛 leapfrog 步积分；动量类分量由学习到的位置类表示的时间导数得到，形成显式二阶状态用于预测与控制。

Result: 在保守与驱动视觉单摆环境中，LeHami 相比无约束 JEPA 世界模型显著改善长时程速度预测，并在基线下收缩时经验上保持潜体积恒定；学习到的流还支持未见子帧步长的准确积分与数值时间反演。

Conclusion: 几何结构可为潜世界模型提供与表示正则化互补的推理时保证，说明辛/Hamilton 约束是提升长时程潜空间预测稳定性的有效途径。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models directly in latent space, but unconstrained autoregressive predictors may contract the latent distribution over long rollouts. We introduce Symplectic Hamiltonian JEPA (LeHami), which replaces the standard predictor with an action-conditioned Hamiltonian flow over a structured latent state (q, p) integrated using an exactly symplectic leapfrog step. This construction preserves phase-space volume at every rollout step and rules out uniform contraction, asymptotically stable fixed points, and merging of distinct latent states, independently of the learned parameters or action sequence. We obtain the momentum-like component from temporal derivatives of the learned position-like representation, providing an explicit second-order state for prediction and control. On conservative and actuated visual pendulum environments, LeHami substantially improves long-horizon velocity prediction over an unconstrained JEPA world model and empirically maintains constant latent volume where the baseline contracts. The learned flow also supports accurate integration at unseen sub-frame step sizes and numerical time reversal. These results show how geometric structure can provide inference-time guarantees that are complementary to representation regularization in latent world models.

</details>


### [157] [Imperfect Verifiers, Exact Targets: Inference-Time Scaling for Continuous Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15281)
*Kijung Jeon,Molei Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出连续状态验证器引导回溯(CS-VGB)，通过反复去噪与加噪使采样收敛到目标奖励倾斜分布，即使验证器不准确也成立。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证器引导的推理时扩展通过额外计算对中间状态打分，引导生成走向更优输出。但不完美的中间验证器会扭曲采样，仅靠反复精化无法保证恢复到期望的奖励倾斜分布。

Method: CS-VGB在连续生成模型上，通过正确配对的去噪与加噪转移进行反复操作；利用验证器在中间检查点指导回溯，使清洁检查点处的平稳分布等于目标奖励倾斜分布。

Result: 在给定正则条件下，CS-VGB即使存在验证器误差也以指数速率收敛到目标，达到清洁样本所需更新次数随检查点数量线性增长；在可解析设定中成功恢复目标分布，而对比方法在相同验证器误差下失败。在扩散模型与一步随机后验映射上实例化，在ImageNet提示引导生成、CelebA面部属性生成和多机器人规划中，奖励与任务成功率随推理预算增长，图像生成奖励超越仅去噪基线的平台期。

Conclusion: CS-VGB为存在验证器误差时的奖励倾斜采样提供了理论保证与实用框架，实现随推理预算持续提升的性能。

Abstract: Verifier-guided inference-time scaling uses additional computation to score intermediate states and steer generation toward better outputs. However, imperfect intermediate verifiers can distort sampling, and repeated refinement alone does not ensure recovery of the desired reward-tilted distribution. We introduce Continuous-State Verifier-Guided Backtracking (CS-VGB), an inference-time scaling method for sampling from reward-tilted distributions with continuous generative models through repeated denoising and renoising. With correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions, the stationary distribution of CS-VGB at the clean checkpoint equals the desired reward-tilted target, even when intermediate verifiers are inaccurate. Under stated regularity conditions, CS-VGB converges exponentially to the target despite verifier error, and the expected number of updates needed to reach a clean sample grows only linearly with the number of checkpoints. In analytically tractable settings, we empirically demonstrate that CS-VGB recovers the desired reward-tilted distribution despite verifier error, whereas the compared verifier-based sampling methods fail to recover the target under the same verifier errors. We also instantiate the framework with diffusion models and one-step stochastic posterior maps. Across prompt-guided ImageNet generation, facial-attribute generation on CelebA, and multi-robot planning, recurrent CS-VGB search improves reward and task success as inference budgets grow, with image-generation rewards continuing beyond the observed plateaus of denoising-only baselines.

</details>


### [158] [FragFlex: Fragment-Based Flexible Molecular Generation for Exploring Vast Chemical Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15284)
*Sihyun Park,David Ryan Koes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FragFlex：一种在片段（fragment）层面进行节点插入/删除的变长离散扩散模型，可联合建模分子大小、片段身份与片段间连接，配合连接位点预测器和价态约束装配器生成原子级分子，在大规模实验中实现近乎完美的化学有效性与高唯一性的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物发现需要高效探索天文数字规模的化学空间。分子图扩散模型虽有前景，但许多方法在生成前需固定图的大小（节点数）。虽然原子级插入/删除可实现变长生成，但联合建模分子大小、原子类型和化学键并同时保持化学有效性仍具挑战。

Method: 提出 FragFlex，一个灵活长度的离散扩散模型，在片段层面执行节点插入与删除。在去噪过程中，模型联合学习片段图的大小、片段身份以及片段间的连接关系；随后通过一个神经连接位点（attachment-site）预测器和一个价态感知（valence-aware）装配器，将生成的片段图转换为原子级分子。

Result: 在大规模实验中生成了 1000 万个分子，FragFlex 在保持高唯一性的同时实现了近乎完美的化学有效性，展示出二者之间的良好平衡。

Conclusion: 在片段层面进行变长离散扩散，可有效解决固定图大小的限制并降低原子级建模的复杂性，从而在化学有效性与生成多样性（唯一性）之间取得优异平衡。

Abstract: Drug discovery requires efficient exploration of an astronomically large chemical space. Molecular graph diffusion models offer a promising approach to this task, but many require graph size to be fixed before generation. Although atom-level insertion and deletion can enable flexible-size generation, jointly modeling molecular size, atom types, and bonds while maintaining chemical validity remains challenging. We introduce FragFlex, a flexible-length discrete diffusion model that performs node insertion and deletion at the fragment level. During denoising, FragFlex jointly learns the size, fragment identities, and inter-fragment connectivity of the fragment graph. A neural attachment-site predictor and valence-aware assembler then convert the generated fragment graph into an atom-level molecule. In large-scale experiments generating 10 million molecules, FragFlex achieves near-perfect chemical validity while maintaining high uniqueness, demonstrating a strong balance between the two.

</details>


### [159] [WisdomNet: trustable machine learning toward error-free classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15299)
*Truong X. Tran,Ramazan S. Aygun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"可信赖学习"(trustable learning)方法及WisdomNet架构，通过引入共轭神经元判断网络能否正确分类，无法确定时拒绝决策或交由人类专家，从而在多次实验中实现0%误分类错误率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即使准确率超过95%的分类器仍会产生误分类错误，因此在许多机器学习应用中无法完全信赖分类器输出，需要一种能避免误分类并识别不可靠预测的机制。

Method: 提出可信赖学习方法论，并设计新的神经网络架构WisdomNet：在原有网络中额外引入"共轭神经元"(conjugate neuron)，用于指示网络能否对数据正确分类；当无法准确判定时，模型应标记可能存在误分类错误，拒绝决策或将其交由人类专家处理。该架构可应用于任何已构建的模型。

Result: 在多层感知机、卷积神经网络及深度网络等多种架构和不同数据集上进行评估，WisdomNet能将分类错误率降至0%，同时仅将约10%以内难以分类的数据标记为"拒绝"。

Conclusion: 通过引入共轭神经元和拒绝机制，WisdomNet可实现0%误分类错误率，且被拒绝样本比例较低，为构建可信赖分类器提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Misclassification is a critical problem in many machine learning applications. Since even the classifier models with high accuracy (e.g., > 95%) still introduce some misclassification error, it may not be possible to rely on the output of a classifier. In this paper, we introduce trustable learning, which prompts the learning model to yield only the true output, thus avoiding misclassifications. Whenever the model cannot decide the output accurately, the learning model should indicate that there could be a misclassification error if it is forced to classify, and hence, it should reject to make a decision or defer it to a human expert. Therefore, we develop a methodology for trustable learning and apply it to artificial neural networks and show that it is possible to develop a classifier with 0% misclassification error. We propose a novel neural network architecture named WisdomNet that could provide zero prediction error by introducing an additional neuron named as conjugate neuron that would indicate whether the network is able to classify the data correctly or not. The WisdomNet architecture can be applied to any previously built model, and we have evaluated WisdomNet with several network architectures such as multilayer perceptron, convolutional neural network, and deep network on different data sets. The results show that the WisdomNet is able to reduce the classification error rate to 0%, while labeling the data is difficult to classify as `reject' at a low percentage of within around 10%.

</details>


### [160] [FENAS: A Few-Shot Meta-Ensembling Framework for Efficient Neural Architecture Search with Synergized Zero-Cost Proxies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15307)
*Yifeng Mao,Yuze Feng,Yutong Shen,Liyang Gao,Zhixiang He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FENAS是一个拓扑无关的少样本性能预测框架，将零成本代理的初始化先验经CAST（copula对齐+协同变换）映射为紧凑特征流形，用轻量元学习器在极少标注下生成稳健排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零成本代理（ZCP）虽免训练且快速，但每个代理只能刻画架构的部分性质，导致跨数据集与搜索空间排序不稳定；基于GNN的预测器虽精度更高，却依赖标注架构、图编码器与昂贵的表示学习，不适合极端少样本场景。因此需要一种兼具ZCP效率与高预测精度的少样本排序机制。

Method: 提出FENAS，一个拓扑无关的少样本预测框架，将互补的初始化先验转化为稳健排序信号。其核心组件CAST是一条特征管线，融合copula对齐与协同变换（synergy transformation），把异构ZCP映射到紧凑特征流形，从而让轻量元学习器在稀缺监督下产出可靠排序。

Result: 在NAS-Bench-201上，仅使用0.5%标注样本时，FENAS取得Kendall's Tau (τ) = 0.70，优于该低标注体制下的代表性拓扑类少样本预测器；在闭域搜索中，约1138秒即可完成NAS-Bench-201空间评估，并获得有竞争力的测试精度。

Conclusion: FENAS提供了一种快速、可靠且结构简单的评估机制，能够在有限评估预算下支持自动化神经架构设计。

Abstract: Efficient neural architecture search (NAS) requires accurate performance estimation under limited evaluation budgets. Existing zero-cost proxies (ZCPs) provide fast training-free signals, but each proxy usually captures only a partial property of an architecture, leading to unstable rankings across datasets and search spaces. In contrast, GNN-based predictors can improve accuracy, but often depend on labeled architectures, graph encoders, and costly representation learning, which makes them less suitable for extreme few-shot settings. We propose FENAS, a topology-agnostic few-shot prediction framework that turns complementary initialization priors into robust ranking signals. Its core component, CAST, is a feature pipeline that combines copula alignment and synergy transformation. CAST maps heterogeneous ZCPs into a compact feature manifold, enabling lightweight meta-learners to produce reliable rankings from scarce supervision. On NAS-Bench-201, with only 0.5% labeled samples, FENAS achieves a Kendall's Tau ($τ$) of 0.70, outperforming representative topology-based few-shot predictors in this low-label regime. In closed-domain search, FENAS evaluates the NAS-Bench-201 space in approximately 1138 seconds and achieves competitive test accuracy. By providing a fast, reliable, and structurally simple evaluation mechanism, FENAS supports the design of automated neural architectures under limited evaluation budgets.

</details>


### [161] [Accuracy and Uncertainty in Machine Deception Detection (Research White Paper)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15314)
*Heng-Sheng Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该白皮书提出 Machine Deception Detector：读取语言模型全部层级激活，仅用响应标签学习欺骗证据token，校准报警阈值控制假阳性率，并用检测器集成度量分数不确定性，仅在成员一致时报警。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于内部激活的欺骗检测器存在三方面不足：依赖所读取的特定层级、在更广泛测试上性能下降、且不给出报警的置信度。而检测器的价值取决于其报警所应得的信任，因此需要同时提升检测准确性与分数不确定性刻画。

Method: 检测器读取语言模型的每一层；仅使用响应标签学习哪些token携带欺骗证据；校准报警阈值使假阳性率低于预设水平；采用此类检测器的集成来度量每个分数的不确定性，仅当集成成员一致时才报警，并以置信水平设定每次报警所需的确定程度。

Result: 提出评估方案：在指令式诚实与欺骗陈述上训练，在 Liars' Bench 的五个未见欺骗任务上测试，由六个 Qwen3 模型（0.6B 至 32B 参数）读取；并设计用于揭示哪些层级携带欺骗特征以及该特征随模型规模如何变化。

Conclusion: 该白皮书面向检测准确性与检测器分数不确定性双重目标，提出全层读取、标签驱动、阈值校准与集成一致性报警的欺骗检测框架，并给出跨任务、跨模型规模的评估设计。

Abstract: A deception detector is only as useful as the trust its alarms deserve. Like a polygraph, detectors that read a language model's internal activations can catch deceptive responses that look honest. Yet current detectors depend on which layers they read, weaken on broader tests, and do not state how certain their alarms are. This white paper proposes the Machine Deception Detector, which targets both detection accuracy and the uncertainty of detector scores. The detector reads every layer of the language model, learns which tokens carry evidence of deception using only response labels, and calibrates its alarm threshold so that its false--positive rate stays below a prescribed level. An ensemble of such detectors measures the uncertainty of each score and raises an alarm only when its members agree, with a confidence level that sets how certain each alarm must be. The proposed evaluation trains on instructed honest and deceptive statements, tests on five unseen deceptive tasks of Liars' Bench read by six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, and is designed to also show which layers carry the deception feature and how this changes with model size.

</details>


### [162] [CIViC: Evidence Gates for Audio-Conditioned Visual Prediction on Proxy Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15327)
*Mengzhe Geng,Max W. Y. Lam,Yuewen Cao,Shoukang Hu,Jing Xu,Marc Tessier,Xu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出CIViC（条件输入与视觉解释检查），一个四门协议，用于把"解释"与"干预"、"留出任务比较"或"端点控制"关联起来，从而检验音频信息是否真正被任务使用，而非仅靠移除音频导致的输出变化来判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅移除音频会改变视觉预测器的输出，但无法证明该任务实际使用了预期的音频信息。因此需要一个更严格的协议来检验音频信息使用的解释，避免将输出激活误读为任务依赖。

Method: 提出CIViC：一个四门协议，将解释与干预、留出任务比较或端点控制相链接。在三个代理任务上演示：（1）行为者不相交的脸部光栅测试；（2）合成音频特征混合任务；（3）源视频不相交的SpeakerVid代理任务。

Result: 静态脸部光栅测试中，跨行为者音频替换通过注册检测规则但效应很小；在另一时间端点，常数音频拟合在四个匹配种子中优于音频训练拟合。合成混合中，条件增强拟合的1000步RMSE高于纯音频拟合（0.1807 vs 0.1707），且差距随训练缩小。SpeakerVid代理中，五特征置零拟合（五个低层音频摘要置零，保留身份、对话和条件输入）在四个留出条件和五个配对种子上的整帧灰度RMSE低于对齐音频，而对齐音频的分段漂移误差更低。

Conclusion: 结果表明，输出激活、留出误差和端点控制在这些代理任务中支持不同的解释，说明判断音频信息是否被使用需综合多种检验，不能仅凭单一指标（如输出激活）下结论。

Abstract: Removing audio can shift a visual predictor's output without showing whether the task uses the intended audio information. We introduce Conditional Input and Visual Interpretation Checks (CIViC), a four-gate protocol that links an interpretation to an intervention, held-out task comparison, or endpoint control. We demonstrate CIViC on actor-disjoint face-raster tests, a synthetic audio-feature mixture, and source-video-disjoint SpeakerVid proxy tasks. In the static face-raster test, cross-actor audio replacement meets the registered detection rule with a small effect; on a separate temporal endpoint, constant-audio fits score better than audio-trained fits in four matched seeds. In the synthetic mixture, the condition-augmented fit has higher 1,000-step RMSE than the audio-only fit (0.1807 vs. 0.1707), with the gap shrinking during training. In the SpeakerVid proxy, the five-feature-zero fit (five low-level audio summaries zeroed; identity, dialogue, and condition inputs retained) has lower whole-frame grayscale RMSE than aligned audio across four held-out conditions and five paired seeds, while aligned audio has lower segment-drift error. The results show that output activation, held-out error, and endpoint controls support different interpretations across these proxy tasks.

</details>


### [163] [Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum: A Fully Unmasked Non-LLM Curriculum for Craftax](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15328)
*Jiayu Zhu,Luyuan Li,Yuyuan Shi,Hanyi Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum (AHC)，一种面向Craftax-Full的领域知识驱动、基于规则的训练课程系统。不含LLM推理且不禁用任何动作，AHC在约20亿PPO转移后取得原任务回报46.70±0.57，优于同等架构的原生PPO-GTrXL（41.91±1.01），并接近所报道的LLM生成课程水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作多依赖LLM生成课程或动作掩码来提升复杂环境（如Craftax-Full）中的强化学习表现，但其推理成本高、实现复杂。本文旨在验证：仅凭显式、领域知识驱动的规则化课程（无须LLM推理、不限制动作空间）是否也能达到与LLM生成课程相当的原任务回报。

Method: AHC整合五个要素：以成就为导向的任务、从初始状态采集的进度（harvested initial-state progress）、难度自适应、有界选择，以及原任务练习。系统完全基于规则，不进行LLM推理，保留全部43个动作。评估在1024个固定世界上每模型进行10次随机rollout。此外设置三组AHC重复运行、两项单项消融、联合冻结难度与移除继承进度的消融，以及基于14B教师的Skill-Preflight诊断。

Result: 在2,005,401,600次PPO rollout转移后，三组主AHC运行原生任务回报为46.70±0.57（样本SD），对照的原生PPO-GTrXL为41.91±1.01；另一组三运行队列达46.08±1.23。两项单项消融均值相近；联合冻结难度并移除继承进度降至45.14±2.79。全67成就画像显示回报差异主要来自Intermediate成就，最深层成就仍未解决。Skill-Preflight诊断表明前置条件与楼层准入约束限制了练习。AHC及三组14B诊断配置的聚合回报接近所报道80B DiCode均值45.88，低于235B均值48.55。

Conclusion: 结果表明，在Craftax-Full上，不依赖LLM推理、且不使用动作掩码的显式规则化课程，可以达到与所报道LLM生成课程相当的原任务回报，说明课程设计的结构化领域知识可作为LLM课程生成的有效低成本替代。

Abstract: We introduce Anchor-and-Harvest Curriculum (AHC), a domain-informed, rule-based training system for Craftax-Full. AHC combines achievement-oriented tasks, harvested initial-state progress, difficulty adaptation, bounded selection, and original-task practice. It uses no LLM inference and keeps all 43 actions available. At 2,005,401,600 PPO rollout transitions, three primary AHC runs obtain native-task return $46.70\pm0.57$ (sample SD), compared with $41.91\pm1.01$ for fresh native PPO-GTrXL with the same student architecture and evaluation protocol. Evaluation uses ten stochastic rollouts on each of 1024 fixed worlds per model. An additional cohort of three AHC runs reaches $46.08\pm1.23$. Two single-component ablations retain similar mean returns, while jointly freezing difficulty and removing inherited progress gives $45.14\pm2.79$. All-67-achievement profiles show that most of the return difference comes from Intermediate achievements, while the deepest-floor achievements remain unsolved. A Skill-Preflight diagnosis with a 14B teacher shows how prerequisite and floor-access constraints restrict practice. AHC and three 14B diagnostic configurations reach aggregate returns near the reported 80B DiCode mean of 45.88 and below the 235B mean of 48.55. These results show that an explicit curriculum without LLM inference can reach returns comparable to those reported for LLM-generated curricula on Craftax-Full, without action masking.

</details>


### [164] [Full Waveform Inversion with a Learned Preconditioner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15331)
*Jeongjin Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究能否用RTM图像训练的神经算子为FWI提供学习型预条件，对比了投影FWI与FNO、JI-FNO预条件FWI，发现JI-FNO最优，标准FNO不稳定，并揭示非线性神经高斯牛顿内层求解的失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FWI在实际应用中受病态性、对更新方向敏感以及基于曲率方法计算代价高的问题制约，因此需要探索更有效的预条件手段。作者希望验证：在逆时偏移（RTM）图像上训练的神经算子，是否能作为有用的学习型预条件算子用于FWI。

Method: 对比投影FWI与神经预条件FWI，后者分别采用标准傅里叶神经算子（FNO）和雅可比信息FNO（JI-FNO）。神经预条件通过将所学RTM映射的法算子作用于真实Devito FWI梯度来修正更新方向。此外还分析了将神经RTM输出直接匹配FWI梯度的非线性神经高斯牛顿型内层求解。

Result: JI-FNO预条件取得最低的模型误差，且数据残差衰减与基线投影FWI相当；标准FNO预条件不稳定，模型恢复更差，尽管使用相同的神经预条件框架。非线性神经高斯牛顿型内层求解存在失效模式：将神经RTM输出直接匹配FWI梯度会造成目标空间不匹配，无法给出可靠下降方向。

Conclusion: 仅靠前向RTM图像预测不足以实现有效的学习型预条件；要产生有用的反演更新，需要准确的所学导数以及目标函数一致的神经算子使用方式。

Abstract: Full-waveform inversion (FWI) is a powerful approach for reconstructing subsurface velocity models, but its practical performance is limited by ill-conditioning, sensitivity to the update direction, and the high cost of curvature-based methods. In this project, we investigate whether a neural operator trained on reverse-time-migration (RTM) images can provide a useful learned preconditioner for FWI. We compare projected FWI against neural-preconditioned FWI using either a standard Fourier neural operator (FNO) or a Jacobian-informed FNO (JI-FNO). The neural preconditioner applies the normal operator of the learned RTM map to modify the true Devito FWI gradient. Our experiments show that the JI-FNO preconditioner achieves the lowest model error while maintaining data-residual decay comparable to baseline projected FWI. In contrast, the standard FNO preconditioner is unstable and gives worse model recovery, despite using the same neural-preconditioning framework. We also identify a failure mode of a nonlinear neural Gauss Newton-type inner solve: directly matching the neural RTM output to the FWI gradient creates an objective-space mismatch and does not yield a reliable descent direction.
