These results suggest that forward RTM-image prediction alone is insufficient for learned preconditioning; accurate learned derivatives and objective-consistent use of the neural operator are critical for producing useful inversion updates.

</details>


### [165] [ZOIF: Zeroth-Order Influence Function Estimation for LLM Data Selection Using Only Forward Passes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15336)
*Lisong He,Yunxuan Jiang,Haishan Ye,Xiangyu Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZOIF：一种完全基于前向传播的零阶影响函数框架，通过三阶段无反向传播流程实现大模型数据选择，在显著降低峰值内存的同时保持竞争性下游效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 影响函数可为大语言模型提供有原则的数据选择（如识别有影响的训练样本用于模型编辑、调试或高效微调）。然而将其扩展到 LLM 面临两大障碍：十亿级 Hessian 矩阵的不可解性，以及反向传播带来的高昂内存开销。现有经典 IF 近似虽降低了 Hessian 复杂度，但仍依赖反向传播计算梯度，需要存储大量中间激活，阻碍了大规模数据选择的实际应用。

Method: 提出 ZOIF，一种完全通过前向传播进行影响估计的零阶框架。其将影响估计分解为三个无反向传播阶段：(1) 通过零阶估计近似平均代理梯度；(2) 将逆 Hessian-向量积重构为辅助零阶优化问题并求解，从而绕过显式求逆；(3) 沿前述已计算的参数更新方向，通过前向有限差分推导逐样本影响分数。

Result: 实验表明，ZOIF 所选择的数据子集在下游效用上与所评估的基线方法具有竞争力，部分情况下甚至更优；同时峰值内存成本大幅降低，整体计算时间相当。

Conclusion: ZOIF 通过零阶、纯前向传播的方式实现影响估计，在资源受限条件下实现内存高效的数据选择，为大规模 LLM 数据选择提供了可行且有效的替代方案。

Abstract: Influence functions enable principled data selection for large language models (e.g., identifying influential training samples for model editing, debugging, or efficient fine-tuning). However, scaling IFs to LLMs is hindered by the intractability of billion-scale Hessian matrices and the prohibitive memory overhead of backpropagation (BP). While many classical IF approximations reduce Hessian complexity, they still rely on BP for gradient computation, requiring massive storage for intermediate activations that impedes practical data selection at scale. To address this, we propose ZOIF, a zeroth-order framework for influence estimation that operates entirely via forward passes, enabling memory-efficient data selection under resource constraints. ZOIF decomposes influence estimation into three BP-free stages: (1) approximating the average proxy gradient via zeroth-order estimation; (2) reformulating and solving the inverse Hessian-vector product as an auxiliary zeroth-order optimization to bypass explicit inversion; and (3) deriving per-sample influence scores via a forward finite difference along the previously computed parameter update direction. Experiments show that ZOIF selects data subsets with downstream utility competitive with, and in some cases exceeding, the evaluated baselines, yet at substantially lower peak memory cost and with comparable overall computation time.

</details>


### [166] [CodeWalk: Generating Coding Benchmarks by Walking a Problem Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15345)
*Jiaxin Fang,Runyuan He,Arnav Gupta,Sahil Kumawat,Huanzhi Mao,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"代码组合"方法：将已验证的原子编程问题程序化组合为level-N任务，仅在每个原子问题单独未解决且联合参考解通过评测检验时保留任务，无需模型生成或验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量编程问题收集成本高。SWE-bench等基准依赖大量人工标注，合成替代方案则依赖昂贵的模型生成与验证，因此需要一种低成本甚至零成本构造新编程问题的途径。

Method: 将问题生成形式化为代码组合：把已验证的原子问题组合成level-N任务；保留条件为每个原子问题均未被解决，且联合参考解能通过评测时使用的同一检查。整个任务构造过程完全程序化，不使用语言模型生成或验证。在四种编码场景中实例化：多缺陷修复、证明补全、复杂度分析、克隆等价。

Result: 生成任务对前沿模型具有挑战性，随组合深度增加，各模型表现均下降；同时可作为训练数据，基于拒绝采样的微调在每一组合层级上都提升了Qwen3.5-9B。

Conclusion: 通过组合已有已验证问题即可近乎零成本地创建新编程问题，所得任务兼具评测挑战性与训练价值，为编程问题基准与训练数据的规模化构造提供了无需模型生成的可行路径。

Abstract: High-quality coding problems are expensive to collect. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench rely on substantial human curation, while synthetic alternatives typically rely on costly model generation and validation. In this work, we show that new coding problems can be created at almost no cost by composing existing ones. We formulate problem generation as code composition: verified atomic problems are combined into level-$N$ tasks, and a task is kept only if every atomic problem remains unsolved and a joint reference solution passes the same check used at evaluation time. The entire task-construction process is programmatic and requires no language-model generation or validation. We instantiate this approach in four coding settings: multi-bug repair, proof completion, complexity analysis, and clone equivalence. The generated tasks are challenging for frontier models, which all degrade as compositional depth increases. The generated tasks are also useful as training data: rejection-sampling fine-tuning on them improves Qwen3.5-9B at every composition level.

</details>


### [167] [Siam-ALS: An Explainable Siamese Deep Learning Framework for Early ALS Detection Using EEG and Eye-Tracking Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15351)
*Abdur Rahman,A. A. M. Muzahid,Istiak Ahmed,Dipto Biswas,Hua Han,Yujin Zhang,Ferdous Sohel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Siam-ALS：一种可解释的孪生深度学习框架，联合建模同步EEG与眼动（ET）信号用于ALS检测，在EEGET-ALS数据集上准确率0.988、AUROC 0.998，跨数据集AUROC约0.98，并用6种XAI方法验证可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ALS诊断因症状异质性强、依赖临床评估而具有挑战性，亟需基于患者生成生理信号的客观、数据驱动方法；同时EEG反映脑活动变化、ET反映眼动控制，二者可提供互补信息。

Method: Siam-ALS采用双模态专用编码器：卷积EEG编码器捕获时空神经模式，MLP式ET编码器建模眼动动力学；特征经权重共享的孪生分支处理并融合为64维联合嵌入；使用轻量分类器预测ALS，并借助成对度量学习应对小规模、多样化的ALS数据集；在EEGET-ALS上采用严格被试级交叉验证评估，并在独立BigP3BCI数据集上做跨数据集验证；另用6种XAI方法在学习到的嵌入空间中评估可解释性。

Result: 在EEGET-ALS数据集上，Siam-ALS取得准确率0.988、AUROC 0.998，优于经典机器学习、深度学习及非孪生融合方法；跨数据集在BigP3BCI上AUROC约0.98，显示跨BCI范式的泛化能力；6种XAI方法中SHAP在识别重要EEG与ET模式方面保真度最高，但差异在统计上可比。

Conclusion: Siam-ALS为多模态ALS检测提供了一个准确、可泛化且可解释的框架。

Abstract: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) diagnosis remains challenging due to heterogeneous symptoms and reliance on clinical assessment, underscoring the need for objective, data-driven approaches that leverage patient-generated physiological signals. We propose Siam-ALS, an explainable Siamese deep learning framework that jointly models synchronized electroencephalography (EEG) and eye-tracking (ET) signals. EEG captures ALS-related changes in brain activity, while ET provides information about oculomotor control, allowing the model to learn complementary patterns associated with ALS. The framework employs two modality-specific encoders: a convolutional EEG encoder that captures spatiotemporal neural patterns and an MLP-based ET encoder that models oculomotor dynamics. These modality-specific features are processed through weight-sharing Siamese branches and fused into a compact 64-dimensional joint embedding. A lightweight classifier is used to predict ALS, while pairwise metric learning helps the model learn more effective patterns from the small, diverse ALS datasets. Performance was evaluated on the public EEGET-ALS dataset using strict subject-level cross-validation, where Siam-ALS achieved an accuracy of 0.988 and an AUROC of 0.998, demonstrating strong performance compared with classical machine learning, DL, and non-Siamese fusion approaches. Cross-dataset evaluation on the independent BigP3BCI dataset achieved an AUROC of approximately 0.98, supporting the generalization capability of Siam-ALS across different BCI paradigms. To enhance interpretability, six XAI methods were evaluated in the learned embedding space, with SHAP achieving the highest, though statistically comparable, fidelity in identifying important EEG and ET patterns that contribute to ALS predictions. Overall, Siam-ALS provides an accurate, generalizable, and explainable framework for multimodal ALS detection.

</details>


### [168] [Adversarial Detection for Pre-trained Classifiers via Lipschitz-Margin Analysis with Certification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15359)
*Rui Zhang,Xinle Cao,Huazhen Yu,Jian Liu,Youwen Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向检测的认证框架：将认证 ℓ2 鲁棒性归约为认证检测，只需处理单一 Lipschitz 常数 L，并给出两种检测器 D_Adv 与 D_lc，可在任意预训练分类器上即插即用。在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-1k 上匹配或超越五种基线，CIFAR-10 VGG16 上拒绝全部评测的预算内对抗样本，其中 62-82% 同时被形式化认证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度分类器在自动驾驶感知等安全关键场景中仍易受小幅对抗扰动影响。现有认证 ℓ2 防御存在代价高昂的权衡：随机平滑需要数百次含噪查询，Lipschitz 网络则约束架构并牺牲干净精度。作者转向检测范式，认为在安全关键部署中漏检攻击的代价高于误报干净输入，因此认证"ℓ2 球内对抗输入被检测到"比认证"预测不变"更契合实际需求。

Method: 证明从认证 ℓ2 鲁棒性到认证检测的 Lipschitz-margin 归约，将问题简化为处理单个 Lipschitz 常数 L。提出两个检测器族：D_Adv 从单次防御方扰动对估计 L；D_lc 在该对基础上加入局部 margin 质心，使估计值保持在证书所需水平之上。二者均无需重训练、可直接部署于任意预训练分类器。若使用有效全局界，检测器在该半径下完全认证；若使用局部估计 L'，则认证为样本级，仅在满足认证条件时适用。

Result: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-1k 及四种骨干网络（LeNet-5、VGG16、ResNet-50、ViT-B/16）上，检测器匹配或超越五种基线（CTT、SortNet、CRM、ContraNet、A²D）。CIFAR-10 + 1-Lipschitz SortNet 下，归约在对比的认证检测器中以最低 FPR 实现 100% 认证检测；标准 CIFAR-10 VGG16 下，检测器拒绝所有评测的预算内对抗样本，其中 62-82% 同时被拒绝且形式化认证。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，认证检测是认证鲁棒性的一种更实用替代，通过 Lipschitz-margin 归约与单侧扰动估计，可在不重训练、不修改架构的前提下为任意预训练分类器提供形式化检测保证，并在多个数据集与骨干网络上取得优于现有基线的认证检测性能。

Abstract: Deep classifiers deployed in safety-critical services like autonomous-driving perception remain vulnerable to small adversarial perturbations. Certified $\ell_2$ defenses today face a costly trade-off: randomized smoothing (RS) requires hundreds of noisy queries per input, while Lipschitz networks (LN) constrain the architecture and sacrifice clean accuracy. We take a detection-oriented approach instead: rather than certifying that predictions are invariant inside an $\ell_2$ ball, we certify that adversarial inputs within an $\ell_2$ ball are \emph{detected} --- a guarantee aligned with security-critical deployments where missing an attack is costlier than flagging a clean input.
  To realize this, we prove a Lipschitz-margin reduction from certified $\ell_2$ robustness to certified detection, which reduces the problem to handling a single Lipschitz constant $L$. We introduce two detector families: $\mathbb{D}_{Adv}$, which estimates $L$ from a single defender-side perturbed pair, and $\mathbb{D}_{lc}$, which augments that pair with a local margin centroid to keep the estimate above what the certificate requires. Both deploy on any pretrained classifier without retraining. With a valid global bound, the detector is fully certified at that radius; with a local estimate $L'$, certification is sample-wise and applies only when our certified condition holds.
  Across MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-1k on four backbones (LeNet-5, VGG16, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16), our detectors match or outperform five baselines (CTT, SortNet, CRM, ContraNet, A$^2$D). For CIFAR-10 with 1-Lipschitz SortNet, our reduction delivers $100\%$ certified detection at the lowest FPR among compared certified detectors; on the standard CIFAR-10 VGG16, our detectors reject all evaluated in-budget adversarial examples, with 62-82\% both rejected and formally certified.

</details>


### [169] [ANTE: Anticipate, Then Execute -- Learning Internal World Models for Coding Agents from Verified Beliefs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15368)
*Yi Ge,Kangrui Ruan,Jifan Chen,Manish Prajapat,Christian Bock,Xiaoyang Wang,Rein Houthooft,Aritra Sengupta,Varun Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ANTE（Anticipate, Then Execute）智能体强化学习框架，通过真实执行验证策略的动作前预测，并将其转化为逐步信用分配，在 SWE-bench Verified 上将 Qwen3-32B 的 pass@1 从 25.0% 提升至 57.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体在容器化环境中根据工具响应或执行结果决定后续动作，但大多缺乏前瞻能力：策略不预判动作后果，终端奖励难以将失败归因到早期步骤，导致错误编辑在信号到来前就不可逆地破坏仓库状态。已有代码世界模型要么在强化学习前训练后即冻结，要么退化为对环境输出的辅助 next-token 损失，无法为动作提供有效的前瞻与信用分配。

Method: 1) ANTE 以真实执行验证策略的动作前预测，并将其转为动作及"信任或弃权"决策的逐步信用；2) 提出 Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization（BAPO）：在每个动作前声明内部信念，将已确定的预测通过锚定在策略自身预测上的方式转化为逐步优势；3) 提出 ANTE-TTO（test-time optimization）：借助训练后的预测能力在推理时选择候选动作，无需外部评分器，促进有效的测试时扩展。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，ANTE 将 Qwen3-32B 的 pass@1 从 25.0% 提升至 57.2%，比未使用信念状态的匹配 GRPO 基线高 6.2%；世界模型准确率在 RL 过程中从 44% 升至 69%；所学前瞻能力可跨 harness 及分布外领域迁移。

Conclusion: 目标是构建一个"知道已发生什么、当前成立什么、下一个动作将达成什么"的代码世界模型，通过信念锚定的策略优化与执行验证的前瞻预测，实现更好的逐步信用分配与推理时动作选择。

Abstract: Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.

</details>


### [170] [E8 Lattice Key Quantization for Low-Bit KV-Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15384)
*Sasho Nedelkoski,Alexander Acker,Soeren Becker,Dominik Scheinert,Odej Kao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于E8格矢量量化的KV缓存压缩方法，在2-bit键+2-bit值的极低比特配置下保持接近基线质量，实现约6倍压缩，优于标量k3v2方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受内存约束，KV缓存压缩至关重要。现有标量量化方法存在质量-保真度权衡：2-bit精度下性能不稳定，或需3-bit键才能维持模型质量。作者希望探索更高效的低比特压缩原语来扩展质量-内存边界。

Method: 针对KV中的键，采用基于E8格的矢量量化（VQ），利用相邻维度间相关性获得比独立标量量化更高的信噪比（SQNR）；并设计基于表的不对称打分算法，在注意力计算中避免显式码本反量化，保持与标量基线相当的解码吞吐。

Result: 在五个LLM家族上，E8 k2v2方法实现约6倍KV压缩，比标量k3v2小约20%，同时保持接近基线的长上下文困惑度；在全套困惑度评测中，E8在80%的模型-数据集-上下文设置下优于标量k3v2。

Conclusion: E8格矢量量化提升了每字节质量且吞吐持平，表明结构化键量化是KV压缩栈中的有效原语，为长上下文LLM推理扩展质量-内存边界提供了低开销方案。

Abstract: Compressing the key-value (KV) cache is essential for serving long-context large language models (LLMs) under memory constraints. While current scalar quantization methods achieve significant compression, they typically face a quality-fidelity trade-off, either suffering from performance instability at 2-bit precision or necessitating 3-bit keys to maintain model quality. In this work, we demonstrate that a uniform low-bit k2v2 configuration (2-bit keys and 2-bit values) can preserve near-baseline quality by using vector quantization (VQ) based on the $E_8$ lattice for KV keys. We show that structured VQ exploits correlations across adjacent dimensions to achieve signal-to-quantization-noise ratios (SQNR) higher than those of independent scalar quantization at the same key payload rate. To ensure practical utility, we adapt a table-based asymmetric scoring algorithm that avoids explicit codebook dequantization during attention computation and preserves decode-throughput parity with scalar baselines. Across five LLM families, our $E_8$ k2v2 approach yields \textasciitilde$6\times$ KV compression, roughly 20\% smaller than scalar k3v2 (3-bit keys and 2-bit values), while retaining near-baseline long-context perplexity. In our full-suite perplexity evaluation, $E_8$ improves over scalar k3v2 in 80\% of model--dataset--context settings. These results indicate that $E_8$ lattice VQ improves quality per byte while keeping throughput at parity, suggesting that structured key quantization is a useful primitive for KV-compression stacks. Overall, our work provides a low-overhead primitive for expanding the quality-memory frontier in long-context LLM inference.

</details>


### [171] [Approximation in Contrastive Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15388)
*Yuanfan Li,Zihan Zhang,Yiming Ying,Ding-Xuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从逼近论视角解释对比表示学习（CRL）：将PMI与紧算子联系起来，证明D维内积模型实现秩D谱逼近，并给出神经网络评分函数的普适一致性、逼近误差率及下游检索误差的快速校准率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CRL的总体目标被识别为两模态间的逐点互信息（PMI）log[p(x,y)/(p_X(x)p_Y(y))]，但PMI一般为不可分离函数，而标准内积评分f(x)^⊤g(y)为何能有效逼近这一非可分离目标尚不清楚。本文旨在从逼近角度回答这一问题。

Method: 将PMI与紧算子建立联系，分析D维内积模型的谱逼近性质；进而研究神经网络实现，分析深度网络评分函数的普适一致性及其逼近误差率与PMI光滑度的关系；并在结构化低秩数据模型下推导中等宽度编码器可达到的改进速率；最后在密度比Tsybakov噪声条件下分析从对比超额风险到下游检索误差的校准。

Result: 证明了D维内积模型等价于秩D谱逼近，其误差由谱尾部控制；深度神经网络评分函数具有普适一致性，逼近误差率取决于PMI函数的光滑度；在结构化低秩数据模型下，中等宽度编码器可获得更优速率；在密度比Tsybakov噪声条件下建立了从对比超额风险到下游检索误差的快速校准率。

Conclusion: 内积评分模型可被理解为对不可分离PMI目标的低秩谱逼近，这一视角统一解释了CRL的有效性，并为深度网络与低秩结构下的误差率和下游检索性能提供了理论保证。

Abstract: Contrastive representation learning (CRL) is a fundamental paradigm for
  learning transferable representations. Recent work
  identifies its population target as the pointwise mutual information (PMI)
  $\log\frac{p(x,y)}{p_X(x)p_Y(y)}$
  between two modalities $X,Y$, where $p$ is the joint density function and
  $p_X,p_Y$ are the marginals. However, it remains unclear why standard inner-product scores $f(x)^\top g(y)$ can effectively approximate a generally nonseparable population target PMI. In this paper, we address this question from the aspect of approximation for CRL. By linking PMI to a compact operator, we show that $D$-dimensional inner-product models perform rank-$D$ spectral approximation, with error controlled by the spectral tail. We then study neural network realizations: in general settings, we show that deep neural network scoring functions are universally consistent, and the approximation error rates depend on the smoothness of the PMI function; under structured low-rank data models we obtain improved rates attained by moderate-width encoders. Finally, we establish a fast calibration rate from contrastive excess risk to downstream retrieval error under a density-ratio Tsybakov noise condition.

</details>


### [172] [DC-Flow: Target-Conditioned Cyclic Peptide Design via Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15391)
*Yitian Wang,Minjie Cheng,Yaning Cui,Maohua Yang,Dongdong Wang,Hongteng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DC-FLOW，一种基于延迟耦合流匹配（Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching）的分阶段生成框架，用于目标条件环肽设计，通过延后序列与侧链激活、再将其反馈至骨架，实现骨架几何与残基身份的协同演化，并支持级联测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标条件环肽设计需协调界面侧链与宏观环化闭合。现有端到端生成器从噪声中同时更新几何与化学变量，导致残基被分配到无序坐标；而预测器辅助流程因在"提议-筛选"阶段缺乏反馈、并在序列搜索中忽略3D结构提议，易陷入局部陷阱。论文旨在同时克服这两类范式的缺陷。

Method: 提出DC-FLOW分阶段生成框架，核心为延迟耦合流匹配：将序列与侧链的激活推迟至目标条件骨架成形之后，先解决结构歧义再进行化学分配；随后将延迟激活反馈回骨架，通过耦合各自的流实现骨架几何与涌现残基身份的协同演化，从而提升宏观环化闭合的可靠性与界面堆积质量。对预测器辅助流程，DC-FLOW提供带轨迹内引导的3D提议，支持级联测试时扩展，以剪除冗余骨架并提前终止无前景的细化过程。

Result: 大量实验表明，DC-FLOW提升了环化保真度、多样性与界面能量学表现，在固定最终候选预算下显著提高了高置信度环肽结合物的产率。代码已开源：https://github.com/mianqiu00/DCFlow。

Conclusion: DC-FLOW通过延迟耦合流匹配统一了生成与预测器辅助流程，为环肽结合物设计提供了更可靠、更高效的新范式。

Abstract: Target-conditioned cyclic peptide design requires coordinating interfacial side chains with macrocyclic closure. Existing end-to-end generators concurrently update geometric and chemical variables from noise, assigning residues to disordered coordinates. Meanwhile, predictor-assisted workflows often get stuck in local traps because they lack feedback in the propose-and-filter stage and ignore 3D structural proposals during sequence search. To overcome the drawbacks of these two paradigms, we propose DC-FLOW, a staged generative framework built around Delayed-Coupling Flow Matching. In principle, DC-FLOW postpones sequence and side-chain activation until a target-conditioned backbone takes shape, resolving structural ambiguity before chemical assignment. Then, it feeds delayed activations back into the backbone, achieving co-evolution of backbone geometry and emerging residue identities by coupling their flows. This mechanism enables more reliable macrocyclic closure and favorable interface packing. For predictor-assisted workflows, DC-FLOW supplies 3D proposals with in-trajectory guidance, enabling cascaded test-time scaling to prune redundant backbones and terminate unpromising refinement early. Extensive experiments show that DC-FLOW improves cyclization fidelity, diversity, and interface energetics, substantially increasing the yield of confident cyclic peptide binders under a fixed final-candidate budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/mianqiu00/DCFlow.

</details>


### [173] [WUSPruner: Second-Moment-Optimal Transforms for Structured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15394)
*Shengkun Tang,Dan Alistarh,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 WUSPruner，一种基于变换的结构化剪枝框架，将基选择建模为局部线性重构问题，利用激活与权重统计构造 WUS 变换，使二阶矩同时对角化并平衡，从而给出有原则的坐标删除准则，并在 8B–72B 的 Llama 和 Qwen 上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构化剪枝通常被表述为在原表示下识别要删除的模型维度，但坐标删除的效果本质上依赖于剪枝所在的基。因此，如何专门为坐标删除选择合适的基，是一个更根本的问题。

Method: 将基选择形式化为直接最小化剪枝引起重构损失的局部线性重构问题；受 WUSH 中二阶矩变换启发，由激活与权重统计联合构造 WUS 变换；理论上证明在正定二阶矩下，WUS 变换在所有可逆基变换中最小化局部重构损失，使激活与权重的二阶矩同时对角化并平衡，从而将删除误差分解为独立谱贡献；据此提出基于分块 WUS 变换与紧凑输入投影的可扩展剪枝方法。

Result: 在 8B 至 72B 参数的 Llama 与 Qwen 模型上，于语言建模、知识、常识推理、数学与代码生成基准上一致优于结构化剪枝基线，同时在实际推理延迟与内存占用上也有降低。

Conclusion: 为坐标删除选择基是结构化剪枝的关键，WUS 变换在正定二阶矩条件下具有最优性，所提出的 WUSPruner 兼顾理论依据、可扩展性与实证效果，并能带来实际推理效率收益。

Abstract: Structured pruning is typically formulated as identifying which model dimensions to remove, often within the model's original representation. However, the effect of coordinate deletion fundamentally depends on the basis in which pruning is performed. This raises a more fundamental question: how should the basis be chosen specifically for coordinate deletion? We introduce WUSPruner, a transform-based framework for structured pruning of large language models. We formulate basis selection as a local linear reconstruction problem that directly minimizes the reconstruction loss induced by pruning. Inspired by the second-moment transformation in WUSH, we consider a WUS transform constructed jointly from activation and weight statistics. We show that under positive-definite second moments, WUS transform minimizes the local reconstruction loss over all invertible changes of basis. In the resulting basis, the activation and weight second moments are simultaneously diagonalized and balanced, causing the deletion error to decompose into independent spectral contributions and yielding a principled criterion for coordinate selection. Guided by this result, we develop a scalable pruning method based on blockwise WUS transformations and compact input projections. Experiments on Llama and Qwen models from 8B to 72B parameters show consistent improvements over structured pruning baselines across language modeling, knowledge, commonsense reasoning, mathematics, and code generation benchmarks, while also delivering practical reductions in inference latency and memory usage.

</details>


### [174] [GA-SVD: Generation-aware Singular Value Decomposition for LLM Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15398)
*Shengkun Tang,Cong Zeng,Zongfang Liu,Dan Alistarh,Zhiqiang Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GA-SVD，一种面向生成任务的LLM低秩压缩框架，通过生成感知权重白化与进化式全局秩分配，在Mistral-7B、Qwen3、Llama-3.3等模型上超越现有SVD基线并达到SoTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM参数量大导致显存与计算开销高，难以在资源受限场景部署；一次性低秩压缩可有效降低模型规模和推理成本，但现有基于SVD的方法主要面向选择题基准，在生成任务上性能保持不佳，且秩分配策略多为启发式。

Method: GA-SVD包含两个核心组件：1）Generation-Aware Weight Whitening（GAWW），利用在线策略知识蒸馏（on-policy knowledge distillation）的梯度构造与生成行为对齐的白化变换；2）进化式全局秩分配方法，在给定全局压缩比下搜索高效的逐层秩分配。

Result: 在Mistral-7B、Qwen3系列和Llama-3.3模型上进行大量实验，在选择题和生成基准上均一致优于现有SVD基线，取得SoTA结果；并验证了方法可扩展至700亿参数规模的模型。

Conclusion: GA-SVD通过生成感知白化与全局秩分配，有效提升了一次性低秩压缩在生成任务上的性能保持能力，兼具效果与可扩展性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generalization across a broad range of reasoning and generation tasks, but their large parameter counts impose substantial memory and computation costs, hindering deployment in practical resource-constrained settings. One-shot low-rank compression is a promising solution since it reduces model size and inference cost effectively. However, existing SVD-based methods primarily target multiple-choice benchmarks and often fail to preserve performance on generation tasks. Moreover, their rank allocation strategies are typically heuristic. We propose GA-SVD, a generation-aware low-rank compression framework for LLMs. First, we introduce Generation-Aware Weight Whitening (GAWW), which leverages gradients from on-policy knowledge distillation to construct whitening transformations aligned with generative behavior. Second, we develop an evolutionary global rank allocation method that searches for effective layer-wise rank allocation under a given global compression ratio. Across extensive experiments on Mistral-7B, Qwen3 series, and Llama-3.3 models, evaluated on both multiple-choice and generative benchmarks, GA-SVD consistently outperforms existing SVD-based baselines and achieves state-of-the-art (SoTA) results. We further demonstrate scalability by applying our method to models with up to 70B parameters.

</details>


### [175] [Harnessing VLM in Embodied RL: From Reward Regressor to Success Detector via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15401)
*Xin Liu,Yutong Jiang,Jian Su,Ziheng Wang,Chuang Wang,Haoran Li,Dongbin Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VLMeg框架，将VLM用作成功检测器而非奖励回归器，通过探索增强的关键观测门控机制实现高效的无奖励从零强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练VLM作奖励回归器的方法需要大量标注，且主要为微调预训练策略设计，在更困难的从零RL设定中表现较差。作者认为其根本原因是：回归精确奖励与VLM天然擅长的能力不匹配，而让VLM充当成功检测器更契合其固有的多模态VQA能力。

Method: VLMeg的核心是探索增强的关键观测门控：(1)基于当前RL回合与生成的成功轨迹的相似度，判断该回合是否值得评判；(2)从值得评判的回合中选取混淆度最低的关键观测交由VLM评估，作为回合奖励。该门控机制避免冗余调用并提升VLM检测精度。针对值得评判回合稀疏的问题，引入基于生成轨迹的探索激励，促使向值得评判轨迹高效探索，从而触发更多VLM奖励并获得更高的RL效率。

Result: 在MetaWorld的大量实验中，VLMeg在12个具有挑战性的无奖励任务上实现了最先进的从零RL，优于先进的VLM基线；在3个具有挑战性的真实世界实验中，VLMeg也能在无任何真值奖励的情况下实现有效RL。

Conclusion: 将VLM定位为成功检测器而非奖励回归器更契合其能力，配合关键观测门控与探索激励，可显著提升从零RL的样本效率与检测精度，并在仿真与真实场景中验证了无奖励RL的可行性与先进性。

Abstract: VLMs provide promising solutions to embodied reward design. Most current methods that train VLMs as reward regressors not only require extensive annotations but are also primarily designed for finetuning pretrained policies, and perform less well in the more challenging from-scratch RL setting. This issue stems from a fundamental mismatch: regressing precise rewards is misaligned with what VLMs naturally excel at. We posit that it is more aligned with VLMs' inherent multi-modal VQA capabilities for the models to function as success detectors, and propose VLM success reward via Exploration-Augmented Key-Observation Gating (VLMeg) to well harness VLM for embodied reward design. As the core of VLMeg, the proposed exploration-augmented key-observation gating first determines whether the current RL episode is judgment-worthy based on its similarity to a generated success trajectory. Then, the key observation with the lowest confusion from the judgment-worthy episode will be selected for VLM evaluation as episodic reward. This gating mechanism not only avoids redundant calls but also enables higher detection accuracy of VLM. Considering the sparsity of judgment-worthy episodes, the advanced exploration incentives based on the generated trajectory are introduced, enabling more efficient exploration toward judgment-worthy trajectories for more VLM reward triggers and thus gaining higher RL efficiency. Extensive experiments in MetaWorld demonstrate VLMeg achieves state-of-the-art from-scratch RL, outperforming advanced VLM-based baselines on 12 challenging reward-free tasks. Furthermore, VLMeg also enables effective RL without any ground-truth reward in 3 challenging real-world experiments. Code will be open after acceptance at https://github.com/Raina915/VLMeg.

</details>


### [176] [Riemannian Graph Tokenizer for Structural Knowledge Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15427)
*Qimin Zhou,Haibo Liu,Yujie Wang,Li Sun,Chuan Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出黎曼图分词器（RGT），通过黎曼几何桥接结构知识与量化表示，以支持跨域结构知识迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型中分词器至关重要，但图分词器仍处早期阶段，面临非欧几里得结构处理和结构语义捕获的挑战。核心问题是如何设计图分词器以实现结构知识迁移。

Method: RGT包含三个关键组件：（1）定义几何词汇表（树、环、序列），捕捉基本结构模式并反映图的内在几何；（2）构建带黎曼直通估计器的黎曼量化器，将多域图结构离散化为token；（3）引入几何对齐解码器，将流形特定的token投影到统一切空间，以保证跨几何空间的一致性与可迁移性。同时提供理论分析与几何解释。

Result: 在多样数据集上的大量实验表明，RGT显著增强了跨图域的结构知识可迁移性。

Conclusion: RGT借助黎曼几何有效实现图结构的分词与跨域知识迁移，理论与实验均验证其有效性。

Abstract: Foundation models are at the forefront of artificial intelligence. A tokenizer, converting the raw input into discrete representations that the model can understand, plays an important role to the success of foundation models. Unlike the text tokenizer that is well studied in large language models, graph tokenizer is still at its early stage, facing the challenges of tackling the non-Euclidean structures and capturing the structural semantics. How to design a graph tokenizer for structural knowledge transfer? To this end, we propose a Riemannian Graph Tokenizer (RGT) that bridges the structural knowledge and quantized representations to support cross-domain structural knowledge transfer. The connection is established by Riemannian geometry. Specifically, we first define the geometric vocabulary (trees, cycles and sequences), which captures fundamental structural patterns and reflects the intrinsic geometry of graph. Second, we construct a Riemannian quantizer with Riemannian Straight-Through Estimator to tokenise graph structures across multiple domains into discrete tokens. To ensure consistency and transferability across diverse geometric spaces, RGT further incorporates a geometry-aligned decoder that projects manifold-specific tokens into a unified tangent space. The theoretical analysis and geometric interpretations are provided to support the effectiveness of our proposed method. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that RGT significantly enhances structural knowledge transferability across graph domains.

</details>


### [177] [Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization for Robust Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15428)
*Chang-Hoon Jeong,Kisung Shin,Hanwool Sul,Byoung-Tak Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PLATO通过训练时主动暴露于支持集外的隐变量来提升离线元强化学习的任务外推泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Context-based离线元强化学习（COMRL）主要靠更好的任务表示，将任务身份与行为策略伪影分离，隐含假设干净表示可迁移到不支持（参数外推）任务。但此类任务上编码器产生的隐变量落在训练支持集之外，策略从未在该区域训练，导致外推泛化缺口。

Method: PLATO假设任务隐变量位于低维流形，且不支持任务离训练质心更远。据此将推断的隐变量沿远离质心方向扰动以合成反事实任务；学习的解码器集成在每个扰动隐变量处展开短轨迹，并在悲观权重下更新策略，对集成分歧的步降权。理论证明扰动以可控幅度离开训练支持集，不支持泛化误差上界与该扰动可达范围同阶，并给出认知分歧保持有界的条件。

Result: 在八个MuJoCo连续控制基准上，PLATO在不支持任务上的回报持续优于强COMRL基线，同时在分布内任务上保持竞争力。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过扰动隐变量合成反事实任务并结合解码器集成悲观更新，可有效弥合COMRL在不支持任务上的外推泛化缺口，理论与实验均验证其有效性。

Abstract: Context-based offline meta-reinforcement learning (COMRL) has advanced almost entirely through better task representations, which separate task identity from artifacts of the behavior policy so that the latent reflects the task alone. The implicit expectation has been that a clean representation will transfer to out-of-support (parameter-extrapolation) tasks. On such a task, however, the encoder produces a latent outside the training support, where the policy has never been trained. We address this gap with Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization (PLATO), which exposes the policy to off-support latents during training. PLATO assumes a mild manifold hypothesis: task latents lie on a low-dimensional manifold, and out-of-support tasks lie farther from the training centroid. It exploits this geometry by perturbing inferred latents outward from the centroid to synthesize counterfactual tasks. A learned decoder ensemble then rolls out short trajectories at each perturbed latent, and the policy is updated on the imagined transitions under a pessimism weight that down-weights steps on which the ensemble disagrees. We prove that the perturbation leaves the training support by a controllable margin and that the out-of-support generalization gap is bounded by the same perturbation reach, and we give explicit conditions, verified empirically, under which the epistemic disagreement at the perturbed latent stays bounded away from zero. On eight MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, PLATO consistently improves out-of-support returns over strong COMRL baselines while remaining competitive on in-distribution tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/deephoony/plato.

</details>


### [178] [World Modeling through Spectral Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15429)
*Holger Molin,William Peng,Marco Bagatella,Randall Balestriero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecWM，一个基于谱表示学习的 JEPA 框架，通过目标相似度核显式指定观测间关系并训练编码器复现该几何，可调控世界模型保留的信息，并显著提升规划性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心问题是如何告诉世界模型应当保留哪些信息。作者从谱表示学习角度切入，希望用显式指定的表示几何来引导潜在世界模型保留对控制有用的信息。

Method: 提出 SpecWM，一种 JEPA 框架。通过目标相似度核显式指定观测间期望关系，训练编码器在嵌入几何中复现这些关系；不同核提供不同监督信号，从物理状态信息到仅需轨迹内观测顺序的自监督时序核。理论分析包括：刻画目标函数的全局最优、给出线性可恢复性与对冗余信息不变性的条件，并在理想化设定下将时序核相似度与行为后继度量相联系。

Result: 核的选择强烈决定可从表示中恢复的物理量。时序谱对齐相比 LeWorldModel 提升了 CEM 规划成功率：OGBench Cube 由 52% 提升至 68%，OGBench Scene 由 49% 提升至 77%，CALVIN 由 29% 提升至 51%。

Conclusion: 显式指定表示几何为引导潜在世界模型为控制保留何种信息提供了一种简单有效的方式。

Abstract: How do we tell a world model what information to preserve? We study this question through the lens of spectral representation learning. We introduce SpecWM, a JEPA framework that explicitly specifies desired relationships between observations through a target similarity kernel and trains the encoder to reproduce those relationships in its embedding geometry. Different kernels provide different supervision, ranging from physical state information to a fully self-supervised temporal kernel requiring only the ordering of observations within trajectories. We characterize the global optima of the objective, establish conditions for linear recoverability and invariance to nuisance information, and connect temporal-kernel similarity to the behavioral successor measure under an idealized setting. Empirically, the choice of kernel strongly controls which physical quantities are recoverable from the representation. More importantly, temporal spectral alignment improves CEM planning success over LeWorldModel from 52% to 68% on OGBench Cube, 49% to 77% on OGBench Scene, and 29% to 51% on CALVIN. These results suggest that explicitly specifying representation geometry provides a simple way to steer what latent world models preserve for control.

</details>


### [179] [Split Conformal Interval Length under Huber Contamination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15458)
*Xiao Zhang,Bowen Zhang,Lie He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究Huber污染下分裂共形预测区间长度的理论刻画，分别在训练与校准阶段推导有限样本上界与极小极大下界，并扩展至CQR等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对分裂共形预测区间长度的分析主要针对干净数据，训练与校准阶段数据污染如何改变区间长度（相对于干净总体oracle）尚缺乏系统研究。

Method: 假设Huber污染模型，推导在污染分布上一致成立的有限样本上界，主项为 L(δ_1+n_1^{-1/2})+(n_2^{-1/2}+δ_2)/((1-δ_2)r_0)；在正则非对称位置子模型上建立匹配上界速率的极小极大下界；对校准污染给出总体区间长度偏差的精确最坏情形刻画；并将上界结果推广至共形分位数回归（CQR）与自适应残差分数。

Result: 得到污染下区间长度的有限样本上界及其匹配的极小极大下界（常数因子内一致），校准污染情形具有精确最坏情形刻画，并在合成与真实数据实验中验证了训练与校准污染的理论结论。

Conclusion: 污染会通过训练比例δ_1与校准比例δ_2（以及校准集规模n_2、残差分位水平r_0）系统性影响分裂共形预测的区间长度，所提界刻画了该影响并具速率最优性，且可扩展至CQR与自适应分数。

Abstract: Existing analyses of interval length in split conformal prediction largely focus on clean data. However, how contamination at the training and calibration stages alters interval length relative to the corresponding clean population oracle remains understudied. In this paper, we consider Huber contamination and derive a finite-sample upper bound that holds uniformly over contaminating distributions, with leading terms scaling as $L(δ_1+n_1^{-1/2}) +(n_2^{-1/2}+δ_2)/((1-δ_2)r_0)$, in addition to a clean-sample estimation term. We further establish a minimax lower bound matching the upper-bound rate up to constant factors on a regular asymmetric location submodel. For calibration contamination, we obtain an exact worst-case characterization of the population interval-length deviation. We also extend the upper-bound results to conformalized quantile regression and adaptive residual scores. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets provide empirical support for our theoretical findings on training and calibration contamination.

</details>


### [180] [Revisited Support Vector Machines: A Unified Joint Optimization Framework with Nyström Approximation for Scalable Adaptive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15498)
*Nassou Gongon Benjamin,Noulapeu Ngaffo,Patrick Njionou Sadjang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"Revisited SVM"统一框架，将SVM训练重构为核超参数与对偶变量的连续联合优化问题，结合Nyström低秩近似与块坐标上升算法，将复杂度降至O(Nm)，在多领域实验中获得最高100倍加速并保持或超越GridSearch精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SVM在大数据时代面临两大瓶颈：训练的三次复杂度O(N^3)，以及静态核函数的刚性。传统方法把核选择视为离散的暴力GridSearch问题，导致数据表示学习与决策边界优化相互解耦，效率低且不灵活。

Method: 提出"Revisited SVM"统一框架，将学习过程重构为连续联合优化问题，推导新的目标函数J(α, θ)，同时优化对偶Lagrange乘子与核超参数。针对该非凸问题，设计混合块坐标上升（BCA）算法并与Nyström低秩近似紧耦合，以降低计算复杂度。

Result: 在生物信息学、金融、网络安全与计算机视觉四个异构领域实验表明：该方法精度匹配甚至常超越穷举GridSearch，训练加速最高达100倍；在NSL-KDD入侵检测数据集上达到96.25%准确率，而标准基线仅50%。结果经严格统计检验验证。

Conclusion: 该工作表明将核选择与SVM优化统一为连续联合优化是可行且高效的，复杂度由O(N^3)降至O(Nm)，并提供了算法收敛性的理论分析，验证了自适应核建模高维非线性流形的能力。

Abstract: The theoretical elegance of Support Vector Machines (SVMs), grounded in statistical learning theory, establishes them as a reference for robust classification. However, in the era of Big Data, classical SVMs face two major bottlenecks: the prohibitive cubic complexity $\mathcal{O}(N^3)$ of training and the rigidity of static kernels. Traditional methodologies treat kernel selection as a discrete, "brute-force" GridSearch problem, effectively decoupling the learning of data representation from the optimization of the decision boundary. This paper proposes a paradigm shift with a so-called "Revisited SVM", a unified framework that recasts the learning process as a continuous %bi-level joint optimization problem. We derive a novel objective function $J(α, θ)$ that allows for the simultaneous optimization of dual Lagrange multipliers and kernel hyper-parameters. To solve this challenging non-convex problem efficiently, we introduce a hybrid Block Coordinate Ascent (BCA) algorithm, tightly integrated with Nyström-based low-rank approximation, which drastically reduces computational complexity to $\mathcal{O}(Nm)$. Extensive experiments conducted across four heterogeneous domains (Bioinformatics, Finance, Cybersecurity, and Computer Vision) demonstrate that our approach not only matches but often exceeds exhaustive GridSearch accuracy, while delivering training speedups of up to 100x. Notably, on the complex NSL-KDD intrusion detection dataset, our adaptive kernel approach achieves 96.25\% accuracy compared to a mere 50\% for standard baselines, proving its unique ability to model complex non-linear manifolds in high-dimensional spaces. We validate our results using rigorous statistical tests and provide a theoretical convergence analysis of the proposed algorithm.

</details>


### [181] [CacheLink: Functional KV Transport for Zero-Prefill Cross-Model Context Handoff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15509)
*Haomiao Qiu,Yining Tang,Zijia Song,Ruizi Han,Ziyue Qiao,Miao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究零预填充的跨模型上下文交接，指出KV重建保真度不能代表接收方效用，提出直接优化接收方行为的耦合K/V校正方法CACHELINK。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存通过复用历史计算提升长上下文服务效率，但模型切换会打断复用，接收方不得不重新预填充上下文。已有仿射传输方法能从发送方缓存重建接收方KV状态，但作者通过分析发现重建保真度是接收方效用的劣质代理：相似的K/V重建误差会导致显著不同的注意力模式、预测分布和下游精度，因为传统重建目标忽略了K和V在接收方注意力中依赖query的功能重要性。

Method: 提出CACHELINK，通过接收方行为直接学习耦合的K/V校正，而非仅最小化重建误差，从而保留传输缓存所诱导的接收方计算。

Result: 在四组独立训练的发送方-接收方配对和七个评估面板上，CACHELINK在每对中均提升了所有方法的等权均值。在匹配诊断中，CACHELINK使K/V平方误差变化小于0.4%，同时显著改变接收方注意力和下一token行为。在32K上下文下，相比接收方重新预填充，交接延迟最多降低7.27倍。

Conclusion: 仅靠重建保真度不足以保证有效的跨模型KV传输，保留传输缓存所诱导的接收方计算对实现高效跨模型KV传输至关重要。

Abstract: KV caches make long-context serving efficient by reusing past computation, but model switching breaks this reuse and forces the receiver to prefill the context again. We study \emph{zero-prefill cross-model context handoff}: translating a sender cache into a receiver-compatible state so that the receiver can continue directly without prefilling same context. Existing affine transport methods show that receiver KV states can be substantially reconstructed from sender caches. However, through extensive analyses, we find that reconstruction fidelity is a poor proxy for receiver utility. Similar K/V reconstruction errors can lead to substantially different attention patterns, predictive distributions, and downstream accuracy, because conventional reconstruction objectives overlook the query-dependent functional importance of K and V in receiver attention. We thus introduce CACHELINK, which learns a coupled K/V correction through the receiver behavior directly. Across four independently trained sender--receiver pairs and seven evaluation panels, CACHELINK improves the equal-weight mean over all methods for every pair. In matched diagnostics, CACHELINK changes K/V squared error by less than 0.4% while substantially changing receiver attention and next-token behavior. At 32K context, it reduces handoff latency by up to $7.27\times$ relative to receiver re-prefill. Our findings verify that reconstruction fidelity alone is insufficient and that preserving the receiver computation induced by the transported cache is important for effective cross-model KV transport.

</details>


### [182] [SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15514)
*Sankar Behera,Dhruv Singh,Satyadev Ahlawat,Yamuna Prasad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SARATHI 解耦结构剪枝中的神经元选择与权重重建：用无数据的 NMF 残差子空间探针打分、自适应 OBS 局部重建、偏置漂移补偿，在 15–40% 稀疏度下实现竞争性困惑度与更优零样本精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝的后训练方法将神经元选择与权重重建耦合在同一校准数据集上，导致领域偏差，并在高稀疏度下出现显存溢出。作者希望解耦这两个阶段，去除对校准数据打分的依赖，并消除全局显存瓶颈。

Method: SARATHI 分为三步：（1）无数据的 NMF 残差子空间探针，基于权重内在几何对神经元打分，与 Robust PCA 有形式化联系；（2）自适应 OBS，使用局部校准批次重建剪枝权重，每层峰值内存为 O(d²)，避免耦合方法的全局显存瓶颈；（3）偏置漂移补偿，修正 post-LayerNorm 架构中的系统性激活漂移，防止高稀疏度下的困惑度崩塌。

Result: 在两类架构族（门控与非门控 FFN）的六个模型上、15–40% 稀疏度范围内，SARATHI 取得有竞争力的困惑度，并在零样本准确率上匹配或超越现有结构化剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 通过解耦神经元选择与权重重建，SARATHI 在无需校准数据打分、显存受控的条件下实现了高质量的结构化剪枝，验证了无数据打分、局部重建与偏置补偿组合的有效性。

Abstract: Structured pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by permanently removing neurons and weight rows, yielding dense, hardware-agnostic speedup. Existing post-training methods couple neuron selection and weight reconstruction through a shared calibration dataset, introducing domain bias and out-of-memory failures at high sparsity. We propose SARATHI, a framework that decouples these two stages. A data-free \emph{NMF Residual Subspace Probe} scores neurons using intrinsic weight geometry, without accessing any calibration data, and carries a formal connection to Robust PCA. \emph{Adaptive OBS} then reconstructs the pruned weights with a localized calibration batch, operating in $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ peak memory per layer and eliminating the global memory bottleneck of coupled methods. A \emph{Bias Shift Compensation} step corrects systematic activation drift in post-LayerNorm architectures that would otherwise cause perplexity collapse at high sparsity. Experiments across six models from two architecture families (gated and non-gated FFN) at 15--40\% sparsity show that SARATHI achieves competitive perplexity and matches or exceeds existing structured pruning baselines on zero-shot accuracy.

</details>


### [183] [OceanFlow: Coherent Flow Matching for Probabilistic Ocean Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15518)
*Yuan Gao,Fan Xu,Hao Wu,Xiaomeng Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OceanFlow，一个用于概率性全球海洋建模的连贯流匹配框架，通过均值锚点与状态条件路径律联合重塑残差分布，并引入因子化动力学算子（FDO），在集合均值精度、概率可靠性和物理一致性上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率性海洋建模对风险感知的海洋作业、气候分析和科学决策至关重要，下游决策依赖未来海洋状态的**条件分布**而非单一确定性轨迹。现有数据驱动海洋模型在确定性全球建模上已日益准确高效，但概率建模仍不成熟：扰动驱动的集合方法在未显式优化成员联合分布的情况下制造离散度，常导致校准差和物理不一致。

Method: OceanFlow 采用连贯流匹配（coherent flow matching）框架。首先为条件集合建立一个锐利且稳定的均值锚点（mean anchor）；随后流匹配学习一个连贯的状态条件路径律（state-conditioned pathwise law），在每次转移中围绕该锚点联合重塑残差分布，在保持预测中心的同时细化状态相关不确定性。此外提出因子化动力学算子（Factorized Dynamics Operator, FDO），将因子化转移与学习到的状态条件响应结合，用以参数化均值锚点与残差流速度。

Result: 大量实验表明，OceanFlow 在集合均值精度、概率可靠性和物理一致性诊断指标上均优于竞争基线。

Conclusion: 连贯流匹配是通向数据驱动概率性海洋建模的一条有效路径。代码已开源。

Abstract: Probabilistic ocean modeling is essential for risk-aware marine operations, climate analysis, and scientific decision-making, where downstream decisions depend on the conditional distribution of future ocean states rather than a single deterministic trajectory. Recent data-driven ocean models have made deterministic global ocean modeling increasingly accurate and efficient, but probabilistic ocean modeling remains underdeveloped. Specifically, perturbation-driven ensembles can create spread without explicitly optimizing the joint distribution of their members, often yielding poor calibration and physical inconsistency. To address these issues, we propose OceanFlow, a coherent flow matching framework for probabilistic global ocean modeling. OceanFlow first establishes a sharp, stable mean anchor for the conditional ensemble. Flow matching then learns a coherent state-conditioned pathwise law that jointly reshapes the residual distribution around this anchor at each transition, preserving the predictive center while refining state-dependent uncertainty. We further introduce a Factorized Dynamics Operator (FDO), which combines factorized transitions with a learned state-conditioned response to parameterize the mean anchor and residual-flow velocity. Extensive experiments show that OceanFlow improves ensemble-mean accuracy, probabilistic reliability, and physical-consistency diagnostics over competitive baselines, supporting coherent flow matching as an effective route toward data-driven probabilistic ocean modeling. Code is available at https://github.com/YuanGao-YG/OceanFlow.

</details>


### [184] [Sensitivity Fidelity Reveals Physical Dependencies Beyond Forecast Accuracy in Deep-Learning Earth-System Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15540)
*Qi Chen,Peng Zhan,Hongxing Cui,Wenqing Cui,Ibrahim Hoteit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"敏感性保真度"作为评估深度学习地球系统预报模型的新准则，除预测误差外，还需考察模型对输入扰动的响应是否符合可信参考或已知物理规律；在Rayleigh-Bénard对流基准与ENSO预测中验证了该准则的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在地球系统预报中日益接近数值模拟，但仅靠预报误差无法判断模型学到的输入-输出依赖关系是否具有物理一致性，因此需要引入额外的评估标准。

Method: 提出"敏感性保真度"准则：在预测误差之外，检验模型对输入扰动的响应是否与可信参考（如伴随模式/adjoin）或已知物理知识一致。在理想化Rayleigh-Bénard对流基准中对比四种代理架构，并将其应用于无伴随参考的ENSO预测。

Result: 四种代理架构虽预测误差均较低，但其编码的敏感性差异显著；与匹配伴随模式的定量比较比预测精度更能区分模型，且预测能力与敏感性保真度并不必然一致；有限扰动实验将其与初始条件不确定性的传播相关联；在ENSO预测中，所学敏感性表现出事件级鲁棒性、有限扰动下的有效性及与已知前兆信号的一致性。

Conclusion: 基于梯度的评估可作为预报误差指标的有力补充，为检验数据驱动的地球系统模型是否学到物理上可信的依赖关系提供了实用测试手段。

Abstract: Deep-learning models increasingly rival numerical simulation in Earth-system forecasting, yet forecast error alone cannot determine whether their learned input-output dependencies are physically consistent. Here we introduce sensitivity fidelity as an additional criterion: alongside prediction error, model responses to input perturbations should be examined against a trusted reference or established physical knowledge. In an idealized Rayleigh-Bénard convection benchmark, four surrogate architectures achieved low forecast errors yet encoded markedly different sensitivities. Quantitative comparison with a matched adjoint distinguished the models far more sharply than forecast accuracy and showed that predictive skill and sensitivity fidelity need not coincide, while finite-perturbation experiments further linked these differences to the propagation of initial-condition uncertainty. We then applied this strategy to El Niño-Southern Oscillation prediction, where no adjoint reference exists and learned sensitivities showed event-wise robustness, validity under finite perturbations, and consistency with established precursors. These results identify gradient-based evaluation as a discriminating complement to forecast-error metrics, providing a practical test of whether data-driven Earth-system models learn physically credible dependencies.

</details>


### [185] [UNISON: A Unified Framework for Learning from Scored Bags](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15564)
*Ofek Kirshenboim,Or Shkuri,Shani Finkelshtein,Yoram Louzoun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UNISON是一个统一框架，将多实例学习与推荐系统视为对"带分数的包集合"的同一学习问题，通过三个阶段（通用物品表示、包特异性偏好、包级推断）实现跨域统一建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统方法将包级分类（多实例学习）与个性化推荐作为两个独立问题处理，缺乏统一视角；作者希望用一个共享框架同时解决这两类任务，并获得更高的计算效率与可解释性。

Method: 将两类问题统一为从(item, score)对的带分数包集合中学习，分解为三阶段：(1)学习通用物品表示；(2)用轻量个性化参数建模包特异性偏好；(3)由学到的偏好推断包级特征。通过一阶分析为线性包特异性打分提供理论依据（泰勒余项由偏好函数曲率控制）。冷启动场景下将冷包拟合问题归约为无岭线性回归，给出闭式解，并为迭代变体提供收敛性保证。

Result: 在娱乐（书籍、电影）、免疫学（基于TCR的分类）和微生物组等多样领域上，UNISON匹配或超越当前最好方法，且计算效率与可解释性更优。受控合成实验表明，即使投影φ无法接触原始打分机制，包特异性参数(w_j, b_j)仍能恢复驱动物品分数的潜在因子（AUC>0.998）。

Conclusion: UNISON表明多实例学习与推荐系统可统一为同一学习范式，兼具理论支撑、跨域有效性、高效性与可解释性，代码已开源。

Abstract: We introduce UNISON, a unified framework that bridges multiple instance learning and recommendation systems by treating both as instances of learning from scored bag collections of (item, score) pairs. Unlike traditional approaches that address bag-level classification and personalized recommendation as separate problems, UNISON decomposes learning into three interconnected stages: (1) learning universal item representations, (2) modeling bag-specific preference patterns through lightweight personalized parameters, and (3) inferring bag-level characteristics from learned preferences. We justify the architectural choice of linear bag-specific scoring through a first-order analysis: when item embeddings are sufficiently smooth in the score, a linear function approximates the score up to a Taylor remainder controlled by the curvature of the underlying preference function. For cold-start scenarios, we show that the cold-bag fitting problem reduces to ridge-less linear regression with a closed-form solution, and provide convergence guarantees for the iterative variant. Empirically, UNISON matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse domains: entertainment (books, movies), immunology (T cell receptor (TCR) based classification), and microbiome, offering superior computational efficiency and interpretability. A controlled synthetic experiment further confirms that the bag-specific parameters ($w_j, b_j$) recover the latent factors that drive item scores even when the projection $φ$ has no access to the original scoring mechanism (AUC > 0.998). UNISON is available at https://github.com/louzounlab/UNISON.

</details>


### [186] [Truncation Samplers Are Nested: Comparing Decoding Rules Is a Measurement Problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15570)
*Rasul Khanbayov,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出几乎所有部署的截断采样规则都保留概率排序词表的前缀，因此任意两条规则在每个解码步都嵌套；嵌套给出闭式每步距离与耦合，从而构造分离证书，可在不额外测量下界定两采样器差异，并揭示精确性脆弱、认证小差异需极高精度；实验证明证书普遍≥0.998，但耦合带来的配对估计可降方差1.2–3.8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 比较两种截断采样器代价极高（一次比较耗六千A100小时），且事先无法预知两者差距。作者希望找到一种无需大量测量即可界定或认证两采样器差异的方法，并重新审视"选择截断采样器"究竟是设计问题还是测量问题。

Method: 作者观察到几乎所有的截断规则都保留概率排序词表的前缀，因而任意两条规则在每一步解码中都是嵌套的。基于嵌套性，推导出每步距离的闭式表达，并构造耦合使两采样器在首次分歧前生成完全相同的文本。将每步距离沿生成过程累加，得到分离证书，其可界定两采样器在任意有界结果上的差异，且可直接从比较日志中计算；当两规则从不互相超越时，该证书恰好等于序列级全变差距离。同时利用耦合构造无偏配对估计器。

Result: 在六个开源模型、四个数学与科学基准上，所有测试的超参数网格的证书均≥0.998，说明单凭界很难判定比较结果；但同族两成员间可非常接近。耦合给出的无偏配对估计器相对prompt级配对降低方差1.2–3.8倍。按默认配对的方差及作者对其prompt间分量的点估计，在GSM8K、MATH-500和GPQA-Diamond上解决一个点差需每prompt 8–32个样本，AIME 2025约需210个；若取该分量的上置信界，GPQA-Diamond需超过32个，而AIME 2025在任何样本数下都无法分辨。

Conclusion: 选择截断采样器在很大程度上是一个测量问题，而不只是设计问题。分离证书虽形式优美、可从日志直接计算，但因精确性脆弱、认证小差异要求极高精度，实际中往往只能提供较松的界；真正有用的是耦合，它提供了降低方差的无偏配对估计，为后续比较实验的样本量规划提供了依据。

Abstract: Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be. We observe that almost every deployed truncation rule keeps a prefix of the probability-sorted vocabulary, so any two such rules are nested at every decoding step. Nesting yields a closed-form per-step distance and a coupling under which both samplers emit identical text until they first disagree. Accumulated over a generation, this gives a separation certificate that bounds the difference between two samplers on any bounded outcome, is computable from logs a comparison already produces, and equals their sequence-level total variation distance exactly when neither rule ever overtakes the other. Two consequences follow without measurement: exactness is fragile, and certifying a small difference requires the two retained masses to agree to very high precision at every step. On six open-weight models over four math and science benchmarks, the certificate for every hyperparameter grid we tested is at least 0.998, so a bound alone rarely settles a comparison, although two members of one family can be far closer. What remains useful is the coupling, which gives an unbiased paired estimator that cuts variance $1.2$-$3.8\times$ against prompt-level pairing. Read against benchmark sizes at the default pair's variance and our point estimate of its between-prompt component, resolving a one-point difference needs 8 to 32 samples per prompt on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond and about 210 on AIME 2025; at that component's upper confidence bound GPQA-Diamond needs more than 32 and AIME 2025 cannot be resolved at any sample count. Choosing a truncation sampler is a measurement problem at least as much as a design one. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/truncation-samplers.

</details>


### [187] [The Gradient That Top-k Distillation Never Computes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15589)
*Rasul Khanbayov,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明top-k蒸馏中的重归一化只消除了尾部质量的可见性而非其可移动性：重归一化目标仅依赖保留token间的log-odds，其沿控制尾部质量方向的梯度恒为零，导致知识蒸馏中尾部质量自由漂移，且保留集在k=d+1前无法确定教师分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署中的蒸馏流水线常采用top-k截断加重新归一化的做法，普遍假设重归一化能够补偿被丢弃的质量。作者质疑该假设，试图从梯度层面揭示截断+重归一化对尾部质量的实际影响，说明它并非安全保障，并量化其对蒸馏效果的真实作用。

Method: 理论分析：证明重归一化目标只依赖保留token之间的log-odds，其沿控制尾部质量方向的梯度精确为零（真实教师上该分量约2-3×10^-15），全词表梯度等于截断梯度加一个由尾部质量加权的残差项。实验：在七个开放权重教师上测试保留集规模k与隐藏维度d的关系；进行有/无交叉熵项的对比，以及与全词表对照的尾部质量漂移实验，并开展off-policy运行评估实际影响。

Result: 重归一化对控制尾部质量的梯度分量近乎为零；无交叉熵项时，top-k学生的尾部质量偏离教师，而全词表对照略向教师靠拢；加入交叉熵后差距缩小约四倍但仍存在。七个开放权重教师上，保留集需达到k=d+1（d为隐藏维度）才能确定教师分布，此后七个教师均精确恢复，而常用缓存大小多低于该阈值。off-policy运行中实际效应真实但小于教师-学生对选择的影响。

Conclusion: 重归一化是一种归一化手段而非安全机制：它隐藏而非消除尾部质量问题。top-k蒸馏忽视了尾部质量的梯度信号，导致学生分布偏离教师；保留集过小会造成教师分布不可辨识。实践影响虽真实，但弱于师生对的选取，提示应重新审视截断+重归一化的默认做法。

Abstract: Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains. Renormalization is assumed to account for the missing mass. We prove that it removes the visibility of tail mass, not the freedom to move it. The renormalized objective depends only on log-odds among the retained tokens, so at each position its gradient along the directions that control tail mass is exactly zero; on a real teacher that component measures $2$-$3\times10^{-15}$ of the gradient. The full-vocabulary gradient equals the truncated gradient plus a residual weighted by the tail masses, and training acts only on the first term. Without the cross-entropy term, a top-k student's tail mass drifts away from the teacher's while a full-vocabulary control moves slightly toward it; with it, the gap shrinks about fourfold but persists. On seven open-weight teachers, the retained set determines the teacher's distribution only from $k=d+1$ ($d$ the hidden dimension): recovery is exact from there on all seven, and commonly cached sizes sit below it. In our off-policy runs the practical effect is real but smaller than the choice of teacher-student pair. Renormalization is a normalization, not a safeguard. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/top-k-distillation.

</details>


### [188] [An Attention-Guided Graph Neural Network Surrogate for Boundary Integral Computation in Physical Field Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15590)
*RongZe Gao,YuWei Wu,XinRan Ji,XingYue Ren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种注意力引导图神经网络(GNN)代理模型，用于在边界信息不完整时恢复缺失边界量，并结合边界元法(BEM)重建内部物理场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际问题可归结为边值问题：边界信息充足时可用线性方程求解，但工程与科学计算中常面临边界信息不完整的“欠定”情形。传统方法难以有效处理缺失边界信息，因此需要一种能够从已知边界量学习非线性映射、恢复缺失边界量并快速重建内部物理场的框架。

Method: 提出GNN-BEM框架：1) 将离散边界上的物理信息提取到隐空间，采用变分自编码器(VAE)架构学习从已知边界量到缺失边界量的非线性映射；2) 引入注意力机制建模不同类型边界信息之间的相关性；3) 利用传统边界元法(BEM)积分公式重建内部物理场。

Result: 以二维Laplace和Poisson方程数值算例进行验证，结果显示GNN-BEM在重建精度、局部细节保持和模型稳定性方面表现良好，表明该框架适合复杂边界条件下的边界信息恢复与内部物理场快速重建。

Conclusion: GNN-BEM为偏微分方程在复杂边界条件下的边界信息恢复与内部物理场快速重建提供了一种可行的计算框架。

Abstract: In practical engineering and scientific computing, a real physical system can be reduced to a boundary value problem, and the adequate boundary information to determine the interior spatial distribution and evolutionary state of the physical field can be solved with linear equations, alternatively, the the real physical problem can be treated with boundary problems with in adequate information problems in field of machine learning. This paper proposes a deep learning framework for the recovery of missing boundary information using an attention-guided graph neural network (GNN) surrogate. The framework extracts features from the physical information on the discretized boundary into a latent space, and the missing boundary quantities are then predicted by the network. Thus, the nonlinear mapping from known boundary quantities to missing boundary quantities is learned using a variational autoencoder (VAE) architecture, while an attention mechanism is incorporated to better model the correlations among different types of boundary information. Furthermore, the interior physical field can be reconstructed using the conventional boundary element method (BEM) integral formulation. The effectiveness of the GNN-BEM framework is evaluated using numerical examples of the two-dimensional Laplace and Poisson equations, which demonstrate good performance in reconstruction accuracy, local detail preservation, and model stability. The results show that GNN-BEM provides a feasible computational framework for boundary information recovery and fast interior physical field reconstruction for partial differential equations under complex boundary conditions.

</details>


### [189] [ProML: Progressive Multi-label Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15614)
*Yi Kou,Jieting Wang,Yuhua Qian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Progressive Multi-Label Learning (ProML)框架，通过引入辅助预测变量将标签拟合与预测器学习解耦，得到闭式解与等价的profiled目标函数，并理论上分析了优化几何性质，在多标签特征选择任务上验证了有效性与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多标签学习通过标签拟合、相关性建模与结构正则化的联合优化构建模型，这种耦合范式将多个学习目标强加于单一预测参数矩阵，迫使其同时拟合观测标签并编码结构先验。该耦合可能导致病态优化几何、增加超参数敏感性并复杂化容量控制，因此需要解耦策略以改善优化与泛化性能。

Method: 提出ProML框架，引入辅助预测变量解耦直接标签拟合与预测器学习。该辅助变量具有闭式解，进而导出等价的profiled目标函数，其中监督拟合项被权衡参数缩放。该方法给出ProML与传统耦合学习的统一视角，后者为其极限情形。进一步将ProML实例化用于多标签特征选择，融合全局-局部标签先验与行稀疏正则化。并对优化几何进行理论分析。

Result: 理论分析表明，在二次半正定结构正则化下，ProML削弱拟合项的主导曲率，扩大稳定学习率范围，并提供可控的保真度-正则化权衡。在12个基准数据集上的大量实验与受控优化分析验证了理论分析，并展示了该方法稳健且具竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: ProML通过解耦标签拟合与预测器学习，有效缓解耦合范式的病态优化几何与超参数敏感性问题，并统一了耦合学习的视角；实例化于多标签特征选择后，方法在理论与实验层面均得到验证，具备稳健且竞争性的表现。

Abstract: Multi-label learning typically pursues model construction through the joint optimization of label fitting, correlation modeling, and structural regularization. While empirically effective, such a coupled paradigm imposes multiple learning objectives on a single predictive parameter matrix, forcing it to simultaneously fit observed labels and encode structural priors. This coupling may induce ill-conditioned optimization geometry, increase hyper-parameter sensitivity, and complicate capacity control. To address the these issues, this paper proposes a Progressive Multi-Label Learning (ProML) framework, which decouples direct label fitting from predictor learning via the introduction of an auxiliary predictive variable. This auxiliary variable admits a closed-form solution, yielding an equivalent profiled objective in which the supervised fitting term is scaled by a trade-off parameter. This result provides a unified view of ProML and conventional coupled learning, with the latter recovered as a limiting case. We theoretically analyze the optimization geometry of ProML and show that, under quadratic positive semidefinite structural regularization, ProML attenuates the dominant curvature of the fitting term, enlarges the stable learning rate range, and provides a controllable fidelity-regularization trade-off. Further, we instantiate the ProML for multi-label feature selection task by integrating global-local label priors and row-sparse regularization. Extensive experiments and controlled optimization analyses on 12 benchmark datasets empirically corroborate the theoretical analysis and demonstrate the robust and competitive performance of the proposed method.

</details>


### [190] [Adaptive Role Assignment and Controlled Feature Reconstruction for Federated Image Semantic Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15623)
*Yuxuan Chen,Jiao Bie,Hang Qi,Jingjin Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ARC-FedSC：一种RAN感知的混合联邦语义通信框架，通过角色Bandit分配与服务器端受控特征重建（FR），在固定通信预算下协调UE角色与FR，实验验证其在时变信道下优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合联邦语义通信中，UE可贡献模型更新或语义特征，但存在角色成本异构，以及模型聚合与特征重建之间相互作用的问题，制约了在实际无线接入网（RAN）中的部署。

Method: 提出ARC-FedSC框架：由RAN Aware Role-Bandit结合UE在不同角色下的历史贡献与当前上行链路状况进行角色分配；由Temporal Consistency Alignment（TCA）依据近期模型聚合方向对特征重建进行调控；整体在固定通信预算下由服务器端控制FR。

Result: 在CIFAR-10与时变RAN信道上的实验表明，ARC-FedSC在后训练阶段于五种角色配置下均优于基线，最优配置最后20轮平均PSNR约24.17 dB；Role-Bandit平均滚动UE覆盖率达85.3%（基线约65.7%）；TCA将有害FR事件概率从0.245降至0.093，降低62.0%；消融与敏感性研究进一步验证设计有效性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ARC-FedSC通过RAN感知的角色分配与时间一致性对齐的受控特征重建，有效缓解异构角色成本与聚合-重建耦合问题，提升混合联邦语义通信在动态RAN环境下的性能与稳定性。

Abstract: Hybrid federated semantic communication enables user equipment (UEs) to contribute model updates or semantic features under a shared training framework. However, heterogeneous role costs and the interaction between model aggregation and feature reconstruction (FR) remain key challenges in practical radio access network (RAN) deployment. To address these issues, we propose ARC-FedSC, a RAN-aware framework that coordinates UE role assignment and server-side controlled FR under a fixed communication budget. Within ARC-FedSC, RAN Aware Role-Bandit learns the historical contribution of UEs in different roles together with current uplink conditions, while Temporal Consistency Alignment (TCA) regulates FR according to recent model aggregation directions. Experiments on CIFAR-10 with time-varying RAN channels show that ARC-FedSC outperforms baselines across all five tested role configurations in the later training stage, with the best configurations achieving about 24.17 dB average PSNR over the last 20 rounds. Component level results further show that Role-Bandit maintains an average rolling UE coverage of 85.3%, compared with about 65.7% for baseline, while TCA reduces the probability of harmful FR events from 0.245 to 0.093, corresponding to a 62.0% reduction. Ablation and sensitivity studies further support the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed design.

</details>


### [191] [The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15629)
*Mukund Athmaram,Manoj Rao,Liang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个考虑“绑定资源”（计算、权重加载或KV缓存访问）的代价模型，用于LLM服务的混合精度配置选择，既可作为延迟预测器，也可作为在延迟或精度预算下的分配器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合精度配置选择需要权衡速度与精度。现有分配器以平均位宽或内存预算作为速度代理，但服务速度实际受计算、权重加载或KV缓存访问中不同瓶颈资源限制，具体取决于阶段、批大小和上下文长度。字节代理无法捕捉这些成本，因此更少位数并不总意味着更快服务。

Method: 构建一个考虑绑定资源的代价模型，并以两种方式使用：一是作为预测器，给定配置和运行点，用针对模型、GPU和服务栈校准的常数估计服务延迟，并在三类硬件上评估准确性；二是作为分配器，将建模时间成本与实测的每张量精度成本结合，用动态规划在延迟或精度预算下选择配置。

Result: 代价模型作为延迟预测器在三类硬件上进行了准确性评估；作为分配器，其所得配置与字节感知分配和仅敏感性分配进行了比较。

Conclusion: 以字节为代理的分配方式无法充分反映计算、权重加载和KV缓存访问等限制，需用考虑绑定资源的代价模型进行混合精度配置选择，从而在延迟或精度预算下获得更优配置。

Abstract: Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy. Allocators that use average bit-width or a memory budget as a speed proxy can miss changes in the resource that limits execution. We argue that served speed can be limited by compute, weight loading, or key-value (KV) cache access, depending on the phase, batch size, and context length. A byte-based proxy does not capture all of these costs, so fewer bits do not always mean faster serving. To address this gap, we build a cost model that accounts for the binding resource and use it in two ways. First, as a predictor: given a configuration and operating point, it estimates serving latency using constants calibrated for the model, GPU, and serving stack. We evaluate its accuracy across three hardware classes. Second, as an allocator: we combine modeled time costs with measured per-tensor accuracy costs and use a dynamic program to select a configuration under a latency or accuracy budget. We compare its configurations against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation.

</details>


### [192] [MERIT: Scaling KG Foundation Models with Relation Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15638)
*Cosimo Gregucci,Daniel Hernandez,Antonio Vergari,Steffen Staab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MERIT是首个基于Transformer关系编码器的知识图谱基础模型，将关系名两两注意力建模、motif以软先验形式引入，在56个基准上匹配SoTA零样本MRR的同时推理速度比TRIX快6倍、比FLOCK快100倍以上，并在复杂查询问答微调中于同等成本下超越UltraQuery。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KGFM（如ULTRA、MOTIF、TRIX、FLOCK）通过扩大关系图规模（更多motif模板边）或增加随机游走序列来提升性能，但更大的关系图意味着更多消息传递、更多游走序列意味着更长编码开销，导致训练与推理成本显著上升，阻碍其应用于复杂查询问答等更复杂推理任务。因此需要逆转"以成本换性能"的趋势。

Method: 提出MERIT，首个采用Transformer关系编码器的KGFM：所有关系名之间进行全注意力交互（every relation name attends to every other），motif不再作为显式边注入，而是作为软先验（soft prior）参与编码。

Result: 在56个基准上，MERIT的零样本MRR与当前SoTA KGFM相当，同时推理速度比TRIX快6倍、比FLOCK快100倍以上；在复杂查询问答任务上以UltraQuery方式微调得到MERITQuery，在同等成本下性能优于UltraQuery。

Conclusion: 以Transformer全注意力关系编码器替代边式消息传递与随机游走集成，并让motif以软先验形式进入，可在不牺牲零样本链接预测性能的前提下大幅降低推理成本，且该高效架构可有效迁移到复杂查询问答等更复杂推理任务。

Abstract: Knowledge graph (KG) foundation models (KGFMs) predict links on unseen graphs zero-shot. KGFMs have been pioneered by ULTRA which builds a relation graph from co-occurrences that match motif templates, and passes messages over it to obtain relation representations. More recent KGFMs such as MOTIF and TRIX increase the size of this relation graph, and FLOCK replaces message-passing with probabilistic random-walk ensembles. However, larger relation graphs mean more messages, and more walks mean more sequences to encode, so they improve performance at higher training and inference cost. This cost hinders their use in more complex reasoning tasks, such as complex query answering. To reverse this trend, we design MERIT, the first KGFM with a transformer relation encoder: every relation name attends to every other, and the motifs enter as a soft prior rather than as edges. Over 56 benchmarks, MERIT matches the zero-shot MRR of SoTA KGFMs while being 6x faster than TRIX and over 100x faster than FLOCK at inference. Fine-tuned for complex query answering like UltraQuery, MERITQuery improves over it at matched cost.

</details>


### [193] [Context-Aware Precision Scheduling for Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15640)
*Mukund Athmaram,Manoj Rao,Liang Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向端侧小语言模型（SLM）的上下文感知混合精度调度方法：通过标定不同精度与上下文长度下的执行耗时模型，结合张量敏感度，在延迟或精度预算下选择各权重张量的精度配置，并在运行时按预先生成的调度表执行、保留会话KV缓存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧SLM需在上下文增长时平衡精度与延迟。混合精度可按张量大小与敏感度分配不同精度，但最优配置依赖运行条件：为短上下文选定的配置在长上下文下可能不再最优。因此需要随上下文自适应地调整精度分配。

Method: 1) 在不同精度与上下文长度下实测并标定时序模型；2) 将时序模型与张量敏感度结合，在延迟预算或精度预算下求解分配方案；3) 主张"位数少不等于执行快"，故用标定的执行代价而非仅权重字节数预估延迟；4) 生成可提前准备的张量精度切换调度表，运行时依表执行并保留会话KV缓存；5) 精度预算路径下，用量化KV缓存的实测误差推断剩余可分配给权重的预算，并据此动态升降权重精度。

Result: 在笔记本GPU上评估了实际执行的调度表，包括含三种权重格式的长上下文调度，以及测量完整响应时间与正确率的工具调用基准；延迟预算下，长上下文读取更大的KV缓存压缩了权重运算时间，分配器倾向选择更低精度。

Conclusion: 实验揭示了上下文感知精度在何种情况下有益、以及在哪些情形下精度恢复仍然受限。

Abstract: Small language models (SLMs) used as on-device agents must balance accuracy and latency as their context grows. Mixed precision helps manage this tradeoff by assigning different precisions to weight tensors according to their size and sensitivity. However, these choices depend on the operating conditions, so a configuration selected for a short context may no longer provide the best tradeoff at a longer one. We calibrate a timing model from measurements at different precisions and context lengths, and combine it with tensor sensitivities to choose configurations under a latency or accuracy budget. We argue that fewer bits do not always mean faster execution, so our predictor estimates latency from calibrated execution costs rather than weight bytes alone. Under a latency budget, reading the larger key-value (KV) cache leaves less time for weight operations, leading the allocator to select lower precisions. This gives a schedule of tensor changes that can be prepared before execution. Our runtime follows the schedule while retaining the session's KV cache. We evaluate executed schedules on a laptop GPU, including a longer-context schedule with three weight formats and a tool-use benchmark measuring full response time and correctness. Under an accuracy budget, measured error from a quantized KV cache determines the budget left for weights. The allocator can raise or lower weight precision as this estimate changes. These experiments show where context-aware precision helps and where accuracy recovery remains limited.

</details>


### [194] [Testing Central Structure for Complex Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15659)
*Qilong Wu,Yuxiao Li,Simeng Zhang,Xinying Liu,Yan Liu,Zengyou He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将"网络是否具有统计可识别的中心结构"作为网络级假设检验问题，以邻接谱半径为统计量，通过零模型生成随机网络估计经验p值，并在模拟基准与55个真实网络上评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统中心性度量即使在观测差异可由普通结构变异解释时仍会对节点进行排序，缺乏对"网络是否真的存在可统计识别的中心结构"这一前置问题的检验。

Method: 将中心结构存在性问题形式化为网络级假设检验；采用邻接谱半径作为检验统计量；在指定零模型下生成随机网络以估计经验p值；使用G(N,M)、Chung-Lu及两种配置模型实现，在模拟基准与55个真实网络上评估，并通过保持网络规模与密度固定的受控实验改变指定中心节点的数量与连边权重。

Result: 中心结构强度与经验p值呈明显负相关；拒绝决策显著依赖零模型所保留的结构性质，不同模型下被判定存在中心结构的网络集合并非简单嵌套关系。

Conclusion: 网络中心结构的存在性应作为显式假设检验问题处理；结论对零模型选择高度敏感，因此报告中心性结果时须说明零模型及其保留的结构约束。

Abstract: Centrality measures rank nodes even when the observed differences can be explained by ordinary structural variation. We therefore study a preceding question: whether a network contains a statistically identifiable central structure at all. We formulate this question as a network-level hypothesis testing issue using the adjacency spectral radius as the test statistic and estimate an empirical p-value from randomized networks generated under a specified null model. The framework is evaluated using G(N,M), Chung-Lu, and two implementations of the configuration model on simulated benchmarks and 55 real networks. Controlled experiments further vary the number and connection weights of designated central nodes while holding network size and density fixed. The results show a clear negative association between central-structure strength and the empirical p-value. They also demonstrate that rejection decisions depend substantially on the structural properties preserved by the null model: the detected network sets are not simply nested across models.

</details>


### [195] [Drift, Then Spread: Learning One-Step Generative Policies for Online Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15662)
*Chunyu Luo,Hongyu Zhao,Guangyi Ni,Yue Song,Lingkai Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DriftSpread，一种基于 Drifting 的单步生成策略，用于在线最大熵强化学习，无需可解策略密度即可引入熵，在 MuJoCo 上取得最佳归一化回报并兼具训练与推理效率优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式策略（扩散、流模型）能表达丰富的动作分布，但迭代采样开销大；同时在线 MaxEnt RL 引入熵通常需要可解的策略密度或分数估计，二者难以兼顾。

Method: 基于 Drifting 的能量视角，从负最大熵目标推导出 critic 引导的 Drift 项与熵诱导的 Spread 项，并在同一 actor 中顺序学习：用动作回归实现价值提升，用分布匹配刻画熵效应。更新过程既不需要从 critic 定义的 Boltzmann 目标直接采样，也无需策略密度或分数估计。

Result: 在固定 critic 且精确拟合条件下，证明小步长极限继而长时间极限下收敛到 Boltzmann 目标；在 MuJoCo 上，DriftSpread 在所有对比方法中取得最高聚合归一化回报，并在训练和推理效率上优于扩散与流基线。

Conclusion: DriftSpread 以单步生成策略实现高效的在线 MaxEnt RL，在理论上保证收敛到 Boltzmann 目标，在实验中兼顾性能与效率，为生成式策略的落地提供了新思路。

Abstract: Generative policies offer expressive action distributions for online reinforcement learning (RL), but many diffusion- and flow-based policies require costly iterative sampling. We propose DriftSpread, a one-step generative policy based on Drifting for online maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) RL. To incorporate entropy without a tractable policy density, we build on an energy-based view of Drifting and derive critic-guided Drift and entropy-induced Spread from the negative MaxEnt objective. Our method learns these updates sequentially in the same actor, using action regression for value improvement and distribution matching to capture the effect of entropy. The actor updates require neither direct samples from the critic-defined Boltzmann target nor policy-density or score estimation. Under exact fitting with a fixed critic, we prove convergence to the Boltzmann target in the small-step limit followed by the long-time limit. On MuJoCo, DriftSpread achieves the highest aggregate normalized return among all evaluated methods, while outperforming the diffusion- and flow-based baselines in both training and inference efficiency.

</details>


### [196] [DRanker: A Transformer-Based Multi-Task Ranking Model for the Disney+ Homepage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15696)
*Priya Nirmal Singh Khokher,Daniel Nemirovsky,Benjamin P. Whitesell,Ethan Sukrae Lee,Eric Wulf,Tom Chee-Duffy,Nicholas Flores*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DRanker——一个基于Transformer的多任务排序模型，用于Disney+首页个性化推荐，并在全球部署中取得关键互动指标超1%、日活提升0.5%的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Disney+首页需要在大规模场景下实现个性化排序，同时需兼顾推荐偏差问题与推理效率，因此需要探索在工业级规模下可行的Transformer排序方案。

Method: 采用encoder-only架构，输入为增强的互动历史序列，结合轻量级因果去偏机制；配套支持大规模Transformer排序的推理栈；通过迭代开发系统对比更复杂方案与更简单设计。

Result: 更简单的设计在离线指标、定性行为评估和生产环境中均持续优于更复杂方案；模型全球部署后，关键互动指标提升超过1%，日活提升0.5%。

Conclusion: 在工业级推荐排序中，简洁架构往往优于复杂替代方案；数据工程、去偏方法和架构选择是构建大规模排序系统的关键实践要素。

Abstract: We present DRanker (Disney+ Ranker), a transformer-based multitask ranking model serving personalized recommendations on the Disney+ homepage. We describe the encoder-only architecture over enriched engagement-history sequences paired with a lightweight causal debiasing mechanism, and the inference stack that enables transformer-based ranking at scale. Through iterative development, we systematically evaluated more complex alternatives and found that simpler designs consistently outperformed them on offline metrics, qualitative behavioral evaluation, and in production. Deployed globally, DRanker drives over 1% lift in our key engagement metric and 0.5% lift in daily active users across all experiences powered by the ranker. We share practical lessons on data engineering, debiasing, and architectural choices that shaped our ranking system at scale.

</details>


### [197] [TabMosaic: Unified In-Context Diffusion for Tabular Generative Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15699)
*Jayoung Kim,Sanghyun Hong,Noseong Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将表格数据的多种生成任务统一为“给定未见表格的观测单元格，建模任意目标单元格集合的联合条件分布”，提出 TabMosaic 统一上下文扩散模型，在 48 个真实表格、20 个基线上取得全部生成任务第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格生成方法要么需要针对具体表格进行训练，要么只能将上下文学习限制在单单元格预测这一狭窄设定下，缺乏一个能够同时覆盖合成、缺失值填补和条件生成的统一框架。

Method: 作者把各类表格生成任务建模为任意目标单元格集合在观测单元格条件下的联合条件分布。采用扩散模型，其去噪目标在所有目标单元格上联合定义，而非逐单元格进行；在预训练分布下，该目标的最优解为目标集合上的后验预测分布。基于此提出 TabMosaic，一个面向未见且可能不完整表格的混合类型单元格生成的统一上下文扩散模型，无需表格特定训练。

Result: 理论分析表明，其预训练目标为任意目标集合的条件负对数似然以及相对后验预测分布的散度提供了上界，从而将上下文学习的贝叶斯解释从单值预测推广到联合多单元格生成。在 48 个真实世界表格上，TabMosaic 在所有评估的生成任务上均优于 20 种基线方法，排名第一。

Conclusion: TabMosaic 以统一的扩散式上下文学习框架整合了表格合成、缺失值填补与条件生成等任务，兼具理论保证与实证优势，证明联合多单元格建模是表格生成任务的有效统一范式。

Abstract: Generative modeling for tabular data has advanced to the point where models can synthesize realistic records, recover missing values, and generate samples conditioned on class labels or observed attributes. Despite recent advances, existing approaches either require table-specific training or restrict in-context learning to single-cell prediction. In this work, we formulate these tabular generative tasks as a single problem: modeling the joint conditional distribution of an arbitrary set of target cells given the observed cells of an unseen table. To this end, we turn to diffusion, whose denoising objective is defined jointly over all target cells rather than one cell at a time. Under the pretraining distribution, this objective is minimized by the posterior predictive distribution over the target set. Building on this, we propose TabMosaic, a unified in-context diffusion model for generating mixed-type target cells in unseen, potentially incomplete tables without table-specific training. We further show that its pretraining objective bounds the conditional negative log-likelihood and the divergence from the posterior predictive for arbitrary target sets, extending the Bayesian account of in-context learning from a single-value prediction to joint multi-cell generation. Across 48 real-world tables, TabMosaic ranks first on all evaluated generative tasks against 20 baseline approaches

</details>


### [198] [RespFocus: Learning Temporal Evidence for Weakly Supervised Respiratory Sound Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15702)
*Yi Tian,Xiaohuan Chen,Yufei tang,Xinyu Lin,Hongliang Li,Chengbin Hou,Degen Huang,Rongshan Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 RespFocus 弱监督框架，用多示例学习从周期级标签中学习可检视的时间声学证据并融入分类，同时发布多中心儿科呼吸音队列 PedResp2026。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 呼吸听诊成本低但瞬态湿啰音与持续性哮鸣音在嘈杂临床录音中难以识别；传统深度学习分类器是黑箱，无法揭示支撑预测的时间声学证据。

Method: RespFocus：基于多示例学习（MIL）的弱监督框架，从周期级标签中学习可检视的时间证据，并将其整合进分类；同时构建 PedResp2026 多中心儿科呼吸音队列，在常规临床环境下采集并进行周期级标注裁定。

Result: 分类实验中，RespFocus 在公开 ICBHI 2017 上四分类得分为 69.55%，在 PedResp2026 上为 72.91%；证据诊断与匹配的时间干预实验支持所学证据对模型预测的功能性贡献。

Conclusion: 结果表明 RespFocus 有潜力成为自动化呼吸音诊断工具。

Abstract: Respiratory auscultation provides a low-cost means of assessing pulmonary function, yet transient crackles and sustained wheezes can be difficult to recognize in noisy clinical recordings. Conventional deep learning classifiers often operate as black boxes, offering limited insight into the temporal acoustic evidence supporting their predictions. We present RespFocus, a weakly supervised framework that uses multiple instance learning (MIL) to learn inspectable temporal evidence from cycle-level labels and integrate it into classification. We also introduce PedResp2026, a multicenter pediatric respiratory sound cohort collected in routine clinical environments with adjudicated cycle-level annotations. In classification experiments, RespFocus achieves four-class Scores of 69.55\% on public ICBHI 2017 and 72.91\% on PedResp2026. Evidence diagnostics and matched temporal interventions support the functional contribution of the learned evidence to model predictions. Together, these findings highlight RespFocus's potential as a tool for automated respiratory sound diagnosis.

</details>


### [199] [Generalizable Model Editing Could Be More Than Direct Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15707)
*Xiaotian Ye,Chunyao Yang,Xiaohan Wang,Junkai Chen,Yongqi Duan,Mengqi Zhang,Shu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出模型编辑领域长期追求的"直接泛化"（把LLM视为输入-输出映射来评估）在理论上存在可识别性问题、实践中受偏置模糊与优化动力学干扰；而在真实聊天机器人与用户的交互场景中，经典编辑方法反而表现出流畅的泛化。作者因此提出以"组合泛化"作为理论有据、实证可验证的替代范式，并在多种模型与编辑方法上验证其普遍性，呼吁领域转向更可泛化、可部署的知识更新技术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型编辑的核心目标是泛化到复杂任务，但既有工作将其形式化为"直接泛化"范式，即把LLM行为视为输入-输出映射，期望事实更新能改变推理任务上的输出。尽管投入大量实证努力，领域共识仍是这种泛化极难实现。作者在真实聊天机器人-用户部署场景中发现，即便是经典编辑方法也展现出显著流畅的泛化能力，这一反差促使他们重新审视泛化的障碍与主流范式的局限。

Method: 作者首先对"直接泛化"进行理论分析，指出其根本受限于可识别性（identifiability）问题；随后剖析现有试图规避该问题的做法，发现其受制于所构造偏置的模糊性，以及易被优化动力学等其他因素覆盖的脆弱性。在此基础上，作者提出"组合泛化"作为替代范式，依托现代LLM日益增强的推理与组合能力，并在多种模型和多种编辑方法上进行验证，检验该泛化行为是否普遍存在。
