Result: 在真实聊天机器人-用户交互场景中，即使是经典编辑方法也表现出显著流畅的泛化行为。通过对多种模型与编辑方法的验证，作者发现这种泛化行为具有普遍性。同时，理论上直接泛化存在可识别性缺陷，实践中规避手段又受偏置模糊与优化动力学覆盖的影响。

Conclusion: 作者认为可泛化的模型编辑不应局限于直接泛化，组合泛化是理论上更扎实、实证上更有效的方向。他们呼吁领域进行范式转变，走向更具泛化性与实际可部署性的知识更新技术。

Abstract: A central desideratum in model editing is generalization to complex tasks, which prior work formalizes under a direct generalization paradigm: treating and evaluating LLM behavior as an input-output mapping and expecting a factual update to alter outputs on reasoning tasks. Yet despite substantial empirical effort, the field consensus remains that such generalization is highly challenging and elusive. However, when we deploy the latest models in an in-the-wild chatbot-user setting, we surprisingly find that even classical editing methods exhibit remarkably fluent generalization behavior. This motivates us to revisit the obstacles to generalization and the limitations of the prevailing paradigm. We find that direct generalization is fundamentally constrained both theoretically and practically: theoretically, it suffers from an identifiability issue; and practically, existing approaches attempting to circumvent this are further hindered by the ambiguity of their constructed biases and by vulnerability to being overridden by other factors such as optimization dynamics. We instead identify compositional generalization, empowered by the increasingly strong reasoning and composition abilities of modern LLMs, as a theoretically grounded and empirically validated alternative. We validate this phenomenon across multiple models and editing methods, showing that such generalization behavior is widespread. Overall, we argue that generalizable model editing could be more than direct generalization, and call for a paradigm shift toward more generalizable and practically deployable knowledge update techniques.

</details>


### [200] [Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15709)
*Haotian Li,Liran Dong,Kaicheng Xiao,Guoliang Xing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对线性注意力与循环模型的状态低比特量化问题，指出循环状态在每次更新后重新量化会导致误差跨步累积且高度相干，仅降低单步误差不足；提出免训练的Low-Rank Bypass（LRB）与Bounded Directional Rounding（BDR），分别处理舍入前的微小更新和舍入时的方向反转，在多个模型上显著优于INT4，并降低状态内存与加速解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性注意力和循环模型将历史token压缩为固定大小的状态，并在每步更新。高精度存储这些状态在大批量下带来显著的内存与带宽开销，因此需要低比特状态量化。但与权重、KV缓存不同，循环状态在每次更新后都要重新量化，量化误差会跨步累积。作者分析发现这些误差在步与步之间高度相干，因此仅减少单步误差并不充分，需要针对误差累积机制进行处理。

Method: 作者从误差相干性来源出发，指出其主要源于舍入时丢失的小更新，并在舍入前和舍入时两个环节进行干预。舍入前：提出Low-Rank Bypass（LRB），将小更新累积在紧凑的低秩缓冲区中，并周期性将其中足够大的元素合并到状态中。舍入时：观察到状态元素甚至可能朝着与更新相反的方向移动，这种反转尤其有害；因此提出Bounded Directional Rounding（BDR），在不增加额外存储的情况下，将发生反转的元素朝其更新方向舍入。BDR虽然增大了单步舍入误差，但提升了模型表现，说明单步中更新方向比舍入误差大小更重要。

Result: 在Gated DeltaNet、GLA、Mamba2和RetNet上，该免训练方法显著优于INT4，同时相对于FP32状态，状态内存最多降低5.3倍，解码速度最多提升1.9倍。

Conclusion: 循环状态的低比特量化需要关注跨步误差的相干性，而非仅优化单步舍入误差。通过在舍入前用低秩缓冲保留小更新、在舍入时按更新方向约束反转元素，可以在免训练条件下有效缓解误差累积，在多种线性注意力与循环模型上实现内存节省与解码加速，并优于INT4基线。

Abstract: Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. To preserve these updates, we intervene both before and at rounding. Before rounding, we propose Low-Rank Bypass (LRB), which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. At rounding, we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update, and such reversals prove particularly harmful. Therefore, we propose Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR), which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. Although BDR enlarges the rounding error, it improves the model, suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. Across Gated DeltaNet, GLA, Mamba2, and RetNet, our training-free method substantially outperforms INT4, while reducing state memory by up to 5.3$\times$ and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9$\times$ relative to FP32 states.

</details>


### [201] [What DNA Foundation Models Learn Beyond Sequence Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15711)
*Vincenzo Yuto Civale,Andrew David Bagdanov,Alberto Magi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了五个DNA基础模型的冻结表征相对于k-mer频率基线在57个基因组分类数据集和两个基因表达回归任务上的增量预测价值，发现简单k-mer特征与多数模型相当，仅NTv3表现出一致优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因组基础模型声称能提供超越简单序列组成的预测信息，但缺乏系统验证其表征是否真正带来超越k-mer频率等组成性特征的增量预测效用。

Method: 在57个基因组分类数据集和两个探索性基因表达回归任务上，将五个DNA基础模型的冻结表征与归一化k-mer频率对比；采用全局固定及多尺度k-mer基线及不同下游探针检验排序稳健性；用匹配的随机森林协议比较全局6-mer特征及其与各模型嵌入拼接的效果；将嵌入分解为可由6-mer频率线性预测的成分与岭回归残差；并进行保持6-mer的精确打乱实验以探测序列顺序敏感性。

Result: 简单k-mer特征与多数模型竞争力相当，NTv3表现出一致优势；在拼接比较中，NTv3在57个数据集中有46个提升（平均ΔMCC=+0.072），Caduceus增益较小，其余模型未提升平均MCC；线性可恢复性不能可靠指示下游效用；6-mer保持打乱揭示任务相关的序列顺序敏感性，以NTv3最为显著，但仅有序敏感并不保证预测提升。

Conclusion: 组成性特征应作为评估基因组基础模型表征增值的必要控制基线；线性可恢复性与序列顺序敏感性可作为互补诊断指标，用于评估冻结基因组表征的附加价值，但不涉及微调能力的结论。

Abstract: Do genomic foundation models (FMs) provide predictive information beyond simple sequence composition? We evaluate frozen representations from five DNA FMs against normalized k-mer frequencies across 57 genomic classification datasets and two exploratory gene-expression regression tasks. Simple k-mer features remain competitive with most models, whereas NTv3 shows a consistent advantage; the ranking is robust to globally fixed and multi-scale k-mer baselines and alternative downstream probes. To test incremental predictive utility directly, we compare global 6-mer features with their concatenation with each FM embedding under a matched Random Forest protocol. NTv3 improves 46 of 57 datasets (mean $Δ$MCC = +0.072), while Caduceus provides smaller gains and the other models do not improve mean MCC. We separately decompose embeddings into a component linearly predictable from 6-mer frequencies and a ridge residual, finding that linear recoverability does not reliably indicate downstream utility. Exact 6-mer-preserving shuffles further reveal task-relevant sequence-order sensitivity, most pronounced for NTv3, although order sensitivity alone does not guarantee predictive improvements. Our results establish compositional features as essential controls and offer complementary diagnostics for evaluating the added value of frozen genomic representations, without making claims about fine-tuning capacity.

</details>


### [202] [Uncovering the Generative Landscape of Diffusion Models: A Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15724)
*Hannah Janmohamed,Joao Correia,Penousal Machado,Antoine Cully*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将质量-多样性（QD）优化与扩散模型结合，提出QD Diffusion框架及基于雅可比主奇异向量的h-space谱变异算子，在文本到图像生成上显著提升质量与多样性平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准扩散采样偏向高似然区域，导致输出多样性受限；许多领域需要的不是单一高似然样本，而是多样化且高性能的解组合，因此需要挖掘模型完整表达范围的方法。

Method: 提出Quality-Diversity Diffusion，将QD适配到扩散模型，直接优化模型的潜在噪声与条件嵌入，并利用嵌入模型量化多样性；进一步提出h-space Spectral Mutation算子，通过分析模型输入到激活的雅可比矩阵的主奇异向量，引导搜索沿语义敏感度最大的方向进行。

Result: 在文本到图像生成任务上，与12个基线方法对比，Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion始终取得最低FID分数，展现图像质量与多样性的优异平衡。

Conclusion: 将QD优化与扩散模型结合可有效发现多样化高性能输出，谱引导变异进一步提升了搜索效率与生成质量，为利用模型完整表达能力提供了新思路。

Abstract: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have emerged as powerful generative priors across domains ranging from molecular design to high-resolution image synthesis. However, standard diffusion sampling is inherently biased toward high-likelihood regions, often limiting the diversity of outputs. In many domains, a single, high-likelihood sample is insufficient. Instead, diverse portfolios of high-performing solutions are required, motivating methods that uncover a model's full expressive range. Here we show that integrating Quality-Diversity (QD) optimisation with diffusion models enables the discovery of diverse, high-performing outputs. We first propose Quality-Diversity Diffusion, a framework that adapts QD to diffusion models by directly optimising the model's latent noise and conditioning embeddings and leveraging embedding models to quantify diversity. Second, we introduce a novel h-space Spectral Mutation operator, which guides search along directions of maximal semantic sensitivity by analysing principal singular vectors of the model's input-to-activation Jacobian. We evaluate our combined approach, Spectral-Guided Quality-Diversity Diffusion, on text-to-image generation. Against 12 baselines, our method consistently achieves the lowest FID score, demonstrating an excellent balance of image quality and diversity.

</details>


### [203] [A Dependency-Aware Multi-GPU Training Framework for Temporal Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15730)
*Yang Zhao,Yue Dai,Liang Qiao,Buxin Tu,Bo Liu,Sen Zhang,Yi Zhang,Xiaoyu Hao,Jun Shi,Junshi Chen,Hong An*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DepBloom通过放宽TGNN中事件依赖的严格同步，利用时空局部性、批内短期依赖恢复及关键路径优化三项技术，实现多GPU训练平均2.84倍、最高5.16倍加速，同时保持模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序图神经网络(TGNN)以节点状态向量(记忆)记录图事件并用于预测，这种以记忆为中心的设计导致后续事件的预测依赖早期事件的内存更新，使得多GPU训练困难。现有方案为保模型质量严格保留全部事件依赖，限制并行性并造成昂贵的跨GPU内存同步开销。

Method: 作者观察到：依赖在时间与图拓扑上具有高局部性；大批量内遗漏的短程依赖可低成本恢复；许多内存更新并非立即需要。据此提出DepBloom三项技术：(1)时间有界空间划分，减少不必要的跨GPU同步并提升并行度；(2)批内记忆精化，在扩大批中恢复遗漏的短程时序依赖；(3)关键路径优化，在多GPU流水线执行中优先处理紧急内存更新并推迟非关键工作。

Result: 在多种代表性模型和多样化数据集上的实验表明，DepBloom相对最先进方法平均加速2.84倍，最高可达5.16倍，同时保持相当或更优的模型精度。

Conclusion: TGNN训练中的事件依赖并非必须严格串行保留，灵活处理这些依赖可在不损害训练质量的前提下显著提升多GPU训练的并行效率与速度。

Abstract: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) achieve superior performance in many dynamic graph learning tasks. These models use node state vectors (i.e., memories) to capture and record graph changes (i.e., events), and then exploit these memories to assist prediction. However, this memory-centric design makes multi-GPU training challenging because predictions for later events often depend on memory updates from earlier events. To maintain model quality, existing multi-GPU TGNN training schemes strictly preserve all event dependencies, which limits parallelism and causes expensive cross-GPU memory synchronization. In this work, we observe that many of these dependencies can be handled more flexibly without harming training quality. Specifically, (a) dependencies in TGNN training have high locality in both time and graph topology, (b) the short-range dependencies missed within a large batch can often be recovered cheaply, and (c) many memory updates are not immediately needed. Based on these observations, we propose DepBloom to accelerate multi-GPU TGNN training with three techniques: (1) temporally bounded spatial partitioning to reduce unnecessary cross-GPU synchronization and improve parallelism; (2) intra-batch memory refinement to recover missing short-range temporal dependencies inside enlarged batches; and (3) critical-path optimization to prioritize urgent memory updates while deferring non-critical work during multi-GPU pipeline execution. Experimental results across representative models and diverse datasets show that DepBloom achieves an average speedup of 2.84$\times$ and up to 5.16$\times$ over state-of-the-art methods, while maintaining comparable or better model accuracy.

</details>


### [204] [Hyperbolic Time Series Forecasting with Learnable Decomposition and Manifold Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15760)
*Sarang Rajendra Patil,Vishal Fenn,Mengjia Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HyperForecast，首个在双曲空间中运行的长时时间序列预测框架，将级联分解得到的频率层级嵌入 Poincaré 球，在 11 个基准中的 9 个上超越现有最优方法，长预测步长下 MSE 最多降低 58%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列本身具有多尺度结构（缓慢趋势、季节性模式、高频残差），而传统预测模型在欧氏空间中建模，无法刻画级联分解在分量之间诱导的次序关系。作者发现级联分解按特征频率为分量排序，形成天然的频率层级，该层级与双曲空间随半径指数级增长的表示容量及嵌套层级特性天然契合。

Method: 提出 HyperForecast：在 Poincaré 球上嵌入分解得到的时间片段，用径向距离编码嵌套层级（低频分量靠近原点、高频分量靠近边界）；通过测地速度建模，给出两种流形动力学变体：(a) 基于 Poincaré 残差动力学的自回归预测，(b) 并行预测所有未来片段的非自回归预测。

Result: 在 11 个长时预测基准中的 9 个上稳定优于现有及当前最优基线，长预测步长下均方误差最多降低 58%；进一步分析表明学到的径向嵌入能够恢复频率层级，且双曲几何对预测性能有显著贡献。

Conclusion: 双曲空间中的频率层级嵌入为多尺度时间序列预测提供了有效的几何归纳偏置，HyperForecast 验证了该思路在长时预测任务上的优越性与可解释性。

Abstract: Multiscale structure is central to time series forecasting: temporal signals contain slowly varying trends, intermediate seasonal patterns, and high-frequency residuals. Traditional forecasters model this multiscale structure in Euclidean space, without representing the ordering it induces among components. We identify that cascaded decomposition orders components by their characteristic frequencies, forming a natural frequency hierarchy. This hierarchy aligns with the exponential volume growth of hyperbolic space, which provides increasing representational capacity with radius and naturally accommodates nested hierarchies. We propose HyperForecast, the first long-term time series forecasting (LTSF) framework operating in hyperbolic space. HyperForecast embeds decomposed temporal segments on the Poincaré ball where radial distance captures this nested structure, from low-frequency components near the origin to high-frequency components near the boundary. We model geodesic velocity through two manifold-dynamics variants: (a) autoregressive forecasting via Poincaré residual dynamics, and (b) non-autoregressive forecasting that predicts all future segments in parallel. HyperForecast consistently outperforms existing and state-of-the-art baselines on 9 of 11 long-term forecasting benchmarks, achieving up to 58% lower mean squared error at long horizons. Further analysis reveals that the learned radial embeddings recover the frequency hierarchy and that hyperbolic geometry contributes substantially to forecasting performance.

</details>


### [205] [Who Sets the Pace of Judge Hacking? Judge Capability versus the Policy-Judge Gap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15778)
*Haosen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在冻结、无参考的LLM评判器上用GRPO训练策略会提高评判器接受率，但12个（策略，评判器）组合的留出贪心准确率均无提升（种子均值增益≤0.04）；评判器被"钻空子"的深度主要由评判器自身质量（AUC）决定，而非策略-评判器差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"用冻结LLM评判器作奖励进行RL训练"是否真能提升策略真实能力，抑或只是让评判器更多接受其答案（即reward hacking/judge hacking），并厘清决定钻空子深度（plateau）与速度（onset）的因素是策略-评判器能力差距，还是评判器本身质量。

Method: 以GRPO在冻结、无参考LLM评判器上训练策略；用留出集贪心准确率做事后分析，并设置同配方的金标奖励对照。训练0.5B与1.5B Qwen2.5策略对抗四个不小于自身的评判器（Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B、Llama-3.2-3B），以及1.5B策略对抗一个更小评判器（Qwen3-0.6B）；用Spearman相关、预设配对对比、盲测留出评判器及哈希锁定step-0预测器进行分析。

Result: 12个单元中种子均值准确率增益均未超过0.04；金标奖励对照使1.5B策略贪心准确率提升+0.054 [0.013, 0.096]，0.5B策略无显著增益。四个上升单元的早期训练rollout准确率上升主要是采样锐化（sample sharpening）。plateau与评判器AUC相关（Spearman −0.69 [−0.94, −0.14]），同族内更大评判器被欺骗更浅。onset方面，两个预设配对的更大差距单元被欺骗快3.5倍，与差距假说矛盾。更小评判器并未更早被欺骗。盲测中哈希锁定的step-0预测器未超过step-0 AUC。7-8B三个族评判器plateau分别为0.37、0.67、0.85。

Conclusion: 评判器接受率上升并不代表真实能力提升，12个单元中未见留出贪心准确率增益。评判器被钻空子的深度与其自身质量（AUC）相关、同族更大评判器被欺骗更浅，而onset的预设配对结果与"策略-评判器差距"解释相矛盾；但受限于12个单元，无法在统计上正式区分评判器AUC与差距对两个端点的影响。

Abstract: When a policy is trained with GRPO against a frozen, reference-free LLM judge, the judge accepts more of its answers, but in a post-hoc analysis we detect no gain in held-out greedy accuracy: in all 12 (policy, judge) cells, the seed-mean gain never exceeded 0.04. A gold-reward control with the same recipe raised the 1.5B policy's greedy accuracy by +0.054 [0.013, 0.096], so for this policy the flat accuracy is specific to the judge reward; for the 0.5B policy, gold reward also gave no detectable gain. In the four rising cells we checked, the early rise in training-rollout accuracy is mostly sampling sharpening, as it is under gold reward. We then ask whether the policy-judge gap or the judge sets how far and how fast RL exploits the judge's false positives. We train 0.5B and 1.5B Qwen2.5 policies against four judges at least as large (Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B, Llama-3.2-3B) and the 1.5B policy against one smaller judge (Qwen3-0.6B). The depth of judge hacking (the plateau) tracks the judge: it correlates with judge AUC (Spearman -0.69 [-0.94, -0.14] over 12 cells), and within a family the larger judge is fooled less deeply. For the pace (onset), two pre-specified pairs contradict the gap account (the larger-gap cell was fooled 3.5x sooner at the pre-specified threshold). With 12 cells we cannot formally separate judge AUC from the gap for either endpoint. The smaller judge was not fooled sooner than a judge as large as the policy, though it also differs in family and template. In a blind test on three held-out judges, a hash-locked step-0 predictor did not beat step-0 AUC, but three cells cannot separate them. At 7-8B, judges from three families plateaued at 0.37, 0.67 and 0.85.

</details>


### [206] [Heterogeneous Structured Pruning Under Resource Constraints for Hardware-Efficient Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15781)
*Cameron Barker,Andreas Paraskeva,Jan N. van Rijn,Elliot J. Crowley,Henry Gouk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HSP：一种硬件感知的免训练剪枝框架，通过异构结构搜索空间与资源约束，为每个子层分配最优稀疏结构与密度，在边缘设备上改善质量-资源前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练剪枝只考虑保留权重总数，忽略目标硬件的存储与计算方式；预先选定稀疏结构并统一应用于所有投影，未权衡各结构在不同子层上的剪枝误差、延迟与内存差异。

Method: HSP包含两部分：(i) 异构搜索空间，涵盖dense、unstructured、2:4、block-sparse、head/channel (H/C) 剪枝选项；(ii) 基于延迟与内存模型的结构正则化约束；采用全局求解器在资源预算下为每个子层选择一种选项，以最小化代理剪枝损失，从而为每个投影分配结构与密度。

Result: 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super边缘设备上，对OPT与LLaMA模型进行评估，HSP相较免训练基线改善了质量-资源前沿。

Conclusion: HSP将现有基于重要性的方法一般化，实现硬件感知的异构结构化剪枝；项目页面与代码链接维护于 cameronbarker.me/publications/hsp。

Abstract: Training-free pruning removes weights from pretrained large language models to reduce their deployment cost. However, existing approaches typically consider only the total number of retained weights. Consequently, their pruning decisions do not account for how target hardware stores and processes those weights. These methods select a sparsity structure in advance and apply it uniformly to all projections, rather than accounting for how each structure trades pruning error against latency and memory across sublayers. We propose Heterogeneous Structured Pruning (HSP), a hardware-aware pruning framework that combines two components: (i) a heterogeneous search space of dense, unstructured, 2:4, block-sparse, and head / channel (H/C) pruning options and (ii) structure-regularising constraints based on latency and memory models. Our contribution generalises existing importance-based methods: a global solver selects one option per sublayer to minimise proxy pruning loss under a resource budget, thereby assigning each projection a structure and density. We evaluate HSP on OPT and LLaMA models for an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super edge device, where it improves the quality-resource frontiers over training-free baselines.
  A project page and updated links for the related code is maintained at: cameronbarker.me/publications/hsp.

</details>


### [207] [ML-CLAPPS: A Probabilistic Framework for Imbalanced Multilabel Learning under Class Prioritization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15816)
*Priel Hazan,Nir Almog,Noam Keidar,Yael Yaniv,Assaf Schuster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ML-CLAPPS，一种可学习采样器，通过优化训练实例分布来控制模型对不同类别的暴露，从而在多标签类不平衡场景下实现类别优先级排序，并在真实ECG多标签图像数据集上取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界数据集常存在严重类别不平衡，多标签场景因复杂的标签共现问题比二分类/多分类更具挑战；临床上（如ECG分类）还需优先识别高风险疾病，以降低漏诊（假阴性）带来的高代价，因此需要兼顾不平衡处理与重要疾病优先级控制的方法。

Method: 提出多标签类别优先概率采样器（ML-CLAPPS），一种可学习采样器：它优化训练实例上的分布，以控制模型对不同类别的暴露程度，从而应对多标签不平衡；同时引入用户定义的重要性向量（IV），通过该向量实现对重要类别的优先排序。

Result: 在真实世界多标签ECG图像数据集上，ML-CLAPPS达到当前最优性能；其类别暴露与指定IV对齐，提高某类别重要性可相应提升该类的分类性能，实现对临床关键疾病的显式优先级控制。

Conclusion: ML-CLAPPS将多标签不平衡处理与类别优先级排序统一为可学习采样框架，有效支持临床场景中高风险疾病的优先识别，为多标签类别不平衡问题提供了可行且高效的新方案。

Abstract: Real-world datasets often exhibit severe class imbalance, degrading the performance of deep learning models, particularly on rare classes. While imbalance is well studied in binary and multiclass settings, it is substantially more challenging in multilabel problems due to complex label co-occurrence. In clinical applications such as ECG classification, this challenge is coupled with a second critical challenge: the need to prioritize high-risk conditions, regardless of their prevalence, to mitigate the high cost of false negatives. We introduce the Multilabel Class-Prioritized Probabilistic Sampler (ML-CLAPPS), a learnable sampler that optimizes a distribution over training instances to control the model's exposure to different classes. This approach addresses multilabel imbalance while enabling prioritization of significant conditions via a user-defined importance vector (IV). Empirical evaluation on a real-world multilabel ECG image dataset demonstrates that ML-CLAPPS achieves state-of-the-art performance. We show that it aligns class exposure with the specified IV, and that increasing a class's importance leads to corresponding improvements in its classification performance, enabling explicit prioritization of clinically critical conditions.

</details>


### [208] [Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Anomaly Detection in Real-World Cloud Telemetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15818)
*Sumit Dhyani,Sougata Mukherjea*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对IBM Cloud Console真实数据进行深度学习异常检测基准评测，发现TimesNet因早期检测灵敏度高而NAB得分最优，Transformer早期检测强但误报率高，改进的GRU自编码器以更稳定的误报表现取得竞争性效果，说明云异常以短时偏差为主而非周期性结构，需重视时序感知评估与鲁棒后处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代云平台从成千上万个微服务中产生高维、含噪遥测数据，其异常具有短时、不规则、基本非周期性的特点，与经典异常检测基准差异显著，导致及时检测困难；同时缺乏面向真实云场景的、时序感知的深度学习模型评测。

Method: 构建基于真实IBM Cloud Console数据集的实证基准，在Numenta Anomaly Benchmark（NAB，一种兼顾早期检测与误报的时序感知指标）下评测GRU、Transformer、TimesNet、Autoformer等深度学习架构；并提出融合鲁棒打分与持续性规则的改进GRU自编码器。

Result: TimesNet凭借强早期检测灵敏度获得最高NAB得分；Transformer也能较早检出异常但误报率偏高；改进的GRU自编码器在误报曲线更稳定的情况下取得竞争性表现；各模型间性能差异不大。

Conclusion: 真实云异常主要由短时偏差而非持续周期性结构主导，模型间有限的性能差距印证了这一点；因此时序感知评估与鲁棒后处理对云异常检测至关重要。

Abstract: Modern cloud platforms generate high-dimensional, noisy telemetry from thousands of microservices. Unlike classical anomaly detection benchmarks, cloud anomalies are short-lived, irregular, and largely non-periodic, making timely detection challenging. We present an empirical benchmark of deep learning models for anomaly detection using a real-world IBM Cloud Console dataset. We evaluate GRU, Transformer, TimesNet, and Autoformer architectures using the Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB), a timing-aware metric that accounts for early detection and false alarms. TimesNet achieves the highest NAB scores due to strong early-detection sensitivity. Transformer models also detect anomalies early but incur higher false-positive rates. An improved GRU autoencoder, incorporating robust scoring and persistence rules, achieves competitive performance with a more stable false-alarm profile. Overall, the modest performance differences suggest that real cloud anomalies are dominated by short-term deviations rather than persistent periodic structure, emphasizing the importance of timing-aware evaluation and robust post-processing.

</details>


### [209] [Guarded Block Transfers for Polytope Distance: Linear Convergence with Explicit Constants and Gap-Certified Screening for SVM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15829)
*Mayank Gupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"受保护的块传输"方法，将每次扫描的多个MDM传输聚合为一次精确线搜索，在Minkowski差多面体上证明全局线性收敛，并提供间隙安全的筛选界；在五个LIBSVM基准上精度与基线相当，但速度不及LIBLINEAR/LIBSVM，其优势在于认证证书而非速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硬间隔SVM训练等价于两个凸包之间的距离问题，Triangle Algorithm（TA）能以带认证的对偶间隙求解，但每次只做单个MDM传输导致扫描次数多、效率低。作者希望在不破坏收敛保证的前提下聚合多个传输以减少扫描次数，并利用TA证书实现安全筛选。

Method: 提出受保护的块传输（guarded block transfers）：每次扫描聚合k个Mitchell–Demyanov–Malozemov（MDM）传输为一次精确线搜索，并用与点数n无关的代价与单个最佳传输比较进行保护；当主导传输被容量裁剪时改用away step。在目标为1-强凸的Minkowski差多面体上分析收敛，采用间隙安全筛选（TA证书为Frank–Wolfe间隙除以当前距离）。

Result: 证明全局线性收敛且有显式常数、无需组合swap-step界；每步收缩与k无关，仅drop-count界随k增长。筛除所有零权重点的迭代界为O((k/ρ)log(1/τ))（含几何的对数因子），ρ为速率常数，τ为最优面间隔。在五个LIBSVM基准上：两者均收敛处与基线匹配4–5位有效数字；在稀疏支持硬间隔上与LIBSVM持平、优于BPCG；但全缓存SMO在核L₂间隔上持平或更优，LIBLINEAR对偶求解器在可分L₂间隔上快至4.5×，在稠密支持L₂间隔和近乎接触的核凸包上本研究求解器慢1–3个数量级。

Conclusion: 块传输聚合在理论上是安全的（收敛速率与k无关），且间隙安全筛选有明确的迭代上界；但实证速度优势有限，其核心价值在于提供可认证的间隙，而非计算速度。

Abstract: Hard-margin SVM training is the distance problem between two convex hulls, which the Triangle Algorithm (TA) solves with a certified duality gap. We propose \emph{guarded block transfers}: $k$ Mitchell--Demyanov--Malozemov (MDM) transfers per scan are aggregated into one exact line search, guarded by a comparison with the single best transfer at a cost independent of the number of points $n$, and replaced by an away step when the leading transfer is capacity-clipped. On the Minkowski-difference polytope, where the objective is $1$-strongly convex, we prove global linear convergence with explicit constants and no combinatorial swap-step bounds; the per-step contraction is $k$-independent and only the drop-count bound grows with $k$, so aggregation is provably safe while the saving in scans is measured, not proved. Since the TA certificate is the Frank--Wolfe gap divided by the current distance, gap-safe screening applies, and we bound the iteration after which it has removed every zero-weight point off the optimal faces by $O\!\left(\tfrac{k}ρ\log\tfrac{1}τ\right)$ up to logarithmic factors in the geometry, $ρ$ the rate constant and $τ$ the optimal-face margin. On five LIBSVM benchmarks, with fairer baselines than our submission, the solver matches the baselines to four or five digits wherever both converge, ties LIBSVM on sparse-support hard margins and beats our blended pairwise conditional gradients (BPCG). But our full-cache sequential minimal optimisation (SMO) code ties or beats it on kernel $L_2$ margins, LIBLINEAR's dual solver is up to $4.5\times$ faster on the separable $L_2$ margin, and our solver is one to three orders of magnitude slower than LIBLINEAR's Newton solver on dense-support $L_2$ margins and than LIBSVM on a nearly touching kernel hull. Its edge is the certificate, not speed.

</details>


### [210] [How Shared Representations Become Specialized: Formation, Maintenance, and Latent Susceptibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15830)
*Toru Takahashi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究用极简人工学习器考察共享内部表征下"目标特化"如何形成、维持与改变，并通过一系列干预揭示其形成机制、当下支持与时间依赖的潜在易感性三者可被区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当多个预测共用同一内部表征时，某些目标的信息会比其它目标更易被恢复（即特化/偏置）。作者希望理解这种特化如何形成、持续以及在何种条件下被改变，且强调需要区分"形成原因"、"当前支持"与"潜在易感性"这几个常被混淆的维度。

Method: 采用最小人工学习器，在重构误差等权的情况下训练；通过改变被观测的目标来定向选择偏好目标；对比不同观测与更新条件但匹配特定重构指标的多个学习器；施加短暂的对抗性干预；并针对优化器（Adam的一阶/二阶矩、重置、交换二阶矩）及SGD校准进行受控实验；此外设置三目标对称场景进行扩展验证。

Result: 改变被观测目标能精确选择偏好目标并重定向已特化的学习器；移除当前支持可减弱已形成的偏置，而"状态跟随式更新反馈"可维持它。两个在指定重构指标上匹配的学习器，在相同短暂对抗干预下响应仍不同；重置Adam基本消除十次更新的差异，交换其二阶矩则反转哪条路径更易受影响。进一步干预显示，仅使二阶矩缩放的均值相等可减小但不能消除差异，其坐标方向模式也起作用。使用新初始化Adam或校准SGD时，路径差异出现更晚；而500次共同对抗更新可使选定的分配端点接近。另一个对照在获得过程相同、平均损失权重相等但权重变异与实现序列联合不同的情况下，仍产生响应差异。该选择式形成在三目标对称设定中同样成立。

Conclusion: 这些干预可将特化的"形成"、"当前支持"与"时间依赖的潜在易感性"三者区分开来；特化不仅取决于当前训练支持，还受优化器状态（尤其是二阶矩的均值与坐标模式）及训练历史序列的潜在影响。

Abstract: When several predictions use the same internal representation, information about some targets can remain easier to recover than information about others. We study how this specialization forms, persists, and changes in minimal artificial learners. With reconstruction errors weighted equally during learning, changing which target is observed precisely selects the favored target and redirects an already specialized learner. Removing current support can reduce a formed bias, whereas state-following update feedback can maintain it. We then compare learners formed through different observation and update conditions but matched on specified reconstruction measurements. Both change under the same brief opposing intervention, yet their responses differ. Resetting Adam largely removes the ten-update difference; exchanging its second moment reverses which route is more susceptible. New interventions show that equalizing the mean second-moment scaling reduces but does not remove the difference: its coordinate-wise pattern also matters. With fresh Adam or calibrated SGD, smaller route differences emerge later, whereas 500 common opposing updates bring the selected allocation endpoints close. A further control produces response differences with identical acquisition and equal mean loss weights but jointly different weight variability and realized sequence. Acquisition-selected formation also extends to a symmetric three-target setting. These interventions distinguish specialization's formation, present support, and time-dependent latent susceptibility.

</details>


### [211] [LLM Value Functions for Credit Assignment in Agentic RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15840)
*Kaijie Zhu,Weixiang Yan,Omar Attia,Abbas Kazerouni,Alexander Toshev,Andrew Szot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LVRL，用 LLM 自身预训练知识与上下文学习能力估计 policy-aware 状态价值，实现稀疏奖励长程任务中的步级信用分配，并扩展到专家策略蒸馏（LVOPD），在多个智能体基准上显著优于 GRPO 与 PPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程任务中结果奖励稀疏，动作级信用分配困难；GRPO 等方法将整条轨迹的同一优势分配给所有动作，粒度过粗；critic-based 方法需额外学习价值函数，成本高且不稳定。

Method: LVRL 不微调独立 critic，而是利用 LLM 的预训练知识与上下文学习能力估计 policy-aware 状态价值；将价值模型以 group context 为条件，并用初始与终止状态的已知价值对预测进行校准，从而由估计价值差实现步级信用分配。进一步提出 LVOPD，结合 on-policy distillation，将教师监督集中于估计价值下降的动作上。

Result: 在 AppWorld、BabyAI、SWE-bench Verified 上评估，策略规模 4B–32B：LVRL 一致且明显优于 GRPO 与 PPO；AppWorld 与 SWE-bench Verified 上相对 GRPO 绝对提升最高达 13.6 与 8.6 个百分点；BabyAI 上从完全失败提升至 75.0% 成功率；LVOPD 在 AppWorld 上稳定优于标准蒸馏基线；Monte-Carlo 分析表明冻结 critic 能准确识别语义陷阱与恢复行为。

Conclusion: LVRL 能从稀疏终局结果中提取鲁棒且 policy-aware 的步级信用，无需训练额外 value function 即可实现高效 RL；LVOPD 进一步将价值估计用于蒸馏监督。整体为 LLM 智能体长程稀疏奖励学习提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language model (LLM) agents remains challenging in long-horizon tasks with sparse outcome rewards, where assigning credit to individual actions is difficult. Methods such as GRPO assign the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, while critic-based methods require learning an additional value function that can be costly and unstable. We introduce LLM Value Function RL (LVRL), which uses the pretrained knowledge and in-context learning ability of an LLM to estimate policy-aware state values without finetuning a separate critic. LVRL conditions the value model on group context and calibrates its predictions using known values at the initial and terminal states, enabling step-level credit assignment from estimated value differences. We further extend this idea to learning from an expert policy through on-policy distillation (OPD), introducing LLM Value Function OPD (LVOPD), which focuses teacher supervision on actions associated with decreases in estimated value. We evaluate our approach across diverse agentic benchmarks: AppWorld, BabyAI, and SWE-bench Verified. Across policy scales (4B to 32B), LVRL consistently and substantially outperforms both GRPO and PPO. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified, LVRL yields absolute improvements of up to 13.6 and 8.6 percentage points over GRPO. Notably, on tasks requiring extended exploration like BabyAI, LVRL bridges the gap from total failure to 75.0% success. Furthermore, LVOPD yields consistent improvements over standard distillation baselines on AppWorld. Finally, Monte-Carlo analysis confirms that our frozen critic accurately identifies semantic pitfalls and recoveries, proving that LVRL extracts robust, policy-aware step-level credit from sparse terminal outcomes.

</details>


### [212] [What Do Sparse Autoencoder Feature Discovery Scores Identify? From Activations to Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15850)
*Yifeng Guo,Yanran Li,Xiang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征通常基于观测相关性被发现，却常用于干预（如引导、消融）。作者以干预归因（干预对模型输出的一阶效应）为目标量，证明观测证据一般无法识别该归因，并提出基于梯度的精确分解。实验显示探针预测与干预归因存在数十到数百倍量级偏差，而梯度归因能准确预测单隐消融的符号（91–97% vs 17–35%），并选出产生更强消融效应的特征集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SAE特征的发现依赖其激活与行为共变（观测性证据），但实际使用通过干预（steering、ablation）进行。这种"发现方式"与"使用方式"的不一致可能导致选择依据错位：探针预测的变化未必等于干预带来的真实归因效应。论文旨在建立干预归因这一原则化目标，并揭示并量化观测证据与干预归因之间的差距。

Method: 1. 将干预归因定义为特定干预对模型输出的一阶效应（estimand）。2. 对一大类响应函数，理论证明观测性特征发现证据一般不能识别该归因。3. 推导基于梯度的精确分解，刻画线性探针预测与干预归因之间差距的来源。4. 在四个模型-SAE组合上验证：计算探针到归因的幅度比、与小幅引导的一致性；对具有非零效应的单隐消融进行符号预测对比；比较基于归因、相关性、秩检验、探针系数选择的特征集在留出提示上的绝对平均消融效应。

Result: Probe-to-attribution幅度比中位数达数十到数百倍；归因与小幅引导高度一致。单隐消融（非零效应）中，梯度预测与实际符号匹配率91–97%，而探针隐含变化仅17–35%。基于归因选择的特征集在留出提示上的绝对平均消融效应大于基于相关性、秩检验或探针系数选择的集合。

Conclusion: 干预归因是一个原则化、可由梯度估计的目标，适用于选择用于干预的SAE特征。基于相关性的观测式特征发现不能替代干预归因，应转向以归因为导向的特征选择。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are typically discovered from how their activations co-vary with behaviour, yet they are often used through interventions such as steering or ablation. We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes. Attribution-selected sets also produce larger absolute mean ablation effects on held-out prompts than sets selected by correlation, rank tests or probe coefficients. Together, these results establish intervention attribution as a principled, gradient-estimable target for selecting SAE features for intervention.

</details>


### [213] [GuidanceNFT: NFT-Based Reward Fine-Tuning of Guided Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15856)
*Jiayin Liu,Zeyu Michael Li,Bingshuo Qian,Xiang Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 GuidanceNFT，通过在引导样本上在线流匹配估计匹配参考速度，修正 NFT 损失中的回归项，使奖励优化在 CFG 下既能持续提升奖励又保持提示对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiffusionNFT 面向任务奖励微调扩散模型，但优化奖励不保证对完整提示的保真度。CFG 可增强提示对齐，而 NFT 是无 CFG 形式的方法，在其微调速度场上施加 CFG 反而可能降低已优化奖励。因此需要在引导输出分布上优化奖励并保留提示对齐，但直接把标准 NFT 用于引导样本会导致奖励退化或训练崩溃。

Method: 作者将失败归因于 NFT 损失中使用的参考速度与引导样本分布得分不匹配，从而偏置改进方向。提出 GuidanceNFT：在引导样本上通过在线流匹配估计匹配的参考速度，并用其校正 NFT 的两个回归项；在参考精确时，校正后的目标可恢复 NFT 原本的更新。

Result: 在显式与内置引导下，所学习到的校正均能维持奖励提升。在 SD3.5-M 上，GuidanceNFT 在有/无 CFG 时于 GenEval、文本渲染和多奖励目标上均取得比 NFT 更高的优化奖励，并在域外评测指标上获得更好的整体提示对齐。在内置引导模型（Model Guidance、ELF）上，进一步展现出 ImageNet 生成提升、OpenWebText 上更优的困惑度—熵权衡以及 GSM8K 更高准确率。

Conclusion: GuidanceNFT 通过校正 NFT 参考速度以匹配引导分布，解决了奖励优化与提示对齐之间的冲突，在多种引导形式与任务上稳定提升奖励并对齐不退化，验证了该校正机制的有效性与通用性。

Abstract: DiffusionNFT (NFT) fine-tunes diffusion models toward task-specific rewards, but optimizing these rewards does not guarantee fidelity to the full prompt. Although classifier-free guidance (CFG) strengthens prompt alignment, NFT is formulated as a CFG-free method, and applying CFG to the fine-tuned velocity field can reduce the optimized reward. This motivates optimizing rewards over the guided output distribution while seeking to retain its prompt alignment. However, applying standard NFT directly to guided samples can cause reward degradation or training collapse. We trace this failure to a mismatch between the reference velocity used in the NFT loss and the score of the guided sample distribution, which biases the improvement direction. We propose GuidanceNFT, which estimates the matching reference velocity through online flow matching on guided samples and uses it to correct both regression terms. With an exact reference, the corrected objective recovers NFT's intended update. In our experiments, the learned correction sustains reward improvement under both explicit and built-in guidance. On SD3.5-M, GuidanceNFT achieves higher optimized rewards than NFT with and without CFG across GenEval, text-rendering, and multi-reward objectives, together with better overall prompt alignment as measured by off-domain evaluation metrics. Experiments on models with built-in guidance, including Model Guidance and ELF, further demonstrate improved ImageNet generation, a better perplexity-entropy tradeoff on OpenWebText, and higher accuracy on GSM8K.

</details>


### [214] [A Hybrid Gaussian Process-Extreme Gradient Boosting Machine Learning Framework for Robust Knockdown Factor Prediction and Reliability-Based Design of Thin Spherical Shell Caps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15862)
*Budhaditya De,Rohan Majumder,Devasmit Dutta,Aman Deep Gupta,Sudib Kumar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究利用机器学习回归模型，结合实验数据，提出一种GPR与XGBoost的混合模型以降低球壳盖屈曲折减因子（KDF）的保守性，并建立基于可靠性的设计框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深球壳盖弹性屈曲中，实验临界载荷显著低于线性特征屈曲预测值，通常由初始几何缺陷解释，并用无量纲折减因子（KDF）协调。但NASA SP-8007和Eurocode 3等传统KDF取自大量实验数据的下界，过于保守，需要降低其保守性。

Method: 基于球壳屈曲实验数据训练机器学习回归模型；提出高斯过程回归（GPR）与极端梯度提升（XGBoost）相结合的混合模型，并与人工神经网络（ANN）、支持向量回归（SVR）、随机森林回归（RFR）和基于直方图的梯度提升（HGBoost）对比。各模型输入六个特征，输出为单一KDF；通过敏感性分析确定影响KDF的最关键特征；最后构建依赖预测ML模型的基于可靠性的设计框架。

Result: 所提GPR-XGBoost混合模型相比ANN、SVR、RFR和HGBoost等传统ML算法表现出更优性能；通过敏感性分析识别出对KDF影响最大的特征。

Conclusion: 该研究通过ML回归降低球壳盖KDF的保守性，并以预测模型支持安全一致且较少保守的基于可靠性的设计框架。

Abstract: Elastic buckling remains a critical concern in the design of deep spherical shell caps, given that experiments reveal a significant reduction of critical loads from those predicted by linearized eigen-buckling analysis. This discrepancy has been attributed to initial geometric imperfections and is often reconciled through a dimensionless parameter, namely the knockdown factor (KDF). However, conventional KDFs (NASA SP-8007; Eurocode 3) are highly conservative, as they represent the lower bound of an extensive body of experimental data. This study aims to narrow the conservatism in the KDFs for spherical shell caps through machine learning (ML) regression models trained on experimental data on spherical shell buckling. A hybrid model is proposed by combining Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) with Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and its improved performance is demonstrated over conventional ML algorithms, i.e., the Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Support Vector Regressor (SVR), Random Forest Regressor (RFR), and Histogram-based Gradient Boosting (HGBoost). Each of these models uses six input features and a single output, i.e., the KDF. The most critical feature affecting the KDF is ascertained through a sensitivity analysis. The study concludes with a reliability-based design framework that relies on the predictive ML model to obtain safety-consistent, yet less conservative, KDFs.

</details>


### [215] [Variance-Optimal State Resampling for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15888)
*Yibo Wang,Yuanxin Liu,Zhaoran Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将强化学习（带可验证奖励）中的采样效率问题建模为采样分布优化问题，推导出闭式Neyman分配律，并提出VSR方法改进GRPO。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带可验证奖励的强化学习在无学习信号的状态上浪费了大量rollout预算，需要提升采样效率。

Method: 将问题重构为：在固定rollout预算下，哪个状态分布能最小化策略梯度估计器的方差。求解得到闭式Neyman分配 μ_var(s) ∝ d(s)σ(s)，与GRPO的组相对优势自然关联，并随策略改进自发形成逆向课程，无需外部调度。基于此提出VSR（方差驱动状态重采样），作为GRPO的即插即用修改，使用前缀回放缓冲区和零成本方差代理。

Result: 在数学推理基准和长时程智能体任务（Sokoban、BabyAI）上，VSR在多数基准上优于GRPO和GiGPO，且每次更新生成的token更少。

Conclusion: 通过优化状态采样分布以最小化策略梯度方差，可显著提升rollout预算利用率；VSR以更少token实现更优性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards spends much of its rollout budget on states that yield no learning signal. We recast this as a question about the sampling distribution itself: under a fixed rollout budget, which distribution over states minimizes the variance of the policy-gradient estimator? The answer admits a closed-form Neyman allocation, $μ_{\mathrm{var}}^π(s) \propto d^π(s)\,σ_π(s)$, which connects naturally to GRPO's group-relative advantage and induces an emergent reverse curriculum as the policy improves, with no externally imposed schedule. Building on this principle, we propose VSR (Variance-driven State Resampling), a plug-in modification to GRPO using a prefix replay buffer and a zero-cost variance proxy. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks and long-horizon agentic tasks (Sokoban, BabyAI), VSR outperforms GRPO and GiGPO on most benchmarks with fewer generated tokens per update.

</details>


### [216] [Sample-Optimal Multi-Group Learning with an ERM Oracle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15916)
*Princewill Okoroafor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多组学习中能否仅通过经验风险最小化（ERM）预言机达到最优样本复杂度，并给出达到最优速率的算法与匹配下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多组学习算法存在两难：达到最优样本复杂度的算法需记录每个（组，假设）对，在大规模假设类下不可行；而基于预言机的算法速率更差。因此作者追问：仅通过ERM预言机访问类别时，能否达到最优速率。

Method: 提出一种算法，使用加权ERM预言机（作用于组与假设的对），调用多项式次，样本量为 Õ((d_G+d_H)/ε²)，其中 d_G、d_H 分别为组类和假设类的VC维，ε 约束每个组上按概率加权的超额风险。并针对每个输入至多属于k个组且这些组可列举的特殊情形，仅用假设类的ERM预言机。

Result: 一般情形下样本复杂度为 Õ((d_G+d_H)/ε²)，并证明即使计算无限制，任意学习者的下界为 Ω((d_G+d_H)/ε²)，说明预言机效率不增加额外样本。特殊情形下仅需假设类ERM预言机，agnostic 设定样本量为 Õ((d_H+log k)/ε²)，可实现设定（每组都有在其上正确的假设）为 Õ((d_H+log k)/ε)。

Conclusion: 通过ERM预言机即可在多组学习中达到最优样本复杂度，预言机效率不带来样本代价；在组数受限且可列举的特殊情形下，仅用假设类ERM预言机即可，并给出相应上界。

Abstract: In multi-group learning, a single predictor must perform nearly as well as the best hypothesis in a class on every group in a rich, possibly infinite and overlapping, collection of subpopulations. The known algorithms with the optimal sample complexity keep track of every pair of a group and a hypothesis, which is impossible for the large classes of interest, and the known oracle-based algorithms have a worse rate. We ask whether the optimal rate can be attained by a learner that accesses the classes only through an empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. We give an algorithm that uses $\tilde{O}((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples and polynomially many calls to a weighted ERM oracle over pairs of a group and a hypothesis, where $d_G$ and $d_H$ are the VC dimensions of the group and hypothesis classes and $\varepsilon$ bounds the excess risk on every group, weighted by its probability. We also show a matching lower bound of $Ω((d_G+d_H)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples for every learner even with unlimited computation, so oracle efficiency costs no additional samples. We also consider a natural special case in which every input belongs to at most $k$ groups and these groups can be listed. In this case, an ERM oracle for the hypothesis class alone suffices, with $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon^2)$ samples in the agnostic setting and $\tilde{O}((d_H+\log k)/\varepsilon)$ samples when every group has a hypothesis that is correct on it.

</details>


### [217] [Fast and Accurate: Improving Personalized LLM Performance by Semantic Concentration Inspired Workload Split between RAG and Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15921)
*Xingke Yang,Sicong Li,Lingfeng Yao,Rui Chen,Changqing Luo,Xin Fu,Miao Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PUR 方法，依据用户历史数据的语义集中度在 PEFT 与 RAG 之间划分负载，将语义集中的“核心”信息交给 PEFT 离线微调，将分散信息留给 RAG 在线处理，从而同时提升个性化生成的准确性与降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化 LLM 服务需要兼顾生成质量与推理延迟。现有方案（PEFT、RAG 及 Full PEFT+RAG）忽略了用户历史数据在语义上的异质集中性，未能充分挖掘个人数据对个性化性能的潜力，因此存在质量与效率的改进空间。

Method: PUR（PEFT Union RAG）利用用户个人历史数据的语义集中特征进行工作负载切分：将语义集中的“核心”信息分配给 PEFT 做离线参数化微调，将分散信息保留给 RAG；在线推理时，对 PEFT 覆盖范围内的“核心”查询直接生成回答，仅对零散的“外围”查询调用 RAG。

Result: 实验表明，通过合理划分 PEFT 与 RAG 的工作负载，PUR 在多任务、多用户场景下持续取得最佳生成准确率/质量，同时相较表现最优的基线方法将推理延迟降低 14.4%–46.6%。

Conclusion: 基于语义集中的自适应负载划分可有效协同 PEFT 与 RAG，兼顾个性化 LLM 的生成质量与推理效率，优于现有 PEFT、RAG 及二者简单叠加的方案。

Abstract: With ever increasing personalized large language model (LLM) services, the next question to answer is how to improve the quality of services/users' experiences, which is indicated by personalized LLM generation accuracy/quality and inference latency. Although state-of-the-art designs, e.g., parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or Full PEFT+RAG, can help, they largely ignore the heterogeneous semantic concentrations of users' historical data and cannot fully unleash the potential of personal data for personalized LLM performance enhancement. In this paper, we propose PEFT Union RAG (PUR), a novel ``fast and accurate'' approach that exploits the semantic concentration of users' personal historical data to split workload between PEFT and RAG, aiming to improve personalized LLM performance in terms of better generation accuracy/quality and lower inference latency. Briefly, PUR partitions user's personal historical data and assigns semantic concentrated ``core'' information to PEFT for offline parametric fine-tuning, while retaining dispersed information for RAG. During the online LLM inference, PUR directly generates responses for ``core'' queries covered by the PEFT region and invokes RAG only for sporadic ``peripheral'' queries. Experimental results show that, by appropriately splitting workload between PEFT and RAG, PUR consistently achieves the best generation accuracy/quality for various users across multiple tasks, while reducing inference latency by 14.4%--46.6% compared with the best performed method.

</details>


### [218] [Mesh-Free Convolution: Learned Spectral Attenuation and Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15931)
*Niloufar Zakariaei,Manav Manav,Eldad Haber*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Mesh-Free Convolutions（MFCs），在连续空间定义滤波器、仅在求值时离散化，可跨分辨率复用同一套滤波器，学习平滑的尺度相关滤波并引入方向性项以刻画输运行为。在流体力学与天气预报基准上，基于MFC的模型能实现稳定的长时程自回归滚动、可靠地跨分辨率迁移，并更好地保持长时间统计特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 求解PDE解算子需要模型能表达跨网格与跨尺度的空间结构；在时间相关问题中算子常被自回归使用，预测状态反复作为输入，微小空间误差被反复传播，导致不稳定与漂移，损害长期解的保真度。现有方法依赖网格相关模板或固定频谱截断，难以兼顾稳定性与跨分辨率迁移。

Method: 提出Mesh-Free Convolutions（MFCs）：滤波器定义在连续空间，仅在求值时进行离散化，从而同一组学习到的滤波器可应用于不同分辨率；不采用网格相关的模板（stencil）或固定频谱截断，而是学习平滑的、尺度相关的滤波，并加入方向性项以刻画类输运（transport-like）行为。

Result: 在流体力学与天气预报基准上，基于MFC的模型能够产生稳定的长时程滚动（rollout），可靠地跨分辨率迁移，并更好地保持长时间统计特性。

Conclusion: 连续、无网格的滤波是PDE算子学习的一种有用归纳偏置，尤其在自回归预测场景中具有优势。

Abstract: Learning solution operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) requires models that can represent spatial structure across grids and scales. This becomes especially important in time-dependent problems, where the learned operator is often used autoregressively: each predicted state is fed back as input to predict future states. In this setting, small spatial errors can be repeatedly propagated through the learned dynamics, leading to instability and drift, vitiating long-term solution fidelity.
  We propose Mesh-Free Convolutions (MFCs), filters defined in continuous space and discretized only at evaluation time. This allows the same learned filters to be applied across resolutions. Rather than imposing a grid-dependent stencil or a fixed spectral cutoff, MFCs learn smooth scale-dependent filtering and include directional terms for transport-like behavior.
  Across fluid-dynamics and weather-forecasting benchmarks, MFC-based models produce stable long-horizon rollouts, transfer reliably across resolutions, and better preserve long-time statistics. These results suggest that continuous, mesh-free filtering is a useful inductive bias for PDE operator learning, especially in autoregressive prediction.

</details>


### [219] [DiffNash: Finding Nash Equilibrium in High-Dimensional Continuous Action Spaces with Diffusion Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15932)
*Haichuan Wang,Anagha Satish,Jiale Zheng,Saisneha Ghatti,Lingkai Kong,Kai Wang,Milind Tambe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于扩散模型的均衡求解框架，通过重加权分数匹配目标训练扩散策略，实现OMD与FP的扩散变体；主方法DiffNash结合OMD的快速收敛与FP的样本效率，并利用ELBO差值估计量校正样本重用带来的分布偏移。在森林保护与连续Colonel Blotto博弈上，Nash间隙较最强基线分别降低35.6%与24.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维连续博弈的均衡计算需要学习并表征丰富的多模态策略分布，而传统神经策略难以做到。扩散模型天然适合建模此类分布，但标准扩散训练依赖来自固定目标分布的直接样本，而在迭代式博弈求解更新中，每个更新后的策略分布样本通常无法直接获得。因此需要一种无需从每个更新策略采样的扩散训练方法。

Method: 提出扩散式均衡计算框架，支持Online Mirror Descent（OMD）与Fictitious Play（FP）的扩散变体。核心是推导重加权分数匹配（reweighted score-matching）目标，使得无需来自每个更新策略的直接样本即可训练扩散策略。主方法DiffNash通过经验回放缓冲区复用历史动作，融合OMD的快速收敛性与FP的样本效率。为校正样本重用导致的分布偏移，推导当前与历史策略Evidence Lower Bound（ELBO）之差的无偏估计量，其指数形式作为对应重要性权重的可计算代理，无需评估扩散似然。

Result: 在森林保护博弈与连续Colonel Blotto博弈上进行评估，Nash间隙相较最强基线分别降低35.6%和24.7%，且超参数调优极少。

Conclusion: 该工作表明扩散模型可有效用于高维连续博弈的均衡计算，重加权分数匹配与基于ELBO差值的重加权机制解决了迭代求解中无直接目标样本与样本重用分布偏移的难题，DiffNash在保持低调参成本的同时显著缩小Nash间隙。

Abstract: Computing equilibria in high-dimensional continuous games requires learning and representing rich, multi-modal strategy distributions, something conventional neural policies struggle to achieve. Diffusion models offer a natural solution, but standard diffusion training requires direct samples from a fixed target distribution, which are generally unavailable under iterative game-solving updates. We propose a diffusion-based framework for equilibrium computation that enables diffusion-based variants of Online Mirror Descent (OMD) and Fictitious Play (FP). Our approach derives a reweighted score-matching objective that trains diffusion policies without requiring direct samples from each updated policy. Our main method, DiffNash, combines the fast convergence of OMD with the sample efficiency of FP by reusing past actions through a replay buffer. To correct the resulting distribution shift from sample reuse, we derive an unbiased estimator of the difference between current and past policies' Evidence Lower Bounds, whose exponential provides a tractable proxy for the corresponding importance weight without evaluating diffusion likelihoods. We evaluate our approach on forest protection games and continuous Colonel Blotto games, reducing the Nash gap over the strongest baseline by 35.6% and 24.7%, respectively, with minimal hyperparameter tuning.

</details>


### [220] [Error-Based Bidirectional Predictive Coding Enables Deep, 4-Bit Predictive Coding Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15933)
*Garrett Kinman,Zeljko Zilic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出将双向预测编码(bPC)与基于误差的重新参数化(ePC)结合，并引入误差梯度全局范数裁剪，使预测编码网络在深层(≥8层)、4比特量化下稳定训练，兼顾判别与生成，精度损失极小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码网络(PCNs)具有反向传播所不具备的优势：纯局部信息学习、单一网络兼具判别与生成、通过能量最小化实现灵活推理。但其迭代推理开销大，需要硬件加速，而高效加速器需兼顾深度与激进量化。然而经典基于状态的PC存在两大缺陷：推理信号随深度指数衰减导致深层模型无法训练，低精度会进一步加剧这一问题。

Method: 将两种近期方法结合：(1) 双向PC(bPC)，统一判别与生成；(2) 基于误差的重新参数化(ePC)，在推理时优化预测误差而非状态。误差优化在单次反向传播中把输出信号传递到每一层，消除信号衰减；再引入误差梯度的全局范数裁剪，在深层稳定误差动态。最终形成ePC+bPC模型，并进行W4A4E4量化感知训练，覆盖FP4及三种posit格式。

Result: ePC+bPC可稳定训练至至少八层，在W4A4E4量化感知训练下保持全精度准确率与干净的类条件生成。在六层网络上，基于状态的bPC退化至随机水平，而ePC+bPC在一个epoch后分类准确率高出50个点以上，类条件生成的RMSE好5-9倍。4比特量化几乎无损：全精度与4比特准确率差距最多约5个点，最佳格式下不足2个点。

Conclusion: 论文刻画了方法所克服的两种失效模式：基于状态PC的有界信号衰减，以及无正则化误差优化中的误差发散。该工作将完整PCN属性集扩展到深层4比特场景，为4比特原生PCN加速器提供了依据。

Abstract: Predictive coding networks (PCNs) promise properties not offered by backpropagation-trained networks: learning from purely local information, a single network that both discriminates and generates, and flexible inference by energy minimization. However, their iterative inference is expensive, making hardware acceleration desirable, and a useful, efficient accelerator needs both depth and aggressive quantization. Canonical state-based PC delivers neither: its inference signal decays exponentially with depth, so deep models fail to train, and low precision makes it worse. We show that pairing two recent methods carries the full PCN property set into the deep, 4-bit regime: bidirectional PC (bPC), which unifies discrimination and generation, and the error-based reparameterization (ePC), which optimizes prediction errors rather than states during inference. Error optimization delivers the output signal to every layer in a single backward pass, removing the signal decay; one additional element, global-norm clipping of the error gradients, stabilizes the error dynamics at depth. The resulting ePC+bPC model trains stably up to at least eight layers and retains its full-precision accuracy and clean class-conditional generation under W4A4E4 quantization-aware training, across FP4 and three posit formats. On six-layer networks, where state-based bPC collapses to chance, ePC+bPC classifies more than 50 accuracy points above it after one epoch of training, with class-conditional generations 5-9x better in RMSE. 4-bit quantization is nearly free: full-precision and 4-bit accuracies differ by at most ~5 points, and by under two in the best-performing formats. We characterize the two failure modes the method overcomes, bounded signal decay in state-based PC and error divergence in unregularized error optimization, and discuss implications for a 4-bit-native PCN accelerator.

</details>


### [221] [Instance-Adaptive Online Multiclass Multicalibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15954)
*Zhiming Huang,Jamie Morgenstern,Aaron Roth,Claire Jie Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在线多分类多校准问题，提出一种具备超越最坏情况保证的自适应算法：当对抗序列的期望落在维度为 s 的仿射子空间时，校准误差降至 Õ(n^{1/(s+2)}T^{(s+1)/(s+2)})，且无需预先知道该子空间或其维度，该速率在 T≥n≥2 时是极小极大最优的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线多分类多校准的最坏情况累积 ℓ1 校准误差随维度 d=n-1 呈 Θ̃(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)}) 增长，当类别数稍大时该速率迅速退化、难以实用。因此需要针对实际序列的低维结构设计自适应算法，以突破最坏情况瓶颈。

Method: 将预测建模为 d=n-1 维单纯形上的点，追踪对抗选定的结果期望序列，检测其张成的仿射子空间维度 s，并据此调节校准更新；算法不需预先获知子空间或维度 s，自适应地达到相应速率的累积 ℓ1 多校准误差界。

Result: 当序列的期望位于 s 维仿射子空间时，以高概率获得 Õ(n^{1/(s+2)}T^{(s+1)/(s+2)}) 的误差；在 T≥n≥2 时该速率是极小极大最优的（忽略多对数因子）；对固定条件均值的随机实例，界退化为 Õ(√(nT))，即对时间范围呈平方根依赖。

Conclusion: 该工作通过自适应利用序列的低维几何结构，显著改进了在线多分类多校准的最坏情况误差速率，并在所设条件下达到极小极大最优性，同时涵盖随机情形下的平方根速率。

Abstract: We study online multiclass multicalibration over $T$ rounds, and give an algorithm with beyond-worst-case guarantees. With $n$ possible outcomes, forecasts lie in a simplex of dimension $d=n-1$. In the worst case, cumulative $\ell_1$ multicalibration error scales with $\widetildeΘ(T^{(d+1)/(d+2)})$, which becomes untenable once $d$ exceeds a small constant. Our algorithm adapts to the geometry of the realized sequence: if the sequence of adversarially selected outcome means lies in an affine subspace of dimension $s$, it obtains error $\widetilde O(n^{1/(s+2)}T^{(s+1)/(s+2)})$ with high probability. The algorithm adapts to this structure without knowing the subspace or its dimension. For $T\ge n\ge2$, this rate is minimax optimal up to polylogarithmic factors. For a stochastic instance with a fixed conditional mean, the bound specializes to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$, giving a square-root dependence on the horizon.

</details>


### [222] [Scaling Repeated-Data Pretraining: Batch Size, Regularization, and GPU-Time Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15965)
*Sewon Min*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究在算力充足但唯一训练数据有限、需重复使用同一数据预训练的场景，发现批次大小与训练轮数联合优化呈U型关系，并揭示截止时间与资源分配对训练配方的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型预训练面临唯一训练数据有限而算力充足的现实约束，需要重复训练同一批数据。已有的无限算力预训练研究（Kim et al. 2026）中，若干关键选择此前被固定或孤立研究，且训练配方多基于单次遍历假设优化，未必适用于重复数据场景，因此需要系统考察这些未充分探索的因素。

Method: 先重新审视无限算力预训练，将批次大小与训练轮数联合优化，考察验证损失与批次大小的关系，并检验在单次遍历假设下优化的训练配方（如每轮重新将文档打包成新序列、权重共享、正嵌入权重衰减）。随后放松无限算力假设，将GPU与时间视为两种独立资源，研究截止时间约束下的批次大小选择与延迟导向并行策略。

Result: 批次大小与验证损失呈U型关系，最优批次小于典型预训练所用批次，可能因小批次梯度噪声带来隐式正则化。每轮重新打包文档、权重共享、正嵌入权重衰减等配方可被进一步调优。在时间预算约束下，更紧的截止时间偏向更大批次，延迟导向并行可用更多GPU换取更短训练时间；但即使时间预算固定，较小批次配合较少GPU仍可能比更大批次配合更多GPU取得更低验证损失。

Conclusion: 研究识别出重复数据训练中未被充分探索的因素，表明训练配方与资源分配策略应从单次遍历预训练向重复数据预训练做出相应调整，并为实践提供具体指导。

Abstract: We study pretraining when compute is abundant but unique training data are finite, requiring repeated training on the same data. We first revisit infinite-compute pretraining (Kim et al. 2026) and show that its frontier depends critically on choices previously fixed or studied only in isolation. In particular, optimizing batch size together with epoch counts reveals a U-shaped relationship between validation loss and batch size, favoring smaller batches than typical pretraining, likely because small-batch gradient noise provides implicit regularization. We further find that training recipes, previously optimized under a single-pass assumption, can be tuned, e.g., repacking documents into new sequences every epoch, weight tying, and positive embedding weight decay.
  We then relax the infinite-compute assumption. In particular, smaller-than-typical batch sizes can require prohibitively long sequential training, motivating to treat GPUs and time as separate resources. Tighter deadlines favor larger batches, and latency-oriented parallelism can trade additional GPUs for shorter training. Nevertheless, even under a fixed time budget, a smaller batch with fewer GPUs can achieve lower validation loss than a larger batch with more GPUs, challenging the common practice of increasing data parallelism to maximize GPU utilization under a deadline. Together, our results identify underexplored factors in repeated-data training and provide concrete guidance on how training recipes and resource allocation should change from single-pass pretraining.

</details>


### [223] [Softmax-Free Attention in Spiking Transformers as the Zero-Temperature Limit of Two-Level Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15968)
*Roberto C. Sotero,Pouya Taghipour,Jose M. Sanchez-Bornot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文证明无softmax的脉冲注意力等价于独立二能级系统乘积的零温极限，从而将其定位于热力学相图的冻结有序相，并解释了替代梯度消失导致的优化困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 脉冲Transformer通过舍弃softmax归一化、改用阈值化二值注意力来实现能效提升，但这一舍弃破坏了原本用于分析注意力网络的热力学框架：归一化测度与配分函数不再存在，缺乏理论分析基础。

Method: 作者从理论上建立对应关系，证明无softmax的脉冲注意力恰好是多个独立二能级系统之积的零温极限；据此将脉冲注意力映射到热力学相图中，并分析其熵代价、物理能耗下限（Landauer型）以及替代梯度消失问题，最后用前向松弛实验验证理论。

Result: 脉冲注意力在所有输入下都严格处于冻结有序相；组织注意力所需的熵代价坍缩，转而被由动作电位产生所支配的Landauer型物理能耗下限取代；有序相钉扎从数学上解释了替代梯度消失造成的优化困难。前向松弛实验将标准注意力与神经形态注意力机制置于统一的热力学轴上。

Conclusion: 该工作恢复了脉冲注意力网络的热力学分析基础，揭示了其有序相本质与能耗下限，并为替代梯度消失的优化难题提供了物理解释。

Abstract: Spiking Transformers achieve energy efficiency by discarding softmax normalization in favor of thresholded, binary attention. However, this removal breaks the thermodynamic framework used to analyze attention networks, as the normalized measure and partition function cease to exist. We restore this theoretical foundation by proving that softmax-free spiking attention operates exactly as the zero-temperature limit of a product of independent two-level systems. This correspondence places spiking attention strictly in the frozen ordered phase of the thermodynamic phase diagram for all inputs. Consequently, the entropic cost of organizing attention collapses, replaced by a Landauer-type physical floor governed by action-potential generation. Furthermore, this ordered-phase pinning mathematically explains the optimization difficulty caused by vanishing surrogate gradients. We validate this theory with forward-relaxation experiments, placing both standard and neuromorphic attention mechanisms on a unified thermodynamic axis.

</details>


### [224] [Probabilistic Forecasting of Wildfire Size Using Conditional Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15983)
*Isaac Lee,Bryan Shaddy,Assad Oberai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出基于条件生成算法（流匹配）的概率模型，预测野火面积随时间的演变（时间序列），而非空间分辨的火势蔓延，降低成本并支持预警等下游应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间分辨的火势蔓延预测计算成本高，难以高效集成到预警系统与风险评估等下游应用中，因此需要一种低成本、可量化的野火面积时序预测方法。

Method: 采用条件生成算法中的流匹配（flow matching）构建概率模型。输入包括当前与前一步的火面积估计、空间平均气象条件、地形特征与燃料组成，输出为3小时区间内的火面积变化量。训练数据来自140组WRF-SFIRE耦合大气-野火模拟，并配以NAM（北美中尺度）模型的气象数据。

Result: 敏感性分析表明模型对风速、温度和相对湿度的响应具有物理一致性。相对WRF-SFIRE参考解，单步预测的sMAPE为0.39；对12个留出测试案例进行24小时递归多步预测，最终火面积sMAPE同样为0.39，并能给出有意义的预测不确定性量化。

Conclusion: 流匹配概率模型能够以较低计算成本实现野火面积时序的概率预测，兼具精度与不确定性量化能力，适合集成到预警与风险评估等下游应用。

Abstract: In this work we present a probabilistic model for predicting the temporal evolution of wildfire size using conditional generative algorithms, namely flow matching. Rather than predicting spatially resolved fire progression, the proposed model forecasts a time series of fire acreage, substantially reducing computational cost and enabling efficient integration with downstream applications such as early warning systems and risk assessment tools. Given estimates of the fire size at the current and previous forecasting steps, alongside spatially averaged weather conditions, terrain characteristics, and fuel composition, the model predicts the change in fire area over a 3-hour interval. Training data are drawn from 140 coupled atmosphere-wildfire simulations generated using WRF-SFIRE, paired with weather data from the North American Mesoscale (NAM) model. Sensitivity analysis demonstrates that the model captures physically-consistent responses to variations in wind speed, temperature, and relative humidity. Model performance is evaluated against reference solutions from WRF-SFIRE. For single-step predictions, the model achieves a symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE) of 0.39 relative to the reference WRF-SFIRE solutions. Recursive multi-step predictions over 24 hours are performed for 12 held-out test cases, where the flow matching model achieves a final fire area sMAPE of 0.39 while further providing meaningful quantification of forecast uncertainty.

</details>


### [225] [Dissipative Lagrangian Neural Networks for the Interpretable Modelling of Passive Mechanical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15996)
*Rob Seabourne,Alice Cicirello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出耗散拉格朗日神经网络（dLNN），一种连续时间系统辨识方法，可分别从数据中学习机械系统的保守与耗散动力学，其耗散力参数化在结构上保证耗散性与无源性，并在真实系统预测任务中优于现有拉格朗日架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有拉格朗日神经网络架构难以有效、可控地建模机械系统中的耗散效应（如阻尼与摩擦），往往将耗散项与保守项混淆，缺乏结构性约束（如无源性），也难以在数据有限时保持泛化能力，且学到的模型通常缺乏可解释性。

Method: 提出dLNN，将保守动力学与耗散动力学分开学习。核心是耗散力的新参数化方法，具备三个特性：(i) 结构上约束为耗散，强制所学模型的无源性；(ii) 不能吸收保守力学项；(iii) 保持足够表达能力，可表示广泛的状态相关阻尼与正则化摩擦力。此外引入符号蒸馏程序，从学到的物理分量中提取闭式表达式。

Result: 在两个真实机械系统上验证：混沌双摆的轨迹预测与六自由度工业机器人的逆动力学建模。dLNN预测性能优于现有拉格朗日架构，并与黑箱神经模型相当；所施加的物理结构提升了对未见状态的泛化能力，在训练数据有限时优势尤为明显。符号蒸馏应用于工业机器人，得到可解释符号模型，保持高预测精度的同时降低了神经拉格朗日模型评估的计算开销。

Conclusion: dLNN通过结构化耗散力参数化实现了保守与耗散动力学的解耦学习，兼顾无源性、表达力与泛化性，并借助符号蒸馏获得高精度、低计算开销的可解释模型，为机械系统辨识提供了兼顾物理一致性与实用性的方案。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose the Dissipative Lagrangian Neural Network (dLNN), a continuous-time system identification technique that separately learns the conservative and dissipative dynamics of a mechanical system directly from data. A key contribution is a novel parametrisation of dissipative forces that (i) is structurally constrained to be dissipative, enforcing passivity of the learned model, (ii) cannot absorb conservative mechanics, and (iii) retains sufficient expressivity to represent a broad family of state-dependent damping and regularised friction forces. The model is validated on prediction tasks on two real-world mechanical systems: trajectory prediction of a chaotic double pendulum and inverse-dynamics modelling of a six-degree-of-freedom industrial robot. Across these tasks, the dLNN demonstrates improved predictive performance over existing Lagrangian architectures while remaining competitive with a black-box neural model. The imposed physical structure also improves generalisation to unseen states, with the benefits becoming particularly pronounced when training data is limited. Finally, we introduce a symbolic distillation procedure that extracts closed-form expressions from the learned physical components. Applied to the industrial robot, this produces interpretable symbolic models that retain high predictive accuracy while reducing the computational overhead associated with evaluating neural Lagrangian models.

</details>


### [226] [Representational Difference Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15997)
*Abdulkarim Mugisha,Divin Irakiza*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出表示差异蒸馏（RDD），通过两个非对称亲和矩阵诊断师生表示的结构性错配区域，并将蒸馏信号集中到这些区域，在CIFAR-100上取得与CRD相当、优于KD/RKD的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关系型与对比型蒸馏方法对所有样本一视同仁，在表示空间中匹配良好与匹配较差的区域投入相同梯度，导致蒸馏效率不高，缺乏针对性。

Method: RDD使用两个非对称亲和矩阵刻画两个相反方向的错配：一个识别学生错误地认为相似的样本，另一个识别教师已具备但学生尚未学到的关系。这些亲和度决定蒸馏损失对齐哪些样本对，以及每个错配样本被纠正的强度。作者还探索了基于课程与基于采样的变体。

Result: 在CIFAR-100上，以resnet32x4到resnet8x4设置，RDD测试精度75.58%，与CRD（75.45%）相当，并高于KD与RKD。课程/采样变体实验表明，对损失加权比过滤数据更有效。

Conclusion: 通过诊断并聚焦师生表示的结构性错配区域，RDD能以更精准的蒸馏信号达到与强对比基线相当的性能，且加权损失优于数据过滤策略。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation transfers representational knowledge from a large teacher network to a compact student. Existing relational and contrastive distillation methods treat all samples uniformly, spending equal gradient on well-matched and poorly-matched regions of the representation space alike. We propose Representational Difference Distillation (RDD), which diagnoses where teacher and student representations structurally disagree and concentrates the distillation signal on those regions. RDD uses two asymmetric affinity matrices that capture opposing directions of misalignment: one identifies samples the student incorrectly considers similar, the other identifies teacher relationships the student has yet to learn. These affinities determine which sample pairs the distillation loss aligns and how strongly it corrects each misaligned sample. On CIFAR-100 with resnet32x4 to resnet8x4, RDD reaches 75.58% test accuracy in our runs, on par with CRD (75.45%) and above KD and RKD. We additionally explore curriculum-based and sampling-based variants, finding that weighting the loss is more effective than filtering the data.

</details>


### [227] [A 4-Qubit Variational Quantum Classifier for Sequence-Specific Classification of DNMT3A and DNMT3B Flanking Methylation Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15998)
*Murat Isik,Yusuf Moinuddin,Humaira Gowher,Sabre Kais*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于变分量子分类器（VQC）的量子机器学习方法，用于区分DNMT3A与DNMT3B的DNA甲基化序列偏好，在4,096个NNNCGNNN基序数据集上取得ROC-AUC为0.661±0.009的概念验证结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DNA甲基化由DNMT3家族酶催化，是调控基因表达与基因组稳定性的关键表观遗传修饰。然而，DNMT3A与DNMT3B在序列侧翼偏好上的精细差异难以区分，原因在于生化序列数据具有复杂、高维的特征，传统计算方法面临挑战，因此需要探索新的建模范式。

Method: 研究采用量子机器学习思路，构建变分量子分类器（VQC）。基于实验获得的深度酶学数据，构建包含4,096个唯一NNNCGNNN基序的数据集。使用自研的NumPy精确态矢量模拟器评估一个四量子比特VQC。所描述的电路为两层结构，含24个可训练旋转门、8个CNOT门和8个输入编码旋转门，测量前共40个门。在五个初始化种子下进行评估。

Result: 五种子下修正后VQC评估的ROC-AUC为0.661±0.009（变异性为样本标准差）。留出测试集近似平衡，含200个DNMT3A标记基序与210个DNMT3B标记基序；一个始终预测DNMT3B的基线模型在该测试集上准确率为51.2%，平衡准确率为0.500。

Conclusion: 该工作作为概念验证，为在复杂表观遗传分类任务中应用近期量子架构奠定了基础，并为生物信息学中的混合量子-经典流水线提供了方向。

Abstract: DNA methylation is a critical epigenetic modification that regulates gene expression and genome stability, primarily catalyzed by the DNA methyltransferase 3 (DNMT3) family of enzymes. Distinguishing precise sequence-specific flanking preferences between DNMT3A and DNMT3B remains computationally challenging due to the complex and high-dimensional nature of biochemical sequence data. In this study, we propose a novel Quantum Machine Learning (QML) approach to classify DNA methylation preferences, leveraging a Variational Quantum Classifier (VQC). Using experimentally derived deep enzymology data, we constructed a dataset containing 4,096 unique NNNCGNNN motifs. We evaluated a four-qubit VQC using a custom NumPy exact-statevector simulator. The described two-layer circuit contains 24 trainable rotations, eight CNOT gates, and eight input-encoding rotations, totaling 40 gates before measurement. Across five initialization seeds, the revised VQC evaluation achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.661 pm 0.009, where variability denotes sample standard deviation. The held-out test partition is approximately balanced, containing 200 DNMT3A-labeled motifs and 210 DNMT3B-labeled motifs. An always-DNMT3B predictor achieves 51.2% accuracy and a balanced accuracy of 0.500 on this test partition. This proof-of-concept establishes a foundation for utilizing near-term quantum architectures in complex epigenetic classification tasks, paving the way for hybrid quantum-classical pipelines in bioinformatics.

</details>


### [228] [Certified Robustness via Sparse Second-Order Cone Relaxations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16016)
*Mohammadreza Maleki,Daniel Sadig,Rushendra Sidibomma,Mahyar Fazlyab,Arman Adibi,Reza Samavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一类二阶锥规划(SOCP)松弛层级，在LP与SDP之间取得计算-紧致性折中，并引入CORE按目标类别选择性使用紧松弛，兼顾认证精度与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络认证鲁棒性对安全敏感场景至关重要，但精确认证需解非凸优化。LP松弛可扩展但过于保守，SDP松弛更紧却计算昂贵，因此需要一种兼顾紧致性与效率的中间方案。

Method: 构造分层SOCP松弛：结合ReLU激活的凸包松弛、基于认证变量界的选择性McCormick提升，以及由2×2主子式诱导的二阶锥约束；逐步添加约束形成单调递增紧致度的层级，实现可控的计算-紧致性权衡。进一步提出CORE(类别优化鲁棒评估)，仅对廉价松弛未能认证的目标类别施加更紧松弛。

Result: 在MNIST与CIFAR-10的全连接及卷积网络上，SOCP认证鲁棒精度优于LP，与alpha,beta-CROWN相当，且比SDP快数个数量级；在全连接MNIST上，CORE变体达到SDP-cert的认证鲁棒精度，平均验证时间最多减少86.30%。

Conclusion: 选择性二阶约束是介于可扩展LP与紧致SDP认证之间的实用折中方案，CORE机制可显著降低验证时间而不损失认证精度。

Abstract: Certified robustness is critical for deploying neural networks in safety-sensitive settings, but computing exact certificates typically requires solving nonconvex optimization problems. Practical verifiers use convex relaxations: linear programming (LP) relaxations are scalable but often too conservative, whereas semidefinite programming (SDP) relaxations can be substantially tighter but are computationally expensive. We introduce a hierarchy of second-order cone programming (SOCP) relaxations that provide stronger certificates than LP while avoiding the cost of global positive-semidefinite constraints. Our construction combines convex-hull relaxations of ReLU activations, selective McCormick lifting over certified variable bounds, and second-order cone constraints induced by 2-by-2 principal minors. Adding these constraints progressively yields a monotone hierarchy of increasingly tight bounds with a controllable computation-tightness trade-off. On fully connected and convolutional networks on MNIST and CIFAR-10, SOCP-based verification improves certified robust accuracy over LP-based verification and is competitive with alpha,beta-CROWN, while remaining orders of magnitude faster than SDP-based verification. These results position selective second-order constraints as a practical middle ground between scalable LP-based and tight SDP-based certification. Finally, we introduce class-optimized robust evaluation (CORE), which applies tighter relaxations only to target classes not certified by cheaper ones. On the fully connected MNIST benchmark, CORE variants match SDP-cert's certified robust accuracy while reducing average verification time by up to 86.30%.

</details>


### [229] [When Does Compensating Inherited Quantization Error Help? Mean-Square Guarantees for Layer-Wise Quantization and Their Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16020)
*Tianhao Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究逐层训练后量化中"误差补偿"在何种假设下才能保证网络输出误差不劣于无补偿方案，给出线性网络在条件下均方误差不增的证明、失效条件分析以及8B模型4比特实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逐层训练后量化让每层补偿前面层传来的量化误差，但这一补偿是否必然降低输出误差此前缺乏严格保证，甚至存在被引用的"普适保证"结论，作者希望澄清其成立的前提与失效边界。

Method: 对任意深度线性网络，在逐层校准Gram矩阵可逆、每层舍入误差条件均值为零且两方案具有相同确定性二阶矩映射（如无界网格上的减法抖动）时，证明预置强度在[0,1]的补偿使均方输出误差不劣于无补偿；通过精确残差恒等式刻画充要条件；分析ReLU网络中激活状态改变与误差跨样本迁移导致失效，并用校准投影与激活模式的交换子界定超出量；给出有界码本下逐层最优解仍可能更差的例子及两层标量线性网络的反例；在两个8B模型4比特上做实验。

Result: 理论上：均方误差不增的增益可分解为直接消除的误差与后续舍入噪声激励降低两部分；在ReLU与有界码本下比较可能失效，存在两个独立失效原因；固定舍入误差时两层标量线性网络即可推翻已发表的普适保证。实验上：固定半强度补偿在所有测试的模型、文本与绘图任务中均优于无补偿舍入，但没有任何选强度规则能稳定胜过逐层规则，且在选参数据上降低全网络损失并不能可靠降低新文本上的损失。

Conclusion: 逐层量化误差补偿的收益并非普遍成立，其有效性依赖于舍入误差结构、激活行为、码本有界性以及比较时固定校准输入等前提；实践中半强度补偿较稳健，但强度选择规则与以训练损失选参的可迁移性仍不可靠。

Abstract: Layer-wise post-training quantization methods let each layer compensate for the quantization error inherited from earlier layers. We ask under what assumptions such compensation guarantees a network output error no larger than without it. For linear networks of any depth, with the required calibration Gram matrices invertible, if the rounding error of each layer has zero conditional mean and a deterministic second-moment map common to both schemes, as under subtractive dither on an unbounded grid, then compensation with strengths in $[0,1]$ fixed in advance gives a mean-square output error no larger than no compensation, each scheme being followed along its own trajectory. The exact gain separates error removed directly from reduced excitation of later rounding noise. Outside this setting the comparison can fail. With rectified linear activations it fails for two independent reasons: noise changes activation states, and, even when no state changes, the correction moves error from samples on which a unit is inactive to samples on which it is active. With stable activations, commutators between the calibration projection and the activation patterns bound the excess. With a bounded codebook, even unique exact layer-wise minimizers with no overload can give a larger output error. For fixed rounding errors it already fails for two scalar linear layers, refuting a published universal guarantee. An exact residual identity gives the necessary and sufficient condition on a common layer input. All these comparisons hold the calibration input fixed. On two 8B models at 4 bits, fixed half-strength compensation beat uncompensated rounding in every model, text and draw tested, yet no rule for choosing the strength beat a layer-wise rule consistently, and lowering the full-network loss on the data used to choose did not reliably lower it on new text.

</details>


### [230] [Autoregressive Decoding as a Martingale: Characterizing the Stochastic Dynamics of LLM Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16041)
*Xiahui Zhu,Zhenyi Qi,Wanwei Liu,Haoang Chi,Yang Tan,Xinyu Sun,Ji Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从严格概率视角研究自回归LLM解码的随机动力学，将每步预测误差定义为采样token指示量与模型条件预测分布之差，证明累积误差过程是关于解码filtration的鞅，并给出其可预测二次变差的闭式表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归LLM本质上是条件概率模型，但其解码过程的随机动力学很少从严格概率论角度被研究。作者希望为解码过程的序列波动与预测不确定性建立理论联系，并为LLM生成文本检测与不确定性量化提供数学基础。

Method: 定义每步预测误差为采样token指示量与模型条件预测分布之差；证明累积误差过程关于解码filtration构成鞅，且条件一阶矩恒为零；进一步推导该鞅序列二阶行为的闭式表达，证明其可预测二次变差化简为 $\sum_t\left(1-p(y_t\mid y_{<t})\right)$，仅由已实现token概率即可计算。在Llama-3.x与Qwen2.5系列（1B至72B参数）上进行白盒实验验证。

Result: 白盒实验表明，在Llama-3.x和Qwen2.5系列（1B至72B参数）上实测的二阶矩与鞅分析给出的理论预测高度吻合。

Conclusion: 该工作为分析自回归LLM解码提供了概率论框架，揭示了不同语言模型内在的概率指纹，并为LLM生成文本检测与不确定性量化建立了严格的数学基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across a wide range of language tasks. At their core, autoregressive LLMs are conditional probability models that learn to approximate the next-token distribution given the preceding context. Despite this probabilistic nature, the stochastic dynamics of autoregressive decoding have rarely been investigated from a rigorous probabilistic perspective. In this work, we define the per-step prediction error as the difference between the sampled token indicator and the model's conditional predictive distribution, and prove that the cumulative error process is a martingale with respect to the decoding filtration, implying that its conditional first-order moment is identically zero. Beyond this first-order property, we derive a closed-form expression for the second-order behavior of the martingale sequence: its predictable quadratic variation reduces to $\sum_t\left(1-p(y_t\mid y_{<t})\right)$, computable from realized token probabilities alone. This identity establishes a direct theoretical connection between sequence fluctuations and predictive uncertainty during autoregressive decoding. White-box experiments on Llama-3.x and Qwen2.5 families (1B to 72B parameters) verify that the empirically measured second-order moments closely match the theoretical predictions derived from our martingale analysis. These results provide a probabilistic framework for analyzing autoregressive LLM decoding, reveal intrinsic probabilistic fingerprints of different language models, and establish a rigorous mathematical foundation for LLM-generated text detection and uncertainty quantification.

</details>


### [231] [Backward Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16048)
*Amin Meghrazi,Yuanyuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将 backward conformal prediction (BCP) 扩展到协变量偏移场景，通过重要性加权在密度比已知时保持其失误覆盖率(miscoverage)保证；提出在排序后的非一致性分数(score)向量上估计密度比，证明在可解释条件下渐近恢复相同报告并刻画其偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BCP 能固定预测集大小并估计失误覆盖率，但依赖校准集与测试数据的可交换性假设。在协变量偏移下该假设失效，需引入重要性加权。同时作者发现 BCP 的紧致失误覆盖率报告仅取决于分配给被遗漏校准样本的相对权重，这解释了为何更好的域分类器有时反而产生更差的估计。由于 BCP 仅依赖非一致性分数，高维输入上的密度比估计并非必要。

Method: 1) 用重要性加权将 BCP 推广至协变量偏移，密度比已知时保持保证；2) 分析发现失误覆盖率报告只依赖被遗漏校准样本的相对权重；3) 提出在排序后的分数向量上估计密度比，而非在高维输入空间估计；4) 证明该方法在可解释条件下渐近恢复相同报告，并刻画其他情形下的偏差。

Result: 在模拟与基准分布偏移实验中，所提方法改善了 BCP 的失误覆盖率估计；且基于分数的加权(score-based weighting)相比基于嵌入的加权(embedding-based weighting)始终产生更准确的估计。

Conclusion: BCP 在协变量偏移下可通过重要性加权扩展且保持保证，其报告仅依赖分数层面的相对权重；在分数向量上估计密度比是更有效且鲁棒的做法，实验验证其优于嵌入层面的加权。

Abstract: Backward conformal prediction (BCP) fixes the size of a prediction set and estimates its miscoverage, but assumes calibration and test data are exchangeable. We extend BCP to covariate shift through importance weighting, preserving its guarantees when the density ratio is known. We show that BCP's tight miscoverage report depends only on the relative weight assigned to missed calibration examples, explaining why a better domain classifier can sometimes produce a worse estimate. Motivated by the fact that BCP depends only on nonconformity scores, we propose estimating density ratios on sorted score vectors rather than high-dimensional inputs. We prove that this approach recovers the same report asymptotically under an interpretable condition and characterize the resulting bias otherwise. Experiments with simulated and benchmark distribution shifts show that the proposed method improves BCP's miscoverage estimates, while score-based weighting consistently yields more accurate estimates than embedding-based weighting.

</details>


### [232] [Interpretable Graph Partitioning for Spatial Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16063)
*Yuta Shikuri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将全局代理模型的构建形式化为图划分问题，通过选取连通子图最小化顶点级预测的簇内残差，并引入约束排除人为连接、开发边界调整算法，从而在保持可解释性的同时获得空间连贯且边界灵活的划分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间预测中灵活的黑盒预测模型日益普及，但在可解释性至关重要的场景下其实际应用仍受限。因此需要一种既能近似黑盒预测、又具备简单可解释表示的全局代理模型。

Method: 将问题形式化为图划分：选择连通子图，最小化顶点级预测的簇内残差。该形式可视为空间区域化的一种变体，但作用于个体位置上的模型预测而非预定义面单元。针对点级形式在大规模位置下可能产生区域间人为连接、降低可解释性的问题，引入排除此类连接的约束（同时保留灵活的划分边界），并从理论上分析该约束对划分结果的影响，同时开发了调整划分边界的计算流程。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提方法能够产生空间连贯且边界灵活的划分。

Conclusion: 通过带约束的图划分构建全局代理模型，可在近似黑盒空间预测的同时兼顾可解释性，实现空间连贯、边界灵活的划分效果。

Abstract: Spatial prediction estimates unobserved values from spatially distributed observations. Although flexible predictive models are increasingly available, their practical use remains limited when interpretability is essential. In this study, we formulate a graph partitioning problem to construct a global surrogate model that approximates black-box predictions with simpler representations. Specifically, we select connected subgraphs to minimize within-cluster residuals in vertex-level predictions. Although this formulation can be viewed as a variant of spatial regionalization, it operates on model-based predictions at individual locations rather than predefined areal units. With many locations, this point-level formulation may produce artificial connections between regions, reducing interpretability. We therefore introduce a constraint that excludes such connections while retaining flexible partition boundaries. We theoretically analyze how this constraint affects the resulting partition. We also develop a computational procedure for adjusting partition boundaries. Experimental results show that the proposed method yields spatially coherent partitions with flexible boundaries.

</details>


### [233] [Dream2Discern: Learning from Hard Latent Variants for Runtime Failure Prediction in Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16071)
*Boxuan Zhang,jianing Zhu,Xiaotian Han,Ruixiang Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Dream2Discern，一种基于隐式增强的运行时审计器，利用自身预测损失指导表示算子扰动生成难例，无需额外轨迹采集与结果验证，在两个基准上实现超过90%的轨迹级加权准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM多智能体系统的可靠部署需要运行时审计器从观测到的执行前缀预测最终结果，但审计器训练依赖有限且需昂贵执行与验证的轨迹语料；单纯扩大失败覆盖范围缺乏明确准则来识别当前审计器难以分类的前缀。

Method: Dream2Discern 通过自身预测损失引导的隐式增强进行训练。Dream阶段：选择审计器表示算子的扰动，以提升在已记录前缀上的预测损失，生成难潜变量；Discern阶段：审计器利用原始标签从这些变体中学习预测执行结果。变体随审计器学习不断重新生成，将有限语料转化为可再生的难例来源。

Result: 在 AFTraj-2K 与 StepShield 上的广泛评估表明，Dream2Discern 优于竞争性失败审计器，在两个基准上均达到超过90%的轨迹级加权准确率，并兼顾预测准确性与及时性。
