Conclusion: Dream2Discern 通过损失引导的隐式增强，无需额外轨迹采集或结果验证即可持续生成难例，有效提升运行时审计器的分类性能与部署可靠性。

Abstract: Reliable deployment of LLM-based multi-agent systems calls for runtime auditors that predict terminal outcomes from observed execution prefixes. These auditors typically learn from a limited corpus of trajectories with verified outcomes. Expanding this corpus requires costly execution and verification, yet broader failure coverage alone provides no explicit criterion for identifying prefixes that the current auditor finds difficult to classify. To this end, we propose Dream2Discern, a runtime auditor trained through implicit augmentation guided by its own prediction loss. During Dream, we select perturbations of the auditor's representation operators to increase prediction loss on recorded prefixes, yielding hard latent variants. During Discern, the auditor learns to predict execution outcomes from these variants using the original labels. The variants are regenerated as the auditor learns, turning a limited corpus into a renewable source of hard examples and requiring no additional trajectory collection or outcome verification. Extensive evaluations on AFTraj-2K and StepShield show that Dream2Discern outperforms competitive failure auditors and achieves over 90% trajectory-level weighted accuracy on both benchmarks while balancing prediction accuracy and timeliness. Project page: https://zbox1005.github.io/dream2discern-project/

</details>


### [234] [Memorization in image classification: test set behavior and scaling laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16090)
*Jeevesh Attri,Florentin Guth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究CNN在图像分类任务上记忆随机标签/像素时的行为与训练动态，发现记忆型网络并非简单查找表：独立初始化网络学到不同的预测函数，且完全记忆所需样本呈现次数可随数据集规模增大而减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度网络既能学到可泛化的解，也能记忆任意映射。作者认为理解泛化必须先理解记忆，而后者研究不足。核心疑问包括：泛化型与记忆型网络在行为与训练动态上有何差异？记忆型网络是否只是独立存储输入-输出映射的查找表？

Method: 在图像分类任务上训练CNN，使用随机化标签或随机化像素构造无结构映射；比较独立初始化网络在未见图像上的预测一致性，并考察数据集规模对插值训练集所需网络容量与训练时间的影响。

Result: 独立初始化、在同一随机标签上训练的网络学到不同的预测函数，在测试样本上给出不同预测（与泛化型网络相反）；记忆不学得通用解。数据集规模方面，即使输入-输出对无共同结构，完整记忆某样本所需的呈现次数也可随数据集规模增大而减少，这与直觉相反。

Conclusion: 记忆型网络并非简单查找表，而是表现出有待深入研究的机制性行为；记忆与泛化的关系需要进一步探讨。

Abstract: Deep neural networks are capable of both learning generalizing solutions on natural tasks and memorizing arbitrary mappings. We argue that understanding the former requires understanding the latter, which is much less studied. In what ways do networks that generalize or memorize differ in their behavior or their training dynamics? Do memorizing networks simply function as a lookup table where input-output mappings are stored independently? We investigate these questions in the context of CNNs trained on image classification tasks with randomized labels or pixels. We first study the behavior of such memorizing networks on unseen images. We find that independently initialized networks trained on the same random labels learn different predictive functions: they make different predictions on test examples, in contrast with generalizing networks. We then examine the effect of dataset size on memorization through the required network capacity and training time to interpolate the training set. Counter-intuitively, we find that the number of presentations of a given example required for complete memorization can decrease with dataset size even when input-output pairs share no common structure. Although memorizing networks do not learn a universal solution, they exhibit interesting behaviors which call for further investigations into the underlying mechanisms.

</details>


### [235] [SelectTTRL: Representation-Guided Data Selection for Efficient Test-Time Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16104)
*Yi Li,Linan Yue,Weibo Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出COS指标揭示模型内部响应表征与题目经验准确率之间的稳定关系，并据此设计SelectTTRL，只对排名靠前的部分测试题进行测试时强化学习，从而大幅降低计算量同时保持或提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Test-Time Reinforcement Learning（TTRL）对所有无标签测试题都执行同样的高成本多响应采样与优化流程，忽略了不同题目在训练效用上的巨大差异；而能否在训练前、无真值答案的情况下识别高价值题目，是尚未解决的问题。

Method: 作者定义COS为模型响应表征与一个由独立问答数据集构造的"正确性方向"之间的余弦相似度；通过跨模型、跨数据集、跨设置的实验验证COS与题目可解性的一致性，并给出理论分析。基于此提出SelectTTRL：用COS对测试题排名，只对选定百分位区间内的题目应用标准TTRL流程，其余题目跳过采样与强化学习更新。

Result: 在多个推理基准上，SelectTTRL在保持甚至提升标准TTRL性能的同时，显著减少了测试时计算开销。

Conclusion: 内部响应表征可用于在无真值条件下预先估计题目训练效用，为测试时强化学习的计算效率优化提供了一种表征引导的数据选择范式。

Abstract: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) enables large language models to adapt directly on unlabeled test problems by constructing pseudo-labels from multiple sampled responses. However, existing TTRL methods typically apply the same expensive sampling and optimization procedure to all test problems, despite substantial differences in their training utility. In this paper, we study whether such problems can be identified before costly test-time training, without access to ground-truth answers. We uncover a stable relationship between internal response representations and problem-level empirical accuracy. Specifically, we define COS as the cosine similarity between a model's response representation and a correctness-related direction constructed from an independent question-answering dataset. COS consistently correlates with problem solvability across different models, datasets, and experimental settings, and we further provide a theoretical analysis explaining this relationship. Building on this finding, we propose SelectTTRL, a representation-guided data selection method that ranks test problems using COS and applies TTRL only to a selected percentile interval. SelectTTRL leaves the standard TTRL pipeline unchanged for the selected problems, while avoiding unnecessary multi-response sampling and reinforcement learning updates on the remaining ones. Experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SelectTTRL substantially reduces test-time computation while maintaining or improving the performance of standard TTRL. Code is available at https://github.com/heyiliyi/SelectTTRL-public.

</details>


### [236] [Beyond Policy Rollouts: Embedding-Space Directional Exploration with Anchored Noise for LLM RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16105)
*Daijiao Liu,Huiyi Wang,Lina Yao,Dong Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EDEN通过在rollout源头对输入嵌入施加带锚点的扰动，替换少量标准rollout，从而增强RLVR的组内奖励变异与探索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR常使用小规模rollout组，同一策略重复采样易产生高度相似轨迹，导致组内奖励变异减小、组相对优势信号被削弱。现有方案（提高采样温度、熵奖励、非对称裁剪、扩大rollout预算）只改变采样范围或策略更新，未改变rollout的输入条件。

Method: 提出EDEN（基于锚定噪声的嵌入空间方向性探索），在rollout源头进行干预。在同一rollout预算下，将每组中一小部分标准rollout替换为：由同一策略基于“提示词加一个附加的扰动嵌入位置”生成的rollout。用高斯噪声驱动变异，共享锚点提供组内共同的调条件方向。被选中的扰动rollout以降低权重的优势值参与GRPO更新；模型结构、离散解码与测试时推理均不变。

Result: 在多个模型规模和数学推理基准上，EDEN优于GRPO及同流程下的探索性对照方法，在采样解覆盖度上提升最大。分析表明，更多提示词组产生非零的组相对学习信号，且噪声与锚定发挥互补作用。

Conclusion: 在rollout源头进行干预是提升RLVR探索能力的有效手段。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically uses small rollout groups per prompt, where repeated sampling from the same policy can yield highly similar trajectories, reducing within-group reward variation and weakening group-relative advantage signals. Existing remedies such as higher sampling temperature, entropy bonuses, asymmetric clipping, and larger rollout budgets broaden sampling or modify policy updates but leave rollout conditioning unchanged. In this paper, we propose EDEN (Embedding-space Directional Exploration via anchored Noise), which intervenes at the rollout source through anchored input perturbations. EDEN explores beyond the policy's own rollouts. Within the same rollout budget, it replaces a small fraction of standard rollouts in each group with rollouts that the same policy generates from the prompt plus a single appended, perturbed embedding position, rather than from the prompt alone. Gaussian noise drives variation, while a shared anchor provides a common conditioning direction within each prompt group. Selected perturbed rollouts contribute to GRPO updates with downweighted advantages, and the model architecture, discrete decoding, and test-time inference remain unchanged. Across model scales and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, EDEN outperforms GRPO and the exploration controls evaluated in the same pipeline, with the largest gains in sampled solution coverage. Analyses show that more prompt groups provide non-zero group-relative learning signals and that noise and anchoring play complementary roles. Intervening at the rollout source is thus an effective lever for exploration in RLVR.

</details>


### [237] [Silence and Noise: Resolving Suppression and Overvaluation in Multimodal Entity Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16106)
*Xizhe Zhang,Jingfeng Zhang,Meng-Fen Chiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文揭示多模态实体对齐中特征缺失与拓扑差异的耦合退化问题，提出生成式校准框架ALMEA，通过跨模态补全与隐空间语义校准的双向反馈环路，在稀疏监督下显著超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态实体对齐（MMEA）研究将特征缺失性与跨图拓扑不对称视为孤立的预处理或去噪问题，忽视了二者在多模态融合过程中的破坏性耦合。作者识别出两种失效模式：细节缺失（DM）导致的过度评估，以及上下文失衡（CI）导致的抑制效应，后者使密集结构上下文淹没弱但具高判别性的模态信号，引发高层语义漂移。

Method: 提出ALMEA生成式校准框架，建立低层特征重建与高层隐空间对齐之间的双向反馈环路。核心组件包括：跨模态补全（CMI）合成缺失模态细节以缓解过度评估；隐空间语义校准（LSC）对齐跨图联合嵌入以抑制拓扑驱动的语义漂移；在稀疏监督下设计受控迭代选择（CIS），自适应获取具代表性与多样性的伪标签对，在有限预算下优化隐空间校准。

Result: 在标准基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ALMEA持续优于最先进基线。在20%监督率下，MRR最高绝对提升5.20%，Hits@1最高提升6.40%，并在更高监督阈值下保持稳健增益。

Conclusion: 该工作系统性地形式化并验证了MMEA中缺失性与拓扑差异耦合引发的两种退化机制，证明将特征重建与隐空间对齐联合建模的有效性，为不完整多模态知识图谱融合提供了稳健的解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal entity alignment (MMEA) is fundamental to integrating heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs), yet existing paradigms remain critically vulnerable to incomplete modalities and cross-graph structural asymmetries. This paper exposes a fundamental oversight in current MMEA research: treating feature missingness and topological discrepancies as isolated preprocessing or denoising challenges, which overlooks their destructive coupling during multimodal fusion. We systematically formulate and evaluate two newly identified failure modes: 1) Detail Missing (DM)-induced overvaluation, where the absence of local modality details causes models to overemphasize uninformative, blurred representations; and 2) Context Imbalance (CI)-induced suppression, where topological discrepancies across KGs allow dense structural contexts to overwhelm weaker but highly discriminative modal signals, triggering high-level semantic drift. To break this cycle of degradation, we introduce ALMEA, a generative and calibration framework that establishes a bidirectional feedback loop between low-level feature reconstruction and high-level latent space alignment. Specifically, Cross-Modality Imputation (CMI) synthesizes missing modality details to mitigate overvaluation, while Latent Semantic Calibration (LSC) aligns cross-graph joint embeddings to suppress topology-driven semantic drift. Under sparse supervision, we develop Controlled Iterative Selection (CIS) to adaptively acquire representative and diverse pseudo-labeled pairs, optimizing latent calibration under constrained budgets. Extensive evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that ALMEA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. At a 20% supervision rate, ALMEA yields substantial absolute improvements of up to 5.20% in MRR and 6.40% in Hits@1, maintaining robust gains across higher supervision thresholds.

</details>


### [238] [PID-Gated Continual Prompt Adaptation Under Noisy Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16129)
*Zhentao Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文将提示词持续适配中的"何时触发指令更新"问题类比为调度问题，借鉴PID控制思想提出一族轻量门控机制，在非平稳环境、噪声反馈下实现性能与编辑调用预算的帕累托优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在非平稳环境中部署时，任务会漂移，需不断修订指令。但若每次报告错误后就重写提示词，噪声反馈会被固化为持久性错误。核心问题在于：反馈何时应触发一次持久性的指令更新，以及以何种编辑调用代价完成——这一调度问题常被忽视。

Method: 受比例-积分-微分（PID）控制启发，提出一族轻量门控机制：对当前误差做出比例响应、随时间累积证据（积分项），并在编辑后进行劣化回滚（微分/回退）。将门控与简单基线及先进提示优化器（TextGrad、GEPA）进行基准对比，覆盖多种漂移任务、LLM参数规模、反馈噪声水平与随机种子。

Result: PID门控的持续提示适配在任务性能（高准确率、低误差）与编辑调用预算之间取得了比所考虑基线更优的帕累托权衡。

Conclusion: 控制理论式调度是一种简单、通用的工具，可在不可靠反馈下实现鲁棒的提示适配。

Abstract: Deploying LLM agents in non-stationary environments requires continually revising their instructions as the task drifts, yet rewriting after every reported mistake can turn noisy feedback into persistent errors. This raises an often-overlooked scheduling question in prompt adaptation: when should feedback trigger a lasting instruction update, and at what editor-call cost? Taking inspiration from proportional-integral-derivative (PID) control, we introduce a family of lightweight gates that react to the current error, accumulate evidence over time, and roll back deterioration after an edit. We benchmark these gates against both simple baselines and advanced prompt optimizers (TextGrad and GEPA), over a diverse suite of drifting tasks, LLM parameter sizes, feedback-noise levels, and random seeds. PID-gated continual prompt adaptation yields a more favorable Pareto trade-off between task performance (high accuracy, low error) and editor-call budget than the baselines considered, pointing to control-theoretic scheduling as a simple, general tool for robust prompt adaptation under unreliable feedback.

</details>


### [239] [XForecast: The KDD 2026 Finance Day Challenge on News-Grounded Financial Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16131)
*Jaehoon Lee,Jun Seo,Seunghan Lee,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Minjae Kim,Sungdong Yoo,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Soonyoung Lee,Yongjae Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出XForecast，一个基于新闻的金融预测基准与竞赛，任务为结合历史股价与配对新闻信号预测四周后的股价走势。数据覆盖2019–2023年100只大盘股，采用FinTexTS多模态数据生成方法，并引入加权命中率指标，重点关注新闻影响更强的样本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融预测传统上依赖数值时间序列信号，而新闻等文本信息利用不足。需要一个能系统评估文本与时间序列融合方法的基准，以推动新闻驱动的金融预测研究。

Method: 提出XForecast基准与竞赛：融合股价数据与策展金融文本，文本由多模态数据生成方法FinTexTS产生；数据涵盖2019–2023年100只大盘股，2019–2022年训练，2023年评估；采用加权命中率（weighted hit rate）指标，对新闻信息影响预计更强的样本赋予更高权重。

Result: 构建了包含100只大盘股、跨2019–2023年的新闻-价格配对数据集，并设立训练/评估划分；以加权命中率为评价标准，并在Kaggle上作为KDD 2026 Finance Day的XForecast Challenge开展竞赛，用于基准测试时间序列与文本信息融合方法。

Conclusion: XForecast为新闻驱动的金融预测提供了标准化基准与竞赛平台，推动时间序列与文本信息融合方法的发展与比较。

Abstract: Financial forecasting has traditionally relied on numerical time-series (TS) signals, while textual information such as news remains largely underutilized. We introduce XForecast, a benchmark and competition for news-grounded financial forecasting, where the task is to predict stock price movements four weeks ahead using both historical price data and paired news signals. XForecast combines stock price data with curated financial text generated using FinTexTS, a multimodal dataset generation method. It covers 100 large-cap stocks from 2019--2023, with training on 2019--2022 and evaluation on 2023. To better evaluate models that leverage textual signals, we adopt a weighted hit rate metric that places greater emphasis on instances where news information is expected to have stronger influence. The XForecast Challenge, hosted on Kaggle as part of KDD 2026 Finance Day, aims to benchmark methods for integrating financial TS and textual information.

</details>


### [240] [BARTER: Compact Dynamic Sparse Training with Standard Dense Kernels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16147)
*Yueyuan Sui,Payal Mohapatra,Qi Zhu,Stephen Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BARTER是一种结构化动态稀疏训练（DST）框架，通过保持训练张量物理紧凑、在层间动态重分配容量，从而利用标准稠密内核降低训练成本，而非依赖稀疏内核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DST方法仅对参数做掩码（mask），矩阵维度不变，因此训练加速依赖稀疏内核等专门支持，实际收益受限。作者希望在不依赖稀疏内核的情况下，利用标准稠密内核获得训练加速与显存节省。

Method: BARTER在普通反向传播中仅利用活跃单元的统计量，对注意力头和前馈通道在各自固定的全局预算下进行剪枝与克隆；每次拓扑更新时，重设受影响参数张量的尺寸并重映射其优化器状态，使后续训练直接在紧凑模型上进行，从而保持张量物理紧凑。

Result: 在Transformer视觉模型、两个图像分类基准、密度0.1–0.7的实验中，Top-1准确率与全张量DST基线相当；在NVIDIA L40上，训练片段实测加速最高达6.29×，峰值显存分配减少最高81.3%；在iPhone 13 Pro Max训练基准上相对全张量DST基线加速2.78×。

Conclusion: BARTER表明结构化DST可通过物理紧凑张量在标准稠密内核上实现显著的训练加速与显存节省，同时保持与全张量DST相当的精

Abstract: Dynamic sparse training (DST) aims to reduce training costs while maintaining accuracy. Existing DST methods mask out parameters but keep matrix dimensions unchanged. Training speedups therefore depend on specialized support, such as sparse kernels. We introduce BARTER, a structured DST framework that reduces training cost using standard dense kernels by keeping training tensors physically compact while dynamically reallocating capacity across layers. Unlike existing works that require computing gradients for all parameters, BARTER instead uses statistics collected only from active units during ordinary backpropagation to prune and clone attention heads and feed-forward channels under separate fixed global budgets. At each topology update, it resizes the affected parameter tensors and remaps their optimizer states, so subsequent training steps operate directly on the compact model. Training and fine-tuning experiments with Transformer-based vision models on two image classification benchmarks at densities from $0.1$ to $0.7$ show competitive Top-1 accuracy relative to full-tensor DST baselines. On an NVIDIA L40, BARTER achieves speedups of up to $6.29\times$ in measured training segments and reduces peak allocated GPU memory by up to $81.3\%$ relative to these implementations. An iPhone 13 Pro Max training benchmark additionally shows a $2.78\times$ speedup over the full-tensor DST baseline.

</details>


### [241] [WildTrace: Evaluating Training Data Detection in Realistic Large-Scale LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16152)
*Hengxiang Zhang,Junxian Liu,Hongxin Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 \textsc{\method} 基准，用于在真实大规模后训练（SFT、DPO、RL）场景下可靠评估训练数据检测方法，发现现有方法平均 AUC 仅 0.529，接近随机水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练虽显著提升模型性能，但使用大量未公开数据引发基准污染与版权侵权担忧，推动训练数据检测研究。然而现有评估要么采用事后构建的基准引入分布偏移，要么依赖与真实后训练场景差异较大的小规模受控设置，导致报告性能难以反映真实场景下的检测效果。

Method: 构建多阶段流水线生成的 \textsc{\method} 基准，覆盖后训练全生命周期中各阶段特定模型（SFT、DPO、RL）；针对每个模型在四个多样化任务上构建专属评估集，成员与非成员分布匹配且成员标签可验证，以实现可靠评估。

Result: 在 \textsc{\method} 基准上，即使表现最佳的方法平均 AUC 也仅为 0.529，接近随机猜测水平（0.5）；分析还表明评估协议会显著影响所测得的检测性能。

Conclusion: 现有检测方法在真实后训练场景下效果有限，凸显了开发有效、实用且鲁棒的训练数据检测方法的巨大空间，同时强调评估协议对检测性能测量的重要影响。

Abstract: Although post-training significantly enhances model performance, the use of massive undisclosed data raises concerns about benchmark contamination and copyright infringement. This drives growing interest in training data detection for post-trained models. Existing evaluations for training data detection often leverage benchmarks constructed post hoc, which can introduce distribution shifts. Alternatively, controlled evaluations rely on small-scale training setups that diverge from realistic post-training settings. As a result, their reported performance may not faithfully reflect the effectiveness of detection methods in real-world scenarios. To this end, we introduce \textsc{\method}, a reliable benchmark designed to evaluate detection methods in realistic, large-scale post-training settings. Built on a multi-stage pipeline, \method\space encompasses stage-specific models throughout the post-training lifecycle, spanning SFT, DPO, and RL. To perform a reliable evaluation, we construct model-specific evaluation sets across four diverse tasks, featuring distribution-matched members and non-members with verifiable membership labels. Our results reveal that even the best-performing method achieves an average AUC of only 0.529 on our benchmark, which approaches random-guessing level (0.5). Furthermore, our analysis suggests that evaluation protocols can significantly affect measured detection performance. These findings highlight the significant potential for developing effective, practical, and robust detection methods under realistic scenarios.

</details>


### [242] [Fisher information and the geometry of memorization in neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16161)
*Daniel T. Bernstein,Chase Goddard,Luca Di Carlo,Vudtiwat Ngampruetikorn,David J. Schwab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究利用 Fisher 信息刻画神经网络如何将可泛化结构与训练数据中的噪声记忆特征分离，并在 CIFAR-10 视觉模型、合成上下文学习 Transformer 及解析可解线性模型中验证了该机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解机器学习泛化能力的关键在于刻画模型如何从训练数据中分离可泛化结构与特异甚至损坏的特征。Fisher 信息作为基于损失几何的诊断工具，被认为能区分泛化与记忆，但其具体作用机制和跨结构、跨任务的普适性尚不清晰，需要进一步探究。

Method: 在 CIFAR-10 上训练视觉模型，并引入只能通过记忆学习的可控噪声；将模型权重投影到顶层 Fisher 特征向量上，分析泛化任务性能与噪声样本记忆的解耦情况，并考察该解耦在不同层间的差异。随后在求解合成上下文学习任务的小型 Transformer 中验证，并在简单解析可解线性模型中以闭式形式复现。

Result: 将权重投影到顶层 Fisher 特征向量能够解耦通用任务性能与噪声样本记忆；这种解耦在不同层间表现出差异化分布。相同现象在小 Transformer 的合成上下文学习任务中出现，并在解析线性模型中以闭式形式复现。

Conclusion: Fisher 信息捕捉了神经网络在泛化与记忆之间分配容量所依赖的几何结构特征，为理解模型容量分配机制提供了统一视角。

Abstract: A fruitful approach towards understanding generalization in machine learning involves characterizing how models separate generalizable structure from idiosyncratic or even corrupted features of training data. Fisher information has emerged as a diagnostic tool for this separation, leveraging loss geometry to distinguish generalization from memorization. Here we investigate this connection in vision models trained on CIFAR-10 with controlled noise that can be learned only through memorization. We show that projecting model weights onto the top Fisher eigenvectors decouples general task performance from noisy sample memorization, and we investigate how this decoupling presents differentially across layers. We show that the same phenomena are present in small transformers trained to solve a synthetic in-context learning task, and are reproduced in closed form in a simple, analytically solvable linear model. Our results reveal that Fisher information captures aspects of the geometric structure underlying how neural networks allocate capacity between generalization and memorization.

</details>


### [243] [When Participant Disjoint Validation Is Not Enough to Establish Generalization in Parkinson's Gait Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16220)
*Md. Sifat,Sania Akter,Akif Islam,Md. Ekramul Hamid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在WearGait-PD帕金森病步态分类研究中，仅用采集站点即可获得AUC 0.955，超过步态特征模型（0.882）；在同站点或跨站点验证下降至0.668与0.576，表明参与者去重的汇总式验证未能将疾病判别与站点相关变异分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与者不重叠的交叉验证虽能避免个体重复，但当采集站点与诊断标签存在结构性依赖时，仍会给出乐观估计。作者希望检验这种去重策略是否真的隔离了疾病相关的判别信息，还是混入了站点相关变异。

Method: 数据为133名WearGait-PD参与者（65例帕金森病、68例对照），含159个压力步道汇总特征。队列为非因子设计：两个站点仅含单一诊断组，仅VA-Seattle同时包含两组。采用重复的参与者级嵌套交叉验证；比较站点单独模型与步态特征模型，并在逻辑回归流程中加入步态、年龄、性别。进一步进行同站点（VA-Seattle）评估、JHOC+Bayview到VA-Seattle的迁移压力测试，以及诊断组内站点预测和站点条件置换分析。

Result: 站点单独模型AUC为0.955±0.003，高于步态特征模型0.882±0.014；在逻辑回归流程中，将步态特征加入站点、年龄、性别后，汇总判别力无可见提升。更严格控制站点的评估给出更低且不精确的估计：VA-Seattle同站点AUC为0.668（95% bootstrap CI 0.477–0.836），JHOC+Bayview至VA-Seattle迁移压力测试为0.576（0.375–0.770）。诊断组内站点预测与站点条件置换分析显示步态表征保留了大量采集站点结构。

Conclusion: 参与者去重的汇总式验证未能将疾病相关判别与站点相关变异隔离开；站点标签依赖造成乐观估计。研究提示应审慎检查站点标签依赖，并尽可能通过同站点或独立验证支持汇总结果，再对跨机构泛化作出更广泛声明。

Abstract: Participant-disjoint cross-validation prevents direct participant overlap, but it may still produce optimistic estimates when acquisition site and diagnosis are structurally dependent. We examined Parkinson's disease classification using 159 pressure-walkway summary features from 133 WearGait-PD participants, including 65 participants with Parkinson's disease and 68 controls. The cohort was non-factorial: two sites contained only one diagnostic group, whereas VA-Seattle was the only site containing both groups. In repeated participant-level nested cross-validation, site alone achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.955 plus or minus 0.003, exceeding the gait-feature model (0.882 plus or minus 0.014). Under the evaluated logistic-regression pipelines, adding gait features to site, age, and sex produced no measurable improvement in pooled discrimination. More site-controlled evaluations produced lower and imprecise estimates: VA-Seattle same-site AUC was 0.668 (95% bootstrap confidence interval 0.477 to 0.836), and the JHOC + Bayview-to-VA-Seattle transport stress test achieved 0.576 (0.375 to 0.770). Supporting within-diagnosis site-prediction and site-conditioned permutation analyses showed that the gait representation retained substantial acquisition-site structure. These findings indicate that participant-disjoint pooled validation did not isolate disease-related discrimination from site-associated variation. They encourage careful examination of site-label dependence and, where possible, support for pooled results through within-site or independent validation before broader claims are made about generalization across institutions.

</details>


### [244] [AutoNovo: Agentic Program Search Discovers Transferable Nucleic Acid Design Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16232)
*Joel Shor,Subhashini Venugopalan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用智能体程序搜索（agentic program search）迭代发现核酸设计器（AutoNovo），以提升跨模型泛化能力，在3/3 DNA设计任务和6/6迁移任务上取得最佳平均表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核酸的计算机优化依赖预测模型（oracle），但这些模型无法完美刻画生物功能，因此针对单一模型优化出的序列可能利用模型特有伪影，无法泛化到独立模型。已有研究表明，不同设计器的泛化能力差异显著，如何设计出跨模型泛化能力强的核酸设计器成为关键问题。

Method: 采用智能体程序搜索（agentic program search），迭代地提出、执行、评估并修改核酸设计器的代码，同时总结出有效引导该搜索的提示策略。

Result: AutoNovo设计器在3/3个DNA设计任务的in-silico性能上、以及6/6个迁移任务的独立模型评估上，均取得所评估方法中最佳的平均表现。且最优设计器来自一个被发现的设计器家族，而非单一通用最优设计器。

Conclusion: 该工作是实现最大化跨模型泛化能力的核酸设计器的第一步，有助于提高in-silico设计序列反映真实生物学功能的概率，作者计划公开这些设计器。

Abstract: In-silico optimization of nucleic acids relies on predictive oracles that imperfectly capture biological function, so sequences optimized against one model may exploit model-specific artifacts and fail to generalize to independent models. Recent studies have shown that not all designers generalize equally well to independent models. In this work, we use agentic program search to iteratively propose, execute, evaluate, and revise code for nucleic-acid designers. We describe the successful strategies used to prompt the search. AutoNovo designers achieved the best observed mean among the evaluated methods on 3/3 DNA-design tasks in terms of in-silico performance, and 6/6 transfer tasks in terms of independent models. The designers come from a family of discovered nucleic acid designers rather than a single universal best designer. We plan to release the resulting designers. These results are the first steps in creating nucleic acid designers that maximize cross-model generalization, and thus improving the odds that in-silico designed sequences reflect real biology.

</details>


### [245] [From Simulated Fluids to Living Tissue: Zero-Shot Foundation Model Transfer to Perturbed Embryos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16236)
*Louisa Cornelis,Haewon Jeong,Irina Espejo,Payel Mukhopadhyay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将连续动力学基础模型Walrus微调于仅12个野生型果蝇囊胚层视频，评估其自回归预测在分布内及温度/基因扰动零样本条件下的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 体内实验视频数据有限，尤其在遗传突变与环境扰动条件下数据稀缺，导致模型难以泛化到数据集代表性条件之外。但组织尺度上果蝇动力学可描述为连续流场，因此有望借用其他物理系统学到的表示作为发育动力学先验。

Method: 在广泛模拟连续系统上预训练的连续动力学基础模型Walrus，用12个野生型果蝇囊胚层视频的组织速度场进行微调；进行自回归预测，并在分布内与未见温度、基因扰动的零样本条件下评估，零样本指在微调未见的扰动条件下不额外训练直接测试。

Result: 分布内，从零训练的傅里叶神经算子(FNO)在VRMSE上最佳；但在最严重分布偏移（突变胚胎与未见温度的样本）下，Walrus（CRPS）表现最强。预测捕捉到平均表面组织速度轨迹的形状及其在17°C与27°C之间的分离，包括胚带延伸起始时峰值出现的时间——胚胎发育中具有生物学意义的里程碑。

Conclusion: 初步证明：只要系统满足连续介质描述，来自不同动力系统的表示可迁移至实验形态发生过程。结果也激励将物理基础模型作为低数据条件下形态发生模拟的新型互补工具进一步研究。

Abstract: Morphogenesis is driven by the interplay of genetic regulation and tissue mechanics. In vivo video data is limited, particularly under genetic mutations and environmental perturbations, making generalization beyond the most representative conditions in the dataset challenging. However, at tissue scales, the dynamics of Drosophila can be described as a continuum flow, motivating the usage of representations learned across other physical systems as priors for developmental dynamics.
  We investigate finetuning Walrus, a Continuum Dynamics Foundation Model pretrained across a broad set of simulated continuous systems, on tissue velocity fields from only 12 wild-type Drosophila blastoderm videos. We evaluate autoregressive prediction both in-distribution and zero-shot under unseen temperature and genetic perturbations. Zero-shot refers to evaluation on perturbation conditions never seen during wild-type finetuning, without any additional training. In-distribution, a Fourier Neural Operator model trained from scratch achieves best performance on VRMSE. However, Walrus (CRPS) is the strongest model under the most severe distribution shift of unseen samples of mutated embryos and temperature conditions. Interestingly, predictions capture the shape of the mean surface tissue velocity trajectory and its separation between 17°C and 27°C, including the timing of the peak at Germ Band Extension onset, a biologically meaningful milestone of embryo development.
  Our results provide preliminary support that representations learned from different dynamical systems can transfer to experimental morphogenesis in developmental regimes, provided they admit a continuum description. More broadly, our results motivate further study of physics foundation models as a new complementary tool for the simulation of morphogenesis in low-data regimes.

</details>


### [246] [Reflected Proximal Dynamics for Accelerated High-Accuracy Log-Concave Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16248)
*Bo Yuan,Wei Guo,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出"反射近端动力学"（reflected proximal dynamics），将近端采样与辅助变量的精确反射、条件动能运动及受控刷新相结合，构建两种实现（通量重采样欠阻尼半转、持续动量四分之一转），在warm start下以 Õ(√κ d^{1/4}) 期望oracle查询达到TV误差ε，去除warm start后为 Õ(κ^{6/7} d^{1/4})，且对ε依赖为 polylog(1/ε)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究 R^d 上 π(x)∝e^{-V(x)} 的采样问题，V 为 α-强凸、β-光滑，条件数 κ=β/α。近端采样（proximal sampler）能精确保持目标分布，并在小步长极限下退化为过阻尼 Langevin 动力学，但其高斯重采样步骤丢弃方向信息；而欠阻尼 Langevin 动力学通过动量保留方向信息从而加速探索。作者因此希望构造一种既保持目标分布精确性、又保留方向持续性（directional persistence）的近端方法。

Method: 提出反射近端动力学（reflected proximal dynamics）：将近端采样与辅助变量的精确反射、条件动能运动（conditional kinetic motion）以及受控刷新（controlled refreshment）结合。给出两种具体实现：(1) 通量重采样欠阻尼半转（flux-resampled underdamped half-turn）；(2) 持续动量四分之一转（persistent-momentum quarter-turn），以在保持目标分布的同时实现方向信息的持续性。

Result: 在具有常数 χ² 散度的 warm start 下，两种方法均以 Õ(√κ d^{1/4}) 期望 oracle 查询数达到总变差（TV）误差 ε。进一步通过将近端初始化阶段与现有后验采样器结合，并采用优化的粗步长，去除了对 warm start 的依赖，初始化与采样合计需要 Õ(κ^{6/7} d^{1/4}) 期望 oracle 查询。两种情形下对精度 ε 的依赖均为 polylog(1/ε)。

Conclusion: 反射近端动力学在保持目标分布精确性的同时引入方向持续性，在高精度对数凹采样中同时改善了条件数 κ 与维度 d 的依赖，并将 ε 依赖降至 polylog(1/ε)，是一个有前景的加速高精度对数凹采样框架。未来可能进一步优化 κ 的指数（如向 √κ 逼近）并扩展到更弱的凸性假设。

Abstract: We study sampling from $π(x)\propto\mathrm{e}^{-V(x)}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, where $V$ is $α$-strongly convex and $β$-smooth with condition number $κ=β/α$. For this problem, the proximal sampler preserves the target exactly and recovers overdamped Langevin dynamics in the small-step limit, but its Gaussian resampling step discards directional information. Underdamped Langevin dynamics retains such information through momentum to accelerate exploration, motivating a proximal construction that combines target preservation with directional persistence. We introduce \textit{reflected proximal dynamics}, which combines proximal sampling with an exact reflection of the auxiliary variable, conditional kinetic motion, and controlled refreshment. We develop two realizations: a flux-resampled underdamped half-turn and a persistent-momentum quarter-turn. From a warm start with constant $χ^2$ divergence, both methods achieve total variation error $\varepsilon$ using $\widetilde O(\sqrtκd^{1/4})$ expected oracle queries. We further remove the supplied warm-start assumption by combining either sampler with existing posterior samplers in a proximal initialization stage with an optimized coarse step size. Accounting for both initialization and sampling yields $\widetilde O(κ^{6/7}d^{1/4})$ expected oracle queries. In both regimes, the dependence on the target accuracy $\varepsilon$ is $\mathrm{polylog}(1/\varepsilon)$, making reflected proximal dynamics a promising framework for accelerated high-accuracy log-concave sampling.

</details>


### [247] [Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16264)
*David Aquilué-Llorens,Abel Puigseslloses,Angel Blanco,Claire Braboszcz,Aureli Soria-Frisch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统考察了无监督时域EEG特征提取的频谱约束：在1/f衰减谱下，MSE重建损失导致自编码器（LSTMVAE、VAEEG、Transformer）忽略高频信息，需引入频域损失与梯度平衡来保留高频瞬态特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG是脑部疾病早期诊断的无创、可扩展定量生物标志物来源，深度表示学习已成为从原始信号中提取潜在特征的有力范式。但神经网络倾向于低估高频信息，而EEG具有振荡特性和1/f^χ功率衰减，易掩盖与疾病相关的高频特征，这一问题尤为突出。

Method: 系统性研究三种自编码器架构（LSTMVAE、VAEEG、Transformer）以及一个最先进EEG基础模型的无监督时域特征提取的频谱约束。采用合成实验与实证验证相结合的方式，分析MSE损失在1/f衰减谱下的幅度驱动掩蔽效应，并考察潜在维度增大的影响。

Result: 自编码器能够捕捉alpha减慢等宏观尺度变化，但由于MSE损失在1/f衰减谱下引发的幅度驱动掩蔽效应，对更高频率存在系统性偏差。增加潜在维度可缓解这种高频衰减，但会牺牲潜在表征的紧凑性和生成稳定性。

Conclusion: 随着该领域向大规模基础级特征提取器发展，必须超越简单的时域重建，整合频域损失项和梯度平衡技术，从而在潜在表征中保留对诊断复杂脑部疾病至关重要的细微高频瞬态特征。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive, scalable source of quantitative biomarkers for the early diagnosis of brain disorders, and deep representation learning has become a powerful paradigm for extracting information-rich latent features from raw signals. However, neural networks tend to under-represent high-frequency information, a concern that is especially acute for EEG given its oscillatory nature and characteristic $1/f^χ$ power decay, which risks masking disease-relevant high-frequency signatures. In this study, we systematically investigate the spectral constraints of unsupervised time-domain feature extraction across three autoencoder architectures (LSTMVAE, VAEEG, Transformer) and a state-of-the-art EEG foundation model. Using synthetic experiments and empirical validation, we show that while autoencoders capture macro-scale shifts such as alpha slowing, they remain biased against higher frequencies due to a magnitude-driven masking effect induced by the Mean Squared Error loss under 1/f-decaying spectra. Increasing latent dimensionality mitigates this attenuation but sacrifices latent compactness and generative stability. We argue that, as the field advances toward large-scale foundation-level feature extractors, it is imperative to move beyond simple time-domain reconstruction and to integrate spectral-domain loss terms and gradient-balancing techniques, so that the subtle high-frequency transients critical for diagnosing complex brain disorders are preserved in the latent representation.

</details>


### [248] [Error Correction in Trained TTT Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16268)
*Yuhe Hu,Wen Jia Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究TTT（测试时训练）层中由预测导出的梯度更新结构及其经验作用，通过理论推导与在已训练检查点上的干预实验，区分"预测导出更新"的数学形式与其实际行为价值，指出评估测试时记忆需结合实现分析与实时干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTT层在处理输入序列时更新快速权重记忆，但仅凭基于梯度的更新本身，无法说明记忆如何修正已有的关联。作者希望弄清已发布TTT实现中预测导出更新的结构与真实作用，弥合数学形式与实际行为价值之间的鸿沟。

Method: 对点积目标，刻画其缺失预测误差残差的性质，并给出重参数化后内循环上升与下降等价的条；对TTT-Linear与TTT-MLP采用的基于LayerNorm的平方误差目标，推导内循环梯度并识别出一个在发布初始化、零epsilon极限下被抵消的预测导出分量。随后在三个已训练检查点上测量完整归一化预测项的实际贡献，并做局部逐token范数匹配的干预实验，另设合成实验考察delta规则覆写对步长的依赖。

Result: 移除该预测导出贡献但保留LayerNorm雅可比时，各模型平均梯度范数比为0.25–0.32。在《战争与和平》的100,303个token上，同样的局部逐token范数匹配干预使TTT-Linear-760M与1.3B的困惑度上升2.8–2.9%，而冻结全部快速权重更新则使其上升4.2–4.5倍。合成测试显示普通delta规则覆写依赖步长。

Conclusion: 结果将预测导出更新的数学形式与其行为价值区分开来，表明评估测试时记忆既需要实现层面的分析，也需要实时干预实验，二者缺一不可。

Abstract: Test-time-training (TTT) layers update fast-weight memory while processing an input sequence. A gradient-based update, however, does not by itself establish how the memory revises an existing association. We study the structure and empirical role of prediction-derived updates in released TTT implementations. For dot-product objectives, we characterize the absence of a prediction-error residual and establish conditions under which inner-loop ascent and descent are equivalent after reparameterization. For the LayerNorm-based squared-error objective used by TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP, we derive the inner gradient and identify a prediction-derived component that cancels at the released initialization in the zero-epsilon limit. We then measure the full normalized prediction's contribution on three trained checkpoints. Removing this contribution while retaining the LayerNorm Jacobian gives a mean gradient norm ratio of 0.25 to 0.32 across the models. On 100,303 tokens from War and Peace, the same intervention with local per-token norm matching raises perplexity by 2.8-2.9% on TTT-Linear-760M and 1.3B, whereas freezing all fast-weight updates raises it by factors of 4.2-4.5. Separate synthetic tests illustrate the dependence of plain delta-rule overwriting on step size. The results distinguish a prediction-derived update from its behavioral value and show why implementation analysis and live interventions are both needed to assess test-time memory.

</details>


### [249] [A Survey of Flow Matching in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16275)
*Nabuat Zaman Nahim,Fairoz Nower Khan,Peizhong Ju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于流匹配（Flow Matching, FM）在强化学习（RL）中应用的综述，提出一个双轴分类体系，并梳理前沿方向与开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流匹配近年成为RL中高效、可表达多模态策略的生成式建模框架，相较扩散策略推理延迟更低、更易融入RL目标；但相关研究在离线连续控制、在线微调与基础模型对齐等方向快速扩张，文献高度碎片化，缺乏系统性梳理。

Method: 综述性研究。沿两个维度组织文献：（1）所建模的目标分布，如动作策略、价值评论家、转移动态；（2）RL信号整合机制，如能量加权回归、基于流的策略梯度、组相对策略优化。并综述离散与非欧几里得动作空间等新兴前沿，且与高斯及扩散基线进行系统对比分析。

Result: 形成流匹配强化学习方法的全面分类体系，并给出与高斯、扩散基线的系统比较，同时梳理关键开放问题。具体性能数据未在摘要中呈现。

Conclusion: 该综述为下一代生成式强化学习与对齐研究提供了基础性路线图。

Abstract: Flow Matching (FM) has recently emerged as a principled and efficient generative modeling framework for reinforcement learning (RL), enabling expressive, multimodal policy parameterizations via deterministic probability transport. Compared to diffusion-based policies that rely on stochastic denoising chains, FM uses sampling based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with learned velocity fields, which can substantially reduce inference latency and simplify the incorporation of RL objectives. As research in flow-based RL rapidly accelerates across offline continuous control, online fine-tuning, and foundation model alignment, the literature has become highly fragmented. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive taxonomy of flow-matching approaches in reinforcement learning. We organize the literature along two axes: the target distribution being modeled (e.g., action policies, value critics, transition dynamics) and the mechanism of RL signal integration (e.g., energy-weighted regression, flow-based policy gradients, and group relative policy optimization). Furthermore, we survey emerging frontiers such as discrete and non-Euclidean action spaces, provide a systematic comparative analysis against Gaussian and diffusion baselines, and outline critical open problems. Ultimately, this survey serves as a foundational roadmap for the next generation of generative reinforcement learning and alignment.

</details>


### [250] [Fast Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss Transforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16289)
*Angelos Korakitis,Vasileios Nakos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出两种基于随机Hadamard变换组合的嵌入构造（第二阶段用高斯对角替代Rademacher），用于量化KV缓存，并证明了与Fast JL类似的维度与运行时间保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低大语言模型推理时的内存占用，量化是主要技术之一；QJL以1比特非对称量化压缩KV缓存并近似保持注意力所需内积。既有工作希望用结构化嵌入（如随机Hadamard变换组合）替代稠密高斯投影，同时保持相同嵌入维度。

Method: 构造两种基于随机Hadamard变换组合的嵌入：第二种对角采用高斯而非Rademacher。第一种加入高斯抖动以平滑量化器；第二种插入随机置换以正则化所得高斯测量的协方差结构。

Result: 第一种构造达到 m=O(ε^{-2}log^2(d/δ))；第二种在m受限条件下达到 m=O(ε^{-2}log(d/δ))；两者均可在 O(d log d) 时间内应用，并获得与非量化Fast JL类似的嵌入维度与运行时间保证。

Conclusion: 两种构造在保持结构化快速计算（O(d log d)）的同时改进了嵌入维度保证，为量化KV缓存场景提供了更高效的近似内积嵌入方案。

Abstract: Quantization has emerged as one of the primary techniques for reducing the memory footprint of large language models during inference. A prominent example is Quantized Johnson$-$Lindenstrauss (QJL), which compresses KV caches using 1-bit asymmetric quantization while approximately preserving the inner products required by the attention mechanism. Recent theoretical and practical work aims at replacing the dense Gaussian projections used by the aforementioned transforms with more structured embeddings $-$ such as compositions of randomized Hadamard transforms $-$ while retaining the same embedding dimension.
  In this paper, we introduce two constructions based on a composition of randomized Hadamard transforms, albeit with a Gaussian rather than Rademacher diagonal in the second stage. The first adds Gaussian dithering to smooth the quantizer, while the second inserts a random permutation to regularize the covariance structure of the resulting Gaussian measurements.
  We prove embedding-dimension and running-time guarantees analogous to those of Fast JL in the non-quantized setting. The first construction achieves $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log^2(d/δ))$, while the second achieves $m=O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(d/δ))$ under a restriction on $m$. Both constructions can be applied in $O(d\log d)$ time.

</details>


### [251] [SLDBench v2: Active Scaling Law Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16297)
*Lingbei Meng,Rui Huang,Zhirong Shen,Jinxin Liu,Lingxiao Jing,Haorui Chen,Yaosong Du,Haowei Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SLDBench v2，将 scaling law 发现基准从 8 个场景扩展到 127 个（并筛选出 30 个困难场景），同时引入“主动式”设定：智能体需自行决定运行哪些实验并支付其记录成本，结果显示主动设定下预测性能显著下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Scaling law 能从小规模实验预测大模型性能，但找到可靠的 law 本身需要大量昂贵实验。论文希望检验语言模型智能体能否在实验条件下自主发现 scaling law，从而评估其在 AI-for-AI 场景中辅助模型开发的能力。

Method: SLDBench v2 有两项扩展：(1) 语料从 8 个场景扩展到 127 个，覆盖语言模型预训练、下游性能和视觉-语言迁移，并筛选出 30 个参考幂律拟合 R² ≤ 0.8 的困难场景，代表至少 1.09×10²³ FLOPs 的源报告训练算力；(2) 引入主动式 scaling law 发现，智能体自主选择实验、支付记录成本（如训练 FLOPs），并在结果到来时修正 law，最终在与被动设定相同的隐藏外推目标上评分。

Result: 在 8 个前沿智能体系统上，中位 R² 从被动设定的 0.72–0.75 降至主动设定的 0.24–0.57，预测误差上升 1.5–4.7 倍（因系统而异）。智能体偏好廉价实验，平均仅花费全池成本的 8–44%；低成本采集有时能给出较强预测，但廉价购买也会导致外推所需的实验条件未被观测到。

Conclusion: 实验规划仍是智能体辅助模型开发的关键开放挑战，在盛行的 AI-for-AI 研究范式中尤为突出。

Abstract: Scaling laws predict large-model performance from small experiments, but finding a reliable law itself requires costly experiments. SLDBench tests whether language-model agents can discover scaling laws when all experimental results are given upfront. We introduce SLDBench v2 with two extensions. First, we expand the corpus from 8 to 127 scenarios spanning language-model pretraining, downstream performance, and vision-language transfer, and select 30 challenging scenarios on which a reference power-law fit reaches $R^2 \le 0.8$; they represent at least $1.09 \times 10^{23}$ FLOPs of source-reported training compute. Second, we introduce active scaling law discovery: an agent chooses which experiments to run, pays each one's recorded cost (e.g., training FLOPs), and revises its law as outcomes arrive, and is scored on the same hidden extrapolation targets as in the passive setting. Across 8 frontier agent systems, median $R^2$ drops from 0.72-0.75 (passive) to 0.24-0.57 (active), and prediction error rises 1.5-4.7 times, depending on the system. Agents favor cheap experiments, spending 8-44% of the full-pool cost on average; low-cost acquisition can yield strong predictions, but cheap purchases also leave experimental conditions needed for extrapolation unobserved. Experimental planning thus remains a key open challenge for agents that assist model development in the prevailing AI-for-AI study.

</details>


### [252] [BehaviorFormer: Discovering Behavioral Patterns via Clusterable Next-Token Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16322)
*Tobias Schneider,Danial Fahrner,Soren Antebi,Daniel Uedelhoven,Lennard Bodden,Sandra Halscheidt,Rafet Sifa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文扩展了下一词预测Transformer，结合深度聚类算法DCSS，在开放世界游戏（Minecraft）中学习具有良好分离性的行为表征，发现了23种跨玩家泛化的行为模式，并归纳为七类可解释行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放世界游戏缺乏明确目标和真实标注，使得行为模式发现具有挑战性；现有自监督表征虽有结构，但缺乏清晰可分的聚类结构。

Method: 将深度聚类算法DCSS与下一词预测Transformer相结合，在受控的Minecraft多人会话（26名玩家）数据上学习具有良好分离聚类的表征。

Result: 方法识别出23种不同的行为模式，这些模式在研究的玩家间具有泛化性，并将自监督表征中的隐含结构进一步细化为清晰可分的聚类；聚类被归为七类可解释类别：静止、游荡、旅行、挖矿、基地工作、伐木和耕作。

Conclusion: 在无明确目标的开放世界游戏中，融合深度聚类的自监督Transformer能够有效发现可泛化且可解释的行为模式，为无标注行为分析提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Discovering behavioral patterns in open-ended games is challenging due to the lack of clear objectives or ground-truth annotations. In this work, we extend a next-token prediction Transformer with the deep clustering algorithm DCSS to learn meaningful representations with well-separated clusters. In a controlled Minecraft session with 26 players, the method discovers 23 distinct behavioral patterns that generalize across the studied players, further refining structures present in self-supervised representations into clearly separable clusters. We group the clusters into seven interpretable categories covering stationary, roaming, travel, mining, base work, logging, and farming behavior.

</details>


### [253] [Probabilistic Simulation of Gas-Liquid Interfaces with Coupled Flow Matching on Spherical Harmonics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16327)
*Kiet Bennema ten Brinke,Rachna Ramesh,Douwe Orij,Ivo Roghair,Vlado Menkovski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种神经代理模型，用紧凑共享表征联合预测气泡轨迹与界面变形，将高保真两相流模拟转化为快速条件生成推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气泡流中气泡运动、变形与流体动力学相互作用强耦合，网格分辨的高保真模拟（如DNS/Front-Tracking）计算开销极大，难以高效预测气泡群演化。

Method: 将预测建模为条件生成问题而非确定性回归，单次前向即可生成完整未来时间窗口；采用紧凑共享表征联合输出气泡轨迹与界面变形；在Front-Tracking数据集BubbleSH上训练与评测，使用轨迹、形状及分布性指标评估运动学、形态学与相互作用特性。

Result: 代理模型能复现关键流动统计特征，同时运行速度比底层DNS求解器快数个数量级。

Conclusion: 神经生成式代理可有效替代昂贵的网格分辨模拟，实现气泡群轨迹与变形的快速高保真预测，为气泡流高效仿真提供可行路径。

Abstract: Bubbly flows involve strongly coupled bubble motion, deformation, and hydrodynamic interactions, making high-fidelity simulation computationally expensive. We propose a neural surrogate that jointly predicts bubble trajectories and interface deformation in a compact, shared representation, replacing costly mesh-resolved simulation with fast generative inference. Because two-phase flow dynamics is nonlinear and chaotic, we treat forecasting as a conditional generative problem rather than deterministic regression, predicting entire future windows in a single pass. We train and evaluate the surrogate on BubbleSH, a Front-Tracking dataset of rising deformable bubble swarms, assessing performance using trajectory, shape, and distributional metrics over kinematic, morphological, and interaction-based properties. The surrogate reproduces key flow statistics while running several orders of magnitude faster than the underlying DNS solver.

</details>


### [254] [Rescuing Points Trapped Inside Incorrect Decision Regions: A target for Evaluating and Improving Forward-Forward Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16347)
*Alireza Rahmansetayesh,Amirhossein Yousefiramandi,Maxwell Spiridonov,Sumit Raut,Kent Ziti,Pierre Baldi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 前向-前向学习的评估不能仅靠线性探针准确率：未训练网络的表征已显著高于随机水平。作者提出基于边界邻近指数（BPI）的分析方法，发现初始误分类点中靠近决策边界的点更易被"拯救"，而不同方法在纠正深度嵌入错误点的能力上差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前向-前向学习及其变体主要以分类准确率（常通过线性探针）评估。但单一准确率会高估学习方法的贡献——未训练的卷积网络表征上线性探针已远超随机水平，且准确率无法揭示哪些数据点被纠正、哪些仍误分类。因此需要超越准确率的评估方法来刻画学习相对于随机基线的真实贡献。

Method: 提出基于边界邻近指数（BPI）的分析方法。BPI是一种多分类间隔，以类质心作为参照进行归一化。将该分析应用于七种前向-前向变体及相关的层局部方法，考察初始误分类点的"拯救率"与其在探针决策边界附近位置的关系。

Result: 初始误分类点中，靠近探针决策边界的点通常比深处错误决策区域内部的点具有更高的拯救率。拯救率在不同方法间差异显著，部分方法能纠正相当比例深度嵌入错误区域的点。

Conclusion: 该分析提供了超越准确率来评估表征学习的方式，并将"拯救深处错误决策区域内部的点"确立为改进局部学习方法的目标。

Abstract: Forward-Forward learning replaces end-to-end backpropagation with local, layer-wise training objectives. Its variants are evaluated primarily by classification accuracy, often measured with linear probes trained on their representations. We show that this evaluation can over-credit the learning method: a linear probe on the representations of an untrained convolutional neural network already reaches accuracy well above chance. Moreover, a single accuracy value does not reveal which datapoints become correctly classified after training and which remain misclassified. To examine what learning contributes beyond the random, untrained baseline, we present an analysis methodology built on the Boundary Proximity Index (BPI), a multiclass margin normalized by a class-centroid reference. We apply our analysis to seven Forward-Forward variants and related layer-local methods and find that initially misclassified points near the probe's decision boundary generally have higher rescue rates than those farther inside incorrect decision regions. Rescue rates vary substantially across methods, with some correcting a substantial fraction of these deeply embedded points. Together, these analyses offer a way to evaluate representation learning beyond accuracy and identify the rescue of points far inside incorrect decision regions as a target for improving local learning methods.

</details>


### [255] [DWI Connectome-based Sex Classification in Young using Supervised Variational Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16348)
*Aditya Kothapalli,Aaryan Gera,Sathvik Reddy,Ninad Aithal,Debanjali Bhattacharya,Neelam Sinha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于787名15–25岁年轻成人的DWI结构连接组（82个Desikan-Killiany图谱ROI），采用监督变分自编码器（SVAE）提取潜空间特征并进行性别分类，MLP取得80%最高准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 青春期大脑发育受激素变化显著影响，性别间在脑结构与功能上存在差异；已有研究虽探讨过这些差异，但缺乏对DWI连接组进行紧凑、正则化潜表示的性别分类建模，本文旨在引入SVAE学习此类表示以提升性别判别效果。

Method: 研究对象为787名15–25岁年轻成人，使用DWI结构连接组数据，选取Desikan-Killiany图谱的82个ROI。采用监督变分自编码器（SVAE）从DWI连接组中提取潜空间特征，并进行初步探索性数据分析以观察性别特异性潜空间模式；随后将SVAE潜特征输入多种机器学习分类器（包括多层感知机MLP等）完成性别分类。

Result: 探索性分析显示SVAE潜特征能够捕捉性别特异性的潜空间模式；在所用机器学习分类器中，多层感知机（MLP）表现最佳，性别分类准确率达80%。

Conclusion: SVAE能够从DWI连接组中学习紧凑且信息量高的表示，有效用于性别分类；研究展示了DWI脑连接组学结合深度学习区分性别的潜力，并为未来在包括跨性别个体在内的多样化人群中研究性别相关脑结构变异提供了方向。

Abstract: During adolescence, significant changes in brain development are influenced by hormonal changes that impact both the body and the brain. This study presents sex classification in 787 young adults having age range of 15-25 years using Diffusion-weighted (DWI) structural connectome, focusing on 82 Desikan-Killiany atlas ROIs. A supervised variational autoencoder (SVAE) is used to extract latent space features from DWI connectome data. Although several studies explored differences in brain structure and function between sexes, the main contribution of this study lies in incorporating SVAE to learn a compact, regularized latent representation for the task of sex classification. Initial exploratory data analysis shows that these features can capture the differences in sex-specific latent space patterns. Subsequently, the learned latent space SVAE features are fed to different ML models for sex classification. Among the considered ML classifiers, the multi-layer perceptron yields the highest accuracy of 80% in classifying sex. This demonstrates the effectiveness of SVAE in learning compact, informative representations from DWI connectome for sex classification. The present work highlights the potential of using DWI brain connectomics and deep learning to differentiate sex, paving the way for future research on diverse populations that may include transgender individuals, to better understand sex-related variations in brain structure.

</details>


### [256] [A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16352)
*LoonSage Team,Bowei Song,Caiwei Zhao,Chuwen Liu,Dechuang Gu,Dong Fang,Feiyu Xie,Huaiyu Li,Hui Zhang,Jian Tian,Jian Wang,Jie Zhao,Liguang Li,Maoyun Wang,Meiyan Yang,Minghan Zhu,Pai Liu,Pandeng Yao,Renbao Tian,Ru Yang,Shuai Jia,Shuai Tan,Shuailong Li,Shuliang Li,Teng Jin,Tianze Yang,Wenbo Cui,Wenjing Bai,Wenkang Wu,Xiaowei Jiang,Xiaoyi Dong,Yanpeng Wang,Yanwen Wang,Yaohui Ma,Yawen Wang,Yihang Zhang,Yingjie Yan,Zhanbiao Lian,Zhenyu Lu,Zhida Hu,Zhihui Hao,Zhihui Hu,Zhiwen Xiao,Zhiyi Gao,Zhongwei Qi,Zhuangzhuang Wu,Ziqian Liu,Ziyue Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 LoongSage，一个面向智能体任务的原生异步强化学习框架。其核心约 14K 行代码，基于 Megatron 训练与 SGLang 推理，通过单控制器编排、AgentFlow 统一执行范式、滑动窗口与 TransferMesh 同步机制实现高效异步训练，并支持多教师在线策略蒸馏。四组完整训练实验表明任务奖励稳定提升、训练-推理差距受控且硬件利用率高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型能力前沿从静态推理转向智能体任务（外部工具调用、多轮交互、长视野决策），现有主流强化学习框架变得愈发笨重，导致采用、使用与调试的开销显著上升，亟需更轻量、更贴合智能体场景的框架。

Method: LoongSage 采用智能体原生、全异步架构，核心约 14K 行代码。训练基于 Megatron 分布式训练，推理基于 SGLang 高吞吐推理；编排集中于单一控制器进程，所有驻留 GPU 组件封装为 Ray actor。提出 AgentFlow 统一执行范式，统一编排白盒与黑盒智能体；引入滑动窗口策略限制轨迹陈旧度；采用 TransferMesh 拓扑感知同步机制，在每步后为各接收者选择最快传输路径分发权重。此外引入内存高效的 Teacher Manager，将教师模型扩展与 GPU 显存约束解耦，原生支持多教师在线策略蒸馏。

Result: 在四组完整训练（涵盖复杂强化学习与多教师蒸馏）的评测中，任务奖励持续稳定提升，训练-推理差距始终处于受控状态；全异步流水线消除了同步空闲气泡，维持了较高的硬件利用率。

Conclusion: LoongSage 以轻量核心与全异步设计有效降低了智能体强化学习框架的采用、使用与调试开销，兼顾训练稳定性与硬件效率，并为多教师在线策略蒸馏提供了内存可扩展的原生支持。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

</details>


### [257] [LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16368)
*Zhixiong Zhao,Zukang Xu,Xing Hu,Lifeng Liu,Guangyu Sun,Dawei Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LoopQuant: 面向循环语言模型的循环感知训练后量化框架


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型（LoopLM）通过递归复用共享Transformer模块提升参数效率，但其在不断演化的循环状态上重复计算，给低比特部署带来新挑战。已有PTQ方法主要针对前馈Transformer设计，无法处理跨循环激活动态、循环间敏感度异质性和递归误差传播，导致低精度下性能显著下降。

Method: LoopQuant包含三个核心组件：1）跨循环分布规范化（CLDC），学习跨循环状态的共享量化友好表示，同时保持参数共享；2）交互感知的循环级精度分配（ILPA），在固定比特预算下通过建模任务级循环敏感度与跨循环交互来分配激活精度；3）循环条件任务校准（LCTC），通过轻量级任务空间校准使量化推理与低比特递归轨迹对齐。

Result: 在多种LoopLM架构上，LoopQuant持续优于现有低比特PTQ方法。在Ouro-2.6B上，W4A4的LoopQuant性能超过所有W4A8基线，模型内存降低65.3%，相比朴素INT4仅增加3.4%存储开销，并相对BF16实现1.7倍解码加速。

Conclusion: LoopQuant在精度、压缩与推理效率之间实现了良好均衡，为低比特LoopLM推理提供了实用且部署友好的方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared Transformer modules, yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, largely designed for feed-forward Transformers, fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics, heterogeneous loop sensitivity, and recursive error propagation, leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. To address these challenges, we propose LoopQuant, a loop-aware PTQ framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of LoopLMs. LoopQuant is built on three core components: 1) Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization (CLDC) learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing; 2) Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation (ILPA) allocates activation precision under a fixed bit budget by modeling task-level loop sensitivity and cross-loop interactions; and 3) Loop-Conditioned Task Calibration (LCTC) further aligns quantized inference with the low-bit recursive trajectory through lightweight task-space calibration. Extensive experiments across LoopLM architectures demonstrate that LoopQuant consistently outperforms existing low-bit PTQ methods. On Ouro-2.6B, LoopQuant under W4A4 surpasses all W4A8 baselines in performance, while reducing model memory by 65.3% with only 3.4% additional storage overhead over naive INT4 and achieving a 1.7 times decoding speedup over BF16. These results demonstrate a strong balance among accuracy, compression, and inference efficiency, providing a practical and deployment-friendly solution for low-bit LoopLM inference. The code is available at [https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant].

</details>


### [258] [Sampling from Neural Operator Priors to Solve Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16396)
*Andrew Millard,Joshua Murphy,Zheng Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将神经算子先验与伪自举序贯蒙特卡洛（pBS SMC）结合，并提出基于DPM++改进的引导提议分布，用于在函数空间中求解偏微分方程。在五个基准PDE系统上，该提议分布在所有测试步数下取得最优误差-时间权衡；配合pBS后在多数反问题设置中误差最低，少步采样时增益最显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE的自然求解空间是函数空间，近期研究将稀疏观测与PDE残差引导采样同神经算子先验结合。然而引导采样框架需要合适的提议分布，现有方法在密度不可直接计算的情形下受限，且采样效率（步数）与精度之间的权衡有待优化。

Method: 将神经算子先验与伪自举序贯蒙特卡洛（pBS SMC）配对，该框架支持无法获得可解密度的提议分布；并改造DPM++算法，使其适配引导采样场景，形成一种新的提议分布。

Result: 在五个基准PDE系统上，新提议分布在所有测试步数下均取得最优的误差-时间权衡；将其嵌入pBS后，在大多数反问题设置中误差最低，且在采样步数较少时增益最大。

Conclusion: 改造DPM++得到的引导提议分布与pBS SMC结合，可在函数空间中高效、精确地求解PDE正反问题，尤其适用于采样预算有限的场景。

Abstract: Guided sampling with sparse observations and PDE residuals has recently been combined with neural operator priors to solve partial differential equations in function space, their natural setting. We pair such a prior with pseudo-bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo (pBS SMC), a guided sampling framework that accommodates proposals without tractable densities, and introduce a new proposal by adapting the DPM++ algorithm to the guidance setting. Across five benchmark PDE systems this proposal attains the best error--time trade-off at every step count tested, and wrapping it in pBS gives the lowest error on most inverse-problem settings, with the largest gains when few sampling steps are used.

</details>


### [259] [Learning $ω$-Powered Conditional Distributions with Importance-Weighted Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16419)
*Maciej Falkiewicz,Frantzeska Lavda,Jason Ramapuram,Alexandros Kalousis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究能否显式学习CFG所隐含的指数加权目标分布，提出IW-CFM方法，通过对条件流匹配样本按密度比重新加权来逼近该目标，并在合成数据与ImageNet上验证其优于匹配引导的CFG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG常被解释为对ω次幂条件分布的采样（ω=γ），但CFG一般并不能精确地从该分布采样。作者试图探究能否显式地学习这一幂次目标分布，从而更准确地刻画出CFG所隐含的分布。

Method: 提出重要性加权条件流匹配（IW-CFM）：利用冻结的条件与无条件流模型得到密度比，对条件流匹配样本重新加权。在精确归一化权重下，其目标梯度等价于在幂次目标上的流匹配梯度；实践中采用自归一化估计与针对高维数据的正则化经验近似，并训练轻量级amortized corrector。

Result: 在合成分布上，IW-CFM能恢复解析的幂次目标，而数值匹配的CFG（γ=ω）存在明显偏差；在ImageNet上，amortized轻量corrector与对应加权/过滤参考分布的对齐优于固定引导和匹配引导的CFG。另外，对真实ImageNet数据的CLIP分析显示，不同提示对比下存在整体偏移，同时类别响应异质，甚至出现非单调轨迹。

Conclusion: 研究为探究和近似模型定义的幂次条件分布提供了一条实用路径，表明显式学习加权目标比直接使用CFG更接近其理论目标分布。

Abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) with guidance scale $γ$ is commonly motivated by the $ω$-powered conditional distribution obtained by setting $ω=γ$, but CFG does not, in general, sample from this distribution exactly. We study whether the powered target can instead be learned explicitly. We introduce Importance-Weighted Conditional Flow Matching (IW-CFM), which reweights conditional flow-matching examples using density ratios obtained from frozen conditional and unconditional flow models. With exact normalized weights, the resulting objective has the same gradient as flow matching on the powered target; in practice, we use self-normalized estimation and a regularized empirical approximation for high-dimensional data. On synthetic distributions, IW-CFM recovers analytical powered targets for which numerically matched CFG, $γ=ω$, exhibits a visible mismatch. On ImageNet, an amortized lightweight corrector achieves better alignment than fixed- and matched-guidance CFG with the corresponding weighted and filtered reference distributions. We additionally present an exploratory CLIP analysis of powered-density rankings on real ImageNet data. Aggregate shifts across selected prompt-specific contrasts coexist with heterogeneous classwise responses, including nonmonotonic trajectories. These results provide a practical route for studying and approximating model-defined powered conditional distributions.

</details>


### [260] [Resample the Answer: Where to Spend Test-Time Compute in Recursive Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16427)
*Maxime Illouz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Gated Answer Resampling (GAR)，仅对 TRM 的答案状态 y 进行门控重采样并配合其自带的停机头，无需训练或调参，即在大幅超越扰动 z 的方法同时显著节省测试时算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归推理模型（如 TRM）通过迭代精化答案状态 y 与推理状态 z 来求解任务，其失败常被归因于"坏盆地"——将递归困在错误答案的潜空间区域。现有测试时方法分别扰动 y、z 或二者兼施以求恢复，但不同扰动目标对性能、测试时算力效率与扩展性的影响尚无系统结论。

Method: 在 TRM 上进行受控实验，比较在同等算力（深度与宽度）下分别重采样 y 与扰动 z 的恢复效果；据此提出 GAR：将答案状态 y 的重采样与模型自身的停机头（halting head）配对，仅对停机头判定为拒绝的题目进行重启，每道题最多 64 次重启，且不进行训练或超参数搜索。

Result: 失败轨迹的失败信息承载于答案状态中；同等算力下重采样 y 的失败恢复量高于所测试的任何 z 扰动，且算力预算越大差距越明显。GAR 将 TRM 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上从 85.9% 提升至 99.4%，在 Pencil Puzzle Bench 验证集上从 68.8% 提升至 85.6%。在相同检查点上，即便 PTRM 使用 42–197 倍算力，GAR 仍优于该逐步扰动 z 的方法。

Conclusion: 答案状态 y 是递归推理失败的关键载体，针对 y 的门控重采样是更有效且更算力高效的测试时纠错策略；GAR 无需训练或调参即可带来一致性的大幅提升，并对扰动 z 的方法在效率上形成显著优势。

Abstract: Recursive reasoning models such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) iteratively refine two latent states: an answer state y, decoded into the output, and a reasoning state z, which is never decoded. Many of their failures have been attributed to bad basins, regions of latent space that trap the recursion on wrong answers. Recent test-time approaches perturb y, z or both to recover these failures, but the impact of this choice on performance, test-time compute efficiency and scaling properties remains unclear. Through controlled experiments on TRM, we find that a failed trajectory carries its failure in its answer state. At equal compute, in depth and in width, resampling y recovers more failures than any perturbation of z we tested, and the performance gap widens as the test-time compute budget grows. Our approach, Gated Answer Resampling (GAR), pairs this resampling of the answer state with the model's own halting head and restarts only the puzzles that the head rejects. With at most 64 restarts per puzzle and no training or hyperparameter search, GAR takes TRM from 85.9% to 99.4% on Sudoku-Extreme and from 68.8% to 85.6% on Pencil Puzzle Bench validation. On the same checkpoints, GAR also outperforms Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), which perturbs z at each step, even when PTRM uses 42 to 197 times as much compute.

</details>


### [261] [ECHO: Correcting Time Series Foundation Model Forecasts with Historical Analogues and Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16433)
*Boya Zhang,Xilin Dai,Yilin Wang,Qiang Xu,Luyao Dong,Xing He,Wen Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ECHO黑盒预测校正框架，融合历史相似片段与历史预测误差两类互补信号，在5个TSFM和9个数据集上均降低MSE，平均宏平均相对降低9.26%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）虽提供通用预测能力，但其输出可能与目标领域的时间特征不匹配；在仅有黑盒访问权限时，需要一种轻量化的预测校正方法。

Method: 基于"两类历史信息互补"的观察——历史类比揭示相似上下文如何演化，历史预测误差揭示TSFM在目标域的系统性偏差——设计ECHO框架。包含AnalogE：结合检索到的历史类比、当前上下文与基础预测，通过跨域预训练学习可迁移校正；RecentE：从历史预测误差中学习目标域专属残差校正，并随因果可得反馈累积不断精化；两者按各自观测到的预测表现动态加权组合。

Result: 在5个代表性TSFM与9个真实数据集构成的45个骨干-数据集组合中，MSE全部下降，宏平均MSE平均相对降低9.26%；收益同样延伸至长时程预测。

Conclusion: ECHO无需访问TSFM内部参数即可实现轻量、通用且稳定的预测校正，验证了历史类比与近期误差信号互补融合的有效性与跨模型、跨数据集的可扩展性。

Abstract: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) provide general-purpose forecasting capabilities, yet their forecasts can remain misaligned with the temporal characteristics of a target domain. This motivates lightweight forecast correction even when only black-box access to the TSFM is available. Our key observation is that two forms of historical information provide complementary correction signals: historical analogues reveal how similar contexts evolved, while past forecast errors reveal a TSFM's characteristic deviations in the target domain. Based on this observation, we propose ECHO, a black-box forecast correction framework that learns from both sources. ECHO uses AnalogE to assess retrieved historical analogues together with the current context and base forecast, learning transferable corrections through cross-domain pretraining. In parallel, RecentE learns target-specific residual corrections from past forecast errors and refines them as causally available feedback accumulates. ECHO dynamically combines the two corrections according to their observed forecasting performance. Across 5 representative TSFMs and 9 real-world datasets, ECHO reduces MSE in all 45 backbone--dataset settings, yielding an average relative reduction of 9.26\% in macro-average MSE. Its gains also extend to long-horizon forecasting.

</details>


### [262] [StructZO: Structured Zeroth-Order Optimization for Memory-Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16451)
*Xuanlin Yang,Jia Li,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: StructZO 是一种结构化零阶优化框架，通过在激活诱导的信息子空间内进行大查询零阶估计并施加谱控制，将有效估计维度从 mn 降至 mr，显著缩小零阶与一阶优化在大模型微调中的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型微调的显存瓶颈主要来自反向传播。零阶优化器仅依赖前向评估以降低显存开销，但仍与 Adam 等一阶优化器存在明显性能差距。作者认为该差距不仅源于缺少显式梯度，还因为一阶微调受益于有信息的低秩优化几何、大规模信号聚合以及良态更新方向。

Method: StructZO 在激活诱导的信息子空间内执行大查询零阶估计，对降维后的更新施加谱控制，再映射回原始参数空间；从而在紧凑、几何感知的空间中聚合方向信号，同时避免反向传播的激活与优化器状态显存开销。

Result: 理论上，当诱导子空间捕获集中的优化相关方向时，StructZO 将有效零阶估计维度从 mn 降至 mr，剩余投影误差由激活 Gram 矩阵的谱尾控制。实验上，在 OPT 系列与 Llama3.1-8B 的多项下游任务中，较最强零阶基线平均相对提升最高 8.7%，单任务最高 26.9%，平均性能与一阶 Adam 差距在 1.5% 以内。

Conclusion: 结构化且带谱控制的零阶更新可大幅缩小零阶与一阶优化之间的差距，为显存高效的大模型微调提供了有效途径。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models at scale is increasingly limited by the memory cost of backpropagation. Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimizers reduce this burden by relying only on forward function evaluations, but they still exhibit a substantial performance gap to first-order (FO) optimizers such as Adam. We argue that this gap does not arise solely from the absence of explicit gradients: FO fine-tuning also benefits from informative low-rank optimization geometry, large-scale signal aggregation, and well-conditioned update directions. Motivated by this, we introduce StructZO, a structured Zeroth-Order optimization framework for memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning. StructZO performs large-query ZO estimation within an activation-induced informative subspace and applies spectral control to the resulting reduced-space update before mapping it back to the original parameters. This lets ZO aggregate useful directional signals in a compact, geometry-aware space while avoiding the activation and optimizer-state memory costs of backpropagation. We show theoretically that, when the induced subspace captures concentrated optimization-relevant directions, StructZO reduces the effective ZO estimation dimension from $mn$ to $mr$, with the remaining projection error governed by the spectral tail of the activation Gram matrix. Empirically, across OPT-series and Llama3.1-8B on diverse downstreamtasks, StructZO improves over the strongest existing ZO baselines by up to $8.7%$ relative on average and up to $26.9%$ relative on individual tasks, while remaining within $1.5%$ of FO-Adam on average. These results suggest that structured and spectrally controlled ZO updates can substantially narrow the gap between ZO and FO optimization.

</details>


### [263] [SLEM: Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16484)
*Dohyeon Kim,Bedionita Soro,Bruno Andreis,Sung Ju Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无需校准数据的专家合并框架SLEM，在VAE潜空间中基于权重谱合并MoE专家，兼顾通用知识与生成任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型虽能高效扩展容量，但需存储全部参数，显存开销大。现有专家合并压缩方法存在两个缺陷：(i) 参数空间直接凸插值未必对应专家函数的有意义插值；(ii) 专家相似度或合并系数估计依赖校准数据，受校准分布影响。

Method: SLEM（Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging）：一种免校准的专家合并框架。利用VAE将专家权重编码为结构化潜表示；基于潜空间相似度在层内与跨层对专家分组；由专家权重谱导出合并系数；执行几何感知的潜空间插值，并解码为合并后的专家权重。

Result: 与现有专家合并方法相比，SLEM在通用知识基准上取得相当或更优的表现，在包含数学推理与代码生成的生成类基准上取得更高的平均性能。

Conclusion: 通过将专家合并转移到VAE潜空间并利用权重谱确定合并系数，SLEM在不依赖校准数据的前提下实现了更有效的专家压缩与合并，尤其利于生成类任务。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale model capacity efficiently by activating only a small subset of experts for each input, while still requiring all parameters to be stored in memory, resulting in substantial memory overhead. Expert merging techniques have recently emerged as a promising compression paradigm that reduces this overhead by consolidating multiple experts into a smaller set. However, existing approaches have two key limitations: (i) direct convex interpolation in parameter space is not generally guaranteed to yield meaningful interpolation of expert functions; and (ii) estimating expert similarity or merging coefficients often relies on calibration data, introducing dependence on the calibration distribution. To address these limitations, we propose Spectrum-Aware Latent Expert Merging (SLEM), a calibration-free expert merging framework that occurs in a structured latent representation of expert weights using a VAE. SLEM groups experts within and across layers based on latent similarities and derives merging coefficients from expert weight spectra. It then performs geometry-aware latent interpolation and decodes the resulting representations into merged expert weights. Compared with existing expert merging methods, SLEM achieves comparable or better performance on general knowledge benchmarks and higher average performance on generation benchmarks involving mathematical reasoning and code generation.

</details>


### [264] [Growing and Transferring Pathways for LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16489)
*Haolin Tian,Yikang Li,Tonghan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GrowRL 通过结构化增长将 RL 学习到的更新组织为紧凑的计算通路，实现跨模型复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 能显著提升大语言模型推理能力，但一次有效训练耗费大量资源，若能跨模型复用 RL 所获得的计算则可放大训练价值。

Method: 冻结预训练主干，在每个 Transformer 层加入独立的因果注意力分支和前馈网络分支；零初始化输出投影以在初始化时保持预训练策略不变，RL 仅更新新增通路；学习到的通路保持显式结构，可迁移至结构兼容的目标模型并在冻结目标主干下继续适配，并支持通路的顺序迁移。

Result: 在五个主干上实验，以少量可训练参数取得有竞争力的数学推理与分布外性能；学习到的通路在三个迁移方向上均带来即时增益，每个方向上仅 10 次目标侧更新后的性能已接近 100 次更新的水平。

Conclusion: 计算通路可作为参数高效且可复用的强化学习适配单元。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but an effective training run requires considerable resources. Reusing the computation acquired through RL across models would extend the value of that training. We propose GrowRL, an RL method that organizes learned updates into compact computational pathways through structural growth. GrowRL freezes the pretrained backbone and adds an independent causal attention branch and a feed-forward network branch at each Transformer layer. Zero-initialized output projections preserve the pretrained policy at initialization, and RL updates only the added pathways. The learned pathways remain explicit after training, allowing transfer to structurally compatible target models and subsequent adaptation with the target backbone frozen. The architecture also supports sequential transfer of additional pathways. By keeping the learned attention and feed-forward computation separate from the pretrained weights, GrowRL provides an explicit structure for preserving and reusing the outcome of an RL run. Experiments across five backbones show competitive mathematical reasoning and out-of-distribution performance with a small number of trainable parameters. Learned pathways provide immediate gains across all three transfer directions, with performance after only 10 target-side updates already close to that after 100 updates in every case. These results support computational pathways as parameter-efficient and reusable units of reinforcement learning adaptation.

</details>


### [265] [Drafting Agents, Not Just Tokens: Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16491)
*Xin Xu,Ke Cheng,Hao Wang,Yangru Huang,Yanghao Xiao,Zhichao Chen,Zhisheng Zhong,Xun Liu,Yi Li,Qian Li,Haibin Lv,Jun Zhang,Jie Jiang,Zhouchen Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI)，在有限预算下先草拟可执行的后续代理、再要求通过完整验证方可采纳，并配合 VATS 与 GVO 实现探索与评估的平衡，在多项实验中超越 Janus、MetaRSI-v1 与 HGM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提升代理需要连续修订，但在有限预算下难以权衡探索与评估：搜索范围过窄会遗漏有效的编辑序列，而完整评估每个中间版本又会在序列产生已验证改进前耗尽预算。

Method: 提出 Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI)：在前代尚未完全评估前即草拟可执行的后续代理，但采纳前要求完整验证；使用 Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) 依据续接的预测验证回报在进一步编辑与待完成检查之间分配预算；使用 Group Verification Optimization (GVO) 在已完成的搜索上学习改进器，同时保持真实评估器固定。

Result: 在主科学对比中，终端增益超过 Janus 33.3%–40.0%；在全部 50 个科学主干—任务对上优于 Janus，并在二十个主干上以 1.85%–2.38% 的宏平均系统分优势超过 MetaRSI-v1；编码验证成功率达 69.4%，高于 HGM 的 64.3%，且目标成本指数低 20.8%。

Conclusion: SpecRSI 通过“先草拟、后验证”的推测式递归自我改进机制，结合预算感知的树搜索与分组验证优化，在有限预算下有效平衡探索与评估，并在科学推理与编码验证任务上取得一致的性能提升与成本优势。

Abstract: Improving an agent through successive revisions requires balancing exploration and evaluation under a limited budget. A narrow search can miss useful sequences of edits, while fully evaluating every intermediate version can exhaust the budget before those sequences yield a verified improvement. We introduce Speculative Recursive Self-Improvement (SpecRSI), which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption. Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) allocates the budget between further edits and outstanding checks using the predicted verified return of a continuation. Group Verification Optimization (GVO) learns the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed. In the main scientific comparison, terminal gains exceed Janus by 33.3%--40.0%. Additional evaluations show that SpecRSI outperforms Janus in all 50 scientific backbone--task pairs and exceeds MetaRSI-v1 by 1.85%--2.38% in macro-average system score across twenty backbones. Coding-validation success reaches 69.4% versus HGM's 64.3% at a 20.8% lower target-cost index.

</details>


### [266] [pi-Net: Empirical Latent Representations for Differentiable Physics Heads in Data-Scarce Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16504)
*Akshay Dhalpe,Arnab Chattopadhyay,Shahriar Bakrani Balani,Eric Cortanéa,Sasu Tarkoma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出pi-Net物理信息潜变量模型，用编码器把输入映射到物理归一化潜空间，再由可微物理头解码，在数据稀缺的GMAW焊接案例中以60个样本取得R²=0.864，优于纯数据驱动基线并提供因果可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多物理系统可靠预测面临两难：物理仿真器计算代价高，纯机器学习方法依赖大量数据且不透明。将量纲分析引入有向计算图可避免显式求解PDE，但此类构造通常产生欠定系统，只能充当不完美的仿真器，性能受限。

Method: 提出pi-Net——一种物理信息潜变量模型，用于求解上述不完美仿真器。其混合架构包含两部分：编码器将输入映射至物理归一化的潜空间，随后由可微的物理头（differentiable physics head）解码得到最终预测。整体通过端到端可微方式训练。

Result: 在真实且数据稀缺的熔化极气体保护焊（GMAW）案例中，仅用60个实验样本即达到R²=0.864。结果表明，在数据稀缺场景下pi-Net显著优于纯数据驱动基线，同时提供因果的、工艺层面的可解释性。

Conclusion: 将量纲分析与潜变量建模、可微物理解码结合，可在数据稀缺条件下构建兼具精度与可解释性的物理信息预测模型，为多物理系统建模提供了一条不依赖显式PDE求解的可行路径。

Abstract: Developing reliable predictive models for multi-physics systems often forces a compromise between computationally demanding physical simulators and data-hungry, opaque machine learning (ML) algorithms. While incorporating dimensional analysis into directed computation graphs offers a structurally sound alternative to explicitly solving partial differential equations (PDEs), such formulations typically yield underdetermined systems that act as imperfect simulators. We introduce pi-Net, a physics-informed latent variable model that resolves these imperfect simulators. The hybrid pi-Net architecture consists of an encoder that maps inputs into physically normalized latent space, which are then decoded into final predictions by a differentiable physics head. Evaluated on a real-world, data-scarce Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) case study, the framework achieves an R2 of 0.864 with only 60 experimental samples. The results demonstrate that pi-Net significantly outperforms purely data-driven baselines in data-scarce regimes while providing causal, process-level explainability.

</details>


### [267] [Asymptotic Risk of Learning-Rate Schedules for Least-Squares Regression with Discretely Distributed Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16518)
*Noé Colomban,Francis Bach,Fabian Schaipp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究流式最小二乘（Slock 模型）上 SGD 最后一次迭代的有限时间风险，给出常数与 WSD 学习率调度的精确渐近等价与缩放律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解 SGD 在最小二乘问题中最后一次迭代的风险行为，特别是不同学习率调度（常数 vs. Warmup-Stable-Decay）对风险缩放的影响，以及冷却阶段长度、批大小与训练时长之间的相互作用。

Method: 在具有离散分布特征的流式最小二乘（Slock 模型）上分析 SGD 的最后一次迭代，该设定将不同特征方向的动力学解耦；在幂律源条件与容量条件下，推导常数调度与 WSD 调度的精确有限时间风险与渐近等价表达式。

Result: 在调优基础学习率下，缩放律以 Θ(T^{-q}) 衰减，其中 q 与冷却长度 c∈(0,1] 无关，但对常数调度严格更小；任意固定相对长度 c>0 的冷却都能以多项式因子改善风险，其长度仅影响常数项，并在线性衰减（c=1）时最小化。最优风险仅通过 bT 依赖于批大小 b 与时长 T，直至临界批大小。

Conclusion: WSD 类调度中即使很短的冷却阶段也能带来多项式级别的风险改善，线性衰减（c=1）给出最优常数；批大小与时长的作用可归结为乘积 bT（至临界批大小），为学习率调度与批大小选择提供理论指导。

Abstract: We study the last iterate of stochastic gradient descent (SGD) on streaming least squares with discretely distributed features (Slock's model), which decouples the dynamics across eigendirections. Under power-law source and capacity conditions, we derive the exact finite-time risk and asymptotic equivalents of constant and Warmup-Stable-Decay (WSD) schedules. With a tuned base learning-rate, the resulting scaling law decays as $Θ(T^{-q})$, where $T$ is the horizon, and $q$ is independent of the cooldown length $c \in (0,1]$ but is strictly smaller for the constant schedule: any cooldown of fixed relative length $c > 0$, however short, improves the risk by a polynomial factor, while its length only affects the constant, which is minimized by linear decay ($c = 1$). Finally, we show that the optimal risk depends on the batch size $b$ and horizon $T$ only through $bT$, up to a critical batch size.

</details>


### [268] [Reinforcement Learning with Hawkes-Structured Networks for Market Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16524)
*Fernando Acero,Philipp Plank,Yufei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无模型强化学习框架，用于Hawkes订单流下的做市，并设计Hawkes结构网络（HSN）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实订单到达具有聚集、自激发的非马尔可夫Hawkes特征，传统做市方法难以刻画，需要兼顾理论保证与可扩展的表示学习。

Method: 先建立非渐近性能界，量化用有限指数加权特征近似无限维Hawkes状态的损失；据此提出HSN，用可学习的指数混合滤波器编码历史订单流，并通过无模型RL端到端联合优化特征表示与报价策略。

Result: 在单资产与多资产做市任务中，针对指数混合、幂律和状态切换核，HSN优于通用神经网络结构，获得更高交易奖励，并隐式恢复底层订单流强度。

Conclusion: 结构化神经表示与无模型RL结合，可有效处理一般Hawkes订单流并提升做市表现，同时保留可解释的强度恢复能力。

Abstract: Market making under realistic order-flow dynamics is challenging due to the clustered, self-exciting nature of order arrivals, which are naturally modeled by non-Markovian Hawkes processes. We propose a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) framework for market making with general Hawkes order-flow dynamics. We first establish non-asymptotic performance bounds that quantify the loss incurred by approximating the infinite-dimensional Hawkes state using a finite collection of exponentially weighted features. Guided by this analysis, we introduce the Hawkes-Structured Network (HSN), a novel neural architecture that encodes historical order flow through a learnable mixture-of-exponentials filter. HSN is trained end-to-end using model-free RL, jointly optimizing the feature representation and quoting policy directly from reward feedback. Experiments on single- and multi-asset market-making problems with mixture-of-exponentials, power-law, and regime-switching kernels demonstrate that HSN outperforms general-purpose neural architectures, achieving higher trading rewards while implicitly recovering the underlying order-flow intensities.

</details>


### [269] [Learning Graded Sparse Mechanisms: A Representation Theorem and Certified Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16537)
*Mark Kozdoba,Shie Mannor*

Main category: cs.LG
