Second, suppose the agent chooses a unit-vector action and the reward is a quadratic function of that vector. This could arise when an LLM judge scores a weighted consolidation of reasoning paths, or when coupled robotic sensors each respond to a mix of actions. Then some coherent policies earn strictly more expected reward than every classical policy with the same action probabilities, and we give the margin in closed form. In a two-action example, both policies assign probability $0.5$ to each action, yet the classical one earns expected reward $0$ while the coherent one earns $1$, the maximum. Outside these two settings, DMRL matches or transfers the classical results. This is a theory paper. All results are proved, and we report no empirical evaluation.

</details>


### [341] [Compute-optimal data scaling for neural surrogates via multi-fidelity training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17221)
*Paul Setinek,Fabian Paischer,Nils Thuerey,Johannes Brandstetter,Felix Koehler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将神经PDE代理模型的训练建模为固定数据生成算力预算下的数据量与保真度联合优化问题，提出多保真度训练可实现相对数据生成算力的帕累托最优误差缩放，在匹配高保真单保真训练精度的前提下最多节省6.3倍数据生成算力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经PDE代理模型通常依赖数值模拟器生成的合成数据训练。随着模型规模扩大与缩放定律要求更大数据集，数据生成成本往往超过训练成本，成为缩放瓶颈。与其他领域数据不同，每个PDE样本的成本可由其数值保真度调节，且成本-精度权衡遵循已知的收敛率，这一特性尚未被充分利用。

Method: 作者将神经代理模型训练形式化为在固定数据生成算力预算下，关于数据数量与数据保真度的函数，并把保真度视为细粒度离散谱而非二值区分。基于此，将低保真度模拟结果作为额外训练信号，构建最优保真度混合策略进行多保真度训练。

Result: 在数据生成算力约束下，多保真度训练实现了帕累托最优的误差缩放。采用最优保真度混合训练，其精度与仅使用高保真数据训练相当，而数据生成算力最多减少6.3倍。结论在六个PDE问题（涵盖结构化网格与非结构化网格）、两类误差来源（离散化误差与迭代求解器误差）以及四种代理模型架构上得到验证，累计超过7000次训练运行。

Conclusion: 多保真度训练是缓解PDE神经代理模型数据生成算力瓶颈的有效途径，可在不损失精度的前提下显著降低数据生成成本，为数据驱动的PDE求解提供了可扩展的训练范式。

Abstract: Neural surrogates for Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) are usually trained on synthetic data from numerical simulators. As models grow and scaling laws demand larger datasets, the cost of data generation often outweighs the training cost and becomes the bottleneck in the scaling quest. Unlike data in other domains, however, each PDE sample has a tunable cost that depends on its numerical fidelity, with the resulting cost-accuracy trade-off governed by known convergence rates. We exploit this property by formalizing neural surrogate training as a function of both data quantity and fidelity under a fixed data generation compute budget, treating fidelity as a fine-grained discrete spectrum rather than a binary distinction. Building on this, we show that multi-fidelity training enables Pareto-optimal error scaling against data generation compute. By using simulations at lower fidelities as an additional training signal, training on the optimal fidelity mixture matches the accuracy of high-fidelity-only training, with up to $6.3\times$ less data generation compute across our settings. We validate these findings across six PDE problems spanning structured grids and unstructured meshes, two distinct error sources (discretization and iterative-solver error), and four surrogate architectures, totaling over 7,000 training runs.

</details>


### [342] [MIRRA: Fast, High-Fidelity Molecular Generation with Chemistry-Informed Discrete Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17244)
*Ge Sun,Juan J. de Pablo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MIRRA 是一种离散流匹配分子生成器，通过化学特征共享与按需计算 identity 概率，在保留完整化学词汇的前提下实现快速、高保真的分子生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子生成需要准确的化学选择与高效采样。化学 building blocks 可缩小图规模，但使每个节点成为数万个相关 identity 中的选择，导致词汇量大、采样成本高。现有方法难以在保持全词汇可用的同时兼顾速度与保真度。

Method: 提出 MIRRA（Molecular Identity Representation, Refresh and Assembly），一种离散流匹配生成器：从化学知识中学习表示，仅在需要时评估 identity 概率，同时保持词汇表中每个 identity 可用；利用化学特征在相关 blocks 间共享信息，并通过学习到的 identity 修正模型在分子上下文中区分它们；采样器先决定哪些位置需要 refresh 再计算其概率，从而避免无用的预测，同时保持每个采样转移的完整性。

Result: 在各任务最强基线下，MIRRA 在 ZINC250k 上将化学分布误差降低 29-31%、图分布误差降低 53-60%，生成速度最高提升 8.6 倍；属性定向任务每秒获得的不同新颖命中数估计提升 7.8-20.8 倍；在留出的聚合物测试集上，实现 100% 周期性有效性且具有已知链拓扑，而聚合物 VAE 仅为 57.0%。

Conclusion: MIRRA 证明了在采样全程保持完整化学词汇可用的条件下，仍能实现快速且高保真的分子生成，在化学/图分布精度、采样速度与聚合物有效性等指标上全面优于现有方法。

Abstract: Fast, high-fidelity molecular generation requires accurate chemical choices and efficient sampling. Chemical building blocks reduce graph size, but make each node a choice among tens of thousands of related identities. We introduce MIRRA (Molecular Identity Representation, Refresh and Assembly), a discrete flow-matching generator that learns from chemical knowledge and evaluates identity probabilities only when needed, while keeping every identity in its vocabulary available. Chemical features share information across related blocks, and learned identity corrections distinguish them in molecular context. By deciding which positions will refresh before computing their probabilities, the sampler avoids unused predictions while preserving each sampling transition. Against the strongest baselines in each task, MIRRA reduces chemical and graph distribution errors on ZINC250k by 29-31% and 53-60%, respectively, with generation up to 8.6 times faster. Property targeting yields an estimated 7.8-20.8 times more distinct novel hits per second. On a held-out polymer test set, MIRRA achieves 100% periodic validity with known chain topology, versus 57.0% for a polymer variational autoencoder. These results demonstrate fast, high-fidelity generation with the full chemical vocabulary available throughout sampling.

</details>


### [343] [LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17246)
*Riccardo De Santi,Federico Di Gennaro,Angelo Gnazzo,Sophia Tang,Pranam Chatterjee,Fanny Yang,İsmail İlkan Ceylan,Michael M. Bronstein,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LLM-to-Flow Distillation（LFD）框架，用冻结LLM作为自适应教师，通过"子目标课程+LLM判断偏好+DPO蒸馏"，把领域特定流/扩散生成器对齐到自然语言表达的高层科学发现目标，无需显式代理奖励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学生成发现需要同时具备高层科学推理能力与满足设计空间结构的生成能力，但目前二者割裂：基础LLM拥有广博的化学/生物知识却不擅长生成结构合法样本，领域流/扩散生成器能捕捉有效序列与几何先验却缺乏高层推理与目标控制。实验科学中往往不存在可用的显式代理奖励，学习型预测器也难以准确刻画目标，因此如何在没有显式奖励的情况下把科学生成器对齐到自然语言发现目标，是核心问题。

Method: LFD以冻结LLM作为领域生成器的自适应教师。给定如"生成具有抗癌潜力的肽"的目标，教师构造感知流模型当前能力的中间子目标课程，逐步将生成器引向原始发现目标。每轮中，LLM在目标任务下评判采样候选，其判断转化为偏好，通过DPO（直接偏好优化）迭代蒸馏进生成器。该过程即使在初始模型对最终目标设计概率几乎为零时也能提供稠密学习信号，从而向覆盖不足、分布外区域迁移。

Result: 在治疗性肽设计与小分子结构设计两个任务上，LFD实现了新型生成控制能力，可将任意领域特定科学生成器对齐到以高层自然语言目标表达的科学发现任务。

Conclusion: 将LLM的高层科学推理与领域生成模型的结构先验解耦后再通过偏好蒸馏耦合，是无需显式奖励即可实现自然语言目标导向科学发现生成的可行路径，为通用科学生成控制提供了新范式。

Abstract: Generative discovery in science requires coupling high-level scientific reasoning with the ability to generate samples respecting the structure of a design space. Yet these capabilities remain largely separated: foundation LLMs encode broad chemical and biological knowledge, while domain-specific flow- and diffusion-based generators capture the priors needed to produce valid sequences and geometries. We study how to align such scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals without requiring an explicit proxy reward, which is often unavailable or poorly captured by learned predictors in experimental sciences. We introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), where a frozen LLM acts as an adaptive teacher for a domain-specific generator. Given a goal such as 'generate peptides with promising anticancer activity', the teacher constructs a curriculum of intermediate sub-goals aware of the flow's current capabilities, and progressively directs them toward the original discovery goal. At each round, the LLM judges sampled candidates under the current objective. These judgments induce preferences that are iteratively distilled into the generator through DPO. This procedure provides dense learning signals even when the initial model places negligible probability on designs satisfying the final goal, enabling adaptation toward poorly covered, out-of-distribution regions. Experiments on therapeutic peptides and small-molecule structure design demonstrate that LFD enables a new form of generative control: aligning arbitrary domain-specific scientific generators to scientific discovery tasks expressed via high-level natural-language goals.

</details>


### [344] [Protocol Choices Matter More Than the Aggregation Algorithm: Federated Learning for In-Hospital Mortality Prediction in Care-Unit and Multi-Hospital Federations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17265)
*Rodrigo Tertulino,Ricardo Almeida,Laércio Alencar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在同一流程与统一评估协议下比较七种联邦聚合策略（FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedAdagrad、FedAdam、FedYogi、FedCluster），在MIMIC-IV的12个护理单元与eICU-CRD的49家医院两个联邦上、跨10个随机种子用Friedman与Holm校正检验评估。SCAFFOLD在两个联邦及18个变体中的17个排名第一，但领先亚军不超过0.008，且其相对FedAvg的优势主要来自漂移校正。在护理单元联邦中，协议选择（出院编码预测变量、客户端级SMOTE、评估最后一轮）对判别力的影响超过算法选择；Platt缩放可修复由不平衡校正扭曲的风险且不损失判别力。结论：应先固定协议再排名算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习可让医院在不汇集病历的情况下训练共享死亡率模型，但已发表的聚合策略比较很少控制评估协议，导致算法间的差异可能与协议差异混淆，无法判断性能提升究竟来自算法还是来自预处理、评估口径等非算法因素。因此需要以单一流水线、统一调参、统一选模与重复种子检验，分离算法选择与协议选择对判别力的影响。

Method: 构建两个联邦：MIMIC-IV中某医院的12个护理单元，以及eICU-CRD的49家医院。比较七种聚合策略：FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD、FedAdagrad、FedAdam、FedYogi、FedCluster。所有策略在同一流程下调参与按同一规则在验证集上选模；每次比较在10个随机种子上重复，并用Friedman检验与Holm校正进行多重比较。另设置共享SCAFFOLD局部优化器的对照以归因漂移校正的贡献，并考察出院编码预测变量、客户端级SMOTE、评估最后一轮而非最佳验证轮等协议选择，以及Platt缩放对风险的校准效果。

Result: SCAFFOLD在两个联邦（AUC-ROC 0.886与0.819）及18个变体中的17个排名第一，但对亚军的领先幅度从未超过0.008；对照实验显示其相对FedAvg的大部分优势可归因于漂移校正。在多医院联邦中，联邦训练与集中式训练相当。在护理单元联邦中，三项协议选择对判别力的改变大于算法选择：出院编码预测变量使AUC-ROC提高0.038，客户端级SMOTE最多降低0.074，评估最后一轮而非最佳验证轮最多降低0.084。基于验证数据的Platt缩放在不损失判别力的前提下修复了由不平衡校正扭曲的风险估计。

Conclusion: 聚合策略间的差异在实际量级上很小，且很大程度可由局部优化器与漂移校正机制解释；相较之下，预处理、样本平衡方式与模型选择/评估口径等协议选择对判别力的影响更大。因此研究应先固定并报告评估协议，再对算法进行排名，否则算法比较结论不稳健。

Abstract: Federated learning allows hospitals to train a shared mortality model without pooling their records, but published comparisons of aggregation strategies rarely control the evaluation protocol. This study compared seven strategies (FedAvg, FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedAdagrad, FedAdam, FedYogi and FedCluster) on two federations built with one pipeline: 12 care units of a hospital in MIMIC-IV and 49 hospitals in eICU-CRD. Each strategy was tuned and selected on validation data by the same rule, and every comparison was repeated across 10 seeds with Friedman and Holm-corrected tests. SCAFFOLD ranked first in both federations (AUC-ROC 0.886 and 0.819) and in 17 of 18 variants, but its margin over the runner-up never exceeded 0.008, and a control sharing its local optimizer attributed most of its margin over FedAvg to drift correction. On the multi-hospital federation, federated training matched centralized training. In the care-unit federation, three protocol choices changed discrimination by more than the choice of strategy did: discharge-coded predictors (+0.038 in AUC-ROC), client-level SMOTE (up to -0.074), and evaluating the last instead of the best validation round (up to -0.084). Platt scaling on validation data repaired the risks distorted by imbalance corrections without loss of discrimination. Studies should therefore fix the protocol before ranking algorithms.

</details>


### [345] [Measuring Learned Equivariance: An Information Theoretic Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17269)
*Claire Schlesinger,Wolfgang Gatterbauer,Robin Walters*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出用归一化互信息(NMI)与中心化核对齐(CKA)直接探测神经网络中间表征的学习等变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据增强可替代架构等变性来学习对称性，但不保证网络真正尊重这些对称性；中间表征的群作用未给定，导致其学习等变性难以度量。

Method: 在有限离散设定下证明等变性等价于原始与变换输入的逐点表征互为确定关系，据此构造基于NMI的检验；对高维激活采用CKA作为可扩展检验，并对正交特征变换给出精确保证。

Result: 在多种架构与任务上，数据增强通常提升变换一致性，表明可直接从表征探测学习等变性，无需恢复其背后隐藏的变换规则。

Conclusion: 等变性可被直接度量为表征间的一致性；NMI与CKA提供理论可依、可扩展的探测手段，为评估数据增强所诱导的对称性学习提供实用工具。

Abstract: Learning symmetries through data augmentation offers an alternative to architectural equivariance, but does not guarantee that a network respects those symmetries. Measuring learned equivariance is especially difficult for intermediate representations, whose group actions are not specified. In a finite discrete setting, we show that equivariance requires representations of original and transformed inputs to determine one another exactly, yielding a test based on normalized mutual information (NMI). For high-dimensional activations, we use centered kernel alignment (CKA) as a scalable test, with an exact guarantee for orthogonal feature transformations. Across architectures and tasks, augmentation usually increases transformation consistency, showing that learned equivariance can be probed directly from representations without recovering the hidden transformation rules that relate them.

</details>


### [346] [The Surprising Expressivity of a Single Neuron with Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17283)
*Roey Magen,Nirmit Joshi,Gal Vardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明：在自回归链式思维（CoT）生成框架下，单个神经元即可模拟与前馈电路同类的任意计算。对于阈值与ReLU等激活，规模为s、输入为n的电路可由维度O(ns+s²)的单神经元、用O(s²)步生成模拟，且界与电路深度无关并在自然假设下紧致。阈值情形显著改进Joshi等（COLT 2025）随深度指数增长的界，进而可模拟多项式时间图灵机且仍可从CoT监督中高效学习。核心证明借助与加性组合中Sidon集合的新联系；实验上用单个自回归ReLU神经元蒸馏CIFAR-10教师网络并取得非平凡测试精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归语言模型经CoT监督取得成功，引出一个根本问题：一个next-token预测器可以简单到什么程度，仍能通过其自回归生成的CoT高效模拟一般计算？已有工作（如Joshi等，COLT 2025）对阈值激活的模拟界随电路深度指数增长，复杂度高。本文旨在刻画极简自回归模型的表达力下界，并给出深度无关的紧致模拟界。

Method: 1) 理论构造：对包含阈值、ReLU在内的一类广泛激活函数，构造单个自回归神经元模拟同激活的前馈电路。2) 关键工具：建立与加性组合中Sidon集合的新联系，用于在自回归生成序列中编码电路门与连线信息。3) 复杂度分析：证明规模s、n输入的电路可由维度O(ns+s²)的神经元、以O(s²)生成步模拟，并论证界与电路深度无关、在自然假设下紧致。4) 推论：阈值激活下可模拟多项式时间图灵机，并保持从CoT监督中高效可学习。5) 实验：训练单个自回归ReLU神经元模仿CIFAR-10上的神经网络教师。

Result: 理论上：单个自回归神经元（含阈值、ReLU）可模拟任意同类前馈电路；维度O(ns+s²)，生成步O(s²)，均与深度无关且在自然假设下紧致；阈值情形将Joshi等（COLT 2025）随深度指数增长的界改进为深度无关；由此自回归阈值神经元可模拟多项式时间图灵机且可高效学习。实验上：单个自回归ReLU神经元被高效训练以模仿神经网络教师，在CIFAR-10上取得非平凡测试精度。

Conclusion: 极端简单的next-token预测器（单个神经元）在CoT自回归生成下即具备通用计算模拟能力，其模拟复杂度仅取决于电路规模而非深度，达到紧致界；该结果统一并强化了阈值/ReLU电路的CoT模拟理论，并通过Sidon集合建立表达力与加性组合的联系。这为理解CoT为何赋予简单自回归模型强大计算能力提供了理论依据，并以CIFAR-10蒸馏实验给出初步验证。

Abstract: The success of autoregressive language models trained with Chain-of-Thought~(CoT) supervision raises a fundamental question: How simple can a next-token predictor be while still enabling the efficient simulation of general computation through its autoregressively generated CoT? Surprisingly, we show that a single neuron suffices. For a broad family of activations, including threshold and ReLU, a single autoregressive neuron can simulate any feedforward circuit with the same activation. Specifically, a size-$s$ circuit on $n$ inputs can be simulated by a neuron of dimension $O(ns+s^2)$ using $O(s^2)$ generation steps, with both bounds independent of circuit depth and tight under natural assumptions. For threshold activations, this improves upon the simulation of Joshi et al. (COLT 2025), whose bounds scale exponentially with circuit depth. Consequently, autoregressive threshold neurons can simulate polynomial-time Turing machines, while remaining efficiently learnable from CoT supervision. Our main expressivity result relies on a novel connection to Sidon sets from additive combinatorics. As an experimental illustration, we efficiently train a single autoregressive ReLU neuron to mimic a neural network teacher with nontrivial test accuracy on CIFAR-10.

</details>


### [347] [Which Geometry on Which Layer? Measured Sign-Spectral Assignment in Mixed-Optimizer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17285)
*Hiroki Naganuma,Laura Gomezjurado,Mahdi Ghaznavi,Ganesh Talluri,Atsushi Nitanda,Seng Pei Liew,Ryuichiro Hataya,Ioannis Mitliagkas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 作者将"哪些层用sign类更新、哪些层用谱（Muon/Scion类）更新"形式化为可测度的逐层几何分配决策问题，通过有限批次下保守下降引理下界的比值、以及基于梯度对齐与Hessian向量积的局部方向二次分数，提出了可由方向曲率驱动的逐层路由方法G-Scion，并在输入秩实验、31M GPT-2与ViT-B/16上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代神经网络训练常采用混合优化配方：embedding与输出层用AdamW类或sign类更新，隐层矩阵用谱（spectral）更新。但这种分配通常按层类型固定，缺乏选择合适几何（sign还是谱）的明确准则。作者希望把sign-versus-spectral分配从经验约定转变为可度量、逐层的决策问题。

Method: 1) 针对理想无记忆（memoryless）步，推导谱更新与sign更新在保守下降引理下界的有限批次比值，其闭式分解为信号效率项与依赖几何的全局曲率因子；2) 在正信号区域，在同一光滑性假设下给出双侧界，通过显式的噪声依赖阈值判断哪一步具有更大的条件期望下降；3) 由此导出基于梯度对齐与Hessian-vector product的局部方向二次分数，用于G-Scion（Generalized-Scion）中的逐层路由控制。

Result: 在受控输入秩（input-rank）实验中，包含方向曲率的判据在全部七个聚合设置中都匹配同迭代（same-iterate）实测排序，而无曲率的代理指标选择了相反的几何。在31M GPT-2上，输出分数将输出层从谱warmup路由到sign，G-Scion在无记忆与匹配动量对比下均优于固定Scion的验证损失。ViT-B/16结果进一步表明，在语言建模之外，谱优势分配也能胜过固定Scion。

Conclusion: 优化器几何不必按层类型硬编码，逐层几何分配是可测量并可被理论判据指导的决策；本文是理解"应如何分配几何"的第一步。方向曲率是稳定选取sign或谱更新的关键因素。

Abstract: Modern neural-network training uses mixed recipes, assigning AdamW-like or sign-based updates to embedding and output layers and spectral updates to hidden matrices. These assignments are usually fixed by layer type, without a clear criterion for selecting the appropriate geometry. We turn sign-versus-spectral assignment into a measurable, layerwise decision problem. For ideal memoryless steps, we derive a finite-batch ratio of conservative descent-lemma lower bounds for spectral and sign updates. Its closed form separates signal efficiency from a geometry-dependent global curvature factor. In the positive-signal regime, the same smoothness assumption gives two-sided bounds that determine which step has the larger conditional expected decrease when the ratio crosses explicit noise-dependent thresholds. We then derive a local directional quadratic score from gradient alignments and Hessian-vector products and use it in Generalized-Scion (G-Scion) to control layerwise routing. In a controlled input-rank experiment, including directional curvature matches the measured same-iterate ordering in all seven aggregate settings, whereas the curvature-free proxy selects the opposite geometry. On 31M GPT-2, the output score routes the output layer from spectral warmup to sign, and G-Scion improves validation loss over fixed Scion in memoryless and matched-momentum comparisons. ViT-B/16 results further show that a spectral edge assignment can outperform fixed Scion outside language modelling. These results suggest that optimizer geometry need not be hard-coded by layer type and are a first step toward understanding how it should be assigned.

</details>


### [348] [A Geometrical Approach to Constructing Neural Networks for Perfect Training-set Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17312)
*Akos Hajnal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出一种按需构造的神经网络，通过几何分析和分层划分实现训练集全样本完美分类，具有紧凑、可解释和可并行构造的特点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在不考虑正则化的情况下，实现训练集的完美分类，并提升模型的可解释性与构造效率。

Method: 对输入数据进行几何分析，生成分离超平面并映射为带阶跃激活函数的神经元；采用分层划分构造斜决策树，实现类间分离，叶节点直接定义线性可分层的神经元；网络为两个隐藏层结构，分别负责类间分离与线性可分表示转换。

Result: 在 MNIST 数据集上实现训练集完美分类，并获得紧凑模型；线性可分层的规模仅比类间分离层多一个神经元。

Conclusion: 决策树与网络神经元之间的直接对应关系增强了可解释性，构造过程支持并行实现并提升可扩展性。

Abstract: This paper proposes a method for constructing a neural network that achieves perfect classification of all samples in a given training set, without taking regularization into account. The network is constructed on-demand, with its layer sizes and neuron parameters determined through a geometrical analysis of the input data, in which separating hyperplanes are created and mapped to neurons with step activation functions. The proposed architecture consists of two hidden layers with distinct roles: inter-class separation and transformation of the data into a linearly separable representation. Inter-class separation requires every bi-chromatic pair of samples belonging to different classes to be separated by at least one hyperplane. We show that when this separation is achieved through a hierarchical partitioning of the data, the leaf nodes of the oblique decision tree, obtained as a byproduct, directly define the neurons of the linear separability layer, whose size is only one neuron greater than that of the inter-class separation layer. Experiments on the MNIST dataset demonstrate that the proposed method achieves perfect training-set classification, and compact models. The direct correspondence between the decision tree and network neurons enhances interpretability and explainability, while the construction procedure offers opportunities for parallel implementation and improved scalability.

</details>


### [349] [Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration network (JEDI-net)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17314)
*Rishav Mukherjee,Jeffrey Ahearn Thompson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JEDI-net通过将SHAP值聚类得到的潜在子群身份嵌入网络,使预测能动态适应每个观测的特征重要性模式,从而提升深度模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习虽能自动提取复杂元特征,但因未观测的潜在因子(latent factors),其表现仍可能不稳定。把潜在因子信息显式引入模型,可让网络依据推断出的因子调整行为以改善性能。然而神经网络本身已能隐含捕捉此类复杂性,对原始特征空间做外部聚类收益有限,因此需要新的方式来揭示潜在结构。

Method: 提出JEDI-net(Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration Network)统一架构:在优化过程中周期性聚类SHAP值,以识别具有相似特征重要性模式的潜在子群;并将这些子群身份(embedding)直接嵌入网络,使预测能够依据每个观测的预测结构自适应调整。该方法延续FORCE的思路,即基于特征重要性剖面而非原始特征进行聚类。

Result: 文中主要说明该统一架构的设计思路及其相较前作FORCE的进展,即把周期性SHAP聚类与身份嵌入整合到单一网络中,实现动态适应;摘要未给出具体量化指标或对比结果。

Conclusion: 按特征重要性模式聚类观测、并将所得潜在子群身份显式嵌入网络,是一种有原则且有效的揭示潜在结构的方式;JEDI-net将这一机制统一为端到端架构,有望进一步改善神经网络在存在潜在因子时的预测表现。

Abstract: Deep learning has become the dominant form of machine learning due in part, to its ability to automatically engineer complex meta features from data. However, even deep learning features can perform erratically because of unobserved latent factors. incorporating latent factor information explicitly, can improve performance by letting the model alter its behavior based on such inferred factors. Because neural networks often capture such complexity inherently, external clustering of the original feature space offers limited benefit. clustering observations by feature importance profiles, rather than raw features, offers a principled way to uncover latent structure, since observations with similar importance patterns may share predictive dynamics. In a prior work, Feature Oriented Representation with Clustering and Explanation (FORCE) we showed that this approach measurably improved neural network performance. In this article, we present JEDI-net(Joint Embedding with Dynamic Integration Network) a unified architecture that periodically clusters SHAP values during optimization to identify latent subgroups with similar feature importance patterns, embed their identities directly into the network, allowing predictions to adapt to each observations predictive structure.

</details>


### [350] [Near-Optimal Regret Bounds for Monotone Stochastic Optimization under Semi-Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17320)
*Tao Hu,Rohan Ghuge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对单调随机优化在半强盗反馈下的在线到离线归约问题，提出了一种强单调条件下的通用归约，实现了 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ 的期望遗憾，并回答了 $\citet{liu2025improved}$ 提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作在单调随机优化下给出在线到离线归约，但期望遗憾为 $\widetilde O(n\sqrt T)$；而针对最优停止和 Pandora's box 的问题特定算法可达到 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$。核心问题是：能否设计通用的在线到离线归约达到这一更优速率。

Method: 针对强单调随机优化提出 oracle-efficient 归约。强单调性相对于所选离线算法定义。方法结合 Bernstein 型乐观分布估计与针对自适应策略轨迹的 Hellinger 稳定性界，并按照被执行策略的探测概率对平方边际误差加权聚合。

Result: 归约实现 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ 期望遗憾，同时保持满足相同条件 oracle 的近似保证；当 $T\ge n$ 时该速率在对数因子内最优，即使在全反馈下亦然。在单调性与一致有界坐标变化下，同一算法达到 $\widetilde O(n^{3/4}\sqrt T)$ 期望近似遗憾，改进了此前对 $n$ 的线性依赖；指数 $3/4$ 对其普通遗憾在实例与精确 oracle 选择下是紧的。

Conclusion: 该通用归约回答了开放问题，达到与问题特定算法匹配的 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ 速率，并适用于 prophet inequality、Pandora's box、best-of-$K$ 选择、随机背包、随机定向和随机子模最大化等多种问题。

Abstract: Stochastic optimization models sequential decision-making under uncertainty, typically assuming known input distributions. When these distributions are unknown, \citet{agarwal2026semibandit} give an online-to-offline reduction for monotone stochastic optimization under semi-bandit feedback, where only probed variables are observed. Its expected regret relative to the offline guarantee is $\widetilde O(n\sqrt T)$, where $n$ is the number of variables and $T$ the horizon. For optimal stopping and Pandora's box, \citet{liu2025improved} achieve $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ using problem-specific algorithms. \emph{Can a general online-to-offline reduction achieve this improved rate?}
  We give such a reduction for strongly monotone stochastic optimization, answering the corresponding open question. Strong monotonicity is defined relative to the chosen offline algorithm. Our oracle-efficient reduction achieves $\widetilde O(\sqrt{nT})$ expected regret while preserving approximation guarantees for oracles satisfying the same condition. It combines Bernstein-type optimistic distribution estimates with a Hellinger stability bound for adaptive policy transcripts, aggregating squared marginal errors weighted by the executed policy's probing probabilities. The rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors for $T\ge n$, even under full feedback.
  Under monotonicity and uniformly bounded coordinate-wise variation, the same algorithm achieves $\widetilde O(n^{3/4}\sqrt T)$ expected approximation regret, improving the previous linear dependence on $n$. The exponent $3/4$ is sharp for its ordinary regret over instances and exact oracle choices. Our framework applies to prophet inequality, Pandora's box, best-of-$K$ selection, stochastic knapsack, stochastic orienteering, and stochastic submodular maximization.

</details>


### [351] [COMPASS: Membership Inference Attack Against Vision Large Language Models via Adaptive Noise Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17332)
*Damien Lo,Hong Kyu Lee,Ruixuan Liu,Li Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 COMPASS，一种自适应灰盒成员推理攻击（MIA），通过在校准扰动幅度与成员得分方向后，对 VLLM 进行全范围小扰动分析，实现对训练数据暴露的检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉大语言模型（VLLM）部署于隐私敏感领域，引发训练数据暴露担忧。现有灰盒 MIA 依赖熵统计或生成描述，生成成本高、分离度有限；基于扰动的方法只关注大扰动，导致小扰动下 VLLM 的成员行为尚不清楚。

Method: 系统刻画受控高斯扰动下不同噪声水平的 VLLM 成员行为；发现最优扰动幅度与成员信号方向随模型-数据集对变化，低噪声区间常比大扰动分离度更高，成员发散度低于非成员，出现得分方向反转。据此提出 COMPASS，利用松分布匹配的已知非成员参考集校准扰动幅度与得分方向，采用 Renyi 归一化 KL 散度与 Renyi 散度，并对最具信息量的 image-logit 位置做 max-k 聚合。

Result: 在 LLaVA v1.5-7B、MiniGPT-4、HuluMed-32B 上，覆盖预训练、指令微调与医学图像数据集，COMPASS 优于基线。通用领域数据 AUC 最高达 0.88；分布匹配的医学评测达 0.64 AUC，而最强基线仍在随机水平。

Conclusion: 全范围自适应扰动分析是有效的 VLLM 成员推理途径，固定扰动幅度或预设得分方向均不可靠。

Abstract: Vision large language models (VLLMs) are deployed in privacy-sensitive domains, raising training-data exposure concerns. Existing gray-box membership inference attacks (MIAs) commonly rely on entropy statistics or generated descriptions, requiring costly generation with limited membership separation. Perturbation-based methods instead measure response changes but focus on large perturbations, leaving VLLM membership behavior under smaller perturbations poorly understood. We systematically characterize VLLM membership behavior under controlled Gaussian perturbations across noise levels at fine resolution. We find that optimal perturbation magnitude and membership-signal direction vary across model-dataset pairs. In many settings, a previously unstudied low-noise regime yields stronger separation than large perturbations, with members exhibiting lower divergence than non-members, reversing the conventional score direction. Other settings retain the conventional direction, demonstrating that neither a fixed perturbation magnitude nor a predetermined score orientation is universally reliable. We propose COMPASS, an adaptive gray-box MIA that calibrates both the perturbation magnitude and membership-score direction using a loosely distribution-matched, known non-member reference set. We instantiate COMPASS using Renyi-normalized KL divergence and Renyi divergence, with max-k aggregation over the most informative image-logit positions. Across LLaVA v1.5-7B, MiniGPT-4, and HuluMed-32B, spanning pretraining, instruction-tuning, and medical-image datasets, COMPASS outperforms baselines. On general-domain data, COMPASS achieves AUCs up to 0.88. On the distribution-matched medical evaluation, it reaches 0.64 AUC, while the strongest baseline remains at chance level. These results establish full-range adaptive perturbation analysis as an effective approach to VLLM membership inference.

</details>


### [352] [On the Statistical Mechanics of Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17347)
*Jerry Yao-Chieh Hu,Yu-An Chen,Maojiang Su,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过现代Hopfield模型重新审视Transformer注意力的统计力学，建立自由能形式化框架，刻画注意力推理的参数区域与临界阈值，并识别出玻璃相与鲁棒推理相之间的一阶相变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer注意力机制虽广泛使用，但缺乏从统计力学角度对其推理可靠性与相结构的严格理论刻画，尤其是参数区域与临界阈值的界定不清晰。

Method: 构建自由能形式化框架，将查询状态的随机性与注意力权重纳入自由能景观，把注意力视为对应统计力学系统（现代Hopfield模型）在自由能最小化原理下的运动方程；并进一步推广至具有随机查询与键的注意力情形。

Result: 在注意力中识别出玻璃相与鲁棒推理相之间的一阶相变，给出了区分不同参数区域与临界阈值的判据。

Conclusion: 为刻画一族Transformer注意力机制的相结构与推理可靠性提供了严格的统计力学框架。

Abstract: We revisit the statistical mechanics of Transformer attention via modern Hopfield models. We present a free-energy formalism to characterize parameter regimes and critical thresholds for robust attention inference. The resulting free-energy landscape incorporates randomness in query states and attention weights. Attention then emerges as the equation of motion of the corresponding statistical-mechanical system (i.e., modern Hopfield model) through the standard free-energy minimization principle. This allows us to identify first-order phase transitions in attention between glassy and robust-inference phases. We further extend to attentions with stochastic queries and keys. Together, our results provide a rigorous statistical-mechanics framework for characterizing phase structure and inference reliability across a family of Transformer attention mechanisms.

</details>


### [353] [HarnessTTT: Learn to Optimize Harness at Test-Time for Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17370)
*Yingzi Ma,Yulong Cao,Nanxi Li,Fang Wu,Yizhe Zhang,James Zou,Yejin Choi,Chaowei Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 HarnessTTT，一个测试时学习框架：在冻结执行器（executor）的前提下，训练一个"框架提议器"（harness proposer）来生成可执行的 harness（包含系统提示、可复用技能、工具、中间件与执行控制），通过预算受限的发现式 rollout 反馈，用发现导向的策略梯度目标（gap-normalized reward、RLOO、max-sharpening）更新提议器，从而让小型冻结模型高效完成科学发现搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现需要在有限计算预算内找到最佳有效解，而现有方法通常依赖固定的搜索流程或对执行器本身进行微调。作者关注一个被忽视的问题：搜索过程本身（即指导搜索的"框架"）能否借助搜索反馈被学习并改进？若能，则可在不训练执行器的情况下提升发现效率，并让学到的框架迁移到更强的执行器上。

Method: 1) 框架设计：提议器生成可执行 harness，涵盖系统提示、可复用技能、工具、中间件与执行控制；2) 流程：每个 harness 引导一次预算受限的发现式 rollout，其结果作为更新提议器的反馈；3) 优化目标：发现导向策略梯度，结合 gap-normalized reward、leave-one-out 优势（RLOO）与 max-sharpening 以偏好高性能提案；4) 校验与保留：生成组件在执行前须通过验证，搜索跨轮保留最佳有效解与被选中的 harness；5) 执行器保持冻结，仅训练 proposer。

Result: 在数学、系统、GPU 内核、启发式编程、天体动力学与生物学共 14 项发现任务上：冻结 9B 执行器的 HarnessTTT 在全部 11 项基准任务上优于同执行器的 OpenEvolve（如 circle packing 从 1.17 提升至 2.64）；相对发现微调的 Finch-9B 最高提升 92%；在 9 项任务上保持最佳开源 <10B 结果；在 Erdős minimum overlap 上达到 0.380919，优于最佳人类参考 0.380927。将 proposer 与冻结执行器扩展至 27B 后，在 14 项任务中的 11 项上进一步提升；将学到的 harness 迁移到 GPT-5.5，在 14 项任务中的 9 项上达到或超过已报告的最强系统（任意 backbone）。

Conclusion: 实验表明"框架搜索本身可以在测试时被学习"：训练好的 proposer 能让小型冻结执行器高效搜索，且其发现的 harness 可迁移到更强的执行器并保持增益，说明将搜索流程作为学习对象是提升科学发现计算效率的有效途径。

Abstract: Scientific discovery with language models requires finding the best valid solution within a finite computational budget. We study how feedback from this search can improve the procedure used to conduct it. We introduce HarnessTTT, a test-time learning framework that trains a harness proposer while keeping the executor frozen. The proposer generates executable harnesses comprising system prompts, reusable skills, tools, middleware, and execution controls. Each harness guides a budgeted discovery rollout, whose outcome provides feedback for updating the proposer. A discovery-oriented policy-gradient objective combines gap-normalized rewards, leave-one-out advantages (RLOO), and max-sharpening to favor high-performing proposals. Generated components are validated before execution, and the search retains the best valid solution and selected harnesses across rounds. Across fourteen discovery tasks in mathematics, systems, GPU kernels, heuristic programming, astrodynamics, and biology, HarnessTTT with a frozen 9B executor improves on OpenEvolve with the same executor on all eleven benchmark tasks (e.g., from 1.17 to 2.64 on circle packing), improves on the discovery-fine-tuned Finch-9B by up to 92%, holds the best open-weight sub-10B result on nine, and reaches 0.380919 on Erdős minimum overlap, better than the best human reference of 0.380927. Scaling the proposer and frozen executor to 27B improves on eleven of fourteen tasks, and transferring the learned harnesses to GPT-5.5 matches or exceeds the strongest reported system of any backbone on nine of fourteen tasks. Together, these results show that harness search can itself be learned at test time: a trained proposer lets a small frozen executor search effectively, and the harnesses it finds carry over to stronger executors.

</details>


### [354] [Robustly Reliable Learning for Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17381)
*Avrim Blum,Anh Tuan Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出回归场景下的"鲁棒可靠学习"问题：给定测试点、训练集、污染预算b和实值假设类，目标是输出最优预测范围I*，使任何与除至多b个点外一致的L-Lipschitz预测器在测试点上的预测值必落入该范围。针对L-Lipschitz假设类，分别在数据L-Lipschitz一致与一般场景下设计了算法并给出复杂度与最优性证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗环境下的回归可靠性问题：需要在存在数据污染（至多b个点）的情况下，为测试点给出一个有理论保证的预测范围，使得任何满足L-Lipschitz性且与绝大多数数据一致的预测器都必须落在该范围内，从而提供可证明的可靠性保证。

Method: 针对L-Lipschitz假设类分两种情形：1）受限情形（污染后数据仍保证L-Lipschitz一致），提出简单的第b优（b-th best）启发式算法，证明其能计算最紧范围I*，复杂度O(n)且证明其计算最优；2）一般情形（数据不再L-Lipschitz一致），将最优范围计算归约为违约图（violation graph），该图建模数据点间的两两L-Lipschitz违约关系，利用图的核（kernel）的结构性质提出FPT算法，在O(n²+b⁴)时间内计算精确最优范围。

Result: 受限情形下第b优算法正确且计算最优，复杂度O(n)；一般情形下FPT算法以O(n²+b⁴)计算精确最优范围，并在SETH假设下证明了下界Ω(n^{2-o(1)})，表明该算法计算最优。最后讨论了该问题的开放方向。

Conclusion: 本文形式化并求解了对抗环境下回归的鲁棒可靠学习问题，针对L-Lipschitz假设类给出了计算最优的算法，并建立了匹配的复杂度下界，为该新问题方向奠定了基础并指出开放问题。

Abstract: We introduce the problem of robustly reliable learning for the regression setting in adversarial environments. Given a test point $x_{test}$, a training dataset $S$ of $n$ data points, a corruption budget $b \ll n$, and a real-valued hypothesis class $\mathcal H$, our goal is to output the optimal prediction range $I^*_{x_{test}}(S, b)$, such that any $L$-Lipschitz predictor consistent with all but at most $b$ points in $S$ must predict a value $h(x_{test}) \in I$. We then instantiate the analysis for $L$-Lipschitz hypothesis classes, a natural and widely studied class in the regression setting, focusing on two key scenarios. First, for the restricted case where the corrupted dataset is guaranteed to be $L$-Lipschitz consistent, we propose a simple and efficient $b^{th}$-best heuristic algorithm and prove its correctness in computing the tightest possible range $I^*_{x_{test}}(S, b)$. We then establish its computational complexity of $O(n)$ and show that it is computationally optimal in this scenario. Building on this foundation, we address the general scenario where the dataset $S$ is no longer $L$-Lipschitz consistent. We demonstrate that computing the optimal range in this setting reduces to analyzing a violation graph, which models the pairwise $L$-Lipschitz violations among data points. By leveraging the structural properties of this graph's kernel, we propose a Fixed-Parameter Tractable (FPT) algorithm that computes the exact optimal range in $O(n^2 + b^4)$ time. Furthermore, under the Strong Exponential Time Hypothesis (SETH), we establish a computational lower bound of $Ω(n^{2 - o(1)})$, proving that our algorithm is computationally optimal. Finally, we discuss open directions for the problem of robustly reliable learning for regression.

</details>


### [355] [Mitigating Black-Box Score-Based Query Attacks via Gradient Confusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17382)
*Ali Javeri,Javad Hezareh,Radin Shahdaei,AmirMahdi Sadeghzadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Gradient Confusion Defense (GCD)，一种无需重训练、确定性的测试时包装器，通过扰动返回给攻击者的概率向量，使其暴露的对数几率梯度与真实对抗损失梯度最大程度错位，从而在不损失干净精度的前提下显著提升对基于分数黑盒攻击的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于分数的黑盒对抗攻击仅靠反复查询即可构造对抗样本，对已部署模型构成严重威胁。现有防御多依赖随机输出扰动，但攻击者可通过增加查询预算或对随机性取平均来恢复稳定的梯度估计，从而绕过防御。

Method: GCD是一个无需重训练、确定性的测试时包装器，主动塑造返回给查询攻击者的概率向量。其核心是求解一个基于模型雅可比矩阵的约束优化问题，使暴露的对数几率梯度对齐到一个与真实对抗损失梯度最大程度错位的目标混淆方向。该方法不改变模型参数，仅修改输出概率。

Result: 理论分析证明GCD可证明地减缓基于梯度估计的攻击，并在基于随机搜索的攻击中引入系统性的接受/拒绝错误，且混淆效应随被防御查询比例增加而放大。在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，针对ResNet-18、ResNet-50、ViT-B/16及四种SOTA攻击的实验验证了理论预测：GCD达到SOTA鲁棒性，且干净精度零下降。

Conclusion: GCD通过确定性梯度混淆实现强鲁棒性，克服了随机化防御易被自适应攻击利用的缺陷，适用于安全关键部署场景。

Abstract: Score-based black-box adversarial attacks pose a serious threat to deployed machine learning systems by exploiting repeated model queries to craft adversarial examples, requiring neither access to model parameters nor architecture. Existing defenses predominantly rely on stochastic output perturbations, which fail to prevent determined attackers from recovering stable gradient estimates by increasing query budgets or averaging over randomness. In this work, we propose the Gradient Confusion Defense (GCD), a retraining-free, deterministic test-time wrapper that actively shapes the probability vector returned to querying adversaries. By solving a constrained optimization problem grounded in the model's Jacobian, GCD aligns the exposed logit-gradient with a target confusion direction that is maximally misaligned with the true adversarial loss gradient---increasing the query complexity of attacks without sacrificing predictive utility or top-1 accuracy. We provide rigorous theoretical analysis demonstrating that GCD provably slows gradient-estimation-based attacks and induces systematic accept/reject errors in random search-based attacks, with the confusion effect amplifying as the fraction of defended queries increases. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet across multiple architectures (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, ViT-B/16) and four state-of-the-art attacks confirm these predictions: GCD achieves state-of-the-art robustness, while incurring zero clean accuracy degradation. %Crucially, unlike randomization-based defenses, GCD's deterministic structure provides resilience against adaptive attacks that exploit stochasticity, making it well-suited for security-critical deployment settings.

</details>


### [356] [Variable Input Masked Autoencoders for Wrist-Worn Accelerometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17383)
*Harish Haresamudram,Wanting Mao,Aditya Radhakrishnan,Maxwell A. Xu,James M. Rehg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VarMAE，一种可变输入掩码自编码器，在采样率与时间窗口上学习统一表征，用单一编码器在八个基准上匹配或超越基线，参数仅3.82M。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器基础模型预训练时固定输入时长与采样率，而实际录制条件、下游任务与部署约束高度异质，导致单一模型难以跨传感配置迁移。

Method: 预训练时对同一信号构建两个视图：长时长高频率视图与短时长低频率视图（随机裁剪+下采样）；在每个视图内做掩码重建，并引入跨分辨率掩码重建目标，用长视图可见token预测短视图的掩码token。裁剪与下采样形成互补信息瓶颈，迫使模型学到对输入时长和采样率变化都有效的表征。

Result: 在NHANES大规模数据集上预训练，单一预训练编码器在八个基准数据集上匹配或超越受控的基础模型基线，且仅3.82M参数，参数高效。

Conclusion: 单一基础模型可实现跨传感配置的广泛迁移能力，参数效率高，验证了可变输入建模对可穿戴传感基础模型的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Large-scale repositories of wearable sensor data have enabled the development of foundation models for human activities and behavior. However, existing models are pretrained using fixed input durations and sampling rates, despite substantial heterogeneity in recording conditions, downstream tasks, and deployment constraints. We introduce VarMAE, a variable input masked autoencoder that learns a single representation across sampling rates and temporal contexts. During pretraining we construct two views of the same signal: a long duration high frequency view, and a short duration lower frequency view, obtained via random cropping and downsampling. We perform masked reconstruction within each view and introduce a cross-resolution masked reconstruction objective that uses visible tokens from the long view to predict masked tokens from the short view. Cropping and downsampling impose complementary information bottlenecks, encouraging the model to learn representations that remain effective across input durations and sampling rate changes. We pretrain VarMAE on the large-scale NHANES dataset, producing a single pretrained encoder matching or outperforming controlled foundation model baselines on eight benchmark datasets. With only 3.82M parameters, VarMAE is parameter efficient and shows that a single foundation model can achieve broad transfer capabilities across sensing configurations.

</details>


### [357] [Measure Neural Mappings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17384)
*Ricardo Baptista,Edoardo Calvello,Bohan Chen,Andrew Stuart,Urbain Vaes*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出并定义测度神经映射（MNMs），将测度相关神经传输与集成一致性结合，建立非紧支撑概率测度上注意力机制的定量连续极限，证明其Wasserstein误差以N^{-1/2}衰减，并在七个算子实验中验证理论预测的粒子数依赖关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学机器学习中的贝叶斯推断与不确定性量化常涉及无界状态空间上的概率测度，而现有对Transformer/注意力作为测度算子逼近的理论分析多局限于紧支撑或缺乏定量连续极限，故需在非紧测度上给出误差可控的算子学习框架。

Method: 引入MNMs，要求从输入律采样的集成输出以概率收敛到指定总体输出（集成一致性）；在强次高斯与尾部可积假设下，推导非紧律上注意力的定量连续极限；对固定自注意力Transformer给出期望输出Wasserstein误差界（经验输入Wasserstein误差加额外N^{-1/2}注意力项），证明pre-norm（经归一化后的紧致稳定性）与post-norm（尾部条件）均为MNMs；推广至交叉注意力、多头注意力与分组Transformer，并分析Set Transformer作为测度到向量映射的欧氏误差界。

Result: 自注意力Transformer的期望输出Wasserstein误差≤经验输入Wasserstein误差+O(N^{-1/2})；交叉注意力、多头与分组评估有相应估计，随组规模增大收敛；Set Transformer得到期望欧氏输出误差的N^{-1/2}界。在d=1,2,3,5,10的七个算子上实验（一维用Wasserstein精确计算，高维用Sinkhorn近似），观测的Wasserstein与切片Wasserstein衰减率接近各自理论采样基准。

Conclusion: MNMs为无界测度空间上的算子学习提供了统一的理论框架，表明Transformer类架构在非紧测度上具有N^{-1/2}级别的集成一致性与连续极限保证，理论与实验吻合，适用于贝叶斯推断与不确定性量化等科学机器学习场景。

Abstract: We introduce and define measure neural mappings (MNMs), which combine measure-dependent neural transport with ensemble consistency for learning operators on probability measures. Ensemble consistency requires outputs from growing ensembles sampled from an input law to converge to the specified population output in probability. We establish quantitative continuum limits for attention on noncompact laws under strong sub-Gaussian and tail-integrability assumptions. These laws accommodate unbounded state spaces in scientific machine learning, including Bayesian inference and uncertainty quantification. For fixed self-attention transformers, the expected output Wasserstein error is bounded by the empirical input Wasserstein error plus an additional $N^{-1/2}$ attention term. These self-attention transformers are MNMs under the stated assumptions: pre-norm architectures follow from compact stability after normalization, while post-norm architectures are covered under the stated tail conditions. We prove corresponding cross-attention estimates and extend the results to multihead attention and grouped transformer evaluation, with convergence as the group size grows. For Set Transformers viewed as measure-to-vector mappings, we obtain an $N^{-1/2}$ bound on the expected Euclidean output error under the stated assumptions. Experiments on seven operators in dimensions $d=1,2,3,5,10$ support the predicted particle-count dependence, using one-dimensional Wasserstein computations and Sinkhorn approximations in higher dimensions. The observed Wasserstein and sliced Wasserstein decay rates are close to their respective theoretical sampling benchmarks.

</details>


### [358] [Cross-Market Meta-Learning for Electricity Price Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17387)
*Delaram Pirhayatifard,Terrence Alsup*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MetaGrid：跨市场元训练的拓扑感知Transformer，实现单一参数集适应未见电网的日前电价预测，在五个美国ISO的无泄漏基准上取得最低平均MAE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日前电价预测通常按市场单独建模，导致统计与树模型精度饱和，高容量序列模型受限于单一市场仅数年的小时级数据；同时各节点被当作独立序列，忽略了网络拓扑与阻塞带来的空间依赖。由于不同ISO的电价形成受共享物理规律与大体相似的market设计驱动，作者将跨市场历史视为预训练语料。

Method: 提出MetaGrid：一个拓扑感知的Transformer，跨市场进行meta-training，得到与区域数量（zone-count）无关的单一参数集，可适应未见电网。所有模型使用相同输入：电价、日前负荷预测与日历特征。

Result: 在五个美国ISO的无泄漏基准上，MetaGrid取得最低平均MAE，较最佳基线提升3.1%，较同架构从零训练提升7.7%。

Conclusion: 跨市场元训练与拓扑感知建模能有效突破单市场数据瓶颈，实现跨电网泛化的高精度日前电价预测。

Abstract: Day-ahead (DA) electricity price forecasting is usually posed per market, with a separate model fitted to each grid's own history. This caps accuracy: statistical and tree-based baselines saturate, while higher-capacity sequence models need more training data than a single market's few years of hourly prices can supply. Such methods also treat each node as an independent series, discarding the spatial dependencies induced by network topology and congestion. Because price formation across independent system operators (ISOs) is driven by shared physics and largely common market design, we instead treat cross-market history as a pretraining corpus. We present MetaGrid, a topology-aware transformer, meta-trained across markets so that a single zone-count-independent parameter set adapts to an unseen grid. On a leak-free benchmark of five U.S. ISOs, where every model receives the same prices, DA load forecasts and calendar features, MetaGrid attains the lowest average MAE, improving on the best baseline by 3.1\% and on the same architecture trained from scratch by 7.7\%.

</details>


### [359] [JustOPD: On-Policy Distillation from Autoregressive to Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17397)
*Zikun Zhang,Jiayuan Sheng,David D. Yao,Wenpin Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 JustOPD，一种从自回归语言模型（ARM）到扩散语言模型（DLM）的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过训练时采用自回归 rollout 对齐 ARM 教师的从左到右解码，在保留 DLM 推理阶段灵活生成顺序能力的同时实现有效蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）能让 LLM 学生模型从自身策略采样序列并学习教师分布，但面向扩散语言模型（DLM）的 OPD 研究不足，现有工作主要局限于 DLM 到 DLM 蒸馏。由于强教师 DLM 稀缺，且 DLM 具备灵活生成顺序，带来额外技术挑战。更关键的是，ARM 的从左到右解码与 DLM 的灵活解码顺序存在错配，如何将强 ARM 的知识有效蒸馏到较弱的 DLM 尚不清晰。

Method: 受 Ni et al. (2026) 启发，提出 JustOPD：在训练过程中使用自回归 rollout，使学生的生成过程与 ARM 教师的从左到右解码相对齐，从而支持从 ARM 教师进行有效蒸馏，同时在推理阶段保留 DLM 的灵活生成顺序能力。

Result: 以 Qwen3-14B 为教师、Dream-7B 为学生进行实验，结果表明 JustOPD 在多种散度选择下均能持续提升数学推理性能，优于基础 DLM。

Conclusion: JustOPD 有效解决了 ARM 教师与 DLM 学生之间的解码顺序错配问题，实现了跨架构（ARM→DLM）的在线策略蒸馏，在保留 DLM 灵活生成特性的同时显著增强其数学推理能力。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a post-training approach for large language models (LLMs) that enables a student model to learn a teacher model's distribution from sequences sampled from the student's own policy. Despite its promising capability, OPD for diffusion language models (DLMs) remains underexplored and existing studies primarily focuses on DLM-to-DLM distillation. The limited availability of strong teacher DLMs and the flexible generation order of DLMs impose additional technical challenges as well. However, it remains unclear how to effectively distill knowledge from a strong autoregressive language model (ARM) into a weaker DLM, given the mismatch between the left-to-right decoding of ARMs and the flexible decoding order of DLMs. Inspired by Ni et al. (2026), we propose JustOPD, an ARM-to-DLM on-policy distillation method that uses autoregressive rollouts during training to align the student's generation process with the ARM teacher's left-to-right decoding. This alignment enables effective distillation from ARM teachers while preserving the DLM's flexible generation-order capability at inference time. Experiments using Qwen3-14B as the teacher and Dream-7B as the student demonstrate that JustOPD consistently improves mathematical reasoning performance over the base DLM across multiple divergence choices.

</details>


### [360] [Learning to Detect Shifts in Unstructured Data Streams via Monitoring-by-Betting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17399)
*Siyu Zhou,Jialin Ouyang,Fan Xia,Adarsh Subbaswamy,Drew Prinster,Suchi Saria,Augusto Garcia-Agundez,Sarah Pollet,Jinoos Yazdany,Patrick Vossler,Jean Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将序贯变点检测重构为"投注博弈"，提出渐近e-检测器，在无结构数据上实现自适应方向假设且渐近控制误报率，实验证明自适应监控器检测更快、更可解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI系统的持续监控需要检测所摄入与生成的无结构数据中的分布漂移。现有方法为保证误报控制，通常要求预先指定检测漂移所用的差异度量。但对无结构数据，预指定会产生"敏感性—广度"权衡：窄定义度量对预期漂移敏感却可能遗漏意外变化，宽定义度量覆盖面广但敏感性下降。自适应地假设漂移方向可突破此限制，但这种数据依赖的自适应会破坏传统误报保证。

Method: 通过testing-by-betting框架调和自 adaptive 性与统计有效性：将序贯变点检测重新表述为投注博弈，投注者在观测到来时不断更新其假设的漂移方向（witness function）。提出渐近e-检测器（asymptotic e-detectors），利用规模为m的校准集近似变化前分布，并证明随m增大渐近控制误报的平均运行长度（ARL）。在此基础上开发自适应监控策略，从基于嵌入学习的黑箱投注器，到基于LLM提出概念的可解释投注器。

Result: 校准集小至m=30即可提供有效控制。在三个真实数据集（含临床AI scribe部署数据）上，同误报水平下自适应监控器比固定监控器检测漂移更快。当真实漂移稀疏且可解释时，LLM概念监控器检测最快、最可解释，并能辅助复杂漂移的根因诊断。

Conclusion: testing-by-betting框架使数据依赖的自适应方向假设与统计有效性得以兼容，渐近e-检测器在较小校准集下即可控制误报，自适应与可解释的监控策略在真实场景中优于固定度量方法，并可支持根因诊断。

Abstract: Continuous monitoring of generative AI systems requires detecting distribution shifts in the unstructured data they ingest and generate. Existing monitoring methods typically control false alarms by requiring the discrepancy measure used to detect shifts to be *pre-specified*. However, for unstructured data, pre-specification creates a sensitivity--breadth trade-off: a narrowly defined measure is sensitive to the anticipated shift but may miss unexpected changes, whereas a broadly defined measure may detect a wider range of shifts but with reduced sensitivity. Although adaptively hypothesizing the shift direction can overcome this limitation, such data-dependent adaptation generally invalidates conventional false-alarm guarantees. We reconcile adaptivity with statistical validity through testing-by-betting, reframing sequential changepoint detection as a betting game in which the bettor continually updates its hypothesized shift direction, or witness function, as new observations arrive. We introduce *asymptotic e-detectors*, which approximate the pre-change distribution using a calibration set of size $m$, and prove that they asymptotically control the average run length to a false alarm as $m$ increases. Empirically, calibration sets as small as $m=30$ provide effective control. We then develop adaptive monitoring strategies ranging from black-box bettors that learn from embeddings to interpretable bettors based on LLM-proposed concepts. Across three real-world datasets, including data from a clinical AI scribe deployment, adaptive monitors detect shifts faster than fixed monitors at the same false-alarm level. Further, when the true shifts are sparse and interpretable, LLM-concept monitors provide the fastest and most interpretable detection, while also guiding root-cause diagnosis for complex shifts.

</details>


### [361] [Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion for Extreme-Aware Time-Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17407)
*Lin Jiang,Rongchao Xu,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CrossTF：利用时域与频域去噪器之间的"跨视图不对称性"，通过分阶段优化在晚期窗口内学习融合参数，实现极端事件保真的时间序列生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实时间序列生成需忠实复现稀有但高影响的极端事件。现有方法依赖专门表示或极端导向的训练目标，往往限制所捕获极端的多样性，或损害整体分布保真度。

Method: 核心经验发现为"极端敏感的跨视图不对称性"：沿连接时域与频域两视图干净样本估计的方向移动，可显著改变极端保真度而对整体生成质量影响有限；并识别出晚期跨视图窗口，其间该差异趋于稳定且跨视图调整对极端保真度影响尤强。据此设计分阶段优化：先训练并冻结两个去噪器，随后仅在该窗口内学习逐步融合参数，采用基于极值理论的目标函数并施加能量距离约束，从而支持在视图估计间插值及外推。

Result: 在 7 个真实数据集上与 11 个基线对比，CrossTF 相较最强基线将极端保真度提升 26.1%，整体性能提升 7.4%。

Conclusion: 跨视图差异可作为极端感知时间序列生成中低维优化的有效基础。

Abstract: Generating realistic time-series requires faithfully reproducing rare but high-impact extreme events. Existing approaches often rely on specialized representations or extreme-focused training objectives, which may restrict the diversity of captured extremes or compromise overall distributional fidelity. We propose Cross-View Time-Frequency Diffusion (CrossTF), a framework that exploits discrepancies between time- and frequency-view denoisers for extreme-aware time-series generation. Our key empirical finding is extreme-sensitive cross-view asymmetry: moving along the direction connecting the two views' clean-sample estimates substantially changes extreme fidelity while having limited effects on overall generation quality. We further identify a late-stage cross-view window in which this discrepancy stabilizes and cross-view adjustments have a particularly strong effect on extreme fidelity. These findings motivate a staged optimization strategy in CrossTF: after training and freezing both denoisers, it only needs to learn step-specific fusion parameters within this window using an Extreme Value Theory-based objective under an energy-distance constraint. This formulation supports interpolation between and extrapolation beyond the view-specific estimates while limiting degradation in overall generation quality. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets against 11 baselines show that CrossTF improves extreme fidelity by 26.1% and overall performance by 7.4% relative to the strongest baselines. These results highlight cross-view discrepancy as an effective basis for low-dimensional optimization in extreme-aware time-series generation.

</details>


### [362] [Position: Beyond Training Time, Test-Time Coordination is Essential for Cooperative MARL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17409)
*Dongsu Lee,Sooraj Sathish,Joonkyung Kim,Woojun Kim,Amy Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文主张：协作式多智能体强化学习应将"测试期协调"纳入问题定义，而非视为部署产物。作者提出"可恢复性缺口"（recoverability gap）概念，并界定了"集中训练与混合执行"（CTME）这一被忽视的问题设定，将CTDE作为其极限情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流范式CTDE仅在训练期使用全局信息，执行期无协调通道。这在智能体弱耦合或环境平稳时足够，但当团队需在条件变化后重新对齐时就会失效——该局限是结构性的，而非算法性的，增加训练无法补上执行期不存在的通道。

Method: 非提出新算法，而是提出一个新的协作MARL问题设定：CTME（集中训练与混合执行）。其中协调者观测全局状态并发出高层信号，智能体本地行动。该设定显式规定了团队级信息、高层信号及训练后的更新频率，CTDE作为其极限情形被恢复。

Result: 界定了"间歇性测试期协调"这一未被充分探索的设计空间，并通过CTME形式化了测试期信息结构；论证了去除测试期通道是建模选择而非必然。

Conclusion: 作者不主张CTDE已过时，而是指出：当具备全局遥测且团队需从漂移中恢复时，移除测试期通道是错误的默认设定。CTME为这类长时程、集中监控的协作系统提供了更显式的问题表述。

Abstract: We argue that cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) should treat test-time coordination as part of the problem definition rather than a deployment artifact. Our focus is on long-horizon, centrally monitored cooperative systems such as warehouse robotics, automated storage-and-retrieval systems, and cloud-resource scheduling, where teams share a reward, operate under shifting objectives, and already run with global telemetry at deployment. The dominant paradigm in this regime, centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE), uses global information only during training and provides no coordination channel at execution. This is sufficient when agents are weakly coupled or the environment is stationary, but it fails when the team must realign after conditions change. The limitation is structural rather than algorithmic, and more training cannot add a channel that does not exist at execution time. We call this the recoverability gap. To address it, we name the underexplored design space of intermittent test-time coordination as centralized training with mixed execution (CTME), in which a coordinator observes global state and emits high-level signals while agents act locally. CTME is not a particular learning algorithm, but a cooperative MARL problem setting that makes test-time information structure explicit. It specifies team-level information, high-level signals, and update frequency after training, with CTDE recovered as a limit case. We do not argue that CTDE is obsolete. We argue that removing the test-time channel is a modeling choice, not a necessity, and the wrong default when global telemetry is available and teams must recover from drift.

</details>


### [363] [On Making $\mathrm{SE}(2)$-Invariant Networks Optimal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17424)
*Tomas Karella,Emily Shinkle,Alice Elisabeth Anastasia Allen,Pieter J. Swart,Nicholas Lubbers,Roxana Bujack*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于经典不变量理论推导出对对称群可证明最优（极小且信息保持）的不变特征映射，并将其实现为可无缝嵌入CNN的即插即用模块以实现SE(2)不变性，在显著降低计算成本的条件下取得与SOTA等变方法相当或更优的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将平移等变性之外的更丰富对称群（如SE(2)的平移与旋转）作为归纳偏置引入神经网络，是架构与计算上的持续挑战；现有等变方法往往需要改动非线性层或归一化层，计算代价高，且缺乏对不变特征映射最优性的理论刻画。

Method: 从经典不变量理论出发，构造关于对称群"可证明最优"的不变特征映射，即极小（不冗余）且信息保持（不损失判别信息）；该构造可无缝集成到标准网络结构中，无需修改非线性层与归一化层。具体实现为面向CNN的即插即用模块，在标准架构内强制SE(2)不变性，同时覆盖平移与旋转。此外对等变性与不变性之间的关系进行了理论与实证分析。

Result: 所构建模型兼具高效性与表达力；实验显示在显著更低计算成本下，准确率与最先进等变方法相当或更优。关于等变性与不变性的分析揭示了二者在控制鲁棒性与灵活性方面的不同作用。

Conclusion: 以不变量理论为指导可获得极小且信息保持的最优不变特征映射，并能以即插即用方式低成本地为标准CNN赋予SE(2)不变性；等变性与不变性在鲁棒性和灵活性上扮演互补角色。

Abstract: Respecting a-priori known symmetries of underlying data is a key principle in designing efficient neural architectures. Convolutional neural networks are a canonical example, encoding translation equivariance. Extending this inductive bias to richer symmetry groups such as $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ in the most effective way possible is an ongoing architectural and computational challenge. Building on classical invariant theory, we derive invariant feature maps that are provably optimal: minimal and information-preserving with respect to the symmetry group. Our construction is designed to integrate seamlessly into standard architectures, requiring no modification to nonlinearities or normalization layers. As a concrete implementation, we introduce a plug-and-play module for convolutional neural networks that enforces $\mathrm{SE}(2)$ invariance, capturing both translations and rotations within standard architectures. The resulting models are both efficient and expressive. Experiments show competitive or improved accuracy compared to state-of-the-art equivariant methods at significantly lower computational cost. Finally, we provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of the relationship between equivariance and invariance, offering insight into their roles in controlling robustness and flexibility.

</details>


### [364] [EmoXpt: Analyzing Emotional Variances in Human Comments and LLM-Generated Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06597)
*Shireesh Reddy Pyreddy,Tarannum Shaila Zaman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出EmoXpt情感分析框架，基于推文数据对比人类对生成式AI的情绪与ChatGPT自身回复的情感，发现LLM生成回复更高效、连贯且更趋正面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI广泛应用引发支持与批评并存的多元观点；既有研究多只关注人类情感，缺乏对ChatGPT自身情绪表达的评估，因此需要同时刻画人类与LLM两方情感。

Method: 以提及ChatGPT、OpenAI、Copilot、LLMs等关键词的人类推文为数据，分析其情感动态；并让ChatGPT对选定推文作出回复，构建EmoXpt情感分析框架，同步评估人类对生成式AI的看法与ChatGPT回复中的情感。

Result: 实验结果显示，与人类回复相比，LLM生成的回复明显更高效、更连贯，并且情感上持续更偏正面。

Conclusion: EmoXpt为同时评估人类与LLM情感提供了新框架，揭示了人机情感表达的显著差异，有助于理解生成式AI的情感智能及其社会反响。

Abstract: The widespread adoption of generative AI has generated diverse opinions, with individuals expressing both support and criticism of its applications. This study investigates the emotional dynamics surrounding generative AI by analyzing human tweets referencing terms such as ChatGPT, OpenAI, Copilot, and LLMs. To further understand the emotional intelligence of ChatGPT, we examine its responses to selected tweets, highlighting differences in sentiment between human comments and LLM-generated responses. We introduce EmoXpt, a sentiment analysis framework designed to assess both human perspectives on generative AI and the sentiment embedded in ChatGPT's responses. Unlike prior studies that focus exclusively on human sentiment, EmoXpt uniquely evaluates the emotional expression of ChatGPT. Experimental results demonstrate that LLM-generated responses are notably more efficient, cohesive, and consistently positive than human responses.

</details>


### [365] [When Sparsity Breaks Connectivity: Functional Reachability and Guided Topology Dynamics in Extreme Sparse Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17425)
*Mohammad Pasande,Mateusz Jaworski,Jeroen Rook,Elena Mocanu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"可达性引导的动态稀疏训练"（guided DST），通过在分层稀疏图上形式化前向、反向与功能可达性并推导闭式期望，将其作为拓扑演化的指导信号，偏向剪除非功能边、再生功能一致的候选连接，从而在极高稀疏度下显著恢复精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态稀疏训练（DST）周期性剪枝与再生连接，在极端稀疏（≥99%）下这一动态过程易破坏输入-输出信息通路，导致标准幅度/随机更新策略性能急剧下降。作者希望从连通性保持的角度理解并缓解这一问题。

Method: 在分层稀疏图上形式化前向、反向与功能可达性，推导可达神经元与边的闭式期望，并用蒙特卡洛实现验证理论；据此设计可达性驱动的拓扑演化修改（guided DST），使剪枝偏向非功能边、再生偏向功能一致的候选连接。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 与 Tiny ImageNet 上，guided DST 相比未引导 DST 大幅缩小精度差距（CIFAR-100 在 99.9% 稀疏度下最高提升 +14.4 个百分点）；在 MLP-Mixer 上，guided DST 在 99.99% 稀疏度下仍可训练，而未引导随机再生则急剧退化。

Conclusion: 该工作将极端稀疏训练刻画为一种连通性保持的动力学过程，表明基于可达性结构的拓扑演化指导能有效维持信息通路，实现极端稀疏下的可训练性。代码已开源。

Abstract: Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) periodically prunes and regrows connections, inducing a discrete dynamical mechanism over network topologies. At extreme sparsity ($\ge 99\%$), this dynamic tends to destroy input-output information pathways, and performance with standard magnitude/random updates degrades sharply. We formalize forward, backward, and functional reachability on layered sparse graphs, derive closed-form expectations for reachable neurons and edges, and show that Monte Carlo realizations match the theory. Guided by this reachability-based structure, we bias pruning toward non-functional edges and regrowth toward functionally consistent candidates. We introduce this reachability-driven modification of topology evolution as Reachability-guided in DST, referred to as guided DST. On CIFAR-10/100 and Tiny ImageNet, guided DST recovers large accuracy gaps versus unguided DST (up to $+14.4$ points at $99.9\%$ sparsity on CIFAR-100), and on MLP-Mixer guided DST remains trainable at $99.99\%$ sparsity while unguided random regrowth degrades sharply. These results cast extreme-sparse training as a connectivity-preserving dynamical process. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/mzjaworski/ea_dst.

</details>


### [366] [Latent Algorithmic Structure Precedes Grokking: A Mechanistic Study of ReLU MLPs on Modular Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23784)
*Anand Swaroop*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReLU MLP在模加法grokking时学到近二值方波输入权重，输出权重相位满足φ_out=φ_a+φ_b；仅从噪声训练模型的权重中提取频率相位，即重构出95.5%准确率的理想化模型，说明grokking是"锐化"记忆期已编码的算法而非发现新算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作将grokking描述为transformer和MLP中产生正弦式输入权重分布。作者希望厘清ReLU MLP中权重结构的确切形式，并检验grokking究竟是在发现正确算法，还是在锐化记忆阶段已存在的算法。

Method: 实证观察ReLU MLP的权重分布形态；用DFT提取每个神经元权重的频率与相位，分析输出权重的Fourier相位关系；据此构造理想化MLP——输入权重替换为完美二值方波、输出权重替换为余弦，参数取自真实模型主Fourier分量；并在噪声数据训练模型上做提取重构验证。

Result: ReLU MLP学到近二值方波输入权重（中间值权重仅出现在符号变化边界附近），输出权重主Fourier相位满足相位和关系φ_out=φ_a+φ_b，该关系在噪声数据训练且未grokking时也成立。理想化模型在频率相位取自仅0.23%准确率的噪声训练模型时达到95.5%准确率。

Conclusion: Grokking并未发现正确算法，而是锐化一个在记忆阶段已被大量编码的算法：逐步将输入权重二值化为更干净的方波，并对齐输出权重，直至泛化成为可能。

Abstract: Grokking-the phenomenon where validation accuracy of neural networks on modular addition of two integers rises long after training data has been memorized-has been characterized in previous works as producing sinusoidal input weight distributions in transformers and multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs). We find empirically that ReLU MLPs in our experimental setting instead learn near-binary square wave input weights, where intermediate-valued weights appear exclusively near sign-change boundaries, alongside output weight distributions whose dominant Fourier phases satisfy a phase-sum relation $φ_{\mathrm{out}} = φ_a + φ_b$; this relation holds even when the model is trained on noisy data and fails to grok. We extract the frequency and phase of each neuron's weights via DFT and construct an idealized MLP: Input weights are replaced by perfect binary square waves and output weights by cosines, both parametrized by the frequencies, phases, and amplitudes extracted from the dominant Fourier components of the real model weights. This idealized model achieves 95.5% accuracy when the frequencies and phases are extracted from the weights of a model trained on noisy data that itself achieves only 0.23% accuracy. This suggests that grokking does not discover the correct algorithm, but rather sharpens an algorithm substantially encoded during memorization, progressively binarizing the input weights into cleaner square waves and aligning the output weights, until generalization becomes possible.

</details>


### [367] [Reinforcement Learning In Partially Verifiable Environments for Colon Cancer Treatment Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17426)
*Li-Ching Chen,Andrés Franco Valiente,Yuta Ishiyama,Zachary R. Chalmers,William Chen,Kelsey Natsuhara,Taema Brinjikji,Madhumita Sushil,Travis Zack,Julian C. Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将肿瘤治疗方案制定建模为部分可观测下的交互式强化学习问题，利用真实临床记录构建患者特异、过程感知的奖励，通过GRPO/GDPO优化Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，显著超越基座模型与前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床决策是部分可观测下的序贯过程，常无唯一正确决策。LLM在医学问答上表现强，但扩展到临床推理困难，因许多任务仅部分可验证。已有临床RL工作多聚焦可验证的诊断终点，而肿瘤治疗决策这类多路径均可辩护的任务仍难以获得有效学习信号。

Method: 将肿瘤治疗规划形式化为部分可观测下的交互式RL问题；从真实世界临床记录中的决策过程构建患者特异、过程感知的奖励。智能体需在结构化患者表征上序贯采集信息，再给出首选一线治疗推荐；评估涵盖信息采集、治疗选择与推理对齐。使用GRPO与GDPO在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上优化。

Result: RL大幅提升基座策略，超越前沿模型能力。GDPO训练的策略相较基座Llama的平均@3标量临床奖励提升79.60%，在同一交互环境下超过GPT-5.2达18.82%，同时训练期间查询次数减少。

Conclusion: 当患者状态与底层临床决策过程均仅被部分观测时，患者特异、部分可验证的奖励可为交互式临床RL提供有效学习信号。

Abstract: Clinical decision-making is a sequential process of information collection, clinical inference, and forecasting under partial observability, often without a uniquely correct treatment decision. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong medical question-answering capabilities but extending these advances to clinical reasoning remains challenging because many clinical tasks are only partially verifiable. Recent clinical reinforcement learning (RL) work has therefore largely focused on diagnostic endpoints, where correctness can be more directly verified. Oncology treatment decision making is a particularly challenging instance of this problem that extends beyond medical question-answering in which multiple decision trajectories can be clinically defensible for the same partially observed patient state. We formulate oncology treatment planning as an interactive RL problem under partial observability and construct patient-specific, process-aware rewards from decision processes observed in real world clinical records. The agent must learn to sequentially acquire information from a structured patient representation before committing to a first-line treatment recommendation, and is evaluated on information gathering, treatment selection, and reasoning alignment. Using GRPO and GDPO to optimize Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct within this environment, RL substantially improves the base policy beyond frontier model capabilities. The GDPO-trained policy increases Mean@3 scalar clinical reward by $79.60\%$ over base Llama and exceeds GPT-5.2 by $18.82\%$ under the same interactive environment, while reducing query count during training. Overall, our results show that patient-specific, partially verifiable rewards can provide an effective learning signal for interactive clinical RL when both the patient state and the underlying clinical decision process are only partially observed.

</details>


### [368] [Monarch-Muon: Structure-Aware Muon for Fast and Memory-Efficient Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17429)
*Alexander Miasnikov,Ruslan Kabirov,Gleb Molodtsov,Dmitrii Vlashchuk,Vladimir Aletov,Nail Bashirov,Daniil Tikhonov,Maxim Krutikov,Aleksandr Shestakov,Aleksandr Beznosikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Monarch-Muon结构化矩阵感知优化器，降低内存与耗时并提升质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型训练受墙钟时间与内存占用双重约束，Muon等矩阵感知优化器虽能改善优化效果，但其稠密极坐标更新代价高昂，亟需降低该开销。

Method: 针对以Monarch因子参数化的权重提出Monarch-Muon结构化优化器：利用该结构压缩权重、梯度与优化器状态，将单一稠密正交化替换为多个小规模独立更新子问题，并通过分块信赖域解释对该设计进行形式化。

Result: 固定结构下优于Monarch-AdamW：257M稠密模型3.06 vs 3.09，1B MoE模型2.68 vs 2.77；双块MoE变体在少用15%激活参数、25.4%总参数的情况下匹配稠密AdamW。6.89B规模实测将峰值内存从68.9降至52.9 GB，Muon优化器状态从14.60降至6.77 GB，优化器步耗时从1288降至304 ms。

Conclusion: Monarch-Muon在保持或提升模型质量的同时显著降低内存占用与优化器步耗时，验证了结构化矩阵感知优化在高效大模型训练中的有效性。

Abstract: Training large language models is constrained by both wall-clock time and memory footprint, and recent matrix-aware optimizers sharpen this tradeoff: Muon can improve optimization but its dense polar update remains expensive. We propose Monarch-Muon, a structured matrix-aware optimizer for weights parameterized by Monarch factors. The resulting structure reduces weights, gradients, and optimizer state, and exposes small independent update subproblems in place of a single dense orthogonalization; we formalize this through a blockwise trust-region interpretation. In quality runs, Monarch-Muon improves over Monarch-AdamW at fixed structure: 3.06 vs. 3.09 in the dense 257M model and 2.68 vs. 2.77 in the 1B MoE model; the two-block MoE variant also matches dense AdamW while using 15% fewer active and 25.4% fewer total parameters. In 6.89B-parameter systems measurements, Monarch-Muon reduces peak memory from 68.9 to 52.9 GB, Muon optimizer state from 14.60 to 6.77 GB, and the Muon optimizer step from 1288 to 304 ms.

</details>


### [369] [The belief-action gap in language model agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17444)
*Ayse Sila Okcu,Weisheng Wang,Tongmeng Xie,Niall Dalton,Angelos Nalmpantis,Raghu Arghal,Mario Giulianelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究测量语言模型智能体在文本网格世界中的状态信念、动作价值与动作偏好，发现任务相关信息常被表征却未被行为反映，失败部分源于信息到行动的转换而非信息缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体的失败原因各异，需要不同的解释与干预；作者希望厘清推理过程中状态信念、动作价值与动作偏好如何相互作用并影响决策承诺。

Method: 结合基于报告的探针与基于表征的探针估计任务相关信念，用逆向强化学习估计动作价值，并在推理全程追踪动作偏好；随后进行强制动作测试与推理窗口激活编辑实验。

Result: 任务相关的状态与价值信息在表征上往往比在行为中更可靠；决策在承诺点附近收敛，报告的不确定性在承诺附近下降，但单个信念变化不能稳定解释动作偏好的转变；移植其他决策的推理前缀可影响强制动作，而推理窗口激活编辑对动作控制有限。

Conclusion: 部分失败并非源于缺少任务相关信息，而是源于已有信息向行动的转换；该测量方法能区分信息可用性与信念—行动一致性，但本身不足以判定每种失败的具体成因。

Abstract: Language model (LM) agents can fail for different reasons, requiring different explanations and interventions. We study how state beliefs, action values, and action preferences interact as LM agents reason and commit to decisions in text-rendered grid worlds. We estimate task-relevant beliefs using report-based and representation-based probes, and action values using inverse reinforcement learning. We find that task-relevant state and value information is often represented more reliably than it is reflected in behaviour. Tracking action preferences throughout reasoning further shows that decisions sharpen around a commitment point and reported belief uncertainty decreases near commitment, although individual belief changes do not consistently explain shifts in action preference. Finally, forced actions follow reasoning prefixes from other decisions when transplanted, whereas the tested reasoning-window activation edits provide limited control over the action. Together, these results suggest that some failures arise not from missing task-relevant information, but from how available information is translated into action. Our measurements distinguish information availability from belief-action consistency without by themselves identifying the cause of each failure. Our code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/belief-action-gap-F745/

</details>


### [370] [On Sleep-Wake Disorder Identification from Polysomnographic Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17451)
*Alvise Dei Rossi,Luigi Fiorillo,Giuliana Monachino,Alessia Calzoni,Julia van der Meer,Markus H. Schmidt,Claudio L. A. Bassetti,Silvia Santini,Francesca Faraci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在统一的整夜、缺失感知状态空间下游框架下，比较冻结表征：规模与模态覆盖匹配时，睡眠分期监督编码器优于自监督PSG基础模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督PSG基础模型被期望捕获睡眠分期之外的临床信息，但此前很少与规模、模态覆盖相当的睡眠分期预训练编码器进行公平对比，导致其下游潜力可能被高估。

Method: 采用统一的整夜、缺失感知状态空间下游建模框架，冻结预训练表征，在来自未见注册队列的7,906例PSG上，对六类睡眠-觉醒及昼夜节律障碍组进行多标签识别；对比大规模多队列睡眠分期监督编码器与自监督PSG基础模型。

Result: PSG基础模型优于仅EEG、单队列的监督基线，但当监督预训练的规模与模态覆盖接近时，该排序反转；迁移自神经睡眠评分器的模型整体性能更高，且下游数据效率更好。

Conclusion: 评估PSG基础模型的下游潜力时，必须使用规模与模态匹配的监督预训练基线，否则结论可能存在偏差。

Abstract: Self-supervised polysomnography foundation models (PSG FMs) aim to capture clinically useful information beyond sleep staging, yet are rarely compared with sleep-staging encoders pretrained at comparable scale and modality coverage. Using a common whole-night, missingness-aware state-space downstream modeling framework, we compared frozen representations from prominent large-scale, multi-cohort sleep-stage-supervised encoders and self-supervised PSG FMs for multilabel identification of six sleep-wake and circadian disorder groups in 7,906 PSGs from an unseen registry. Although PSG FMs outperformed an EEG-only, single-cohort supervised baseline, this ordering reversed when supervised pretraining approached comparable scale and modality coverage. Transfer learning from neural sleep scorers achieved higher overall performance while exhibiting greater downstream data efficiency. These findings underscore the need for scale- and modality-matched pretrained supervised baselines when assessing PSG FMs' downstream potential.

</details>


### [371] [Effect of Spherical Parameter Space on Number of Non-Forgetting Tasks and Capacity of Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17453)
*Nazanin Mirhosseini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在高维球面参数空间（$d\\to\\infty$）下建立了持续学习的渐近理论模型：将每个任务的可接受解集建模为短程线球，任务最优解由Neyman-Scott团簇点过程生成，学习过程视为信道，并推导出保证"永不遗忘"（可行域非空）的任务数上界及总信息论容量上界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续学习中的核心矛盾是稳定性（不遗忘旧任务）与可塑性（学习新任务）之间的权衡。现有分析多缺乏对高维参数空间几何结构的刻画，也缺少对任务之间相似性/依赖关系的统计建模。本文希望借助高维球面几何与点过程工具，给出一个可分析的渐近框架，从而量化"在保证不遗忘的前提下最多能学多少任务"以及信息论容量上限。

Method: 1) 参数空间取 $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\\sqrt{d})$，$d\\to\\infty$；每个任务 $i$ 的损失面在球面上，其"可接受损失区域"用短程线球 $B_{\bm\\Theta_i}(r_i(d))$ 近似。2) 用 Neyman-Scott 团簇点过程 $\\Phi$ 建模任务最优解的相似性：团簇中心 $\\{\bm Y_j\\}$ 为球面上的齐次 Poisson 点过程，团内最优解服从均值 $\bm Y_j$、浓度 $\\kappa$ 的 von Mises-Fisher 分布。3) 把任务 $t$ 的学习算法抽象为信道 $Q_t(\\mathrm{d}\bm w_t\\mid \\bm w_{t-1},\\mathcal K_{t-1},\bm\\theta_t)$，其中 $\\mathcal K_{t-1}=\\bigcap_{i=1}^{t-1}B_{\bm\\Theta_i}(r_i(d))$ 为历史可行域交集。4) 成功条件为学到的参数落入 $B_{\bm\\Theta_t}(r_t(d))\\cap\\mathcal K_{t-1}$。5) 在该模型下做渐近分析（$d\\to\\infty$，$\\kappa/d\\to\\alpha$）。

Result: 推导出保证 $\\mathbb P[\\mathcal K_T(\bm\\Theta_{1:T})\\neq\\emptyset]\\to 1$（即存在同时满足所有任务的公共可行解、实现非遗忘）时，任务数 $T$ 的一个上界；其中极限条件为 $d\\to\\infty$ 且 $\\kappa/d\\to\\alpha$（$\\alpha>0$ 为常数）。进一步，对从 $\\Phi$ 中均匀采样的 $T$ 个任务，在非遗忘约束下给出了总信息论容量的上界。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个基于高维球面几何与点过程的持续学习渐近分析框架，揭示了任务相似性结构（团簇与浓度 $\\kappa$）对可持续学习任务数量和信息论容量的制约，为理解稳定性-可塑性权衡提供了可量化的理论边界。

Abstract: We propose a continuous learning formulation for $T$ non-forgetting tasks with the spherical parameter space $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ in asymptotic regime $d\rightarrow \infty$. Each task $i$ has an optimum $\bmΘ_i$, minimizing its corresponding loss function $R_i(\bm{w})$ on sphere. We reduce each task $i$ to an acceptable loss region modeled by a geodesic ball $B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$ on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ centered at $\bmΘ_i$ with radius $r_i(d)$. To model task dependencies (similarities), task optima $\bmΘ_i$ are distributed by a Neyman-Scott clustered point process $Φ$. Cluster centers $\{\bm{Y}_j\}_{j=1}^{N_p}$ form a homogeneous Poisson point process on sphere, while intra-cluster task optima follow a von Mises-Fisher distribution with mean $\bm{Y}_j$ and concentration $κ$. Each task $t\in \{1, ..., T\}$ learning algorithm is considered to be a channel $Q_{t}(\mathrm{d}\bm{w}_t | \bm{w}_{t-1}, \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmθ_{1:t-1}), \bmθ_t)$, where $\bm{W}_t$ is the learned parameter of task $t$ and $\mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})=\bigcap_{i=1}^{t-1}B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$. Since in continual learning, the learner does not need to reach $\bmΘ_t$ exactly to successfully learn task $t$, to avoid forgetting as well as reliable learning, it only needs for the learned parameter vector $\bm{W}_{t}$ to enter $B_{\bmΘ_t}(r_t(d)) \cap \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})$. Using this model, we derive an upper bound on $T$ ensuring $\mathbb{P}[\mathcal{K}_{T}(\bmΘ_{1:T}) \neq \emptyset] \rightarrow 1$ as $d\rightarrow \infty$ and $κ/d \rightarrow α$, where $α>0$ is a constant. Finally, for $T$ tasks sampled uniformly from $Φ$, we derive an upper bound for total information theoretic capacity under the non-forgetting constraint for each task.

</details>


### [372] [Assessing the Performance of AI Models in Misinformation Detection Using Predefined Social Noise Constructs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17469)
*Manar Alsaid*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将"社会噪声"概念引入虚假信息检测流程，基于50万条X平台乌克兰话题推文，评估六种文本模型与一种GNN，RoBERTa准确率达97.17%为最优，GNN达64.52%，LIME显示89.6%预测权重来自上下文特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体产生大量用户生成内容，形成"社会噪声"，会淹没有意义的话语并放大虚假信息。现有虚假信息检测方法主要聚焦事实核验，普遍忽视社会噪声在放大虚假信息中的作用，作者希望弥补这一空白，通过将社会噪声构念纳入AI流程提升检测与缓解效果。

Method: 采用预定义的社会噪声构念，构建数据集：从X平台采集2024年3月至2025年3月俄乌冲突期间带乌克兰话题标签的50万条推文。评估六种基于文本的模型以及一个图神经网络（GNN），并利用LIME可解释性分析考察预测依据，比较各模型在缓解虚假信息影响方面的表现。

Result: 先进机器学习模型表现强劲，准确率介于79.94%至97.17%之间。RoBERTa最优，准确率97.17%、Cohen's kappa 0.9660、MCC 0.9660、AUC 0.9977。GNN准确率64.52%、AUC 0.899，优于随机分类，说明其利用了推文间的关系结构。所有文本模型的kappa均大于0.75，总体一致性显著。LIME表明89.6%的预测权重来自上下文特征而非孤立关键词。

Conclusion: 将社会噪声整合进AI流程可增强虚假信息检测，并支持在大规模社交媒体环境中实施更有效的缓解策略；上下文特征在预测中起主导作用，凸显超越关键词与单纯事实核验的必要性。

Abstract: Social media platforms generate vast volumes of user-generated content that often obscure meaningful discourse, a phenomenon conceptualized as social noise. While existing misinformation detection methods primarily focus on factual verification, they largely overlook the role of social noise in amplifying misinformation. This study assesses the performance of six text-based models and a graph neural network (GNN) in mitigating the effects of misinformation using predefined social noise constructs. The dataset consists of 500,000 tweets collected from the X platform using the Ukraine hashtag during the Russia-Ukraine conflict from March 2024 to March 2025. Advanced machine learning models achieve strong performance, with accuracies ranging from 79.94% to 97.17%. RoBERTa demonstrates the highest performance, with an accuracy of 97.17%, Cohen's kappa of 0.9660, MCC of 0.9660, and AUC of 0.9977. The GNN achieves an accuracy of 64.52% and an AUC of 0.899, demonstrating performance above random-chance classification by exploiting the relational structure between tweets. All text-based models achieve kappa values greater than 0.75, indicating substantial overall agreement. Explainable AI analysis using LIME reveals that 89.6% of predictive weight is attributed to contextual features rather than isolated keywords. The findings highlight that integrating social noise into AI pipelines enhances misinformation detection and supports more effective mitigation strategies in large-scale social media environments.

</details>


### [373] [Structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics for partial differential equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17483)
*Kyriakos Flouris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一套结构保持保真度诊断指标，可在无训练数据与方程访问条件下判别机器学习代理模型是学到了物理还是数值离散误差，其对真实动力学的误差排序相关性最高达0.94，而测试损失与之无关甚至反向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PDE机器学习代理模型通常由数值求解器生成的数据训练，故训练数据服从的是数值格式的修正方程而非原PDE；在同一求解器数据上计算的测试损失无法区分"学到物理"与"学到离散误差"的模型，需要新的评估手段。

Method: 提出一组结构保持保真度诊断（structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics）：仅依赖模型对某一已知物理性质（如守恒量、对称性、哈密顿结构）的满足程度构造简单评分，无需访问训练数据或控制方程。

Result: 在五个系统上，诊断指标与相对真实动力学的误差的排序相关性最高达0.94，而测试损失与之不相关或呈反相关；对Burgers、Korteweg-de Vries与Navier-Stokes方程，诊断指标能区分测试损失判定为等价（包括同阶）的数值格式。

Conclusion: 结构保持保真度诊断可作为独立于训练数据和方程的模型评估工具，揭示被测试损失掩盖的离散误差学习问题，并用于甄别数值格式对代理模型保真度的影响。

Abstract: Machine learning surrogates of partial differential equations (PDEs) are commonly trained on data generated by numerical solvers. Therefore, the training data obey not the PDE but the modified equation of the numerical scheme, and the test loss, computed on data from the same solver, cannot distinguish a model that learned the physics from one that learned the discretization error. Here, we show that the difference is nevertheless visible in the trained model. We propose a suite of structure-preserving fidelity diagnostics, simple scores that measure whether a learned model respects one known property of the physics, such as a conserved quantity, a symmetry or a Hamiltonian structure, without access to the training data or the governing equation. Over five systems, the diagnostics track the error with respect to the true dynamics with a rank correlation of up to $0.94$, while the test loss is uncorrelated or anti-correlated with it. For the Burgers, Korteweg-de Vries and Navier-Stokes equations, the diagnostics separate numerical schemes that the test loss ranks as equivalent, including schemes of the same order. order.

</details>


### [374] [A Time-Synchronous Prequential Evaluation Framework for Next-Week Student Disengagement Prediction from Moodle LMS Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17490)
*David Otoo-Arthur,Terence L. van Zyl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究构建了时间同步的前序（prequential）在线预测框架，用于基于Moodle日志预测学生下周的脱离行为（不活跃起始），并对SGD-LR、OSELM和ESN三种在线模型进行比较评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回顾性评估可能无法反映预测发布及结果可观测时的真实可用信息，因此需要一个时间同步、按日历时间顺序进行的在线评估框架，以更真实地反映预警模型的实际部署表现。

Method: 按日历时间排序，模型仅用已可获得的结果更新，且在每个预测截点保持不变；开发、校准与评估在时间上分离。比较SGD-LR、OSELM和ESN在预测性能、固定/冻结/滚动阈值策略、日历时间变异及四类行为特征集上的表现，保留集包含49,329次预测，不活跃起始率为37.68%。
