However, Sinkhorn divergence is based on balanced optimal transport, whose exact marginal constraints can induce undesirable transport under finite minibatch fluctuations. We introduce UW-Flow, which replaces the balanced Sinkhorn energy with a debiased unbalanced Sinkhorn divergence and derives the corresponding Wasserstein velocity. The resulting dynamics retain W-Flow's cross-minus-self structure, recover the balanced limit, and preserve target identifiability under suitable assumptions. We further characterize the finite-batch velocity error of balanced and unbalanced transport by comparing each minibatch field with its population counterpart. Our analysis identifies conditions under which marginal relaxation yields smaller minibatch-to-population velocity error, and shows that for separated matched modes, balanced sensitivity grows with inter-mode separation while the corresponding Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) sensitivity remains controlled by local transport geometry. Controlled experiments on fixed-support and continuous two-mode distributions support these predictions. On MNIST, CIFAR-10, and ImageNet-100, UW-Flow improves generation under matched training budgets, with the largest gains in unconditional generation and consistent improvements in the class-conditional setting.

</details>


### [478] [Last-Iterate Convergence of Clipped SGD with Linear Decay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18555)
*Wei Jiang,Haomin Bai,Zechao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究重尾噪声下裁剪随机梯度下降（clipped SGD）的末迭代收敛性，给出凸、复合及非光滑目标的收敛上界，并分析因果攻击者替换少量梯度时的鲁棒性，同时提供干净与受损模型的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重尾噪声（仅有有界中心p阶矩，1<p≤2）在实际随机优化中常见，而以往多数工作关注平均迭代或遍历意义下的收敛，末迭代收敛刻画更贴近算法实际输出。本文旨在填补裁剪SGD在重尾噪声下末迭代收敛理论的空白，并探讨其在对抗梯度破坏下的鲁棒性。

Method: 假设随机梯度无偏且噪声具有有界中心p阶矩。对光滑凸目标采用线性递减学习率分析裁剪SGD的高概率误差界；进一步借助近端更新（proximal updates）将末迭代保证扩展到非光滑复合目标与光滑复合目标；并考虑因果攻击者可替换至多q个梯度，分析同一裁剪更新的误差界；最后构造干净与受损oracle模型对应的下界。

Result: 对光滑凸目标得到高概率误差界 O(LR²log(1/δ)/T + σR(log(1/δ)/T)^{(p-1)/p})；在非光滑与光滑复合目标上经近端更新也建立了末迭代保证；当因果攻击者替换至多q个梯度时，同类裁剪更新达到将log(1/δ)替换为log(1/δ)+q的界；并给出干净与受损oracle模型相应的下界。

Conclusion: 裁剪SGD在重尾噪声下具有可证的末迭代收敛性，且对少量因果梯度替换具有鲁棒性；所得上界与下界相互匹配，说明所给界在相应oracle模型下（在阶上）是紧的。该结果将裁剪机制的收敛理论统一扩展到末迭代、复合目标与对抗破坏场景。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the last-iterate convergence of clipped stochastic gradient descent under heavy-tailed noise. We assume that the stochastic gradients are unbiased and that the noise has a bounded central $p$-th moment, where $1<p\le2$. For smooth convex objectives, a linearly decreasing learning rate gives a high-probability error bound of order $O(LR^2\log(1/δ)/T+σR(\log(1/δ)/T)^{(p-1)/p})$. We further establish last-iterate guarantees for nonsmooth composite objectives and smooth composite objectives with proximal updates. In addition, when a causal adversary replaces at most $q$ gradients, the same clipped update achieves a bound with $\log(1/δ)$ replaced by $\log(1/δ)+q$. The corresponding lower bounds for the clean and corrupted oracle models are also provided.

</details>


### [479] [When More Objectives Make Identification Easier: The Role of Preferences and Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18577)
*Bo Xue,Ji Cheng,Yuanyu Wan,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多目标老虎机中的最佳臂识别（BAI），针对高斯老虎机建立了对所有偏好序一致成立的"特征时间"下界，通过Pareto、线性、字典序偏好下的显式比较揭示三种反直觉现象，并提出渐近最优算法OATS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有BAI研究多聚焦单一目标，而现实应用常涉及多准则，因而推动多目标老虎机BAI的研究。直觉上多目标识别因需要在更高维奖励空间中识别最优臂而更难，但额外目标也提供了更丰富反馈、可能减少所需探索。本文旨在刻画多目标何时以及为何使BAI变得更容易。

Method: 针对高斯老虎机，建立固定置信度识别下的特征时间（characteristic-time）下界，且该下界对所有偏好序一致成立；在Pareto、线性与字典序偏好下进行显式比较分析；提出Order-Aware Track-and-Stop（OATS）算法，该算法在任意指定置信水平下正确，并渐近匹配下界。

Result: 揭示三种现象：(i) 识别更大的最优集合可能比识别唯一最优所需样本更少；(ii) 向量反馈相对坐标反馈的优势本质上取决于偏好序；(iii) 多目标识别所需样本甚至可能少于最容易的对应单目标问题。OATS算法在任意给定置信度下正确且渐近达到下界。

Conclusion: 多目标并非必然使BAI更难，其难度取决于偏好序与最优集结构；特征时间下界统一刻画了这一现象，OATS算法实现了渐近最优的多目标最佳臂识别。

Abstract: Best-arm identification (BAI) aims to identify the optimal arm using as few samples as possible. While most existing work focuses on a single objective, many real-world applications involve multiple criteria, which motivates the study of BAI in multi-objective bandits. Intuitively, multi-objective identification seems harder, since the learner must identify optimal arms in a higher-dimensional reward space; however, the additional objectives also provide richer feedback that can reduce the required exploration. In this paper, we characterize when and why multiple objectives can make BAI easier. For Gaussian bandits, we establish a characteristic-time lower bound for fixed-confidence identification that holds uniformly across preference orders. Through explicit comparisons under Pareto, linear, and lexicographic preferences, we reveal three phenomena: (i) identifying a larger optimal set can require fewer samples than identifying a unique optimum; (ii) the advantage of vector feedback over coordinate feedback depends fundamentally on the preference order; and (iii) multi-objective identification can require fewer samples than even the easiest corresponding single-objective problem. Finally, we propose Order-Aware Track-and-Stop (OATS), an algorithm that is correct at any prescribed confidence level and asymptotically matches the lower bound.

</details>


### [480] [Fairness under Prediction Error in Predict-then-Optimize Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18593)
*Hilda Adwubi Osei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在 predict-then-optimize 流程中，基于预测值 $\hat{y}$ 强制的人口均等（demographic parity）约束在真实结果 $y$ 上会系统性失效，且违背程度随预测误差 $σ$ 增长并饱和；真实结果层面的公平性缺口平均而言不随样本量变化，仅方差以 $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ 衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策时真实结果 $y$ 不可观测，因此公平约束只能施加于预测 $\hat{y}$。论文关注一个被忽视的问题：这样施加的约束是否对真实结果 $y$ 仍然成立，以及违背程度如何随预测误差 scaling。

Method: 以预算约束的分配问题为例，将其建模为线性规划求解；在合成场景中通过数值实验刻画真实结果公平缺口随预测误差 $σ$ 的变化，并拟合 $c(1-e^{-σ/τ})$ 形式；推导两部分理论界：一是闭式局部敏感性结果（缺口对预测误差的一阶响应仅取决于每组两人，与求解器验证吻合至三位有效数字），二是由决策变量有界性得到的、与误差无关的普适上界。随后在 US Census income 数据上，对已训练预测器的输出施加人口均等约束，并在加利福尼亚与德克萨斯两州、各十次独立 train/test 划分下检验真实收入层面的剩余差距。

Result: 真实结果公平缺口随 $σ$ 单调增长并饱和，拟合为 $c(1-e^{-σ/τ})$，其中 $c=0.1545\pm0.0103$、$τ=3.9045\pm0.3745$；缺口均值与样本量无关，方差以标准 $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ 速率衰减。闭式局部敏感性结果与求解器吻合至三位有效数字；普适上界与经验饱和水平一致但更松。在 US Census income 数据上，基于预测输出的人口均等约束把真实收入中未约束的差距降为约原来的三分之一，仍残留 34.4%±3.3%（加州）与 35.7%±1.8%（德州）的差距，且无法从预测本身察觉；这一机制与近似量级在两个人口结构和收入分布不同的州之间保持一致，并在每州十次独立划分下稳定。

Conclusion: 在决策时看似被完全满足的公平约束，可能掩盖对它所保护的真实结果的实质性、系统性违背；因此在 predict-then-optimize 流程中评估公平性，必须超越预测层面，关注真实结果层面的残余不公。

Abstract: Fairness constraints in predict-then-optimize pipelines are necessarily enforced on predicted outcomes $\hat{y}$, since true outcomes $y$ are unobserved at decision time. We study whether a demographic parity constraint enforced this way continues to hold against $y$, and how the resulting violation scales with prediction error. Using a budget-constrained allocation problem solved as a linear program, we show empirically that the true-outcome fairness gap grows with prediction error $σ$ and saturates, well fit by $c(1 - e^{-σ/τ})$ with $c = 0.1545 \pm 0.0103$ and $τ= 3.9045 \pm 0.3745$; its mean is invariant to sample size while its variance decays at the standard $O(1/\sqrt{n})$ rate. We derive a two-part theoretical bound: a closed-form local sensitivity result showing the gap's first-order response to prediction error depends on only two individuals per group, validated against the solver to within three significant figures; and a universal, error-independent ceiling following from the boundedness of the decision variable, confirmed consistent with but looser than the empirical saturation level. On US Census income data, enforcing demographic parity on a trained predictor's output reduces an unconstrained disparity in true income to roughly one-third of its original size, leaving 34.4% $\pm$ 3.3% (California) and 35.7% $\pm$ 1.8% (Texas) of the disparity intact and undetectable from the predictions alone -- consistent not only in mechanism but in approximate magnitude across two states with different demographics and income distributions, and stable across ten independent train/test splits in each. A fairness constraint that appears fully satisfied at decision time can mask a substantial, systematic violation of the outcome it was meant to protect.

</details>


### [481] [Does self-distillation improve reasoning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18613)
*Jason Ken Adhinarta,Raina Wu,Ashutosh Sharma,Avinash Balakrishnan,Rameswar Panda,Polina Golland,Yoon Kim,Zhang-Wei Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视两种代表性自蒸馏方法SDPO与OPSD，发现其报告的性能提升不能稳定泛化到未见问题，主要源于过拟合或迁移已有推理行为，而非有效利用特权信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自蒸馏方法在训练时模仿自身在特权信息（如正确答案、环境反馈）条件下的预测，近期报告称其样本效率与泛化性优于强化学习（RL），但这些收益是否能在分布外评估中成立、以及是否真正来自特权蒸馏，尚不清楚。

Method: 在代码、科学、工具使用和数学推理任务上，对两种代表性方法SDPO（自蒸馏策略优化）和OPSD（同策略自蒸馏）进行重新评估；分析其增益是否泛化到未见问题，并考察自蒸馏梯度与直接优化期望回报的策略梯度之间的对齐程度。实验模型包括Qwen3（1.7B–14B）和OLMo-3-7B。

Result: 报告的性能提升不能一致地泛化到未见问题，主要由过拟合或对已有推理行为的迁移所解释，而非有效利用特权信息；自蒸馏梯度与直接优化期望回报的策略梯度对齐性较弱，因而作为策略改进方向的有效性存疑。

Conclusion: 在Qwen3（1.7B–14B）与OLMo-3-7B上的实验表明，如何有效利用特权信息提升推理能力仍是一个未解决的开放问题。

Abstract: Self-distillation is an emerging approach that trains a model to imitate its own predictions when conditioned on privileged information, such as correct answers or environmental feedback. Recent methods have reported better sample efficiency and generalization than reinforcement learning (RL), but it remains unclear whether these gains extend beyond in-distribution evaluations and whether they stem from privileged distillation. In this paper, we revisit two representative methods, Self-Distillation Policy Optimization (SDPO) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), across code, science, tool use, and math reasoning tasks. We find that their reported gains do not consistently generalize to unseen problems and are largely explained by overfitting or transferring existing reasoning behavior, rather than effectively using privileged information. Moreover, self-distillation gradients show weak alignment with policy gradients that directly optimize expected reward, questioning whether they provide an effective direction for policy improvement. Our experiments across Qwen3 models (1.7B-14B) and OLMo-3-7B suggest that effectively leveraging privileged information to improve reasoning remains an open challenge. Our code is available at https://github.com/sleepypandu/does-sd-improve-reasoning

</details>


### [482] [Deterministic Prediction as Global Velocity: Flow Matching for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecast](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18621)
*Jiajing Hu,Xu Han,Li-Ping Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DV-Flow，一种统一流匹配框架，将确定性预测器作为并行速度分量而非传输路径终点，实现稳定端到端训练并提升概率预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列预测中不确定性量化至关重要，现有生成模型方法常将确定性预测与生成建模结合，但确定性模型嵌入生成过程中导致计算图过深、概率传输路径改变，联合训练不稳定。

Method: 提出DV-Flow统一流匹配（flow-matching）框架，将确定性预测器建模为并行速度分量，而非传输路径的终点，从而支持稳定的端到端优化，并将多种现有形式纳入为特例以便直接比较。

Result: 在六个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，DV-Flow相较强基线在概率预测性能上取得一致提升。

Conclusion: DV-Flow通过重构确定性预测器与生成过程的耦合方式，解决了现有方法联合训练不稳定问题，为概率时间序列预测提供了统一且有效的框架。

Abstract: Accurate uncertainty quantification is critical for many time series forecasting applications, and recent studies have increasingly adopted generative models to capture predictive uncertainty. Existing approaches often combine deterministic forecasting with generative modeling to improve predictive performance. However, their joint training is typically unstable because the deterministic model is embedded within the generative process, resulting in deep computational graphs and changing the probability transport path. In this work, we propose DV-Flow, a unified flow-matching formulation that incorporates the deterministic predictor as a parallel velocity component rather than as the endpoint of the transport path. This design enables stable end-to-end optimization while subsuming several existing formulations as special cases, allowing direct comparisons among them. Extensive experiments on six real-world datasets demonstrate that DV-Flow consistently improves probabilistic forecasting performance over strong baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/tufts-ml/dv-flow-time-series.

</details>


### [483] [Geometric Calibration of Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18634)
*Jianzhu Bao,Jia-Chen Gu,Qingyuan Liu,Haozhen Zhang,Kai-Wei Chang,Nanyun Peng,Wenya Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出几何校准视角，并开发了免数据、免训练的 SPACE 方法，通过在原版权重主成分子空间内选择性回退 SFT 更新分量，缓解域外能力退化并提升域内性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SFT 会产生稠密更新，扰动原版权重沿主方向的谱几何结构，可能破坏模型的先验知识，因此需要以 SFT 前权重的几何结构为参考来精炼 SFT 更新。

Method: 将问题形式化为几何校准，提出 SPACE（子空间投影用于适配检查点增强）：一种轻量级事后方法，仅在 SFT 前权重的主子空间内选择性回退 SFT 更新分量，同时保留其正交补空间中的分量；该方法无需数据与训练，仅需 SFT 前和 SFT 后的检查点。

Result: 在 Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Llama-3.1 和 Olmo-3（2B 至 14B）上，覆盖数学、代码、医学 SFT 及多种 SFT 变体进行评估。SPACE 缓解域外（OOD）能力回归，并相比未校准的 SFT 检查点进一步提升域内（ID）性能。数学 SFT 下，Qwen2.5-7B 的 ID/OOD 平均增益为 2.85/2.26 分，Qwen3-14B-Base 为 2.41/1.52 分。

Conclusion: 结果表明 SFT 更新与 SFT 前权重的几何关系塑造了适配模型的能力，并进一步支持采用几何感知的参数更新以实现模型的持续改进。

Abstract: Recent studies investigate the weight geometry through its spectral structure, which characterizes how the weights transform different input directions. Within this view, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is shown to induce dense updates that perturb the spectral geometry of pre-SFT weights along their principal directions, potentially disrupting the model's prior knowledge. These observations motivate using the geometry of pre-SFT weights as a reference for refining learned SFT updates. We study this perspective as Geometric Calibration and develop SPACE Subspace Projection for Adapted Checkpoint Enhancement), a lightweight post-hoc method that selectively reverts SFT update components within the principal subspace of the pre-SFT weights while preserving those in its orthogonal complement. SPACE is a data-free, training-free method that requires only the pre- and post-SFT checkpoints. We evaluate SPACE on Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Llama-3.1, and Olmo-3 models ranging from 2B to 14B, across mathematical, coding, and medical SFT, as well as several SFT variants. Overall, SPACE mitigates out-of-domain (OOD) capability regression while further improving in-domain (ID) performance over the uncalibrated SFT checkpoints. For math SFT, SPACE yields average ID/OOD gains of 2.85/2.26 points on Qwen2.5-7B, and 2.41/1.52 points on Qwen3-14B-Base, respectively. These results highlight how the geometric relationship between SFT updates and pre-SFT weights shapes the adapted model's capabilities and, more broadly, motivate geometry-aware parameter updates for continual model improvement.

</details>


### [484] [MultiAlloc: Budget-Aware Precision Allocation for KV Cache Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18642)
*Yangchengyu Zhou,Zhiping Wu,Runchang Jiang,Dongdong Ren,Youfang Han,Wei Zhao,Dongqi Cai,Wenbin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MultiAlloc：一种基于离线画像的KV缓存精度分配框架，在固定内存预算下自适应地在"层粒度精度增强"与"token粒度信息保留"之间分配量化资源，无需在线搜索，在推理与长上下文任务上一致优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV缓存是LLM推理（尤其长上下文与复杂推理）中的主要显存开销来源。现有KV缓存量化工作分别从层粒度精度调整和token级信息保留等不同压缩粒度入手，但在实际部署中，核心挑战不只是"压缩多少"，而是：在固定KV缓存内存预算下，如何将有限的量化资源在多种异构的精度保持策略之间进行分配。该跨粒度资源分配问题此前缺乏系统性建模与解决方案。

Method: 提出MultiAlloc——面向KV缓存量化的画像引导（profiling-guided）精度分配框架。方法要点：（1）利用轻量级离线画像刻画两层信息：层敏感度（layer sensitivity）与token重要性（token importance）；（2）在固定内存约束下，依据画像得到的"内存—精度"权衡曲线，自适应地确定量化资源在层粒度精度增强与token粒度保留之间的分配比例；（3）离线推导出有效的精度分配策略，推理时直接应用该策略，避免在线分配搜索带来的开销。

Result: 在推理与长上下文基准上的大量实验表明，在相同内存预算下，MultiAlloc在多种模型（Mistral、Llama、DeepSeek-Qwen、QwQ）上一致优于层粒度方法、token粒度方法以及近期多粒度KV缓存量化方法。

Conclusion: KV缓存量化的关键应从单一粒度压缩转向固定预算下的跨粒度精度资源分配。通过离线画像刻画层敏感度与token重要性并据此推导分配策略，可在不增加在线开销的前提下实现更优的内存—精度权衡，为KV缓存量化提供了一条可部署的有效路径。

Abstract: The Key-Value (KV) cache constitutes a dominant source of memory consumption during large language model (LLM) inference, particularly in long-context and complex reasoning scenarios. Existing KV cache quantization methods have explored different compression granularities, including layer-wise precision adjustment and token-level information preservation. In practical deployment, however, the key challenge is not merely compression, but how to allocate limited quantization resources among heterogeneous precision preservation strategies under a fixed KV cache memory budget. We propose MultiAlloc, a profiling-guided precision allocation framework for KV cache quantization that adaptively distributes limited quantization resources between layer-wise precision enhancement and token-wise preservation. MultiAlloc employs lightweight offline profiling to characterize layer sensitivity and token importance, enabling adaptive precision allocation under a fixed memory constraint. Guided by the profiled memory--accuracy trade-off, it automatically derives an effective precision allocation strategy without online allocation search, and applies the resulting policy during inference. Extensive experiments on reasoning and long-context benchmarks demonstrate that MultiAlloc consistently improves over layer-wise, token-wise, and recent multi-granularity KV cache quantization methods under matched memory budgets across diverse models, including Mistral, Llama, DeepSeek-Qwen, and QwQ.

</details>


### [485] [Tiny Recursive Message Passing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18649)
*Tommaso Salvatori,Matteo Forasassi,Alexis Toumi,Giovanni de Felice*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将深度监督+截断递归训练与离散演绎栅格等测试时程序应用于消息传递网络，在Sudoku-Extreme上以16k参数达约99%准确率，并实现零样本跨问题规模迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归Transformer结合深度监督、截断递归与测试时离散演绎已在算法与约束推理中取得优异表现，本文探究这些程序能否迁移到消息传递网络，并验证两类要素（架构递归训练与测试时程序）是否互补，从而实现参数高效且可迁移的推理模型。

Method: 在消息传递神经网络上沿用递归Transformer的训练范式：采用深度监督与截断递归使极深循环稳定可训，并在测试时引入离散演绎栅格等程序；同时分析梯度截断代价与信息在图上传导轮数的关系，考察连边拓扑在截断鲁棒性与跨问题规模迁移间的权衡。

Result: 在Sudoku-Extreme上以16k参数模型取得约99%测试准确率，H100上约10分钟、CPU上约9小时即可训练完成；实验表明深度监督/截断递归与测试时程序互补且参数高效；梯度截断代价随信息跨图所需轮数增长，连边选择存在鲁棒性与迁移性的权衡；模型可零样本迁移到训练时未见过的更大实例，在N-queens与布尔可满足性上以远少于流行神经基线的参数量取得更优表现。

Conclusion: 消息传递网络结合深度监督、截断递归与测试时演绎程序，可构建参数高效、训练快速且具零样本规模泛化能力的推理模型，优于常用神经基线。

Abstract: Message passing neural networks have shown remarkable performance in algorithmic and constraint reasoning, due to their ability to encode the structure of the task directly in the architecture. Recent work has shown that better results can be achieved using recursive transformers trained with deep supervision and truncated recursions, which make extremely deep loops stable to train, and equipped with test-time procedures such as discrete deduction lattices. In this work, we apply the same procedures to message passing networks, and show that the two ingredients are complementary, and lead to parameter efficient models: we obtain about $99\%$ test accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme with a model of $16$k parameters that trains in about $10$ minutes on an H100, or in $9$ hours on a CPU. We further show that the cost of truncating gradients grows with the number of rounds information needs to cross the graph, making the choice of wiring a trade-off between robustness to truncation and transfer across problem sizes. We conclude by showing that our models transfer zero-shot to larger instances than those seen during training, outperforming popular neural baselines on N-queens and Boolean satisfiability with a fraction of their parameters.

</details>


### [486] [Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18651)
*Leif Sieben,Yoel Zimmermann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了化学语言模型（CLM）预训练的效果：在64个分子性质预测数据集上，预训练带来的下游增益并不随规模提升而扩大，性能饱和且低于梯度提升基线；仅基于传统理化描述符的监督预训练能稳定提升性能，部分预训练甚至不如随机初始化编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 化学语言模型被广泛用于学习可迁移至下游任务的分子表示，但预训练是否真正带来实质收益、其增益是否随规模增长尚缺乏系统性评估，作者因此希望厘清预训练在CLM中的真实作用与边界。

Method: 采用一系列化学语言模型，在64个分子性质预测数据集上系统对比不同预训练方式（包括化学/理化描述符预训练、其他形式的预训练）与随机初始化编码器、梯度提升基线，考察预训练对下游性能的影响及其缩放规律。

Result: 预训练带来的下游增益不随规模扩大而增长，性能饱和并低于梯度提升基线；在所评估的各种设置中，只有对传统理化描述符进行监督预训练能持续提升下游性能，而某些预训练形式得到的模型甚至比随机初始化编码器更差；模型虽能较好解析分子结构，但表现并不优于随机初始化模型。

Conclusion: CLM在预训练中至多学习到类描述符性质以及低层次的词元统计特征，除了经典分子特征已捕捉的信息外，其学到的化学知识出乎意料地有限，提示当前化学语言模型预训练范式的有效性存在局限。

Abstract: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.

</details>


### [487] [Bayesian Test-Time Inference of Task-Aligned Similarity from Weak Interactive Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18656)
*Weida Liang,Kenji Kawaguchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BASIS是一种免训练的贝叶斯方法，利用弱测试时反馈在预设任务准则库中推断当前决策应对齐的相似性准则，并联合推断目标与准则，在概念恢复、示例选择与响应改进任务上优于静态混合规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型系统在测试时频繁通过相似性比较做决策（检索示例、排序候选、修正响应），但相似性并非唯一：词汇、语义、结构、风格等相似度可能指向不同候选，且任务对齐的相似性判据会随实例变化。固定的单一准则或固定混合准则在准则漂移时会失效。

Method: 提出BASIS（Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals），一种免训练的贝叶斯方法：维护关于候选目标与相似性准则的联合后验，利用标量分数、成对偏好或验证器输出等弱测试时反馈进行更新，并通过期望信息增益选择探针。文中在有限噪声模型下刻画了目标-准则对可恢复的条件。

Result: 在概念恢复、推理示例选择与响应改进三类任务上，相比调优的静态混合方法，BASIS将六探针概念恢复Success@1从56.0%提升至68.1%，推理准确率从72.3%提升至73.1%，响应改进胜率从61.4%提升至63.8%；在等算力下也超过best-of-N选择（推理72.1%、改进61.2%）。准则不匹配和候选池更大时增益最显著，匹配对照表明自适应准则加权贡献了主要收益，联合目标-准则推断带来额外提升。

Conclusion: BASIS表明自适应准则选择能有效缓解测试时相似性判据漂移问题，联合推断目标与准则优于固定准则或固定混合策略。其局限是仅在预设准则集合内选择，无法发现新准则。

Abstract: Language model systems repeatedly make test-time decisions by comparing similarity: they retrieve exemplars, rank candidates, and revise responses. Yet similarity is not unique: lexical, semantic, structural, and stylistic resemblance can point to different candidates, and the task-aligned notion can change across instances. We introduce BASIS (Bayesian Axis Selection via Interactive Signals), a training-free Bayesian method that uses weak test-time feedback to infer which criterion in a supplied, task-specific library governs the current decision. It maintains a joint posterior over candidate targets and criteria, updates it from scalar scores, pairwise preferences, or verifier outputs, and selects probes by expected information gain. In a finite noisy model, we characterize when the target-criterion pair is recoverable and show why fixed-criterion and fixed-mixture rules can fail under criterion shift. Across concept recovery, reasoning exemplar selection, and response refinement, BASIS improves six-probe concept-recovery Success@1 from 56.0% to 68.1%, reasoning accuracy from 72.3% to 73.1%, and refinement win rate from 61.4% to 63.8% over tuned static mixtures. It also exceeds compute-matched best-of-N selection on reasoning (72.1%) and refinement (61.2%). Gains are largest under criterion mismatch and with larger candidate pools, and matched controls indicate that adaptive criterion weighting explains much of the benefit, with joint target-criterion inference adding further value. BASIS selects only among supplied criteria and does not discover new ones.

</details>


### [488] [BridgeTwist: Twisting Schrödinger Bridges for Training-Free Conditional Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18658)
*Mengyu Li,Qianqian Qu,Jun S. Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 BridgeTwist，一种面向预训练 Schrödinger bridge 生成模型的无训练条件采样器，基于 tempered twisted 序贯蒙特卡洛框架，实现渐近精确的后验采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型已有无训练条件采样器，但作为灵活随机传输模型的 Schrödinger bridge（SB）尚无对应的无训练条件采样方法，该空白亟待填补。

Method: 采用 tempered twisted 序贯蒙特卡洛方案：将 SB 预训练得到的 velocity 与 score 场组合为端点预测器，并在该端点处评估似然，构造闭式 plug-in twist 代理；因该代理在源端附近不可靠，引入时变指数对 twist 进行退火（tempering），在早期步骤降低其权重；同时设计桥形推理时扩散调度，使提议噪声集中于路径内部；利用 telescoping 重要性权重抵消所有中间 twist 因子。

Result: 在类条件与文本提示图像生成上优于无训练基线；在 inpainting、deblurring、超分辨率任务上与专用逆问题求解器相当。

Conclusion: BridgeTwist 为预训练 SB 模型提供了首个无训练条件采样框架，通过 tempered twisted SMC 与桥形调度实现渐近精确的后验采样，并在多种条件生成任务中验证了有效性。

Abstract: Generative models are often required to serve many downstream conditional tasks. In the training-free setting, a pretrained unconditional model is reused as a prior and combined with a task-specific likelihood to sample from the corresponding posterior. While such training-free samplers have been developed for diffusion and flow models, their counterpart for Schrödinger bridge (SB) models remains unexplored, despite the growing appeal of SBs as flexible stochastic transport models between general source and target distributions. We propose BridgeTwist, a training-free conditional sampler for pretrained SB generative models, formulated as a tempered twisted sequential Monte Carlo scheme. Its twist is a closed-form plug-in surrogate, obtained by combining the velocity and score fields exposed by SB pretraining into an endpoint predictor and evaluating the likelihood there. Since this surrogate is less reliable near the source, we temper the twist with a time-varying exponent, downweighting its influence at early steps. We further introduce a bridge-shaped inference-time diffusion schedule that concentrates the proposal noise in the interior of the path. Telescoping importance weights then cancel all intermediate twist factors, yielding an asymptotically exact sampler for the posterior. Empirically, BridgeTwist outperforms training-free baselines on class-conditional and text-prompted image generation, and is competitive with specialized inverse problem solvers on inpainting, deblurring, and super-resolution.

</details>


### [489] [Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18677)
*Haldun Balim,Yilun Du,Na Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出生成式轨迹规划（GTP）框架，将扩散模型作为动作序列的提议分布，结合学习到的动力学、奖励与价值模型进行轨迹级推理，在连续控制与长时域操作任务中匹配或超越现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线决策中存在高效推理与长时域推理之间的张力：基于价值的方法依赖短时域自举，限制了长期信息的传播；轨迹优化方法虽显式规划，但每一步决策都需解决高维优化问题。

Method: GTP 是一种基于模型的框架，学习一个生成模型作为动作序列上的提议分布。不从零开始优化序列，而是从扩散先验中采样候选序列，再利用学习到的动力学、奖励和价值模型对候选序列进行精炼，从而实现高效的轨迹级推理。

Result: 在连续控制与长时域操作任务上，GTP 匹配或超越最先进的无模型、扩散策略和基于模型的基线方法，并在强基线退化的情形下保持稳定。

Conclusion: 结果表明，生成模型最好被理解为规划的结构化提议分布而非策略，这为将生成建模与基于模型的决策相结合提供了新视角。

Abstract: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.

</details>


### [490] [ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18683)
*Bowen Ding,Mingda Wan,Yuhan Chen,Jiyao Yuan,Qi Zhu,Futing Wang,Heyuan Deng,Fei Mi,Lifeng Shang,Tao Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProAS（Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping），一种即插即用框架，通过动态演化的Agentic Reference Graph（ARG）实现细粒度信用分配，缓解无critic算法中轨迹级优势均匀广播的问题，在ALFWorld与WebShop上取得SOTA并加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无critic的RL算法（如GRPO）存在"均匀信用分配困境"：将轨迹级优势等值广播给所有动作，导致偏好轨迹中的结构性无效动作被强化，同时忽略非偏好轨迹中早期关键偏差的下游级联影响。作者希望在不引入critic额外开销的前提下解决该问题。

Method: ProAS为即插即用框架，依赖动态演化的Agentic Reference Graph（ARG），通过两个机制实现细粒度信用分配：Masking Unreasonable Incentives（MUI，掩蔽不合理激励）与Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution（APR，非对称惩罚再分配）。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，ProAS普遍将主流group-based基线提升至新SOTA：ALFWorld成功率峰值达91.9%与94.3%，WebShop达66.7%与70.8%；训练收敛最高加速2.44倍，且对不完美或蒸馏得到的ARG保持强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: ProAS以低开销方式解决了无critic算法的信用分配均匀性问题，显著提升LLM智能体在长程交互任务中的表现与训练效率，并对参考图质量下降具备鲁棒性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally invalid actions in preferred trajectories and ignores the downstream cascading influence of early pivotal deviations in unpreferred ones. To resolve this without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), a plug-and-play framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that ProAS universally elevates mainstream group-based baselines to new state-of-the-art performance, achieving peak success rates of 91.9\% and 94.3\% on ALFWorld, alongside 66.7\% and 70.8\% on WebShop, respectively. Furthermore, it accelerates training convergence by up to $2.44\times$ while maintaining strong robustness against imperfect or distilled ARGs. Codes: https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS.

</details>


### [491] [A Refresh Interval Does Not Fully Specify a Refresh Schedule: Learning-Rate-Dependent Placement in Kronecker-Preconditioned Language Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18695)
*Xinyu Wang,Zhiwei Zhai,Yu Gu,Zijun Yu,Sicheng Lyu,Jingrui Tian,Lei Ding,Ziyang Song,Xiao-Wen Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在固定刷新次数下，Kronecker 预条件优化器中刷新发生的时机（placement）会影响留出损失，且其优劣排序随学习率、模型规模和训练长度变化；建议完整报告刷新调度并跨学习率比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Kronecker 预条件优化器虽通过刷新频率控制缓存曲率特征分解的重算，但仅关注"多久刷新一次"，忽略了"何时刷新"这一自由度。作者希望揭示刷新时机本身会带来同算力下的性能差异，从而说明仅凭单一学习率的比较可能得出误导性结论。

Method: 在 Mousse 优化器、GPT 风格模型上训练，固定四刷新调度中的首次与末次刷新，仅移动中间两次刷新的位置，并在不同模型规模、不同学习率及不同训练长度下进行对比；同时设置对照（包括已发布优化器内部实现），并用谱宽度陈旧度（spectral-width staleness）打分尝试预测排序。

Result: 在 FineWeb 上，两种放置方式的排名随学习率升高发生反转——低学习率时靠后放置更好，高学习率时靠前放置更好，故单一学习率比较可报告任一排序。该反转在多种对照下依然成立，且在已发布刷新密度下时机仍然重要。偏好翻转对应的学习率随模型规模增大而降低（与更小留出模型一致），并随训练长度变化。谱宽度陈旧度打分在每个学习率下预测的排序相同，未能捕捉该反转。

Conclusion: 刷新调度的时机是应被显式报告和调优的自由变量；应在实际使用的各个学习率下比较调度，避免单点学习率带来的错误排序结论。

Abstract: Kronecker-preconditioned optimizers recompute a cached curvature eigendecomposition only periodically, and implementations and adaptive methods control this through the refresh frequency. We show that frequency leaves part of a schedule free: at a fixed number of refreshes, when they occur changes held-out loss at the same compute. Training GPT-style models with the Mousse optimizer across model sizes, we move the middle refreshes of a four-refresh schedule while fixing the first and last. On FineWeb the two placements exchanged rank as the learning rate rose (later placement was better at low rates, earlier placement at high ones), so a single-learning-rate comparison can report either ranking. The reversal held under controls including the published optimizer internals, and placement still mattered at the published refresh density. The learning rate at which the preference flips fell with model size, consistent with a held-out smaller model, and shifted with training length. A spectral-width staleness score predicted the same ranking at every learning rate and missed the reversal. Refresh schedules should be reported in full and compared across the learning rates at which they will be used.

</details>


### [492] [Learning Source Structure: Bayesian Prediction with Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18725)
*Meir Feder,Ruediger Urbanke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究以"informed Bayes"作为可量化、可证伪的参照标准，证明在跨上下文可相互推理的Markov源上，训练后的Transformer能够模仿贝叶斯预测器，并可被定量预测其四项超出学习曲线的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作多在上下文可独立学习的源上将Transformer与贝叶斯比较，无法检验跨上下文信息共享的情形。作者希望建立一个能对训练后Transformer行为做出精确、可证伪预测的定量参照。

Method: 构造参数每次重新采样、Transformer只能学到源族及其先验的序列任务，提出informed Bayes作为训练损失的唯一极小化者。构建至多64个符号的Markov源（已知/隐藏编码的乘积源、共享未知基律与深度的转移行、三个族的混合），并设计四项超出学习曲线的检验，比较预测值与实测值。

Result: 四项预测均与实测吻合：训练族外源的残余损失预测2.237比特、实测2.309；两个独立分量同时变化时额外损失翻倍，预测0.345、实测0.350；首次出现token时其他上下文的收益；以及复制先前续写开始获益的深度。学习曲线上，小型Transformer在共享结构可见时即匹配informed Bayes，隐藏结构需更多层与训练，最大模型差距低于0.01比特/token。

Conclusion: informed Bayes可分解为注意力选择并累积的充分统计量，以及由先验固定、由前馈网络学习的估计器；训练付出的是该架构先验下informed Bayes的复杂度，有限记忆的通用预测界则限制了有界网络能逼近的程度。因此模仿何时可能、何时必然失效得到解释。

Abstract: A transformer trained on sequences whose source parameters are drawn afresh each time can learn only what the sequences share: the source family and its prior. The Bayesian predictor that knows both, which we call informed Bayes, is the unique minimizer of the training loss and is computable from the family alone; we use it as a quantitative, falsifiable reference. Where earlier work compared transformers with Bayes on sources whose contexts can be learned independently, we build Markov sources with up to 64 symbols in which observations in one context inform prediction in another: product sources with known or hidden encodings, transition rows sharing an unknown base law and depth, and a mixture of three families. Our main result is that informed Bayes predicts, from the family and prior alone, how a trained transformer behaves in four tests that go beyond the learning curve: the loss that remains under a source outside the training family (predicted 2.237 bits, measured 2.309), the doubling of the extra loss when two independent components change rather than one (0.345 predicted, 0.350 measured), the benefit of other contexts when a token appears for the first time, and the depth at which copying an earlier continuation starts to pay. On the learning curves themselves, small transformers match informed Bayes when the shared structure is visible in the tokens, and hidden structure needs more layers and training, with gaps below 0.01 bits per token for the largest models. We explain why the imitation is possible and where it must fail: informed Bayes decomposes into sufficient statistics that attention selects and accumulates and an estimator, fixed by the prior, that the feed-forward network learns; training pays the complexity of informed Bayes under the architecture's prior, and finite-memory universal prediction bounds how closely a bounded network can reach it.

</details>


### [493] [On the Monitorability of Natural Language Autoencoders: Identification vs Discrimination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18727)
*Kevin Yandoka Denamganaï*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文将自然语言自编码器（NLA）的训练与监督部署分别形式化为两种不同的指称博弈，理论预测 AV 的解释只能识别所指激活而无法排除高度相似的错误解释；实验以 AR 作代理监控者验证了这一缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLA 被提议作为语言模型的监督工具：AV 用英文解释激活向量，AR 将解释映射回向量。其监督价值取决于人类监控者能否在 AV 给出解释时区分真实与虚假的激活说明。作者希望从理论层面厘清这一能力的前提与边界，并检验训练目标是否足以支撑监督需求。

Method: 将 NLA 训练形式化为生成式指称博弈，将 NLA 监督部署形式化为判别式、多模态、部分可观测的指称博弈，二者建立在被监控语言模型激活与其真实说明之间的多对多关系上。以 NLA 自身的 AR 作为最大同情的代理监控模型，在一个公开 checkpoint 上开展对照实验：真实说明 vs. 其他激活的说明，以及真实说明 vs. 仅有一处主张不同的流畅竞争说明；并加入由无关模型执行的保义改写以检验是否存在私有约定。

Result: 在全部 320 次比较中，真实说明均胜过其他激活的说明；但面对仅有一处主张不同的流畅竞争说明，真实说明仅以 60.2%（标准误 6.7%，随机水平 50%，n=35）胜出。保义改写仅损失 2.1% 到另一激活说明的距离，说明失败并非源于 NLA 对在 AV 解释中形成了私有约定。竞争说明仅测试对话记录层面的真值，由被监控模型的对话即可裁定。

Conclusion: 两种博弈之间的差距预测并解释了观察结果：训练从不要求解释排除任何东西，因此 AV 的解释能识别所指激活，却无法区分真实说明与高度匹配的虚假说明。上述结果界定了最易情形，关于被监控模型自身处理过程的断言仍未被检验；作者提出若干猜想，使两项结果都可成为该框架的推论。

Abstract: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) are proposed as oversight tools for language models: an Activation Verbaliser (AV) writes an English explanation of an activation vector, and an Activation Reconstructor (AR) maps the explanation back to a vector. Their value for oversight depends on a human monitor being able to tell a true account of an activation from a false one, given the Av's explanation. We formalise NLA training and NLA oversight deployment as two different referential games from Emergent Communication: training is a generative referential game, while oversight is a discriminative, multi-modal, partially-observable referential game played over a many-to-many relation between the monitored language model's activations and the accounts that are true of them. The gap between the two games predicts that AV's explanations will identify which activation they describe without discriminating its true account from closely matched false ones, since training never asks explanations to rule anything out. Using the NLA's own AR as a maximally-sympathetic surrogate monitor model, we experimentally confirm this theoretical insight on one released checkpoint: true accounts beat accounts of other activations in all 320 comparisons, but beat fluent rivals differing in a single claim only 60.2% of the time (std.err. 6.7%, chance at 50%, $n = 35$). A meaning-preserving rewrite by an uninvolved model costs only 2.1% of the distance to another activation's account, so the failure is not due to the NLA pair having developed private conventions in the AV's explanations. Our rival accounts test only transcript-level truths, which the monitored language model's conversation settles, so these results bound the easiest case and leave claims about the monitored model's own processing untested. We state conjectures that would make both results consequences of the framework.

</details>


### [494] [Learning When to Transfer: Reinforcement Learning for Carbon-Footprint Modeling in New Manufacturing Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18730)
*Muhammad Umar Farooq,Daniel R. Cooper*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种选择性知识迁移的强化学习方法，通过奖励机制评估每个迁移机会相对于监督基线的价值，从而在前向预测中避免负迁移。方法应用于增材制造零件隐含温室气体排放量化，在留一材料评估中实现RMSE 5.2 g CO2e/件，优于目标域单独训练和全池化迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 制造商在表征新材料、新工艺或新产品时，目标域常缺乏足够运行数据来训练可靠预测模型。已有制造数据蕴含可迁移知识，但当源域与目标域差异较大时，盲目复用会造成负迁移，且现有方法多在事后诊断而非在预测过程中控制负迁移。

Method: 提出强化学习式的选择性知识迁移方法：奖励函数针对每个迁移机会，将其与监督替代方案进行比较打分，从而在前向预测过程中避免并控制负迁移。在目标域数据有限的情况下，学习到的策略在多个预测器之间选择，包括基于单个源操作、源子集，或监督替代方案（完全池化源或仅目标数据）。通过验证门控（validation gate），仅当迁移预测优于监督替代方案时才部署。方法面向支持碳核算及性能与质量结果的变量学习。

Result: 以材料挤出增材制造零件的隐含温室气体排放为案例演示，使用来自729个实验、涵盖五种材料（ABS、PETG、TPU、PLA和再生PLA）的数据。响应变量结合实测制造电力与聚合物特定的从摇篮到大门生产因子，22个材料、工艺和刀具路径特征描述每个实验。留一材料评估中，方法平均测试RMSE为5.2 g CO2e/件，比仅目标域训练低20.00%（当目标训练数据仅5-10%时低32.5%），比无条件源-目标池化低10.30%。

Conclusion: 该选择性知识迁移强化学习方法能有效避免负迁移，在目标域数据稀缺的制造场景中显著提升预测精度，尤其适用于碳核算、性能与质量结果的建模，为跨材料/工艺的知识复用提供了可控框架。

Abstract: Manufacturers often need to characterize a new material, process, or product before enough operating data are available to train reliable predictive models for this new, target domain. Existing manufacturing operations contain potentially useful knowledge to accelerate this characterization, but indiscriminate reuse of data from existing source domains can cause negative transfer in learning of the new, target domain when the manufacturing domains differ sufficiently. This work proposes a reinforcement-learning method for selective knowledge transfer, where its reward scores each opportunity to transfer against supervised alternatives, so negative transfer is avoided and controlled during forward prediction instead of being diagnosed afterwards. Given limited data from a new target domain, the learned policy chooses among predictors based on individual source operations, subsets of the sources, or the supervised alternatives: fully pooled sources, or target data alone. A validation gate deploys the transferred prediction only when it improves upon the supervised alternatives. The method is designed for learning variables supporting carbon accounting, as well as performance and quality outcomes. We demonstrate the approach by quantifying the embodied greenhouse-gas emissions of parts produced via material-extrusion additive manufacturing, using data from 729 experiments spanning five materials: ABS, PETG, TPU, PLA, and recycled PLA. The response combines measured fabrication electricity with polymer-specific cradle-to-gate production factors, while 22 material, process, and toolpath features characterize each experiment. In leave-one-material-out evaluation, this method achieves a mean test RMSE of 5.2 g CO2e per part, 20.00% lower than target-only training (32.5% lower when only 5-10% of the target training data are available) and 10.30% lower than indiscriminate source-target pooling.

</details>


### [495] [SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18735)
*Yuqi Huang,Xingyao Li,Yunlong Hou,Fengzhuo Zhang,Jiachun Pan,Vincent Y. F. Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SP$^2$ec：面向VLM自推测解码的无训练bandit算法，利用吞吐量单峰规律动态调整草稿配置，在多个模型与任务上最高提升11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码可加速大模型推理，但VLM输入模态多样，小规模训练草稿模型难以持续高吞吐；自推测解码复用目标模型保持多模态能力，但其效率依赖为每个prompt选择合适的草稿配置。

Method: 提出Single-Peak SPeculative decoding（SP$^2$ec），一种在生成过程中自适应调整草稿配置的无训练bandit算法。利用现有自推测方法（SWIFT、KnapSpec、SpecVLM及本文cosSim）中观察到的吞吐量单峰模式，针对每个query显式最小化一种新的wall-time regret，对应经验wall-time时延，并给出理论保证。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct与LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B上，跨视觉与文本任务，相较原自推测方法取得最高11%的一致提升。

Conclusion: SP$^2$ec可在极低探索代价下逼近最优草稿配置，具备广泛适用性。

Abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11\% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

</details>


### [496] [Enabling Token-wise Importance Sampling in Off-Policy RLVR with Proximal KL Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18738)
*Hao Bai,Jiarui Yao,Tong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Proximal KL，一种用于可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的离策略方法：将近端参考策略与采样策略分离，以有界未来KL信用替代PPO裁剪，并附带理论证明与实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中的离策略数据（异步生成、rollout与训练不匹配、响应复用）普遍存在。逐token重要性加权虽避免了整条响应似然比连乘，但通常会给策略梯度带来偏差，因此需要一种既修正逐token偏差又保持优化目标正确性的方法。

Method: 理论上证明：在覆盖性与局部表达性条件下，完整未来KL信用使精确近端优化器成为更新的唯一平稳策略，即使行为策略为旧策略的混合，也无需整条响应权重或拟合critic；并建立持续覆盖与行为策略时变下的连续时间表格总体更新收敛性，以及线性logistic模型在额外假设下的有限样本奖励保证。方法上提出Proximal KL：分离近端参考与采样策略，用有界未来KL信用替换PPO裁剪，并采用逐token校正。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B与Qwen3-4B上的七组匹配离策略对比中（涵盖两个学习率、响应复用与rollout陈旧度），Proximal KL在八个数学基准的微平均准确率上最多超过GRPO达2.58%；单独的同策略对比取得相当的总准确率。周期刷新实验中，Proximal KL避免了PG与CISPO的崩溃，训练准确率超过GRPO，且以更少策略更新达到更高准确率。消融显示逐token校正优于序列级与无权重对照；保留逐token校正时，未来KL反馈相比PPO裁剪降低了对所测基线扰动的敏感性；有限未来时域在AIME24的mean@16与pass@16上优于完整尾部，固定策略测量表明截断在所测时域内降低了校正方差。

Conclusion: 逐token校正结合未来KL信用可在离策略RLVR中提供理论可证的最优性保证与稳定的收敛行为，并在多模型、多基准实验中一致优于GRPO，兼顾同策略性能与训练稳定性，同时通过有限时域截断在方差与性能间取得更好折中。

Abstract: Off-policy data in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can arise from asynchronous generation, rollout-training mismatch, and response reuse. Token-wise importance weighting avoids multiplying likelihood ratios across a response but generally biases policy gradients. We prove that, under coverage and local expressiveness conditions, full future KL credit makes the exact proximal optimizer the update's unique stationary policy, even for mixtures of older policies, without full-response weights or a fitted critic. We further establish convergence of continuous-time tabular population updates under persistent coverage and time-varying behavior policies, and a finite-sample reward guarantee for linear logistic models under additional assumptions. These results motivate Proximal KL, a practical off-policy RLVR method that separates the proximal reference from the sampling policy and replaces PPO clipping with bounded future KL credit. Across all seven matched off-policy comparisons on Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, spanning two learning rates, response reuse, and rollout staleness, Proximal KL outperforms GRPO in micro-averaged accuracy over eight math benchmarks by up to 2.58%. A separate on-policy comparison yields comparable aggregate accuracy. In periodic-refresh experiments, Proximal KL avoids the collapses observed in PG and CISPO, exceeds GRPO's training accuracy, and reaches higher accuracy in fewer policy updates. Ablations show that token-wise correction outperforms sequence-level and unweighted controls. With token-wise correction retained, future KL feedback reduces sensitivity to the tested baseline perturbation relative to PPO clipping. A finite future horizon improves AIME24 mean@16 and pass@16 over the full tail, while fixed-policy measurements show that truncation reduces correction variance over the tested horizons.

</details>


### [497] [A Rate Transfer Method: Convergence Rates in Stochastic Gradient Descent via Stochastic Calculus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18739)
*Neil Walton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"速率转移"方法，将关联随机微分方程（SDE）的有限时间Lyapunov估计转化为随机梯度算法的有限时间收敛界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机梯度算法的有限时间收敛分析通常依赖繁琐的概率论证；作者希望提供一个统一、简洁的框架，借助关联SDE的Lyapunov分析来推导收敛速率。

Method: 在一般性的矩条件与光滑性假设下，建立速率转移机制：把随机梯度法的收敛分析归约为一个微积分论证，即验证关联SDE的Lyapunov生成元不等式。

Result: 该方法能够复现经典随机梯度方法的已知收敛速率，并且为通过微积分论证分析其关联SDE来建立新优化算法的收敛速率提供了途径。

Conclusion: 速率转移方法将SDE的有限时间Lyapunov估计与随机梯度算法的收敛界连接起来，简化了收敛分析并具备推广到新算法的能力。

Abstract: We develop a rate-transfer method that converts finite-time Lyapunov estimates for an associated stochastic differential equation (SDE) into finite-time convergence bounds for stochastic gradient algorithms. Under generic moment and smoothness conditions, the convergence analysis of the stochastic gradient method reduces to a calculus argument verifying a Lyapunov generator inequality for the SDE. The method recovers established rates for classical stochastic gradient methods and provides a way to establish convergence rates for new optimization algorithms through calculus arguments applied to their associated SDEs.

</details>


### [498] [SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18807)
*Wenlin Zhong,Hao Wang,Kun Yuan,Fan Yang,Jinluan Yang,Dian Jin,Xu Tan,Yiquan Wu,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SkillScaffold，一种策略自适应的训练脚手架，用低成本技能效用估计与选择性技能注入改进智能体强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能型强化学习方法默认技能注入有益，或用间接反馈、大量 rollout 评估技能效用；试点研究表明基于 rollout 的效用估计成本高且在采样有限时不稳定，且技能收益随候选技能和当前策略在各查询上的能力而变化。

Method: 复用经过结果验证的训练轨迹生成候选技能，并通过结果感知的似然比较估计效用，无需针对候选技能的环境 rollout；效用决定是否注入以及注入哪个技能，若无候选被判定有帮助则保留无技能执行。联合训练让 Generator 产出适配不断演化的 Executor 的技能；Scaffolded RL 促进技能内化以支持无技能推理。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 与 τ²-Bench 上，短时程与长时程任务均优于强智能体 RL 和技能型 RL 基线；消融与分析验证了基于效用的选择与弃用（abstention）的重要性。

Conclusion: SkillScaffold 通过低成本、策略自适应的技能效用估计与选择性注入，提升了智能体强化学习的探索与性能，并支持技能内化后的无技能推理。代码已开源。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.

</details>


### [499] [Depth Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18809)
*David González-Martínez,Philipp Nazari,T. Konstantin Rusch,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Depth Memory (DM) 统一框架，将深度方向的表示混合形式化为跨层信息存储与检索，并据此设计 Linear Depth Memory (LDM) 架构，在 400M 和 1.5B 规模上取得最低困惑度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 残差连接通过加性累积层输出传播信息，而 mHC、AttnRes 等新方法用更具表达力的深度聚合机制提升了大模型语言建模性能。作者希望从"跨层信息存储与检索"的视角统一理解这些深度聚合机制，并据此设计更优架构。

Method: 提出 Depth Memory (DM) 统一框架，用"流（stream）"描述 PreLN transformer、mHC 与 AttnRes，例如显式记忆流被查询以增强每层输入、其输出再写回记忆供后续层使用（AttnRes 中为显式层表示的递增缓存，mHC 中为扩展残差流）。基于该视角提出 LDM，将跨深度信息检索形式化为回归问题并用递归最小二乘求解，传播三条流：标准残差流、线性联想记忆流、逆协方差流。同时提出硬件感知实现以降低峰值激活内存与访存流量。

Result: 在 400M 与 1.5B 参数规模下，LDM 相比 PreLN、mHC、AttnRes 基线持续取得最低困惑度，并具备有竞争力的零样本准确率。

Conclusion: 将深度方向表示混合视为信息存储与检索问题，可统一现有深度聚合机制并导出高效的新架构 LDM，兼顾性能与训练/推理效率。

Abstract: Residual connections propagate information through a network by additively accumulating layer outputs. Recently proposed alternatives, such as Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) and Attention Residuals (AttnRes), instead use more expressive depth aggregation mechanisms that improve language modeling performance at scale. In this work, we consider the mixing of representations over depth as a problem of storing and retrieving information across layers. Formalizing this perspective, we introduce Depth Memory (DM), a unified framework that describes the standard pre-layer-norm (PreLN) transformer, mHC, and AttnRes in terms of streams that carry representations through the network. One such stream, for example, could be an explicit memory stream that is queried to enrich the input to every layer, and whose output is subsequently written back into the memory for use by later layers. For AttnRes, this memory stream is a growing cache of explicit layer representations. For mHC, it is an expanded residual stream. Building on this view, we propose Linear Depth Memory (LDM), which formulates information retrieval across depth as a regression problem solved using recursive least squares. The resulting architecture propagates three streams across depth: the standard residual stream, a linear associative memory stream, and an inverse covariance stream. For high-throughput training and inference, we propose a hardware-aware implementation of LDM that reduces peak activation memory and memory traffic. LDM consistently achieves the lowest perplexities among PreLN, mHC and AttnRes baselines at the 400M and 1.5B parameter scales, alongside competitive zero-shot accuracy.

</details>


### [500] [Statistical Vignettes on the Grokking Phenomenon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18811)
*Baye Malick Gning,Elvis Dohmatob*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在简单且可解析的理论框架下研究 grokking 现象，区分初始化、信号强度、权重衰减、样本量与输入维度的影响，明确 grokking 发生的尖锐条件，并给出泛化平台期长度的解析渐进表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于 grokking 的研究中，初始化、信号强度、权重衰减、样本量和输入维度等因素会产生表面上相似但机制不同的学习曲线，导致解释混乱；同时插值边缘与 lazy-to-rich 转变在 grokking 中的角色尚不清晰。

Method: 构建简单、可解析的理论设定，将学习过程分解为基于冗余特征的早期拟合、核心特征学习和延迟泛化三个阶段；推导 grokking 发生的尖锐条件与泛化平台期长度的解析渐进表达式，并刻画早期泛化与无法达到测试精度目标的区域。

Result: 识别出 grokking 可证明发生的尖锐条件，得到泛化平台期长度的解析渐进表达式；刻画了早期泛化与失败区域；表明插值边缘是独立动力学区域，其中消失的谱隙将核心学习与泛化分隔开；理论结果得到大量实验支持。

Conclusion: grokking 可类比化学动力学中的快慢两相，文献中的 lazy-to-rich 转变可能反映类似的动力学时间尺度分离；接近插值在既有 grokking 解释中的作用由此得到澄清。

Abstract: In this work, we study grokking in a simple, analytically tractable setting whose rich phenomenology allows us to disentangle the effects of initialization, signal strength, weight decay, sample size, and input dimension. These factors can produce superficially similar learning curves through distinct mechanisms, complicating their interpretation. Our analysis distinguishes early fitting through nuisance features, core feature learning, and delayed generalization. We identify sharp conditions under which grokking provably occurs and derive analytic asymptotic expressions for the lengths of the generalization plateaus. Our results also characterize regimes of early generalization and failure to reach a prescribed test accuracy target. We show that the interpolation edge constitutes a distinct dynamical regime, where vanishing spectral gaps separate core learning from generalization, helping clarify the role of proximity to interpolation in existing accounts of grokking. The resulting picture is analogous to fast and slow phases in chemical kinetics and suggests that the lazy-to-rich transition discussed in the literature may reflect a similar separation of dynamical time scales. Our theoretical results are faithfully supported by extensive experiments.

</details>


### [501] [Scaling Online Optimal Transport Minibatches for Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18838)
*Peter Chen,Sergey Levine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出可扩展的在线熵正则最优传输（OT）近似方法，支持更大规模的源-目标耦合，从理论上证明其相较独立配对能严格降低全随机梯度方差与积分误差，并在单细胞基因与图像流训练中验证了更大在线耦合带来更稳定的训练和更优生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流模型在扩展时的核心难题是训练与积分的稳定性，而这在流匹配中关键取决于源样本与数据的配对方式。独立随机配对引入大量随机性；minibatch OT 虽能构造在线耦合以降低随机性，但在更大、更高维数据集上，小 minibatch 限制了其收益，而每步将耦合扩展到显著更大的 minibatch 在计算上不可行。此外，OT 耦合如何影响完整随机梯度与积分在理论上尚未解决。

Method: 提出一种可扩展的在线熵正则 OT 近似，使得能够使用显著更大的源-目标耦合，同时保留 OT 的优势；针对无正则与熵正则 OT 两种情形，从理论上分析其对完整随机梯度方差与积分误差的影响，并刻画随在线耦合 minibatch 增大而增强的改进规律。

Result: 理论证明相较独立配对，无正则与熵正则 OT 均能严格降低完整随机梯度方差与积分误差，且改进随在线耦合 minibatch 增大而增强；在单细胞基因插值流与图像流训练实验中，这些预测得到验证，更大的在线耦合持续改善训练稳定性与最终生成性能。

Conclusion: 通过可扩展的在线熵正则 OT 近似，可在可行计算代价下使用更大耦合，兼顾 OT 收益与效率，并从理论与实验两方面确立 OT 耦合对梯度方差与积分误差的正面作用，为流模型规模化训练提供了稳定且高性能的方案。

Abstract: A central challenge in scaling flow models is maintaining stability in training and integration. In flow matching, this stability depends critically on how source samples are paired with data. Independent random pairing introduces substantial stochasticity, motivating minibatch optimal transport (OT) to construct online source-target couplings that reduce this randomness (Tong et al., 2024). However, as applications extend to larger and higher-dimensional datasets, small minibatches can limit these benefits, while scaling the coupling to substantially larger minibatches at every iteration is computationally prohibitive. Moreover, how OT coupling affects the full stochastic gradient and integration remains theoretically unresolved. In this work, we develop a scalable online entropic OT approximation that enables substantially larger source-target couplings while preserving the benefits of OT. We close the theoretical gap for both unregularized and entropic OT by proving strict reductions in full stochastic-gradient variance and integration error relative to independent pairing, and further characterize how these improvements strengthen as the online coupling minibatch grows. Experiments on single-cell gene interpolation-flow and image-flow training validate these predictions, showing that larger online couplings consistently improve training stability and final generation performance.

</details>


### [502] [Fast Rates for Offline Q-Learning with KL Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18839)
*Yize Hao,Guangxin Jiang,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带有KL正则化的有限时域MDP离线Q-learning，提出KLQ与KLPQ两种算法，首次证明离线Q-learning能达到$\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$的快速样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明KL正则化可在离线决策中带来快速率，但采用增量式随机逼近更新的Q-learning在离线场景下能否达到此类快速率尚不明确。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 首先提出KL正则化Q-Learning（KLQ），即经典Q-learning的简单变体，利用KL正则化在无显式悲观主义下进行分析；进而提出KL正则化悲观Q-Learning（KLPQ），将悲观机制引入KLQ。

Result: KLQ在无显式悲观主义下达到$\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$样本复杂度，但其保证对KL正则化参数和时域呈指数依赖；KLPQ在保持相同$\widetilde{O}(1/\epsilon)$速率的同时消除了该指数依赖，进一步改进样本复杂度。

Conclusion: 本文首次为表格型有限时域KL正则化MDP中的离线Q-learning建立了快速率保证。

Abstract: This paper investigates offline Q-learning for finite-horizon Markov decision processes with Kullback-Leibler (KL) regularization. Recent studies have shown that KL regularization can yield fast rates in offline decision-making problems. However, it remains unclear whether Q-learning, which adopts incremental stochastic approximation updates, can achieve such fast rates in the offline setting. We first propose KL-regularized Q-Learning (KLQ), a simple variant of classical Q-learning. By exploiting KL regularization, we prove that KLQ achieves a sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}(1/ε)$ without explicit pessimism. This guarantee, however, has an exponential dependence on the KL regularization parameter and the horizon. To address this limitation, we further propose KL-regularized Pessimistic Q-Learning (KLPQ), which incorporates pessimism into KLQ. We prove that KLPQ retains the same \(\widetilde O(1/ε)\) rate while removing the explicit exponential dependence, thereby further improving the sample complexity. To the best of our knowledge, these results establish the first fast-rate guarantees for offline Q-learning in tabular finite-horizon KL-regularized MDPs.

</details>


### [503] [Two Clocks: Why Larger Rollout Batches Learn Slower but Fail on Schedule in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18853)
*Yuante Li,Junwei Quan,Kai Qiu,Kate Zhang,Yicheng Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"双时钟"框架，区分取得进展所需样本量与崩溃前消耗的样本量，指出RLVR中平方根学习率缩放在多步训练下不能保持样本效率，并据此设计多步训练调度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR依赖昂贵的模型生成响应，因此倾向使用更大rollout批次并按平方根规律缩放学习率。已有结论认为"每rollout一次优化器更新"时该规则近似保持每样本进展，但在实际多步训练中此结论缺乏理解。

Method: 建立双时钟框架，将"取得进展所需样本"与"崩溃前消耗样本"分离；在局部二次模型下分析平方根规则的漂移与曲率效应，提出临界批次与漂移阈值假设下的失败时钟；在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B上用GRPO做受控实验，批次范围达16倍，并跨数据集、通用checkpoint、7B模型验证。

Result: 局部二次模型显示平方根规则保持每样本一阶漂移但不保持进展：批次越大更新次数越少、步长越长，曲率损失更多，存在依赖学习率的临界批次，超过后样本效率下降；漂移阈值预测的失败时钟样本数沿平方根规则近似不变。GRPO实验支持两个预测：ratio clipping延缓失败（尤其大batch），但不消除进展差距；放宽clip以稳定性换取短暂速度提升。进展差距在其他数据集、通用checkpoint和7B模型上重现。

Conclusion: 双时钟框架揭示了平方根规则在实践多步训练中的样本效率缺陷，并给出简单的多步RLVR调度：先在临界批次以下启动，再在失败前切换到更大批次。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies on costly model-generated responses, motivating larger rollout batches and square-root learning-rate scaling. Reported to approximately preserve progress per sample with one optimizer step per rollout, this rule is less understood in practical multi-step training. We develop a two-clock framework that separates the samples needed to make progress from those consumed before collapse. Under a local quadratic model, the square-root rule preserves first-order drift per sample but not progress: larger batches take fewer, longer updates and lose more to curvature, yielding a learning-rate-dependent critical batch beyond which sample efficiency degrades. A drift-threshold hypothesis predicts a complementary failure clock whose sample count remains approximately invariant along the square-root rule. Controlled GRPO experiments on Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B across a $16\times$ batch range support both predictions. Ratio clipping delays failure, especially for larger batches, but the progress gap persists without it. Widening the clip trades stability for a transient speed gain. The progress gap reappears on another dataset, a general-purpose checkpoint, and a 7B model. Finally, we use the two-clock framework to derive a simple multi-step RLVR schedule: start below the critical batch and switch to a larger batch before failure. Our code is available at: https://github.com/WinstonLiyt/two-clocks-rlvr.

</details>


### [504] [Exact Topological Compliance: Generating Persistence-Equivalent Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18856)
*Mattie Ji,Indradyumna Roy,Vikas Garg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次提出"精确拓扑合规"的图生成问题：生成持久图(PD)与目标完全一致的图，并给出局部迭代构造与全局约束满足两种方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续同调用持久图刻画图的拓扑演化，但既有拓扑感知生成模型依赖软正则化，只能近似匹配目标PD，无法保证拓扑精确一致。

Method: 方法一为局部方法：依据PD施加的局部与全局约束，迭代构造基于度数的PD等价图，并证明每个输出都实现目标PD且所有基于度数的PD等价图均可达。方法二将生成问题重铸为全局约束满足问题，给出可由现代约束编程求解器求解的完整编码，适用于任意基于顶点的置换等变过滤方案，且在度过滤下具有最小性。

Result: 在四个标准图生成基准上的实验表明，两种方法均能精确实现目标PD；同时揭示局部生成在样本多样性与可达性之间存在固有权衡，而全局方法可避免陷入不可行状态。

Conclusion: 本文为严格拓扑合规的图生成提供了原理性框架，兼顾局部可构造性与全局约束完备性，实现了对目标持久图的精确复现。

Abstract: Persistent homology summarizes the topological evolution of a graph as persistence diagrams (PDs). Generating graphs whose topology matches a target descriptor is increasingly important, yet existing topology-aware generative models rely on soft regularization, producing graphs whose PDs may only be approximately similar. We initiate a principled investigation of the generation problem: produce graphs that realize a target PD exactly. We propose two approaches guided by the implicit local and global constraints a target PD imposes. The local approach builds degree-based PD-equivalent graphs iteratively, and we prove that every output realizes the target PD and that every degree-based PD-equivalent graph is reachable. However, as shown thereafter, local generation necessarily trades off between sample diversity and reaching infeasible states. We therefore recast generation as a global constraint satisfaction problem with a complete encoding solvable by modern constraint programming solvers. This is applicable to any vertex-based permutation equivariant filtration scheme and is minimal under the degree filtration. Experiments on four standard graph generation benchmarks confirm that both methods realize the target PD exactly. Together, our methods provide a principled treatment of strict topology-compliant graph generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Aalto-QuML/ExactCompliance.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [505] [Simple Linear Corrections for Compression in Late Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14196)
*Mihir Agarwal,Sabyasachi Basu,Viraj Agrawal*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究对late-interaction（多向量）模型的文档向量进行压缩后，是否可以通过对打分函数做轻量级线性修正来恢复检索质量。方法在冻结编码器与压缩器的前提下，针对每种编码器-压缩器-向量预算组合，通过蒸馏未压缩模型的得分分布学习一个全局线性修正。在ColBERTv2、Jina v4与ColPali2上于MS MARCO、BEIR、ViDoRe v3评测，域内设置下160个BEIR配置中有154个优于压缩基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Late-interaction模型在质量与嵌入成本上介于cross-encoder与dense encoder之间，但其索引存储与打分开销高昂。常用的pooling与pruning压缩技术虽然降低成本，却在大幅压缩时显著劣化检索质量，且通常需要重训练编码器或重新压缩文档，代价高。因此作者希望探究：仅对打分函数做轻量修改，能否在不重训练编码器、不重压缩文档的情况下挽回压缩造成的质量损失。

Method: 针对每一个（编码器、压缩器、向量预算）组合，通过蒸馏未压缩模型的候选文档得分分布，学习一个全局线性修正。编码器与压缩器均保持冻结。该修正既可在检索时对每个查询在线应用，也可离线一次性作用于已存储向量。实验覆盖ColBERTv2与Jina v4（MS MARCO、BEIR）以及ColPali2（ViDoRe v3视觉文档检索），涉及四种免训练压缩方法、多种向量预算、域内适配以及从MS MARCO到BEIR的迁移，并额外测试了用合成查询训练的修正矩阵。

Result: 在域内设置下，修正在160个BEIR配置中的154个上优于压缩基线；从MS MARCO迁移到BEIR时，效果随模型与数据集不同而波动较大。此外，使用合成查询训练的矩阵可在ViDoRe v3上超过压缩基线。

Conclusion: 一个小型可学习修正即可在不重训练编码器、不重新压缩文档的前提下，部分恢复因压缩而损失的检索质量，表明轻量级打分函数调整是缓解多向量检索压缩劣化的有效途径。

Abstract: Late-interaction (multi-vector) models represent documents using a set of token-level vectors, providing a middle ground between cross-encoders and dense encoders in terms of quality and cost of embedding. However, compared to the latter, the indices are costly to store and score. Pooling and pruning based compression techniques are deployed widely but deteriorate in quality noticeably with aggressive compression. We investigate whether a lightweight change to the scoring function can recover retrieval quality after document-vector compression. For each combination of encoder, compressor, and vector budget, we learn a global linear correction by distilling the uncompressed model's score distributions over candidate documents. The encoder and compressor remain frozen, and the correction can be applied to each query at search time or once, offline, to the stored vectors.
  We evaluate the method with ColBERTv2 and Jina v4 on MS MARCO and BEIR, and with ColPali2 on the ViDoRe v3 visual document retrieval benchmark. Experiments cover four training-free compression methods, multiple vector budgets, in-domain adaptation, and transfer from MS MARCO to BEIR. In the in-domain setting, the correction improves over baseline compression in 154 of 160 BEIR settings, while transfer from MS MARCO is more variable across models and datasets. We also find that matrices trained with synthetic queries can improve over baseline compression on ViDoRe v3. These results show that a small learned correction can recover some of the quality lost to compression without retraining the encoder or recompressing the documents.

</details>


### [506] [Understanding and Mitigating Training Instability in Large-Scale Recommender Systems: A Cascade Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14394)
*Yuening Li,Zeyu Wang,Zhen Zhang,Jiayi Liu,Zhimeng Jiang,Yuji Roh,Weikai Xu,Mingyan Gao,Onkar Dalal,Chuan He,Liang Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对工业级短视频推荐系统中训练不稳定问题，提出并验证了一套应对“梯度爆炸—权重爆炸—损失爆炸”（G-W-L）级联发散的结构化缓解框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模推荐系统部署于动态工业平台（如日交互量达数十亿的短视频服务），用户数据分布快速漂移与模型复杂度上升，常触发以梯度爆炸为起点、经权重爆炸传播、最终导致损失爆炸的发散级联（G-W-L cascade），严重阻碍模型收敛与性能。

Method: 在工业短视频推荐场景下对G-W-L级联进行系统性分析，并提出结构化缓解框架：将干预措施显式映射到级联的各个阶段，分别对应梯度（G）控制、权重/激活（W）稳定化与损失（L）塑形。

Result: 在大型工业短视频推荐系统上对所提策略进行了实证验证，证明其有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作为理解与应对训练发散提供了结构化框架，并为在大规模、非平稳环境下部署鲁棒且持续更新的推荐系统提供了实践性洞见。

Abstract: Training large-scale recommender systems on dynamic industrial platforms, such as Short-Form Video (SFV) services with billions of daily interactions, faces critical stability challenges. Rapid distribution shifts in user data and increasing model complexity frequently trigger a divergence cascade, typically initiating with gradient explosion, propagating to weight explosion, and culminating in loss explosion. This G-W-L cascade severely impedes model convergence and performance. This paper provides a systematic analysis of this G-W-L cascade within an industrial SFV recommender context. We then propose and evaluate a structured mitigation framework where interventions are explicitly mapped to counteract specific stages of the cascade: gradient (G) control, weight/activation (W) stabilization, and loss (L) shaping. Our contribution provides a structured framework for understanding and tackling training divergence, offering practical insights for deploying robust, continuously updated recommenders in large-scale, non-stationary settings. We empirically validate the effectiveness of these strategies on a major industrial SFV recommendation system.

</details>


### [507] [Co-adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining for Structured Knowledge Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14465)
*Zhisheng Qi,Haoyu Han,Jiaxi Li,Bing He,Huiyuan Chen,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Mahantesh M. Halappanavar,Jin Lu,Yu Zhang,Tianming Liu,Yu Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CoRE框架，无需预定义查询-规则配对，联合学习规则路由与约束检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化知识检索依赖无约束检索或预定义查询-规则监督（如作者-论文、解剖-药物规则），这种监督在实践中往往不可得。

Method: CoRE包含一个路由智能体选择规则，对应检索器遍历知识库并对满足规则约束的证据排序；路由策略用强化学习、规则约束检索器用对比学习交替优化，形成闭环：所选规则为检索器提供监督，检索效果作为路由策略的奖励。

Result: 在科学发现、生物医学推理、电商知识管理等STaRK-QA数据集上验证有效；消融实验显示路由与检索器协同适应的收益；基于生成的路由可跨数据集迁移，并受益于多域预训练加目标域微调。

Conclusion: CoRE可在无显式查询-规则监督下实现路由与检索的协同适应，规则使用分析还可支持规则的自动精炼与发现。

Abstract: Structured knowledge retrieval acquires task-relevant evidence from structured knowledge sources for downstream tasks. Existing methods rely on unconstrained retrieval or predefined query-rule supervision, such as author-paper rules for scientific discovery and anatomy-drug rules for precision medicine. Such supervision is rarely available in practice. We propose Co-Adaptive Rule Routing and Constraining Retrieval (CoRE), which jointly learns which reasoning rule to assign to each query and how to retrieve evidence under that rule, without predefined query-rule pairs. A routing agent selects a rule, and its corresponding retriever traverses the knowledge base and ranks evidence that satisfies the rule's constraints. Because routing and retrieval are interdependent, CoRE alternates between reinforcement learning for the routing policy and contrastive learning for the rule-constrained retriever. The selected rules provide supervision for retriever training, while retrieval performance rewards the routing policy. This closed-loop process enables both components to co-adapt without explicit query-rule supervision. Experiments on STaRK-QA datasets across scientific discovery, biomedical reasoning, and e-commerce knowledge management demonstrate CoRE's effectiveness. Ablations show the benefit of co-adapting the router and retriever. Generation-based routing transfers across datasets and benefits from multi-domain pretraining followed by target-specific fine-tuning. Analysis of rule usage across queries also informs automatic rule refinement and discovery.

</details>


### [508] [EVISTA: Unified Multimodal Video Search with Evidence-Aware Temporal Path Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14510)
*Minh-Huy Tran,Van-Thinh Vo,Minh-Khoi Nguyen,Duy-Tan Nguyen,Anh-Quan Nguyen-Tran,Loi Nguyen Khanh*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出统一多模态视频检索系统EVISTA与证据感知的时序路径优化方法TEMPO-P，用于按时间顺序检索同一视频中的多个事件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大数据时代从大规模视频库中精确检索事件日益重要且困难。尤其是同一视频内多个事件由视觉内容、屏幕文字、语音等不同证据类型描述时，怎样按其时间顺序定位这些事件成为难题。独立事件检索存在两大局限：某个事件检索较弱时可能漏掉相关视频；独立检索出的事件候选在时间上可能不一致，或无法表示主要由文本或语音定义的事件。

Method: 构建统一多模态视频检索系统EVISTA，在共享关键帧索引上集成视觉语义、OCR、ASR、物体和元数据检索；提出证据感知的时序路径优化方法TEMPO-P：跨事件与模态聚合候选视频，利用视觉、OCR和ASR证据联合对关键帧打分，并通过动态规划在每个视频内选择紧凑的时序有序路径。TEMPO-P作为EVISTA的有序事件检索模式被集成。

Result: 在5个主办方查询和36个额外多事件查询上，TEMPO-P在视觉描述事件上与纯视觉时序对齐持平（R@1均为0.42），并能检索含文本定义事件的查询（R@1为0.38），而纯视觉对齐无法表示此类事件。

Conclusion: TEMPO-P通过跨事件、跨模态聚合候选与动态规划联合评分，克服了独立事件检索的漏检与时序不一致问题，作为EVISTA的有序事件检索模式，实现了对视觉、文本与语音定义事件的多模态有序检索。

Abstract: In the era of big data, precise event retrieval from large video collections has become increasingly important and challenging. In particular, locating multiple events from the same video in their temporal order is difficult when different events are described by different types of evidence, such as visual content, on-screen text, and spoken words. We develop EVISTA, a unified multimodal video retrieval system for the Ho Chi Minh City AI Challenge 2026, which integrates visual-semantic, OCR, ASR, object, and metadata search over a shared keyframe index, and propose TEMPO-P, an evidence-aware temporal path optimization method for ordered multi-event retrieval. Building EVISTA for this task reveals two limitations of independent event retrieval: a relevant video may be missed when one event is weakly retrieved, and independently retrieved event candidates may be temporally inconsistent or unable to represent events defined primarily by text or speech. TEMPO-P addresses these limitations by aggregating candidate videos across events and modalities, jointly scoring keyframes using visual, OCR, and ASR evidence, and selecting a compact temporally ordered path within each video through dynamic programming. On five organizer queries and 36 additional multi-event queries, TEMPO-P matches visual-only temporal alignment on visually described events (R@1 0.42 for both) and retrieves queries containing text-defined events, which visual-only alignment cannot represent (R@1 0.38). TEMPO-P is integrated into EVISTA as its ordered-event retrieval mode.

</details>


### [509] [LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14550)
*Wen Zhang,Xiao Bai,Hsiang-wei Chao,Mengfan Zhu,Tong Zhao,Mingxuan Ju,Xiaodong Liu,Congfei Zhang,Yunzhi Zhou,Yajun Wang,Jinchao Li,Yu Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于动态商品广告（DPA）检索系统离线评估的用户-商品相关性指标：先将用户参与历史通过语义ID分组、事件分层分割压缩为意图代表集，再借助LLM智能体式提示框架对推荐商品与各意图的相关性评分并聚合为用户级分数，指标与离线及在线业务指标强相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPA检索系统的评估存在困难：传统离线参与度指标受稀疏、有偏反馈限制，而在线评估成本高、耗时长。因此需要一个稳定、可解释且与业务指标一致的离线评估指标。

Method: 1) 构建用户-商品相关性指标：通过Semantic-ID分组的、事件分层的分割方法，将用户参与历史压缩为紧凑的意图代表集合；2) 评估推荐商品对每个意图的相关性并聚合为用户级相关性分数；3) 使用LLM作为语义相关性判别器，提出智能体式、与人类对齐的提示框架，生成多类别相关性准则，并将教师模型判断蒸馏到高效的学生模型以实现规模化评估。

Result: 所提出的相关性指标与离线业务指标和在线业务指标均呈现强相关性，能够在A/B测试前实现更快、更可靠的DPA检索迭代。

Conclusion: 该工作为DPA检索系统提供了一种可扩展、稳定且可解释的离线评估方案，可捕获启发式方法常忽略的细粒度功能与语义关系，减少对高成本在线评估的依赖。

Abstract: Dynamic Product Advertising (DPA) retrieval systems are a core component of modern e-commerce advertising; however, their evaluation remains challenging. Conventional offline engagement metrics are limited by sparse, biased feedback, while online evaluation is costly and time-consuming. In this work, we propose a user--product relevance metric for offline evaluation of DPA retrieval systems. The metric first compresses the engagement history into a compact set of intent representatives via Semantic-ID-grouped, event-stratified segmentation, then assesses the relevance of a recommended product to each individual intent and aggregates them as a user-level relevance score, yielding a stable and interpretable measure of retrieval quality. To compute this metric at scale, we leverage large language models (LLMs) as semantic relevance judges, capturing nuanced functional and semantic relationships that heuristic methods often miss. We propose an agentic, human-aligned prompting framework that generates multi-category relevance guidelines and distills teacher-model judgments into an efficient student model for scalable evaluation. The resulting metric strongly correlates with offline and online business metrics, enabling faster and more reliable DPA retrieval iteration before A/B testing.

</details>


### [510] [Fine-Tuning Strategy, Not Just Data: A Statistically Rigorous Audit of Gender and Stereotypical Bias in Embedding Models for HR Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14579)
*Ekta Yadav*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文审计六个多语言句嵌入模型（LaBSE与E5系列，含公开及定制微调版本）的职业性别与刻板印象偏见，指出朴素显著性检验中的非独立性错误，并采用职业级配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验、个体重采样bootstrap置信区间及置换检验重新分析。校正后，E5-Base的知识蒸馏微调显著增加Bias-in-Bios偏见（Δ=-0.177，p<10⁻⁸），而二分类微调无统计显著变化（p=0.218），表明微调策略是HR推荐系统的可操作设计杠杆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 嵌入模型是现代职位—候选人匹配的核心，简历、职位描述和查询被编码为稠密向量，推荐依赖该空间的最近邻检索。因此嵌入中的社会偏见会直接传导至HR推荐。作者希望审计多语言句嵌入模型在职业性别与刻板印象维度上的偏见，并将统计有效性作为首要关切，纠正既有评测中的方法学缺陷。

Method: 使用Bias-in-Bios（职业性别偏见）与StereoSet（职业、种族、性别、宗教刻板印象）审计六个多语言句嵌入模型（LaBSE与E5系列，含公开及定制微调）。识别出朴素显著性检验的非独立性错误：池化非独立成对相似度将0.0046的均值差夸大为p≈0；改用职业级配对Wilcoxon符号秩检验、个体重采样bootstrap置信区间，以及StereoSet的置换检验。

Result: 校正后，E5-Base的知识蒸馏（KD）微调显著增加Bias-in-Bios测得的偏见（Δ=-0.177，p<10⁻⁸，值越负表示偏见越大），但该度量对全局嵌入几何敏感；StereoSet职业类别的亲刻板印象模式（未校正p<0.05）佐证了KD结果。同一基座模型的二分类微调未显示统计可区分的变化（p=0.218）。此外报告了哪些基准类别检验力不足，并指出两个领域适配模型因软件访问限制未能纳入显著性检验，限制了结论的推广。

Conclusion: 微调策略是构建HR推荐系统的从业者可操作的设计杠杆；评测HR嵌入偏见时必须采用尊重数据非独立性的统计方法，否则会将微小差异夸大；部分基准类别检验力不足、且两个领域适配模型因软件访问限制缺席显著性检验，需谨慎解读结论并加以改进。

Abstract: Embedding models underpin modern job-candidate matching: resumes, job descriptions, and queries are encoded as dense vectors, and recommendations come from nearest-neighbor retrieval over that space. Any social bias in the embeddings therefore feeds directly into HR recommendations. We audit six multilingual sentence-embedding models (LaBSE- and E5-family, both public and custom fine-tuned) using Bias-in-Bios (occupational gender bias) and StereoSet (stereotypes across profession, race, gender, and religion). We treat statistical validity as a first-class concern: we identify a non-independence error in a naive significance test, where pooling non-independent pairwise similarities inflated a trivial 0.0046 mean difference to $p \approx 0$, and replace it with a profession-level paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, individual-resampling bootstrap confidence intervals, and permutation tests for StereoSet. Under the corrected methodology, knowledge-distillation (KD) fine-tuning of E5-Base significantly increases measured bias on Bias-in-Bios ($Δ= -0.177$, $p < 10^{-8}$; more negative means more bias), although this measure is sensitive to global embedding geometry. The KD result is corroborated by pro-stereotype patterns in the StereoSet profession category (uncorrected $p < 0.05$). Binary-classification fine-tuning of the same base model shows no statistically distinguishable change ($p = 0.218$). Fine-tuning strategy is thus an actionable design lever for practitioners building HR recommenders. We also report which benchmark categories are underpowered, and note that two domain-adapted models could not be included in significance testing due to a software-access constraint, which limits our conclusions.

</details>


### [511] [The Company a Question Keeps: Auditing Open Jev-Style Models for Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14631)
*Jianbo Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该文审计了七种开放Jev风格检查点中"请求独立性"假设：在92个TREC检索查询构造的276个三段落状态上，通过配对干预分别改变请求问题、显示证据与候选资格。请求扩展使Nimble在9.1%/8.0%判决上出现严格二元翻转，并在阈值0.5下改变21.4%/18.9%的选择或弃权动作；正确率变化分别为0.0/+8.2个百分点。字段掩码将全部70次请求集翻转归因于序列化进评分提示的模式字段。Von中固定共享分隔符位置消除了两次资格诱导偏好翻转；Laya-typed默认CUDA路径产生五次段落互换但无严格二元翻转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验Jev所称"针对共享证据独立评估各类型问题"的接口性质是否成立，即评分是否真正与所请求问题集合无关。若请求表述改变即可系统性地改变判决、选择/弃权动作与正确率，则该独立性界面在文档化的接口层面并不成立，需要定位其来源（模式字段序列化、共享分隔符位置等）并区分硬件/数值路径造成的表面差异。

Method: 在7个开放Jev风格检查点上，以92个TREC检索查询构造276个三段落状态；采用配对干预（paired interventions）分别操纵请求问题、显示证据与候选资格；用预先固定（inference前固定）的0.5阈值统计严格二元翻转率、选择/弃权动作变化率与正确率变化，并用95%查询级bootstrap区间估计不确定性；通过字段掩码（field masking）做归因分析；对Von固定共享分隔符位置、对Laya-typed比较默认CUDA与FP32重跑以排查数值/硬件路径影响。

Result: 请求扩展在TREC DL2019/2020上引起Nimble 9.1%/8.0%的严格二元判决翻转，并改变21.4%/18.9%的选择或弃权动作；正确率变化为0.0/+8.2个百分点，95%查询bootstrap区间分别为[-6.0,6.0]与[3.8,12.6]。字段掩码将全部70次请求集翻转追溯至序列化进每个评分提示的模式字段。Von中固定共享分隔符位置消除了所选诊断状态中两次资格诱导的偏好翻转。Laya-typed默认CUDA路径产生五次段落互换但无严格二元翻转，两年动作变化区间均含零；FP32重跑下其概率移动在模型四位小数报告分辨率上消失。

Conclusion: 文档化的"请求独立"接口在实践中不成立：判决与动作对请求集合、模式字段序列化及共享分隔符位置敏感，且敏感度依赖模型、年份与数值路径。建议将字段序列化格式与分隔符位置纳入评测协议，并以固定精度/后端报告稳健性，避免将硬件或数值分辨率伪影误判为语义偏好。

Abstract: Jev's documented interface evaluates typed questions independently against shared evidence. We audit request independence in seven open Jev-style checkpoints on 276 constructed three-passage states from 92 TREC retrieval queries. Paired interventions separately change requested questions, displayed evidence, and candidate eligibility.
