Conclusion: 应将以提示词为中心的静态拒答护栏，转向"先生成、边监控部分响应、仅在转为有害时中止"的交互式护栏。由于危害是模型输出的属性而非查询的属性，且部分响应已携带大部分判别信号，该方案可在保证安全的同时显著降低不必要拒答、挽回用户本应获得的信息服务。

Abstract: LLM-based information systems need safety guardrails. Most guardrails classify the prompt alone. If the prompt looks harmful, the system rejects it before any answer is generated. This is costly. Many rejected prompts would have received a safe response. Users lose help they should have received from the information system. This cost grows as conversational and generative search becomes common. Prompt-level labels treat harm as a property of the query. But harm depends on what the model actually writes. Existing input-output guards do look at responses. But they judge a finished response, so the decision comes after full generation. However, we observe that safety of model interaction with the input prompt can be inferred early with only partial output. So the system can start generating, watch the partial response, and stop only if it turns harmful. We test this idea in three steps. First, we build a dataset of 41,944 prompt-response pairs with seven open weights LLMs from three families: Llama, Gemma, and Qwen. Second, we show that prompt harmfulness and interaction safety differ. Prompt labels and response labels agree on only 50.46\% of items (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.06). Of the prompts that make any model respond harmfully, only 3.5\% do so for all seven LLMs. Third, we show that partial responses carry most of the signal. Fine-tuned classifiers predict response-level harm well (best AUPRC 0.885, F1 0.807). About one third of the response tokens recover almost full-response AUPRC.

</details>


### [580] [Shaping Latent Mixture-of-Experts: From Expert Geometry to Layerwise Capacity Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14644)
*Yaoxiang Wang,Kai Zhang,Ruobing Xie,Lanrui Wang,Guoliang Zhao,Junhui Li,Jinsong Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出LatentMoE，将专家计算置于低维空间，使专家输入维度与中间宽度成为显式设计变量；理论证明局部雅可比秩受二者共同约束、均衡时秩上限最大，实验验证近方形专家最优，并用层级内在维度引导容量分配，取得更低验证损失与更强下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度MoE通常通过收窄单个专家来增加专家数量，把专家形状当作路由粒度的副产品而非独立设计变量，缺乏对专家形状及其层级容量分配的系统性研究。

Method: 提出LatentMoE，把专家计算移到低维空间，将专家输入维度与中间宽度显式暴露为设计选择；从理论上分析专家局部雅可比秩由这两维共同界定，并在固定单专家参数量下均衡二者以最大化秩上限；开展跨模型规模与路由粒度的受控形状扫描；进一步利用层级内在维度（ID）指导跨深度容量分配，在保持每层参数量、激活FLOPs与通信量不变的前提下共同调整专家数量与形状。

Result: 受控形状扫描在不同模型规模和路由粒度下一致偏好近方形专家；相较于层级同构基线，ID引导的容量分配实现了更低的验证损失和更强的下游任务表现。

Conclusion: 专家形状与层级容量分配可作为MoE的实用设计轴，为细粒度MoE的架构设计提供了新的优化方向。

Abstract: Fine-grained mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly increase expert count by narrowing each expert, treating expert shape as a by-product of routing granularity. LatentMoE moves expert computation into a lower-dimensional space, exposing the input dimension and intermediate width of each expert as explicit design choices. We show that an expert's local Jacobian rank is jointly bounded by these two dimensions, and that balancing them maximizes the rank ceiling at fixed per-expert parameters. Controlled shape sweeps across model scales and routing granularities consistently favor near-square experts. We further use layerwise intrinsic dimension (ID) to guide capacity allocation across depth, co-varying the number and shape of experts while keeping per-layer parameter count, activated FLOPs, and communication volume constant. Compared with layer-homogeneous baselines, our ID-guided allocation achieves lower validation loss and stronger downstream performance. These results establish expert shape and layerwise allocation as practical design axes for MoEs.

</details>


### [581] [RASSG: Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating for Streaming Tool Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14659)
*Daijin Hu,Xi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RASSG框架，联合控制流式语音助手的工具启动与取消，通过"三次一致"触发启动、并在效果不可逆前的最后可行时机结合失效风险与执行代价决定取消，显著降低过时执行率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式语音助手可在用户说话未结束时提前启动工具，以减少等待，但用户随后的自我纠正会使其看似稳定的参数失效，导致"过时执行"，且其不可逆副作用在最终调用被纠正后依然存在。因此需要能同时管理工具提前启动与适时取消的机制。

Method: 提出Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating（RASSG）：当连续三次语音识别结果具有相同的非空参数时启动工具；随后将经校准的参数失效风险与执行代价相结合，在效果变为不可逆之前的最后可行时机决定是否取消执行。

Result: 在ReCAST、FDB-v3与Audio2Tool上，采用固定工具运行时间与取消参数的受控执行时钟进行评估。在ReCAST的prospective-repair子集上，RASSG将过时执行率从LocalAgreement-2的50.00%降至3.15%，成功轨迹平均延迟3.676s；在两组公开语音数据集上均优于所有提前执行基线。相同初始启动条件下的消融实验支持主动取消的有效性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，RASSG能有效降低流式语音工具调用中的过时执行，并验证了在效果不可逆前控制进行中调用的价值。代码与数据已开源于 https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG。

Abstract: Streaming speech assistants can launch tools before users finish speaking, overlapping execution with incoming speech to reduce user waiting time. However, subsequent self-corrections can invalidate apparently stable arguments, causing stale execution whose irreversible effects persist even after the final call is corrected. We propose Repair-Aware Semantic Survival Gating (RASSG) to jointly control tool launch and cancellation during streaming speech. RASSG launches a tool when three consecutive speech recognition results arrive with identical nonempty arguments, then combines calibrated argument invalidity risk with execution costs to decide cancellation at the last feasible opportunity before effects become irreversible. Evaluation on ReCAST, FDB-v3, and Audio2Tool uses a controlled execution clock with fixed tool runtimes and cancellation parameters. On ReCAST's prospective-repair subset, RASSG reduces the stale execution rate from LocalAgreement-2's 50.00% to 3.15%, with a mean delay of 3.676s across successful trajectories. The stale reduction also holds against every early-execution baseline on both public speech datasets. Ablations with identical initial launches support active cancellation, showing the value of controlling ongoing calls before their effects become irreversible. Code and data are available at https://github.com/daijinhu/RASSG.

</details>


### [582] [A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14680)
*Pushp Garg,Himangshu Sarma,Mrinmoy Ghorai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出结构感知混合框架用于印度手语（ISL）词汇级识别，通过熵驱动SVD采样、连续双位置编码+弹性Transformer、运动学条件自适应GCN解决变速与双手性难题，并构建120类9,453视频数据集，达89.8%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手语识别面临签名速度多变与空间结构复杂的问题；ISL因其固有的双手性需要精确建模，同时受限于大规模词汇基准的稀缺，以及标准模型无法处理不规则签名速度。为此需要构建高效且结构感知的ISL识别框架。

Method: 采用熵驱动的SVD采样器动态提取信息量大的关键帧以减少计算冗余；针对子采样造成的非规则物理时间间隔，使用连续双位置编码（Continuous Dual Positional Encoding）配合距离感知的弹性Transformer（distance-aware Elastic Transformer）保持自然签名节奏；空间上使用运动学条件自适应GCN（Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN），通过统一的骨骼-关节特征显式建模双手几何；并利用物理节点丢弃（Physical Node Dropout）与ArcFace优化缓解受试者特异记忆。

Result: 构建了包含120类、9,453个视频的原生ISL数据集；框架取得89.8%的准确率，为复杂手语建模建立了有力基线。

Conclusion: 所提出的结构感知混合框架能够有效应对ISL的变速与双手几何挑战，在自建大规模词汇数据集上验证了性能，为复杂手语识别提供了强基线。

Abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. Spatially, a Kinematically-Conditioned Adaptive GCN explicitly models bimanual geometry using unified bone-joint features. To validate our framework, a 120-class, 9,453-video native ISL dataset is created. Augmented by Physical Node Dropout and ArcFace optimization to mitigate subject-specific memorization, our framework achieves a competitive 89.8% accuracy, establishing a strong baseline for complex sign language modeling.

</details>


### [583] [Reference Wording Shapes Retrieval of Robot Task Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17549)
*Jahnavi Yelamanchi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在RLBench操作基准的自然语言指令上，作者比较了五种免训练词汇检索器在80种随机参考描述组合下的任务识别效果。字符n-gram TF-IDF表现最佳，留出指令平均Top-1准确率达61.3%，高于BM25（55.6%）和词级TF-IDF（54.9%）。结果表明参考描述措辞与表示选择对指令-任务检索有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从简短指令识别机器人任务的效果依赖于检索库中可用的描述内容。作者希望量化这种依赖效应，即参考描述的措辞选择与文本表示方法对指令到任务检索的影响程度。

Method: 从62个公开任务文件中提取296条固定描述；对每个任务随机选取一条索引描述，构建80种检索库组合；在排除与冲突任务标签完全相同的字符串后，比较五种免训练词汇排序器（字符n-gram TF-IDF、BM25、词级TF-IDF等）在留出指令上的Top-1准确率。

Result: 字符n-gram TF-IDF取得61.3%的平均Top-1准确率，优于BM25（55.6%）和词级TF-IDF（54.9%）。跨检索库选择，字符TF-IDF范围为55.2%-66.8%，5%-95%分位区间为56.9%-64.8%。在匹配查询上添加第二条索引描述可使字符TF-IDF提升7.0个百分点。

Conclusion: 参考描述的措辞与文本表示选择对指令-任务检索性能有实质影响。在一致评估协议下，字符级表示和适度增加索引描述数量能有效提升检索准确率。

Abstract: Identifying a robot task from a short instruction is sensitive to which descriptions are available for retrieval. We investigate this effect in the natural-language instructions included with the RLBench manipulation benchmark. We extract 296 fixed descriptions from 62 publicly available task files and compare five training-free lexical rankers over 80 random choices of one indexed description per task. Exact strings assigned to conflicting task labels are excluded from the primary score. Character n-gram TF-IDF achieves 61.3% mean top-1 accuracy on the resulting held-out instructions, compared with 55.6% for BM25 and 54.9% for word TF-IDF. Across gallery choices, character TF-IDF ranges from 55.2% to 66.8%; its 5th-95th percentile range is 56.9%-64.8%. Adding a second indexed description improves character TF-IDF by 7.0 percentage points on matched queries. These results quantify the influence of reference wording and representation choice on instruction-to-task retrieval under a consistent evaluation protocol.

</details>


### [584] [AcrossVAM2.0: Conflict-Aware Point Supervision for Parameter-Efficient Video Diffusion Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14693)
*Nan Wu,Yee Hung Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在5.01B参数的文本到视频扩散Transformer上研究"显式点对应"与"外观先验"的张力，提出ACROSSVAM2.0（置信度加权track-and-visibility头、零初始化残差反馈、非对称PCGrad），在保持初始生成器不变的前提下提升对应一致性，但不均匀提升视频质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 显式点对应能描述可见表面的运动，对适配视频生成器很有吸引力；但它可能覆盖大规模预训练模型已学到的外观先验。作者意图研究并缓解这一张力，在适配过程中既引入对应监督，又不破坏生成器的原始能力与主更新方向。

Method: 提出ACROSSVAM2.0，包含三个组件：(1) 置信度加权的track-and-visibility预测头；(2) 零初始化残差反馈，使模型在初始化时与原始生成器完全等价；(3) 非对称PCGrad，在共享LoRA参数上仅移除与主flow-matching梯度方向冲突的辅助分量，从而保护主更新。在四个变体上进行1000步、3个独立随机种子的消融实验。

Result: 完整方法在全部3个种子中相对匹配的flow-only续训降低KLT前向-后向循环误差（种子级平均差-0.00711，SD 0.00505），且3个种子的robust sharpness均为正。扩展至24个prompt（216个视频）的评测中，聚合CoTracker3循环误差较匹配对照降低9.7%，在6个VBench维度上接近持平；但种子级跟踪效应异质，且I3D-FVD从0.1824退化到0.2022。

Conclusion: 结果支持一个有边界的结论：冲突感知的适配能在不造成广泛感知退化的前提下改善对应一致性，但并不能一致地提升视频质量。作者公开了公式、伪代码、匹配输出、源表格与工件溯源信息。

Abstract: Explicit point correspondence is attractive for adapting video generators: it describes how visible surfaces move, but can overwrite the appearance prior learned by a large pretrained model. We study this tension in a 5.01B-parameter text-to-video diffusion transformer. ACROSSVAM2.0 combines a confidence-weighted track-and-visibility head, zero-initialized residual feedback, and asymmetric PCGrad that removes only the auxiliary component opposing the primary flow-matching gradient on shared LoRA parameters. The design preserves the generator exactly at initialization and protects its primary update during adaptation. In a four-way ablation trained for 1,000 steps with three independent seeds, the full method lowers KLT forward-backward cycle error in all three seeds relative to a matched flow-only continuation (mean seed-level difference -0.00711, SD 0.00505), while robust sharpness remains positive in all three. An expanded 24-prompt evaluation (216 videos) yields 9.7% lower aggregate CoTracker3 cycle error than the matched control and near-matched performance on six VBench dimensions; however, the seed-level tracking effect is heterogeneous and I3D-FVD regresses from 0.1824 to 0.2022. These results support a bounded claim: conflict-aware adaptation improves correspondence consistency without broad perceptual degradation, but does not uniformly improve video quality. We release equations, pseudocode, matched outputs, source tables, and artifact provenance.

</details>


### [585] [Fresh at Decision, Stale at Action: Routing New Information to LLM Decisions Already Made](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18126)
*Ayoub Merimi,Souhail Bakkali,Abdeljalil Sakat*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"决策有效性时间戳理论"与"决策账本"机制：用六个时间戳刻画决策、以新鲜度上限界定决策在行动时的保证，并将准确率分解为路由与时间判断两种能力；在五个8B至前沿规模LLM上用受控决策流验证了四项预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的决策在做出时依赖"新鲜"信息，但行动发生在之后、且世界会变化，因此决策可能在执行时已失效。现有研究缺乏对"决策随时间保持有效"这一问题的形式化刻画与可操作的支撑机制。

Method: 1) 提出决策有效性时间戳理论：六个时间戳定义一个决策，用"新鲜度上限"（freshness ceiling）界定行动时点的最新证据能保证什么，将剩余风险归于之后发布的信息。2) 将准确率分解为路由（在修订截止期前把新信息送达受影响的决策）与时间判断（按行动时点解读信息）两种能力。3) 构建决策账本：持久化保存每个决策的时间、证据与背景知识，并以决策时写下的"监视条件"（watch conditions）建立索引。

Result: 在带精确标签的受控决策流上，跨五个8B至前沿规模的LLM验证了四项预测：(1) 仅凭新鲜度即可得到上限所预测的准确率；(2) 模型在决定性消息到达后即据其行动，故准确率随路由变化；(3) 账本索引决定路由可触及的范围，监视条件能以低暴露度触达间接依赖；(4) 剩余错误集中在"变更何时生效"这一时间判断问题上。

Conclusion: 新鲜度保证决策在做出时正确，而路由与时间判断保证其在被执行时仍然正确；二者共同构成随时间维持决策有效性的框架。

Abstract: Freshness shapes an LLM decision at the moment it is made; the action it commits to is latent, carried out later, in a changing world. We therefore introduce a timestamp theory of decision validity and a decision ledger that realises it. Six timestamps define a decision; a freshness ceiling bounds what up-to-date evidence guarantees at action time, placing the remaining risk in information published afterwards. Accuracy then factorises into two capabilities: routing, which delivers that information to affected decisions before their revision deadlines, and temporal judgment, which reads it for the time of action. The ledger is persistent state holding each decision's times, evidence and background knowledge, indexed by watch conditions written at decision time. Controlled decision streams with exact labels confirm four predictions across five LLMs, from 8B to frontier scale: freshness alone yields exactly the accuracy the ceiling predicts; models act on decisive news once it arrives, so accuracy follows routing; the ledger's index sets what routing reaches, and watch conditions reach indirect dependencies at low exposure; and the remaining errors concern when a change takes effect. Freshness makes a decision right when it is made; routing and temporal judgment keep it right when it is carried out.

</details>


### [586] [Joint Discrete and SE(3) Diffusion for Protein Interface Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14699)
*Zhenqiao Song,Jianwen Xie,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PIDiff，一种物理化学增强的多模态扩散框架，用于靶标条件化的蛋白质复合物序列与结构联合设计，并构建PIBench数据集，在minibinder与抗体设计任务上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高亲和力、靶标特异性蛋白结合剂设计是现代疗法的核心，但现有生成方法生成的许多设计无法在结合界面同时实现几何互补与物理化学互补。

Method: PIDiff将离散序列空间扩散与连续SE(3)结构流形上的扩散相耦合，联合设计靶标条件化的序列与结构；其核心为PIFormer架构，交替使用几何感知的不变点注意力与全局序列自注意力。同时构建了基于PDB、包含多样靶标支架的蛋白-蛋白复合物数据集PIBench。先在PIBench上预训练，再针对minibinder设计与抗体设计两个治疗相关任务进行微调。

Result: 在所有任务上，PPFrame在序列设计成功率、结构结合能以及序列-结构协同设计性方面均持续优于基线方法。（注：原文方法名为PIDiff，此处结果句中出现的"PPFrame"疑为笔误或命名不一致。）

Conclusion: 通过在离散序列与连续结构流形上耦合扩散并进行物理化学增强的多模态建模，PIDiff能够提升结合界面的几何与物理化学互补性，为治疗相关的蛋白结合剂设计提供有效方案。

Abstract: The design of high-affinity, target-specific protein binders is central to the development of modern therapeutics. However, existing protein-generation methods remain limited in this setting, as many generated designs fail to simultaneously achieve geometric and physicochemical complementarity at binding interfaces. To address this challenge, we introduce PIDiff, a physicochemically enhanced multimodal diffusion framework for protein-protein complex design. PIDiff jointly designs target-conditioned protein sequences and structures by coupling diffusion in discrete sequence space with diffusion on the continuous (SE(3)) structural manifold. At its core, PIDiff employs PIFormer, a novel architecture that interleaves geometry-aware invariant point attention with global sequence self-attention. We further curate PIBench, a protein-protein complex dataset with diverse target scaffolds derived from the Protein Data Bank (PDB). We first pretrain PIDiff on PIBench and subsequently fine-tune it for two therapeutically relevant applications: minibinder design and antibody design. PPFrame consistently outperforms baseline methods across sequence design success rate, structure binding energy, and sequence-structure co-designability on all tasks.

</details>


### [587] [Choosing LLMs for Strategic Agent Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18354)
*Arastun Mammadli,Herbert Woisetschläger,Jawad Fayaz,Shiqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将博弈论评估扩展到"策略选择"元博弈：在潜在且需在线学习的收益矩阵上动态挑选LLM，发现策略能力高度依赖具体博弈与对手，且轻量多臂老虎机路由优于嵌入或自反思方法但仍不及最佳固定模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有博弈论基准仅评估单个固定模型的策略表现，而LLM路由器虽权衡质量与成本，却缺乏策略结构意识，既不考虑未知对手，也不考虑对手随时间适应并改变反馈信号的问题。

Method: 把策略选择定义为叠加在基础博弈之上的元博弈：每轮由选择器从模型组合中派出一个LLM，应对潜在且在线学习的博弈收益矩阵；在5个博弈与10个LLM上评测，对多种选择器（查询嵌入、LLM自反思、多臂老虎机及其非平稳/对抗变体）进行比较。

Result: 评估信号具有博弈特异性，获得可靠信号所需种子次数N远高于传统基准设置；模型策略能力随博弈设置与对手变化显著。基于查询嵌入或LLM自反思的方法无法稳定捕获策略信号，轻量多臂老虎机更可靠但仍逊于最佳固定模型，非平稳与对抗变体未能超过平稳老虎机基线。

Conclusion: 策略选择应作为元博弈被显式建模与评估；当前方法在应对动态变化的对手时存在明显缺口，尤其难以处理非平稳对抗性的策略反馈信号。

Abstract: Game-theoretic benchmarks claim that large language model (LLM) strategic decision-making varies across game types, interaction structures, and capability dimensions. However, they only evaluate strategic performance across individual fixed models. In parallel, contemporary LLM routers pick models under quality-cost trade-offs, but with no notion of a strategic structure. They do not account for an opponent that might be unknown, and that can adapt over time and shift the feedback signal. To address this, we extend the game-theoretic evaluations and define strategic selection as the meta game layered on top of the base game. In each round, a strategic selector fields an LLM from a portfolio of models to navigate a game payoff matrix that is latent and learned online. We find that the evaluation signal is game-specific, and that extracting a reliable signal requires a much higher number of seed runs $N$ compared to traditional benchmarking setups. Evaluating across 5 games and 10 LLMs, we show a model's strategic competence varies significantly depending on the game setup and the opponent faced. Building on this, we implement a suite of selector methods and find that approaches that rely on query embeddings or LLM self-reflection do not consistently capture the underlying strategic signal. A lightweight multi-armed bandit algorithm performs more reliably across games, though it still falls short of the best fixed model. Finally, we show that simple non-stationary and adversarial bandit variants fail to outperform a stationary bandit baseline, pointing to a gap in how current methods handle a shifting opponent in strategic settings.

</details>


### [588] [DSABench: Benchmarking Source Discovery, Coordination, and Execution for Multi-Database Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14700)
*Jinlong Luo,Haoran Wu,Bo Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 DSABench 基准，联合评估多数据库场景下的源路由、跨源依赖协调与执行能力，揭示现有模型在多库工作流上的显著不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数 text-to-SQL 基准直接提供目标数据库，但在大规模数据目录中，"选择数据源"本身就是问题的一部分：智能体需找到请求所需的每个数据库、确定其结果如何拼接，并执行由此形成的工作流。现有基准缺乏对这类联合能力的评测。

Method: 构建 DSABench，含 815 个经人工审核的任务，来源于 Spider、BIRD 和 LiveSQLBench；其中 618 个任务需多个数据库共同贡献，105 个任务对所需数据源存在多种合理解释。采用可执行契约（executable contracts）定义数据源参与、跨源依赖与源内执行；RouteEnv 允许智能体在不暴露金标注的前提下检视公开目录证据。开展仅路由（routing-only）研究与路由+执行研究，涉及七种 / 四种模型后端。

Result: 仅路由研究中，最高 RA-Set 得分为 60.55%，而纳入协调要求后最高 RA-Graph 得分仅 34.66%，差距明显。加入执行要求后差距进一步扩大：四种后端下，非特权 Route+Exec-Graph 中位成功率在无澄清时为 6.69%–7.98%，提供一次澄清时为 11.44%–13.25%，最佳澄清配置达 16.99%。在歧义任务上，澄清使精确分支源恢复率提升 39.8–43.2 个百分点。

Conclusion: 检索到看似合理的数据库或生成正确的局部 SQL 并不足够；智能体必须在整个多数据库工作流中正确传递信息。DSABench 表明当前模型在源发现、跨源协调与端到端执行方面仍存在巨大提升空间，澄清反馈可显著改善歧义场景表现。

Abstract: Most text-to-SQL benchmarks provide the target database. In a large data catalog, however, choosing the sources is part of the problem: an agent must find every database needed for a request, determine how their results fit together, and execute the resulting workflow. We present DSABench to evaluate these capabilities jointly. Its 815 human-reviewed tasks draw on Spider, BIRD, and LiveSQLBench; 618 require several databases to contribute, and 105 allow more than one interpretation of the required sources. Executable contracts define source participation, cross-source dependencies, and source-local execution, while RouteEnv lets agents inspect public catalog evidence without revealing the gold annotations. In our routing-only study across seven model backends, the highest RA-Set score is 60.55%, compared with a highest RA-Graph score of 34.66% when coordination requirements are included. The gap becomes more pronounced when execution is required. Across four backends, median non-privileged Route+Exec-Graph success ranges from 6.69% to 7.98% without clarification and from 11.44% to 13.25% with one clarification; the best observed clarified configuration reaches 16.99%. On ambiguous tasks, clarification improves exact branch-source recovery by 39.8-43.2 percentage points. These findings illustrate why retrieving plausible databases or producing correct local SQL is not enough: an agent must carry the right information through the entire multi-database workflow.

</details>


### [589] [How to Build a Benchmark That Actually Measures Taste](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14707)
*Xiaofan Wu,Xi Zeng,Miaoxia Chen,Peishan Chen,Shuyan Li,Chen Wang,Jiyun Yao,Hanyong Zhong,Jiahao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 TasteBench 成对好坏品味基准与配套控制协议，量化位置偏差、词法泄漏与难度天花板三类效度威胁，并给出可修复工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 专家对齐的"品味"基准应奖励工艺判断力，而非钻测试空子的能力；现有评测难以区分二者，需可测量的控制协议来隔离伪信号。

Method: 构建覆盖视觉、品牌、图书、技术类目的成对 good-vs-bad 基准，采用冻结评分量表与专家唯一金标（专家组 n>=3，主要门限为一致性>=0.60，弱参与标签仅用于训练/分析）；设计控制协议：专家金标、弱标签防火墙、构建阶段侧别随机化、文件名清洗与困难过滤；在 Round-1 试点（三位真人专家，250 对）上施加该协议检验。

Result: 识别并量化三种效度威胁：（1）位置偏差——偏好项位于 A 槽概率 0.956，恒选 A 策略得分 0.956；（2）词法泄漏——文件名 token 线索得分 0.912；（3）难度天花板——工艺类目人类一致性近满（图书/品牌/技术 1.0），A/B 随机化下五张 VLM 卡在工艺上均达 1.0，仅视觉类有区分度（约 0.84–0.91；事后困难子集 n=107 工艺仍为 1.0）。侧别随机化工具将位置偏斜从 0.916 降至 0.495/0.505。

Conclusion: 位置与泄漏属可修复的构建伪影，工艺类难度天花板是成对难度限制，须由 Round-2 解决；本文不评估参与度、年代/圈层条件与校准，也不声称通用品味 SOTA，仅提供对基准"测什么、未测什么"的校准式认识，并发布参考评测框架与侧别随机化工具。

Abstract: Expert-aligned "taste" benchmarks should reward craft judgment, not the ability to game the test. We introduce TasteBench, a pairwise good-vs-bad benchmark across visual, brand, book, and tech items under a frozen rubric with expert-only gold (panel n>=3; percent agreement >=0.60 primary gate; weak engagement labels train/analysis-only), together with a control protocol that separates craft judgment from test-gaming. Applying the protocol to a Round-1 pilot (primary_human_expert; three biological human experts; n=250 pairs) surfaces and quantifies three validity threats: two construction artifacts that inflate the trivial-baseline layer, and a difficulty ceiling that inflates every score. (1) Position: the preferred item is slot A with probability 0.956, so an always_item_a policy scores 0.956 (fair chance 0.5). (2) Lexical leakage: a filename token cue scores 0.912. (3) Difficulty ceiling: craft domains show near-ceiling human agreement (book/brand/tech 1.0), and even under A/B randomization (eval_assignment_seed7; gold_side_A ~0.47) all five VLM cards reach 1.0 on craft, with only visual separating (~0.84-0.91; a post-hoc hard subset, n=107, leaves craft at 1.0). The protocol (expert-only gold, a weak-label firewall, side randomization at construction, filename scrubbing, and hard filters) makes each artifact measurable and, for the two construction artifacts, correctable; we release a reference eval harness and a side-randomization tool, and show the tool removes the position skew (0.916 to 0.495/0.505). The result is a calibrated view of what the benchmark does and does not yet measure: position and leakage are fixable, whereas the craft-domain ceiling is a pair-difficulty limit that Round-2 must address. We do not evaluate engagement, era/circle conditioning, or calibration here, and we claim no general taste SOTA.

</details>


### [590] [Relational Semantic Grounding for Test-Time Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14721)
*Tianle Liu,Gongbo Cheng,Chenggong Ni,Minming Gu,Tao Zhou,Fuyuan Hu,Fan Lyu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SEGA提出一种面向测试时发现（TTD）的语义锚定框架，利用大语言模型生成属性描述并构建属性锚定的视觉-语义空间，通过关系语义锚定将未知样本映射为可解释语义概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有TTD方法依赖视觉聚类或原型比较，只能为发现的类分配匿名标签，在开放世界应用中缺乏可解释性。因此需要将匿名的测试时聚类转化为可解释的语义概念。

Method: SEGA用LLM为已知类生成属性丰富的描述，并在训练阶段构建属性锚定的视觉-语义空间；测试时引入关系语义锚定（RSG），用相似与不相似的已知类锚点对未知样本进行锚定，提示LLM生成候选概念并在学习到的语义空间中重排序，所选概念进一步用于置信度引导的测试时语义稳定化。

Result: 实验表明SEGA提升了TTD基线方法的表现，并展现出面向开放世界的语义锚定潜力。

Conclusion: 通过将属性级语义对齐与关系概念锚定相结合，SEGA 把匿名测试时聚类转化为可解释的语义概念，为开放世界TTD提供了语义锚定新范式。

Abstract: Test-Time Discovery (TTD) aims to recognize known classes and detect novel ones from a continuous unlabeled test stream after deployment. Existing TTD methods mainly rely on visual clustering or prototype comparison, and can only assign anonymous labels to discovered classes, leaving them difficult to interpret in open-world applications. In this paper, we propose SEGA, a Semantic Grounding with Attributes framework for TTD. SEGA leverages large language models to generate attribute-rich descriptions for known classes and constructs an attribute-anchored visual-semantic space during training. At test time, we introduce Relational Semantic Grounding (RSG), which grounds unknown samples with similar and dissimilar known-class anchors, prompts the LLM to generate candidate concepts, and reranks them in the learned semantic space. The selected concept is further used for confidence-guided test-time semantic stabilization. By coupling attribute-level semantic alignment with relational concept grounding, SEGA transforms anonymous test-time clusters into interpretable semantic concepts. Experiments show that SEGA improves TTD baselines with the promise of semantic grounding for open-world.

</details>


### [591] [MHWA: Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14727)
*Pengcheng Pan,Guoqing Ma,Yuhan Zhang,Yang Chen,Yichen Liu,Ziheng Li,Shan Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MHWA是一种多时间尺度分层世界-动作模型，通过跨步高层上下文通道降低全局上下文更新频率以抑制漂移累积，并借助上下文感知路由动态重构低层专家混合，在14款Atari游戏上以77M参数达到0.884的IQM HNS，超越同规模JOWA-70M并与JOWA-150M相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归世界模型在决策中样本效率高，但开环推演存在随规划时域增长而加剧的漂移与误差累积问题。分层时间抽象可通过缩短有效预测时域来缓解漂移，然而现有分层设计引入额外结构与概念复杂度，难以控制，且相对扁平基线的收益有限。因此需要一种既能抑制漂移又不显著增加复杂度的分层方案。

Method: 提出MHWA（Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model）。其核心为：1）采用跨步（strided）高层上下文通道，降低全局上下文的更新频率，从而遏制复合漂移的传播；2）通过上下文感知路由，门控网络利用全局上下文与当前观测动态重构低层专家混合（MoE），实现灵活的高低层协调，缓解静态分层中常见的层间干扰。

Result: 在14游戏Atari子集、10%子采样离线数据、三个训练种子的设定下，采用RLiable的seed-by-game聚合，MHWA（77M参数）取得IQM人类归一化分数（HNS）0.884；匹配规模的JOWA-70M基线为0.529；MHWA数值上与JOWA-150M相当，但参数量约为其一半，每序列训练FLOPs减少70.88%。

Conclusion: MHWA通过多时间尺度分层与上下文感知动态路由，在不显著增加模型复杂度与计算成本的前提下有效抑制自回归世界模型开环推演的漂移累积，以更少参数和训练算力达到甚至接近更大规模扁平基线的决策性能，验证了动态高低层协调相对于静态分层设计的优势。

Abstract: Autoregressive world models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for sample efficient decision making, yet their open loop rollouts often exhibit increasing drift that leads to error accumulation even within a relatively small planning horizon. Hierarchical temporal abstraction is a natural candidate to mitigate such drift by reducing the effective prediction horizon; however, existing hierarchical designs can introduce added structural and conceptual complexity, sometimes making them difficult to control and limiting gains over flat baselines. To this end, we introduce MHWA (Multi-timescale Hierarchical World-Action model), which employs a strided high level context channel to reduce global context update frequency, effectively curbing the propagation of compounding drift. Crucially, via context aware routing, the gating network dynamically reconfigures a low level mixture of experts by using both global context and current observations, thereby enabling flexible high-low coordination, helping alleviate interference commonly observed in static hierarchies. Empirically, using RLiable's seed-by-game aggregation, MHWA (77M parameters) achieves an IQM human normalized score (HNS) of 0.884 across three training seeds on a 14-game Atari subset using 10% subsampled offline data, outperforming a matched JOWA-70M baseline (0.529) and achieving numerically comparable performance to JOWA-150M while using nearly half the parameters and 70.88% fewer training FLOPs per sequence.

</details>


### [592] [Think in Strategies, Act with Tools: Traceable Agentic Optimization for Combinatorial Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14736)
*Zhongnian Li,Shi Xu,Peng Ying,Weikang Gong,Zhixiao Wang,Xinzheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出工具增强的策略智能体（TASA），通过将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择，并利用LLM构建问题专用工具与策略引导的自适应工具规划器，提升OPRO类方法的解质量与可追踪性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OPRO直接利用大语言模型通过自然语言提示生成候选解，但其优化过程难以追踪，导致LLM无法捕捉前序迭代中积累的有用信息，从而限制了解的质量。

Method: TASA基于优化轨迹为每一步规划策略，将优化过程分解为可追踪的策略选择；同时利用LLM构建问题专用工具，并引入策略引导的自适应工具规划器，高效利用轨迹信息更新解。

Result: 在持续探索下建立了局部收敛性，并在共享的候选-评估预算下对完整框架进行评估，结果验证了其解质量与策略引导搜索的可追踪性。

Conclusion: TASA通过轨迹总结与利用、策略分解与工具增强，缓解了OPRO优化过程不可追踪的问题，在相同评估预算下提升了解的质量。

Abstract: Optimization by PROmpting (OPRO) directly leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate candidate solutions through natural-language prompting. However, OPRO's optimization process is difficult to track, which prevents LLMs from capturing useful information accumulated over previous iterations, thereby limiting solution quality. To address this limitation, we propose a Tool-Augmented Strategic Agent (TASA) which summarizes and exploits trajectory to improve solution quality. Specifically, TASA plans the strategy for each step based on the optimization trajectory, which decomposes the optimization process into traceable strategy selections. Moreover, we leverage LLM to construct problem-specific tools and introduce a strategy-guided adaptive tool planner, which efficiently utilizes the information of trajectory to update solutions. We establish local convergence under persistent exploration and evaluate the complete framework under a shared candidate-evaluation budget. The results support its solution quality and the traceability of strategy-guided search.

</details>


### [593] [SAGE: Pushing 2-Bit Vector-Quantized LLMs toward Real-World Usability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14745)
*Xianglong Yan,Zenan Wu,Kewei Zhang,Kaicheng Yang,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SAGE是一种面向大语言模型的极低位宽（2-bit）权重向量量化方法，通过能量分层分组与自适应比特分配两项设计，在保护敏感通道和分配方向/半径比特预算上取得改进，实现SOTA精度并配合定制CUDA核带来最高2.55倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极低位宽权重量化可降低大模型部署成本。3比特以下标量量化精度损失严重，向量量化（VQ）通过更强的联合编码能更好保持精度，但现有VQ方法在真实任务上仍有明显退化。两个关键设计问题尚未被充分探索：(1) 如何在联合编码的向量内保护敏感权重通道；(2) 如何在固定比特预算下，在方向、半径等表示分量之间进行分配，以适应不同权重矩阵。

Method: 提出SAGE（Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy），包含两个组件：1) 能量分层分组（ESG）：将通道分组与激活加权拟合耦合，在每个子向量内组合来自不同能量层的通道，从而优先保护敏感通道；2) 自适应比特划分（ABS）：在固定预算下，为每个矩阵平衡方向码本容量与半径精度，选择使激活加权重构误差最低的划分方案。

Result: 在覆盖知识、数学、代码生成、指令遵循和工具使用等基准上，SAGE在2-bit量化设定下达到SOTA性能。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，保留BF16模型平均基准分数的95.3%。配合定制CUDA核，相比FP16实现最高2.55倍的非流式端到端加速。

Conclusion: SAGE通过能量分层分组与自适应比特划分，有效解决了向量量化中敏感通道保护与比特预算分配问题，在2-bit极低位宽下实现SOTA精度并具备实际部署加速收益，代码已开源。

Abstract: Extreme low-bit weight-only quantization is an effective approach to reducing the deployment costs of large language models. Below 3 bits, scalar quantization often suffers severe accuracy loss, while vector quantization (VQ) better preserves accuracy through more expressive joint encoding. However, existing VQ methods still exhibit substantial degradation on real-world tasks, and two design challenges remain underexplored: (1) protecting sensitive weight channels within jointly encoded vectors; and (2) allocating a fixed bit budget among representation components, such as direction and radius, to suit different weight matrices. To address these challenges, we propose SAGE: Split Adaptation and Grouping by Energy for weight-only vector quantization. First, Energy-Stratified Grouping (ESG) couples channel grouping with activation-weighted fitting, grouping channels from different energy tiers within each subvector to prioritize sensitive channels. Second, Adaptive Bit Split (ABS) balances direction-codebook capacity and radius precision per matrix, selecting the split with the lowest activation-weighted reconstruction error under a fixed budget. Across benchmarks covering knowledge, mathematics, code generation, instruction following, and tool use, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance in the 2-bit quantization setting. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, it retains 95.3% of the BF16 model's average benchmark score. With our custom-designed CUDA kernel, SAGE delivers up to a 2.55-fold non-streaming end-to-end speedup over FP16. The code is available at https://github.com/Zincwolf/sage.

</details>


### [594] [Equal-information evaluation of credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14750)
*Gennadiy Chistiakov,Yury Yanovich*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个评估模块化金融强化学习中信用分配的框架，结合等信息重构对照、固定效用比较和预设下游护栏，并在三个受控研究中识别出三类评估失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模块化金融强化学习中的信用分配难以评估：被归因的信号可能改善某个组件损失，却不增加决策相关信息，也不改善经济结果。

Method: 构建评估框架，包含等信息重构对照、固定效用比较和预设下游护栏；将其实例化于归因引导的模块化交易架构，并开展三项受控研究，分别覆盖更新分配、监督目标表示和组合风险控制。

Result: 在披露接口下，基于残差的分配被普通损失预算对照精确复现；直接缺口监督提升了组件预测，但未能保持解码结果；在固定效用下，逐组件评论家监督相较标量监督恶化了风险条件确定性等价和回撤。

Conclusion: 识别出三类评估失败：冗余归因信号、表示导致的预测权衡、组件监督与下游风险结果错位；保留的历史工程案例说明模块级学习主张需要运行级溯源。贡献是一套可复用方法论，用于评估部分可观测、延迟反馈和经济风险约束下专家系统的信用分配。

Abstract: Credit assignment in modular financial reinforcement learning is difficult to evaluate because an attributed signal may improve a component loss without adding decision-relevant information or improving economic outcomes. We propose an evaluation framework combining equal-information reconstruction controls, fixed-utility comparisons and prespecified downstream guardrails. The framework is instantiated in an attribution-guided modular trading architecture and tested in three controlled studies covering update allocation, supervision-target representation and portfolio risk control. We find that residual-based allocation is exactly reproduced by an ordinary loss-budget control under the disclosed interface; direct shortfall supervision improves component prediction but fails decoded-outcome preservation; and component-wise critic supervision worsens risk-condition certainty equivalent and drawdown relative to scalar supervision under fixed utility. These results identify three distinct evaluation failures: redundant attribution signals, representation-induced prediction trade-offs, and misalignment between component supervision and downstream risk outcomes. A preserved historical engineering case further shows why module-level learning claims require run-level provenance. The contribution is a reusable methodology for evaluating credit assignment in expert systems operating under partial observability, delayed feedback and economic risk constraints.

</details>


### [595] [GateSight: Recurrent Memory Anticipates Attention Memory for Query-Agnostic KV Eviction in Hybrid LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14754)
*Junjie Li,Jiong Lou,Jie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GateSight：利用混合语言模型中 GDN 层在预填充阶段产生的写门、衰减与写幅度信号，通过轻量级逐头 MLP 预测 KV 条目的未来效用，从而在预填充后一次性裁剪并物理释放注意力 KV 缓存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合模型（GDN 层 + 全注意力层）中，全注意力层的 KV 缓存随上下文增长并成为推理显存瓶颈。作者希望验证：固定大小的循环记忆是否已经"预知"了注意力记忆所需的信息，从而可据此在查询到来前就判断 KV 条目的价值并压缩缓存。

Method: 1) 验证 GDN 头部保留长记忆的能力由权重而非文档决定；2) 以"删除某 KV 条目对模型自身延续输出的注意力结果影响"定义未来效用，发现 GDN 预填充时输出的写门、衰减与写幅度可提前预测该效用；3) 提出 GateSight，用轻量级逐头 MLP（不读取注意力分数）学习该映射，预测效用决定各注意力层保留的条目，保留量由模型原生注意力输出门（各层均值相差一个数量级以上）决定；4) 服务时在预填充后一次性打分并物理释放被丢弃的 KV 条目。

Result: 在 SCBench 与 RULER-4096 上，使用 Qwen3.8-27B 及相同方案的稀疏注意力模型 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next，覆盖至模型 262K token 上限：仅用十分之一 KV 缓存时，GateSight 在四组模型-基准中的三组为五种查询无关方法中最准确者，并在全部四组上优于 KVzip 达 9.5–47.2 分；且能以相对预填充可忽略的开销完成全长上下文打分。

Conclusion: GDN 循环记忆在预填充阶段即携带了预测注意力 KV 未来效用的信号，GateSight 据此实现查询无关的 KV 缓存压缩，在显著降低缓存占用的同时保持甚至提升精度，且额外开销极小。

Abstract: Hybrid language models interleave Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, whose recurrent memory has a fixed size, with full-attention layers, whose key-value (KV) cache grows with the context and dominates serving memory. In this paper, we ask whether the recurrent memory already knows what the attention memory will need. We first show that which GDN heads of Qwen3.8-27B keep long memories is fixed by the weights rather than by the document. Next, we define the future utility of a KV entry by how much removing it changes the attention output over the model's own continuations, and find that the write gate, decay and write magnitude that GDN layers emit during prefill anticipate this utility before any query is seen. Because the relation is spread across many GDN heads and layers, and a linear map recovers its trend but less of its high-utility tail than a nonlinear one, we propose GateSight, which learns it with lightweight per-head multilayer perceptrons that read these signals and no attention score. Their predicted utility decides which entries each attention layer keeps, and how much each layer keeps is set by the model's native attention output gate, whose mean differs by more than an order of magnitude across layers. Finally, at serving time, GateSight scores the cache once after prefill and physically releases discarded KV entries. Experimental results on SCBench and RULER-4096 with Qwen3.8-27B and, with the same recipe, the sparse-attention model Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, up to the 262K-token limit of the models, show that with a tenth of the attention KV cache, GateSight is the most accurate of five query-agnostic methods on three of the four model-benchmark pairs and leads KVzip on all four, by 9.5 to 47.2 points. Notably, it scores a full-length context with negligible overhead relative to prefill.

</details>


### [596] [CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14763)
*Chenlu Ding,Jiancan Wu,Yanchen Luo,Tianyu Zhang,Yancheng Yuan,Xiang Wang,Xiangnan He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CUSE框架，通过反事实引导与on-policy自蒸馏，实现多模态大模型目标信息的细粒度遗忘，同时保留非目标内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型遗忘方法对完整回复施加统一遗忘目标，并依赖固定的off-policy监督，导致token级控制粗糙、与模型当前行为不一致。

Method: CUSE先通过移除目标相关证据构建反事实输入，利用token概率变化定位需强遗忘的token；再对当前策略采样的回复进行token级遗忘与保留目标的蒸馏，以原模型的冻结副本作为教师模型，并融入遗忘与保留导向的特权上下文。

Result: 在MLLMU-Bench上，CUSE将遗忘集ROUGE-L降低33.6%，同时保留集ROUGE-L比最强基线高1.2%。

Conclusion: CUSE通过反事实引导与on-policy自蒸馏实现细粒度token级遗忘，在有效移除目标信息的同时更好地保留非目标内容。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher model augmented with the corresponding forgetting- and retention-oriented privileged contexts. This design jointly determines what to forget and what to preserve. On MLLMU-Bench, CUSE reduces forget-set ROUGE-L by 33.6% while achieving 1.2% higher retain-set ROUGE-L than the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [597] [How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14772)
*Xiaofan Wu,Xi Zeng,Miaoxia Chen,Peishan Chen,Shuyan Li,Chen Wang,Jiyun Yao,Hanyong Zhong,Jiahao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"相机优先"智能体的核心瓶颈是时间而非识别能力，将短暂目标交互（ETI）形式化为感知截止契约，并设计双截止（记忆硬截止+推理软截止）架构，将记忆与推理解耦。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型在语义识别与语言推理上已足够强大，但许多视觉目标是短暂（ephemeral）的，稍纵即逝。若将记忆与推理绑定在同一端到端路径上，等到单一大流程完成时，关键证据早已消失。因此，制约未来相机优先智能体的核心障碍是时间而非识别。

Method: 提出 Ephemeral-Target Interaction（ETI）问题形式化，并定义"感知截止契约"（Perceptual Deadline Contract），把严格的记忆硬截止与宽松的推理软截止分离，依据是感觉记忆与工作记忆的有界、被动特性。据此设计双截止架构：1）常开、有界、非语义的快路径；2）主动记忆机制，在被覆盖前将关键时刻写入持久记忆（v1 为事件驱动）；3）延后审议层（多模态模型+工具）。在真实 MOT17 轨迹窗口上实例化该契约并做一致性检验。

Result: 基于实测前沿模型延迟校准单路径基线：即使简短回答也需 1.2–9.3 秒，而智能体式的"识别+搜索"耗时更长，说明单路径方案必然错过短暂证据。契约在 MOT17 轨迹窗口上通过了实例化与一致性检查。

Conclusion: "答案可以迟到，证据不能错过。"记忆必须与推理解耦，通过有界的非语义快路径与事件驱动的主动记忆保证证据不丢失，而语义推理可延后处理。

Abstract: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

</details>


### [598] [ProgAgent: Learning Tool Orchestration through Programmatic Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14774)
*Hao Li,Keqing He,Longtao Zheng,Junlong Li,Weihao Zeng,Qian Liu,Yuzhen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 ProgAgent，一个面向程序化工具调用（PTC）的完整训练栈，包含可验证长程任务合成流水线、轻量级 PTC 运行时与两阶段训练方法，使模型通过代码调用工具并将中间结果存入运行时变量而非上下文。仅用 215 个任务、四种环境规模实例化，ProgAgent-14B 在四个基准上以同规模基线更高的通过率胜出，在 LOCA-bench 的 64k token 环境状态下取得 30.7% 通过率（基线为零），且跨执行框架实验显示 PTC 训练收益不局限于接口本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体多采用直接工具调用（DTC），即模型顺序调用工具并将工具响应累积到模型上下文中。在长程任务中，这种累积会导致上下文腐化和编排失效。程序化工具调用（PTC）通过可执行代码调用工具，将中间结果保存在运行时变量而非追加到上下文，有望缓解该问题。然而，先前工作主要将 PTC 视为推理时优化，其用于智能体训练的价值尚不清楚，且缺乏合适的可验证训练任务。因此作者希望系统性地研究 PTC 训练，并填补可验证长程任务稀缺的空白。

Method: ProgAgent 是一个完整的 PTC 训练栈，包含三个组成部分：（1）用于合成可验证长程任务的流水线；（2）轻量级 PTC 运行时；（3）两阶段训练方法。训练数据仅用 215 个任务，并在四种环境规模下实例化。

Result: ProgAgent 在四个基准上的通过率均高于同规模对比基线。在 LOCA-bench 上，当环境状态为 64k token 时，ProgAgent-14B 达到 30.7% 通过率，而所评估的同规模基线得分为零。跨执行框架（cross-harness）实验表明，采用 PTC 训练的模型在两种评估接口下均优于采用 DTC 训练的模型。

Conclusion: PTC 训练在长程智能体任务中具有显著优势，即使训练任务数量很少、环境规模有限也能取得更好性能，尤其在长上下文环境下优势明显；且 PTC 训练的收益能够跨评估接口泛化，说明其价值不仅来自接口本身，而具有更广泛的训练层面的收益。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to orchestrate diverse tools over long-horizon tasks. Existing agents typically use Direct Tool Calling (DTC), where the model invokes tools sequentially, and tool responses accumulate in the model context, which can lead to context rot and orchestration breakdown. In contrast, Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC) invokes tools through executable code and stores intermediate results in runtime variables rather than appending them to the context. Prior work has explored PTC mainly as an inference-time optimization, but its benefits for agentic training remain unclear, and suitable verifiable training tasks are scarce. In this work, we introduce ProgAgent, a full PTC training stack, comprising a pipeline for synthesizing verifiable long-horizon tasks, a lightweight PTC runtime, and a two-stage training recipe. Using only 215 tasks instantiated at four environment scales, ProgAgent yields higher pass rates than the evaluated baselines of comparable size across four benchmarks. On LOCA-bench, ProgAgent-14B achieves a 30.7% pass rate at a 64k-token environment state, where these baselines score zero. Cross-harness experiments show that PTC-trained models outperform DTC-trained models under both evaluation interfaces, suggesting that the benefits of PTC training extend beyond the interface.

</details>


### [599] [LYNX: Analytical Program Synthesis via Grounding and Closed-Loop Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14777)
*Ruichen Xia,Xiao Han,Dingyu Yang,Luwei Yang,Sai Wu,Dongxiang Zhang,Binhui Yao,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LYNX 是一个多智能体框架，将 LLM 驱动的数据分析建模为受模式与知识约束的分析问题，通过规划-生成-验证-精炼的闭环流程提升 NL-to-SQL 的语义一致性与执行正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 数据分析方法（无论是意图到代码的翻译器还是独立分析引擎）难以将领域语义与复杂模式及异构元数据可靠对齐，导致真实工作负载中执行脆弱、分析结果语义不一致。

Method: LYNX 将分析合成组织为规划、生成、验证、精炼的闭环工作流，由三个角色专业化智能体协同保障模式接地、语义一致性与执行正确性；引入 Semantic-Structural Distillation 与 Stage-Aware Allocation（SSD-SAA）缓解领域歧义与模式错位；并通过 delta 引导的迭代修订持续诊断和修复语义与执行层面故障。

Result: 在 BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev 与 Spider 2.0-Lite 两个 NL-to-SQL 基准上，轻量级与商用模型取得 10.66%–59.54% 的执行准确率，相比此前最高效方法减少 70.53% 的 token 消耗；框架在不同骨干模型（开源轻量级到最新商用模型）上展现高泛化性。

Conclusion: 在量化金融分析与复杂多关系 SQL 工作负载上的案例研究进一步证明 LYNX 的鲁棒性、可扩展性及在真实分析场景中的实用价值。

Abstract: LLM-powered data analytics aims to translate natural language instructions into executable analytical programs over underlying data. However, existing approaches, whether treating LLMs as intent-to-code translators or as standalone analytical engines, often fail to reliably align domain semantics with complex schemas and heterogeneous metadata, resulting in brittle execution and semantically inconsistent analytical outputs in real-world workloads. We present LYNX, a multi-agent framework that formulates LLM-driven analytics as a schema- and knowledge-constrained analysis problem rather than a single-pass generation task. LYNX organizes analytical synthesis into a closed-loop workflow of planning, generation, verification, and refinement through three role-specialized agents that collaboratively enforce schema grounding, semantic consistency, and execution correctness. To address domain ambiguity and schema misalignment, LYNX integrates Semantic-Structural Distillation and Stage-Aware Allocation (SSD-SAA). A delta-guided iterative revision continuously diagnoses and repairs semantic and execution-level failures, substantially improving synthesis robustness. We evaluate LYNX on two NL-to-SQL benchmarks, BIRD-SQL Mini-Dev and the more challenging Spider 2.0-Lite. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance and efficiency, achieving 10.66% to 59.54% execution accuracy across lightweight and commercial models, while reducing token consumption by 70.53% compared with the prior most efficient method. Our framework displays high generalization over different backbones, from open-source, lightweight models to the latest commercial models. Additional case studies on quantitative finance analytics and complex multi-relational SQL workloads further demonstrate the framework's robustness, scalability, and practical applicability in real-world analytical scenarios.

</details>


### [600] [Counterfactual Regret for Reflective Agents with Lean-Verified Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14790)
*Zhongnian Li,Shi Xu,Mengting Xu,Peng Ying,Xinzheng Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究反思型语言智能体在资源约束下局部反思与长期性能保证之间的关系，给出次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并在Lean中形式化了13条理论结果的证明链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于策略选择与动作生成的保证，无法说明局部反思何时能为完整智能体在资源约束下提供长期性能保证，存在理论空白。

Method: 建立资源敏感的迁移，界定实际执行路径上的全状态部署差异，并保持学习器与比较器的自身历史规律；由局部生成可靠性导出累积生成机会界，建立质量、覆盖与硬预算的显式权衡，连接策略获取与长期性能；在Lean中形式化13条编号理论结果的证明链，含带重复策略增长与不完美验证的原生实例。

Result: 导出局部生成与部署保证下次线性反事实遗憾的充分条件，并在保留原生控制器的情况下成立；得到累积生成机会界及质量-覆盖-硬预算权衡；以Lean形式化验证了全部13条理论结果。

Conclusion: 该工作弥合了局部反思保证与长期智能体性能保证之间的理论空白，为资源受限的反思型语言智能体提供了可形式化验证的性能理论框架。

Abstract: Reflective language agents reuse feedback and memory to adapt across tasks without updating model weights. However, existing guarantees for policy selection and action generation do not by themselves establish when local reflection yields long-term performance guarantees for the complete agent under resource constraints. In this paper, we address this gap by deriving sufficient conditions for sublinear counterfactual regret from local generation and deployment guarantees, while retaining the native controller. Specifically, we establish a resource-sensitive transfer that bounds full-state deployment discrepancies along actual execution paths and preserves the own-history laws of both learner and comparator. Besides, local generation reliability yields a cumulative generation opportunity bound, linking policy acquisition to long-term performance through an explicit quality, coverage, and hard-budget tradeoff. To verify these guarantees, we formalize the conditional proof chain for all thirteen numbered theoretical results in Lean, including a native instance with repeated policy growth and imperfect validation.

</details>


### [601] [GREAT-ESDD: Graph Edge Attention Network for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14792)
*Attila Lischka,Ze Zhou,Xuegang,Ban,Balázs Kulcsár*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GREAT-ESDD 动态定价与路径规划框架，用 GREAT 神经网络求解器并行求解 CVRP 以估计配送成本，结合 Thompson 采样在线学习客户偏好，实现上门/非上门配送的有效引导，利润较传统求解器提升约 11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线当日达要求运营商持续更新路径，且路径成本随客户数量增长。非上门（OOH）配送选项可帮助企业在客户数量增加时保持较低配送成本，但如何在两种配送方式间动态定价并有效引导客户，同时在线学习客户偏好，是亟待解决的问题。

Method: 构建面向在线下单场景的动态定价-路径框架。基于 Graph-Edge-Attention-Network（GREAT）训练 CVRP 神经求解器，支持不同规模与起始条件，可对部分执行的路径重新优化；批量并行处理多个实例，用于求解客户选择上门或 OOH 后产生的候选路径问题，估计各选项的配送成本增量以设定动态价格，并在客户决策后直接给出更新路径。采用带 Laplace 近似后验的 Thompson 采样在线学习客户偏好，平衡配送费与路径成本，引导客户在门送成本高时选择 OOH。

Result: 在相近的定价决策时间预算下，相比传统路径求解器利润提升约 11%；且能在模拟运营仅 5 天后成功估计客户偏好，表现优于静态定价策略。

Conclusion: 将神经 CVRP 求解器与在线偏好学习相结合，可有效支撑上门与 OOH 混合配送的动态定价与路径决策，在保证求解速度的同时提升利润与客户偏好估计效率。

Abstract: Online, same-day delivery requires operators to constantly update their routes, and the routing cost for deliveries increases with the number of customers. Out-of-home (OOH) delivery options can help companies handle increasing customer numbers while keeping delivery costs low. We develop a dynamic pricing-and-routing framework for this online ordering scenario with home and OOH delivery options. First, we develop a neural solver for the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) based on the Graph-Edge-Attention-Network (GREAT). We train it to solve CVRP with varying instance sizes and starting conditions, allowing it to reoptimize partially executed routes under changing conditions. It is fast while achieving solution quality competitive with traditional baselines. Our solver processes several CVRP instances in parallel in batches and we use it to solve the candidate routing problems that arise from an incoming customer's choice of home or OOH delivery. This provides an estimate of the delivery cost increase per option, which we use to set dynamic prices. Further, it directly provides the updated route once the customer decides. We trade off delivery fees against routing costs and steer customers toward OOH delivery when home delivery would be costly. However, effective steering requires us to know the customer preferences. To learn those online, we use Thompson sampling with a Laplace-approximated posterior. We call the resulting framework GREAT-ESDD (GREAT for Effectively Steered Delivery Decisions). Compared to a traditional routing solver, it increases profit by around 11% under a similar pricing decision time budget. Moreover, we show that we can estimate customer preferences successfully, outperforming a static pricing strategy after only 5 days of simulated operations.

</details>


### [602] [CESNET-TimeSeries26: A Multi-Year Network Traffic Time Series Dataset for Annual Seasonality, Concept Drift, and Long-Term Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14799)
*Josef Koumar,Karel Hynek,Kamil Jerabek,Pavel Siska*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 CESNET-TimeSeries26 数据集，包含 CESNET3 网络连续 995 天流量时间序列及一个约 4.5 年的子网数据，覆盖 278,466 个 IP、285 个机构与 566 个机构子网、三种聚合间隔，为长期网络流量预测提供纵向基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公开数据集时长过短，无法支持考虑年度季节性与行为漂移的长期预测评估；而网络流量管理需要长期评估模型对突发现象和模式变化的适应能力。

Method: 构建并发布 CESNET-TimeSeries26 数据集，采集 CESNET3 网络 995 天连续流量时间序列，并补充约 4.5 年的单一子网数据，以三种聚合间隔覆盖 278,466 个 IP 地址、285 个机构、566 个机构子网，用于预测模型的纵向评测。

Result: 分析表明年度季节性是最主要的周期成分；预测模型只有在训练窗口覆盖至少一个完整年度周期时才能利用年度成分，而现有不足一年的数据集无法提供该条件。

Conclusion: CESNET-TimeSeries26 为网络运营管理与安全监控中的预测模型评估提供了权威的长期基准，并强调了年度周期对长期流量预测建模的必要性。

Abstract: Forecast-based models are fundamental to network traffic management and anomaly detection. However, it is essential to evaluate these forecasting models over extended periods of time in order to assess their adaptability to unexpected phenomena and shifts in underlying patterns. This kind of long-term evaluation requires multi-year data to account for yearly seasonality and behavioral drift. Existing public datasets are too short to support such long-horizon forecasting tasks. We introduce CESNET-TimeSeries26, comprising 995 days of continuous traffic time series from the CESNET3 network, together with a single subnet spanning approximately 4.5 years. The dataset captures 278,466 IP addresses, 285 institutions, and 566 institutional subnets at three aggregation intervals. The dataset provides a definitive longitudinal benchmark for evaluating forecasting models in both operational management and security monitoring. We demonstrate that annual seasonality is the dominant periodic component. Moreover, we show that a forecasting model can exploit the annual component only when its training window covers at least one complete annual cycle, which no sub-year dataset provides.

</details>


### [603] [SpecForge: Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents via Behavioral Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15708)
*Yutong Cheng,Haifeng Chen,Peng Gao,Wei Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SpecForge，通过多前沿树搜索在冻结模型下递归精炼行为规范，解决输出耦合导致的“打地鼠”问题，在DevEval+上达94.9%解决率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冻结权重的编码智能体只能通过改进外部上下文提升性能。行为规范（自然语言代码文档）是重要外部上下文，但递归精炼规范时，程序实体相互依赖，改进一个实体的规范可能损害其他实体正确性，即输出耦合，形成局部改进引发其他回归的“打地鼠”效应，阻碍持续进步。

Method: 将自改进建模为循环：智能体根据当前规范生成代码，用执行验证测试评估，并基于失败精炼规范，改进后的规范再指导后续生成。提出SpecForge多前沿树搜索框架，包含三项机制：(i)Pareto引导状态选择，保留互补规范状态并避免过早承诺；(ii)依赖约束实体选择，优先被调用者先于调用者精炼；(iii)错误多样化扩展，使用不同测试失败子集探索多种精炼。

Result: 在DevEval+上，SpecForge在五种骨干模型上均取得最佳性能，使用Claude-4.5-Sonnet达94.9%解决率，较最强基线平均提升5.7个百分点。改进后的规范还能迁移至跨语言翻译和新功能实现任务，并优于基准提供的需求文档。

Conclusion: 递归自改进中，输出耦合是关键障碍；SpecForge通过Pareto状态选择、依赖约束实体选择与错误多样化扩展有效缓解该问题，在不更新模型权重的情况下显著提升编码智能体表现，且改进规范具有良好迁移性。

Abstract: Coding agents based on frozen language models can improve their performance by refining the external context they rely on, without updating model weights. We study recursive self-improvement through behavioral specifications: natural-language code documentation that describes the behavior of program entities and guides agents in generating correct code. We formulate a self-improvement loop in which an agent generates code from its current specifications, evaluates it with execution-verified tests, and refines the specifications based on observed failures. The improved specifications then guide subsequent generation, progressively improving the agent's understanding of the codebase. However, recursive refinement is challenging because program entities are interdependent. Improving the specification of one entity can inadvertently degrade the correctness of others, a phenomenon we call output coupling. This creates a whack-a-mole effect in which local improvements cause regressions elsewhere, preventing consistent progress. We introduce SpecForge, a multi-frontier tree search framework that addresses this challenge with three mechanisms: (i) Pareto-guided state selection preserves complementary specification states and prevents premature commitment; (ii) dependency-constrained entity selection prioritizes callee-before-caller refinement; and (iii) error-diversified expansion explores multiple refinements using different subsets of test failures. On DevEval+, SpecForge achieves the best performance across five backbone models, including a 94.9% solve rate with Claude-4.5-Sonnet and a 5.7-percentage-point average improvement over the strongest baseline. The improved specifications also make the agent better at tasks outside the loop: they transfer to cross-language translation and to new-feature implementation, where they outperform the benchmark-provided requirement documents.

</details>


### [604] [ASIWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in a Persistent Survival Sandbox](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14807)
*Jianfeng Lin,Runze Wang,Haorong Hong,Yuxuan Xie,Zeno Zeng,Zhongyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ASIWorld——一个持久化生存沙盒，用于评估自主智能体在长时交互中"将目标转化为连贯行动"的持续目标执行能力，并从任务结果、成就达成、生存代价与执行行为等维度进行综合评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估自主智能体不仅要看其能否完成任务，还需考察其在长时程交互中能否把目标转化为连贯行动。在持久化环境中，这要求智能体在不完整观测下协调相互依赖的动作、处理延迟效应，并随着早期决策改变后续机会而进行适应；而现有评估往往只关注最终任务结果，缺乏对实现过程的刻画。

Method: 作者构建了 ASIWorld 生存沙盒，结合持久化的世界与角色状态、以角色为范围的局部观测，以及可编程的异步接口来研究持续性目标执行。智能体可通过直接动作或"智能体编写的程序"（在模型调用之间持续运行）来完成相互依赖的生产与探索任务。评估涵盖任务成功、发展成就的达成、生存代价，并辅以对执行行为的分析；随后在统一 harness 下对九种智能体配置进行探索性研究。

Result: 在九种智能体配置的探索性研究中，八种完成了生产任务，六种同时完成两项任务。对执行轨迹及不同难度层级表现的分析显示，任务结果相近的配置在准备、战斗与恢复行为上存在差异；准备不足与进度停滞相关，而完成任务的配置在生存代价与额外成就标准的满足程度上也不相同。

Conclusion: 结果表明，评估持续目标执行应同时关注任务结果，以及实现结果所伴随的行为与代价；ASIWorld 提供了一种将结果指标与过程行为分析相结合的评估范式。

Abstract: Evaluating autonomous agents requires examining whether they can translate goals into coherent action across extended interactions. In persistent environments, this requires coordinating interdependent actions under incomplete observations, accounting for delayed effects, and adapting as earlier decisions shape subsequent opportunities. We introduce ASIWorld, a survival sandbox that combines persistent world and character state with character-scoped observations and a programmable asynchronous interface to study sustained goal execution. Agents pursue interdependent production and exploration tasks through direct actions or agent-authored programs that continue running between model calls. The evaluation assesses task success, the attainment of development achievements, and survival costs, complemented by an analysis of execution behavior. In an exploratory study of nine agent configurations using a common harness, eight complete the production task and six complete both tasks. Analyses of execution trajectories and performance across difficulty levels reveal different preparation, combat, and recovery behaviors among configurations with similar task outcomes. Incomplete preparation is associated with stalled progression, while configurations that complete the tasks differ in survival costs and the fulfillment of additional achievement criteria. These findings illustrate the value of assessing sustained goal execution through both task outcomes and the behaviors and costs associated with achieving them.

</details>


### [605] [A Reference Architecture for Integrating Agentic AI into Enterprise Software: Responsibilities, Interactions, and Variability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14818)
*Mingqin Yu,Fethi Rabhi,Liming Zhu,Qinghua Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向企业级智能体AI集成的技术中立参考架构，将架构能力归纳为十项职责，并定义边界不变量、类型化跨职责交互与可变点；通过ESG组合分析与交易前合规智能体案例及独立架构映射进行初步验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业软件集成智能体AI时涉及编排、知识记忆、模型访问、工具动作、安全、运行时基础设施与评估等多元架构关注点。现有研究与行业架构虽覆盖部分关注点，但在范围、抽象层次、职责组织、交互表示及能力假设上不一致，缺乏统一、技术中立的参考架构。

Method: 综合研究文献、行业架构指南与互操作规范，按架构目的提炼架构能力，组织为十项职责；定义边界不变量、类型化的跨职责交互，以及区分职责与条件依赖能力、可替换实现机制的可变点；将架构实例化为构建于既有面向服务ESG指标计算与报告系统之上的ESG组合分析与交易前合规智能体，并将一个独立发布的智能体架构映射到该职责体系。

Result: 案例实现十项职责中的七项；不同问题走不同交互路径，控制仅在其条件满足时激活，探测的边界不变量成立；独立架构可映射到所提职责而无需新增职责。部署与记录结果以复现包形式提供。

Conclusion: 结果为该架构的组织方式与适用性提供了初步证据，而非其完备性证据；后续需进一步验证职责覆盖的完整性与更广泛场景下的适用性。

Abstract: Agentic AI moves generative AI applications toward systems that coordinate reasoning, enterprise context, model inference, and external actions. Integrating these capabilities into enterprise software introduces diverse architectural concerns, from orchestration, knowledge and memory, and model access to tools and actions, security, runtime infrastructure, and evaluation. Existing research and industry architectures address many of these concerns but differ in scope, abstraction, responsibility organization, interaction representation, and assumptions about which capabilities are required. This paper presents a technology-neutral reference architecture for enterprise agentic AI integration. We synthesize architectural capabilities from research publications, industry architecture guidance, and interoperability specifications by architectural purpose, organize them into ten responsibilities, and define boundary invariants, typed cross-responsibility interactions, and variation points that distinguish responsibilities from condition-dependent capabilities and replaceable realization mechanisms. We instantiate the architecture as an ESG portfolio-analysis and pre-trade compliance agent over an existing service-oriented ESG metric computation and reporting system, and complement the case with a mapping of an independently published agentic architecture. The case realizes seven of the ten responsibilities; different questions take different interaction paths, controls activate only under their conditions, and the probed boundary invariants hold. The independent architecture maps onto the proposed responsibilities without requiring an additional one. These results provide initial evidence for the architecture's organization and applicability rather than its completeness. The deployment and recorded results are available as a replication package.

</details>


### [606] [Passing Tests, Missing Semantics: Evidence of Interpretive Lock-In in Plan-Based DataFrame Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15797)
*Jingjing,Liu,Dishu Yang,Hongbo Qin,Hansong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究揭示"解释性锁定"风险：在30个DataFrame任务上，自生成测试通过率虽从22/30升至30/30，但无一生成方案与参考输出匹配，测试成功并不代表语义正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规划与修订本应使生成代码更贴近任务规范，但错误的解释可能贯穿规划、实现与测试全过程（即"解释性锁定"）。作者旨在考察这一风险：即自生成测试日益"成功"是否真的等价于语义正确。

Method: 基于TPC Benchmark DS派生30个DataFrame任务，对比Frozen One-Pass、Test-Guided Revision与PlanAudit-Guided Revision三种流程；设置评估者对照（57例）；进行同引擎SQL重执行（30例参考）；在10个定向任务上做全新生成（30例）；并对失败案例做机制性分析。

Result: 测试通过数从22/30提升至29/30与30/30，但无任何生成方案匹配存储的参考输出；评估者对照57/57符合预期；SQL重执行复现28/30参考，而这些任务上77次测试通过运行全部未达成参考一致；PlanAudit在3/30任务上提升代码得分、11/30提升测试覆盖，但两项指标的中位配对变化均为零；失败原因包括测试遗漏需求、采用候选自定义schema、使用无区分性夹具、重复实现中的错误逻辑；定向全新生成得到0/30参考匹配、测试通过运行中25/25为假通过。

Conclusion: 结论具有诊断性而非因果性：各流程在反馈、接地、调用预算与编辑权限上存在差异，且仅用单一模型、每任务一次主生成；因未保留裁决前人工标注，评分者间一致性无法重建，机制分析仍属探索性。总体而言，即便排除不可复现参考，日益成功的自生成测试仍无法确立语义正确性。

Abstract: Planning and revision are intended to bring generated code closer to the task specification. Yet a mistaken interpretation can persist across the plan, implementation, and tests - a pattern we call interpretive lock-in. We investigate this risk on 30 DataFrame tasks derived from TPC Benchmark DS, comparing Frozen One-Pass, Test-Guided Revision, and PlanAudit-Guided Revision. Test-pass counts rose from 22/30 to 29/30 and 30/30, yet no generated solution matched its stored reference output. Evaluator controls returned the expected outcome in 57/57 cases. Same-engine SQL re-execution reproduced 28/30 references; all 77 test-passing runs on these tasks still failed reference agreement. PlanAudit-Guided Revision improved code scores on 3/30 tasks and test coverage on 11/30, but the median paired change was zero for both measures. Failure analysis revealed tests that omitted requirements, adopted candidate-defined schemas, used nondiscriminating fixtures, or repeated the implementation's incorrect logic. Fresh generation on ten targeted tasks produced 0/30 reference matches and 25/25 false passes among test-passing runs. These findings are diagnostic rather than causal: the pipelines differ in feedback, grounding, call budgets, and editing permissions, and the study uses one model and one primary generation per eligible task. Because pre-adjudication human labels were not retained, inter-rater agreement cannot be reconstructed and the mechanism analyses remain exploratory. Overall, increasingly successful self-generated tests did not establish semantic correctness, even after excluding unreproduced references.

</details>


### [607] [EvoCowork: A Benchmark for Real-World Office Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14828)
*Zhou Liu,Xingyan Chen,ZhaoYang Han,Zewei Pan,Zeli Su,Ningxin Pan,Xue Hu,Kaixiong Ting,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoCowork：面向办公多模态的240任务基准，固定模型权重，评估harness级递归自我改进，揭示反馈任务增益难以迁移到跨办公协同工作流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 办公工作流对自我改进智能体要求严格：交付物需正确、原生可编辑且相互一致。核心问题是反馈任务上的增益究竟反映可复用流程，还是任务特化修补，需要专门基准加以区分。

Method: 构建EvoCowork，含240个任务，覆盖演示、文档、表格与跨办公工作流四类模态；固定模型权重，仅演化harness。评测内容、原生结构、公式、跨文件一致性及视觉质量。协议分为反馈、修订选择与最终测试三阶段：先在单模态任务上学习，再在未见单模态任务与跨办公工作流上评估，采用统一初始harness与显式预算。

Result: 静态评估两模型四harness，最佳配置总分42.25，跨办公任务30.62。从相同MSA harness与GLM 5.3出发，ACE与AHE将域内分数分别提升4.90与2.64分，但跨办公分数仅变化+0.03与-1.72。

Conclusion: 提供反馈的文件类型上的增益未必迁移到协同工作流。EvoCowork显式区分二者，并记录harness演化的能力、迁移与成本。

Abstract: Office workflows are a demanding testbed for self-improving agents because their deliverables must be correct, natively editable, and mutually consistent. A central question is whether gains on feedback tasks reflect reusable procedures rather than task-specific fixes. We introduce EvoCowork, a 240-task benchmark for evaluating harness-level recursive self-improvement across four office modalities, with model weights held fixed. The benchmark covers presentations, documents, spreadsheets, and cross-office workflows, and scores submitted artifacts for content, native structure, formulas, cross-file consistency, and visual quality where needed. Its protocol separates feedback, revision selection, and final testing: methods learn from single-modality tasks, then are evaluated on unseen single-modality tasks and cross-office workflows under a shared initial harness and explicit budgets. In static evaluations of two models and four harnesses, the best configuration scores 42.25 overall and 30.62 on cross-office tasks. Starting from the same MSA harness with GLM 5.3, ACE and AHE improve in-domain scores by 4.90 and 2.64 points, respectively, but change cross-office scores by only +0.03 and -1.72. Thus, gains on the file types that provide feedback do not necessarily transfer to coordinated workflows. EvoCowork makes this distinction explicit while recording the capability, transfer, and cost of harness evolution. Code and task packages: https://github.com/DeepThinkingZhouLiu/cowork-evolution-benchmark.

</details>


### [608] [Pre-Registered Genesis Accounting for Recursive Self-Improvement: First Audited Operator-Genesis Events in a Physics-Discovery Runtime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14843)
*Wenbin Mao,Pei Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一套预注册的双层核算框架（M1/M2）以可审计地判定机器"自创机制"，并报告首个通过审计的M2起源事件：由组合搜索自创出无法用标准算子表达的平方反比算子 sq(inv(n))=1/n²（里德伯形式），在NIST氢巴尔末实测数据上取得held-out R²=1.0000000。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "递归自我改进"的主张容易被提出却难以被证伪：改进究竟来自复用设计者提供的机制，还是来自系统自主创作的机制，二者难以区分。因此需要一个可预注册、可审计的核算标准来度量并治理"机器自创机制"。

Method: 提出双层核算：M1统计设计者给定词表内的机器生成内容实例；M2统计机器自创的机制类型（注册进运行时自身词表的新算子，并附带留出验证证书）。采用深度受限的基本算子组合搜索，以真实NIST氢巴尔末谱线的留出R²为判据；审计中发现"自变量由被测定律反演构造"的协议缺陷，改用独立标签协议修复；并加入可审计的复利通道测量与盲测、去策展的起源考试。

Result: 主事件自创算子 sq(inv(n))=1/n²，留出R²=1.0000000，而最佳标准变换仅-0.546；外推到未见能级（用n≤7训练、预测n=8,9）相对误差约10⁻⁶，领先最佳标准算子四到六个数量级。第二事件独立复现开普勒速度定律 sqrt(inv(a))（JPL星历向量）。复利通道首次域级测量得到1.109倍精度比；盲测去策展起源考试的诚实计数为零。

Conclusion: 贡献在于对机器自创机制的度量与治理，而非搜索算法或重新发现的物理规律。两个事件证明系统具备"创作机制的能力"，但尚非自主起源。局限：考试由知晓教科书答案的智能体策展、触发为人工、语法由观察者注入；开普勒事件通过行审计，氢能隙在He II上可复现，证书具阈值稳定性。

Abstract: Claims of recursive self-improvement are easy to make and hard to falsify: did improvement come from re-using designer-provided mechanisms, or from mechanisms the system authored itself? We introduce a pre-registered, two-tier accounting: M1 counts machine-generated content instances within a designer-provided vocabulary, while M2 counts machine-authored mechanism types (new operators registered into the runtime's own vocabulary, with a held-out-validation certificate). We report the first audited M2 genesis events. In the primary event, depth-limited compositional search over elementary operators, judged by held-out R^2 on real NIST hydrogen Balmer measurements, produced the operator sq(inv(n)) = 1/n^2 -- the Rydberg-level form -- which no standard-library transform could express (held-out R^2: -0.546 best standard transform vs. 1.0000000 composed). A protocol flaw (independent variable built by inverting the very law under test) was caught in audit and repaired via an independent-label protocol; extrapolation to unseen levels (n=8,9 trained on n<=7) attains relative error ~10^-6, four to six orders beyond the best standard operator. A second event independently recovered sqrt(inv(a)) -- Kepler's velocity law -- from JPL ephemeris vectors. Also incorporated: an audited compounding channel (first domain-level measurement: 1.109x accuracy ratio on a real held-out domain) and blind, decurated genesis exams whose honest tally is zero. The Kepler event passes line audit; the hydrogen gap reproduces on He II; the certificate is threshold-stable. Against eleven prior systems, the contribution is the measurement and governance of machine-authored mechanisms, not the search algorithm or rediscovered physics. Limitations: exams were curated by agents who knew the textbook answer, triggers manual, grammar observer-injected; both events demonstrate capability to author, not yet autonomous genesis.

</details>


### [609] [Small but Mighty: Test Suites as Improvement Signals for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15964)
*Yutong Cheng,Wei Cheng,Wenchao Yu,Dawei Zhou,Haifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TeSearch：以测试反馈作为可执行信号，用质量-多样性进化算法搜索"小而强"的测试套件，为自演化智能体提供稠密且信息量高的改进信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自演化智能体改写自身harness后需判断哪些改写应保留，改进信号即为改写必须通过的检查。智能体rollout验证代价高且主观；仓库自带测试等可执行检查太稀疏，仅能拒绝约四分之一的改变行为的改写，信号不够稠密和有效。

Method: 以测试反馈作为可执行信号，用质量-多样性进化算法（TeSearch）搜索既小又强的测试套件。TeSearch将套件规模作为行为描述符，使每个规模上都追求质量，从而可达"小而强"的套件；并在搜索过程中学习转移核，对LLM作为该描述符上执行器的行为去噪。

Result: 在129个真实模块与三种骨干模型上，TeSearch给出的测试套件质量优于所有对比方法（包括LLM驱动的进化搜索），且在所有基于LLM的方法中套件最小。作为自演化智能体的改进信号时，它以4.0%虚警率和每次决策3.5秒的代价，拒绝59.9%改变行为的改写，而仓库自带测试仅25.3%。

Conclusion: TeSearch通过质量-多样性搜索获得小且强的测试套件，显著提升自演化智能体改进信号的稠密度与判别力，成本低且开源可用。

Abstract: A self-evolving agent rewrites its own harness and must decide which rewrites to keep, so its improvement signal is the check a rewrite has to pass. Verifying a rewrite by agent rollout is expensive and subjective, while executable checks such as the repository's own tests are too sparse to catch behavior-changing rewrites, rejecting only a quarter of them. We instead take test feedback as the executable signal, and search for test suites that are both small and strong with a quality-diversity evolutionary algorithm, so that the signal is dense and informative. TeSearch treats suite size as a behavior descriptor, so that quality is pursued at every size and a small, strong suite is reachable, and learns a transition kernel during the search that denoises the LLM as an actuator on that descriptor. Across 129 real-world modules and three backbones, TeSearch delivers the highest-quality suites of any method compared, LLM-driven evolutionary search included, and the smallest of any LLM-based one. Used as the improvement signal of a self-evolving agent, it rejects 59.9% of behavior-changing rewrites against 25.3% for the repository's tests, at a 4.0% false-alarm rate and 3.5 s per decision. The code and data are available at https://github.com/ccsnow127/TeSearch.

</details>


### [610] [PEAM: On-device Communication Agent for Personalized, Efficient and Autonomous Mobile Network Configuration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14855)
*Haowen Wan,Shangzhuo Xie,Syue-Ju Syue,Xianyue Wu,Runhua Li,Qianqian Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出PEAM，一种基于端侧LLM的通信智能体，可自主生成毫秒级可执行的个性化网络配置规则，采用规则生成（空闲期批量分析并反思）与规则执行两阶段设计，4B微调模型实现99.13%配置正确率、92.50%规则有效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动端小型LLM推动端侧自主决策（如移动GUI智能体），但网络配置等决策需满足严格时延约束以保障用户体验；传统专家规则方法适应性差、准确性有限。

Method: 首先用人工标注的真实用户数据构建数据集，微调端侧LLM以注入通信知识。运行分两阶段：（1）规则生成阶段，在设备空闲（如夜间）时批量分析历史网络配置记录，跨批次反思以整合一致证据、降低局部偏差、导出稳健规则，并基于高置信度规则构建用户画像以捕捉网络偏好，注入每轮生成循环；（2）规则执行阶段，在通信上下文变化（切换应用、连接条件变化）时触发，检索规则库并执行相应规则。

Result: 基于微调4B模型的PEAM实现99.13%的网络配置决策正确率，生成规则中92.50%有效；相比传统专家规则方法分别高出4.41%和84.50%。

Conclusion: PEAM通过LLM驱动的两阶段规则生成与执行机制，在满足毫秒级时延约束的同时显著提升网络配置的准确性与规则有效性，验证了端侧LLM通信智能体的可行性。

Abstract: The growing deployment of compact large language models on smartphones is enabling autonomous on-device decision-making, such as emerging mobile GUI agents. However, many mobile decisions, such as network configuration when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, must satisfy stringent latency constraints to preserve user experience. In this paper, we propose PEAM, an on-device LLM-based communication agent that autonomously generates personalized network-configuration rules executable within milliseconds. Specifically, PEAM first fine-tune the on-device LLM with a dataset constructed from manually annotated real-user data to integrate the communication knowledge into the local model. PEAM then operates in two phases. In the rule-generation phase, which is performed when the device is idle, such as overnight, PEAM analyzes historical network-configuration records in batches and reflects across batches to consolidate consistent evidence, reduce local bias, and derive robust configuration rules. To enable more accurate and stable rule generation over time, PEAM further constructs a user profile from high-confidence rules to capture the user's network preferences and incorporates this profile into each rule-generation cycle. In the rule-execution phase, PEAM is invoked when the communication context changes, such as when users switch apps or connectivity conditions change, and searches the rule library to identify and execute the appropriate rule. Experiments demonstrate that PEAM, based on a fine-tuned 4B model, achieves 99.13% correct network configuration decisions, while 92.50% of the rules generated by PEAM are valid, outperforming the traditional expert-rule based method by 4.41% and 84.50%, respectively.

</details>


### [611] [EvoWeb: A Benchmark for Coding Agents on Evolving Web Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16402)
*David Nukrai,Bar Alon,Nativ Levy,Ido Andrew Atad,Ido Cohen,Itamar Zimerman,Lior Wolf,Eli David,Ilan Naiman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EvoWeb 基准：32 个 Web 应用、320 个累积请求，用多模态 Agent 在真实浏览器中测试持续演进的代码库，评估长程多请求开发能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Web 生成基准主要针对固定规格的一次性开发进行评测，而真实 Web 开发是通过连续请求不断扩展已有实现的迭代过程，二者的评测目标存在偏差，缺乏面向长程、多请求演进式开发的基准。

Method: 构建 EvoWeb 基准，包含 32 个 Web 应用上的 320 个累积请求，源自真实产品功能并以功能依赖图组织。Agent 迭代修改持久化代码库，由多模态 Web Agent 在实时浏览器中测试每个中间版本，评估新请求功能、跨请求集成能力与历史功能保持情况。不设固定停止准则，而是跨用户容忍阈值整合轨迹表现来刻画可靠性。

Result: 在开源与闭源前沿模型上的实验显示，EvoWeb 能清晰区分模型能力差异，其中跨请求集成是关键挑战；依赖更深或数量更多的后续请求准确率更低，且随请求推进运行时错误发生频率上升。

Conclusion: EvoWeb 为评估和改进 coding agent 在长程、多请求开发场景中的表现提供了测试平台。

Abstract: Web application development often proceeds through successive requests that extend an existing implementation. Yet web-generation benchmarks primarily evaluate development toward fixed specifications. We introduce EvoWeb, a novel benchmark comprising 320 cumulative requests over 32 web applications, grounded in real-world product features and structured by functional dependency graphs. Agents iteratively modify a persistent codebase, while a multimodal web agent tests each intermediate application in a live browser, assessing newly requested functionality, cross-request integration, and previously requested functionality. To characterize reliability throughout development, we integrate trajectory performance across user-tolerance thresholds rather than impose a fixed stopping criterion. Experiments across open- and closed-source frontier models show that EvoWeb reveals clear performance differences between models, with cross-request integration emerging as a key challenge. Further analysis shows that later requests with deeper or more numerous dependencies are solved less accurately, while runtime errors become more frequent over successive requests. EvoWeb provides a testbed for evaluating and improving coding agents in long-horizon, multi-request development.

</details>


### [612] [WeatherBridge: Forecast-Aware Multi-Source Input Adaptation for Pretrained Weather Forecasting Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14863)
*Mutian Xi,Xinyu Su,Xiaohui Zhong,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出WeatherBridge，一种源条件自适应的输入适配器，将异构业务NWP初始状态映射至ERA5参考状态，在不更新预训练预报模型的前提下改善自回归预报。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驱动天气预报模型通常在ERA5上训练，但业务部署必须使用来自物理NWP系统的实时初始状态，其分布与ERA5差异显著。直接用这些状态初始化会导致自回归预报性能退化，因此需要在不改动预训练预报模型的情况下进行输入适配。

Method: WeatherBridge采用Swin-UNet预测结构化残差修正，并在多个空间尺度注入源嵌入以同时捕捉共享大气结构与源特有差异。训练目标结合纬度加权ERA5重建损失与One-step Rollout Alignment（ORA），后者将单步预报误差通过冻结的FuXi模型反向传播，使适配状态兼顾初始状态保真度与下游预报兼容性。

Result: 在2025年1月1日至11月22日期间，使用GFS、HRES、CMA每日初始化数据，覆盖6个变量、最长240小时预见期进行评估。相比FuXi的原始源初始化，WeatherBridge在18个源-变量组合中的17个降低了6–240小时滚动预报的平均RMSE，中位降幅10.2%，最大降幅46.3%。用冻结FuXi训练的适配器在GFS输入上也提升了FengWu预报，且无需重训适配器或FengWu。

Conclusion: 预报感知的输入适配能够改善来自异构业务NWP输入的预报，并可跨基于ERA5预训练的预报模型迁移。

Abstract: Data-driven weather forecasting models are commonly trained on ERA5, yet operational deployment must use timely initial states from physics-based numerical weather prediction (NWP) systems whose distributions differ substantially from ERA5. Direct initialization with these states can degrade autoregressive forecasts, motivating input adaptation that keeps the pretrained forecasting model unchanged. Here, we introduce WeatherBridge, a unified, source-conditioned adapter that maps heterogeneous operational NWP initial states to ERA5 reference states without updating the pretrained forecasting model. WeatherBridge predicts the structured residual corrections with a Swin-UNet and injects source embeddings across multiple spatial scales, allowing the model to capture shared atmospheric structure and source-specific discrepancies. Its training objective combines latitude-weighted ERA5 reconstruction with One-step Rollout Alignment (ORA), which backpropagates one-step forecast error through a frozen FuXi model to optimize the adapted states for both initial state fidelity and downstream forecast compatibility. We evaluate WeatherBridge using daily GFS, HRES, and CMA initializations from 1 January to 22 November 2025 across six variables and lead times up to 240 hours. Relative to raw source initialization of FuXi, WeatherBridge reduces the mean RMSE of FuXi over the 6- 240-hour rollout for 17 of 18 source-variable combinations, with a median reduction of 10.2% and a maximum reduction of 46.3%.
