A key structural contribution is our temporal partition rule, which strictly excludes reviews predating the most recent inspection to prevent superseded signals from skewing current risk. Evaluating CIR on 9,505 routine inspections in Santa Clara County, California (2024-2026), we show that history-based scoring alone reduces mean time-to-detection of major violations by 69 days (20.9%) under a 30% inspection budget, but fails to anticipate severe vermin-related closures (0/8 detected). Incorporating post-inspection review signals drastically improves performance, predicting 7 of 8 vermin closures with an average lead time of 117 days-firing on the exact day of review publication in four instances. Introducing a review corroboration rule improves precision from 0.70 to 0.78 without loss of recall. Finally, we analyze critical implementation challenges, documenting a data-hygiene pitfall (stale review leakage across inspection boundaries) and an evaluation limitation involving unobserved facility self-remediation. This work provides the first case-level evaluation of event-driven inspection triggering using open data and provides a reproducible benchmark for review-augmented public health systems

</details>


### [646] [SocraticRepair: Planning-Guided Socratic Tutoring for Program Debugging and Misconception Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15204)
*Mykhailo Kopytskyi,Jianhua Yang,Mir Seyedebrahimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 SocraticRepair——一种规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导框架，用于程序调试与误解修复，通过微调 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 实现，在分步脚手架与提问质量上优于通用 LLM，并显著减少过早给出答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在计算机教育中应用日益广泛，但其教学能力受限：倾向于过早揭示解决方案，且容易偏离学习者当前的调试目标。

Method: 借鉴规划引导式辅导工作，构建 SocraticRepair 框架；在 Python 编程领域，基于四个预处理编程数据集构建合成多轮辅导对话，对 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct 进行微调；使用一组预定义的独立指标评估，并与通用 LLM 进行对比基准测试。

Result: SocraticRepair 在分步脚手架与提问质量指标上得分更高，同时大幅降低过早披露解决方案的情况；结果也指出可靠的教学计划生成仍是重要挑战。

Conclusion: 规划引导的苏格拉底式辅导能有效提升 LLM 的调试教学表现，但教学计划的可靠生成是未来需解决的关键问题。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used in computer science education. However, the teaching abilities of even the most powerful LLMs are limited: they tend to reveal the solution prematurely and may lose focus on the learner's current debugging objective. To address this, we introduce SocraticRepair, a planning-guided Socratic tutoring framework for program debugging and miscon- ception repair that adapts prior planning-guided tutoring work (Li et al., 2026b). The framework is instantiated in the Python programming domain by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct on synthetic multi-turn tutoring dialogues constructed from four preprocessed programming datasets. The system is evaluated using a predefined set of independent metrics and benchmarked against a general-purpose LLM. The experiments show that SocraticRepair achieves higher scores on stepwise scaffolding and question quality while also substantially reducing premature solution disclosure. The results also identify reliable pedagogical plan generation as an important remaining challenge.

</details>


### [647] [Running Fewer Loops Removes Refusal Behaviour in Recurrent-Depth Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15218)
*Seyedarmin Azizi,Erfan Baghaei Potraghloo,Arya Fayyazi,Saeid Shokoufa,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 循环深度语言模型在推理时可减少循环次数以降低开销，但这会不成比例地削弱安全性：Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 在训练深度一半时数学准确率保留89%，而对有害请求的协助率却升高5.3倍。该安全损失并非信息丢失（有害性仍可从内部状态线性解码），而是缺失了拒绝行为；逐请求选深度等运行时补救无效，而在随机深度上训练可从源头恢复安全性且不损全深度精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环深度语言模型可在推理时按需选择循环次数（loops），减少循环更便宜更快，部署方因此有动机这么做。但作者发现，减少循环会降低模型安全性，且安全性损失幅度超过所测量的其他任何能力损失。其动机是揭示这一被忽视的部署风险，诊断其机理，并寻找有效修复方案。

Method: 作者在四个已发布的 Ouro 检查点及 Huginn-0125 上，通过改变推理时的循环次数构建不同深度模型，并用四种测量工具（其一完全不生成文本）评估能力与安全性。采用线性分类器从单循环后的内部状态探针有害性，并通过在全深度内部状态中移除单个方向来定位缺失机制。对比两类补救方案：运行时修复（早退规则、逐请求选深度）与训练修复（随机深度训练 vs 标准安全训练），并跨模型族复现。

Result: 在半训练深度下，Ouro-1.4B-Thinking 仍解出0.692的GSM8K数学题（全深度0.775，保留89%准确率），但对有害请求的协助率从0.038升至0.205（5.3倍）。信息未丢失：单循环后线性分类器判别请求是否有害达 ROC AUC 0.967（全深度0.986），缺失的是应有的拒绝。全深度移除单一方向可使拒绝率从0.950降至0.130。运行时补救无效：早退规则不会对有害请求多花循环，逐请求选深度也无法恢复损失。训练补救有效：标准安全训练仅在拒绝0.865无害请求下才使浅层模型安全，而随机深度训练在一个循环时达到+0.399的有害/无害拒绝分离度（对比+0.118）；在 Huginn-0125 上，1至32循环各深度有害协助率≤0.040，标准训练则达0.194，且全深度精度无损。

Conclusion: 循环深度模型的安全性对推理时循环次数高度敏感，减少循环带来的安全退化是机制性的拒绝行为缺失，而非有害性信息丢失。运行时修复（早退、逐请求选深度）无法弥补，因模型内部并无针对有害请求增加计算的倾向；唯一有效途径是改进训练，在随机深度上训练可显著提升浅层安全性、获得更大的有害/无害拒绝分离度，并在不牺牲全深度精度的前提下跨模型族复现。

Abstract: A recurrent-depth language model reuses one block of weights several times in a row. The number of repetitions, which we call loops, is chosen when the model runs, not when it is trained, and running fewer is cheaper and faster, so a deployment may choose to do it. Running fewer loops also makes these models less safe, and the loss of safety is larger than the loss of anything else we measured. We study four released Ouro checkpoints and Huginn-0125. At half of its trained depth, Ouro-1.4B-Thinking still solves 0.692 of the GSM8K maths problems, against 0.775 at full depth, keeping 89% of its accuracy. Over the same reduction, the rate at which it helps with harmful requests rises from 0.038 to 0.205, 5.3 times higher. The information is not lost: a linear classifier reads whether a request is harmful from the model's internal state after a single loop, with an ROC AUC of 0.967 against 0.986 at full depth. What the missing loops remove is the refusal that should follow. We measure the effect with four instruments, one generating no text at all, and reproduce it on a second model family. Removing a single direction from Ouro-1.4B's internal state at full depth drops its refusal rate on harmful prompts from 0.950 to 0.130, identifying what the shallow model is missing. Two run-time repairs do not help: the models' early-exit rules do not spend more loops on harmful requests, and choosing a depth per request does not recover the loss. Changing the training does. Standard safety training makes the shallow model safe only by refusing 0.865 of harmless requests, while training at randomly chosen depths reaches a separation of +0.399 between harmful and harmless refusal at one loop, against +0.118. On Huginn-0125 it keeps harmful help at or below 0.040 at every depth from 1 to 32 loops, where standard training reaches 0.194, and it costs no accuracy at full depth.

</details>


### [648] [HarnessNet: Feedback-driven Hierarchical Joint Harness Evolution for Multi-agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15221)
*Zhaoyuan Qiu,Sachith Seneviratne,Yu Xia,Saman Halgamuge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HarnessNet，一种多智能体系统中的分层harness演化框架，以Agentron为基本单元，通过分层图反向传播环境反馈，将联合harness演化分解为局部协调的子任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有harness演化研究多聚焦单智能体，多智能体系统中的联合harness演化尚待探索。单一全局优化器在系统规模扩大时面临上下文与工作量增长问题，且访问限制可能阻碍共享智能体内部信息或系统级反馈。

Method: Agentron由可演化的前向harness、基础模型和局部优化器组成，局部优化器仅能观测和修改该harness。多个Agentron构成分层图，环境反馈沿图反向传播，上游优化器接收来自下游层的节点特定反馈，从而将联合harness演化分解为上下文分离、协调的小任务。

Result: 在AgentBench上使用多个基础模型的实验表明HarnessNet可训练；相比单一全局优化器，在保持局部隐私的前提下取得相当的性能提升，且每次优化器调用所需token与时间更少。迁移研究表明，替换基础模型后演化出的harness仍保持联合有效性，具有跨模型可迁移性。

Conclusion: HarnessNet通过分层局部优化实现多智能体harness协同演化，在性能、隐私保护、计算效率与跨模型迁移性方面具有优势，为MAS中的可扩展harness演化提供了可行方案。

Abstract: AI agents can evolve by using environment feedback to revise their harnesses, the software managing model inputs, tool use, memory, and execution, while keeping foundation models frozen. Existing studies focus on single agents, leaving joint harness evolution in multi-agent systems (MAS) underexplored. A single global optimizer faces growing context and workload as the system scales, while access restrictions may prevent sharing agent internals or system-wide feedback. We propose HarnessNet, a framework for hierarchical harness evolution in MAS. Its basic unit, Agentron, comprises an evolvable forward harness, a foundation model, and a local optimizer that can observe and modify only that harness. Agentrons form a layered graph through which environment feedback propagates backward, with upstream optimizers receiving node-specific feedback from the downstream layer. This decomposes joint harness evolution into smaller, coordinated tasks with separate contexts, reducing individual optimizers' context and workload while keeping access local. Optimizers need not access all agent trajectories or raw environment feedback. Experiments on AgentBench with multiple foundation models demonstrate the feasibility of training HarnessNet. Compared with a single global optimizer, HarnessNet achieves comparable performance gains while respecting local privacy and requiring fewer tokens and less time per optimizer call. A migration study shows that the evolved harnesses remain jointly effective after replacing the foundation models, suggesting transferability across models.

</details>


### [649] [Understanding Unified VLMs: From Attention Probing to Guidance Tuning for Multimodal Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15227)
*Zhengyang Luo,Xiaoyu Qiu,Zhiheng Tan,Yuchen Liang,Yingbin Liang,Liyue Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过探测统一视觉-语言模型（VLM）的注意力头对条件变化的敏感度，发现条件敏感头与条件无关头在T2I和I2T两个方向上表现出一致且稳定的功能分工，并据此提出免训练的推理期引导方法HeadTuned-CFG。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一VLM以共享Transformer主干同时完成T2I与I2T生成，但主干如何在不同方向上处理条件信息仍缺乏理解。作者希望从条件引导（classifier-free guidance, CFG）的视角揭示其内部机制，并据此改进推理。

Method: 对每个注意力头进行探测，度量CFG两条分支（不同条件引导）之间的激活差异，从而识别条件敏感头与条件无关头；在自回归与掩码扩散两种范式的两个统一VLM上验证该模式。基于探测得到的条件变化感知，提出HeadTuned-CFG，在注意力头级别选择并调节条件引导，无需额外训练。

Result: 探测显示存在一部分对条件变化更敏感的注意力头，其余对条件不敏感；该模式在T2I与I2T中均成立，且跨数据样本基本稳定。HeadTuned-CFG在两个生成方向上均带来一致收益，在T2I上相较强基线提升显著。

Conclusion: 统一VLM内部存在注意力头层面的功能专化，是模型的内在属性；利用该性质可在推理期无训练地提升统一多模态生成性能。

Abstract: Unified vision-language models (VLMs) perform both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) generation with one shared Transformer backbone, yet how the backbone processes the condition in either direction remains poorly understood. We study this question from the perspective of conditional guidance: we probe every attention head to show the activation difference between two branches of classifier-free guidance (CFG) with different conditional guidance. On two unified VLMs of autoregressive and masked-diffusion paradigms, the probing reveals a subset of heads that are more sensitive to the change of condition while others are agnostic to it. This characteristic pattern holds in both T2I and I2T generation and is largely stable across data samples, demonstrating the internal mechanism of unified VLMs. Motivated by this, we propose a new inference-time intervention approach for unified multimodal generation, named \textit{HeadTuned-CFG}, which uses the probed condition-change awareness to select and tune the conditional guidance at the attention-head level. Experiments show consistent benefits in both multimodal generation directions of unified VLMs without additional training, and in particular substantial improvements over strong baselines in T2I generation. These results further support the key finding of our probing analysis: the observed pattern of functional specialization is an intrinsic property of unified VLMs.

</details>


### [650] [Words to World: Benchmarking LLMs in Interactive Physical Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15228)
*Xinnan Dai,Kaiqi Yang,Yaxin Li,Cheng Luo,Wanli Li,Mingqing Xiao,Xinyang Jiang,Daoan Zhang,Kaitao Song,Fengze Liu,Zefan Cai,Caihua Shan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于评估大语言模型（LLM）闭环物理交互能力的基准，模型通过控制连接真实机械臂、摄像头和传感器的执行系统完成任务，需指令下达、物理反馈、状态理解与自适应调整。实验揭示LLM将语言推理转化为物理行动的能力及常见失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多通过静态文本响应、离线工具调用或模拟任务评估LLM，无法反映其在真实物理环境中的行动能力。随着LLM开始调用工具、操作设备并做出影响物理世界的决策，亟需衡量其闭环物理交互水平的系统性基准。

Method: 构建一个闭环物理交互基准：模型控制连接真实世界组件（机械臂、摄像头、传感器）的执行系统（harness）。每个任务中模型需下达指令、接收环境物理反馈、解读状态并据此调整下一步动作。评估维度涵盖具身感知、行动规划、工具选择、空间推理、反馈驱动纠错及执行不确定性鲁棒性。

Result: 通过代表性LLM实验，刻画了其将语言推理转化为物理行动的能力，并识别出典型失败模式，包括状态变化幻觉、对意外结果恢复能力差以及长时程规划不稳定。

Conclusion: 该基准为评估LLM作为连接语言、工具与物理世界的交互式智能体提供了系统性基础。

Abstract: Words are increasingly becoming an interface for action: large language models (LLMs) can now invoke tools, operate devices, and make decisions that affect the physical world. However, current benchmarks largely evaluate LLMs through static text responses, offline tool calls, or simulated tasks, leaving open the question of how well they can act in real physical environments. We present a benchmark for measuring LLMs in closed-loop physical interaction, where models control a harness system connected to real-world components including robotic arms, cameras, and sensors. In each task, the model must issue instructions, receive physical feedback from the environment, interpret the resulting state, and adapt its next action accordingly. This setting evaluates capabilities beyond language understanding, including grounded perception, action planning, tool selection, spatial reasoning, feedback-driven correction, and robustness to execution uncertainty. Through experiments with representative LLMs, we characterize their ability to translate linguistic reasoning into physical actions and identify common failure modes such as hallucinated state changes, poor recovery from unexpected outcomes, and unstable long-horizon plans. Our benchmark aims to provide a systematic foundation for evaluating LLMs as interactive agents that connect words, tools, and the physical world.

</details>


### [651] [Using Evidence-Centered Design to Guide Prompt Engineering in Measurement: An Illustration with Automated Essay Scoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15231)
*Jiawei Xiong,Cheng Tang,Hong Jiao,Hanna Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出以证据中心设计（ECD）作为教育场景中提示工程的原则性框架，将ECD的学生模型、证据模型、任务模型映射到提示设计组件，并通过自动评分任务的实证研究验证其优于SOTA提示基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI（尤其是LLM）已广泛用于教育中的题目生成、自动评分与反馈，但输出质量不仅取决于模型，还取决于用户如何构造提示。当前提示工程多为临时性、试错式实践，缺乏原则性设计，导致构念误表、构念无关变异、可复现性有限等效度威胁。作者由此提出用教育测量中的ECD框架为提示工程提供结构化基础。

Method: 将ECD的三个核心模型——学生模型、证据模型、任务模型——映射到教育提示设计的各组件；据此描述一套基于ECD的提示工程工作流；从该映射中提炼出五条设计原则；并开展实证研究，在自动评分任务上对比ECD设计的提示与当前最优（SOTA）提示基线。

Result: 实证研究表明该框架在自动评分任务上具有实用价值，ECD设计的提示相较SOTA提示基线表现出优势，支持其提升AI生成教育输出的效度、信度与公平性。

Conclusion: 将提示工程视为测评设计而非非正式指令，能够增强AI生成教育输出的效度、信度与公平性；ECD为教育场景中的提示工程提供了可操作的原则性基础。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) models, particularly large language models (LLMs), are increasingly used in educational settings for tasks such as item generation, automated scoring, and feedback delivery. The quality of these outputs depends not only on the AI model but also on how users construct the prompts that guide model behaviors. Current prompt engineering practices are largely ad hoc, relying on trial and error rather than principled design. This lack of structure introduces validity threats including construct misrepresentation, construct-irrelevant variance, and limited reproducibility. We propose that Evidence-Centered Design (ECD), a framework in educational measurement for structuring valid inferences from observed performance, can serve as a principled foundation for prompt engineering in educational applications. We map the three core ECD models, the student model, the evidence model, and the task model, onto the components of educational prompt design, and describe a workflow for ECD-based prompt engineering. We derive five design principles from this mapping and present an empirical study contrasting ECD-designed prompts with state-of-the-art (SOTA) prompting baselines on an automated scoring task. Our empirical study demonstrates the usefulness of this framework on automated scoring. Results suggest that treating prompting as assessment design rather than informal instructions strengthens the validity, reliability, and fairness of AI-generated educational outputs.

</details>


### [652] [MoMaTune: Model, Match, Then Tune Language Models for Numerical Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15235)
*Weimin Lyu,Jingfen Zhang,Lingdao Sha,Peng sun,Xiaowei Chen,Vincent Gao,Rui Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出两阶段后训练策略MoMaTune（Model-Match-Tune），通过大规模无标签序列化记录的密集下一词预测与同记录一致性对齐，弥补数值数据中值内敏感性和跨字段依赖的监督缺口，再经下游监督微调，在169,285条记录八个数据集上显著提升掩码值填充与正确上下文指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解码器语言模型在数值数据上持续出现显著失败。数值样本通常以"特征名:值"（如fat:3.4）拼接序列化为文本，而常规任务适配仅对下游预测目标施加损失，导致两类结构监督薄弱：一是值内敏感性（数位位置决定数值大小），因词元交叉熵缺乏显式数值度量而未被监督；二是跨字段结构（同一记录内各测量值统计相关），因仅目标微调未对测量值及其依赖施加直接损失而未被监督。作者旨在围绕这两个监督缺口设计训练策略。

Method: MoMaTune（Model, Match, then Tune）两阶段后训练策略。第一阶段Model：在无标签序列化记录上进行密集的普通下一词预测；可选加入Match：同记录一致性目标，对齐同一示例不同部分视图的表示。第二阶段Tune：针对下游目标预测进行监督微调。在八个公开数据集169,285条记录上评估，340个输入字段中339个为数值型。

Result: 在1.5B参数下，Model将八数据集掩码值填充聚合指标从0.106提升至0.401，三数据集正确上下文增益从0.058升至0.167。诊断显示Model提升了对数值相关数位变化的敏感性，Match提升了对信息性部分视图的鲁棒性。加入Tune后，每个Stage-1父模型的目标监督嵌入聚合指标均提高，两阶段配方聚合得分高于单独Tune。在4B、9.6B、27B参数下使用模型嵌入进行下游预测时观察到相同模式。

Conclusion: 围绕值内敏感性与跨字段结构两个监督缺口设计的两阶段后训练（Model、Match、Tune）能有效提升解码器语言模型在数值数据上的表示质量与下游表现，且该增益在不同规模模型上具有一致性。

Abstract: Despite remarkable progress in language understanding and generation, decoder language models continue to exhibit striking failures on numerical data. Numerical examples are typically serialized as text by concatenating feature names with their values (e.g., fat:3.4), while conventional task adaptation applies loss only to the downstream prediction target. This leaves two structures weakly supervised: within-value sensitivity, where digit position determines numerical magnitude, because token cross-entropy contains no explicit numerical metric; and across-field structure, where measurements in the same record are statistically dependent, because target-only tuning provides no direct loss on the measurements or their dependencies. We introduce MoMaTune (Model, Match, then Tune), a two-stage post-training strategy organized around these supervision gaps. Stage 1 applies Model, ordinary next-token prediction densely over label-free serialized records, and optionally adds Match, a same-record consistency objective that aligns representations of different partial views of the same example. Stage 2 applies Tune, supervised fine-tuning for downstream target prediction. We evaluate MoMaTune on 169,285 records from eight public datasets, with 339 of 340 input fields numerical. At 1.5B parameters, Model raises the eight-dataset masked-value imputation aggregate from 0.106 to 0.401, while the three-dataset correct-context gain rises from 0.058 to 0.167. On diagnostics, Model also increases sensitivity to numerically consequential digit changes, while Match improves robustness to informative partial views. Adding Tune yields higher target-supervised embedding aggregates for each tested Stage-1 parent, and the two-stage recipes obtain higher aggregate scores than Tune alone. The same pattern is observed at 4B, 9.6B, and 27B parameters when model embeddings are used for downstream prediction.

</details>


### [653] [ClinEdge: An Expert-Graded Benchmark of Real Patient Edge Cases Where Frontier Multimodal Models Fail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15239)
*Anurag Sharma,Aditya Sharma,Sapna Baalwan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ClinEdge 用 32 个真实脱敏病例（每例配原始影像与简短病史，含"反模式匹配"特征，以患者实际临床病程为金标准）对 7 个前沿系统进行 224 次专家评分，两级专家评审（1 名资深骨科外科医生初评 + 19 名医师复核）。结果显示所有系统表现均差且失败模式高度共享，归纳出 5 大类 18 种反复出现的失败模式；开放 4 例、保留 28 例，邀请前沿实验室和医疗 AI 公司参与评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学大模型基准多来自执业考试与理论题，少数使用真实临床数据的也仅为部分使用，且很少要求模型阅读患者本人影像。为弥补这一缺口，需要构建基于真实临床实践、以影像与患者实际病程为核心的评测套件。该套件强调深度而非规模，旨在暴露模型在真实临床推理中的系统性问题。

Method: 构建 ClinEdge：32 个来自活跃临床实践的真实脱敏病例，每例将主要影像与简短病史（vignette）配对，并包含已知可击败模式匹配推理的特征，评分对照患者有记录的临床病程。7 个前沿系统通过其公开接口评测，共 224 次专家评分。评分采用两级专家流程：先由 1 名资深骨科外科医生按加权评分表给出评分与通过/不通过判定；再由 19 名医师组成的小组（多为教学医学院的资深专科医生）独立复核每一病例及全部 224 项评分。全部 224 段对话以可回放链接保存。

Result: 所有系统表现均差，且失败具有共性：不同厂商遗漏相同发现、收敛到相同的错误方案。专家记录归纳出 5 大类、18 种反复出现的失败模式，包括：读到影像第一个发现即停止；给出泛化方案并倾向过度治疗；信任误导性病史而忽视正确影像；答案在不同系统与不同运行间波动，并随提问格式改变；错误答案表述流畅且未表达任何不确定性。

Conclusion: 医学大模型在真实临床影像推理上仍存在系统性、跨厂商共有的缺陷，且失败以流畅、自信的形式呈现，缺乏不确定性表达。ClinEdge 采取"深度优先"策略：公开 4 个完整病例，保留 28 个作为留出集，邀请前沿 AI 实验室与医疗 AI 公司提交模型进行评测（联系 research@futrbridge.com），以推动真实临床场景下的模型评估与改进。

Abstract: Most benchmarks for large language models in medicine are built from licensing examinations and theoretical questions. The few that draw on real clinical data do so only in part, and rarely require a model to read a patient's own imaging. ClinEdge addresses this gap with 32 real, de-identified patient cases from active clinical practice, each evaluated across seven frontier systems for a total of 224 expert-graded evaluations. Each case pairs primary imaging with a short vignette, contains a feature known to defeat pattern-matched reasoning, and is scored against the patient's documented clinical course. The suite is built for depth rather than volume. Grading followed a two-stage expert process. First, a senior orthopaedic surgeon graded all 224 responses on a weighted rubric and a pass-or-fail verdict. Second, a panel of nineteen physicians, largely senior specialists at teaching medical colleges, independently reviewed every case and every one of the 224 grades. All seven production systems were evaluated through their public interfaces, and all 224 conversations are preserved as replayable links.
  Performance was poor across all systems, and the failures were shared: different vendors missed the same findings and converged on the same wrong plans. From the experts' notes we catalogue 18 recurring failure modes in five families. The models stop reading an image at the first finding. They give generic plans and lean toward over-treatment. They trust a misleading history over correct imaging. Their answers vary across systems and runs, and change with question format. Failing answers were delivered fluently and without any expressed uncertainty. Four cases are released in full; the remaining 28 are held out, and we invite frontier AI labs and healthcare AI companies to evaluate their models against them (research@futrbridge.com)

</details>


### [654] [RECAP: Calibrating Low-Bit Reasoning Models on the History They Read](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15259)
*Chi Ruan,Yujie Chen,Zixiang Zhao,Jingcai Guo,Haotong Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RECAP后训练量化方法，通过动态前缀校准与前缀读取几何，在低比特下显著提升推理模型长思维链准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特量化虽降低推理模型服务成本，却严重损害长链推理。每步读取数千token的缓存KV，量化误差沿轨迹累积；标准校准基于短片段，缺失后续推理所需的早期上下文；即便保留上下文，仅用缓存重建误差也无法刻画量化误差对后续注意力的影响。

Method: RECAP包含两部分：1）动态前缀校准，将长历史上下文与短块重建分离，用当前量化器重新生成前缀KV，并旋转活动块以监督轨迹上每个位置；2）前缀读取几何，依据历史缓存误差对注意力输出的影响进行监督，对key与value误差非对称加权。两组件仅在在校准阶段应用。

Result: 在多类推理模型与量化设置下均优于基线。W4A4KV4下，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B在MATH500上准确率提升13.3个百分点，Qwen3-4B在AIME-120上提升15.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 在低比特推理中保留历史依赖关系对校准至关重要，RECAP证明了以历史读取为中心的校准可有效缓解长思维链退化。

Abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the cost of serving reasoning models but can substantially degrade long chains of thought. Each step reads cached keys and values spanning thousands of tokens, allowing quantization errors to accumulate along the trajectory. Standard calibration operates on short segments that omit the earlier context needed by later reasoning steps. Even when this context is retained, cache reconstruction error alone does not capture how quantization errors affect subsequent attention. We present RECAP, a post-training quantization method that calibrates reasoning models on the history they read. Dynamic-prefix calibration separates long historical context from short-block reconstruction. It regenerates prefix keys and values with the current quantizer and rotates the active block to supervise every position along the trajectory. Prefix read geometry further supervises historical cache errors according to their effects on attention outputs, weighting key and value errors asymmetrically. With both components applied only during calibration, RECAP outperforms the baseline across multiple reasoning models and quantization settings. Under W4A4KV4, RECAP improves accuracy over the baseline by 13.3 percentage points on MATH500 with DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and 15.8 points on AIME-120 with Qwen3-4B. These results highlight the importance of preserving historical dependencies during calibration for low-bit reasoning.

</details>


### [655] [OntoAR-HAR: Ontology-Guided Agentic RAG with Personalized Memory for Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15292)
*Xiangqing Lu,Tao Zhu,Liang Yu,Shuangjian Li,Lulu Ban,Furong Duan,Mingxing Nie,Liming Chen,Yaping Wan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OntoAR-HAR，一个本体引导的智能体式RAG框架，融合静态群体知识与个性化知识，通过树状活动本体将分类分解为局部决策，在跨被试与异构传感实验中取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM/RAG的HAR方法通常在单层活动空间中以静态群体知识进行检索，导致用相同的静态证据比较大量无关候选，忽视了个人化的运动模式，同时未建模活动粒度间的语义包含关系。

Method: OntoAR-HAR采用树状活动本体，将分类分解为语义相关活动间的局部决策；静态存储提供节点约束的示例，离线挖掘的可执行信号特征提供局部区分的数值证据；推理时个性化存储收集用户观测，LLM在遍历本体至活动标签的过程中融合静态知识、信号特征与个性化记忆。

Result: 跨被试与异构传感实验表明，层次化检索与个性化记忆在多个LLM骨干上带来互补增益，达到SOTA性能；本体建模活动粒度间的层次关系，缓解了长期被忽视的语义包含问题，避免将相关标签视为独立类别。

Conclusion: 显式建模活动粒度层次关系的本体引导RAG框架能有效结合群体与个性化证据，提升免训练目标用户推理性能，并正确处理语义包含问题。

Abstract: LLMs increasingly support sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) by linking motion signals with activity semantics and physical knowledge. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounds decisions in sensor examples and domain features, enabling training-free target-user inference with less dependence on raw numerical arrays. However, existing LLM/RAG-based HAR typically searches single-level activity spaces using static population knowledge. Consequently, they compare many unrelated candidates using the same static population evidence and overlook personalized motion patterns. We propose OntoAR-HAR, an ontology-guided agentic RAG framework combining static population and personalized knowledge. Its tree-structured activity ontology decomposes classification into local decisions among semantically related activities. The static store supplies node-constrained examples, while offline-discovered executable signal features provide numerical evidence for local distinctions. During inference, the personalized store collects selected user observations, which the LLM integrates with static knowledge and signal features while traversing the ontology to an activity label. Cross-subject and heterogeneous-sensing experiments show complementary gains from hierarchical retrieval and personalized memory across multiple LLM backbones, achieving state-of-the-art performance. By explicitly modeling hierarchical relations across activity granularities, OntoAR-HAR also addresses the long-overlooked semantic inclusion problem and avoids treating related labels as independent categories.

</details>


### [656] [CHEAR: Confusion-Hierarchy Evidence-Aware Reasoning for Cost-Efficient Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15298)
*Xiangqing Lu,Tao Zhu,Mingxing Nie,Liming Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CHEAR 提出将活动类别间的混淆组织工作从推理时转移到离线，通过构建并验证活动层级与活动对知识来引导候选比较，在八个数据集上实现 86.79% 跨被试平均准确率、75.91% 候选削减率、96.44% 真活动保留率，并在无层级变体基础上平均降低 85.15% 的单样本 token 消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 与 RAG 虽可为穿戴式传感器的人类活动识别引入相似运动样例与判别性传感器知识，但"证据更多"不等于"证据组织更好"。当前在线提示与 LLM 智能体主要在推理时决定比较哪些活动、何时调用判别知识，导致：活动词表增大时需反复处理更多候选与关联知识；而过早剪枝又会排除真实活动。

Method: 提出混淆层级证据感知推理（CHEAR），将知识组织部分前置到离线阶段：基于跨被试的反复检索错误构建并验证活动层级，并据此建立活动对（activity-pair）判别知识。推理时，该层级负责排序候选比较顺序，LLM 逐步保留候选，仅对剩余活动访问局部判别知识。

Result: 八个数据集上，跨被试平均准确率 86.79%，候选削减率 75.91%，真活动保留率 96.44%；相比无层级结构的变体，单样本 token 用量平均降低 85.15%。八个跨数据集迁移方向的平均准确率为 88.81%。

Conclusion: 围绕已观测到的活动混淆来组织候选与判别知识，可在保持识别性能的同时显著减少在线 LLM 的输入规模。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a new approach to wearable-sensor-based human activity recognition. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) further introduces similar motion examples and discriminative sensor knowledge, enabling decisions grounded in observations relevant to the current query. More evidence, however, does not necessarily mean better-organized evidence. When online prompts and LLM agents primarily orchestrate inference, decisions about which activities to compare and when to invoke discriminative knowledge remain concentrated at inference time. As the activity vocabulary grows, the model must repeatedly process more candidates and associated knowledge, whereas pruning candidates too early risks excluding the true activity. We propose confusion-hierarchy evidence-aware reasoning (CHEAR), which moves part of this knowledge organization offline. CHEAR constructs and validates an activity hierarchy from recurrent cross-subject retrieval errors and builds corresponding activity-pair knowledge. At inference time, the hierarchy orders candidate comparisons; the LLM retains candidates progressively, and local discriminative knowledge is accessed only for the remaining activities. Across eight datasets, CHEAR achieves 86.79\% mean cross-subject accuracy, a 75.91\% candidate reduction rate, and 96.44\% true-activity retention. Per-sample token use is 85.15\% lower on average than in a variant without the hierarchical structure. Mean accuracy across eight cross-dataset transfer directions is 88.81\%. These results show that organizing candidates and discriminative knowledge around observed activity confusions reduces online LLM input while maintaining recognition performance.

</details>


### [657] [SuperAI: Merging Capabilities Across Heterogeneous Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15322)
*Jingtong Dou,Chuancheng Shi,Wenhua Wu,Wei Bao,Fei Shen,Zhiyong Wang,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SuperAI，一种跨架构多模型融合框架，通过正交对齐低维任务相关表示，将多个源模型的能力整合进宿主模型，在15个能力域上取得优于现有跨架构融合方法的平均得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式在各类基础模型中的知识与能力难以复用和组合，由于架构差异与表示不兼容，缺乏统一的跨模型接口来迁移和整合这些能力。

Method: 1) 用共享锚样本从源模型与宿主模型提取任务相关表示，并用PCA构建同维度的低维功能子空间；2) 使用正交Procrustes映射对齐源与宿主坐标系，在保持各源子空间内部几何结构的同时建立跨模型对应；3) 训练带任务输出与源模型增量联合监督的轻量残差MLP，学习输入相关的残差增量并注入宿主模型以完成多模型能力融合。

Result: 在3个宿主模型、15个能力域上的实验表明，SuperAI的平均域得分高于所对比的跨架构融合方法，且随源模型数量增加更能保持通用能力；消融实验支持正交对齐、非线性残差映射与联合监督的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过正交对齐的低维任务相关表示与残差增量注入，SuperAI 实现了跨架构多模型能力融合，验证了该方法在可扩展AI系统构建中的有效性及其关键组件的必要性。

Abstract: Enabling the reuse and composition of knowledge and capabilities distributed across foundation models is an important step toward building scalable artificial intelligence (AI) systems. However, architectural differences and incompatible representations make it difficult to transfer and integrate these capabilities through a unified cross-model interface. To address this challenge, we propose SuperAI, a cross-architecture multi-model fusion framework that integrates complementary capabilities from multiple source models into a host model through orthogonal alignment of low-dimensional task-relevant representations. Specifically, we first extract task-relevant representations from the source models and the host model using shared anchor samples, and apply principal component analysis (PCA) to construct low-dimensional functional subspaces with the same dimensionality. Next, we use orthogonal Procrustes mappings to align the source and host coordinate systems, establishing cross-model correspondences while preserving the internal geometry of each source subspace. Finally, we train a lightweight residual multilayer perceptron (MLP) with joint supervision on task outputs and source-model increments, learning input-dependent residual increments that are injected into the host model for multi-model capability fusion. Experiments on three host models across 15 capability domains show that SuperAI achieves higher average domain scores than the evaluated cross-architecture fusion methods and better preserves general capabilities as the number of source models increases. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of orthogonal alignment, nonlinear residual mapping, and joint supervision.

</details>


### [658] [MultiFlow: Vision-Driven Multimodal fMRI Encoding via Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15339)
*Bui Van Hung,Hoang-Son Vo,Mai Duc Minh Huy,Dang Thanh Vu,Soo-Hyung Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出MultiFlow，一个基于条件流匹配（CFM）的生成式fMRI编码框架，通过将源分布以刺激为条件（SISFM），用单一生成模型逼近大型确定性集成模型的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有fMRI编码模型将预测建模为确定性回归，但相同刺激会引发神经响应的分布（源于生理噪声、血流动力学变异和认知波动），单一的点估计无法刻画这种分布特性。

Method: 提出MultiFlow生成式编码框架，核心为Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching（SISFM）：将CFM的源分布以刺激为条件，用可学习时间卷积以HRF长度感受野塑造源均值，并用方差头收缩源尺度以缩短期望传输路径。以Diffusion Transformer（DiT-X）解码器参数化速度场，包含子层Attention Residuals、十种冻结视觉/音频/语言/视听骨干网络的异构融合，以及按被试的Yeo网络头。

Result: 在Algonauts 2025数据集上，单个MultiFlow检查点恢复了大型确定性集成模型的大部分增益：分布内仅落后1000模型TRIBE集成0.003 PCC（0.3163 vs 0.3195），落后最强分布内/外集成（VIBE-20、MedARC-50）分别为0.010和0.009 PCC，而仅使用单个训练模型而非20-1000个模型的集成。同一检查点还提供刺激条件的不确定性估计和基于采样的多样性。

Conclusion: MultiFlow通过生成式流匹配建模fMRI编码，用单一模型逼近大型集成性能，并额外提供不确定性估计与样本多样性，优于传统确定性回归范式。

Abstract: Current fMRI encoding models frame prediction as deterministic regression, yet identical stimuli evoke a distribution of neural responses (arising from physiological noise, hemodynamic variability, and cognitive fluctuations) that a single point estimate cannot capture. This work introduces MultiFlow, a generative fMRI encoding framework based on Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) and a formulation termed Stimulus-Informed Source Flow Matching (SISFM). SISFM generalises CFM by conditioning the source distribution on the stimulus: a learnable temporal convolution shapes the source mean with an HRF-length receptive field, while a variance head shrinks its scale, shortening the expected transport path. SISFM is instantiated with a Diffusion Transformer (DiT-X) decoder parameterising the velocity field, with sub-layer Attention Residuals, heterogeneous fusion of ten frozen vision, audio, language, and audiovisual backbones, and per-subject Yeo-network heads. On the Algonauts 2025 dataset, a single MultiFlow checkpoint recovers most of the benefit of large deterministic ensembles: it trails the 1000-model TRIBE ensemble in-distribution by 0.003 PCC (0.3163 vs. 0.3195), and the strongest in- and out-of-distribution ensembles (VIBE-20, MedARC-50) by 0.010 and 0.009 PCC, using a single trained model rather than an ensemble of 20-1000. The same checkpoint also provides stimulus-conditioned uncertainty estimates and sample-based diversity.

</details>


### [659] [TRACE: Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing for Safer Language Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15365)
*Ankur Garg,Xuemin Yu,Hassan Sajjad,Samira Ebrahimi Kahou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TRACE框架，在生成过程中追踪有害响应风险，通过概念码本与GRU实现流式检测，选择性地对有害概念激活进行编辑，并留下可审计的检测与干预痕迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全防护需要做到三点：在生成过程中检测风险并及时干预、对原本安全的响应尽量不做改动、同时提供可审计的内部决策依据。然而现有方法难以同时满足实时流式检测、选择性干预与可解释审计的需求。

Method: TRACE学习一个由循环出现的激活模式构成的码本，每个码本向量代表一个潜在概念；推理时将每个token激活分配给最近的码本向量以获得对应概念。用GRU处理激活及其概念特征，预测完整响应的有害性和单调累积的流式风险。干预阶段，将属于有害概念的激活沿附近良性目标定义的方向进行引导。事后由外部LLM标注所学概念，使检测序列和有害到良性的编辑记录可解释。

Result: 在三个生成器和WildGuard、S-Eval两个基准上，TRACE在六项比较中的五项提升了流式F1（相比Kelp），在完整响应检测上保持竞争力。选择性引导在几乎不改变原安全响应拒答率的情况下降低了Harmbench攻击成功率。事后审计揭示了所学概念中反复出现的语义结构，以及分别对应有害检测、安全生成和激活编辑的不同痕迹。

Conclusion: TRACE将流式风险检测、概念级选择性干预与事后可审计性统一在一个框架内，在检测性能、攻击防御和安全响应保持之间取得了良好平衡，并验证了所学概念的可解释语义结构。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can produce harmful content while generating a response. A useful safeguard should not only detect this risk during generation but also intervene while leaving safe responses largely unchanged and provide an auditable record of the internal patterns supporting its decisions. We propose TRACE (Temporal Risk Assessment and Concept Editing), a framework that tracks harmful-response risk during generation, selectively edits token activations, and leaves an auditable trace of its detection and steering decisions. TRACE learns a codebook of recurring activation patterns, with each codebook vector representing a latent concept. At inference time, it assigns each token activation to the nearest codebook vector to obtain the corresponding concept. A gated recurrent unit (GRU) processes the activations and their assigned concept features to predict completed-response harmfulness and a monotone cumulative streaming risk. During steering, activations assigned to harmful concepts are steered along directions defined by nearby benign targets. An external LLM labels the learned concepts post hoc, making detection sequences and harmful-to-benign edit records interpretable. Experiments across three generators and the WildGuard and S-Eval benchmarks show that TRACE improves streaming F1 over Kelp in five of six comparisons while remaining competitive on completed-response detection. TRACE's selective steering reduces Harmbench attack success with little change in refusal on originally safe responses. The post-hoc audit reveals recurring semantic structure in the learned concepts and distinct traces associated with harmful detection, safe generation, and activation edits.

</details>


### [660] [Fewer Bits, More Tries: Recovering Capability Under Memory Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15372)
*Tomer Galanti,Josh Susskind,Eran Malach*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过"验证式重试"（多次并行生成+测试筛选），小模型或压缩模型可恢复因参数量/压缩损失的能力，以多次推理换取接近大模型精度且内存更省、速度更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型能力强但显存需求大，难以本地部署；而单用户本地推理硬件常未被充分利用。作者希望以额外测试时计算来弥补模型规模或压缩带来的能力差距。

Method: 提出"验证式重试"（verified retry）：对较小或压缩模型进行多次并行候选生成，利用公开测试或模型自生成测试对输出进行筛选，将闲置算力转化为测试时计算。

Result: 在四个代码生成基准上显著恢复精度损失。7B Qwen 八次并行尝试在 MBPP+ 上基本追平 32B 模型，并在其余三个基准上超越；内存约为其 1/4，最高快 6 倍，能耗更低（Nvidia GPU 实测）。在多种模型规模、压缩程度和硬件上均观察到类似权衡。

Conclusion: 当正确解在适度重试预算内可达时，模型容量可与验证式测试时计算相互权衡替代，为本地部署提供高效路径。

Abstract: Large language models are generally more capable than smaller ones, but their memory requirements can make local deployment difficult. We ask whether part of this capability gap can instead be recovered by running a smaller or more compressed model multiple times and selecting among its outputs using public or model-generated tests. Single-user local inference can leave hardware underutilized, allowing parallel candidate generation to trade additional test-time computation for accuracy at modest latency cost. Across four code-generation benchmarks, verified retry recovers substantial accuracy lost to model size or compression. A 7B Qwen model with eight parallel attempts essentially matches a 32B model on MBPP+ and exceeds it on the other three benchmarks, while using about $4\times$ less model memory, running up to $6\times$ faster, and using less energy, as measured on Nvidia GPU. We observe similar tradeoff across model sizes, compression levels and hardware choices, although exact benefit depends on the hardware profile and problem setting. These results show that model capacity can be traded for verified test-time computation when correct solutions remain reachable within a modest retry budget.

</details>


### [661] [Analyzing the Dynamics of WSBM-based Echo State Networks using InputDSA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15380)
*Huy Mai,Robert Clarke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文用加权随机块模型(WSBM)为回声状态网络引入生物式模块化储层，并结合输入动态相似性分析(InputDSA)，发现结构多样性并不必然导致行为多样性，且成功的网络呈现"安娜·卡列尼娜式"动态收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物大脑与人工神经网络之间存在结构鸿沟；随机连接的传统储层缺乏生物学合理性，需要引入模块化等结构先验来探究结构如何影响计算动态。

Method: 以WSBM对回声状态网络(ESN)的储层拓扑进行参数化，构建反映潜在功能子回路的模块化储层；引入InputDSA，用于分离并比较结构先验对内在递归动态与外部输入的影响，并对多种架构进行评估与解混分析(demixed analysis)。

Result: 在所选的网络子集上，结构多样性并不必然预测行为多样性；解混分析证实了动态层面的安娜·卡列尼娜原则——环境约束促使成功的智能体动态趋同，而失败网络则退化为特异的轨迹。

Conclusion: 生物启发式的模块化拓扑与InputDSA相结合，为刻画结构先验对递归动态的作用提供了有效框架；结构—行为关系并非简单映射，成功与否更多取决于环境约束下的动态收敛。

Abstract: Bridging the structural gap between biological brains and artificial neural networks presents a pathway to altered computational dynamics. This paper introduces a Reservoir Computing framework that replaces random networks with biologically realistic modularity by applying the Weighted Stochastic Block Model (WSBM) to Echo State Networks (ESNs). This topological parameterization constructs reservoirs reflecting latent functional sub-circuits. Furthermore, the integration of Input Dynamical Similarity Analysis (InputDSA) provides a mechanism to isolate and compare how structural priors modulate intrinsic recurrent dynamics versus external inputs. By evaluating these architectures, we establish that structural diversity does not necessarily predicts behavioral diversity across the selected network subset. Furthermore, our demixed analysis confirms Anna Karenina principle of dynamics, demonstrating that environmental constraints enforce dynamical convergence in successful agents, while failing networks degenerate into idiosyncratic trajectories.

</details>


### [662] [A Decade of PhotoMappers: A Longitudinal Study of Crowdsourced Disaster Photos Geolocalization with Vision-Language Models and Geospatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15403)
*Hao Li,Wenping Yin,Fabian Deuser,Jia Jia,Ziqi Liu,Levente Juhász,Fan Zhang,Filip Biljecki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 基于PhotoMappers十余年众包灾害影像，结合纵向空间分析与跨视角地理定位，评估视觉语言模型的地理推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 众包灾害影像在传统灾害测绘延迟或不完整时能提供及时的实地观测，但其地理价值取决于观测产生的位置、解读方式及能否可靠定位为可行动的地理空间情报（GEOINT）。

Method: 结合纵向空间分析与基于街景影像（SVI）和遥感影像（RSI）的跨视角地理定位；采用30项指标（涵盖地理线索与推理证据）评估视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理能力。

Result: 档案在时空分布上不均衡，受灾害类型、社区生命线与业务优先级影响。融合VGI、SVI与RSI并使用Sinkhorn重排序达到40.90% R@1、61.10% R@5、69.45% R@10，年度R@1在25.00%–65.07%间波动。地理推理亦不均衡：Qwen3.6-27B总体一致性67%，InternVL3-8B为51%，两者在局部化和特定地点证据上比宏观空间格局更困难。

Conclusion: GeoAI的价值不在于替代志愿地理解读，而在于辅助补充：扩展候选检索规模，同时把模糊且影响重大的案例保留给人类判断，为以人为本、负责任的灾害测绘GeoAI提供路径。

Abstract: Crowdsourced disaster imagery provides timely, ground-level observations when conventional disaster mapping is delayed or incomplete, yet its geographic value depends on where observations are produced, how they are interpreted, and whether they can be reliably located as actionable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT). Using more than a decade of PhotoMappers, a crowdsourced disaster-mapping initiative, this study examines the changing geography of disaster information and asks how emerging GeoAI models compare with human geographic interpretation. We combine longitudinal spatial analysis with cross-view geolocalization using street view imagery (SVI) and remote sensing imagery (RSI), and evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) reasoning through 30 indicators spanning geographic cues and reasoning evidence. The results reveal a geographically and temporally uneven archive shaped by changing disaster types, Community Lifelines, and operational priorities. Integrating VGI, SVI, and RSI with Sinkhorn re-ranking achieves 40.90% R@1, 61.10% R@5, and 69.45% R@10, while yearly R@1 varies markedly from 25.00% to 65.07%. Geographic reasoning is similarly uneven: Qwen3.6-27B achieves an overall agreement of 67% compared with 51% for InternVL3-8B, with both models showing greater difficulty with localized and place-specific evidence than broad spatial configurations. We argue that the value of GeoAI lies less in replacing volunteered geographic interpretation than in complementing it, scaling candidate retrieval while retaining human judgment for ambiguous and consequential cases. This provides a pathway toward more human-centered and responsible GeoAI for disaster mapping. All data and code are openly available at https://github.com/bobleegogogo/PhotoMappers-VLM.

</details>


### [663] [State Representation Shapes Long-Horizon Agent Learning and Transfer: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15407)
*Dong Nie,Rui Lan,Yixin Nie,Lingzi Hong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究区分了智能体在工具工作流中"学不会动作"与"会动作但无法在状态变化下执行"两类失败，发现状态表示对迁移性能有决定性影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端成功率无法区分是学习失败还是状态变化下的执行失败，作者希望分离这两种失败模式，探究状态表示在确定性工具工作流中对迁移能力的作用。

Method: 使用Qwen 1.7B、8B、27B模型，在确定性工具工作流中比较不同工作流跨度的监督学习，交叉训练与评估所用状态表示；并进行H16交叉实验、配对选择任务，以及独立的27B ScienceWorld研究。

Result: 跨度匹配监督完成率高，但H4训练的1.7B模型在更长工作流和全状态观测下迁移差；H16交叉中compact训练适配器在compact视图完成50/50、full视图0/50；8B适配器对呈相似不对称；compact mask在执行选择时不参考目标动作；显式相关性提示改善full视图执行但未消除差距；27B ScienceWorld中compact训练在两视图下均提升局部准确率。

Conclusion: 表示敏感的迁移是受控工作流中的瓶颈，但该结论尚未将内容削减与观测的其他变化分离开来。

Abstract: An end-to-end success rate alone cannot distinguish failure to learn an action from failure to apply it as task state changes. We study this distinction in deterministic tool workflows that provide the current artifact state and candidate action recipes. Using 1.7B, 8B, and 27B Qwen models, we compare supervised learning across workflow horizons and cross the state representation used for training with the one used at evaluation. Horizon-matched supervision yields high completion, but an H4-trained 1.7B model transfers poorly to longer workflows under full-state observations. In an H16 crossover, compact-trained 1.7B adapters complete 50/50 held-out tasks in compact view and 0/50 in full view for each of three paired training seeds; full-trained outcomes vary across seeds. A separate 8B adapter pair shows a similar asymmetry. The view dependence also appears in paired-choice tasks where both candidate calls are executable and the correct choice depends on table contents; here, the compact mask does not consult the target action. An explicit relevance cue improves full-view execution but does not close the gap for the tested checkpoint. In a separate 27B ScienceWorld study, compact-state training improves local accuracy under both views, indicating that the transfer pattern depends on the task and observation construction. Together, these experiments identify representation-sensitive transfer as a bottleneck in the controlled workflows, without isolating content reduction from other changes to the observation.

</details>


### [664] [CoverSynth: Coverage-Guided Generation of Retrieval Evaluation Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15409)
*Anahita Sharma,Apaar Shanker,Rishav Chakravarti,Sneha Srinivasan,Vijay Kalmath,Dylan Wilbur,Yuan Li,Sara Bolouki,Yuan Xue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出评估集评估框架与CoverSynth生成器，从无标注语料出发，以覆盖度和证据可靠性为显式目标自动生成企业检索评测集，能揭示领域特有失败模式与系统差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业智能体需要能暴露领域特有失败、并指导部署权衡的检索评测集，但专家人工编写与现有合成方法都缺乏在覆盖度、可靠性、效率与区分度上达标的方法论，领域内也缺少判定评测集是否满足这些属性的评估框架。

Method: 提出评测集评估框架以界定上述准则，并设计CoverSynth生成器：以未标注语料为起点，面向检索需求与系统能力的目标覆盖；用确定性检查在原文中定位证据引文，用模型化检查评估语义有效性以保证可靠的真值标注；不依赖昂贵的人工专家标注。

Result: 在五个公开企业风格语料上，方法产生有信息量的难度变化，暴露未见失败模式（如智能体无法处理欠指定或模糊请求）。在RepLiQA上，人工生成查询有91%能被12个检索系统面板中所有成员回答，而CoverSynth生成查询仅12%。在重复的TechQA/RepLiQA研究中，12/12的同框架模型对比在生成集上具有正的标称95%区间，而人工集仅4/12。

Conclusion: CoverSynth将覆盖度与证据质量作为显式构建目标，产出语料落地的评测，能揭示检索余量与不同智能体配置间的差异。

Abstract: Enterprise agents need retrieval evaluation sets that expose domain-specific failures and guide developers towards efficient deployment tradeoffs. Neither expert-human-authored sets nor current synthetic generation methods provide a methodology for achieving the necessary coverage, reliability, efficiency, and discriminability required for such decision-making. Simultaneously, the field does not have an assessment framework for determining when an evaluation set has satisfied these properties. We introduce an evaluation set assessment framework for these criteria and CoverSynth -- a generator specifically designed to satisfy these criteria without incurring the high cost of human expert labeling. Starting from an unannotated corpus, CoverSynth targets coverage across retrieval demands and system capabilities. Deterministic checks locate evidence quotes in their sources, while model-based checks assess semantic validity to guarantee reliable ground truth. Across five public enterprise-style corpora, our method provides informative variation in difficulty, revealing unseen failure modes such as an inability of agents to handle underspecified or ambiguous requests. On the RepLiQA corpus, 91\% of human-generated queries can be answered by all members on a panel of 12 retrieval systems, compared to only 12\% of CoverSynth-generated queries. Finally, in a repeated TechQA/RepLiQA study, 12 of 12 within-harness model contrasts have positive nominal 95\% intervals on generated sets, compared with 4 of 12 on human sets. CoverSynth makes coverage and evidence quality explicit construction objectives, producing corpus-grounded evaluations that reveal retrieval headroom and differences between agent configurations.

</details>


### [665] [SpecFit: Not All Draft Tokens Cost the Same in Offloaded MoE Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15417)
*Hongliang Cao,Xiuyu Li,Siqi Wang,Ziming Wang,Jingmin Zhu,Hailong Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SpecFit通过选择被验证的草稿子树以最大化预测吞吐量而非接受长度，缓解MoE模型专家权重卸载场景下H2D传输开销，在摘要与GSM8K任务上优于EAGLE-3。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型每token仅激活少量专家，但专家权重卸载到主机内存后，H2D专家传输进入解码关键路径。推测解码虽一次前向验证多个草稿token，但在MoE中每个被验证token激活各自专家，草稿树越大传输专家越多，导致其有时反比自回归解码更慢。

Method: 提出SpecFit，选择被验证草稿子树以最大化预测吞吐量。用草稿路径概率估计期望提交token数；由节点数与子树激活专家的逐层并集预测周期时间；该并集为单调子模覆盖函数，每节点仅为其新增专家付费。对祖先闭合子树做精确搜索，返回预测吞吐量最高的子树；每draft level后运行同一搜索决定何时停止草稿，由未修改的目标模型验证结果。

Result: 在CNN/DailyMail摘要和GSM8K子集上，使用Qwen3-30B-A3B，SpecFit在相同专家缓存下比EAGLE-3分别快21.6%和7.0%，为vanilla EAGLE-3的1.97倍和1.72倍。

Conclusion: SpecFit以吞吐量最优的子树搜索替代接受长度优化，有效降低MoE推测解码中的H2D开销，显著提升解码速度。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token, but when their expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers enter the critical path of decoding. Speculative decoding verifies several draft tokens in one forward pass, yet in an MoE model each verified token activates its own experts, so a larger draft tree transfers more experts. Because of this H2D cost, speculative decoding commits several tokens per verification cycle yet is sometimes even slower than autoregressive decoding. Based on this observation, we propose SpecFit, which chooses the verified draft subtree to maximize predicted throughput rather than acceptance length. SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens from draft path probabilities and predicts cycle time from the node count and the per-layer union of the experts the subtree activates; this union is a monotone submodular coverage function, so each node pays only for the experts it adds. An exact search over ancestor-closed subtrees returns the subtree with the highest predicted throughput; run after each draft level, the same search also decides when to stop drafting, and the unmodified target verifies the result. On CNN/DailyMail summarization and a GSM8K subset with Qwen3-30B-A3B, SpecFit decodes 21.6% and 7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 with the same expert cache and 1.97x and 1.72x as fast as vanilla EAGLE-3. Code is available at https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit.

</details>


### [666] [Hidden in Plain Sight: Advancing Harmful Content Understanding via Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15449)
*Yisong Xiao,Benlei Cui,Shiji Zhao,Zonghao Ying,Yaoyuan Zhang,Longtao Huang,Aishan Liu,Hui Xue,Ting Ma,Haiwen Hong,Xianglong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PASP：通过多感知视图与对抗自博弈，提升LLM对人类可识别但模型中隐匿的恶意意图的识别能力，显著降低自适应攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恶意用户利用伪装内容规避自动化审查，而人类读者能整合语境、语音和视觉线索识破伪装，文本LLM主要依赖token序列且少见演化中的规避手段，二者存在认知不对称，威胁平台安全。

Method: PASP（Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play）：为输入构造文本、语音、视觉三种视图，在保留原始语境的同时暴露token空间中被遮蔽的发音与字形线索；在对抗自博弈中，攻击者利用防御者反馈生成保持意图的规避样本，防御者通过“意图不变性奖励”学习跨表层形式的恶意意图。

Result: 在ChineseHarm-Bench和EvoHarmBench上，自适应攻击成功率分别最多降低73.71%和74.49%；模型能力仅轻微下降；在电商场景中能有效解读真实世界的规避表达。

Conclusion: 多感知视图结合对抗自博弈可有效弥合人类与LLM在识别恶意意图上的认知不对称，在保持模型通用能力的同时提升对抗规避的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Despite significant advances in language understanding, Large Language Models (LLMs) can still miss meaning hidden in plain sight, failing to identify harmful intent in expressions readily understood by humans. Malicious users exploit this gap by strategically disguising harmful content to evade automated moderation, posing a serious threat to online platform safety. The vulnerability reflects a fundamental cognitive asymmetry between human readers, who integrate contextual, phonetic, and visual cues to decipher the intent behind deliberate obfuscation, and text-based LLMs, which rely primarily on token sequences and have limited exposure to evolving evasions. To bridge this asymmetry, we propose PASP (Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play), which combines multi-perceptual views with adversarial self-play to improve understanding of harmful intent as evasions evolve. Specifically, PASP constructs textual, phonetic, and visual views of each input, preserving its original context while exposing pronunciation and glyph cues obscured in token space. During adversarial self-play, an attacker uses defender feedback to generate intent-preserving evasions, while the defender is trained using an intent-invariance reward to understand harmful intent across changing surface forms. Extensive experiments show that PASP reduces adaptive attack success rates by up to 73.71% and 74.49% on ChineseHarm-Bench and EvoHarmBench, respectively, preserves model capabilities with minimal degradation, and effectively interprets real-world evasive expressions in e-commerce.

</details>


### [667] [Scalable Robust MCTS with Anytime Deterministic Optimality Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15461)
*Tomer Massas,Vadim Indelman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出首个面向鲁棒在线MDP规划的确定性anytime保证方法CAR-MCTS，通过采样搜索树上的确定性bounds引导探索、剪枝并认证最优根动作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鲁棒MDP规划需在名义转移模型与真实动态可能不一致时，用可容许模型集合处理不确定性；但在线计算受限，搜索树随horizon指数增长，且每次鲁棒backup需额外优化。现有在线鲁棒方法规模受限，仅能提供概率性保证，缺乏确定性anytime保证。

Method: 将计算限制在采样搜索树上，并确定性界定未采样轨迹的贡献。对任意固定策略，在矩形与非矩形不确定性集下推导其投影鲁棒值与真实鲁棒值之间gap的上下界；在矩形不确定性下，通过鲁棒Bellman算子传播这些界，从而界定最优鲁棒值。这些界可由当前采样树计算、在每个节点成立、随采样支撑扩展而收紧，并在恢复完整支撑时收敛到鲁棒值。基于此提出CAR-MCTS，用确定性界引导探索、剪除可证明次优分支，并在最优根动作被认证时终止；固定策略界还提供任意策略的anytime策略评估机制。

Result: 实验验证了确定性界的成立、支撑扩展下的收紧、显著的分支剪枝、根动作认证以及对最优鲁棒策略的收敛。

Conclusion: 这是首个可扩展的鲁棒MCTS框架，为在线规划与策略评估同时提供anytime确定性保证，且无需枚举完整状态空间。

Abstract: MDP planners often rely on nominal transition models that may differ from the true dynamics. Robust MDP planning accounts for this uncertainty through a set of admissible models, but doing so with limited online computation is challenging: the search tree grows exponentially with the horizon and each robust backup requires an additional optimization. Existing online robust methods remain limited in scale and offer at most probabilistic guarantees. We introduce, to the best of our knowledge, the first deterministic anytime guarantees for robust online MDP planning. We restrict computation to the sampled search tree while deterministically bounding the contribution of unsampled trajectories. For any fixed policy, we derive lower and upper bounds on the gap between its projected and true robust values under rectangular and non-rectangular uncertainty sets. Under rectangular uncertainty, we propagate these bounds through the robust Bellman operator to bound the optimal robust value. These bounds are computable from the current sampled tree, hold at every node, tighten as the sampled support expands, and converge to the robust values as full support is recovered. We develop CAR-MCTS, a bound-guided MCTS planner that uses these deterministic bounds to guide exploration, prune provably suboptimal branches, and terminate once the optimal root action is certified. The fixed-policy bounds also yield an anytime policy-evaluation mechanism that certifies the robust value of any policy, independent of how it was obtained. Experiments verify the deterministic bounds, their tightening under support expansion, substantial branch pruning, root-action certification, and convergence to the optimal robust policy. To our knowledge, this is the first scalable robust MCTS framework with anytime deterministic guarantees for both online planning and policy evaluation, without enumerating the full state space.

</details>


### [668] [MemeLogos: Knowledge-Driven Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Harmful Meme Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15463)
*Hexiang Gu,Saihui Hou,Changlan Liu,Min Ren,Huijia Wu,Hongxun Gu,Zhaofeng He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 MemeLogos，一个知识驱动的检索增强推理框架，用于有害模因检测。它从有害案例中抽象出可复用的危害性知识单元并构建星形知识图谱，结合显式多阶段认知推理，提升检测性能与可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有害模因的危害性常隐晦地体现在视觉、文本与上下文的复杂交互中，检测难度大。现有引入 RAG 和外部知识的方法多检索相似实例或辅助信息，难以捕捉可复用的危害性知识与底层推理机制，导致检测性能与可解释性受限。

Method: 提出 MemeLogos 框架：从多样化有害案例中抽象出反复出现的危害性模式与推理结构，形成可复用知识单元，并组织为专用的星形知识图谱；将结构化知识检索与受认知机制启发的显式多阶段推理过程相结合，用检索到的知识引导危害性推理。

Result: 大量实验表明，MemeLogos 持续优于现有有害模因检测方法，同时生成更连贯、更具可解释性的推理过程，验证了结构化危害性知识对多模态内容理解的有效性。

Conclusion: 结构化危害性知识结合检索增强的多阶段推理，能同时提升有害模因检测的可靠性与可解释性，为多模态内容理解提供了有效路径。

Abstract: With the rapid proliferation of social media, harmful memes have become a growing threat to online ecosystems. Their harmfulness is often implicitly conveyed through complex interactions among visual, textual, and contextual cues, making accurate detection challenging. Recent studies have introduced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and external knowledge into harmful meme detection. However, existing methods mainly retrieve similar instances or auxiliary information, limiting their ability to capture reusable harmfulness knowledge and underlying reasoning mechanisms, and thus constraining both detection performance and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose MemeLogos, a knowledge-driven retrieval-augmented reasoning framework for harmful meme detection. MemeLogos abstracts recurring harmfulness patterns and reasoning structures from diverse harmful cases into reusable knowledge units and organizes them into a dedicated star-shaped knowledge graph. By combining structured knowledge retrieval with an explicit multi-stage reasoning process inspired by cognitive mechanisms, MemeLogos leverages retrieved knowledge to guide harmfulness reasoning, improving both detection reliability and interpretability. Extensive experiments show that MemeLogos consistently outperforms existing harmful meme detection methods while generating more coherent and interpretable reasoning, demonstrating the effectiveness of structured harmfulness knowledge for multimodal content understanding.

</details>


### [669] [SkillFusion: Towards Reliable Multi-Skill Composition for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15481)
*Enhao Huang,Xinye Zhao,Yiming Li,Bingrun Yang,Nanjun Zhou,Chunshu Xia,Hongwei Yao,Zhan Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillFusion 是一个离线编译器，将多个独立编写的技能合并为一个可复用技能，通过类型化、作用域化的约束显式化处理技能间的冲突、偏好竞争与冗余，从而提升多技能联合加载时的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 独立编写的技能在 LLM agent 中被联合加载时，会带来相互不兼容的要求、相互竞争的偏好以及冗余指令。随着技能组合规模增大，这种不兼容性带来的代价日益显著，因此需要将技能组合过程中的冲突协调显式化、可复用化。

Method: SkillFusion 通过类型化、作用域化且与来源指令相关联的约束，使组合决策显式化。具体包括：type-scope gate 筛选候选交互；selective fallback 复查被结构剪枝可能遗漏的指令对；classifier 识别交互类型；adversarial verifier 复核不确定判断；resolver 对硬冲突采用条件路由或显式优先级，对软冲突采用验证后的抽象化，对冗余指令采用去重；source-linked 检查指导合成与压缩；metadata synthesis 支持合并技能的发现。产物保留相关脚本与资源，可跨任务与执行器模型复用。

Result: 在三个 agent 基准和两个迁移基准上，跨三个执行器模型，SkillFusion 在所有被评估的非 oracle 方法中取得最高平均 Success。在最大测试指令配置下，其 Success 是未解析多技能加载的 2.5 倍以上。

Conclusion: 随着技能组合需求增长，冲突协调的价值持续提升。SkillFusion 通过显式化组合决策，有效解决多技能联合加载中的冲突、偏好竞争与冗余问题。代码将在评审结束后开源。

Abstract: Independently authored skills can impose incompatible requirements, competing preferences, and redundant instructions when jointly loaded by an LLM agent. We propose SkillFusion, an offline compiler that reconciles these interactions into a reusable merged skill. Its central idea is to make composition decisions explicit through typed, scoped constraints linked to their source directives. A type-scope gate selects candidate interactions, while selective fallback revisits pairs potentially missed by structural pruning. A classifier identifies interaction types, and an adversarial verifier re-examines uncertain judgments. The resolver applies conditional routing or explicit priorities to hard conflicts, verified abstraction to soft conflicts, and deduplication to redundant instructions. Source-linked checks guide synthesis and compression, and metadata synthesis supports discovery of the merged skill. The resulting artifact retains associated scripts and resources and can be reused across tasks and executor models. SkillFusion achieves the highest mean Success among evaluated non-oracle methods on all three agent benchmarks and on both transfer benchmarks across three executor models. At the largest tested instruction configurations, it achieves over 2.5 times the Success of unresolved multi-skill loading, highlighting the growing value of reconciliation as composition becomes more demanding. The code will be open-sourced after the review process concludes.

</details>


### [670] [When Skills Remain But Access Fails: Factorized Skill Memory for Continual Skill Internalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15492)
*Haomiao Qiu,Yining Tang,Hongyi Wan,Changfeng Sun,Ziyue Qiao,Miao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究持续技能内化中的遗忘问题，发现技能遗忘呈现层次结构（技能寻址遗忘与技能执行遗忘），并提出因子化技能记忆（FSM）以分离可塑的寻址记忆与稳定的执行记忆，实现无回放的持续技能内化，在五阶段基准上取得65.95%精确匹配与93.38%寻址准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技能内化旨在将外部给定的过程性技能转化为模型的持久能力，使语言模型智能体在推理时无需检索或重新注入技能描述即可执行。然而在持续学习新技能时，已内化的旧技能是否仍然可用尚不清楚。作者旨在系统性地研究持续技能内化中的遗忘现象及其结构，并据此设计缓解方法。

Method: 首先刻画遗忘的层次结构：早期训练阶段模型无法从原始请求触发旧技能，但给出正确的规范技能名可显著恢复行为（技能寻址遗忘）；进一步优化后连条件执行也退化（技能执行遗忘）。据此提出因子化技能记忆（FSM），将持续技能记忆拆分为可塑的寻址记忆与稳定的执行记忆。每个阶段仅用当前阶段数据训练新的LoRA执行器，习得后冻结并追加至执行记忆；寻址记忆则在不回放历史请求与执行轨迹的情况下，增量学习将当前请求映射到执行器。推理时由寻址记忆从原始请求中选择一个执行器，仅由该冻结执行器完成单次语言模型生成。

Result: 在基于100个TaskBench技能构建的五阶段基准上，FSM在两种任务顺序下取得65.95%的平均精确匹配和93.38%的寻址准确率，相比最强的无回放参数隔离基线提升14.3个百分点，同时与保留历史训练样本的Replay方法相差仅1.9个百分点。

Conclusion: 持续技能内化中的遗忘具有寻址先于执行的层次结构，将技能记忆因子化为寻址与执行两部分可有效缓解遗忘。FSM在无回放条件下显著优于参数隔离基线并逼近Replay，表明分离可塑寻址与稳定执行是实现持续技能内化的有效路径。

Abstract: Skill internalization aims to convert externally specified procedural skills into persistent model capabilities, allowing language-model agents to execute them without retrieving or reinjecting skill descriptions at inference time. Yet when new skills are learned continually, whether previously internalized skills remain usable is still poorly understood. We study forgetting in continual skill internalization and uncover a clear hierarchical structure. Early in subsequent training, a model may lose the ability to invoke an old skill from the raw request, while supplying only the correct canonical skill name substantially restores the learned behavior; with further optimization, this conditional execution also degrades. We call these two stages skill-addressing forgetting and skill-execution forgetting. Guided by this finding, we introduce Factorized Skill Memory (FSM), which separates continual skill memory into a plastic Address Memory and a stable Execution Memory. At each stage, FSM trains a new LoRA executor using only current-stage data, freezes it after acquisition, and appends it to Execution Memory; in parallel, Address Memory incrementally learns to map current requests to executors without replaying historical requests or execution trajectories. At inference time, Address Memory selects one executor from the raw request, and only that frozen executor performs a single language-model generation. On a five-stage benchmark built from 100 TaskBench skills, FSM achieves 65.95% mean exact match and 93.38% addressing accuracy across two task orders, improving over the strongest replay-free parameter-isolation baseline by 14.3 percentage points while remaining within 1.9 points of Replay, which retains historical training examples.

</details>


### [671] [Large Decision Models: Repurposing Large Language Models as Single-Pass Decision Makers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15501)
*Ziyi Chen,Yan Zhang,Jianhui Wei,Jianing Yin,Daoan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Large Decision Models (LDMs)，将语言模型改造为单次 prefill 前向即输出显式标签概率的决策器，通过 DDS 与 SPRD 训练，并配合置信度路由，在决策任务上兼顾准确率与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有并行 prefill 加串行解码的 LLM 决策方式存在解码开销大、决策概率不显式的问题；而任务专用分类器需逐任务训练、难以泛化到未见过的决策模式。因此需要一种在运行时指定标签、一次前向即返回显式概率且具备泛化能力的通用决策模型。

Method: 将语言模型改造为在单次 prefill 前向中返回运行时指定标签的显式概率，提出两类训练手段：(1) Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS)，覆盖多样领域、规则与标签以适配该接口；(2) Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD)，用冻结教师模型生成任务、按答案一致性过滤，并在重复教师推理得到的标签分布上训练。此外引入置信度路由器处理不确定决策。基准为 DecisionVista，包含新决策模式测试集与留出的人工标注数据源。

Result: 在三个基座模型上，该方案相较步数匹配的基线准确率分别提升 1.8 和 1.5 个百分点；在 Gemma-4-31B 上相对推理式 rollout 实现 182 倍延迟加速。新决策模式测试上推理模型仍更强；在开发集上，路由可中位恢复 92% 的推理准确率优势，同时仅生成其 27%–58% 的 token。

Conclusion: LDMs 通过单次前向的显式概率输出在决策任务上取得显著效率优势，DDS 与 SPRD 有效缩小与推理模型的差距；推理在新模式泛化上仍占优，而置信度路由可在效率与准确率间取得良好折中。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models make decisions through parallel prefill and sequential decoding. Although effective, this approach incurs decoding costs and does not explicitly expose decision probabilities. Existing task-specific classifiers require per-task training and offer limited generalization to unseen decision schemas. We propose Large Decision Models (LDMs), repurposing language models to return explicit probabilities over labels specified at run time using one prefill forward pass. We first adapt models to this interface through Diverse Decision Supervision (DDS), covering varied domains, rules and labels. To further narrow the performance gap to a reasoning model, Self-Posed Reasoning Distillation (SPRD) adds tasks generated by a frozen teacher, filters them for answer consistency, and trains on label distributions obtained from repeated teacher reasoning. We evaluate on DecisionVista, pairing new-schema tests with held-out human-labelled sources. Across three base models, the recipe improves accuracy over a step-matched baseline by 1.8 and 1.5 percentage points, respectively, achieving a 182-fold speedup in latency over reasoning rollout on Gemma-4-31B. Reasoning remains stronger on the new-schema test, motivating a confidence router for uncertain decisions. On development sets, routing recovers a median 92% of reasoning's accuracy advantage while generating 27-58% of its tokens. Code is available at https://github.com/JianhuiWei7/LDM.

</details>


### [672] [Data Portability Revisited: Toward the Human-Centric, AI-Driven Data Ecosystems of Tomorrow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15503)
*Mark Fenwick,Michael Fertik,Paulius Jurcys,Timo Minssen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文批判性审视美国数据可携权监管框架，主张从以服务提供者为中心转向以人为中心的数据治理范式，使个人能在自主掌控的安全空间内聚合数据，并为未来以人为本的AI驱动数据生态奠定基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据访问与可携性虽被多项政策工具视为关键议题，但现行法律对可携性的理解仍偏向服务提供者和数据控制者企业的利益，而非终端用户。作者希望揭示这一偏差，并推动监管框架与技术、市场趋势相协调，以促成数据治理的根本转变。

Method: 采用规范性法律分析与比较研究：以欧盟近期监管发展为参照，批判性考察美国数据可携权制度；同时结合欧盟的技术与市场趋势分析，论证监管应顺应这些趋势以激励市场主体的变革性行为。

Result: 分析表明，现行可携性法律概念在实践中强化了服务提供者与数据控制者企业的优势地位，个人用户的实际控制力有限；而欧盟的技术与市场动向已显示出支持以人为中心数据模式的可行性。

Conclusion: 应推动范式转变，将数据视为数字时代个人身份的基本组成部分，交予个人而非企业掌控；监管框架应与技术和市场发展对齐，构建赋权个人的数据可携权路径，从而支撑面向消费者的AI应用及未来以人为本的AI驱动数据生态。

Abstract: This Article critically examines the contemporary regulatory framework and discourse surrounding data portability in the United States. Using recent regulatory developments in the European Union as an illustration, this Article suggests that although data access and portability are identified as vital issues in multiple policy instruments, in its current iteration, at least, legal conceptions of portability continue to reinforce the interests of service providers and data controller enterprises rather than individual end users. This Article argues that a paradigm shift toward a more human-centric data approach to data governance must occur, under which data would be recognized as fundamental to an individual's identity in a digital age. Therefore, it should be placed in the hands of individuals rather than service providers or data controller enterprises. This Article considers technical and market trends in the European Union that reveal and facilitate such a change. It suggests that regulatory frameworks should better align with these technological and market developments to encourage change-inducing trends among market actors. In short, this Article identifies a transformative approach to data portability that empowers individuals with the freedom and ability to aggregate their data in secure personal spaces under their control or dominion. Such a human-centric perspective on data portability is crucial in building Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered applications for individual consumers that can pave the way for the human-centric, AI-driven data ecosystems of the future.

</details>


### [673] [Agent-Canary-Mas: End-to-End Evaluation of Protocol Risk in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15529)
*Xiuming Liu,Le Gai,Zhiyuan Chang,Peiyang Li,Bin Zhu,Shuo Wang,Chao Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Agent-Canary-Mas 端到端评估系统，追踪 A2A/ANP/BCS 协议风险在长时程多智能体任务中的传导，量化本地攻击成功与下游后果转化之间的差距，并验证协议上下文 Guard 的防御效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估仅测量本地可利用性（local exploitability），无法说明局部成功的协议攻击是否会被后续智能体拒绝，或是否进一步传导为有实际后果的任务决策；同时缺乏证据定位究竟是哪个参与者导致了最终结果。因此需要端到端、可归因的评估框架。

Method: 构建 Agent-Canary-Mas：覆盖 5 类风险、13 个子类，横跨 A2A、ANP、BCS 三种协议，在五个业务域中配对 975 组恶意–良性任务。采用共享 OpenClaw 框架运行自主、可调用工具的智能体，并在不同底层模型下保持任务与执行设置一致。匹配运行将本地协议成功与下游后果分离，保留的证据链连接参与者选择、消息消费、工具活动与任务状态变化。另评估在关键交接点检查对象权限的协议上下文 Guard。

Result: 在三种模型条件下，本地攻击成功率常达 90% 以上，而后果转化率为 7.1%–100.0%。跨智能体证据将宏平均 Audit-F1 从 29.7% 提升至 95.5%。在 Finance 任务上，Guard 将平均 ASR 从 86.1% 降至 53.8%，PTCR 从 65.5% 降至 31.2%，但存在可测量的完成度代价。

Conclusion: 协议风险并非由单点攻击成功决定，而取决于智能体在整个任务过程中如何使用被交换的对象；沿着这一传导路径进行评估，可支持更有信息量的风险评估、归因与防御。

Abstract: Agent-to-agent protocols allow LLM agents to discover peers, exchange results, and coordinate tool use. A locally successful protocol attack, however, may be rejected by a later agent or propagated into a consequential task decision. Measuring local exploitability alone leaves this difference unresolved and provides limited evidence about which participant caused the final outcome.
  We present Agent-Canary-Mas, an end-to-end evaluation system that follows protocol risk through long-horizon multi-agent tasks. It covers five risk classes and 13 subclasses across A2A, ANP, and BCS, with 975 matched malicious--benign task pairs in five business domains. A shared OpenClaw framework runs autonomous, tool-using agents under different underlying models while preserving the task and execution setup. Matched runs separate local protocol success from downstream consequences; retained evidence connects participant selection, message consumption, tool activity, and task-state changes. We further evaluate a protocol-context Guard that checks an object's authority at consequential handoffs.
  Across three model conditions, local attack success is frequently at or above 90%, while consequence conversion ranges from 7.1\% to 100.0\%. Cross-agent evidence raises macro-averaged Audit-F1 from 29.7% to 95.5%. On Finance tasks, the Guard lowers average ASR from 86.1% to 53.8% and PTCR from 65.5% to 31.2%, with a measurable completion tradeoff. These results show that protocol risk depends on how agents use exchanged objects throughout the task, and that evaluating this path supports more informative risk assessment, attribution, and defense.

</details>


### [674] [Self-Representation Alignment in Diffusion Models for Video Background Music Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15575)
*Jincheng Zhang,György Fazekas,Charalampos Saitis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 U-SRA 扩散 U-Net 自表示对齐架构，通过显式对齐低噪声后期层与高噪声早期层的内部表示，提升视频背景音乐生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型广泛用于生成任务，但其去噪过程中的内部表示不够有意义，制约了生成性能。作者希望解决这一表示质量问题。

Method: 提出 Diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment（U-SRA）：在训练中，将较早层、较高噪声条件下的较弱表示，显式对齐到较晚层、较低噪声条件下的更好表示，并引入对齐损失来引导模型学习良好的内部表示；同时采用交叉注意力机制实现音乐与视频片段的同步。任务设定为视频背景音乐生成（符号音乐）。

Result: 在基准视频-音乐数据集上的实验表明，U-SRA 在视频-音乐对齐和整体音乐质量等关键评价指标上均优于当前最先进方法。

Conclusion: 显式对齐扩散模型内部跨层/跨噪声水平表示，可有效提升内部表示质量，从而改善视频背景音乐生成的同步性与音乐质量，验证了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Diffusion models have been widely used for various generative tasks. However, recent studies have demonstrated that the internal representations learned in the diffusion models' denoising process are insufficiently meaningful, which can hinder the generation performance. To address this, we propose a novel diffusion U-Net architecture enhanced by explicitly aligning the weaker representation from the earlier layer conditioned on higher noise with the better representation from the later layer conditioned on lower noise during training, which we use for the challenging multimodal task of video background music generation. Our diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment (U-SRA) employs an alignment loss to effectively guide our diffusion model to learn good internal representations, thereby enabling it to produce higher-quality symbolic music conditioned on video features. We employ a cross-attention mechanism to synchronize music with video segments. Experiments on a benchmark video-music dataset demonstrate that the proposed U-SRA approach for video background music generation surpasses the state-of-the-art across key evaluation metrics, including video-music alignment and overall music quality.

</details>


### [675] [Inverse Garment Design with Visual Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15582)
*Nanxiang Jiang,Yunuo Chen,Zeng Tao,Zizhang Li,Qi Guo,Jiajun Wu,Yin Yang,Chenfanfu Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 DressAgent，一种分层智能体系统，可从单张图像逆向重建多层可仿真 3D 服装缝制样板，通过规划与基于物理仿真的闭环细化，性能大幅超越前馈方法并接近或达到可微优化水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆向服装设计（从单图重建可仿真的 3D 服装）面临两难：可微优化耗时长，前馈方法受训练数据限制；同时多层任意穿搭的缝制样板表示与数据均缺失。

Method: 1) 基于 GarmentCode 提出支持多样风格与任意穿搭层数的增强表示，构建首个含 1.5 万余套服装的多层缝制样板数据集；2) 由粗到细：图层规划与粗估计阶段，智能体推断层序与层间关系、逐层剥离视图并估计粗样板；精细细化阶段，由 Tailor、Critic、Orchestrator 组成智能体三元组，以编辑—仿真—评判的闭环，结合视觉与测量证据对照参考进行迭代；3) 设计专用工具与演化记忆保证收敛；4) 提出智能体式高保真纹理生成方法。

Result: DressAgent 大幅优于前馈方法，在极少时间内超过或匹配可微优化，并可泛化到复杂层叠、多样姿态与体型。

Conclusion: 以智能体规划加物理仿真闭环细化的范式，可高效且高质量地完成多层服装逆向设计与纹理生成，为可仿真服装重建提供了新路径。

Abstract: We study the problem of inverse garment design, reconstructing simulation-ready 3D outfits with arbitrary layers from a single image, with visual agents. Unlike differentiable optimization that is time-consuming, or feed-forward methods limited by training data, we introduce DressAgent, a hierarchical agentic system that recovers garment sewing patterns through planning and closed-loop refinement grounded in physical simulation. To this end, we first present an enhanced representation based on GarmentCode for diverse styles and arbitrary dressing layers, and build the first multi-layer sewing pattern dataset with over 15K outfits for supervision and benchmarking. Inverse design then proceeds coarse to fine: In layer planning and coarse estimation, agents infer layer order and relations, peel each layer into its own view, and estimate coarse patterns. In fine-grained refinement, an agentic trio of Tailor, Critic, and Orchestrator refines patterns in a closed loop of editing, simulating, and judging against the reference with visual and measured evidence. Carefully designed tools and an evolving memory make this refinement converge on the target geometry. We also design an agentic generation method for high-fidelity textures. DressAgent outperforms feed-forward methods by a large margin, surpasses or matches differentiable optimization in a fraction of the time, and generalizes to complex layering, diverse poses, and body shapes.

</details>


### [676] [CondMSP: Condition-Informed and Resource-Aware Inorganic Materials Synthesis Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15603)
*Heewoong Noh,Gyoung S. Na,Elton Pan,Namkyeong Lee,Chanyoung Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CondMSP将材料合成规划（MSP）从"配方预测"扩展到"执行感知规划"，把温度/时间/气氛预测同时用作过程上下文与执行需求，并在炉预算约束下联合选路与热阶段分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MSP方法分别或成对预测前驱体、合成操作与工艺条件，且仅把条件当作预测目标而非过程上下文；因此未探索条件如何支撑合成路线构建，也未解决在有限实验资源下应执行哪些候选路线的问题。

Method: 提出CondMSP：用联合预测器加变量专属专家预测温度、时间与气氛；将预测结果既作为过程上下文（用于操作序列的生成与检索），又作为执行需求（界定哪些热阶段可共享一次炉次及相应成本）；该执行需求规格在所有对比方法中保持固定；在此规格内，按统一效用对跨前驱体集合的路线排序，并在炉预算下通过受限优化联合选择路线与分配其热阶段。

Result: CondMSP提升了条件与操作预测性能；在共享约束下，参考配方复现率由27.9%提升至32.9%（每目标3次模拟炉次），由34.7%提升至40.0%（30次试验）；并新增包含2,344个目标的评测集，支持对以氧化物为主训练化学体系之外的泛化。

Conclusion: CondMSP把MSP由配方预测推进为执行感知规划，验证了条件作为过程上下文与执行需求的双重作用，并通过受限优化在有限炉预算下提升路线选择的实际可执行性与复现效果。

Abstract: Materials synthesis planning (MSP) connects AI-driven materials discovery to experimental realization by proposing precursors, synthesis operations, and processing conditions for a target material. Existing approaches predict these components separately or in pairs and treat conditions only as a prediction target. Consequently, MSP remains centered on recipe prediction: it leaves unexplored how conditions can serve as process context for constructing synthesis routes, and it does not address which candidate routes should be executed under limited experimental resources. We propose CondMSP, which extends MSP from recipe prediction to execution-aware planning. CondMSP predicts temperature, time, and atmosphere by combining a joint predictor with variable-specific experts, and then uses these predictions both as process context, grounding the generation and retrieval of operation sequences, and as execution requirements, specifying which thermal stages can share a furnace run and at what cost. This specification is held fixed across all compared methods; within it, CondMSP ranks routes across precursor sets by a common utility and, under furnace budgets, jointly selects routes and allocates their thermal stages by constrained optimization. CondMSP improves condition and operation prediction and, under this shared constraint, raises reference-recipe recovery from 27.9% to 32.9% at three simulated furnace runs per target and from 34.7% to 40.0% at 30 trials, while a new evaluation set of 2,344 targets supports generalization beyond oxide-dominated training chemistry.

</details>


### [677] [From Stages to States: Unified Iterative Reasoning for MLLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15620)
*Chuang Yu,Xuefei Ma,Yuanhao Feng,Wuxiong Zeng,Bo Wang,Minghong Cai,Dongming Wu,Fei Zhou,Chen Tang,Wenwen Tong,Lewei Lu,Xiangyu Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ReState，将多模态思维链从阶段驱动的流水线重构为状态驱动的动态迭代过程，缓解推理碎片化与训练-推理状态差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于学习的多模态思维链方法多采用阶段中心范式，将不同推理行为分配到预定义阶段分别优化，导致推理过程碎片化，并产生训练与推理之间的推理状态差距。

Method: ReState包含两个互补组件：统一推理状态建模（URSM）与闭环推理状态学习（CRSL）。URSM将推理构建、正确推理保持与错误推理纠正统一为共享状态空间中的状态转移，实现异构推理行为的联合学习；CRSL在训练中引入自生成的历史推理状态，并在推理时递归更新当前状态。此外构建了覆盖八个视觉推理领域的高质量数据集VersaCoT-10K。

Result: 大量实验表明，ReState在不同多模态大模型主干上具有较强适应性，并在多个公开推理基准上取得优异性能。

Conclusion: ReState支持从阶段中心推理向状态中心推理的范式转变，无需额外反思模块、评论器或独立纠正阶段即可实现迭代自我精炼。

Abstract: Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) substantially enhances the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by explicitly modeling intermediate reasoning processes. However, most learning-based MCoT methods follow a stage-centric paradigm, where different reasoning behaviors are assigned to predefined stages and optimized separately. This results in fragmented reasoning and a training-inference reasoning-state gap. To address these limitations, we propose ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework that reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process. It comprises two complementary components: Unified Reasoning State Modeling (URSM) and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning (CRSL). URSM unifies reasoning construction, correct reasoning preservation, and erroneous reasoning correction as reasoning-state transitions within a shared state space, enabling these heterogeneous reasoning behaviors to be learned jointly. CRSL further incorporates self-generated historical reasoning states during training and recursively updates the current state during inference, thereby mitigating the reasoning-state gap and enabling iterative self-refinement without requiring an additional reflection module, critic, or independent correction stage. Furthermore, we construct VersaCoT-10K, a high-quality CoT dataset spanning eight visual reasoning domains, which provides diverse supervision for multi-domain reasoning and reasoning-state refinement.
