*Chen Huang,Yiyang Zhang,Yuhao Wu,Yang Deng,Wenxuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark（UnCoBench），将多智能体协作中的不可靠行为分为错位、不完整与无响应三类，并设计可验证的自动生成流水线，揭示相似可靠设定性能无法保证不可靠证据下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体协作系统与评测普遍隐含“完美同事假设”，即协作者始终提供正确完整信息并及时响应；而现实团队中可能出现答非所问、细节不足或不予响应等情况。因此需要将任务求解能力与不可靠证据收集过程的恢复能力加以区分和评测。

Method: 提出UnCoBench基准，按Misaligned、Incomplete、Missed三类行为失败组织任务；主智能体需验证上下文正确性、诊断信息缺口并追踪未解决依赖以获取正确证据。同时提出可验证、可扩展的自动生成流水线，结合基于LLM的场景生成与答案唯一性和角色必要性可执行检查。

Result: 十个模型的实验显示，相似的可靠设定性能可能对应不同的不可靠证据鲁棒性；轨迹分析发现纠正式后续行动常被遗漏，恢复行为存在低效等待与冗余查询。

Conclusion: 鲁棒协作不仅需要合理推理，还需有针对性的行动来诊断证据失败、恢复相关信息并整合进决策；数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent collaboration is increasingly used to solve complex tasks by dividing work among specialized agents and integrating complementary expertise. Yet existing systems and evaluations largely rest on an implicit perfect-colleague assumption: collaborators provide correct and complete information and respond promptly to requests. In realistic teamwork, however, collaborators may return information that does not answer the intended question, provide insufficient detail to support a decision, or fail to respond to a request. To separate task-solving competence from the ability to recover an unreliable evidence-gathering process, we introduce the Unreliable Colleagues Benchmark (UnCoBench), which organizes behavioral failures through Misaligned, Incomplete, and Missed settings. The main agent need to verify contextual correctness, diagnose information gap and track unresolved dependencies in order to obtain the correct evidence for solving the task. We also introduce a verifiable and scalable automated generation pipeline that pairs LLM-based scenario generation with executable checks of answer uniqueness and role necessity. Results across ten models show that similar reliable-setting performance can result in different robustness to unreliable evidence. Trace analysis reveals frequent omissions of corrective follow-up, and the recovery behavior involves inefficient waiting and redundant queries. These findings show that robust collaboration requires not only sound reasoning, but also targeted action to diagnose evidence failures, recover relevant information, and integrate it into decisions. Our data and source code are available at https://github.com/iNLP-Lab/UnCoBench.

</details>


### [711] [Imitation Holds a Key to Evolution: Localized Repair and Verified Skill Acquisition for Adaptive Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16125)
*Kai Hu,Hua Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出被动模仿（PI）：一种通过定位违反契约、提取局部目标、提出效应匹配技能、测试小补丁并在全任务验证后保留证据的架构循环；将其实例化为确定性符号控制器，分析有限修复查询复杂度，并在模拟工具环境中验证其高效的任务组合修复能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体能够保留成功轨迹，却往往不知道经验中的哪一部分应被用于修复新的偏差。现有方法缺少对"定位偏差—局部修复—验证保留"机制的明确刻画与复杂度分析。

Method: 将被动模仿（PI）形式化为架构循环：定位被违反的契约、提取局部目标、提出效应匹配的技能、测试小补丁、并在全任务验证通过后保留证据。将该循环实例化为确定性符号控制器，在显式的可辨识性与非干涉性假设下分析其有限修复查询复杂度，并设置全轨迹对照、同等表达力的组合式修复对照以及小试验枚举等条件进行对比。

Result: 在十个模拟工具世界中，PI 在允许三次小试验的情况下解决了全部 600 个冷启动留出组合任务，而全轨迹对照仅 6.17%；同等表达力的组合式修复对照与 PI 表现相当。在未见过的工具修订版本上，PI 成功率为 70.0%，无小试验时为 24.0%，自试验枚举时为 79.0%；随后的 24 任务探索性适应流将首次提交成功率提升至 100%。

Conclusion: 结果支持一种有限的"纠正—保留"机制，而非独特激励优势或通用智能；该机制在冷启动组合与工具修订场景下显著优于全轨迹控制，且成本较低。

Abstract: An agent can retain successful trajectories without learning which part of an experience should repair a new discrepancy. We formulate passive imitation (PI) as an architectural loop that localizes a violated contract, extracts a local goal, proposes an effect-matched skill, tests a small patch, and retains evidence after full-task verification. We instantiate this loop as a deterministic symbolic controller and analyze its finite repair-query complexity under explicit identifiability and noninterference assumptions. Across ten simulated tool worlds, PI solves all 600 cold held-out composition tasks with three allowed small trials, compared with 6.17% for a whole-trajectory control, while an equally expressive compositional repair control matches PI. On an unseen tool revision, PI achieves 70.0% success versus 24.0% without small trials and 79.0% with self-trial enumeration; an exploratory 24-task adaptation stream subsequently raises first-submission success to 100%, supporting a limited correction-and-retention mechanism rather than a unique incentive advantage or general intelligence. The CPU-only implementation, integrity checks, and reproducible results are available at https://github.com/FriendOfYishan/PI.

</details>


### [712] [Large Language Model Assisted Transportation Planning through a Differentiable User Equilibrium Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16140)
*Eunseung Lee,Gyeongjun Kim,Keemin Sohn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出一个集成了大语言模型、MCP接口、开源交通规划引擎AequilibraE以及可微用户均衡分配层的"人—AI"交通规划框架，使非专家用户能通过自然语言完成网络分析与方案优化，并以出行时间函数标定和预算约束下的网络设计两个任务进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统交通规划在网络建模、交通分配与优化方面门槛很高，导致网络设计、容量扩展、模型标定等战略性分析对非专家决策者不可及。现有基于LLM的系统多仅充当仿真软件的交互界面，缺乏高效搜索、评估与优化交通方案的能力。

Method: 构建集成式人—AI交通规划框架，包含四个组件：大语言模型、模型上下文协议（MCP）接口、开源交通规划引擎AequilibraE，以及可微用户均衡（UE）分配层。其中可微UE层通过对Beckmann交通分配问题的KKT条件直接求导实现，从而支持基于梯度的搜索与优化。

Result: 在两个代表性规划任务上进行了演示：一是基于观测交通流量标定出行时间函数，二是预算约束下的网络设计。案例表明，可微交通模型与LLM智能体能够协同工作，有效完成分析与优化。

Conclusion: 可微交通模型与LLM智能体的结合可推动交通规划的民主化，显著降低领域专业知识与交通决策之间的壁垒，使非专家用户也能参与战略性规划分析。

Abstract: Transportation planning has traditionally required substantial expertise in network modeling, traffic assignment, and optimization. As a result, strategic analyses such as network design, capacity expansion, and model calibration remain inaccessible to non-expert decision makers. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) provide an opportunity to bridge this gap by enabling natural-language interaction with complex transportation planning tools. However, existing LLM-based systems primarily serve as interfaces to simulation software and lack the ability to efficiently search, evaluate, and optimize transportation solutions. This study proposes an integrated human-AI transportation planning framework that combines a large language model, a model context protocol (MCP) interface, an open-source transportation planning engine (AequilibraE), and a differentiable user equilibrium (UE) assignment layer. The framework allows non-expert users to execute network analyses and improve solutions for optimization. A differentiable UE layer is developed by directly differentiating the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions of the Beckmann traffic assignment problem. The proposed framework is demonstrated through two representative planning tasks: calibration of travel time functions from observed traffic counts and network design under budget constraints. The examples illustrate how differentiable transportation models and LLM agents can jointly democratize transportation planning and substantially reduce barriers between domain expertise and transportation decision making.

</details>


### [713] [Phantom Merge: When Your Large Language Model Agents Pick One but Tell You About Another](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16141)
*Wangshu Zhu,Qianwen Guo,Yushun Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文识别了LLM智能体中的"幻影合并"（Phantom Merge, PM）现象，即实体-证据绑定失败，并提出两阶段框架AGR（锚点接地风险估计）与FAC（固定锚点纠错）进行检测与缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体需在多实体场景下生成可靠响应，不仅要检索相关证据，还须保持证据与正确实体的关联。作者发现现有方法忽视了实体-证据绑定失败问题，即智能体可能将无支持的论断归因于其承诺的实体，即使任务已正确完成。

Method: 1) 在claim级别形式化PM，并在四个智能体领域和四个骨干模型家族中刻画其普遍性与错误子类型；2) 提出两阶段框架：AGR（Anchor-Grounded Risk）结合预发射隐藏状态的表示读出与基于Jacobian的功能信息，提供互补的slot级和anchor-value风险分数；3) FAC（Fixed-Anchor Correction）对标记的claim进行审计，利用观测到的anchor证据选择性修订，若无支持替换则删除。

Result: 在留出的Shopping检测队列上，AGR-slot达到96.2% AUROC和97.3%平均精度，优于所评估的检测基线；在端到端Shopping缓解评估中，FAC将轨迹级PM从51.4%降至6.2%，输出与原始claim比率为80.7%。

Conclusion: 结果表明实体特定接地失败的普遍性，以及结合内部风险估计与证据约束claim纠错的有效性。代码已公开于https://github.com/LabRAI/PhantomMerge。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate over multiple entities, where reliable response generation requires not only retrieving relevant evidence but also preserving its association with the correct entity. We identify Phantom Merge (PM), an entity-evidence binding failure in which an agent attributes unsupported claims to its committed entity, potentially even when the task is completed correctly. We formalize PM at the claim level and characterize its prevalence and error subtypes across four agent domains and four backbone families. To address this problem, we propose a two-stage framework for claim-level risk estimation and correction. First, Anchor-Grounded Risk (AGR) combines a representational readout of the agent's pre-emission hidden state with Jacobian-based functional information, providing complementary slot-level and anchor-value risk scores. Second, Fixed-Anchor Correction (FAC) audits flagged claims and selectively revises them using observed anchor evidence or removes them when no supported replacement is available. On the held-out Shopping detection cohort, AGR-slot achieves an AUROC of 96.2% and an average precision of 97.3%, outperforming the evaluated detection baselines. In the end-to-end Shopping mitigation evaluation, FAC reduces trajectory-level PM from 51.4% to 6.2%, with an output-to-original claim ratio of 80.7%. These results demonstrate the prevalence of entity-specific grounding failures and the effectiveness of combining internal risk estimation with evidence-constrained claim correction. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/LabRAI/PhantomMerge.

</details>


### [714] [Pollard: Governed Semantic Execution Trees for Framework-Independent AI Agent Control and Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16145)
*Muntaser Syed,Marius C. Silaghi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Pollard：一种框架无关的治理语义执行树运行时，以步骤身份统一执行、治理与重放的标识，并在多组实验中验证了严格重放、并发租约协调、语义变更检测与树完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Agent 框架虽支持检查点持久化、工具调用追踪与资源限制，但执行、治理与重放各自使用不同身份标识，导致三者语义不一致，难以保证重放可验证性与治理结果的可追溯性。

Method: 基于受治理的语义执行树构建框架无关运行时。步骤身份承诺规范化输入、kind、尝试次数与父身份；同一棵树记录完成、拒绝、资源结算与分支历史。严格重放直接返回已验证的存储结果而不调用被包装操作；事务型存储协调并发工作者的预留。在签名确定性冻结下进行双状态模型副本、保留租约 PostgreSQL 组、严格重放与语义变更检测等实验，并开展多配对框架矩阵与成本受限托管研究。

Result: 两个状态模型副本执行评估迁移均无不变式违反；保留租约 PostgreSQL 组对照精确限额通过测试；严格重放未产生外部调用；所有语义变更均被检出且对照组无误报；多配对框架矩阵保持参考行为并通过树验证；成本受限托管研究中每条完成的 Pollard 试验都生成经验证的树。

Conclusion: 在明确的租约、边界与封印托管假设下，各实验共同支持该核心机制的有效性。

Abstract: Agent frameworks can persist checkpoints, trace tool calls, and limit resource use, but these facilities often assign different identities to execution, governance, and replay. We present Pollard, a framework-independent runtime based on governed semantic execution trees. A step identity commits to canonical input, kind, attempt, and parent identity; the same tree records completion, refusal, resource settlement, and branch history. Strict replay returns a verified stored result without invoking the wrapped operation, while a transactional store coordinates reservations across concurrent workers. Under a signed deterministic freeze, two state-model replicas each executed the evaluation transitions without an invariant violation, retained-lease PostgreSQL groups were tested against exact limits, strict replay avoided external calls, and all semantic mutations were detected with no false alarms on the controls. A multi-pair framework matrix preserved reference behavior and verified the trees. A separate cost-capped hosted study exercised live provider paths, and every completed Pollard trial produced a verified tree. Together, the studies support the core mechanisms under explicit lease, boundary, and seal-custody assumptions.

</details>


### [715] [Uncovering Robustness Weaknesses in LLM Agents via Persona Evolution with Task-Integrity Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16155)
*Yutao Xie,Jingbo Yang,Guanyu Yao,Xiaoyu Yang,Duo Ding,Shiyu Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 TIPER，一种保持任务完整性的用户人格演化方法，通过反思引导的行为变异和任务级 Pareto 选择自动发现针对特定智能体的用户策略，暴露交互式智能体的鲁棒性弱点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交互式智能体评测多依赖标准化、行为普遍配合的 LLM 用户模拟器，可能掩盖真实多样用户交互下的失败，导致对鲁棒性的过度乐观估计，并缺乏有效训练信号；而现有方法依赖预定义用户行为（可能遗漏特定智能体或领域的弱点），或采用面向失败的搜索（会通过使任务失效而非暴露真实鲁棒性缺陷来降低任务成功率）。

Method: TIPER 在任务完整性约束下演化持久化的用户人格，利用反思引导的行为变异（reflection-guided behavioral mutations）与任务级 Pareto 选择（task-wise Pareto selection）来搜索既能暴露鲁棒性弱点、又保证底层任务有效且可解的用户策略。

Result: 在四个交互式智能体基准上，TIPER 在全部 12 个 GPT-5.4 设置中均降低留出集 avg@3 分数，观测下降 5.8 至 33.7 个百分点；在横跨七种智能体的全部 28 个智能体-领域组合中同样全部下降，中位观测降幅为 22.9 个百分点。进一步分析给出行为到失败的分类体系，将发现的用户行为与常见智能体失败模式关联。

Conclusion: TIPER 能够实现更具诊断性的交互式智能体鲁棒性评测，并为未来智能体鲁棒性改进提供有信息量的失败分析。代码开源。

Abstract: Interactive-agent evaluations commonly rely on standardized LLM-based user simulators that exhibit broadly cooperative behavior, potentially overlooking failures that arise under diverse but realistic user interactions. This can lead to overly optimistic estimates of agent robustness and provide limited failure signals for training agents that generalize across users. Existing approaches largely rely on predefined user behaviors, which may miss agent- or domain-specific weaknesses, while failure-oriented search can reduce task success by invalidating the underlying task rather than exposing genuine robustness failures. To fill this gap, we introduce TIPER, a task-integrity-preserving persona evolution method that automatically discovers agent-specific user policies exposing robustness weaknesses while keeping the underlying task valid and solvable. TIPER evolves persistent user personas through reflection-guided behavioral mutations and task-wise Pareto selection under a task-integrity constraint. Across four interactive-agent benchmarks, TIPER yields lower held-out avg@3 scores in all 12 GPT-5.4 settings, with observed reductions of 5.8 to 33.7 percentage points, and in all 28 agent-domain pairs spanning seven agents, with a median observed reduction of 22.9 points. Further analysis yields a behavior-to-failure taxonomy that connects discovered user behaviors to recurring agent failure modes. Together, these results show that TIPER enables more diagnostic robustness evaluation of interactive agents and provides informative failure analysis for future agent robustness improvement. Code repository: https://github.com/UCSB-NLP-Chang/TIPER.

</details>


### [716] [Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting under Moving-Solid Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16167)
*Jongwon Ryu,Sunjae Yoon,Junyeong Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"交互式4D体积液体预测"新任务，并设计两级循环预测框架TIDE/TIDES，在动态固体条件下的全域液体响应预测中取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法仅能预测静态或预设几何周围的流动，或合成视觉上合理的流体运动，无法预测移动固体如何引发未来全域液体响应，因而对交互式液体动力学覆盖不足；该任务可为机器人液体操作、数字孪生和刚-流视频生成提供上游物理预测原语。

Method: 提出TIDE/TIDES两级循环预测框架：TIDE隔离局部界面驱动的预测；TIDES在此基础上加入传输感知耦合与显式稳定化，以降低累积的rollout误差。实验涵盖适配的邻近基线、受控组件消融、运动/尺寸OOD测试与长时程评估。

Result: 在各类实验中，TIDES取得最佳预测性能；消融实验表明局部交互、传输耦合与稳定化是关键贡献因素。

Conclusion: 该工作的任务定义、基准与TIDE/TIDES研究共同为移动固体条件下的稠密液体预测建立了可控基础，代码已开源。

Abstract: We propose the task of Interactive 4D Volumetric Liquid Forecasting: predicting the spatiotemporal evolution of a future dense 3D liquid velocity field conditioned on how a solid object moves through it. This task provides an upstream physical forecasting primitive for systems that need to reason about motion-conditioned liquid response, including robotic liquid manipulation, digital twins, and rigid-fluid video generation. Existing works have made efforts in predicting flow around static or prescribed solid geometries and synthesizing visually plausible fluid motion. Yet these approaches provide limited coverage for interactive liquid dynamics, as they are not capable of forecasting how a moving solid induces a future full-domain liquid response. In this forecasting scenario, the hydrodynamic effect is condensed near an evolving liquid-solid interface, but the prediction target is a global spatiotemporal rollout. To address this challenge, we propose a two-level recurrent forecasting framework, TIDE/TIDES: TIDE isolates localized interface-driven forecasting, while TIDES adds transport-aware coupling and explicit stabilization to reduce accumulated rollout error. Across adapted neighboring baselines, controlled component ablations, motion/size OOD tests, and long-horizon evaluation, TIDES achieves the best forecasting performance and the ablations identify localized interaction, transport coupling, and stabilization as the key contributors. Together, our task formulation, benchmark, and TIDE/TIDES study establish a controlled foundation for moving-solid-conditioned dense liquid forecasting. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/jongwonryu/TIDE-TIDES.

</details>


### [717] [ProCARE: Real-World Study Automation via Profile-Grounded Evidence Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16175)
*Zhaoyu Fan,Bowen Han,Jincheng Ou,Yanwei Ren,Zehua He,Kaiyu Huang,Pengcheng He,Shanshan Ni,Chengchen Gong,Shuai Xue,Qingjiang Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ProCARE框架，将真实世界研究(RWS)自动化重构为"受约束的编译"过程，通过证据契约与强类型中间表示提升LLM智能体分析的可靠性与可追溯性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界研究基于电子健康档案、保险理赔等常规收集数据分析疗效、安全性及风险因素，但其有效分析依赖数据集特有的临床语义（如索引日期、随访窗口、患者/事件级分析单位、结局边界），这些语义在观察性数据中往往是隐式的。直接用大语言模型智能体自动化RWS因而脆弱，易产生模式不匹配、时间错误、分析粒度不一致及缺乏依据的临床结论。

Method: ProCARE是一个基于数据画像(profile-grounded)的框架，将RWS自动化视为受约束的编译：(1)把异构数据画像转换为"证据契约"(Evidence Contracts)，明确可用变量、时间属性、分布及证据边界；(2)将研究目标编译为RWS-IR，一种用于表达变量、时间关系、分析单位与统计任务的强类型中间表示；(3)通过确定性验证与局部化修复，对模式映射、队列构建、变量派生、分析与解释各环节进行校验和修正。

Result: 在36个基于EHR的基准任务上，ProCARE在代码可执行性、语义一致性和结论可追溯性方面优于强LLM智能体基线；其自动违规诊断与盲法专家评审达成中等至显著的一致性。

Conclusion: 将RWS自动化形式化为受约束的编译流程，并借助证据契约与强类型中间表示，可有效缓解LLM智能体在真实世界研究中的脆弱性，提高分析的可执行性、语义一致性与结论可追溯性。

Abstract: Real-world studies (RWS) analyze routinely collected healthcare data, such as electronic health records and insurance claims, to estimate treatment effects, monitor safety, and identify risk factors outside randomized trials. Automating RWS with large language model agents is appealing but brittle: valid analyses depend on dataset-specific clinical semantics, including index dates, follow-up windows, patient/event-level units, and outcome boundaries that are often implicit in observational data. This leads to schema mismatches, temporal errors, inconsistent analytical granularity, and unsupported clinical claims. We present ProCARE, a profile-grounded framework that reformulates RWS automation as constrained compilation. ProCARE converts heterogeneous data profiles into Evidence Contracts specifying available variables, temporal attributes, distributions, and evidentiary limits, and compiles study objectives into RWS-IR, a strongly typed intermediate representation for variables, time relations, analysis units, and statistical tasks. Deterministic validation and localized repair then check and revise generated workflows across schema mapping, cohort construction, variable derivation, analysis, and interpretation. On 36 EHR-based benchmark tasks, ProCARE outperforms strong LLM-agent baselines in code executability, semantic consistency, and conclusion traceability, with automated violation diagnoses showing moderate-to-substantial agreement with blinded expert review.

</details>


### [718] [Label-Centric Knowledge Retrieval for Zero-Shot Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16182)
*Daoping Wu,Dong Wang,Siyu Liu,Chen Liang,Jian Geng,Ziqi Li,Shuguang Xiong,Ying Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SLKR框架，通过离线构建标签知识库、在线轻量检索，用轻量LLM实现零样本文本分类，兼具旗舰模型的语义知识与低推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旗舰大语言模型具备丰富通用知识与推理能力，但推理成本高、延迟大，难以用于大规模数据标注；而零样本分类中任务描述与标签语义信息未被充分利用，缺乏可复用的标签知识来支撑轻量模型。

Method: SLKR（Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval）以标签为中心，将离线知识构建与在线轻量推理解耦。离线阶段由旗舰LLM针对标签空间（而非输入语料）独立生成标签定义、检索关键词及易混淆标签对的边界规则，形成可复用的标签知识库，一次性开销可摊销至大规模推理；在线阶段先用语义与词汇混合检索选出Top-K候选标签，再选取至多M条与输入相关的边界规则，轻量LLM单次调用完成分类。

Result: 在三个公开基准及一个真实多语言图书分类数据集上，Qwen3.5-4B在全部四个数据集上取得最佳结果，Ministral-3-3B在四个中的三个取得最佳；同时使用紧凑输入上下文，且无需任务专属标注样例。边界消融表明仅检索少量与输入相关规则即可接近使用全部边界的性能，且上下文显著减少。

Conclusion: 将旗舰模型生成的标签知识高效复用于轻量分类是可行且有效的，检索少量输入相关边界规则可在低上下文成本下保持性能，支持大规模零样本文本分类场景。

Abstract: Flagship large language models (LLMs) offer rich general knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but their high inference cost and latency limit their use for large-scale data labeling. We study zero-shot text classification with semantically meaningful labels and task descriptions, without task-specific labeled examples or classifier feedback. We propose \textbf{SLKR} (Semantic Label Knowledge Retrieval), a label-centric retrieval-augmented generation framework that separates offline knowledge construction from lightweight online inference. Offline, a flagship LLM independently generates label definitions, retrieval keywords, and boundary rules for potentially confusable label pairs, forming a reusable label-knowledge store. Because this construction operates over the label space rather than the input corpus, its one-time flagship cost can be amortized across large-scale inference. Online, hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval first identifies the top-$K$ candidate labels and then selects up to $M$ input-relevant boundary rules connecting candidate-label pairs. A lightweight LLM performs the final classification in a single call using the retrieved definitions and rules. Across three public benchmarks and a real-world multilingual book-classification dataset, SLKR achieves the best results on all four datasets with Qwen3.5-4B and on three of four with Ministral-3-3B, while using compact input contexts and no task-specific labeled examples. Boundary ablations further show that retrieving a small set of input-relevant rules preserves performance close to using all boundaries with substantially less context, supporting efficient reuse of flagship-generated label knowledge for lightweight classification.

</details>


### [719] [Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16191)
*Tianyou Lai,Wentao Yue,Zhiying Deng,Qilei Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出Choice2Seq诊断基准，通过在同一问题与候选集上独立进行的“完整答案选择”和“逐步构造”两项任务，衡量模型在序列化局部决策中能否保持已选正确答案，并提出序列组合率(SCR)指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型可能在完整答案选择时选对，却无法通过一系列局部决策正确构造出该答案，说明“选择正确”与“构造正确”之间存在被忽视的能力差距，现有评测未能揭示这一问题。

Method: 构建Choice2Seq基准，在同一问题与候选集上分别评测完整答案选择与顺序构造；提出序列组合率(SCR)度量被正确选择项在局部构造中仍被正确作答的比例；并在Jev、StartLux、Qwen等模型上进行算术与词汇检索等任务评测，辅以限制局部选项为候选支持字符、显式位置索引等干预，以及匹配对话状态评测和序列级置信度与请求代价分析。

Result: Jev在算术和词汇检索上的选择准确率分别达97.1%与99.5%，但在串行构造下仅保留33.0%与2.1%的正确选择；StartLux与Qwen也出现显著差距，包括Qwen直接输出字符时。将局部选项限制为候选支持的字符可提升构造表现，显式位置索引可提升复制保真度，即使对错误选择也有效。匹配对话状态评测显示，局部字段构造基本保持Jev的正确状态，但降低Qwen的平均轮次准确率。

Conclusion: 选择准确率高并不代表序列构造能力可靠，二者存在显著鸿沟。该基准及干预手段可区分任务正确性、计划保真度与输出合规性，且差距具有任务与接口依赖性。

Abstract: A model may select the correct answer yet fail to construct it through a sequence of local decisions. We introduce Choice2Seq, a diagnostic benchmark that measures correctness retention across complete-answer selection and sequential construction in independent runs on the same problems and candidate sets. Sequence Composition Rate (SCR) measures the fraction of correctly selected items that are also answered correctly through local construction. Jev achieves 97.1% and 99.5% selection accuracy on arithmetic and lexical retrieval, yet retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of those correct choices under serial construction, respectively. Substantial gaps also emerge for StartLux and Qwen, including when Qwen emits characters directly. Restricting local options to candidate-supported characters improves construction, while explicit position indexing improves copying fidelity, even for incorrect selections. These interventions distinguish task correctness, plan fidelity, and output compliance. Matched dialogue-state evaluations reveal that local field construction largely preserves Jev's correct states but reduces Qwen's mean-turn accuracy, highlighting task- and interface-dependent differences. Sequence-level confidence and request-cost analyses further characterize completed outputs.

</details>


### [720] [OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16219)
*Seunghan Lee,Jun Seo,Jaehoon Lee,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ONESHOT：利用单个已确认异常对检测器池进行加权软混合，而非选择单一检测器，在大量单变量与多变量序列上优于最强单检测器、池平均及在确认事件上选最优检测器的策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测缺乏通用检测器，最优选择取决于序列本身；现有方法为每条序列选一个检测器或对检测器池取平均，但两者均假设永远没有标签到达，而实际部署的监控系统会收到操作员对报警的确认标签。

Method: ONESHOT用单个已确认异常来对检测器池进行加权而非选择单一检测器：在确认异常上对每个检测器打分，得分作为整个池上软混合的权重。

Result: 在152条单变量和73条多变量序列上，ONESHOT优于最强单检测器、整个池的平均，甚至优于在确认事件上挑选最优检测器的策略。

Conclusion: 单个已确认异常足以接近该序列的最优检测器，表明利用少量在线确认标签的软加权混合是可扩展且有效的异常检测方案。

Abstract: Time series (TS) anomaly detection (AD) lacks a universal detector, with the best choice determined by the series rather than by the algorithm. Existing methods therefore either select one detector for each series or average a pool of them. However, both assume that no label ever arrives, while a deployed monitor does receive them, since an operator confirms the alarms it raises. In this paper, we propose ONESHOT, which uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight the pool rather than to choose one detector from it. Specifically, we score each detector on the confirmed anomaly, and those scores become the weights of a soft mixture over the whole pool. We show that a single confirmed anomaly is enough to come close to the best detector for the series. Across 152 univariate and 73 multivariate series, ONESHOT outperforms the strongest single detector, averaging the whole pool, and even picking the best detector on the confirmed event. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/one_shot.

</details>


### [721] [Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16231)
*Ziyi Liu,Tzu-Sheng Kuo,Jiale Liu,Deqing Fu,Nithum Thain,Crystal Qian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GUIDE框架，用于开发可跨多类多方沟通场景的通用LLM引导者，并通过离线自学习策略实现实时干预。基于432段人类多方对话与20名人类标注者对齐的LLM裁判反馈，自学习出的单一通用引导者在留出对话上以61.4%胜率超越三个任务特定专家引导者；在线实证研究进一步显示其保持引导表现与群体生产力，提升发言舒适度、降低人际摩擦，同时比专家提示少用24.7%轮次与29.0%词数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地被用作多方沟通的促进者，需要能够适应不同情境下多样化群体动态的引导代理。然而现有LLM引导者多针对特定任务目标微调，缺乏可适应不同任务类型与群体动态的通用LLM引导方法。因此作者希望填补通用化LLM引导方法的空白。

Method: 提出GUIDE框架，从客观任务结果与主观指标（心理安全感、感知摩擦）两方面评估引导效果。首先收集由任务特定专家LLM引导者引导的多方人类互动（N=432段对话）；随后采用自学习方法，让LLM从对话中归纳出可操作的策略手册，并利用与人类标注者（N=20）对齐的LLM裁判反馈进行迭代优化，从而得到一个单一通用引导者，并在实时在线实证研究中验证其效果。

Result: 自学习得到的单一通用引导者在留出对话上以61.4%胜率超过三个任务特定的专家引导者。实时在线实证研究中，该通用引导者保持了引导者表现与群体生产力，提升了发言舒适度并降低了人际摩擦，同时相比专家提示少用24.7%的轮次与29.0%的词数。

Conclusion: 研究提供了实证证据，表明LLM能够从任务特定的人类互动中学习可泛化、任务无关的社交引导能力，在多样化群体环境下达到与手工设计任务特定提示相当的水平。

Abstract: As large language models are increasingly adopted as multi-party communication facilitators, there is a growing demand for agents capable of balancing diverse group dynamics across contexts. However, existing LLM facilitators are often fine-tuned for task-specific objectives; generalized LLM-based facilitation methods that can adapt to different types of tasks and diverse group dynamics are underdeveloped. To address this gap, we present GUIDE (Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges, a framework for developing generalized LLM-based facilitators across different multi-party contexts. GUIDE evaluates facilitation across both objective task outcomes and subjective metrics, including psychological safety and perceived friction. Within this framework, we study whether LLMs can self-learn generalized facilitation strategy offline to real-time interventions. We first collect multi-party human interactions guided by task-specific expert LLM facilitators (N=432 conversations). We then employ a self-learning method in which an LLM induces an actionable strategic playbook from conversations and iteratively refines it using feedback from an LLM judge aligned with human annotators (N=20), developing a single generalized facilitator that outperforms the three task-specific expert facilitators on held-out conversations 61.4% win rate. Finally, we evaluate these improvements empirically; in a real-time online empirical study, the self-learned generalized facilitator preserves facilitator performance and group productivity, improves speaking comfort and reduces interpersonal friction, while using 24.7% fewer turns and 29.0% fewer words than the expert prompts. These findings provide empirical evidence that LLMs can learn generalizable, task-agnostic social facilitation from task-specific human interactions, on-par with hand-crafted task-specific prompts across diverse group settings.

</details>


### [722] [ScreenASR-Bench: A Tiered Benchmark for Speech Recognition with Visual Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16260)
*Mingwei Fu,Zheshu Song,Zhikai Zhou,Shen Huang,Shidong Shang,Mengxiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出分级基准 ScreenASR-Bench，含 ETE、EVE、ISE 三个递进难度层级，评估视觉上下文对语音识别中声学歧义词的增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ASR 模型在通用基准上表现良好，但对声学歧义词仍识别困难。基于屏幕场景的视觉上下文可辅助识别，然而现有基准难以揭示不同类型视觉证据所带来的收益差异。

Method: 构建 ScreenASR-Bench 分级基准，设三级：显式文本证据（ETE，基于屏幕直接文本）、显式视觉证据（EVE，基于可见内容而非屏幕文本）、隐式语义证据（ISE，需场景级推理）。对 ASR 模型、大型音频语言模型（LALMs）与 Omni 模型进行广泛实验。

Result: 在三个模型族中，引入视觉上下文相较纯音频设置显著提升召回率；增益在 ETE 最大、ISE 最小，表明模型更善于利用直接视觉证据而非间接语义线索。

Conclusion: 视觉上下文可有效缓解声学歧义，且收益随证据显式程度递减。为促进视觉接地语音识别研究，公开释放 ScreenASR-Bench。

Abstract: Current ASR models perform well on general benchmarks but still struggle with acoustically ambiguous words. Visual context can aid recognition in screen-based scenarios, yet existing benchmarks provide limited insight into the benefits of different types of visual evidence. To address this gap, we introduce ScreenASR-Bench , a tiered benchmark with three progressively challenging levels: Explicit Textual Evidence (ETE), based on direct on-screen text; Explicit Visual Evidence (EVE), using visible content rather than on-screen text; and Implicit Semantic Evidence (ISE), requiring scene-level inference. Extensive experiments on ASR models, Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) and Omni models show that incorporating visual context substantially improves recall over the audio-only setting across all three model families. The gains are largest for ETE and smallest for ISE, indicating that models leverage direct visual evidence more effectively than indirect semantic cues. To facilitate future research on visually grounded speech recognition, we publicly release ScreenASR-Bench.

</details>


### [723] [Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16261)
*Jinwoo Chung,Jangho Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Token-Group Quantization，一种面向 Mamba 超分模型的硬件友好激活 PTQ 框架，通过预测器静态近似 post-scan 分组，并引入频域保持精炼目标校准裁剪边界，在多种设置下超越已有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba 的选择性扫描是输入依赖的状态空间算子，不同空间 token 的激活范围差异大，单一逐层裁剪范围无法匹配所有 token，导致低比特训练后量化（PTQ）困难。而直接按 post-scan 激活分组虽更优，却需要运行时统计与动态分组，硬件不友好。

Method: 1) 静态近似一个硬件不友好的 post-scan 分组 oracle：将偏好裁剪范围相近的 token 分到同组；2) 用轻量预测器从量化扫描路径之前的 pre-scan 特征推断分组；3) 校准阶段对 post-scan 激活描述子聚类生成伪标签；4) 推理时冻结预测器映射分组并查表选择离线校准的组级裁剪边界，无需运行时统计或动态更新；5) 提出频域保持精炼（FPR）目标，对齐全精度教师与量化学生输出的傅里叶振幅与相位以保留高频结构。

Result: 在多种 PTQ 协议、比特宽度、骨干与任务上持续优于已有 Mamba 和 SR PTQ 基线；可迁移到 Transformer SR 与 Vision Mamba 分类；可与基于旋转的量化组合；在 Jetson Orin Nano 上相比 FP16 实现 2.23 倍加速。

Conclusion: 该方法在保持硬件友好与静态低比特推理的同时，有效解决了 Mamba 超分模型的激活量化难题，兼具通用性与实际部署效率。

Abstract: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. During calibration, we form pseudo-labels by clustering post-scan activation descriptors that capture similar rounding--clipping behavior. At inference, the frozen predictor maps pre-scan features to groups and selects entries from offline-calibrated group-wise clipping-bound tables, without runtime statistics collection, dynamic clipping updates, or post-scan group assignment. To address low-bit restoration degradation, we further introduce a Frequency-Preserving Refinement (FPR) objective for clipping-bound calibration. FPR aligns Fourier amplitude and phase between full-precision teacher and quantized student outputs to preserve high-frequency structures. Across PTQ protocols, bit-widths, backbones, and tasks, our method consistently outperforms prior Mamba and SR PTQ baselines, transfers to Transformer SR and Vision Mamba classification, composes with rotation-based quantization, and achieves 2.23x speedup on Jetson Orin Nano over FP16. Code is available here.

</details>


### [724] [agent-risk: Risk Assessment for Changes to AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16280)
*Yue Zhao,Zixiang Xu,Angela Huyue Zhang,S. Alex Yang,Xiyang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 agent-risk replay：把经典风险分析扩展到部分日志与运行系统的局部变更上，通过日志、保存状态重跑或界来判定每个 episode，并证明精确重放所需日志字段、可服务的门控族及重跑/漂移界。bash 沙箱中单靠 7200 条日志无法判定两个重试门控，按门控阻断的 episode 重跑可在半数 agent 调用下达到与实况测试一致的判定；缺逐步伤害记录时停止门控的认证伤害上界最高升至 2.5 倍。结论：审批需预先设计证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署中的 AI agent 在变更（更严格的安全门、新模型）前需组织审批，且只能从既有日志出发。经典风险分析假设完整记录，而现实中日志是部分的、系统只做局部变更；本文希望在这种不完整信息下仍能给出可认证的审批判断，并明确需要何种证据。

Method: 提出 agent-risk replay：基于日志重放 episode，假设其他条件不变且 agent 不预期变更。判定方式为——日志已足以确定按原行为动作的 episode；声明的 stop 值确定已停止的 episode；其余 episode 需要日志支持、保存状态重跑或一个界。理论证明精确重放所需记录的日志字段、哪些保存状态可覆盖一个门控族；对独立 episode 给出决策所需重跑次数的界及相对实况行为的可容忍漂移。在 bash 沙箱中以保守重试门控（拒绝后是否重试）进行实验，对比仅日志判定、从保存状态按门控阻断 episode 重跑、以及事后设定规模的实况测试。

Result: 在 bash 沙箱中，7200 条 episode 的日志单独无法判定两个重试门控中的任何一个，因为它们会让 agent 在日志从未显示的拒绝后继续动作。仅从保存状态重跑各门控阻断的 episode，即在给定日志的前提下，以实况测试一半的 agent 调用量达到两个门控的实况判定。在缺少逐步伤害信息时，停止门控的认证伤害上界最高升至 2.5 倍，因为日志无法显示伤害是否发生在停止之前（无 per-step harm）。

Conclusion: 审批不能事后补证据：agent-risk replay 表明日志单独往往不足，必须预先设计证据——补齐日志字段、保存状态、定向重跑，才能对运行中 agent 的局部变更做出可认证的批准决策。

Abstract: Before changing a deployed AI agent (a stricter safety gate, a new model), organizations must approve the change, starting from existing logs. Extending classical risk analysis to partial records and partial changes to running systems, agent-risk replays logged episodes, assuming nothing else changes and the agent does not anticipate the change. The log settles episodes acting as before, a declared stop value settles stopped ones, and the rest need logged support, a saved-state rerun, or a bound. We prove what logs must record for exact replay and which saved states serve a gate family. For independent episodes, we bound the reruns a decision needs and tolerable drift from live behavior. In a bash sandbox, a 7,200-episode log alone decided neither of two retry gates, which let the agent act after refusals the log never shows. Rerunning only each gate's blocked episodes from saved states reached both live decisions at half the agent calls of a live test sized post hoc for them, given the log. Without per-step harm, a stopping gate's certified harm ceiling rose up to 2.5-fold, since the log hides whether harm preceded the stop. Approval thus needs evidence designed in advance: log fields, saved states, targeted reruns.

</details>


### [725] [REVEAL: Reverse Engineering Agentic Latents from Frontier-Model Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16288)
*Yuetian Du,Meng Wang,Yucheng Wang,Zhangzhe Chen,Wei Wang,Boyu Yang,Weiqi Zhai,Bing Zhao,Ming Kong,Zhan Zhou,Jie Liu,Qiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架REVEAL，通过"协议逆向工程"从文本化的前沿模型轨迹中提取可复用的局部控制信号（Agentic Latents），以激活引导方式提升冻结小模型智能体的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿LLM智能体虽能完成复杂交互任务，但推理成本高昂，因此需要将其经验迁移至更小的开源智能体。然而，现有蒸馏与隐空间通信方法通常需要训练目标模型或访问源模型内部表示，限制了在冻结模型上的应用。

Method: 受协议逆向工程启发，作者提出Agentic Latents，由锚定状态（anchored states）与反馈—响应的循环动态轮廓（dynamic profiles）组成，通过在目标模型中回放轨迹来激发。基于此的REVEAL框架无需训练：利用这些轮廓与轨迹结果，从同一任务、同一源模型的成功与失败rollout中匹配并选取局部事件；对比其响应—转移差异，得到目标特定的引导方向，并在每次响应前施加该方向。

Result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1与Humanity's Last Exam with tools的基准内评测中，三个目标模型上的准确率均高于未修改的智能体。表征分析与行为案例研究进一步支持将前沿模型经验作为局部激活控制来复用。

Conclusion: 文本化的前沿模型轨迹无需源模型内部信息或目标模型训练，即可转化为冻结智能体的局部激活控制信号，从而以低成本实现经验迁移并提升性能。

Abstract: Frontier LLM agents perform complex interactive tasks, but their inference costs motivate transferring their experience to smaller open-source agents. Distillation and latent communication typically require target-model training or access to source-model internals. We study how textual frontier-model trajectories can provide reusable local controls for a frozen agent. Inspired by protocol reverse engineering, we introduce $\textit{Agentic Latents}$, comprising anchored states and dynamic profiles of feedback--response cycles elicited by replay in the target model. Our training-free framework, $\textbf{REVEAL}$ ($\textbf{REV}$erse $\textbf{E}$ngineering $\textbf{A}$gentic $\textbf{L}$atents), uses these profiles and trajectory outcomes to match and select local events from successful and failed rollouts of the same task and source model. Their response-transition contrasts yield a target-specific steering direction, applied before each response. Within-benchmark evaluations on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and Humanity's Last Exam with tools report higher accuracy than unmodified agents across three targets. Representation analyses and behavioral case studies support reusing frontier-model experience as local activation control.

</details>


### [726] [Memory-Efficient Integer-Only Training of Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16298)
*Hazem Hesham Yousef Shalby,Fabrizio Pittorino,Manuel Roveri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种全INT8训练算法，所有张量（权重、梯度、激活）以INT8存储，所有运算（前向、反向、权重更新、优化器更新）均用整数算术完成，在CNN与ViT上于CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet达到竞争性精度，训练内存约为FP32的1/4。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低精度训练可带来显著效率收益，但现有方法在大规模视觉基准上至少在某一阶段（通常是权重更新或优化器状态）仍保留浮点运算，无法实现端到端的整数训练。因此需要一种可扩展到现代深度网络、全流程整数化的训练算法。

Method: 张量以带符号整数尾数加显式2的幂指数形式存储；所有整数运算由五个可组合的基本构建块实现：乘积、求和、除以常数、非线性函数、权重更新。据此可完整实现可训练的整数层，包括卷积、批/层归一化、softmax和GELU。引入逐组速度机制并独立跟踪指数，以在量级差异较大的神经元和通道间保持梯度精度。

Result: 在CNN（ResNet-18/34/50/101、MobileNetV2）和ViT（ViT-Ti/B）上验证，于CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet取得竞争性精度，同时训练内存约为FP32基线的1/4。

Conclusion: 首次证明使用INT8张量和整数算术训练神经网络，可在较低内存预算下达到与浮点训练相当的竞争性精度，为无需浮点运算的高效训练提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Training neural networks in reduced precision can yield significant efficiency gains, yet all existing methods that scale to standard computer vision benchmarks retain floating-point in at least one stage, typically the weight update or optimizer state. We present a training algorithm that scales to modern deep neural networks, in which every tensor (weights, gradients, and activations) is stored as INT8, and every operation (forward pass, backward pass, weight update, optimizer update) is performed in integer arithmetic. Specifically, tensors are stored as signed integer mantissas paired with explicit power-of-two exponents, on which integer-only operations are performed using five custom composable building blocks (products, sums, divide-by-constant, nonlinear functions, and weight updates). This allows complete implementation of trainable integer layers, including convolutions, batch and layer normalization, softmax, and GELU. A per-group velocity mechanism with independent exponent tracking preserves gradient precision across neurons and channels with diverse magnitudes. As every tensor fits in INT8, training memory is roughly 4x smaller than the FP32 baseline. We validate our training algorithm on CNNs (ResNet-18/34/50/101, MobileNetV2) and Vision Transformers (ViT-Ti / B), demonstrating for the first time that training neural networks with INT8 tensors and integer arithmetic can achieve competitive accuracy on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet at a reduced memory budget.

</details>


### [727] [FON: A Draft-Revise Dual-Organ Language Model without Sequence-Level Quadratic Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16301)
*Helong Hu,Hongdan Pan,Shuiqing Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 FON（Fusion-Organ Network），将单一权重堆栈分化为“起草器官”（多抽头可学习延迟＋内容自适应递归，因果、O(S) 训练、O(1) 解码状态）与“修订器官”（多尺度波纹核＋弱门控重处理已写前缀，不生成），在 30M 参数、等参数等 token 条件下 WikiText-103 困惑度 131.03，优于 Transformer（197.73）与 Mamba2（152.53）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自注意力把“读哪里”与“如何混合”两种功能压缩进同一机制，代价是 O(L²) 训练、O(T) 解码状态以及位置信号与训练长度绑定。已有无注意力方案只针对“生成”这一单一功能做优化，未从功能分工角度重构架构。

Method: 将同一权重堆栈在功能上分化为两个器官：起草器官采用多抽头可学习延迟与内容自适应递归，保持因果性，训练复杂度 O(S)、解码状态 O(1)，不含序列级二次注意力；修订器官通过弱门控注入多尺度波纹核，对已写前缀进行重处理，仅修订而不生成。整体在等参数、等 token 预算下对比深度对齐基线，并测试长度外推与填充能力。

Result: 30M 参数下 WikiText-103 困惑度 131.03，优于 Transformer 197.73 与 Mamba2 152.53；优势在所有深度对齐基线上保持，70M 规模下领先约 20.8%。8 倍长度外推退化约 8–9%，无需位置编码工程，表现介于 ALiBi 与 RoPE 之间。修订通道为因果架构原则上缺失的域内填充提供结构路径（较按需耦合 +19%），困惑度代价在测量精度内不可区分。作者同时报告边界：长程检索受损、合成任务劣势、域外代码填充弱于同配方 Transformer、墙钟时间差距 6.5–12.3 倍。

Conclusion: FON 通过把“读取位置”与“混合方式”解耦到起草与修订两个器官，在有限参数与 token 预算下取得优于 Transformer 与 Mamba2 的困惑度，并具备 O(S) 训练、O(1) 解码、免位置编码工程的外推性和结构性填充能力；但其长程检索、合成任务与域外代码填充存在明确边界，且墙钟效率仍有 6.5–12.3 倍差距。

Abstract: Self-attention assigns two functions to one mechanism-where to read and how to mix-at the price of O(L^2) training, an O(T) decode state, and position signals bound to the training length. Existing attention-free alternatives all optimize the single function of generation. We propose FON (Fusion-Organ Network), which differentiates one weight stack into a drafting organ (multi-tap learnable delays + content-adaptive recursion; causal, O(S) training, O(1) decode state, no sequence-level quadratic attention) and a revision organ that re-processes the written prefix through multi-scale ripple kernels injected via weak gates, never generating. At 30M parameters, iso-parameter and iso-token budget, FON reaches perplexity 131.03 on WikiText-103, beating Transformer (197.73) and Mamba2 (152.53); the advantage persists under all depth-aligned baselines and at the 70M tier (-20.8%). At 8x length extrapolation FON degrades by ~8-9% without positional-encoding engineering, between ALiBi and RoPE. The revision channel provides a structural pathway for in-domain infilling that causal architectures lack in principle (+19% over on-demand coupling), at a perplexity cost indistinguishable within measurement precision. We report all costs and boundaries: impaired long-range retrieval, synthetic-task disadvantages, weaker out-of-domain code infilling than a same-recipe Transformer, and a 6.5-12.3x wall-clock gap.

</details>


### [728] [Narrative Paradoxes in LLM Inference: Shaping Reasoning Trajectories toward Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16312)
*Haoming Yang,Ke Ma,Yangbangyan Jiang,Ligong Zhang,Xiaojun Jia,Longtao Huang,Yingfei Sun,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出PDRA攻击方法，通过悖论叙事与三阶段强制分析框架，诱导大模型在多步推理过程中生成有害内容，揭示推理过程本身的安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型的显式推理常被视为可靠性的保障，但当模型在良性语境下推断出有害目标时，逐步推理仍可能带来风险。作者识别出一个新挑战：确保"多步推理过程"本身的安全性——局部连贯的推理步骤可能导向全局有害的结果。现有安全机制多关注单步输出，忽略了推理链条整体的风险传导。

Method: 提出PDRA（Paradox-driven Reasoning-based Attack，悖论驱动推理攻击），一种"编程"有害推理轨迹的攻击方法。首先构造悖论叙事核心：将恶意行为者（如某破坏性角色）与良性任务（如撰写安全公告）配对；随后将该核心嵌入结构化分析框架，强制模型经过三阶段分析——表层目的、潜在意图、操作重建——引导模型在保持叙事连贯的同时产出详细有害内容。机制上，PDRA使模型内部表征偏离拒绝相关模式，抑制安全触发词、激活规划导向词。

Result: 实证表明，PDRA在多种大模型上取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）的攻击成功率，且效率高。机制分析显示其能有效抑制安全触发词汇并激活规划类词汇。

Conclusion: 多步推理过程本身构成独立的安全风险面，局部连贯的推理可导致全局有害输出。仅依赖拒答模式与词汇级安全信号不足以保障推理链安全，需针对推理轨迹整体进行安全评估与防御。

Abstract: Explicit reasoning in large language models (LLMs) is often associated with reliability, yet it can still pose risks when a model infers harmful goals under a benign context. We identify a distinct challenge: ensuring the safety of the \emph{multi-step reasoning process} itself, where locally coherent steps may still lead to globally harmful outcomes. To explore this vulnerability, we propose PDRA (Paradox-driven Reasoning-based Attack), a novel attack method that programs a harmful reasoning trajectory. PDRA first constructs a paradoxical narrative core by pairing a malicious actor (e.g., a terrorist) with a benign task (e.g., writing a safety bulletin). It then embeds this core into a structured analytical framework that forces the model through a mandatory three-stage analysis -- surface purpose, latent intent, and operational reconstruction -- guiding it to produce detailed harmful content while maintaining narrative coherence. Mechanistically, we show PDRA steers the model's internal representations away from refusal-related patterns, suppressing safety-triggering lexicons while activating planning-oriented terms. Empirically, PDRA achieves state-of-the-art attack success rates across diverse LLMs with high efficiency. \textcolor{red}{\textbf{Warning:} This paper may contain sensitive content.}

</details>


### [729] [ReTAC: Residual Test-Time Agentic Computation for Video Spatial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16315)
*Yike Wu,Keyan Chen,Qixiong Wang,Xi Xiang,Maofei Que,Xiaolong Jiang,Xiaoqin Zhang,Ling Shao,Shijian Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"残差式测试时计算"范式，并实现免训练多智能体框架 ReTAC，用于视频空间推理，在多款 MLLM 与基准上取得最优综合表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型的测试时智能体计算虽有收益，但无差别地使用计算会重复已解决的工作、引入噪声证据、甚至干扰原本正确的预测，因此需要更有针对性的计算分配策略。

Method: 作者提出残差式计算：仅对基础模型未解决的需求追加计算，并在局部失败后只重算受影响的状态。据此构建免训练多智能体框架 ReTAC，包含：围绕未解决需求组织补充计算；规划有序步骤获取缺失空间证据并与原生证据融合推理；阶段对齐验证将失败定位到规划、感知或推理环节；基于依赖关系的恢复机制仅重算受影响状态、复用未受影响状态。

Result: 在三种主流多模态大模型与两个广泛采用的基准上，ReTAC 综合得分高于所有对比方法。进一步分析表明，额外计算带来的增益不仅取决于计算量，还取决于计算分配的位置以及被保留的有效中间状态。

Conclusion: 测试时计算应遵循"残差"原则：按需分配、精准定位失败、局部恢复，才能在提升视频空间推理性能的同时避免无效计算与噪声干扰。

Abstract: Test-time agentic computation can improve multimodal large language models (MLLMs) through planning, tool use, iterative perception, and reflection, but indiscriminate computation may duplicate resolved work, introduce noisy evidence, and perturb correct predictions. We propose that such computation should be residual: allocate additional computation only to requirements unresolved by the base model and, after a localized failure, recompute only the affected states. We instantiate this formulation in ReTAC, a training-free multiagent framework for video spatial reasoning. ReTAC organizes supplementary computation around unresolved requirements. It plans ordered steps to acquire missing spatial evidence and combines the observations with compatible native evidence for reasoning. In addition, it uses stage-aligned verification to localize failures to planning, perception, or reasoning. Dependency-based recovery recomputes only affected states while reusing unaffected ones. Extensive experiments show that ReTAC achieves the highest overall score among the compared methods across three mainstream MLLMs and two widely adopted benchmarks. Further analyses show that gains from additional computation depend not only on how much is used, but also on where it is allocated and which valid intermediate states are preserved.

</details>


### [730] [HyWe: Unifying Search and Operation for Real-World Hybrid Web Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16319)
*Zijian Cai,Haowei Liu,Kailai Chen,Lin Peng,Cong Wan,Ziqi Zhang,Chunfeng Yuan,Bing Li,Weiming Hu,Haiyang Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HyWe框架，将搜索与操作能力统一于单一模型与轨迹中，配套自动数据采集流水线HyWeCollector与评测基准HyWeBench，训练出HyWe-35B，在混合网络任务上显著超越搜索型和操作型智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的混合型网页任务同时需要信息检索与页面交互，但现有搜索型（search-based）与操作型（operation-based）智能体在开发与评测上彼此割裂，缺乏统一能力框架与相应基准。

Method: 1) HyWe：在同一模型与轨迹内统一两种能力的框架，两种模式各用专用提示与工具集维持子目标执行，通过显式切换选择所需能力，共享历史使两模式可互相利用发现；2) HyWeCollector：全自动数据流水线，基于任务原型、四种切换模式与多智能体合成，产出经校验的混合轨迹；3) 以此示范训练出35B规模的HyWe-35B；4) HyWeBench：100个由人工撰写、网站与训练集不重叠的任务，含人工子目标清单与基于结果的评测流水线。

Result: HyWe-35B在HyWeBench上成功率达47.0%，较未训练基座提升19.0个百分点，并优于现有搜索型与操作型智能体；未训练时，同一基座使用HyWe可解28.0%任务，而所有工具置于单一提示下仅11.0%；在Online-Mind2Web与WebVoyager上分别达59.0%与88.3%，优于现有开源基线，且相比Fara-7B将每个成功任务的行动成本分别降低48.3%与51.9%。

Conclusion: 统一的混合训练与显式模式切换能有效融合信息检索与浏览器交互能力，在混合任务及多个既有基准上均取得领先性能，并显著降低行动开销。

Abstract: Real-world hybrid web tasks need both information gathering and page interaction, yet search-based and operation-based agents are developed and evaluated separately. To bridge this gap, we introduce HyWe, a framework that unifies both capabilities within one model and trajectory. Its two modes use dedicated prompts and tool sets to sustain sub-goal execution; explicit switching selects the needed capability, and shared history lets each mode build on the other's findings. To provide demonstrations of these behaviors, we develop HyWeCollector, a fully automatic pipeline that uses task prototypes, four switching patterns, and multi-agent synthesis to produce verified hybrid trajectories. We train HyWe-35B on these demonstrations to unify efficient information gathering and browser interaction in a single 35B web agent. To evaluate hybrid task completion, we introduce HyWeBench: 100 human-written tasks on websites distinct from training, with human-written sub-goal checklists and an outcome-based evaluation pipeline. Hybrid training enables HyWe-35B to achieve 47.0% success on this benchmark, improving on the untrained base model by 19.0 percentage points and outperforming existing search-based and operation-based agents. Even before training, the same base model solves 28.0% of tasks with HyWe, versus 11.0% with all tools under one prompt. Beyond hybrid tasks, HyWe-35B achieves 59.0% and 88.3% success on Online-Mind2Web and WebVoyager, outperforming existing open-source baselines and cutting action cost per successful task by 48.3% and 51.9% compared with Fara-7B.

</details>


### [731] [When a Conceptor Complement Becomes Gain: Operator Geometry and Behavioral Attribution in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16325)
*Shuhul Razdan,R Balamurugan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过移除概念锥补集（conceptor complement）中的协方差滤波器、保留目标中心与增益，检验拟合矩阵对语言模型行为改变的贡献；结果显示矩阵修正量占比较小，且未能在配对比较中确立一致的目标抑制增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当干预改变语言模型行为时，难以判断是干预的哪一部分（拟合矩阵还是共享组件）真正起作用；整体干预对比无法单独归因于拟合矩阵，因此需要固定共享组件并直接检验输出后果。

Method: 对以目标为中心的缩放概念锥补集进行消融：移除其拟合协方差滤波器，保持相同的目标中心与增益；在原始孔径α=.05、增益β=2条件下考察21个拟合映射（3个模型×7个目标）；用匹配控制位移量化矩阵修正比例；开展1,920条响应的480组配对比较；进行几何孔径扫描；另测试可逆软滤波器与专用擦除方法。

Result: 在生成干预层，所有21个拟合映射在每个方向上都扩张；矩阵修正仅为匹配控制位移的0.093%–7.815%；保留矩阵改变了许多个体文本，但在四目标面板上未建立一致的目标抑制增益；孔径扫描显示操作区间随滤波器设置改变；可逆软滤波器保留了无约束仿射读出能恢复的信息，而专用擦除方法降低了新拟合探针的预测。

Conclusion: 整体干预比较本身不足以将生成行为归因于拟合矩阵；应分析完整变换、固定共享组件，并直接检验其输出后果。

Abstract: When a steering intervention changes a language model's behavior, which part of the intervention deserves the credit? We test this question for a target-centered, scaled conceptor complement by removing its fitted covariance filter while preserving the same target-specific center and gain. At the original aperture $α=.05$ and gain $β=2$, all 21 fitted maps across three models and seven targets expand every direction at the generation intervention layers. The matrix correction is $0.093\%$--$7.815\%$ of the matched-control displacement on held-out extraction activations. In 480 paired comparisons within a 1,920-response study, retaining the matrix changes many individual texts but does not establish a consistent additional target-suppression benefit on the four-target panel. A geometric aperture sweep shows that the operating regime changes with the filter setting. Separately, an invertible soft filter preserves what an unrestricted affine readout can recover, whereas dedicated erasure methods reduce prediction by newly fitted probes. Together, the results show why a whole-intervention comparison cannot by itself attribute generated behavior to the fitted matrix: analyze the complete transformation, hold shared components fixed, and test its output consequences directly.

</details>


### [732] [TRAP: Tool-result Replay Attack for Probing Misbinding in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16333)
*Yutong Zhi,Jie Zhang,Xiuqi Lu,Jiayuan Xu,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并系统研究了"工具结果错绑定"（tool-result misbinding）失效模式，构建了基于受控回放的基准 ReplayBench，在19个场景、4种失效属性、3种回放机制下评测8个LLM与3个智能体框架，发现跨任务回放平均最终状态错误率达0.649，并将其定位到模型侧动作生成阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体通过外部工具行动，工具结果已成为必须与产生它的执行上下文保持正确关联的执行产物；但当结果在缓存、恢复机制与共享运行时状态中持久化时，这种关联可能断裂，导致真实且未被篡改的结果被不兼容的执行上下文消费，进而诱发不安全动作。作者将此类失效定义为工具结果错绑定，并指出缺乏系统化研究手段。

Method: 提出 ReplayBench 基准，采用受控的工具结果回放，在19个代表性智能体场景、4种失效属性、3种回放机制上评测错绑定；覆盖8个LLM、3个智能体框架与多种有状态工作流，并进行分阶段分析与任务相似度、对象相似度、结果陈旧性、隐式环境变化等维度的消融/敏感性分析。

Result: 发现回放诱发的失效广泛存在，跨任务回放下平均最终状态错误率（Final-State Error Rate）为0.649；分阶段分析将失效定位到模型侧动作生成环节。回放易感性随任务相似度变化，对对象相似度几乎不敏感，且在结果陈旧与隐式环境变化下依然较高。所提出的运行时有效性机制在评测设置中消除了最终状态错误，同时保留合法恢复能力。

Conclusion: 工具结果错绑定是真实且普遍存在的安全风险，根源在模型侧动作生成，因此需要在使用工具的智能体运行时中引入显式的上下文绑定机制；结果呼吁对工具使用运行时进行上下文绑定设计与有效性校验。

Abstract: As AI agents increasingly act through external tools, tool results are no longer simple outputs but execution artifacts that must remain correctly associated with the context that produced them. Yet as results persist across caches, recovery mechanisms, and shared runtime state, this association can break, causing a real and unmodified result to be consumed in an incompatible execution context and lead the agent to an unsafe action. We characterize this failure as tool-result misbinding. To systematically study this failure, we introduce ReplayBench, a benchmark that uses controlled tool-result replay to evaluate misbinding across 19 representative agent scenarios, 4 failure properties, and 3 replay mechanisms. Across eight LLMs, three agent frameworks, and diverse stateful workflows, we find widespread replay-induced failures, with a mean Final-State Error Rate of 0.649 under cross-task replay. Stage-wise analysis localizes these failures to model-side action generation. Further analyses show that replay susceptibility varies with task similarity, shows little dependence on object similarity, and remains high under result staleness and implicit environment changes. These findings motivate runtime validity mechanisms that eliminate final-state errors in our evaluated settings while preserving legitimate recovery. The results call for explicit contextual binding in tool-using agent runtimes. Our work is public at https://github.com/Phitooo/Replaybench.

</details>


### [733] [Efficient Multi-Agent Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Adaptive Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16343)
*Seungdong Yoa,Ye Seul Sim,Suhee Yoon,Sanghyu Yoon,Dongmin Kim,Soonyoung Lee,Bumsoo Kim,Junhyun Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LASE框架通过领导-支持者非对称架构，仅在非中性情境下选择性触发多智能体交互，实现接近单智能体成本的推理性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期理论指出多智能体辩论的收益高度依赖情境：在纠错条件下交互可放大信息信号，但对称辩论动态在期望上是中性的，多数投票往往更优。论文旨在调和这些矛盾观点，主张辩论只有在恰当的时机和结构下才有效。

Method: 提出LASE（Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement），一个以领导者为中心的多智能体辩论框架：引入非对称的领导-支持者架构，实现定向信息流与选择性信号放大，仅在非中性情境中触发交互，否则默认采用简单聚合。

Result: 在多种推理基准测试中，LASE达到多智能体级别的性能，而token成本接近单智能体，效率显著优于静态辩论与投票基线。

Conclusion: 辩论有效性取决于时机与结构，LASE通过选择性、非对称的交互设计，在多智能体推理性能与计算效率之间取得了更优的平衡。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate has shown promise for improving the reasoning of large language models, yet recent theory suggests its benefits are highly regime-dependent. While interaction can amplify informative signals under corrective conditions, symmetric debate dynamics are neutral in expectation, often making majority voting preferable. We reconcile these views by arguing that debate is effective only when invoked at the right time and with appropriate structure. Based on this insight, we propose LASE: Leader-Adaptive Structured Engagement, a leader-centric multi-agent debate framework that selectively engages interaction only in non-neutral regimes. LASE introduces an asymmetric leader-supporter architecture that enables directed information flow and selective signal amplification, while defaulting to simple aggregation otherwise. Experiments across diverse reasoning benchmarks show that LASE achieves multi-agent-level performance with near single-agent token cost, substantially improving efficiency over static debate and voting baselines.

</details>


### [734] [ChronoScribe: Semantic-Numerical Specialization for Instruction-Driven Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16345)
*Yuchen Jiao,Miao Zhang,Yuxuan Liu,Chengxi Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ChronoScribe 框架，将指令驱动时间序列预测拆分为语义与数值两条专精路径：LoRA 微调的 LLM 负责指令理解、执行路径与上下文长度决策，冻结的 TSFM 负责在指定预测区间上生成分位数轨迹，LLM 不生成也不修改预测值。在 23 个评估维度、30 个公开数据集上，sMAPE、MASE、WAPE、RMSE、MAE 误差均最低，TLS 达 65.5，比最强直接 LLM 基线高 10.6 分，最差的直接 LLM 误差也是其 2.0--2.7 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有指令驱动时间序列预测存在根本性张力：系统既要掌握自然语言指令跟随，又要完成精确数值预测。当前方法往往被迫折中——LLM 能理解非结构化请求但直接输出预测值时不准确，TSFM 数值预测可靠但需要结构化输入（目标序列、上下文窗口、预测区间）。因此需要一种"分工协作"的方式，让合适的模型做合适的事。

Method: 采用语义-数值专精化的分工流程。语义侧：LoRA 适配的 LLM（Qwen3.5-9B）提出执行路径与上下文长度，再由确定性规则解析出可执行配置。数值侧：在专家路径上，冻结的 TSFM（Chronos-2）为目标区间生成分位数轨迹；确定性轨迹摘要为最终回复提供条件输入，LLM 既不生成也不修订预测值。评估覆盖 23 个维度、30 个公开数据集，对比 11 个闭源直接 LLM 与 3 个开源 TSFM。

Result: ChronoScribe 在 sMAPE、MASE、WAPE、RMSE、MAE 五项指标上误差均为所有被测系统（含固定上下文对照）中最低；即使表现最好的直接 LLM 基线，其误差仍为 ChronoScribe 的 2.0--2.7 倍。系统层面任务级得分 TLS 为 65.5，比最强直接 LLM 基线高 10.6 分。

Conclusion: 结果支持 ChronoScribe 的任务分工设计：LLM 负责语义解释、配置解析与交互表达，TSFM 负责数值预测，从而在不牺牲指令理解能力的前提下获得更高的预测精度。

Abstract: Recent advances in instruction-driven time series forecasting highlight a fundamental tension: systems must simultaneously master natural-language instruction following and precise numerical prediction. Current approaches often force a compromise. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret unstructured requests but may be inaccurate when asked to produce forecast values directly, whereas time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide numerical forecasts but typically require structured inputs specifying the target series, context window, and horizon. We present ChronoScribe, which applies semantic-numerical specialization to this workflow. A LoRA-adapted LLM proposes an execution path and context length; deterministic rules resolve the executable configuration. On the specialist path, a frozen TSFM produces quantile trajectories for the task-specified horizon. Deterministic trajectory summaries condition the response, while the LLM neither generates nor revises predicted values. We evaluate a Qwen3.5-9B--Chronos-2 implementation across 23 evaluation dimensions and 30 public datasets against eleven proprietary direct LLMs and three open TSFMs. ChronoScribe has the lowest error on sMAPE, MASE, WAPE, RMSE, and MAE among all evaluated systems, including fixed-context controls. Across these metrics, even the lowest direct-LLM error remains 2.0--2.7 times the corresponding ChronoScribe error. At the system level, ChronoScribe achieves a Task-Level Score (TLS) of 65.5, 10.6 points above the strongest direct-LLM baseline. The results support ChronoScribe's division of labor, in which the LLM handles interpretation, configuration, and communication while the TSFM handles numerical forecasting.

</details>


### [735] [World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16365)
*Shinseong Kim,Jaeseok Jeong,Jianlong Fu,Youngjung Uh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Physical Registry：在视频 DiT 内部加入随时间演化的注册槽位，将预测性动力学显式化为可读状态，提升物理合理性并支持候选筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型多通过语义、物理或预测信息指导视觉生成，但标准视频 token 将外观与动力学耦合编码，缺少独立状态来学习与读取预测性动力学，因此核心问题是：对场景演化的预测应置于生成器的何处。

Method: Physical Registry 在视频 DiT 内引入时间接地的注册槽位：由观测条件化的预测初始化，与视频 token 共同演化，并接受未来表征监督，使预测动力学成为生成器显式、可读的状态。基于该可读性提出 Physical Registry Selector (PRS)，利用候选特有注册槽位读出的中间结果与共享预测的偏离程度，在全去噪完成前对未来候选进行排序。

Result: 在 Physics-IQ Verified 受控对比中，较 vanilla fine-tuning 在 I2V/V2V 上提升 9.9/8.7 分，为所比较接口中最大增益；在 Cosmos 与 WAN 各骨干上均提升该基准分数。仅增加 0.45% 参数，即令 Cosmos 3 Nano 16B 的 I2V 分数超过已公布的 Cosmos 3 Super 64B（43.56 vs. 42.7）。在 WorldModelBench 上，四个骨干的物理遵循度与总分均提升。PRS 在四个骨干上将 I2V 分数提升 5.6–15.9%，且无需完成视频的外部评分。

Conclusion: 动力学预测应作为与视频表征共同演化的显式模型状态，该原则在多个骨干与基准上得到验证，并支持高效的无外部评分的候选筛选。

Abstract: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. In a controlled comparison of predictive-state interfaces on Physics-IQ Verified, Physical Registry improves vanilla fine-tuning by 9.9/8.7 points on I2V/V2V, the largest gain among the interfaces we compare. Across all Cosmos and WAN backbones, Physical Registry improves Physics-IQ Verified scores. With only 0.45% additional parameters, it enables Cosmos 3 Nano 16B to surpass the published I2V score of Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs. 42.7). On WorldModelBench, it also improves physical adherence and the total score for all four evaluated backbones. Because the registry becomes candidate-specific while remaining readable, the Physical Registry Selector (PRS) ranks emerging futures by how far their intermediate registry readouts depart from the shared forecast before full denoising is complete. Across four backbones, this selection improves I2V scores by 5.6-15.9% without completed-video external scoring. Together, these results support a broader principle: dynamics prediction should live as an explicit model state that co-evolves with the video representation. Project page: https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/

</details>


### [736] [RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16391)
*Ye Rin Kim,Yongjun Jeong,Seongjun Yun,Hanbum Ko,Soohyun Oh,Sungbin Lim,Sungwoong Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RetroPlanner：一种基于LLM的多步逆合成规划器，通过联合比较多条路线并综合反应可行性、往返一致性与起始原料价格来引导搜索，提升路线可合成性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多步逆合成规划常以"找到通往可购原料的路线"为终点，但该路线还需具备真实化学可行性。近期LLM规划器将过程建模为AND-OR图上的序贯决策，但通常每轮仅扩展单个分子，且仅以可解性为优化目标，在搜索预算耗尽前缺少对多目标实用性路线的比较。

Method: 提出RetroPlanner，联合比较多条路线以将搜索导向更高可合成性。训练其基于化学证据进行推理：目标分子的结构进展、键变化与反应类型、候选路线之间的分歧点，以及多目标下的排序方式。

Result: 在多步逆合成基准上，RetroPlanner相比既有LLM规划器恢复出更多替代路线，同时提升合成路线质量并保持较高成功率。

Conclusion: 通过引入多路线联合比较与多目标（反应可行性、往返一致性、原料价格）导向的搜索，可在维持成功率的同时提升逆合成路线质量与多样性，弥补仅优化可解性的不足。

Abstract: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. RetroPlanner is trained to reason over chemical evidence: structural progress from the target molecule, bond changes and reaction classes, where candidate routes diverge from one another, and how they rank across multiple objectives. Experiments on multi-step retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroPlanner recovers more alternative routes than prior LLM-based planners while improving synthetic route quality and maintaining a high success rate.

</details>


### [737] [Recursive Environment Scaling for General Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16397)
*Lingxiao Jing,Zhengbo Jiao,Yichen Xiang,Bofan Zhu,Lingbei Meng,Yan Ni,Haorui Chen,Ran Ran,Zhirong Shen,Yuheng Yang,Chenhang Cui,Yaosong Du,Rui Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出递归环境缩放（RES）框架，在保持任务目标不变的前提下通过改写信息获取、资源关系与执行依赖来提升智能体基准难度，并用于成对评测与训练轨迹收集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体基准难度受限于固定环境，核心任务目标与环境难度耦合，难以在保持目标不变时系统提升难度。

Method: RES：由 proposer 修改信息访问、资源关系与执行依赖；执行落地检查验证候选环境；被接受的修改跨轮递归继承，生成同目标的相关环境用于成对评测与轨迹收集。

Result: 在3个基准、294个初始任务上，六个评测模型成功率全部下降，Claw-Eval-Live 上下降57.14–77.14个百分点；相同轨迹数与优化设置下，RES轨迹微调在9个模型–基准对比中全面优于原始轨迹SFT，提升7.00–14.61个百分点；消融显示递归继承与依赖组合是难度提升的关键来源。

Conclusion: 环境缩放可同时服务于智能体评测与训练，RES在保持目标不变的同时有效提升难度并提供更优训练轨迹。

Abstract: We study environment scaling as a way to increase agent-benchmark difficulty while holding core task objectives fixed. Our framework, Recursive Environment Scaling (RES), transforms existing benchmark environments while preserving their objectives and completion requirements. A proposer changes information access, resource relations, and execution dependencies; execution-grounded checks validate the resulting candidate, and accepted changes are inherited across rounds. This produces related environments for paired evaluation and training-trajectory collection. Experiments on 294 initial tasks from three benchmarks show lower task success for all six evaluation models, with decreases of 57.14--77.14 percentage points on Claw-Eval-Live. With equal trajectory counts and identical optimization settings, fine-tuning on RES trajectories outperforms original-trajectory SFT in all nine model--benchmark comparisons by 7.00--14.61 percentage points. Ablations identify recursive inheritance and dependency composition as important contributors to increased difficulty. Together, these results support environment scaling for both agent evaluation and training.

</details>


### [738] [SLS-Bench: A Benchmark for Incident Log Summarization with Synthetic Observability Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16412)
*Valerii Iakovlev,Markus Spanring,Martin Flechl*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SLS-Bench，一个面向事故日志摘要的基准，包含90个基于真实事故报告的任务，通过数据生成流水线合成日志流与参考摘要，用于系统评估日志分析智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着IT系统复杂度提升，智能体驱动的自动化事故响应日益关键，其中将大规模日志流摘要为人类可读报告是核心能力。然而现有基准受限于真实数据收集的高成本与复杂性，对端到端的大规模日志流摘要评估仍不充分，缺乏系统性评价手段。

Method: 构建SLS-Bench：选取90个基于真实事故报告的任务，每个任务配有合成日志流与参考摘要。开发数据生成流水线，将事故报告转化为结构化事故模型，以此指导合成日志和参考摘要的生成；流水线结合叙事接地、显式事故建模、生成器-验证器循环，以及与真实日志流的统计对比，从而产出兼具真实性与可控性的可观测性数据。并对14个LLM在该基准上进行评估。

Result: 评估显示，前沿模型能够生成有用的摘要，但代价是高昂的成本和延迟；开源权重模型表现明显落后。基准能够有效区分模型在日志摘要任务上的能力差异。

Conclusion: SLS-Bench为日志分析智能体的系统化评估提供了框架，并为未来合成可观测性基准提供了可扩展的蓝图。

Abstract: As IT systems grow in complexity, automated agent-driven incident response becomes increasingly critical. A key capability for these agents is summarizing large log streams into human-readable reports. Further progress requires meaningfully evaluating this function, yet existing benchmarks leave end-to-end summarization from large log streams underexplored due to the prohibitive cost and complexity of collecting real-world data. We introduce SLS-Bench, a benchmark for incident log summarization featuring 90 tasks grounded in real-world incident reports, each with a synthetic log stream and a reference summary. To construct SLS-Bench, we developed a data generation pipeline that converts incident reports into structured incident models, which guide the generation of synthetic logs and reference summaries. This pipeline combines narrative grounding, explicit incident modeling, generator-verifier loops, and statistical comparisons with real-world log streams to produce realistic and controllable observability data. Our evaluation of 14 LLMs on SLS-Bench shows that while frontier models can produce useful summaries, they do so at substantial cost and latency, and open-weight models lag significantly. SLS-Bench provides a framework for systematic evaluation of log analysis agents and a scalable blueprint for future synthetic observability benchmarks.

</details>


### [739] [Chain Dimension Scaling: Communication-Efficient Loop-Style Scaling for Industrial Short-Video Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16415)
*Zhimeng Jiang,Yuening Li,Ruixiao Sun,Yuanzhen Lin,Kun Jin,Chuan He,Liang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出链式维度缩放(CDS)，通过复用参数的特征交互块迭代执行，将链长作为不增加参数的缩放维度，在工业短视频排序系统中实现压缩与质量缩放两种收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐排序模型持续向宽度和深度扩展至数十亿参数，导致参数增长、分布式通信开销和训练效率低下的问题，需要一种正交于宽度的缩放策略。

Method: CDS反复应用单个参数共享的特征交互块，迭代次数(链长)成为新增缩放维度且不增加参数；通过轻量级链内残差连接稳定优化并提升质量。支持压缩模式(浅块长链匹配深基线)与质量缩放模式(固定参数预算下增加链长)。

Result: 压缩模式下离线质量与基线差距在0.03%内，可训练参数减少26.6%，训练吞吐提升6.4%，在线参与度中性偏正；质量缩放模式下质量随链长单调提升。墙钟分析表明效率提升主要来自跨设备同步开销降低和优化器更新成本减少，而非FLOPs减少。

Conclusion: 参数共享的迭代计算可作为工业排序系统实用且通信高效的缩放轴，链维度在参数复用之外提供额外建模能力。

Abstract: Industrial recommendation rankers keep scaling in width and depth to billions of parameters, but this increasingly incurs costs in parameter growth, distributed communication overhead, and training inefficiency. We introduce \underline{C}hain \underline{D}imension \underline{S}caling (CDS), a scaling strategy orthogonal to width and depth. CDS repeatedly applies a single feature-interaction block with parameters shared across iterations, so the number of iterations (the chain length) becomes a new scaling dimension that adds no parameters. A lightweight intra-chain residual connection stabilizes optimization and improves quality. CDS enables two regimes. In the \emph{compression regime}, shallow blocks with a longer chain match deeper baselines with fewer parameters and faster training; in the \emph{quality-scaling regime}, increasing chain length under a fixed parameter budget yields consistent offline and online gains, suggesting the chain dimension adds modeling capacity beyond parameter reuse. We evaluate CDS in a large-scale multi-task short-video ranking system in production. In the compression regime, CDS stays within $0.03\%$ of baseline offline quality while reducing trainable parameters by 26.6\% and improving training throughput by 6.4\%, with neutral-to-positive online participation. In the quality-scaling regime, quality improves monotonically with chain length. Wall-clock analysis shows the efficiency gain comes mainly not from reduced FLOPs but from lower cross-device synchronization overhead and reduced optimizer update cost. These results position parameter-shared iterative computation as a practical, communication-efficient scaling axis for industrial ranking systems.

</details>


### [740] [AuthGateBench: Benchmarking LLMs as Authorization Gate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16426)
*Zhixiong Zhuang,Jin Jia,Zhiwei Shang,Ziyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AuthGateBench——首个面向良性请求的策略引导授权门控基准，通过对比对设计评估模型能否基于上下文而非仅动作本身进行授权判定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化审批系统将授权决策委托给 LLM 分类器，使编码智能体可在极少人工监督下执行高风险操作，但存在范围升级等失效模式；现有基准主要关注恶意请求下的拒绝行为，隐含策略，缺乏对良性请求授权门控的系统评估。

Method: 构建新流程：由 LLM 生成对比对（contrast pairs），动作与轨迹完全相同，仅请求不同，从而在 block 与 allow 之间翻转标签，以检验模型是否基于上下文推理；并考察辅助环境信号是否有助决策。基准含 1,400 个实例，覆盖源自真实事件的五类失效模式。

Result: 评估显示，准确率在不同失效模式间下降不均，模型过度依赖内部安全对齐；即使被明确授权，模型仍屏蔽多数动作，表现出不稳定而非确定性的决策；而回溯检索的环境信号可显著提升授权准确率。

Conclusion: AuthGateBench 揭示了当前 LLM 授权门控在良性请求下的系统性缺陷，强调需要基于上下文与策略的推理能力；环境信号的引入是提升授权判定可靠性的有效途径。

Abstract: Automated approval systems let coding agents execute high-risk actions with minimal human oversight by delegating the authorization decision to a classifier, typically a large language model (LLM). Such systems, adopted in tools like Claude Code and Codex, remain vulnerable to failure modes such as scope escalation, where the agent takes actions exceeding what the user authorized. Existing benchmarks focus mainly on malicious requests, evaluating refusal under an implicit policy. We introduce AuthGateBench, the first policy-guided benchmark for authorization gating under benign requests. We implement a novel pipeline where an LLM generates contrast pairs with identical action and trajectory but differing request, flipping the label between block and allow. This allows us to assess whether models reason over context rather than the action alone. We further examine whether auxiliary environment signals can help models make better decisions. The resulting benchmark comprises 1,400 instances spanning five failure modes drawn from real-world Claude Code incidents. Evaluations show accuracy degrades unevenly across failure modes as models over-rely on internal safety alignment, and models still block most actions even when explicitly authorized, revealing unstable rather than deterministic decisions; retrospectively retrieved environment signals, however, substantially improve authorization accuracy.

</details>


### [741] [RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16443)
*Yuanpeng He,Ceyao Zhang,Fangjing Li,Kefei Zhu,Lijian Li,Yueheng Li,Tianjia He,Wenpin Jiao,Zhi Jin,Yaodong Yang,Yuanpei Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RAP-WAM通过预测性排练与动作扰动，从视频生成先验中提取动作响应信号用于策略学习，无需外部具身数据或额外评分网络，在仿真与真机任务上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界动作模型借助视频生成先验联合预测未来观测与机器人动作，但如何让未来预测有效指导策略学习仍是关键难题：既需确定未来预测中哪些信息应作为监督信号，又需避免依赖额外评分网络或部署期探针，同时摆脱对外部具身数据中间预训练的依赖。

Method: 提出RAP-WAM，包含三项核心设计：(1) 预测性排练（Rehearsal）：在模型生成输入上训练但保留真实记录目标，并将反复出现的误差累积为空间先验；(2) 动作扰动（Action Perturbations）：扰动动作并测量视频预测的变化，获得动作响应；(3) 基于动作响应的时空信用分配：结合响应、预测误差与排练先验分配视觉监督，并通过空间聚合响应确定未来各动作步的监督强度。此外引入未来监督查询与耦合动作投影，无需独立评分网络或部署期探针，基础模型直接在视频预训练骨干上学习。

Result: 在42项RoboDojo任务上，固定基础与其智能体精炼、任务条件化系统的平均成功率分别为12.85%和15.62%，Score分别为17.86和20.59；在15项真机任务上，完整系统达到89.00%的任务宏平均成功率，超过五个基线中最强者37.67个百分点；在315个固定输出仿真窗口中，45.21%的响应Top20位置落在误差Top20之外，表明动作响应包含预测误差之外的信息。

Conclusion: 动作响应提供了超越预测误差的额外监督信息，基于响应的时空信用分配可有效利用视频生成先验指导策略学习，且无需额外评分网络、部署探针或外部具身数据中间预训练，在仿真与真实机器人任务上均取得领先性能。

Abstract: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error.

</details>


### [742] [XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16478)
*Wei Yao,Chuyao Wang,Ziwei Wang,Nabil Aouf*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出XFD，一种由可解释人工智能（XAI）引导的傅里叶域泛化框架，用于纯仿真下的sim-to-real强化学习。它从仿真观测中提取归因图，转化为策略条件化的傅里叶域干预，在仿真内构造增强鲁棒性的视觉域，从而提升零样本真实世界部署性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的自动驾驶强化学习策略在仿真中训练后，部署到真实世界常出现严重性能退化。现有sim-to-real方法存在不足：基于图像迁移的域适应需要大量目标域数据且局限于部署域；策略无关的域随机化引入无引导扰动，未必反映真实的sim-to-real差异，导致迁移效果欠佳。

Method: 提出XFD框架：1）从仿真观测中提取可解释性归因图；2）将归因转换为策略条件化的傅里叶域干预，扰动对外观敏感的频谱成分，同时保留定义任务的空间结构，从而完全在仿真内构造增强鲁棒性的视觉域；3）设计鲁棒策略优化，引导策略关注任务关键特征、抑制对无关视觉信息的敏感性。

Result: 在仿真与零样本真实世界部署的广泛实验中，XFD在行驶距离和奖励上持续优于标准策略和随机域随机化基线，在背景杂乱的新地图上提升尤为明显。基于归因的分析进一步证明，所提策略在仿真与真实观测间保持了更一致的任务相关视觉证据。

Conclusion: XFD通过XAI引导的傅里叶域泛化，在纯仿真条件下有效缩小sim-to-real差距，实现更强的零样本真实世界迁移与任务相关视觉注意力一致性。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.

</details>


### [743] [PXRD-Bench: How Close Are We to Determining Crystal Structures from Powder Diffraction?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16480)
*Dongyeop Woo,Nofit Segal,Nayoung Kim,Minkyu Kim,Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli,Sungsoo Ahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出PXRD-Bench基准与Bragglite模型，系统评测粉末XRD到晶体结构生成模型的能力与局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从PXRD确定晶体结构对新材料表征意义重大，但现有生成模型评测碎片化，且多假设单相样品与已知成分，难以反映真实场景。

Method: 构建PXRD-Bench统一基准，覆盖未知逐元素原子数及两相混合物中两结构的恢复，提供约410万条带模拟PXRD的训练结构，并测试对未见成分与结构原型的泛化，同时在排除结构匹配训练条目后评估实验PXRD恢复。通过系统研究PXRD建模选择，提出Bragglite模型作为强参考基线。

Result: Bragglite在已知成分的实验RRUFF图谱上取得44.2%的Top-1匹配率，较最强先前基线提升24.6%。分析发现部分模型未能从实验PXRD中获益，对未见结构原型的泛化及两相混合物恢复仍具挑战。

Conclusion: 该基准、系统研究与Bragglite共同厘清了当前PXRD到结构模型的能力边界与局限。

Abstract: Determining crystal structures from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) would enable routine characterization of newly synthesized materials, including those absent from reference databases. Generative models offer a promising approach, but existing evaluations remain fragmented and largely assume single-phase samples with known composition. To fill this gap, we introduce PXRD-Bench, a unified benchmark that extends evaluation to unknown per-element atom counts and recovery of both structures in two-phase mixtures. It provides approximately 4.1 million training structures with simulated PXRD, tests generalization to unseen compositions and structural prototypes, and evaluates recovery from experimental PXRD after excluding structurally matching training entries.
