Abstract: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have substantially improved the capabilities of GUI agents, while memory augmentation has emerged as a promising approach for reusing knowledge from past interactions. However, existing memory augmented GUI agents typically adopt a fixed representation strategy, providing retrieved experience as a static modality. It remains unclear whether a single memory modality is consistently optimal, or how modality preference changes across interaction steps. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of memory modality in VLM based GUI agents. Across GUI benchmarks, we find that the preferred memory representation is strongly step dependent. Motivated by the finding, we introduce \textbf{SwitchMem}, a routing framework that dynamically selects between textual and visual memory representations at each step. Across three GUI benchmarks, SwitchMem outperforms memory augmented baselines that rely on static memory representations. Our findings validate our claim that memory modality is a step dependent decision rather than a fixed design choice. Code and project resources are available at https://txxnrd.github.io/switchmem

</details>


### [843] [Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17976)
*Zhengtao Zou,Pekka Marttinen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过深度线索冲突实验、表征分析与干预，发现视觉语言模型（VLM）在判断物体远近时系统性地偏向图像平面线索（视大小、垂直位置），但其内部表征中仍可解码出正确深度顺序，存在"能表征却不用"的表征-使用错配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究VLM判断物体远近时究竟利用了深度信息，还是依赖图像平面线索；并检验模型内部是否真正保有深度信息，从而理解其深度判断机制。

Method: 构建线索一致与线索冲突条件，聚焦视大小与垂直位置两类图像平面线索，在渲染场景与真实照片上进行对比；对查询物体的视觉表征进行解码分析，并加入图像与类别控制；通过物体级写回（object-level write-back）强化模型自身的深度读出，进行干预实验（不更新参数、不使用深度真值标注）。

Result: 跨模型族与规模，深度判断系统性偏向误导性线索；即便模型答错，正确深度顺序仍可从查询物体的视觉表征中解码，且该信号超出两类目标线索，属图像依赖的深度信息。物体级写回可纠正冲突条件下的错误决策，且修正效果依赖写入信号的方向与目标token，其强度因架构与领域而异。

Conclusion: VLM的深度表征能力与深度信息使用之间存在错配：模型可保留有用的深度信息，却让竞争性图像平面线索对答案施加更大影响。这一发现揭示了"表征存在但未被有效利用"的现象。

Abstract: Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. Strengthening the model's own depth readout through object-level write-back can correct conflict decisions without updating model parameters or using ground-truth depth annotations. Interventions show that the effect of this correction depends on the direction and target tokens of the written signal, while its strength varies across architectures and domains. Together, these findings reveal a mismatch between a model's ability to represent depth and use this information when deciding the answer. VLMs can retain useful depth information while allowing competing image-plane cues to exert greater influence on their answers.

</details>


### [844] [SHELDON: Reasoning through Dual Search over Hypothesis and Observation Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18025)
*Harshit Joshi,Priyank Shethia,Monica S. Lam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SHELDON，一种将假设空间与观察空间分离表示并联合探索的科学推理框架，通过主动寻找新观察与新假设，突破已有假设引导的局部修正，在诊断、抽象推理和优化任务上超越基线最高26.7分，并产生最多4.5倍的新颖解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法在收集观察时往往是为当前假设寻找证据，再以这些假设及其关联证据为条件生成新假设，导致观察发现与既有假设耦合，偏向局部修正而难以探索未知的假设区域。

Method: 受假设-演绎方法（Hempel, 1945）与科学发现双空间模型（Klahr & Dunbar, 1988）启发，提出SHELDON：一种科学推理"装置"（harness），将假设空间与观察空间分别表示并联合探索，主动同时寻找新观察与新假设，从而发现当前假设无法解释的观察。

Result: 在诊断、抽象推理和优化基准上，SHELDON较所评估基线提升最高达26.7个百分点；额外分析显示其生成的新颖解最多为基线的4.5倍。

Conclusion: 将观察发现与假设生成解耦并联合探索，可暴露理解的空白、驱动新探究，并引导生成超越既有假设修正的新假设，从而显著提升复杂推理与发现任务的表现与新颖性。

Abstract: Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr & Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide the generation of hypotheses beyond refinements of existing ones. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning, and optimization benchmarks, SHELDON outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points. Additional analysis shows that SHELDON generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

</details>


### [845] [Beyond Black Boxes: Visual Grounding for Text Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18047)
*Slimane Larabi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种将文本嵌入转换为视觉地形草图（sketch）的表征框架，用于可视化、信息检索和推理探索，并在 MS-COCO 上验证其检索价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者有三个动机：一是可视化文本表征并探索其在 AI 可解释性方面的潜力；二是研究基于草图的表征对信息检索的潜在收益；三是受"心理意象"概念启发，探索其在推理中的可能性。

Method: 提出基于草图的视觉接地（visual grounding）框架，将文本表征转化为视觉地形草图，通过对应草图突出文本嵌入中编码的语义内容。

Result: 在 MS-COCO 数据集上评估草图的文本检索效用。对比显示：SBERT 在严格 top-1 检索准确率上仍占优，但在 top-5 检索上与草图方法性能相当；将 SBERT 与草图方法结合的级联方案优于单独使用 SBERT。

Conclusion: 基于草图的表征若直接在文本上训练，可能为信息检索带来显著潜力。

Abstract: In this paper, our goal is to represent text embeddings as sketches for three main reasons. First, to visualize text representation and to explore their potential their potential for AI explainability. Second, to investigate the potential benefits of the sketch-based representation for information retrieval. Third, to explore their potential for reasoning, drawing inspiration from the concept of mental imagery. We propose a sketch-based visual grounding framework that transforms text representations into visual topographic sketches. Our approach aims to emphasis the semantics content encoded in the text embeddings through the corresponding sketch.
  Evaluations are conducted on the MS-COCO dataset to examine the utility of these sketches for text retrieval. The comparative study of SBERT and Sketch-based method reveals that SBERT retains an advantage in strict top-1 retrieval accuracy while achieving comparable performance to the sketch-based method in top-5 retrieval. A cascaded approach combining SBERT and the sketch-based method outperforms SBERT alone, suggesting that the Sketch-based representation could offer significant potential for information retrieval if trained directly on text.

</details>


### [846] [Can Agents Forget When Asked? A Benchmark for Memory Unlearning in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18052)
*Bofan Xie,Chaokun Wang,Guanchen Ge,Songyao Wang,Fang Niu,Hang Zhang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Bemula——首个面向 LLM 智能体记忆遗忘（memory unlearning）的基准，包含 50 段多轮对话、6 类共 135 个遗忘请求与 1,742 个测试问题；实验表明现有主流记忆系统在按用户请求精确遗忘上几乎全面失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆已成为 LLM 智能体的核心组件，用户会要求删除敏感或过时事实；但现有记忆基准只评估写入、检索与组织，缺乏对"按用户显式请求遗忘"能力的评测，导致该能力长期未被度量。

Method: 构建 Bemula 基准：50 个多会话对话实例、6 类共 135 个遗忘请求、1,742 个测试问题；每个对话配有不含请求的对照版本，只有真正存储过目标信息的系统才能获得遗忘得分。通过配对版本上的五套测试衡量：信息存储、请求信息删除、无关记忆保留、相似事实再学习、抗提取攻击。

Result: 在 Bemula 上，评测 6 种主流记忆系统 × 3 个主干 LLM，并在其中两个主干上加入 Full Context LLM 基线。结果均为负面：所有系统与主干组合端到端通过率不超过 1.5%，多数系统一个请求都无法通过；系统要么在简单攻击下仍可提取目标信息，要么删除范围远超请求内容。

Conclusion: 记忆遗忘仍是智能体记忆设计的开放难题，现有系统无法在精确删除与记忆保持之间取得平衡；数据与代码已开源。

Abstract: Long-term memory has become a core component of large language model (LLM) agents. As agents accumulate personal information over long-term use, users increasingly ask them to delete sensitive or outdated facts. A memory system should honor such requests. It should remove exactly what was requested and keep the rest of its memory intact. However, existing memory benchmarks evaluate only memory writing, retrieval, and organization, so whether agents can forget at the user's explicit request remains under-evaluated. To address this gap, we propose Bemula, the first benchmark dedicated to memory unlearning. It comprises 50 multi-session dialogue instances, 135 forget requests of six types, and 1,742 test questions. Each dialogue has a control version without the requests, so that only systems that have stored the target can earn credit for forgetting. Across the paired versions, five test suites measure storage, removal of the requested information, preservation of unrelated memories, relearning of similar facts, and resistance to extraction attacks. On Bemula, we evaluate six mainstream memory systems under three backbone LLMs, together with the Full Context LLM on two of them. The results are negative. Across all evaluated systems and backbones, no system passes more than 1.5% of forget requests end to end, and most pass none at all. These systems either leave the requested information extractable under simple attacks or delete far more than requested. Memory unlearning therefore remains an open challenge for agent memory design. We release our data and code at https://github.com/Nboxff/bemula-benchmark.

</details>


### [847] [WorkRover: Scaling Long-Horizon Cowork Agent Training Via Recursive Environment Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18067)
*Hang He,Linting Wang,Guanming Liu,Bo Mao,Jinxiu Liu,Yiran Suo,Maosen Zhou,Zhiheng Xi,Guanting Dong,Zhou Shao,Rui Zheng,Jie Zhou,Chengcheng Wan,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xipeng Qiu,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 WorkRover 框架，通过递归环境演化训练长时程协作智能体，包含 harness 驱动的联合合成、FCR 修复选择与 VTCA 信用分配三项技术，在多个协作基准上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体的强化学习依赖可扩展的交互环境，但环境初次生成后往往需要反复测试与修正；修正任务缺陷时还需同步更新其工作上下文与验证器。现有构建流程对这种迭代式精炼支持不足，难以保持各组件语义对齐。

Method: WorkRover 为递归环境演化框架：1）harness 驱动的合成，让构建智能体联合生成并验证语义对齐的工作上下文、可执行任务与基于证据的验证器，并依据工作区状态和执行反馈自适应调整动作，而非固定流程；2）Factorial Compatibility Replay（FCR），利用 rollout 反馈通过依赖封闭重放评估各组件修订的组合，在满足任务需求与评估约束的前提下，选出最小且经验证的修复；3）Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment（VTCA），在轨迹级 GRPO 优势上叠加确定性工作区进展检查信号，并借助记录的工具输出与产物依赖，将有限比例的正向进展信用分配给前置回合。

Result: 以 WorkRover 对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 进行后训练得到 WorkRover-35B-A3B，在 JobBench 上提升 26.27 个百分点，OfficeQA Pro 上提升 29.32 个百分点，GDPval v2 上提升 413.25 Elo 分。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明 WorkRover 为长时程协作智能体的可扩展训练提供了有前景的基础。

Abstract: Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. To support environment evolution, we introduce Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR), which uses rollout feedback to evaluate combinations of component revisions through dependency-closed replay and selects the smallest validated repair among tested candidates while preserving task requirements and evaluation constraints. To provide finer-grained training signals, we propose Verifier-to-Turn Credit Assignment (VTCA), which augments trajectory-level GRPO advantages with signals from deterministic workspace-progress checks and assigns a bounded share of positive-progress credit to prerequisite turns using recorded tool-output and artifact dependencies. Using WorkRover, we post-train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to obtain WorkRover-35B-A3B and evaluate it on several cowork-agent benchmarks. Its reported scores exceed those of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench, 29.32 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro, and 413.25 Elo points on GDPval v2. These results suggest that WorkRover offers a promising foundation for scalable training of long-horizon cowork agents.

</details>


### [848] [AReaL-RSI: Adaptive Scaling and Coordination of Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18083)
*Wenhao Zhou,Jiajun Song,Haitao Wang,Zipeng Qiu,Yingqi Peng,Ruida Xu,Jiale Li,Wenshuang Li,Shusheng Xu,Wei Dong,Hao Dai,Tongkai Yang,Yi Gao,Binhang Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 AReaL-RSI 框架，在不更新主干 LLM 权重的前提下组织持久化智能体研究团队，通过领导智能体选题、条件记忆共享与基于证据的复盘实现递归自改进的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自改进的规模化需要额外计算来产生有效研究进展，但简单增加研究智能体数量会遇到三个问题：早期评估分数可能误导其潜力、共享发现可能丢失适用条件、有用流程可能局限于已完成的研究中而无法复用。

Method: AReaL-RSI 以评估结果和全系统资源开销来刻画规模扩展问题。具体机制包括：领导智能体选择与任务匹配的研究方向并指导进行中的研究；条件记忆共享区分未解决问题与有支撑的发现，并支持接收方适配；在递归演化中，每个轮次后以基于证据的复盘修订研究智能体的研究方向、知识与技能，用于后续轮次。

Result: 在报告的资源分配下，两个主干模型上 AReaL-RSI 相比 Codex-Goal 将 Terminal Bench 性能提升 2.2 个百分点，KernelBench 平均加速提升 32.2–36.8%。可扩展性比较显示优于原生缩放：经验共享加专业化角色相比独立探索在核函数延迟上低 1.9–27.5%，相比仅共享低 1.3–33.9%，覆盖全部七个可比的任务-主干组合。

Conclusion: 在不更新主干权重的条件下，通过领导调度、条件记忆共享与证据复盘式递归演化，可有效组织持久化智能体研究团队并取得优于单纯扩展的规模效益。

Abstract: Scaling recursive self-improvement requires additional computation to produce useful research progress in reaching persistent objectives. Intuitively, more researcher agents can explore more hypotheses, but early evaluation scores might misrepresent their promise, shared findings could lose their applicability conditions, and useful procedures could remain confined to completed investigations. In this paper, we present AReaL-RSI, a framework for organizing a persistent research team of agents without updating backbone LLM weights. We formulate the scaling problem in terms of evaluated outcomes and whole-system resource expenditure. Concretely, a leader agent selects task-appropriate research orientations and guides ongoing investigations; conditional memory sharing distinguishes unresolved problems from supported findings and enables recipient adaptation. During recursive evolution, after each campaign, evidence-based review revises researcher orientation, knowledge, and skills for later campaigns. Experiments compare AReaL-RSI with Codex-Goal on downstream harness optimization, GPU kernel optimization, and AI research tasks using two backbones. Under the reported resource allocations, AReaL-RSI improves Terminal Bench performance by 2.2 percentage points for each backbone and increases mean KernelBench speedup by 32.2-36.8%; further scalability comparisons favor the design of AReaL-RSI over native scaling: combining experience sharing with specialized researcher roles yields 1.9-27.5% lower kernel latency than independent exploration and 1.3-33.9% lower latency than sharing alone across all seven comparable task-backbone pairs.

</details>


### [849] [ResearchFlow-Eval: Tracing the Execution Gap in End-to-End Multi-Claim Autoresearch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18088)
*Peng Jiang,Dongyang Li,Quanying Liu,Xiaoxuan Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ResearchFlow-Eval，一个在阶段与论点两个层面评估自动研究系统连续科研执行与迭代的细粒度框架，发现所有系统的实验执行均落后于设计与规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动研究系统日益承担完整研究项目，但现有评估多针对孤立任务或最终产物打分，未衡量多论点协作、多阶段连续流程以及随证据积累而修正实验的过程级能力。

Method: 以已发表论文为锚点，派生阶段专属评分量表，将每个研究阶段分解为多个维度与可独立打分的量表项；据此对各研究阶段打分，并重点考察跨尝试的论点完成度与实验修正。应用于通用智能体框架、技能增强框架及具备研究专用编排的系统。

Result: 在所有评测系统中，实验执行始终落后于设计与规划；执行环节难以产出高质量结果、难以满足论点要求，反复尝试很少带来可测量改进；技能增强与研究专用编排均未可靠提升得分。

Conclusion: ResearchFlow-Eval将自动研究评估从孤立单目标的运行，扩展到系统追索多论点并在迭代中改进工作的连续工作流。

Abstract: Autoresearch systems increasingly undertake entire research projects. In practice, scientific research requires systems to pursue multiple interdependent claims through a continuous, multi-stage workflow and revise experiments as evidence accumulates. Existing evaluations of autoresearch systems, however, typically score isolated tasks or final artifacts, leaving these process-level capabilities largely unmeasured. We therefore introduce ResearchFlow-Eval, a fine-grained framework for assessing continuous scientific execution and iteration at both the stage and claim levels. Each evaluation is grounded in a published anchor paper, from which we derive stage-specific rubrics that decompose each research stage into dimensions and separately scored rubric items. Using these rubrics, we score each research stage and examine experimental execution in detail, focusing on multi-claim completion and revisions across attempts. We apply the evaluation framework to general-purpose agent harnesses, skill-augmented harnesses, and systems with research-specific orchestration. Across all evaluated systems, experimental execution consistently lags behind design and planning. Within execution, systems struggle to produce high-quality results and meet claim requirements, and repeated attempts rarely yield measurable improvements. Moreover, neither skill augmentation nor research-specific orchestration reliably yields higher scores. ResearchFlow-Eval thus extends autoresearch evaluation beyond isolated, single-objective runs to continuous workflows in which systems pursue multiple claims and refine their work across iterations.

</details>


### [850] [One-Sided Verification Under Limited Expert Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18089)
*Fan Nie,Haotian Ye,Shurui Liu,Zihao Wang,Stefano Ermon,James Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 OSVerify 框架，将"错误提议"与"错误验证"解耦，在限定有效解误拒率（FNR）的前提下最大化无效解拒真率（TNR），从而在有限人力下优先筛选出稀有有效解、过滤无效候选，平均减少 46% 的无效解人工评审量（经验证器后训练可达 57%），并应用于真实科研论文纠错与数学开放猜想验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 在科学发现中日益有用，但对缺乏可靠自动评估的问题，人类专家评审仍不可替代；随着候选解生成规模远超可用评审能力，形成根本性瓶颈。因此需要在有限人力预算下对候选解进行验证：既要过滤无效候选以降低人工负担，又要避免误杀稀有的有效解。

Method: 采用单侧验证目标：在约束有效解误拒率（FNR）的前提下，最大化无效解拒真率（TNR），将人工评审成本显式纳入优化目标。基于"验证一个具体错误比发现错误更容易"的直觉，提出 OSVerify 算法框架，将错误提议（error proposal）与错误验证（error validation）解耦：提议器通过分层分解在不同粒度上搜索解中的错误，验证器则区分实质性错误与细微或幻觉性错误。此外对验证器进行后训练以进一步提升性能。

Result: 在竞赛级与研究级基准上，相同经验低 FNR 约束下，OSVerify 相比投票（voting）基线将无效解的人工评审次数平均减少 46%；对验证器进行后训练后，减少比例提升至 57%。在真实应用案例中，OSVerify 识别出已发表研究论文中的错误并获得原作者确认，还帮助解决了三个 Langlands 开放猜想，且结果获得专家确认。

Conclusion: OSVerify 通过解耦错误提议与验证，在有限人力下有效降低无效解评审成本并保护有效解，兼具基准性能与真实科研实用性，可作为促进人机科研协作的工具。

Abstract: AI has become increasingly helpful in scientific discovery, yet human expert review remains essential for those problems without reliable automated evaluation, posing a fundamental challenge as candidate generation scales beyond available review capacity. This paper studies verification under limited human effort, where rare valid solutions need to be prioritized while invalid candidates should be filtered out to reduce human workload. We adopt the one-sided verification objective that maximizes the rejection rate of invalid solutions (TNR) under a constraint on the false-rejection rate of valid ones (FNR), making human review cost an explicit term to minimize. Drawing on the intuition that verifying a specific error can be easier than discovering one, we introduce OSVerify, an algorithmic framework that decouples error proposal from error validation. The error proposer searches for errors in solutions across different granularities by hierarchical decomposition, while the validator distinguishes substantial errors from minor or hallucinated ones. Experiments on competition- and research-level benchmarks show that OSVerify reduces the number of human reviews of invalid solutions by 46% on average compared to voting baselines under the same empirical low FNR constraint. Our post-training of the validator further improves the reduction to 57%. As high-impact real-world use cases, we apply OSVerify to identify errors in published research papers that are subsequently confirmed by the original authors and help resolve three Langlands open conjectures that are confirmed by experts, demonstrating its utility to facilitate human-AI research collaboration.

</details>


### [851] [AM-Bench: Understanding Agents under Task Underspecification across Models and Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18090)
*Kaiyu Huang,Yiting Li,Angyang Gu,Pinjia He,Minchen Yu,Qingjiang Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 AM-Bench 基准，用于系统表征语言模型智能体在任务规格歧义或不完整时的表现，发现目标缺失影响完成、上下文缺失增加开销、约束缺失削弱合规，且缺失比歧义影响更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体在面对歧义或不完整的任务规格时，执行与澄清都存在困难，但现有研究对不同模型与执行框架下智能体如何应对这些信息缺口缺乏系统刻画。

Method: 构建 AM-Bench，基于 Terminal-Bench 2.0 与 Harness-Bench 改编 48 个任务，每个任务含一个完整规格参照与六个变体，覆盖目标、上下文、约束的歧义或缺失；对五种模型与四种执行框架的所有组合进行 20,160 次运行评估。

Result: 目标缺口阻碍任务完成，上下文缺口增加 token 消耗，约束缺口削弱合规性但未必妨碍完成；三类领域中缺失相比歧义更降低成功率。完整信息下的优势不一定持续，系统排名依赖模型×框架组合及评价标准（完成、成功或重复一致性）。基于澄清请求与匹配完整规格运行的估计表明，澄清可挽回未完成工作，但多数约束违规仍无法解决。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持在不同信息条件下进行模型-框架联合评估，并在依赖动作前对未解决的需求进行针对性澄清；同时公开 AM-Bench 项目仓库以支持后续关于任务欠规格下智能体的研究。

Abstract: Ambiguous or incomplete task specifications complicate both execution and clarification for language-model agents. Yet agents' responses to these information gaps remain poorly characterized across models and execution harnesses. We present AM-Bench, a benchmark built from 48 tasks adapted from Terminal-Bench 2.0 and Harness-Bench. Each task includes a fully specified reference and six variants spanning ambiguous or missing goals, context, and constraints. We evaluate every pairing of five models and four harnesses over 20,160 runs. Our results reveal distinct execution deficits: goal gaps hinder completion, context gaps increase token use, and constraint gaps weaken compliance without necessarily preventing completion. Missingness lowers success more than ambiguity in all three domains. These effects also reshape system comparisons: advantages under complete information need not persist, and rankings depend on model $\times$ harness pairings and the evaluation criterion -- completion, success, or repeat consistency. Estimates based on observed clarification requests and matched fully specified runs further suggest that clarification could recover unfinished work while leaving most constraint violations unresolved. Together, these findings motivate joint model-harness evaluation across information conditions and targeted clarification of unresolved requirements before dependent actions. To support future research on agents under task underspecification, we provide the AM-Bench project repository at https://github.com/s4-lab-cuhksz/AM-Bench.git.

</details>


### [852] [LifeSearch: Benchmarking Deep Research Agents for Real-World Life and Productivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18092)
*Yibo Wang,Senjie Jin,Yansong Ning,Xinbing Liang,Haotian Luo,Jiazheng Zhang,Yuxuan He,Will Wu,Clarenceai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 LifeSearch 基准，用于评估深度研究（DR）智能体在真实生活与职业生产力场景中的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 DR 基准多聚焦学术研究或合成任务，缺乏对真实生活与职业生产力场景的评估，导致 DR 智能体在该类场景中的能力评估不足。

Method: 构建 LifeSearch 基准，包含来自 7 个具体生活与生产力领域真实用户查询种子衍生的 203 个中英文任务；投入超 4,500 小时人工标注，撰写超 4,000 条专家细粒度评分标准，涵盖报告内容的覆盖度与准确性，以及数值、单位、日期和 URL 等具体标准。在统一评估框架下对 12 个先进 DR 智能体进行广泛实验，并通过对比候选 LLM 评判者与人工评分标签确定评分配置。

Result: 表现最佳的前沿智能体 GPT-5.6 Sol 仅取得 63.4% 的分数，说明真实生活与职业 DR 任务仍有较大提升空间；人工排序研究显示基准总分与人工判断高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.89，Kendall τ=0.81）。

Conclusion: LifeSearch 为推进 DR 智能体面向真实世界生活与生产力场景提供了严谨的评估框架与基础。

Abstract: Deep research (DR) agents address open-ended information needs through multi-step reasoning, long-horizon web search, and evidence synthesis. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on academic research or synthetic tasks, leaving DR agents' capabilities in real-world life and professional productivity settings insufficiently evaluated. To bridge this gap, we introduce LifeSearch, a challenging benchmark comprising 203 Chinese and English tasks derived from real-user query seeds across 7 concrete life and productivity domains. With more than 4,500 hours of human annotation, we construct over 4,000 expert-written, fine-grained rubrics, covering both report-content criteria for coverage and accuracy and concrete criteria specifying values, units, dates, and URLs. We conduct extensive experiments on 12 advanced DR agents under a unified evaluation harness, systematically analyzing their performance patterns and failure modes. We find that even the best-performing frontier agent, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves a score of only 63.4%, leaving substantial room for improvement on realistic life and professional DR tasks. We select the grading configuration by comparing candidate LLM judges against human rubric labels, and a human ranking study shows strong alignment between aggregate benchmark scores and human judgments (Spearman's $ρ= 0.89$, Kendall's $τ= 0.81$). LifeSearch provides a rigorous evaluation framework and foundation for advancing DR agents toward real-world life and productivity.

</details>


### [853] [CompanionSafe: From Multi-turn Safety Evaluation to Guardrails for AI Companions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18095)
*Xinyang Liao,Lingyu Li,Kaicheng Shen,Yang Yao,Na Lu,Yan Teng,Xia Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CompanionSafe 框架，包含多轮评测组件 CompanionEval 与风险缓解组件 CompanionGuard，用于 AI 伴侣安全的关系型风险评估与护栏构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 伴侣提供情感支持与持续陪伴，但长期关系互动会引入独特安全风险；已有工作多针对通用危害或特定平台与风险类别，且依赖人工收集对话，难以实现可扩展、贴合用户实际的评测与缓解。

Method: 构建统一"评测—缓解"框架 CompanionSafe：评测端 CompanionEval 基于多样人格、匹配的伴侣角色与对话场景，构建 1,300 个关系化设定，覆盖四个轮次层级，实现可扩展多轮评测；缓解端 CompanionGuard 将基准暴露的失败转化为轮次定位监督，用于伴侣特定风险检测。

Result: 即使强 LLM 与现有守护模型仍易受伴侣特定关系型危害影响；闭源与开源模型均随交互轮次增加而安全风险上升。

Conclusion: CompanionEval 与 CompanionGuard 共同构成实用的评测到缓解闭环，将多轮交互中暴露的关系型安全失败转化为伴侣特定护栏的监督信号。

Abstract: AI companions provide users with emotional support and ongoing companionship, but their sustained relational interactions also introduce distinct safety risks. Prior work largely targets general harms or specific companion platforms and risk categories, while relying on manually collected conversations, limiting scalable and user-grounded evaluation and mitigation. To address this, we introduce CompanionSafe, a unified evaluation-to-mitigation framework for AI companion safety. Its evaluation component, CompanionEval, provides scalable multi-turn evaluation by constructing 1,300 relationally grounded settings from diverse personas, matched companion characters, and dialogue scenarios across four turn tiers. Its mitigation component, CompanionGuard, converts benchmark-exposed failures into turn-localized supervision for companion-specific risk detection. Our results show that even strong LLMs and existing guard models remain vulnerable to companion-specific relational harms, while both closed- and open-source models exhibit increasing safety risks as interactions become longer. Together, CompanionEval and CompanionGuard form a practical evaluation-to-mitigation loop for AI companion safety, turning relational safety failures exposed during multi-turn interaction into supervision for companion-specific guardrails.

</details>


### [854] [Chain of Thought Monitoring Can Fail Even When CoT Is Necessary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18105)
*Lennart Bürger,Piotr Komorowski,Moritz Weckbecker,Evgenii Kortukov,Aakriti Jain,Sebastian Lapuschkin,Wojciech Samek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出"CoT 对答案是否必要"这一二元判据过于粗糙，提出四层 CoT 必要性层级，并构建可测量框架证明即使 CoT 必要，监控仍会失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿实验室用思维链（CoT）监控来检测 AI 系统的不当行为，但其可靠性缺乏可推广的理论依据。近期工作将监控失败归因于 CoT 对答案不必要，并主张 CoT 必要即可监控。本文认为这一二元"必要/不必要"的组织原则过于粗糙，无法刻画不同情形下的可监控性。

Method: 提出基于四个 CoT 必要性层级的更细粒度组织原则，并据此构建框架，通过干预实验在最底三个层级上度量 CoT 可监控性；在真实且困难的预测任务上进行验证。

Result: 在全部三个最底层级上均观察到监控失败，且在三个层级中，CoT 的干预并不影响答案。在困难的医学诊断任务上，患者性别与某临床属性分别在至少 19% 和 24% 的正确回答中影响答案（且 CoT 对答案必要），但其影响几乎从未在 CoT 中被表述出来。

Conclusion: 即便 CoT 对答案必要，也不能保证其可监控；CoT 必要性不足以作为可监控性的充分判据，需要更细粒度的层级化原则来刻画与度量监控可靠性。

Abstract: Chain of Thought (CoT) monitoring is used by frontier labs to detect misbehaviour of AI systems. Yet, its reliability remains poorly understood. We attribute this to the lack of a successful organizing principle that leads to generalizable conclusions about monitoring reliability in different regimes. Recent work attributes monitoring failures to the CoT not being necessary for the answer, and argues that CoT becomes monitorable when it is necessary. We show that this binary necessary/not-necessary organizing principle is too coarse by demonstrating that monitoring failures persist even if the CoT is necessary for the answer. In response, we introduce a more fine-grained organizing principle based on a hierarchy of four CoT necessity levels. Building on this hierarchy, we develop a framework for measuring CoT monitorability at the three lowest levels via intervention experiments. We demonstrate monitoring failures at all three of these levels on realistic, hard prediction tasks. On a difficult medical-diagnosis task, patient sex and a clinical attribute influence the answer in at least 19% and 24% of correct responses with a necessary CoT, respectively, yet their influence is almost never articulated. These results show that even when CoT is necessary, it is not guaranteed to be monitorable.

</details>


### [855] [Monitoring latent reasoning in looped language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18127)
*Pawel Olszowiec,Paulina Tomaszewska,Maciej Żelaszczyk,Michal Byra,Neo Christopher Chung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究构建了基于机制可解释性的五视角审查协议，考察四个家族共八个循环语言模型，揭示其迭代变换是否真正提升能力及在提示扰动下的稳定性，并对比"携带循环"与"重读循环"两类信息传递方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型通过复用同一组层实现每token生成的重复计算，在不增加存储成本的前提下提供更多潜在计算量，因而日益流行。然而其分析仍处于起步阶段：尚不清楚迭代变换是否真正提升了模型能力，也不清楚这些模型在提示扰动下是否保持稳定。该研究旨在填补这一空白，并关注循环语言模型的安全性与高效使用。

Method: 构建一个植根于机制可解释性的审查协议，包含五种多样化的分析视角。将该协议应用于四个家族共八个循环语言模型。关键区分维度为提示信息的传递方式：一类是"携带循环"（carry loops，如Ouro、LoopUS），提示仅在循环状态内部传递；另一类是"重读循环"（re-read loops，如Parcae，以及Raven家族的Rec-OLMo与Huginn），提示在每次迭代时被重新提供。

Result: 通过多视角审查协议对八个循环语言模型进行系统对比分析，刻画了迭代变换对模型能力的影响，以及模型在提示扰动下的稳定性表现，并揭示了携带循环与重读循环两类架构在行为上的差异。

Conclusion: 研究结果为循环语言模型的安全性和高效使用提供了有价值的见解，有助于理解循环计算机制对模型能力与鲁棒性的实际贡献。

Abstract: Looped language models (LMs) reuse one block of layers several times per token generation, promising more latent computation at no additional storage cost. Despite their rising popularity, the analysis of looped LMs is still in its infancy: little is known about whether the iterative transformations actually improve their capabilities, or whether these models remain stable under prompt perturbation. We construct an inspection protocol rooted in Mechanistic Interpretability comprising five diverse lenses. We apply it to examine eight looped LMs from four families. Models differ in many aspects but the key one is whether the prompt is transmitted only within the looped state (carry loops: Ouro, LoopUS) or re-supplied at every iteration (re-read loops: Parcae, and Rec-OLMo & Huginn from the Raven family). The results of our study provide valuable insights concerning safety and efficient use of looped language models.

</details>


### [856] [Mitigating Cross-Modal Hallucinations by Correcting Modality Misrouting in Omnimodal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18141)
*Yu Mi,Licheng Pan,Jiayi Zhu,Qirui Liu,Yitong Qiao,Changtong Xu,Tao Wei,Fei Sun,Zhixuan Chu,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现OLLMs在视听干扰下存在"模态误路由"现象（联合预测错误但相关单模态分支仍可恢复正确答案），并提出免训练推理时方法CaRe进行识别与纠正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Omnimodal大语言模型（OLLMs）在音频-视觉干扰下易产生跨模态幻觉。作者发现：相当一部分错误联合预测中，与问题相关的单模态分支仍能给出正确答案，说明任务相关证据即便未体现在联合预测中，仍可从相应模态中恢复。作者将这一可恢复的失败模式称为"模态误路由"（modality misrouting），并据此提出纠正动机。

Method: 提出CaRe（Conflict-aware Residual Intervention），一种无需训练的推理时方法。流程：（1）用纯文本模态探针识别候选的模态特异性反事实分支；（2）当其预测与原联合预测冲突时，判定可能存在误路由；（3）计算反事实表征与融合表征之间差异的残差方向，用于将原始多模态状态导向相关模态证据，同时保留原视听推理路径中的两个模态；（4）干预强度依据反事实分支的置信度自适应调整。

Result: 在CMM与AVHBench两个基准、两种OLLMs上的实验表明，CaRe一致优于所评估的推理时幻觉缓解基线方法。

Conclusion: 跨模态幻觉中存在可恢复的"模态误路由"失败模式；通过冲突感知的残差干预可在不训练、不改变原推理路径的前提下有效纠正该类错误，提升OLLMs在视听干扰下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Omnimodal large language models (OLLMs) are susceptible to cross-modal hallucinations under audio-visual interference. We find that, for a substantial fraction of incorrect joint predictions, the question-relevant unimodal branch can still recover the correct answer, suggesting that task-relevant evidence can remain recoverable from the relevant modality even when it is not reflected in the joint prediction. We refer to this recoverable failure pattern as \emph{modality misrouting}. We propose CaRe (Conflict-aware Residual Intervention), a training-free inference-time method for identifying and correcting modality misrouting. CaRe uses a text-only modality probe to identify a candidate modality-specific counterfactual branch, and flags potential misrouting when its prediction conflicts with the original joint prediction. For such cases, CaRe computes a residual direction from the discrepancy between the counterfactual and fused representations and uses it to steer the original multimodal state toward the relevant modality evidence, while retaining both modalities in the original audio-visual inference path. The intervention strength is adapted based on the confidence of the counterfactual branch. Experiments on CMM and AVHBench across two OLLMs show that CaRe consistently outperforms the evaluated inference-time hallucination-mitigation baselines.

</details>


### [857] [RadixFlow: Filling Execution Bubbles in Prefix-Cached Hybrid LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18143)
*Huihao Jing,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Haoyu Huang,Sirui Zhang,Yuxuan Liu,Zhongwei Xie,Haoran Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 针对混合LLM中前缀复用因状态未就绪导致的队头阻塞问题，提出RadixFlow，将前缀匹配与状态就绪解耦，把全局扫描屏障变为局部等待，降低延迟和轮次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前缀复用通过共享公共提示前缀的KV缓存提升LLM推理效率，但前提是调度器能在当前worker轮次中执行已匹配分支。现有调度器假设匹配前缀已就绪，这对全注意力成立，但在混合LLM中失效：消费者分支可能需要生产者分支在同一轮次仍在计算的状态，导致等待队列扫描被阻塞消费者截断，产生队头阻塞与"执行气泡"（本可由独立工作填充的空闲批量槽位）。

Method: 提出RadixFlow，将前缀匹配与状态就绪解耦。其"状态就绪遍历"把全局扫描屏障转化为局部等待：仅阻塞消费者分支至下一轮，而在原生状态检查下让可行的独立分支继续填充批次。

Result: 在五个混合模型上，RadixFlow将平均延迟降低3%至24%，worker轮次减少11%至44%，复用率几乎不变。在更大的Qwen3.5模型上，消融实验显示大部分收益来自遍历机制，而在全注意力对照模型上该机制增益很小。较重的轮次限制了该节省向延迟的转化程度。

Conclusion: RadixFlow通过解耦前缀匹配与状态就绪、以局部等待替代全局屏障，有效缓解混合LLM中前缀复用的队头阻塞与执行气泡，在保持复用的同时显著降低延迟与轮次；其收益主要源于遍历机制且取决于轮次的轻重程度。

Abstract: Prefix reuse improves LLM inference by sharing the KV cache of common prompt prefixes. This helps only if the scheduler can execute a matched branch in the current worker round. Schedulers assume that a matched prefix is ready, which holds for full attention but fails for hybrid LLMs. There, a branch (the consumer) may need recurrent state that another branch (the producer) is still computing in the same round. The native scheduler stops its waiting-queue scan at this blocked consumer, and the resulting head-of-line blocking creates \emph{execution bubbles}: idle batch slots that independent work could fill. We introduce RadixFlow, which decouples prefix matching from state readiness. Its state-ready traversal turns a global scan barrier into a local wait: only the consumer is blocked until the next round, while feasible independent branches keep filling the batch under the native state check. On five hybrid models, RadixFlow lowers mean latency by 3\% to 24\% and worker rounds by 11\% to 44\% at almost unchanged reuse. On the larger Qwen3.5 models, ablations show that most of the gain comes from traversal, which adds little on a full-attention control. Heavier rounds limit how much of this saving reaches latency.

</details>


### [858] [When and How Order-Flow Interventions Work After Dealers Adapt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18158)
*Guanghao Wu,Zhuo Cai,Zhidong Li,Shoujin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SOFA（State-aligned Order-Flow Allocation），一种公开订单流合约，通过"状态评分器—承诺调度器—报价到流量分配器"三部分，将干预集中在低风险状态，从而在交易商再适应条件下降低低风险执行成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型交易商代理可能长期维持宽报价，抬高客户交易成本。交易所可将更多订单路由至更紧报价，但宽报价可能反映真实风险；且交易商一旦适应，端到端比较无法说明规则为何有效——是因为干预更多、择时更好、提前公告，还是奖励了正确报价。

Method: SOFA包含三部分：State Scorer基于滞后公开数据对市场状态排序；Commitment Scheduler在交易商报价前公告有预算约束的干预强度；Quote-to-Flow Allocator将固定客户需求的有限份额转向更紧报价。采用配对再适应协议：让竞争规则共享相同干预强度、仅改变时机，交易商从同一检查点对每条规则再适应，并逐一断开单一环节。在ABIDES市场中训练20个独立的交易商种群进行检验。

Result: 在全部20个种群中，将干预集中于评分判定为低风险的状态，相较随机择时均能降低低风险执行成本，平均降低0.040个tick；而陈旧公告或断裂的报价到流量环节会抬高该成本。在主要设定下，该收益以高风险交易成本上升为代价，因此状态对齐仅对将低风险成本权重设为高风险成本1.38倍以上的交易所才划算。

Conclusion: 状态对齐的订单流合约能稳健降低低风险执行成本，其有效性来源于择时与承诺的可信度，而非单纯增加干预强度；但收益存在权衡，需交易所依据自身对低风险与高风险成本的相对权重决定是否采用。

Abstract: Learning dealer agents can settle on persistently wide quotes, raising what customers pay to trade. A venue can route more orders to tighter quotes, but a wide quote may reflect real risk, and once dealers adapt, an end-to-end comparison cannot show why a rule works: because it intervenes more, picks better moments, is announced in advance, or rewards the right quote. We propose SOFA (State-aligned Order-Flow Allocation), a public order-flow contract with three parts: a State Scorer ranks market states from lagged public data, a Commitment Scheduler announces a budgeted intervention strength before dealers quote, and a Quote-to-Flow Allocator shifts a bounded share of fixed customer demand toward tighter quotes. Our paired re-adaptation protocol gives competing rules the same intervention strengths, only re-timed, lets dealers re-adapt to each rule from a shared checkpoint, and breaks one link at a time. Across 20 independently trained dealer populations in an ABIDES market, concentrating the intervention in states that the score ranks as low-risk lowers low-risk execution cost relative to random timing in every population, by 0.040 tick on average, while a stale announcement or a broken quote-to-flow link raises this cost. In the primary setting the gain comes at the expense of high-risk trades, whose costs rise, so state alignment pays off only for a venue that weighs low-risk costs more than 1.38 times as heavily as high-risk costs. Our code is available at https://github.com/moderncavemann/state-aligned-order-flow-contracts.

</details>


### [859] [Back to the Future: Reverse-Consequence Modeling for Long-Horizon Particle Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18168)
*Leyan Zhang,Nantian He,Jiajun Ma,Yanpeng Zhao,Yunbo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ReStep，一种"逆因果"级联轨迹预测框架：先用随机模型直接预测终态，再用锚定扩散生成目标条件化的中间轨迹，并结合3D高斯泼溅构建统一物理-视觉推断系统，显著缓解长时程漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归轨迹预测存在固有累积误差，导致长时程推演严重漂移；而许多含耗散或收敛至静止的物理系统（如摩擦下滑物体、趋于平衡的摆），其终态往往比瞬态动力学更易预测。

Method: ReStep采用反向级联范式：第一步用随机模型直接预测最终状态；第二步用Anchored Diffusion以两端"边界状态"（初态与预测终态）为条件生成目标条件化的中间轨迹，从而约束动力学、降低不确定性。并将该动力学作为物理引擎集成到3D Gaussian Splatting管线中，形成统一的物理-视觉框架，支持从图像进行直观推断。

Result: 在多种刚性与非刚性碰撞数据集上的大量实验表明，ReStep具有更优的长期精度，通过反向结果建模大幅缓解误差累积。

Conclusion: 反转传统前向预测范式（先预测终态、再生成中间过程）能有效抑制自回归漂移；该逆因果级联方法与3D高斯泼溅的结合，为物理-视觉统一推断提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of object trajectories is fundamental to mechanical understanding and robotic control. However, autoregressive models inherently suffer from cumulative errors, leading to severe drift in long-horizon rollouts. Observing that in many physical systems with dissipative or convergence-to-rest behavior, the final states are often more predictable than transient dynamics (e.g., a sliding object resting under friction or a pendulum stabilizing at equilibrium), we propose ReStep, a cascaded approach that reverses the conventional forward-prediction paradigm. ReStep first employs a stochastic model to directly predict the final state, then leverages Anchored Diffusion to generate goal-conditioned intermediate trajectories. By conditioning on both ''boundary states'', it effectively constrains dynamics and reduces uncertainty, producing physically plausible and temporally coherent transitions. We further integrate ReStep dynamics as the physical engine within a 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline, enabling a unified physical-visual framework for intuitive inference from images. Extensive experiments on diverse rigid and non-rigid collision datasets show that ReStep achieves superior long-term accuracy, substantially mitigating error accumulation via reverse-consequence modeling.

</details>


### [860] [Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformers for Hierarchical Intention Recognition from Multimodal Human Activity Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18176)
*Farnaz Soleimani,Abdelghani Chibani,Yacine Amirat,Ghazaleh Khodabandelou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出神经符号图Transformer（NSGT），将人类推理图（HR-G）融入自注意力并以可微一阶逻辑损失做结构正则，实现四层级意图推理，在NTU-Hierarchy上兼顾动作准确率与逻辑一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主动式人机协作要求系统不仅识别即时动作，还需推断支配人类行为的层级化意图。现有深度学习方法多局限于扁平化动作分类，无法刻画从运动学到高层目标之间的结构依赖关系。

Method: 提出多模态框架中的NSGT：将人类推理图HR-G通过可学习拓扑偏置集成进自注意力机制；并引入可微一阶逻辑（FOL）损失作为结构正则项，在原子动作、复合活动、低层意图（LLI）、高层意图（HLI）四个层级上强制本体一致性。在NTU-Hierarchy数据集（NTU RGB+D 120的四层级本体扩展，含119,383个层级episode：85动作、16活动、8 LLI、4 HLI）上评估，并严格隔离标签生成与FOL约束以避免循环监督。

Result: 基础配置下NSGT取得91.65% top-1动作准确率；加入FOL损失后逻辑一致性提升3.26个百分点至96.67%。在一致性最大化配置（λ=0.5）下，逻辑一致性达94.59%，本体矛盾减少33%，同时保持89.90%的top-1动作准确率。学习到的HR-G权重提供可解释推理证据，转移边被强烈利用（β_trans≈+2.6）且无显式监督。

Conclusion: HR-G偏置可在准确率与结构连贯性之间建立可调权衡，FOL正则有效提升本体一致性并减少矛盾，学习到的图权重无需显式监督即可给出可解释的推理证据，验证了神经符号方法用于层级意图推理的可行性。

Abstract: Proactive human-robot collaboration requires autonomous systems to infer not only immediate actions but also the underlying hierarchical intentions governing human behavior. Current deep learning approaches predominantly focus on flat action classification, failing to capture the structural dependencies connecting kinematic motion to high-level goals. A Neuro-Symbolic Graph Transformer (NSGT) is proposed within this multimodal framework, a Human Reasoning Graph (HR-G) is integrated into the self-attention mechanism via learnable topological biases. Furthermore, the architecture is augmented with a differentiable First-Order Logic (FOL) loss, acting as a structural regularizer by which ontological consistency is enforced across four levels: atomic actions, composite activities, Low-Level Intentions, and High-Level Intentions. Evaluation is performed on the synthesized NTU-Hierarchy dataset, a four-level ontological extension of NTU RGB+D 120, wherein existing sequences were mapped into 119,383 complex hierarchical episodes (85 actions, 16 activities, 8 LLIs, 4 HLIs). To prevent circular supervision, strict isolation between label generation and FOL constraints was maintained. In the base configuration, 91.65% top-1 action accuracy is achieved by the NSGT. When the FOL loss is incorporated into the baseline, logic consistency is improved by 3.26 percentage points to 96.67%. Through the HR-G biases, a tunable trade-off between accuracy and structural coherence is established. In the primary consistency-maximizing configuration ($λ$ = 0.5), a logic consistency of 94.59% is reached and ontological contradictions are reduced by 33%, while a robust 89.90% top-1 action accuracy is retained. Finally, interpretable reasoning evidence is provided by the learned HR-G weights, wherein transition edges are strongly exploited ($β$ trans $\approx$ +2.6) without explicit supervision.

</details>


### [861] [QORH: Learning Query-Specific Ordered Rule Hypergraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18198)
*Naixing Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: QORH 将查询相关的规则头与有序规则体联合编码为超边，通过可学习规则选择与角色感知超图消息传递实现归纳式知识图谱链接预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向未见实体与关系的链接预测需要从观测图结构中学到可迁移的推理模式；现有基于关系图的方法主要建模成对依赖，难以保留完整路径规则的组合语义、关系顺序与角色信息。

Method: 提出 QORH（Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph）：以查询关系为条件，将规则头与有序规则体共同编码为超边，显式建模多关系间的联合依赖；利用规则置信度、覆盖率等统计证据进行可学习规则选择；通过角色感知超图消息传递增强关系表示以指导实体级推理；共享参数与具体实体/关系标识符无关。

Result: 在实体归纳与完全归纳基准上，QORH 显著优于所评估的最先进基线，验证了规则超图建模对归纳式链接预测的有效性。

Conclusion: 以查询特定有序规则超边联合建模规则结构，可有效保留路径规则的组合语义与顺序/角色信息，并借助标识符无关的共享参数实现向未见实体与关系的归纳预测。

Abstract: Knowledge graph link prediction involving unseen entities and relations requires learning transferable reasoning patterns from observed graph structure. Existing methods based on relation graphs primarily capture pairwise dependencies, limiting their ability to preserve the compositional semantics, relation ordering, and role information of complete path rules. To address this limitation, we propose QORH (Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph), which jointly encodes rule heads and ordered rule bodies as hyperedges conditioned on the query relation, explicitly modeling joint dependencies among multiple relations. QORH performs learnable rule selection using statistical evidence, such as rule confidence and coverage, and enhances relation representations through role-aware hypergraph message passing to guide entity-level reasoning. The model's shared parameters are independent of specific entity or relation identifiers, enabling inductive prediction for unseen entities and relations. Extensive experiments on entity-inductive and fully inductive benchmarks demonstrate that QORH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines included in our evaluation, validating the effectiveness of rule hypergraph modeling for inductive link prediction.

</details>


### [862] [Consider, Then Choose: Order-Invariant Decisions in System One Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18233)
*Jianguo Huang,Yao Long Teng,Yanchen Deng,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练方法 Runoff，通过"先独立打分选候选、再全位置列举比较"两阶段消除选择题答案对选项顺序的依赖，仅需两次前向传播。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One 类模型对同一输入承诺给出相同答案，但在选择题中该承诺失效：答案依赖选项顺序，且随选项数增加依赖加剧。循环移位平均只能削弱而不能消除这种依赖。作者希望从根本上构造出与选项顺序无关的答案。

Method: Runoff 分两步：(1) 对每个选项单独打分（不受顺序影响），保留少量候选；(2) 在候选中让每个候选占据所有位置进行列表式比较。无需训练，两次前向传播即可完成，按构造保证答案与选项顺序无关。

Result: 在两个开源模型、五个数据集上，Runoff 在打乱选项时答案完全不变（循环移位平均为 9.3% 变化）；在 20 个选项时准确率相当且快 3-4 倍。包裹八个 System One 模型后，消除了五个基准的顺序依赖，而循环移位平均最多变化 15.4%。

Conclusion: 选项顺序对答案的影响主要发生在模型对前几名选项不确定时，尽管列表式答案看似自信。Runoff 以无需训练、低成本的方式彻底消除顺序依赖，显著优于循环移位平均方案。

Abstract: System One models answer typed questions in a single forward pass and promise the same answer for the same input. For choice questions, this promise fails: the answer depends on the order of the options, increasingly so as they grow in number, and averaging over their cyclic shifts reduces this dependence without removing it. Scoring each option alone, which the order cannot affect, shows that the order changes the answer mostly when the model is unsure among its top few options, even though the listwise answer looks confident. We therefore propose $\textbf{Runoff}$, which considers, then chooses: it scores each option alone to keep a few candidates, then compares them in listings where each candidate takes every position. It needs no training and can run in two forward passes, and its answer does not depend on the option order by construction. On two open models and five datasets, it changes no answer under shuffling, against 9.3% for cyclic averaging, and with 20 options it is about as accurate and three to four times faster. Wrapped around eight System One models, it removes the order dependence of the five benchmarks, while cyclic averaging changes up to 15.4%.

</details>


### [863] [Beyond Answer Sharing: TrueMAD for Targeted Peer Engagement in Multi-Agent Debate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18240)
*Dezheng Bao,Sihang Du,Renhong Huang,Zhizhang Yuan,Yifei Sun,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TrueMAD，一种与骨干模型无关的测试时即插即用机制，在多智能体辩论的答案广播与自我修正之间引入一对一自由形式的同伴建议，以提升大语言模型推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准广播式多智能体辩论（MAD）让同伴答案可见，但不要求智能体针对某个特定同伴的主张进行回应。因此可靠推理可能被冲突或多数响应压制，限制可达性能；同时错误推理可能持续存在并损害最终预测，却缺乏可操作的反馈。

Method: TrueMAD在答案广播与自我修正之间引入一对一、自由形式的同伴建议。每个源智能体针对目标当前推理给出支持、反驳、细化或进一步提问，目标智能体保留如何修改的自主权。该机制无需参数更新，可增强标准MAD及其改进变体。

Result: 在AIME、GPQA-Diamond和TruthfulQA上，使用Qwen3-30B-A3B时，TrueMAD相较MAD在智能体级与严格多数准确率上平均提升3.62与3.52个百分点；TrueDMAD相较DMAD分别提升4.72与4.06个百分点。话语、智能体转移和群体层面的分析显示，同伴特定审议更多、修正导向的修改更多，共识动态更有利。

Conclusion: TrueMAD通过一对一自由形式同伴建议强化辩论中的针对性审议，在不更新参数的前提下提升推理准确率并改善共识动态，是一种通用可插拔的测试时增强方案。

Abstract: Multi-agent debate (MAD) aims to improve large language model reasoning by exposing agents to alternative solutions and enabling iterative revision. However, standard broadcast-style MAD makes peer answers visible without requiring agents to engage with a particular peer claim. As a result, reliable reasoning may be suppressed by conflicting or majority responses, limiting achievable performance, while erroneous reasoning may persist and degrade final predictions without actionable feedback. We propose TrueMAD, a backbone-agnostic test-time plug-in that introduces one-to-one, free-form peer advice between answer broadcasting and self-revision. Each source agent responds to a target's current reasoning through support, rebuttal, refinement, or further questions, while the target retains control over how to revise. The same mechanism can augment standard MAD and its improved variants without parameter updates. Across AIME, GPQA-Diamond, and TruthfulQA with Qwen3-30B-A3B, TrueMAD improves agent-level and strict-majority accuracy over MAD by 3.62 and 3.52 percentage points on average, while TrueDMAD improves DMAD by 4.72 and 4.06 points, respectively. Analyses at the utterance, agent-transition, and group levels further show more peer-specific deliberation, more correction-oriented revisions, and more favorable consensus dynamics.

</details>


### [864] [Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18298)
*Jing Liu,Yongxing Qi,Ping Yao,Ting Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种模型无关的五阶段闭环智能体框架，以"候选×证据"矩阵证伪协议规范LLM在可审核、假设驱动决策任务中的输出。实验表明：约束瓶颈在于输出纪律而非模型能力，框架效果与零样本输出纪律呈符号相关（拯救纪律失败模型、稳定高方差模型、但拖累已有纪律模型），并可迁移至抗错误信息数学推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在可审核、假设驱动的决策任务中，每个候选都可对证据逐一核验。作者旨在探究：限制大语言模型性能的真正瓶颈究竟是什么。公共TCMEval-SDT中医辨证基准（200例）上，两年模型缩放仅使零样本得分变动-0.03至+0.08，而输出纪律失效（推理不终止、格式不合规、运行间方差大）在前沿模型中仍持续存在，说明瓶颈是输出纪律与推理结构，而非单纯的模型能力。

Method: 构建模型无关的智能体框架，将决策形式化为五阶段闭环，并由"候选×证据"矩阵证伪协议强制执行：每个候选须对每条证据逐一评判，结论获得许可前须证伪至少一半候选，存活候选以机器可验证的单行格式输出。在五个基座模型上测试，并进行消融（定位代价来源为候选界定格式层）与知识注入对照（证明协议与知识内容解耦）。

Result: 效果对零样本输出纪律呈符号条件性：拯救纪律失败模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash：+0.267/+0.271，完全来自终止拯救）；将高方差模型的运行间标准差从0.218降至0.007（Kimi K3）；但显著拖累已有纪律的模型（预算匹配的Qwen3-4B/32B上-0.087至-0.120）。消融将代价归因于候选界定格式层，并证明效果独立于注入的知识内容。协议还迁移至抗错误信息数学推理：以89.8%召回率、6.8%假阳性率检测注入的虚假前提（MCC 0.54；全标记基线得分为0），并将准确率恢复至无错误信息上限。

Conclusion: 零样本输出纪律薄弱时，推理协议设定性能下限；基座模型能力始终设定性能上限。可审核决策任务的关键约束是输出纪律与推理结构，而非模型规模。

Abstract: What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.

</details>


### [865] [A dataset of formalised theorem statements from the Annals of Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18301)
*Thomas Browning,Katerina Hristova,David Ledvinka,Justus Springer,Hang Lu Su,Jack McKoen,Kevin Buzzard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文发布AnnalsChallenge数据集，包含50条手工用Lean 4和Mathlib形式化的定理陈述，均取自2020年以来发表于《Annals of Mathematics》的论文主结果，经人工审核与AI审计，但不含形式化证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI自动形式化数学的进展显著，但衡量该进展需要既具难度又可信赖的形式化陈述数据集；现有数据集在难度或可靠性上存在不足。

Method: 构建AnnalsChallenge数据集：从2020年后《Annals of Mathematics》论文中选取主结果，人工用Lean 4结合Mathlib形式化50条定理陈述；每条形式化结果先经人工审查，再由AI进行审计。

Result: 公开了50条经人工审查与AI审计、无形式化证明的Lean 4定理陈述，作为评估自动形式化的高难度、可信基准。

Conclusion: AnnalsChallenge提供了一个兼具难度与可信度的基准，用于衡量AI数学自动形式化进展，其不包含证明的设计聚焦于陈述层面的形式化评估。

Abstract: Recent progress in autoformalisation of mathematics using AI has been impressive. Measuring this progress requires datasets of formal statements that are both hard and trustworthy. We present AnnalsChallenge: 50 formalised theorem statements written by hand in Lean 4 using Mathlib. Each is the main result of a paper published in the Annals of Mathematics since 2020. Every formalisation was manually reviewed and then audited by AI. We release them without formalised proofs.

</details>


### [866] [Efficient Safety Guardrails through Latent Dual-Hypothesis Reasoning with On-Demand Trace Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18304)
*Md Asiful Islam,Fahmida Alam,Mihai Surdeanu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LR-Guard 通过学习结构化潜在推理并按需重构教师推理，实现了高效且可解释的安全护栏，在多数场景下优于显式推理教师模型，并在 batch size 为 1 时获得 19.4 倍推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于推理的大语言模型护栏虽能改善安全决策，但因需要显式推理而带来显著的推理开销，需在保持可解释性的同时降低计算成本。

Method: 将冻结教师模型对安全与不安全提示解读及其比较的分析蒸馏为紧凑潜在表示；联合训练这些表示同时用于安全预测和教师显式推理轨迹的重构，从而实现无需对每个决策生成中间文本即可获得人类可读解释。

Result: 在多数域内与域外设置下的安全分类和解释抽取任务中，LR-Guard 优于其显式推理教师模型；batch size 为 1 时实现 19.4 倍推理加速；从潜在信息重构的推理轨迹与教师显式推理具有高语义相似度。

Conclusion: 通过联合学习潜在推理与按需推理重构，可在不牺牲甚至提升安全分类与解释质量的前提下大幅降低推理开销，为高效可解释护栏提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Guardrail approaches that rely on reasoning-based large language models (LLM) improve safety decisions, but come with substantial inference overhead due to the explicit reasoning. We introduce LR-Guard (Latent Reasoning Guardrail), an efficient and explainable guardrail that jointly learns structured latent reasoning and on-demand reasoning reconstruction. Our method distills a frozen teacher's analysis of safe and unsafe prompt interpretations and their comparison into compact latent representations. Joint training optimizes these representations for both safety prediction and reconstruction of the teacher's explicit reasoning traces, enabling human-readable explanations without requiring intermediate text generation for every decision. Experiments show that LR-Guard outperforms its explicit-reasoning teacher in most in-domain and out-of-domain settings on safety classification and explanation extraction, while achieving a 19.4x inference speedup at batch size one. Further, reconstructed reasoning traces from the latent information exhibit high semantic similarity to the teacher's explicit reasoning.

</details>


### [867] [Complex materials engineering via Provenance Action Graphs: potential, structure and demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18314)
*Yevgeny Rakita,Paul Todd,James R. Neilson,Simon J. L. Billinge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨并验证“反应图”在材料合成中的应用潜力，其中事件由反应步骤（动作）及其产物（观测）构成，目标是构建可共享的全局知识库，以加速材料发现，重点关注固相合成中具有动力学特征的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技术上有用、尤其是动力学稳定的材料合成长期依赖大量试错，成功配方被发表而更多失败未被记录；AI 时代提供了从多维合成路径中学习规则的机会，实现正向预测与逆向学习，从而加速材料发现并建立数据智能体可共享、可贡献的知识库。

Method: 将合成过程建模为反应图，事件由反应步骤（动作）和其输出（观测）组成；利用学习算法从多维合成路径中编码规则，并支持正向预测与逆向学习两种模式；重点考察固相合成中的若干典型场景，因其反应本质为动力学控制，需要更细致地监测和控制反应历史。

Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果，仅提出研究框架与测试设想：以反应图为核心对材料合成进行表征与学习，并聚焦固相合成中若干常见合成场景。

Conclusion: 反应图有望成为材料合成知识的统一表示，通过整合成功与失败经验、支持正向与逆向学习，推动可共享的全局知识库建设，从而加速（特别是动力学稳定）材料的发现；后续工作将围绕固相合成的典型动力学场景展开验证。

Abstract: This work discusses and tests the potential of reaction graphs for material synthesis, in which events consist of reaction steps (actions) and their outputs (observations). The importance comes from the requirement to synthesize technologically useful materials, especially those that are kinetically stabilized. Often, it is a science that follows years of trial and error, culminating in (published) successful recipes, but is truly driven by far more (unpublished) failures. The entry into the era of AI provides an opportunity to use learning algorithms to encode rules from multi-dimensional synthesis pathways, regardless of their technological usefulness, and to decode both forward prediction and inverse learning modes. The main incentive is to accelerate material discovery by generating a global knowledge base that can be shared among data agents and contributed to by them. We will focus on several scenarios in the common synthesis process during solid-state synthesis, primarily because these reactions are kinetic in nature and require closer monitoring and control of the reaction history.

</details>


### [868] [AssetForge: Asset-Augmented Task Synthesis for Business Automation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18330)
*Xiangrui Liu,Shuo Tang,Siheng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AssetForge通过"可复用构建资产库+任务专属Rubric"的解耦式流水线构建可执行业务自动化任务，在AutomationBench上显著超越传统Rubrics。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练业务自动化智能体需要能连接自然语言请求、应用状态与可验证终态的可执行任务。传统Rubrics要求作者为每个任务重建应用界面、初始记录、策略证据与结果校验，导致业务逻辑与重复的基础设施工作纠缠在一起，效率低且难以规模化。

Method: AssetForge是资产增强的任务构建流水线：一方面提供可复用的构建资产库（应用界面、世界状态组件、策略/证据载体、原生断言定义），另一方面由任务专属Rubric指导这些资产的实例化；随后通过可执行检查与额外的模型评审对每个候选任务进行验证，返回针对性反馈，并在接受前支持有限的修复（bounded repair）。

Result: 在AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600上，用6,000条AssetForge样本微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，官方严格pass@1达41.17%，是基线9.33%的4.4倍（+31.83分）。相同骨干与GLM-5.3监督、相同接受样本规模（6,000对6,000）下，AssetForge为41.17%，传统Rubrics为30.33%，提升10.84分（相对35.7%）。DeepSeek与GLM监督的AssetForge模型在AppWorld的Test-Normal和Test-Challenge上均优于基线模型。

Conclusion: 结果确立了AssetForge完整构建流水线在AutomationBench public上的优势：资产—Rubric耦合接口引导作者聚焦业务逻辑，而可执行检查与模型评审则负责验证其任务质量。

Abstract: Training business automation agents requires executable tasks that connect a natural-language request to an application state and a verifiable end state. Traditional Rubrics requires Authors to recreate application interfaces, initial records, policy evidence, and outcome checks for each task, entangling business logic with repeated infrastructure work. We introduce AssetForge, an asset-augmented task-construction pipeline that pairs a reusable construction-asset library with task-specific Rubrics. The assets provide application interfaces, world-state components, policy/evidence carriers, and native assertion definitions; the Rubric directs their instantiation for a particular business task. Executable checks and an additional model-based review validate each candidate, return targeted feedback, and support bounded repair before acceptance. On AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600, fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 6,000 AssetForge examples yields 41.17% on the official strict pass@1 metric, 4.4 times the 9.33% base score (+31.83 points). With the same backbone and GLM-5.3 supervision, AssetForge reaches 41.17% versus 30.33% for traditional Rubrics, a 10.84-point gain (35.7% relative) at the same accepted-example scale (6,000 versus 6,000 examples). Both DeepSeek- and GLM-supervised AssetForge models improve AppWorld completion over the base model on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge. These results establish the advantage of AssetForge's complete construction pipeline on AutomationBench public: the coupled asset-Rubric interface directs Authors toward business logic, while executable checks and model-based review validate their tasks.

</details>


### [869] [ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18355)
*Qiuyu Ding,Heng-Da Xu,Changda Xia,Jiajun Shen,Zihao Guan,Zhengchen Yuan,Jianfang Zhang,Di Yang,Jiayi Tian,Yuting Xu,Fei Wang,Shiao Liu,Wei Zhang,Xiaolong Wu,Wenbin Tang,Zedong Chu,Mu Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 ABot-ER，一个统一的具身推理基础模型，通过代理式数据-模型自演化引擎和任务条件自适应训练策略，在单一参数框架内同时实现感知、规划与执行三个维度的专家级深度，并在十二项基准上取得最优整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能要求同时掌握感知、规划与执行，而在这整个谱系上如何兼顾通用性与专业性仍是未解难题——广度与深度之间存在张力。

Method: 提出 ABot-ER 统一具身推理基础模型。其核心包括：Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine，根据模型能力状态持续调整数据策略；Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy，用任务 token 激活共享骨干上的轻量低秩残差模块，从而把异构输出格式的更新分离开，同时保留共享的具身知识。

Result: 在覆盖三大核心能力与五个能力维度的十二项基准上系统评估，ABot-ER 在统一参数框架内于感知、规划、执行三个方向均达到 state-of-the-art 整体性能。

Conclusion: 结果表明广度与深度可以在统一具身推理中共存，为具身基础模型的通用-专用一体化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: We introduce \textbf{ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER)}, a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The \textbf{Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine} continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The \textbf{Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy} uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves \textbf{state-of-the-art overall performance} across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.

</details>


### [870] [Delegating Earth science model calibration to knowledge-guided LLM agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18378)
*Zhanliang Zhu,Ziwei Li,Liujun Zhu,Yuchen Liu,Junliang Jin,Jianyun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出通用校准框架（GCH），实现从校准请求到结果评估的端到端委托：agent在知识基础设施与验证约定约束下定义参数域、观测映射与目标并生成模型代码，GCH冻结相关表述后再进行数值搜索与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将过程式地球科学模型应用至新站点与新问题往往需要专家校准决策；若委托给语言模型agent，必须同时保证科学能力与可复现性。

Method: GCH将校准流程拆分为agent负责的表述阶段与无需agent判断的数值阶段：在KI和验证约定约束下，agent定义参数域、观测映射与目标函数并生成模型专属代码；GCH依据同一组声明检查公式并在数值搜索与评估前将其冻结。测试覆盖六个模型家族，并针对积雪模型、GR4J与VIC开展对照实验。

Result: 积雪模型测试中，知识引导的5/5规格首次执行成功，仅给模型名称则为0/5；验证NSE为0.81-0.94，默认值为0.57。共同目标下，独立GR4J表述的NSE差异在0.001以内；重评估11个已保存参数向量可复现其指标。10组预算匹配的VIC配对测试中，固定搜索不劣于持续agent提议（裕度-0.02 NSE，中位差-0.003）。

Conclusion: 该分离式设计实现了端到端校准委托，使科学选择可审查、数值评估可复现。

Abstract: Applying process-based Earth science models to new sites and questions often requires expert calibration decisions. Reliable delegation to language-model agents must preserve scientific competence and reproducibility. Here we develop a general calibration harness (GCH) for end-to-end delegation from a calibration request to assessed results. Constrained by a knowledge infrastructure (KI) and a validation convention, agents define parameter domains, observation mappings and objectives, and generate model-specific code. GCH checks the formulations against the same declarations and freezes them before numerical search and assessment, which require no further agent judgement. Agent-authored workflows executed across six model families, with assessment identifying unmet criteria. In snow-model tests, five of five knowledge-guided specifications executed on the first attempt, compared with none of five given only the model name, achieving validation Nash-Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) of 0.81-0.94 against 0.57 for defaults. Under a common objective, independent GR4J formulations yielded scores within 0.001 NSE; re-evaluating eleven saved parameter vectors reproduced their metrics. In ten paired VIC tests with matched budgets, fixed search was non-inferior to continuing agent proposals (margin, -0.02 NSE; median difference, -0.003). This separation enables end-to-end calibration delegation with inspectable scientific choices and reproducible numerical evaluation.

</details>


### [871] [The Singularity Has a Distribution: Exact Timing Laws and Detection Limits for a Stochastic Intelligence Explosion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18445)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zheng Gao,Chiwun Yang,Zhizhou Sha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究AI研究自动化引发的"能力-研究"正反馈回路的随机模型，刻画爆炸时间的分布、矩、尾行为及检测样本量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化AI研究会在软件能力与研究投入之间形成正反馈回路，作者希望对此回路建立随机化模型，以理解随机性对"能力爆炸"时机与可检测性的影响。

Method: 采用独立、正向、乘性改进按当前能力的幂次速率到达的随机过程模型；推导等大改进下爆炸时间的几何加权指数和表示及其q-级数变换、矩与尾部；对Lomax分布改进给出Gamma分布结果；并构造恒定与几何增长想法到达率之间的固定样本检验，辅以数值示例。

Result: 随机性不改变确定性爆炸阈值，但将爆炸时点替换为显式分布；等大改进下爆炸时间为几何加权独立指数和，Lomax改进下精确为Gamma分布；自相似性导致临近爆炸时剩余时间的相对不确定性不收敛；已知基线率与对数率增量ℓ时，最小样本量渐近为(12z_α^2)^{1/3}ℓ^{-2/3}；对增长指数在临界值附近的不确定性产生1/t尾与显式常数，导致条件均值等待时间无穷大，但正指数下爆炸必然发生。

Conclusion: 扩展分析表明：固定部署延迟在指定延迟反馈模型中可阻止爆炸；努力的幂律转移会改变增长阈值；确定性监督竞赛中固定分配份额不改变渐近机制，除非指数达到临界相等。数值示例（非经验预测）显示时机与可检测性依赖改进的颗粒度。

Abstract: Automating AI research creates a positive feedback loop between software capability and research effort. We study a stochastic realisation of this loop in which independent, positive, multiplicative improvements arrive at a rate proportional to a power of current capability. Within this model, randomness leaves the deterministic explosion threshold unchanged but replaces the blow-up date by an explicit distribution. For equal-sized improvements the explosion time is a geometrically weighted sum of independent exponentials; its $q$-series representation gives its transforms, moments and tail behaviour, including a two-term small-time asymptotic. For Lomax-distributed improvement sizes the explosion time is exactly Gamma distributed. Self-similarity implies that, with parameters known, the relative uncertainty about the remaining time does not vanish as explosion approaches. We formulate a fixed-sample test between constant and geometrically increasing idea-arrival rates. If the baseline rate and the alternative log-rate increment $\ell$ are known, the minimum sample size at error level $α$ is asymptotic to $(12z_α^2)^{1/3}\ell^{-2/3}$, where $z_α$ is the upper-$α$ standard normal quantile. Uncertainty about the growth exponent near its critical value produces a $1/t$ tail with an explicit constant, and hence an infinite conditional mean waiting time, although explosion is certain given a positive exponent. Separate extensions show that a fixed deployment delay prevents explosion in the specified delayed-feedback models, that power-law diversion of effort shifts the growth threshold, and that in a deterministic oversight race a fixed allocation share does not change the asymptotic regime, except at a critical equality of exponents. Numerical illustrations, which are not empirical forecasts, show how timing and detectability depend on the granularity of improvements.

</details>


### [872] [Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18447)
*Thinker Team,Peng Gao,Jichao Jiao,Chen Liao,Daqin Luo,Yiming Ma,Baiyu Pan,Hailin Shi,Jiyuan Wang,Xiangming Xu,Xiongwei Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Thinker-WM 是一个统一的多模态世界模型，通过共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 联合建模并生成 RGB、度量深度和机器人动作，在表征层面实现外观、几何与动作的统一，并在多项具身世界模型评测中排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型在建模模态与支持功能上较为割裂：视觉动态、几何结构与可执行动作通常通过独立接口或下游模块耦合，未能在共享动力学模型中联合表征与演化。本文旨在实现外观、几何与动作在统一表征下的联合建模与生成。

Method: 提出 Thinker-WM：以共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 为中间核心，配合模态专属编码器与解码器；将外观、几何与动作映射到公共动态表征，由共享参数联合演化，同时保留各自输出结构。同一参数化支持联合视频-动作生成、世界预测、策略推断、动作条件生成、视频到动作生成及逆动力学等多种功能。并设计轻量级运动探针，验证冻结视觉表征中包含可恢复的运动信息。

Result: 训练语料为异构数据，约 2 万小时第一人称视频、1 万小时真实机器人数据与 1 千小时仿真数据，其中约 4 千小时真实机器人数据具对齐深度监督。实验显示在具身世界模型评测中表现强劲，在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad 与 WorldArena 上排名第一；对照研究进一步验证了动作条件、几何交互与多任务训练在共享表征中的增益。

Conclusion: 在统一共享动态表征下联合建模外观、几何与动作，可在保持输出结构差异的同时支持多种具身功能，并显著提升世界模型评测表现，为具身 AI 提供可扩展的多模态世界模型范式。

Abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

</details>


### [873] [Autonomous Science Bench: Evaluating AI Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18449)
*Yibo Wen,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Autonomous Science Bench（v0.1），包含 6 个基于真实已发表实验的预算约束型 design-build-test-learn 闭环实验任务，覆盖生物、化学与材料科学，通过"发现门"与"学习门"双门控评估自主科学发现智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主科学发现智能体需要在有限预算下决定做哪些实验，但现有科学智能体基准多为固定数据集，支持主动实验的又主要依赖模拟，缺乏贴近真实实验流程、同时考察"选得准"与"学得会"的评测环境。

Method: 构建 6 个预算受限的 design-build-test-learn 实验活动，任务源自已发表的真实实验；智能体分批选择设计方案，从实验室服务获得测量结果，并用结果指导后续实验，最终交付一个预测模型。评估采用两道校准门控：发现门评估智能体实际测量的设计质量，学习门评估其模型对留出设计的排序能力。以 8 种智能体-模型配置、共 144 次试验进行试点评测，并公开发布活动集、实验运行时与排行榜。

Result: 试点中最佳配置成功率为 67%；最难的活动在 24 次尝试中仅成功 3 次。两道门控暴露出不同弱点：部分智能体能建立准确排序但找到的候选设计过少；另一些能找到好的设计却无法预测未见设计的表现，这些差异在单一总成功率下被掩盖。

Conclusion: 总体成功率不足以刻画自主科学发现智能体的能力，发现与学习双门控能区分"探索"与"泛化"两类失败模式，为科学智能体提供更具诊断性的评测基准。

Abstract: AI agents for autonomous scientific discovery must decide which experiments to run under a limited budget. Most benchmarks for science agents provide fixed datasets, while others that support active experimentation largely rely on simulation. We introduce Autonomous Science Bench, an initial release comprising six budgeted design-build-test-learn campaigns grounded in published experiments across biology, chemistry, and materials science. Agents select batches of designs, receive measurements from a lab service, and use the results to guide subsequent experiments before delivering a predictive model. Success requires passing two calibrated gates: a discovery gate, which evaluates the designs the agent measured, and a learning gate, which evaluates its model's ranking of held-out designs. In a pilot evaluation of eight agent-model configurations and 144 trials, the best configuration succeeds in 67% of trials, while the hardest campaign is solved in only three of 24 attempts. The two gates reveal different weaknesses: some agents build accurate rankings but find too few promising designs, while others find promising designs but fail to predict which unseen designs will perform well. These differences are obscured by overall success rates alone. We release version 0.1 of the campaigns, lab runtime, and public leaderboard at https://yibow.me/autonomous-science-bench.

</details>


### [874] [Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18497)
*Linhai Ma,Yan Wang,Lingfei Qian,Yupeng Cao,Victor Gutierrez Basulto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文发现工具调用评判器（tool-call judges）在输入中缺少参考文本时，会更少接受正确的参数值，称为"derivation gap"；提出 DeRef 方法，通过独立模型生成参考文本来修复该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用评判器用于评估 LLM 智能体提出的参数值是否正确。作者观察到评判器依赖输入中是否存在明确说明"该值应为多少"的参考文本，而非依据数值本身的正确性判断，这可能导致对正确值的系统性误判。

Method: 作者在七个评判器（包括 System One 模型 CLM 和 Jev）上评估该"derivation gap"现象，分析其成因（默认值、需推理的值、被截断的文本来源）；并通过受控的"来源重定位"（source-relocation）实验验证评判器是否跟随输入中的参考。随后提出 DeRef（Derived Reference）：由一个独立模型阅读完整历史（不看到候选值）生成参考，供评判器使用。

Result: derivation gap 出现在全部七个评判器上，且并非单纯的截断假象——在无截断的基准上，正确默认值的 gap 最大。来源重定位实验表明评判器会偏好输入中可见的错误值，而非来源被隐藏的正确值。DeRef 在三个基准上提升了所有评判器的整体参数 AUROC；在受控测试中将 AUROC 从随机水平或以下提升至 98.40–99.59。

Conclusion: 评判器的判断受输入参考文本可用性影响，存在系统性的 derivation gap；通过独立模型生成参考（DeRef）可显著缓解该问题并提升评判准确性。

Abstract: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.

</details>


### [875] [The Smart Buildings Challenge: Learning Foundation Models for Real-World Optimization at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18511)
*Judah Goldfeder,Ayush Rai,Philippe M. Wyder,Na Li,Victoria Dean,Donna Vakalis,Jiong Lin,Bing Dong,Michael Rossetti,Nathan Kutz,Sohei Arisaka,John Sipple,Hod Lipson,Yoshua Bengio*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"建筑基础模型"挑战赛，要求控制策略在训练建筑集上学得后可零/少配置迁移至未见建筑，以突破建筑优化中策略迁移差的瓶颈，实现全球可扩展的建筑能效优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑占美国碳排放近40%，其中HVAC系统占总建筑排放约40-60%，并占全球能耗15%。尽管AI已有进展，多数建筑仍以数十年前的低效方式运行，建筑优化对ML驱动的气候行动具有巨大短期与长期潜力。最大障碍在于缺乏策略迁移：现有基于仿真或学习的建筑控制系统缺乏泛化能力，仅对开发时所用建筑有效，无法适用于其他建筑，导致优化难以规模化。

Method: 发起一项挑战赛，推动"建筑基础模型"的研发，使其能以最小配置快速适配新建筑。参赛者在给定的一组仿真建筑上构建控制策略，随后在未见过的建筑集合上进行评测；建筑在规模、布局、天气、材料属性与HVAC系统等方面均有差异。

Result: 本文为挑战赛提案，未报告实验结果；其预期成果是获得可跨建筑泛化的控制策略，并建立以跨建筑迁移为评价标准的基准与评测范式。

Conclusion: 若能实现最小配置下的跨建筑迁移，建筑优化即可在全球范围内规模化，从而推动全球可持续性目标取得重大进展，并展示ML应对气候变化的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Buildings cause nearly 40\% of carbon emissions in the US. Of total building emissions, HVAC systems are responsible for approximately 40-60\% and account for 15\% of global energy consumption. Despite advances in artificial intelligence, most buildings still operate as inefficiently as they did decades ago. Building optimization, perhaps more so than any other optimization problem, has enormous potential for Machine Learning (ML) driven impact on climate change, in both the short and long term. One of the biggest obstacles for building optimization is the lack of policy transfer. Most building control systems, whether simulation or learning based, don't generalize: they only work well for the building they were developed for, but not for other buildings. To solve this problem, we propose a challenge for the development of building foundation models that easily adapt to new buildings with minimal configuration and thereby enable building optimization to scale across the globe. Participants will build control policies on a set of simulated buildings, and have their policies evaluated on an unseen set of buildings. The buildings vary in size, layout, weather, material properties, and HVAC system. Successful outcomes from this initiative promise a massive leap forward in global sustainability efforts and demonstrate the great potential of ML to combat climate change.

</details>


### [876] [Lost in Implicit Routing: How LLM Agents Fail to Load Relevant Skills at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18522)
*Jinlin Liu,Wei Chen,Xiaojin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究LLM智能体在可复用技能库扩大时的技能路由失效问题，发现无关技能会通过语义干扰导致智能体漏载或零加载技能，并提出显式预选作为缓解方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复用技能让LLM智能体能够按需加载任务专属指令，但执行效果依赖对技能元数据的隐式路由。作者希望检验这种隐式路由设计是否随技能库规模增长而失效。

Method: 固定SkillsBench任务及其黄金技能不变，逐步加入无关技能进行对照实验；同时比较隐式路由与从同一技能库中显式选择的表现，并通过遮蔽无关技能描述、保留元数据但要求智能体显式规划技能使用等变体，定位失效来源。

Result: 出现“技能路由崩塌”：无关技能增多时智能体加载更少甚至不加载技能。加入1000个无关技能后，已加载技能召回率从73.6%降至27.4%，零加载率从9.3%升至51.6%；而显式选择仍保持73.9%召回率。加载其他技能（包括黄金技能的合理替代项）过于罕见，无法解释该下降。仅遮蔽无关技能描述可大幅恢复加载，但元数据完好时要求显式规划仍低于预选效果。

Conclusion: 技能路由崩塌源于技能描述带来的语义干扰，以及技能选择与任务执行竞争产生的指令干扰。显式预选是可用的缓解手段，但其覆盖率和延迟存在权衡。研究为技能库持续增长场景下的技能协议与评测设计提供了依据。

Abstract: Reusable skills let LLM agents load task-specific instructions on demand, but they make execution depend on implicit routing over skill metadata. We test whether this design scales by holding SkillsBench tasks and their golden skills fixed while adding irrelevant skills. We find skill routing collapse: agents increasingly load fewer or no skills, even though the relevant skills remain available. With 1,000 irrelevant skills, loaded-skill recall falls from 73.6% to 27.4% and the zero-load rate rises from 9.3% to 51.6%, whereas explicit selection from the same library retains 73.9% recall. Loading other skills, including plausible alternatives to golden skills, is too rare to explain this decline. Masking only the descriptions of irrelevant skills largely restores skill loading, yet with the metadata intact, explicitly asking agents to plan skill use still yields lower recall than preselection. These findings point to semantic interference from descriptions and instruction interference when skill choice competes with task execution. We also evaluate explicit preselection as a practical mitigation, including its coverage and latency trade-offs. Our analysis informs skill protocols and evaluation for agents with growing skill libraries.

</details>


### [877] [Input-Conditioned Search for Efficient Test-Time Scaling of Recursive Reasoners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18547)
*Haochen Shi,Tianwen Fu,Qianggang Ding,Yinhan Lu,Yizhan Li,Huan Zhang,Yajie Zhao,Xingdi Yuan,Hengyang Lu,Bang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI
