TL;DR: 本文提出 Input-Conditioned Search（ICS），通过对同一隐状态施加不同输入条件以诱导不同的更新映射，在不额外训练的情况下探索多样化推理轨迹，实现递归推理器的高效测试时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归推理器可通过增加更新次数（深度）或扰动隐状态产生多条轨迹（宽度）来扩展推理，但当思维陷入死胡同时，深度扩展与基于扰动的宽度扩展往往收敛到错误的吸引子，无法可靠地"换角度"重新思考问题。

Method: 提出 ICS：不进行任何额外训练，对同一隐状态施加不同的输入条件，从而从预训练推理器中诱导出替代的更新映射，据此搜索多样化的推理轨迹。

Result: 在六个推理任务上，ICS 取得最高平均准确率，且模型 FLOPs 比所评估的扩展基线最多少两个数量级；受控实验证实 ICS 能将同一状态的轨迹重定向；理论分析与严格数值验证表明 ICS 可在局部消除错误的吸引不动点。

Conclusion: ICS 是一种有效的测试时扩展维度，并激励未来在训练与测试阶段开展关于塑造递归推理的进一步研究。

Abstract: People often tackle difficult problems by thinking more deeply or exploring more possibilities. Similarly, recursive reasoners, which reason by repeatedly applying a learned update rule to latent states, can also scale inference through more updates (depth) or additional trajectories generated by perturbing latent states (width). When people hit a dead end in their thinking, they may step back and approach the problem from a fresh angle. However, neither depth scaling nor perturbation-based width scaling of recursive reasoners can reliably achieve this: both may converge to incorrect attractors. To address this, we propose to explore diverse reasoning traces by applying different update maps to the same latent state, without any additional training. We realize this idea through \emph{Input-Conditioned Search (ICS)}, which searches over input conditions to induce alternative update maps from the pretrained reasoner. Across six reasoning tasks, ICS achieves the highest mean accuracy, while requiring up to two orders of magnitude fewer model FLOPs than the evaluated scaling baselines. Controlled experiments confirm that ICS can redirect trajectories from the same state. Our theoretical analysis and rigorous numerical verification also confirm that ICS can locally eliminate incorrect attracting fixed points. Together, these findings establish ICS as an effective axis for efficient test-time scaling and motivate further research on shaping recursive reasoning during training and at test time.

</details>


### [878] [Rethinking Quality in Large Language Model Routing: Security-Conditioned Model-and-Budget Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18566)
*Yichi Zhang,Zhenxiang Huang,Yuyang Zhang,Yuchen Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCRouter路由框架，为每个查询分别预测效用与安全性并按查询动态加权，同时联合分配模型与token预算，配套构建SCRouterBench基准，域内基线提升13-29点，域外提升19-23点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由器用单一质量指标对"模型-预算"动作排序，无法适配混合负载：普通查询追求正确有用的效用，安全敏感查询追求拒答有害请求或抵抗恶意指令的安全，两类目标偏好不同的模型与预算。

Method: SCRouter对每个模型-预算组合估计"响应在预算内完成"的概率，并据此分别预测效用与安全性；用一个轻量探针（probe）为每个查询决定两项预测的权重；最后在加权效用与安全同成本的权衡下选择模型与token预算。同时构建SCRouterBench：38,869条效用与安全查询，覆盖9个安全维度，每条查询在12个模型×12个预算共144种组合下作答，另含2,753条域外查询。

Result: 在SCRouterBench上，SCRouter相较基线在域内提升13-29个百分点，域外提升19-23个百分点。

Conclusion: 将效用与安全解耦预测并按查询动态加权、联合优化模型与token预算，是应对混合负载LLM路由的有效方案，且具备良好的域外泛化能力。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routers reduce serving cost by choosing which model to call and how many output tokens to grant it for each query. Existing routers rank model-budget actions using a single quality metric. This does not work for mixed workloads. For ordinary queries, a good answer is correct and useful (utility); for security-sensitive queries, a good answer refuses harmful requests or resists malicious instructions (security). These two objectives prefer different models and budgets.
  We propose SCRouter, a router that learns when to prioritize security and how to allocate the token budget. For each model-budget pair, it estimates the probability that the response finishes within budget. It uses this probability to predict utility and security separately. A small probe determines how to weight these two predictions for each query. SCRouter then selects the model and budget by balancing the weighted utility and security against cost. We also build SCRouterBench, a benchmark of 38,869 utility and security queries spanning nine security dimensions, each answered under all 144 combinations of 12 models and 12 budgets, plus 2,753 out-of-domain queries. SCRouter improves the baselines by 13-29 points in-domain and 19-23 points out-of-domain.

</details>


### [879] [Configuring RAG Systems: What Breaks, Where Originates, and How to Fix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18567)
*Liangyu Chen,Youpeng Ma,Yulong Ye,Zezhen Xiang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次对RAG系统的配置问题进行大规模实证研究，基于10个RAG系统的654个真实配置问题，构建了症状、根因、阶段与修复模式的完整分类体系，并提出九条可操作建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG已成为增强大语言模型的主流范式，其系统高度可配置，不少故障与配置相关；但学界对RAG系统配置问题缺乏系统性理解，存在研究空白。

Method: 从10个多样化RAG系统中收集654个真实配置问题进行大规模实证研究，对问题的症状、根因、相关阶段与修复模式进行系统分类归纳。

Result: 建立了RAG配置问题的完整分类体系并提出若干新观察；发现多数症状出现在流水线早期或晚期，而根因所在阶段可能与症状识别阶段不一致；给出九条针对测试、定位与修复的可操作实践建议。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了RAG配置问题的特征，并将其与RAG特有的流水线阶段紧密关联，为从业者理解和处理配置问题提供了系统化指导。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving Large Language Model (LLM) by intertwining it with other components, such as a vector/graph database. Therefore, the resulting RAG systems are often highly configurable, under which a non-trivial amount of failures are related to the configurations. However, there remains a lack of systematic understanding regarding the configuration issues for RAG systems. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues collected from 10 diverse RAG systems. Drawing on this, we provide a complete categorization of the symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns of configuration issues for RAG systems, as well as several new observations. Our findings not only reveal the characteristics of configuration issues, but also strongly link them to the unique pipeline stages of RAG, e.g., we found that most symptoms can be observed at the early or late stage, while the stage of the root cause might not be at the same stage as where the symptom is identified. We also provide nine actionable insights to the practitioners on testing, localizing, and fixing the configuration issues for RAG systems.

</details>


### [880] [Order-Consistent Latent Geometry for Reliable Short-Horizon Planning in World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18570)
*Junlin Wu,Wen Fan,Dandan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将终端欧氏距离隐含规划器的兼容性条件识别为经典"自接近"(self-approaching) 条件，证明潜在轨迹中出现"锐弯"会导致候选动作排序反转，即使在使用精确 rollout 时也是如此，并通过实验验证了该预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在规划器常用候选序列终点到目标潜在点的欧氏距离进行排序。与转移距离完全一致虽理想，但强于规划实际所需——沿转移最短的 rollout，关键要求仅是潜在距离不逆转真实转移进展。作者希望形式化这一放松条件并揭示其失效模式。

Method: 作者将路径无逆转要求等同于经典自接近条件，分析视觉世界模型所预测离散潜在序列的多边形插值，证明锐弯会产生一个非空区域，使终端欧氏距离将转移更差的候选排在真正有进展的候选之前；并借助经典球码界将潜在维度解释为角度容量。设计了包含零填充三维基线的六分支受控实验。

Result: 理论证明：锐弯导致精确 rollout 下仍出现有限时域候选顺序反转。实验验证了预测的排序失败，并将角度排布与环绕维度的影响分离开来。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首次将自接近性识别为终端欧氏潜在规划的规划器兼容条件，并将其违反与精确的有限时域候选顺序反转联系起来；潜在维度可理解为角度容量，排序失败主要源于角度排布而非环境维度。

Abstract: Latent planners often rank candidate action sequences by terminal Euclidean distance to a goal latent. Exact agreement with transition distance would make this score ideal, but is stronger than planning requires: along a transition-shortest rollout, the essential requirement is that latent distance does not reverse true transition progress. We show that this pathwise no-reversal requirement is precisely the classical self-approaching condition. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to identify self-approachingness as a planner-facing compatibility condition for terminal Euclidean latent planning and to connect its violation to an exact finite-horizon candidate-order reversal. Because visual world models predict discrete latent sequences, we analyze their polygonal interpolation. We prove that an acute bend creates a nonempty region in which terminal Euclidean distance ranks a transition-worse candidate ahead of one that makes genuine progress, even under exact rollouts. We further interpret latent dimension as angular capacity through a classical spherical-code bound. A controlled six-branch experiment, including a zero-padded three-dimensional baseline, validates the predicted ordering failure and separates angular arrangement from ambient dimensionality.

</details>


### [881] [LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18572)
*Ruohong Liu,Bohan Tang,Lekang Jiang,Jack Umenberger,Yiwen Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"任务自适应配方空间上的优化"新范式，并实例化为结构化配方优化（SRO），通过LLM配方空间设计器与多域配方优化器，在多目标贝叶斯试验选择与结构化试验证据指导下自动完成LLM后训练，实验取得领先成绩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化后训练存在两类局限：一是搜索预定义配方空间，虽能系统优化但空间固定、无法随目标任务调整可用选择；二是开放式智能体虽能发现任务特定选择，却将其隐含在逐次试验编辑中，难以系统化复用与跨试验重组。需要一种既能自适应任务、又能显式表示配方以便复用、重组和联合优化的新范式。

Method: 提出"任务自适应配方空间上的优化"范式，使配方空间本身可适配目标任务，同时显式表示其选择。以结构化配方优化（SRO）实例化该范式：由基于LLM的配方空间设计器构建任务自适应配方空间，再由多域配方优化器利用结构化试验证据引导LLM候选生成，并进行多目标贝叶斯试验选择。配方覆盖数据源、数据处理、跨域组合与训练配置等耦合决策。

Result: 在评估的目标模型与智能体LLM组合中，SRO均取得最高平均分。在三能力域、六基准的联合后训练中，Qwen3-1.7B配合GPT-5.4时SRO达41.1，最强基线为15.4；Qwen3-4B配合DeepSeek-V4-Flash时SRO达53.8，最强基线为40.8。

Conclusion: SRO验证了任务自适应配方空间优化范式的有效性，能在有限实验预算下系统化地复用、重组并联合优化后训练配方，显著优于固定配方空间搜索与开放式智能体方法，且在多种模型组合下均具稳健优势。代码已开源。

Abstract: Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO.

</details>


### [882] [Reading Right, Acting Wrong: Diagnosing Decision Failures of System One Models in Agent Loops](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18579)
*Yubo Li,Ramayya Krishnan,Rema Padman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文通过行为学方法将智能体决策错误拆解为"读错"与"读对但仍做错"两类，发现在17个快系统与1个推理模型上，多数错误动作源于正确读取后的组合失败，而非感知错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One式模型单次评分选动作，快速廉价，但错误不可归因：无法判断是"误读了状态"还是"读对了却仍做错"。这一归因盲区阻碍了对模型失败的诊断与改进。

Method: 在冻结的智能体决策状态基准上（覆盖模拟环境、客服策略、工具使用、网页导航与编程），为每个下一步动作问题配对关于同一状态的事实性探测题，各自独立作答；在17个快系统与1个推理模型上进行对比分析，并用代码组合模型自身答案以检验组合失败的假设。

Result: 结果一致：多数错误动作发生在正确读取之后，且系统越准确，其错误中这种形式占比越高；这类错误并非随机噪声，而是跨系统聚集于相同状态；在探测事实可证明决定动作的场景中，读全所有事实的模型仍无法组合它们，而用代码组合其自身答案可修复失败。在真实状态上，缺失的往往不是某个事实，而是下一个子目标。

Conclusion: System One模型的决策失败主要不是感知/读取问题，而是事实组合与子目标推断的失效；错误具有系统性与可复现性，通过外部代码组合模型答案可部分修复，为智能体可靠性改进提供了行为学诊断路径。

Abstract: System One models choose an agent's next action by scoring a supplied set of options in a single pass. This makes them fast and cheap, but when they choose wrongly there is nothing to inspect: did the model misread what the agent has seen, or read it correctly and still act wrongly? We answer behaviorally. On a frozen benchmark of agent decision states from simulated environments, customer-service policies, tool use, web navigation and coding, we pair every next-action question with factual probes about the same state, each answered independently. Across seventeen fast systems and a reasoning model, the answer is consistent: most wrong actions follow correct reading, and the more accurate a system, the more of its errors take this form. These errors are not noise; they gather on the same states across systems of every kind. Where the probed facts provably determine the action, models that read every fact still fail to combine them, and their own answers, composed by code, repair the failure. On real states, what is missing is often not a fact but the next sub-goal.

</details>


### [883] [Compare to Correct: Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment for LLM Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18583)
*Cong Hua,Qianqian Xu,Zitai Wang,Zhiyong Yang,Shilong Bao,Linchao Zhang,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PGLA框架，将支持不同答案的推理路径间的成对置信度比较引入测试时扩展，通过KL正则化目标与投票支持融合，作为即插即用项修正投票排序错误，在10个基准、7个模型上验证有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于采样的测试时扩展方法仅使用答案频率或路径置信度计算候选分数，无法显式刻画竞争答案之间的比较关系，因而可能产生投票排序错误。

Method: 受社会选择理论中孔多塞原则启发，引入支持不同答案的路径之间的成对置信度比较，以捕捉答案层面的比较优势；通过KL正则化目标将比较证据与投票支持结合。理论上证明该比较优势等价于对传统投票logits的调整，从而形成Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment（PGLA）框架。

Result: 在包括数学推理、知识推理和代码生成在内的10个挑战性基准上，使用7个参数规模从1.7B到32B的模型进行实验，验证了该即插即用项的有效性；结合外部奖励分数和在线采样的额外评估进一步证明了其适用性。

Conclusion: PGLA通过显式建模答案间的成对比较优势，可补偿较弱的投票支持并纠正基于投票的排序错误，是一种有效且通用的测试时扩展即插即用组件。

Abstract: Sampling-based test-time scaling enhances LLM reasoning by aggregating multiple reasoning paths for the same query. Existing methods use answer frequencies or path confidence to compute candidate scores, which do not explicitly characterize comparisons between competing answers. Inspired by the Condorcet principle in social choice theory, we introduce pairwise confidence comparisons between paths supporting different answers to capture answer-level comparative advantage. We combine this comparative evidence with voting support through a KL-regularized objective. Theoretically, we show that this comparative-advantage is equivalent to the adjustment to the traditional voting logits. In this way, our proposed Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment (PGLA) framework allows comparative evidence to compensate for weaker voting support and correct voting-based ranking errors. Experiments on 10 challenging benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, knowledge reasoning, and code generation with 7 models ranging from 1.7B to 32B parameters speak to the effectiveness of this plug-and-play term. Additional evaluations with external reward scores and online sampling further demonstrate its applicability.

</details>


### [884] [Auditing Future-Memory Use in Point-in-Time Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18602)
*Rongtian Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究检验了PIT智能体内部记忆的可及性是否能预测其证据搜集行为。48项历史公司比较任务显示，Qwen与DeepSeek均能回忆截止日后的事实，但预注册的"偏向更易回忆公司"的假设未获支持；Qwen四项分配估计为负（区间跨零），DeepSeek前瞻复制呈反向模式且稳健显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PIT（point-in-time）智能体即便外部证据严格遵守历史截止点，仍可能回忆出截止日后的事实，即存在"记忆泄漏"。作者关心这种内部记忆可及性是否会进一步影响智能体的证据搜集与最终输出，从而说明仅检查外部证据的截止有效性不足以约束模型行为，需要将记忆可及性评估与行为评估分开进行。

Method: 设计48项历史公司比较任务。先用独立的闭卷（closed-book）营收探针，在回忆不均衡的任务上识别每个模型"记得更牢"的公司，从而在智能体运行前固定预测方向（预注册）。随后在外部证据保持PIT有效的前提下，比较保留真实公司身份与匿名化公司身份的配对运行，检验分配估计是否偏向更易回忆的公司。随后对DeepSeek进行前瞻性复制，并做逐公司、逐配对、剔除未来事实等稳健性检验，以及事后max-T校正的符号翻转检验。最后开展一项前瞻设定的后续实验，考察显式提供未来事实时的影响。

Result: Qwen和DeepSeek都能回忆截止日后的事实，但均未支持预注册的"向更易回忆公司偏移"的假设。Qwen在28项回忆不均衡任务上的四项分配估计均为负，描述性区间跨零。DeepSeek的前瞻复制在20项此类任务上四项指标均呈反向模式，区间低于零；在逐公司、逐配对、剔除未来事实后估计仍为负，四项事后max-T校正符号翻转p值均小于.05。前瞻后续实验中，显式未来事实带来小幅"偏离所提供事实公司"的估计偏移（区间跨零），而最终选择却转向该公司。该自然反向模式的机制仍未阐明。

Conclusion: 内部记忆可及性并不简单地驱动证据搜集方向，二者在实证上可分离。研究建议对记忆可及性、搜索分配与最终输出分别评估，并与外部证据的截止检查并行开展；自然反向模式的机制有待进一步研究。

Abstract: Point-in-time (PIT) agents can recall post-cutoff facts even when their external evidence respects a historical cutoff. We examine whether this access predicts evidence gathering in 48 historical company-comparison tasks. Independent closed-book revenue probes identify the better-remembered company for each model on tasks with unequal recall, fixing the predicted direction before agent runs. We then compare paired runs with real or anonymized company identities while keeping external evidence PIT-valid. Both Qwen and DeepSeek recalled future facts, but neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen's four allocation estimates on 28 unequal-recall tasks were negative, with descriptive intervals spanning zero. A prospective DeepSeek replication showed an inverse pattern across all four metrics on 20 such tasks, with intervals below zero. These estimates remained negative after each company, pair, and future-fact omission, and all four post-hoc max-T-adjusted sign-flip p-values were below .05. In a prospectively specified follow-up, explicit future facts produced small estimated shifts away from the supplied-fact company, with intervals spanning zero, while final choices shifted toward it. The mechanism behind the natural inverse pattern remains unresolved. These findings support separate assessments of memory accessibility, search allocation, and final outputs alongside cutoff checks on external evidence.

</details>


### [885] [AgentStripes: An Evidence-Graded Maturity Model for AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18603)
*Nutan Kumar Naik,Vijay Prasad Poudel,Aditya Kumar Saroj,Saurav Samantray,Abhishek Patel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentStripes：一个面向 AI Agent 的证据分级成熟度模型，包含 0–7 级条纹、12 个过程域（40 项能力）、三道门槛（基础、安全、证明）与 E0–E5 证据等级，通过对能力的 0–3 评级与证据等级合成信用并加权聚合为条纹。对 30 个公开 Python Agent 仓库的静态证据评估仅为演示而非验证：静态证据将最终条纹限制在 2，26 个仓库止于 1 条纹、4 个为 2 条纹，且该区分不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准测试只反映 AI Agent 在任务集上"能做什么"，而不反映某一发布版本是否具备使其可靠、安全、可观测的工程控制，也不反映这些控制被证明的强度。因此需要一个可证据分级、可度量成熟度的模型来弥补这一空白。

Method: 提出 AgentStripes 成熟度模型：定义 0–7 条纹等级、12 个过程域（含 40 项能力）、三道门槛（basic、safety、proof，无论得分多高都将 Agent 限制在某一等级）以及 E0–E5 证据等级。每项适用能力获得 0–3 评级和独立证据等级，合成信用后聚合为严重度加权分数，再转换为受门槛限制的条纹。由工具采集证据，语言模型评判者按显式标准解读，算术过程确定性。模型在主题层面与相关标准比较（不主张符合性），并给出尚未执行的验证协议。

Result: 对 30 个公开 Python Agent 仓库进行探索性、非确证性实证评估，仅使用静态证据：静态证据将所有最终条纹上限限制为 2；26 个仓库止于 1 条纹，4 个为 2 条纹。该区分不可靠——重新评判使 22 个仓库中 4 个的最终条纹发生变化（engine、dossier、panel 均变），而 8 次仅 panel 重复（均为 1 条纹）无变化。

Conclusion: AgentStripes 的参数为专家约定，未基于结果进行校准，且条纹尚未被证明能预测可靠性或安全性；该实证评估仅作为演示而非验证，整体结论仍需通过所指定的验证协议加以确认。

Abstract: Benchmarks report what an Artificial Intelligence (AI) agent can do on a task suite, but not whether one released version has been engineered with the controls that make it reliable, safe and observable, or how strongly that is shown. This paper proposes AgentStripes, an evidence-graded maturity model for AI agents. It defines levels (0 to 7 stripes), process areas (12 areas holding 40 capabilities), three gates (basic, safety, proof) that hold an agent at a level however high its score, and evidence grades E0 to E5. Each applicable capability receives a rating from 0 to 3 and a separate evidence level; these are combined into a credit, aggregated into a severity-weighted score and converted into stripes that the gates limit. Instruments gather evidence, language-model judges interpret it under explicit criteria, and the arithmetic is deterministic. The model is compared with standards at topic level without a claim of conformance, and an unexecuted validation protocol is specified. An empirical evaluation (exploratory, non-confirmatory) of 30 public Python agent repositories, with static evidence only, is a demonstration and not a validation: static evidence caps every final stripe at 2, 26 repositories end at one stripe and 4 at two, and this distinction is unreliable, since re-judging changed the final stripe of 4 of 22 repositories (engine, dossier and panel changed), whereas none of 8 panel-only repeats, all at stripe 1, changed. The parameters are expert conventions without outcome based calibration, and the stripes have not been shown to predict reliability or safety.

</details>


### [886] [Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18606)
*Haotian Liu,Yingjian Chen,Xiaohang Xu,Lang Huang,Yusuke Iwasawa,Yutaka Matsuo,Irene Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DDRG 是一种基于推理图表对齐的选择性纠错框架，可在不扩充候选轨迹池的前提下，利用冲突证据对多数投票结果进行聚焦修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性（SC）通过对采样答案投票提升多步推理表现，但其投票机制无法消解中间推理步骤的分歧，导致中间声明错误可能影响最终答案。

Method: DDRG 构建基于来源的声明图（claim graphs），通过图对齐识别局部冲突，并将冲突发送给对答案不可见的验证器；若验证器支持的驳斥触及多数答案的支持路径，则触发一次聚焦修复，否则返回原始 SC 投票结果。

Result: 在五个基准测试上，原生零样本 DDRG 相比直接回答在宏平均准确率上分别提升 Qwen2.5-7B 8.65 个百分点、Llama3.1-8B 15.83 个百分点；同时优于 CoT、所评估的 GoT 与 GoV 问答适配方法以及 SC。

Conclusion: DDRG 将局部验证与选择性纠错相连接，且无需扩大初始候选池，为多步推理中的中间分歧提供了有效纠错路径。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.

</details>


### [887] [Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18614)
*Ashutosh Hathidara*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出在GRPO下用多步回合的最终结果（而非当前步正确性）来校准LLM智能体每步的自信度信号，用于决定信任、弃权或转交人类。离线RL中步自信度对回合结果的AUROC由接近随机提升至0.68-0.85；在线ALFWorld中ECE从0.42降至0.12以下，选择性执行优于未训练智能体和仅格式RL对照，且不损害任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 控制长时域任务中的LLM智能体，需要在每步判断是否信任其动作、弃权或转交人类，这依赖能预测整个回合最终成败的逐步自信度信号。智能体自报的语言化自信度是自然候选，但现有强化学习方法仅将其校准到当前步决策的正确性，而非多步回合的最终结果，因而无法满足长时域控制需求。

Method: 在GRPO框架下，利用同一任务的一组rollout提供成功标签，并用proper scoring rule将每一步的自信度对该回合的实际结果进行评分，从而将自信度校准到回合最终结局而非单步正确性。在Qwen2.5-7B智能体的ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop已记录轨迹上做离线RL，并在实时ALFWorld智能体上做在线RL；同时提出一种将回合深度、任务难度和尝试级预见性分离的评测协议。

Result: 离线RL中，步自信度对回合结果的AUROC从接近随机升至0.68-0.85，最自信的前10%步骤成功率约为平均的4.3倍。在线ALFWorld中，四种校准奖励提升了早期步AUROC，期望校准误差从0.42降至0.12以下，选择性执行优于未训练智能体和仅格式RL对照，且不降低任务成功率。

Conclusion: 将每步自信度校准到多步回合的最终结果可行且有效，可显著改善校准质量与选择性执行。分离评测显示增益主要来自智能体从第一步即可识别哪些任务会失败，而在同一任务下区分成功与失败尝试更难，仅在TextWorld的早期窗口出现部分信号。

Abstract: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent's own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step's confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68-0.85, and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ~4.3x more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12, and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.

</details>


### [888] [Two Routes to Interoceptive Prioritisation: Dissociating Likelihood Precision and Preference Reweighting in Active Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18617)
*St John Grimbly,Nicolas Kuske,Evert A. Boonstra,Charel van Hoof,Rowan Hodson,Benjamin Rosman,Ryan Smith,Mark Solms,Jonathan P. Shock*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文在具身智能体的主动推理框架下，比较了两种应对紧迫生理需求的方式——提高内感受精度与重加权偏好，并考察二者单独及联合使用对生存、感知与身体模型学习的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体必须在多个相互竞争的生理需求之间进行优先级排序。在主动推理中，应对紧迫需求有两种可能机制：提高关于该需求信息的精度，或提高对能够缓解该需求的结果的偏好。然而这两种干预各自的后果，尤其是对身体模型学习的影响，尚不清楚。

Method: 作者构建了一个包含三种致命需求的觅食网格世界，分别单独及联合实施两种干预：精度提升（锐化内感受后验）与偏好重加权，并测量生存率、感知以及智能体学到的身体模型（模型覆盖的需求水平范围及各水平的质量）。此外在另外72个布局上进行了实验以检验预测。

Result: 精度提升锐化了内感受后验并改善了生存。偏好重加权使身体状态远离致死边界，并改变了智能体学习时所处的状态，导致所学模型覆盖的需求水平更少，在所有水平上质量更低，但在其实际访问的水平上质量略高。在72个额外布局上，未能证实所预测的偏好收益（困难布局），但两种干预在那些布局上都提升了平均生存率，且二者的交互作用为正。

Conclusion: 仅凭生存率无法完整刻画模型如何对需求进行优先级排序以及如何学习关于自身身体的知识；需同时考虑感知精度与偏好重加权对学习过程的影响。

Abstract: An embodied agent must prioritise among competing bodily needs. In active inference, it can respond to an urgent need by increasing the precision of information about that need or by increasing its preference for outcomes that relieve it. We compare these two interventions, separately and together, in a foraging gridworld with three lethal needs, and ask how each changes survival, perception and the body model the agent learns. Precision sharpens interoceptive posteriors and improves survival. Preference reweighting keeps bodily states further from their lethal boundaries and changes the states from which the agent learns, so its learned model covers fewer need levels, with lower quality across all levels but slightly higher quality on the levels it visits. An experiment on 72 further layouts does not establish the predicted preference benefit on difficult layouts, but both interventions improve average survival there and their interaction is positive. Survival alone therefore gives an incomplete account of how a model prioritises needs and learns about its body.

</details>


### [889] [To Align or Not To Align: Check Your COMPASS Before You Train](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18638)
*Fabian Gröger,Petar Damjanović,Maria Brbić*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 COMPASS，一种在对齐或合并之前评估模型对兼容性的诊断指标，将其分解为 k-NN 重叠刻画的配对易度与训练范式上限两个轴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合预训练模型（如视觉编码器与语言模型对齐、微调检查点合并）通常依赖昂贵的经验搜索，因为兼容性只有在对齐或合并之后才能知晓，缺乏事前诊断手段。

Method: 基于"表征收敛在局部邻域层面最稳健"的观察，COMPASS 将兼容性分解为两个低成本轴：pair-specific ease（两编码器间的 k-NN 重叠）与 paradigm-level ceiling（训练范式所允许的最大重叠）。据此对候选模型对排序，并给出四种行动建议：优先选择已一致且范式兼容的配对、对范式兼容但初始一致性低的配对追加算力、当范式无法支撑足够一致性时更换预训练范式、对两轴均差的配对降级处理。

Result: 在 72 组跨模态对齐实验与 392 组任务算术模型合并上验证，COMPASS 的兼容性估计与下游成功率强相关，跨模态对齐任务平均 Pearson 相关系数为 0.91，模型合并为 0.70。

Conclusion: COMPASS 可作为对齐或合并前的兼容性诊断工具，以低成本预测模型对组合效果并指导资源分配与范式选择。

Abstract: Combining pretrained models is a common strategy for building AI systems, whether by aligning a vision encoder with a language model or merging fine-tuned checkpoints. However, finding compatible pairs typically requires costly empirical search, as compatibility is known only after alignment or merging. We propose COMPASS (COMPatibility ASsessment Score), a theoretically motivated diagnostic that estimates whether a model pair will be compatible prior to alignment or merging. Building on the observation that representational convergence is most robust at the level of local neighborhoods, COMPASS decomposes model compatibility into two cheap-to-compute axes: a pair-specific ease, defined as the $k$-NN overlap between the two encoders, and a paradigm-level ceiling, capturing the maximum overlap their training paradigms allow. Together, these two axes provide a ranking of candidate model pairs and prescribe how to act on each pair: (i) prioritize pairs that already agree and whose paradigms are compatible, (ii) invest additional compute on pairs with compatible paradigms but low initial agreement, (iii) switch the pretraining paradigm when it cannot support sufficient agreement, or (iv) deprioritize pairs that score poorly on both axes. We apply COMPASS to $72$ cross-modal alignment experiments and $392$ task-arithmetic model merges and show that compatibility estimates by COMPASS strongly correlate with downstream success, achieving average Pearson correlation of $0.91$ on cross-modal alignment tasks and $0.70$ on model merging.

</details>


### [890] [Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18684)
*Jiajun Chen,Xinyue Chen,Yicheng Jiang,Hua Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Grounding Awareness（接地意识）"概念与受控基准，发现强记忆性能并不保证智能体能区分用户已接受与未确认的提议，且提供更完整用户信息或持久记忆反而会加剧未确认提议被误当作指令执行；作者提出免训练的轻量扩展 Grounding Layer 追踪接地状态并对关键动作进行校验，显著改善智能体行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人智能体记忆研究多聚焦于"学习用户知道什么、偏好什么、想要什么"，但"了解用户"不等于"了解用户与智能体共同确立了哪些约定"。若仅因提议被记住就当作已授权指令，会导致智能体越权执行。因此需要区分已接受、未确认、已修订、限定范围内的安排。

Method: 1）形式化提出 Grounding Awareness（接地意识），即在动作选择时区分已接受、未确认、已修订与限定范围安排的能力；2）构建受控基准，测试智能体能否分辨用户已接受与未接受的提议，以及能否仅在适当场景应用已接受的安排；3）在多种智能体与记忆系统上进行评测；4）沿记忆写入、检索、动作选择三个环节追踪失败来源；5）提出 Grounding Layer，一种免训练、轻量级扩展，显式追踪接地状态并在关键动作前进行校验，不修改模型或记忆系统。

Result: 跨多种智能体与记忆系统的实验表明：强记忆性能并不能保证接地意识；更意外的是，提供更完整的用户信息会增加未确认提议被执行的概率，而持久记忆会促使智能体将这些提议当作用户指令来处理。失败可追溯至记忆写入、检索与动作选择环节。Grounding Layer 在不修改模型与记忆系统的前提下大幅改善智能体行为。

Conclusion: 记忆能力与"共同约定"的接地能力是可分离的，仅靠增强记忆或提供更多用户信息无法解决未确认提议被误执行的问题；将接地状态显式建模并在动作选择层加以校验，是一种轻量且有效的解决路径。

Abstract: Personal-agent memory has largely focused on learning what users know, prefer, and want. However, knowing the user does not necessarily mean knowing what the user and the agent have established together. An assistant's proposal should not become an authorized instruction merely because it is remembered. We introduce Grounding Awareness, the ability to distinguish accepted, unacknowledged, revised, and scoped arrangements when selecting actions. We develop a controlled benchmark to test whether agents can tell the difference between proposals users have accepted and those they have not, and whether they apply accepted arrangements only where appropriate. Across multiple agents and memory systems, we find that strong memory performance does not ensure Grounding Awareness. More surprisingly, providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while persistent memory can cause agents to treat these proposals as if they were user instructions. We trace these failures through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection. Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer, a lightweight, training-free extension that explicitly tracks grounding status and checks consequential actions, substantially improving agent behavior without modifying models or memory systems.

</details>


### [891] [Unlocking Token Rewards via Training-Free Reward Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18704)
*Sitong Wu,Haoru Tan,Bin Xia,Xichen Zhang,Jingyao Li,Shaofeng Zhang,Xiaojuan Qi,Bei Yu,Jiaya Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出免训练的P2T方法，用一阶泰勒估计token对过程奖励的影响，实现token级奖励分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从现有深度奖励模型（PRM）中直接提取token级奖励信号，避免训练额外奖励模型，并实现精确的信用分配。

Method: 将宏观过程奖励归因到每个token，定义影响为替换为语义空token时最终奖励的变化；用一阶泰勒展开将影响简化为token嵌入与空token嵌入之差同奖励对该嵌入梯度的内积，仅需一次前向与一次反向传播。

Result: 在推理基准上显著提升策略优化效率并增强LLM推理泛化：Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct在MathVista上比outcome reward提升+4.9%，Qwen2.5-Math-7B在AIME24上提升+11.5%。

Conclusion: P2T是一种高效、免训练的token级奖励提取方法，使标准RL算法无需额外奖励模型训练即可进行精确信用分配。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose an extremely efficient, training-free method to extract token-level reward signals directly from an existing deep reward model. Our core idea is to attribute the overall process reward to individual tokens by estimating each token's influence. This influence is defined as the change in the final macroscopic reward (e.g., the process reward) when a token is replaced with a semantically null token. Naively calculating this influence is computationally infeasible, requiring N forward passes through the PRM for an N-token sequence. We overcome this bottleneck by proposing a highly efficient gradient-based estimator. Specifically, we use a first-order Taylor approximation, which simplifies the influence calculation to the inner product of the difference between the token embedding and the null token embedding, and the gradient of the reward with respect to the token embedding. This requires only a single forward and backward pass. The resulting token-level rewards enable standard RL algorithms to perform precise credit assignment without requiring additional reward model training. Experiments on challenging reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method substantially improves policy optimization efficiency and enhances the generalization of LLM reasoning capabilities. Our P2T outperforms the outcome reward by +4.9% on MathVista for Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, and +11.5% on AIME24 for Qwen2.5-Math-7B. The code will be released via https://github.com/stonewst/P2T.

</details>


### [892] [Beyond the Verdict: Agentic Code Judging with Verifiable Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18760)
*Zheye Deng,Sha Li,Changlong Yu,Xin Liu,Qin Lu,Priyanka Nigam,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出用"生成反例作为可检验证据"的方式，让模型仅凭题面与源码对竞赛程序进行判定与诊断，并构建 USACO-JUDGE 基准、训练 MoE 智能体验证器 ARBITER，显著提升验证、代码选择与修订效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 在测试时扩展（生成多个候选解并选择、或修订已有尝试）时需要验证器估计候选正确性并提供失败证据。但竞赛编程中官方评测系统虽给出权威判定，却受限于提交预算，且不公开失败解释或反例输入，因此无法直接用官方判题来提供信息反馈。

Method: 将任务形式化为：仅依据问题陈述与源代码，对候选程序进行判定与诊断，并以生成的反例作为可检验证据。构建 USACO-JUDGE 基准（源自 USACO 2026 竞赛，含人类专家与多个 LLM 编写的通过/未通过程序）；在通用执行沙箱中用强化学习训练 35B MoE 智能体验证器 ARBITER。

Result: 训练后，错误程序上的反例成功率从 40.61% 提升至 62.67%，USACO-JUDGE 上的平均二分类判定准确率从 71.41% 提升至 87.41%，接近前沿验证性能。此外在代码选择与代码修订任务上均优于基线。IOI 2026 案例研究中，ARBITER 引导的修订使 GPT-OSS-120B 在官方提交限制下的期望得分超过金牌线。

Conclusion: 不消耗官方提交即可由模型自主完成判定与诊断，反例作为可检验证据有效；经 RL 训练的 ARBITER 在验证、选择与修订上均表现优异，并可实际提升竞赛得分至奖牌水平。

Abstract: Test-time scaling for large language models (LLMs) can involve generating multiple candidate solutions for selection or revising an earlier attempt. To guide selection and revision, we need a verifier that can estimate candidate correctness and provide evidence of failure. In competitive programming, however, official judging systems provide authoritative verdicts under finite submission budgets, without revealing failure explanations or failing inputs. To provide informative feedback without consuming official submissions, we formulate a task in which a model judges and diagnoses a candidate program using only the problem statement and source code, with generated counterexamples serving as checkable evidence. To evaluate this task, we build USACO-JUDGE from the USACO 2026 contests, using accepted and unaccepted programs written by human experts and multiple LLMs. We then train ARBITER, a 35B mixture-of-experts (MoE) agentic verifier, with reinforcement learning in a generic execution sandbox. Training raises counterexample success on incorrect programs from 40.61% to 62.67% and mean binary verdict accuracy on USACO-JUDGE from 71.41% to 87.41%, approaching frontier verification performance. Beyond verification, ARBITER outperforms baselines in both code selection and refinement. In an IOI 2026 case study, ARBITER-guided refinement raises GPT-OSS-120B's expected score above the gold-medal threshold under the official submission limit.

</details>


### [893] [Jeva: System One Models from First Principles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18773)
*Qi Li,Xinchao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出决策原生架构Jeva，通过共享编码器与紧凑决策栈联合满足null感知、置换不变、选项可扩展、可缓存四项结构要求，统一Choice/Noul/Score三类输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从序列化文本直接预测答案的System one模型虽低延迟，但未尊重决策问题的结构。当前设计忽视四项结构要求：(i) null感知——区分答案缺失与候选间不确定性；(ii) 置换不变——候选顺序不应改变决策；(iii) 选项可扩展——候选集扩大时无需重定义输出空间；(iv) 可缓存——对复现选项的请求无关计算应可跨请求复用。

Method: Jeva架构：共享编码器独立表示请求与各选项；紧凑决策栈仅基于不可变选项记忆精炼请求状态；对称聚合产生置换等变概率；共享打分适应可变大小候选集；独立覆盖估计区分答案缺失与候选竞争，支持显式null结果；请求无关的选项表示与层投影支持跨新组装集合复用。这些机制统一Choice、Noul、Score输出。

Result: 在多项评测中，Jeva兼具强类型决策性能与近乎完美的null检测，在任何测试置换下均无决策翻转；可扩展至数千候选，并通过跨请求复用显著降低延迟且不改变决策。

Conclusion: 将决策问题的结构要求显式纳入架构设计，可在保持低延迟的同时提升决策的正确性、稳健性与可扩展性，为决策原生模型提供可行范式。

Abstract: System one models enable direct, low-latency decision-making. Yet recent practice of predicting an answer from serialized text does not, by itself, respect the structure of a decision problem. We argue that current designs underemphasize four important structural requirements. (i) null-aware: Models should distinguish answer absence from uncertainty among candidates; (ii) permutation-invariant: Reordering alternatives should not change the decision; (iii) option-scalable: Growing candidate sets should not require redefining the output space; (iv) cacheable: Request-independent computation over recurring alternatives should be reusable across requests. We introduce Jeva, a decision-native architecture that addresses these requirements jointly. A shared encoder independently represents the request and each option, while a compact decision stack refines only the request state against immutable option memory. Symmetric aggregation yields permutation-equivariant probabilities; shared scoring accommodates variable-size candidate sets. A separate coverage estimate distinguishes answer absence from candidate competition, enabling explicit null outcomes. Request-independent option representations and layer projections support reuse across newly assembled sets. These mechanisms unify Choice, Noul, and Score outputs. Across evaluations, Jeva combines strong typed-decision performance with near-perfect null detection and no decision flips under any tested permutations. It scales to thousands of candidates and substantially reduces latency through cross-request reuse without changing decisions.

</details>


### [894] [BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18780)
*Xiaoguang Guo,Yaohao Long,Chuxu Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BLADE 是一个无需训练的失败归因框架，通过审计依赖证据的使用而非仅追踪信息来源，在多智能体系统失败运行中实现最优或并列最优的错误步骤定位准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型多智能体系统通过跨角色、工具和工作流的协作扩展了单个智能体的能力，但协作也使故障更难诊断：某个智能体可能误读正确结果，而其他智能体将错误继续传播。失败归因旨在识别责任智能体和决定性错误步骤。现有方法虽然追踪依赖关系，但知道信息来自何处并不等于知道问题出在何处，因此需要从"追踪信息"转向"审计信息的使用"。

Method: BLADE（Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence）是一个无需训练的框架。它使用 Jev 进行结构化概率判断，利用依赖概率选择相关的源决策交接点进行审计；在这些交接点上，检查接收决策是否忠实使用其来源且符合任务要求，从而区分错误的引入、传播和修复。这些发现汇总为一个考虑所有执行步骤的全局诊断。

Result: 在共享 Jev 决策接口下，BLADE 对五个 Who&When 和 Who&When Pro 子集中的 1,228 个失败运行，在八种策略中取得最优或并列最优的步骤准确率，无需参考答案，比 All-at-once 高出 2.2-11.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 将责任证据显式化，为构建更具可解释性和可靠性的智能体系统提供了路径。

Abstract: Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error introduction, propagation, and repair. These findings inform a global diagnosis that considers all execution steps. Without reference answers, BLADE achieves the best or tied-best step accuracy among eight strategies under a shared Jev decision interface on 1,228 failed runs across five Who&When and Who&When Pro subsets, outperforming All-at-once by 2.2-11.1 percentage points. Making responsibility evidence explicit offers a path toward more interpretable and reliable agentic systems.

</details>


### [895] [Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18784)
*Yuchen Lu,Julian McAuley,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CarryOn——一种面向对象的上下文运行时，将长程智能体的延续基础从"交互历史"转向"可复用的任务对象"，在建载体、执行上下文与近期交互实时尾部三部分构成上下文视图，并通过跨折叠的载体记录增量修订机制，避免每次折叠时重建完整表示。在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上分别提升 5.8% 与 7.0%，同时将 token 用量降低 51.9% 与 22.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程智能体将进展累积在持久化任务状态中，但每轮仍反复处理描述"进展如何达成"的交互历史，造成上下文冗余与算力/Token 浪费。核心动机是：长程上下文能否围绕"可复用的进展本身"而非产生它的历史来组织，从而在保留延续所需信息的同时淘汰冗余轨迹。

Method: CarryOn 采用面向对象的上下文运行时，用"延续载体（continuation carriers）"承载可复用进展，并联合互补的执行上下文与近期交互的实时尾部（live tail）构建上下文视图。针对历史退役后载体有效性维持的问题，提出跨折叠载体记录机制：对受影响记录依据绑定证据（bound evidence）与环境校验进行修订，未受影响记录直接前向传递，同时联合更新执行上下文，从而无需在每次折叠时重建完整表示。

Result: 在 OSWorld 2.0 上取得 5.8% 的性能提升，在 BrowseComp-Plus 上取得 7.0% 的提升；同时总 token 用量分别下降 51.9% 与 22.9%，表明在提升任务完成度的同时显著降低了上下文开销。

Conclusion: 实验表明，以可复用任务对象为核心组织长程上下文是可行且有效的，能够在性能与效率两个维度同时获益。该工作为长程智能体的上下文管理提供了"面向对象运行时 + 增量载体修订"的新范式。

Abstract: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

</details>


### [896] [Self-Evolving Agent Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18813)
*Chuyang Wei,Haoxiang Guan,Minghang Zhu,Kexin Zhou,Jiyan He,Xiren Zhou,Huanhuan Chen,Yifei Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出"Harness 自进化（Harness RSI）"框架：在保持模型权重固定的前提下，通过反馈驱动流程持久化修改智能体的软件脚手架（提示词、记忆、工作流与可执行组件），并给出演化优化与持续 PAC 学习的理论分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统智能体改进多聚焦于模型权重训练，而实际部署中脚手架（prompts、memory、workflow、code）往往是性能瓶颈。作者希望形式化一种不依赖权重更新、但能跨运行持续累积改进的自进化机制，并厘清其可靠性与风险。

Method: 将自进化建模为反馈驱动的持续修订过程，接受的修订在多次运行间持久保留；框架把"更新目标"与"提出机制""准入机制"分离，并区分解释性状态修改、工具与代码修订、仓库级控制逻辑、插件组合四类目标。搜索过程用演化优化刻画，可靠性用持续 PAC 学习分析；在显式假设下推导期望泛化界、基于历史回归预算的条件保留界，以及使用新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。

Result: 在给定假设下得到三项理论结果：期望泛化界、条件于历史回归预算的保留界、以及依赖新鲜独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。文中还结合既有工作案例说明模型—脚手架协同设计、分布式执行与插件复用，并讨论持久修订对知识共享与组织工作流的影响，及其对科学可靠性、物理安全与制度问责的意义。

Conclusion: 可靠部署要求随着任务分布与评估器变化进行持续验证，并对学习过程、运行时权限和高影响动作设置独立防护。作者提供 66 页综述，涵盖相关工作、理论、算法、评测、应用与 Harness RSI 的广泛影响，并在 https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI 持续更新代码与补充材料。

Abstract: Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.

</details>


### [897] [Read the Room Before Your Model Generates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18820)
*Muyao Kong,Zhihao Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Scenario-Actor框架，从Transformer隐状态中提取场景结构，用场景嵌入这一几何表征来确定解码温度，使温度选择可解释且自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM温度选择多为固定启发式全局设置或上下文/词元级校准，缺乏对交流情境的几何可解释性表征。

Method: Scenario-Actor从Transformer隐状态中提取与场景相关的结构，并依据场景嵌入（对交流情境的结构化几何表示）来确定解码温度。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上，Scenario-Actor在交互式社交场景中目标完成表现强，在开放式指令遵循上显著提升，多轮对话中相较多个基线具竞争力。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种简单且可解释的温度选择框架，通过情境特征自适应调节解码，在多种任务上取得良好效果。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generally rely on sampling temperature to regulate the amount of randomness in their outputs. Mainstream methods for selecting temperature typically involve fixed, heuristic global settings and context or token-level calibration, rather than a geometrically interpretable representation of the communicative scenario. In this work, we introduce a simple and interpretable temperature selection framework, the \textbf{Scenario-Actor}, which adapts decoding to the inferred situational characteristics. Scenario-Actor extracts scenario-relevant structures from Transformer hidden states and determines the temperature from scenario embedding, a structured geometric representation of the communicative setting. Empirical results show that on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Scenario-Actor achieves strong goal-completion performance in interactive social scenarios, significant gains on open-ended instruction following, and competitive performance on multi-turn conversation compared to multiple baselines.

</details>


### [898] [Who Improves the Robot? Toward Physical Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18842)
*Hai Zhou,Fan Yang,Zeyi Chen,Lejun Zhang,Chenyang Fu,Jianping Li,Jiayi Zhu,Xianyang Liu,Yingxuan Yang,Lili Meng,Lu Wang,Xinyang Han,Jiankai Sun,Weirui Ye,Guanchu Wang,Wanhua Li,Ming Zhou,Boyi Li,Ming Jin,Kun Shao,Muhao Chen,Guang Chen,Lei Ma,Joey Tianyi Zhou,Costas Spanos,Xia Hu,Mac Schwager,Weinan Zhang,Qian Feng,Shangding Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述"物理递归自我改进"（Physical RSI），提出L0-L5分级框架区分能力级与元级更新、任务内与跨任务增益，并指出当前文献尚未实现真正意义上的Physical RSI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人任务执行日益自主，但其能力提升仍主要依赖人工驱动。作者希望探究能否让物理经验驱动机器人对自身能力及改进流程进行持久更新，从而实现跨任务的递归式自我提升。

Method: 本文为综述性研究。作者提出L0-L5框架，从能力级/元级更新与任务内/跨任务增益两个维度对自我改进进行分级，并将独立验证的递归增益留作L5。围绕harness adaptation与模型训练梳理现有方法，同时分析治理执行过程与后续更新的安全与控制机制。

Result: 分析表明，尽管自我改进领域已有显著进展，但被调研的文献尚不能证明符合本框架定义的Physical RSI。作者据此识别出四个研究重点：可靠反馈、因果归因、安全保持与基准测试。

Conclusion: Physical RSI仍处于开放问题阶段。作者给出通往"机器人自主改进其学习方式并保证安全"的路径，并公开了相关GitHub仓库。

Abstract: Robots are increasingly autonomous in task execution, yet their improvement remains largely human-driven. This study investigates Physical Recursive Self-Improvement (Physical RSI), in which physical experience guides lasting updates to both a robot's capabilities and its improvement procedure, making subsequent improvement more effective across tasks. Physical RSI faces challenges from noisy observations, continuous dynamics, costly trials, and irreversible consequences. We present an L0-L5 framework that differentiates capability-level from meta-level updates and within-task from across-task gains, reserving L5 for independently verified recursive gain. We study existing methods around harness adaptation and model training, alongside safety and control mechanisms that govern execution and successive updates. Our analysis reveals that, despite substantial progress in self-improvement, the surveyed literature does not yet demonstrate Physical RSI as defined by our framework. We identify research priorities in reliable feedback, causal attribution, safety preservation, and benchmarking, outlining a path toward robots that autonomously improve how they learn while ensuring safety. The GitHub repository for Physical RSI is available at https://github.com/SAIL-Research-Lab/Physical-RSI.

</details>


### [899] [MFG: Multi-turn Feedback Guided Molecular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18851)
*Trieu Nguyen,Frazier N. Baker,Ruoxi Gao,Daniel Adu-Ampratwum,Xia Ning*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多轮反馈引导(MFG)强化学习框架，训练LLM利用前轮反馈渐进优化分子，在10个多目标分子优化任务上平均相似度约束成功率提升至81.50%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标分子优化需基于计算或实验反馈进行迭代修改，但现有基于LLM的方法未被显式训练以利用反馈，且主要集中于单轮优化，缺乏对迭代反馈的有效利用。

Method: MFG引入反馈向量，捕捉性质改进与源分子相似度；并设计反馈对齐的奖励函数，促进跨轮渐进式改进。将该框架应用于多目标分子优化模型GeLLM³O，得到GeLLM³O-MFG。

Result: 在10个多目标分子优化任务上评估，GeLLM³O-MFG取得最高平均相似度约束成功率81.50%，优于基座模型GeLLM³O的70.81%。

Conclusion: 通过强化学习训练LLM利用多轮反馈进行渐进式优化，可显著提升多目标分子优化的相似度约束成功率，验证了反馈引导框架的有效性。

Abstract: Multi-objective molecular optimization is a critical process in drug discovery that aims to modify a given molecule to simultaneously improve multiple properties while maintaining a similar overall structure. This process often requires iterative modifications guided by computational or experimental feedback. Recent large language model (LLM)-based methods have begun to explore this iterative approach; however, these methods are not explicitly trained to leverage such feedback, while existing approaches primarily focus on single-turn molecular optimization. To address this gap, we introduce Multi-turn Feedback Guided (MFG) molecular optimization, a reinforcement learning framework that trains an LLM to progressively optimize molecules using feedback from previous turns. MFG introduces a feedback vector capturing both property improvements and source molecule similarity, alongside a feedback-aligned reward function that promotes progressive improvement across turns. We apply MFG over $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$, a state-of-the-art LLM model for multi-objective molecular optimization, evaluate $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ on ten multi-objective molecular optimization tasks. The results demonstrate that $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O-MFG}$ achieves the highest average similarity-constrained success rate ($81.50%$), outperforming the base model $\text{GeLLM}^{3}\text{O}$ ($70.81%$).

</details>


### [900] [AesCode: Aesthetic Code Generation with Decoupled Cross-Modal Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18860)
*Xin Gao,Yifan Yang,Xin Li,Pan Wang,Yan Li,Muzhao Tian,Mingxi Cheng,Bei Liu,Kai Qiu,Qi Dai,Dong Chen,Yue Dong,Leandros Tassiulas,Rex Ying,Ji Li,Chong Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AesCode：以同一提示生成的图像为美学引导，将目标表示为设计图（design graph），派生跨模态奖励（确定性验证器 + VLM 评判的 Visual Graph Rubric），用逐通道归一化的强化学习优化，生成信息丰富的视觉产物代码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成幻灯片、海报、仪表盘等"以代码表示"的信息密集型视觉产物具有结构化、可编辑、可验证的优势。但代码模型无法"看到"布局与配色在画布上的最终效果，空间规划与美学质量受限；图像生成器擅长视觉设计却易渲染错内容，作为直接复现目标不可靠。因此需要兼顾内容正确性与美学质量的方案。

Method: 1) 提出 AesCode：以内容提示生成代码，同时用同一提示生成的图像作为美学引导。2) 将目标表示为描述整张画布的设计图，使每个属性可归因。3) 从设计图派生互补的跨模态奖励：确定性验证器评估可从代码与渲染中解析的属性；VLM 评判器通过采样特定的 Visual Graph Rubric（VGR，与图元素和关系绑定）评估不可解析属性。4) 用强化学习优化解耦奖励，并采用逐通道归一化，联合提升空间规划、美学质量与可验证正确性。5) 构建同时评测可验证正确性与视觉质量的基准，其视觉分数与人类判断高度一致。

Result: 参考图像能显著提升现有模型生成代码的视觉质量；消融显示 AesCode 从"作为模型输入"和"作为视觉奖励来源"两方面受益于参考图像。相比给定相同参考的同规模 Qwen3-VL 基线，AesCode-8B 与 AesCode-32B 的视觉质量分别提升 31.1 与 22.4 个百分点，达到与 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8 等闭源前沿模型相当的水平。

Conclusion: 通过设计图表示、跨模态解耦奖励与逐通道归一化强化学习，AesCode 有效结合代码的可验证性与图像的美学指导，在保持内容正确性的同时大幅提升视觉质量，无需依赖闭源前沿模型即可达到同级视觉表现。

Abstract: Generating information-rich visual artifacts such as slides, posters, and dashboards as code is appealing because the outputs are structured, editable, and verifiable. Yet code models cannot see how their choices of layout and color come together on the canvas, often limiting spatial planning and aesthetic quality. Image generators excel at visual design but can misrender requested content, making their outputs unreliable targets for direct reproduction. We therefore introduce AesCode, which generates code grounded in the content prompt while using an image generated from the same prompt as an aesthetic guidance. To do so, AesCode represents the target as a design graph that describes the whole canvas and makes each property attributable. From this graph, we derive complementary cross-modal rewards: deterministic verifiers score properties parsable from code and rendering, while a VLM judge assesses the non-parsable ones with a sample-specific Visual Graph Rubric (VGR) tied to graph elements and relations. We optimize these decoupled rewards through reinforcement learning with per-channel normalization to jointly improve spatial planning, aesthetic quality, and verifiable correctness. To evaluate this setting, we build a benchmark that scores verifiable correctness and visual quality separately, with visual scores highly consistent with human judgments. We find that reference images substantially improve the visual quality of code generated by existing models, and ablations show that AesCode benefits from references both as model input and as a source of visual rewards. Relative to same-scale Qwen3-VL baselines given the same references, AesCode-8B and AesCode-32B improve visual quality by 31.1 and 22.4 percentage points, reaching scores comparable to those of closed-source frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8.

</details>

### [901] [SWEeper-Bench: Can Agents Discover Bugs in Interactive Software?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14096)
*Yang Yao,Haozhe Chen,Bingyi Kang,Karthik R Narasimhan,Zhuang Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 SWEeper-Bench：200 个基于真实开源 Web 应用修复构建的任务，仅给代码库与开放式请求，要求智能体自主设计交互测试以发现并修复仅在多步交互后暴露的缺陷；15 个前沿智能体最高仅通过 59.0%，主要瓶颈在于"识别缺陷行为"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体正从文本回复转向即时生成交互式软件，但许多缺陷需经多步交互才暴露。当前用户须自行发现缺陷并等待修复，开发闭环缓慢昂贵；而现有基准多假定缺陷已被识别，智能体"发现交互相关失败"的能力缺乏评估。

Method: 构建 SWEeper-Bench，含 200 个来自 200 个广泛使用开源 Web 应用真实修复的任务。每个任务仅提供代码库与开放式请求（如"发现并修复 Focalboard 的看板分享与成员管理问题"）。因缺陷难以从代码静态察觉，智能体须设计交互式测试来暴露它们；再由一个 agentic verifier 按用户在浏览器中的可观察结果判定修复是否成功。并对智能体轨迹做分阶段分析。

Result: 15 个前沿智能体中表现最佳者仅通过 59.0% 的任务。分阶段轨迹分析显示，最大瓶颈是识别缺陷行为：智能体常能到达相关功能，但未能触发失败，或触发后未能识别出失败。

Conclusion: SWEeper-Bench 衡量了智能体自主闭环（自行发现、触发、识别并修复交互相关缺陷，无需等待用户反馈）的进展，为交付"无需用户反馈即可正常工作"的软件提供了评估基准。

Abstract: Coding agents increasingly interact with users by generating interactive software on the fly rather than replying in text, yet many bugs in such software reveal themselves only after multi-step interactions. Today, users must discover these bugs and wait for fixes, making the development loop slow and expensive. Existing benchmarks typically assume the bugs have already been identified, leaving agents' ability to find interaction-dependent failures largely unevaluated. We introduce SWEeper-Bench, 200 tasks built from real bug fixes in 200 widely used open-source web applications. Each task gives the agent only the codebase and an open-ended request such as "Find and fix issues in Focalboard's board sharing and membership." Because these bugs are hard to detect from code alone, agents must design interactive tests to uncover them. An agentic verifier then judges each repair by what a user would observe in the browser. The best of 15 frontier agents passes only 59.0% of tasks. Through stage-by-stage analysis of agent trajectories, we show that the biggest bottleneck is identifying the buggy behavior: agents often reach the relevant feature but never trigger the failure or fail to recognize it. SWEeper-Bench measures progress toward agents that close this loop themselves, delivering software that works without waiting for user feedback.

</details>


### [902] [Vibe Coding with Google AI Studio Case Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14103)
*Christian Mancas,Cristina Mancas*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文以非程序员使用Google AI Studio（Pro版）通过vibe coding开发中等复杂度软件为例，证明了任何人都能进行vibe coding（即使不懂英语），但顶级AI产品生成的数据库应用仍需充分测试，因为即使规格说明清晰详尽，结果仍可能存在bug和欠佳的开发决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究非程序员（且非英语使用者）能否借助顶级AI工具通过vibe coding成功开发软件，并检验此类工具在实际开发中的可靠性与局限性。

Method: 案例研究法：由一名非程序员使用Google AI Studio（Pro版），在非英语环境下，通过vibe coding方式开发一个中等复杂度的数据库软件应用，并基于清晰的规格说明文档对生成结果进行评估。

Result: 一方面，几乎任何人都能成功进行vibe coding，无需具备开发者身份，也不要求懂英语；另一方面，该顶级AI产品虽能构建出较为合理的数据库应用近似品，但产出仍存在bug，并包含不够明智的开发决策。

Conclusion: vibe coding具有广泛的普及潜力，但即便规格说明几近详尽，其结果仍需彻底测试；AI辅助开发尚不能完全替代人工的质量把关与决策。

Abstract: This paper presents a case study on using Google AI Studio (version Pro) to vibe code a medium-complexity software application by a non-programmer who, moreover, needs it in a language other than English. We prove that, on one hand, almost anybody can successfully vibe code, not only developers, even if you do not speak or understand English, and, on the other, that although such a top AI product can build a reasonable approximation of a fine database software application, vibe coding still needs thorough testing, as even if the initial specification documentation is crystal clear and almost exhaustive, the resulting app may exhibit bugs and not that intelligent development decisions.

</details>


### [903] [Conserved amount, negotiable placement. Prompting perturbs one architecture, an AI reviewer both](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14130)
*Daniel Sagenschneider*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在固定模型与同一REST端点上，让AI智能体在变异式Spring与增量式OfficeFloor两种架构下累积实现60个变更请求。结果：复杂度“总量”稳定（变化7%–20%），但“放置”差异显著——外控条件下变异架构的放置可塑比达2.7–10.0，增量架构近乎不动。唯一能移动增量架构的是“AI评审者”这一个杠杆，但它只作用于管线聚合这一个族。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文动机源于Tesler复杂度守恒定律与Brooks本质/偶然复杂度的区分：若问题的本质复杂度固定，则架构不决定复杂度“数量”，而决定复杂度“放置”。作者试图把"架构"从模糊的定性优劣判断，转化为可测量的性质，并识别出改变复杂度放置的具体杠杆。

Method: 在单一REST端点上，由AI智能体累积实现60个变更请求，对比两种架构：变异式Spring控制器与增量式OfficeFloor管线。实验采用5种条件×每格10次运行，模型固定。其中4种为外部对照，从“裸变更请求”到“公开披露的结构代价函数”，第5种性质不同：由第二个AI智能体对每次变更进行评审并推理聚合度本身。对完成后的复杂度用4种操作化定义测量，并区分6项“数量”指标与11项“放置”指标。

Result: 数量稳定：全部10个实验格中，完成复杂度在4种操作化下仅变化7%–20%；60条规则在同一架构内新增复杂度为21%–29%。放置则不稳定：4种外部对照下，两架构在6项数量指标上的可塑比接近1（6个区间中5个包含1），而在11项放置指标上为2.7–10.0（11个中10个大于1）。变异式架构会移动，增量式架构不动；公开公式可将其带到增量臂未受干预时的放置。AI评审者是唯一能移动增量臂的杠杆，且只作用于一个族：它聚合了管线，在每一个此类指标上提升变更集中度与质量集中度（区间不含0），但未触及耦合、文件数和单节点复杂度。代价被完整报告：严格正确性在多数对比中下降，尽管每条规则在超过99%的检查点上实现正确，且三项结果指标均偏向集中化后的代码库。

Conclusion: 该研究贡献的是关于架构及其杠杆的一项可测量性质，而非对任一架构的裁决。核心结论是：架构主要决定复杂度的放置而非数量；变异式架构具备较高的放置可塑性，增量式架构则依赖特定杠杆（AI评审者）且影响范围有限，并伴随可量化的正确性代价。

Abstract: Tesler's conservation law holds that a problem carries an irreducible amount of complexity. Brooks separates that essential part from the accidental part a solution adds. If the essential part is fixed, architecture is placement rather than quantity, and the question is which levers move placement. An AI agent implements sixty accumulating change requests on one REST endpoint under two architectures, a mutative Spring controller and an additive OfficeFloor pipeline, under five conditions, ten runs per cell, model fixed. Four are external controls, from a bare change request to the disclosed structural cost function. The fifth is different in kind. A second agent reviews each change and reasons about cohesion itself.
  Amount is steady. Across all ten cells the finished complexity varies by 7% to 20% over four operationalisations, and the complexity the sixty rules added by 21% to 29% within an architecture. Placement is not. Under the four external controls the plasticity ratio between the architectures is near 1 on six amount metrics (five of six intervals contain 1) against 2.7 to 10.0 on eleven placement metrics (ten of eleven above 1). The mutative architecture moves, the additive one does not, and the disclosed formula brings it to the additive arm's untouched placement.
  The AI reviewer is the one lever that moves the additive arm, on one family only. It consolidates the pipeline, raising change- and mass-concentration on every such metric, interval excluding zero, while leaving coupling, file count and per-node complexity untouched. The price is reported in full. Strict correctness fell in most comparisons though each rule was implemented correctly in over 99% of checkpoints, and all three outcome measures favour the concentrated codebase. The contribution is a measurable property of an architecture and its lever, not a verdict on either.

</details>


### [904] [OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14157)
*Chenyang Yan,Yingying Zhang,Kanzhi Cheng,Qiushi Sun,Zhengyuan Pan,Zheng Ma,Hang Yan,Yian Wang,Nuo Chen,Jialin Cao,Xingdong Gong,Wenpo Song,Han Chen,Zichen Ding,Fangzhi Xu,Shujian Huang,Xinyu Dai,Yichen Liu,Tiankuo Yao,Bo Wang,Ben Kao,Jianbing Zhang,Lewei Lu,Dahua Lin*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenMobile-2，一个具有完全开放训练环境和配方的近前沿移动智能体，通过构建多样化模拟环境、大规模开放训练数据以及混合 GUI 与原生工具使用范式，在多个基准上取得竞争性表现，并展现出向真实设备迁移的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前移动智能体研究缺乏开放且可控制的训练环境、大规模可验证训练数据，以及探索 GUI 之外交互范式的实验平台，限制了前沿能力的复现与迁移研究。

Method: 构建 MobileGym++，包含 35 个真实商业风格应用及跨应用工作流，并结合 Android 模拟器应用形成超过 110 个应用的多样化环境；整理近 12K 交互轨迹用于监督微调，并构建超过 2K 可执行任务的最大开放可验证 RL 数据集；探索混合 GUI 与 app-native 工具使用设置，在 50+ 应用中实现 300+ 工具；推出 MobileGym++ Bench 支持纯 GUI 与混合评估。

Result: OpenMobile-2 在 AndroidWorld 上达到 79.9，在 MobileWorld 上达到 50.4，并将 SPA-Bench 性能从 31.9 提升至 59.6，接近翻倍，展现出向真实设备移动使用的良好迁移能力。

Conclusion: OpenMobile-2 通过开放环境、数据与混合交互范式的系统化构建，推动了移动智能体的可复现研究与实际部署，并为复杂长时程商业移动场景提供了统一的评估基准。

Abstract: We introduce OpenMobile-2, a near-frontier mobile agent with fully open training environments and recipes. We make three key advances: (1) Diverse environments with simulated commercial apps: We build MobileGym++, featuring 35 realistic, functionally rich commercial-style apps with cross-app workflows, while preserving full controllability for reset and verification. Together with newly configured apps in Android emulators, this yields a diverse playground spanning over 110 apps. (2) Open training data at scale: Building on this foundation, we curate nearly 12K mobile interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and the largest open collection of verifiable RL training data for mobile agents, comprising over 2K executable tasks with automatic rewards. (3) Hybrid GUI and app-native tool use: We explore an experimental mobile-use setting where apps expose selected functionalities as app-native tools alongside their GUIs, allowing agents to interleave GUI actions and tool calls within a task. We implement this setting in MobileGym++ with over 300 carefully scoped tools across 50+ apps. Additionally, we introduce MobileGym++ Bench for complex, long-horizon commercial mobile scenarios, supporting both GUI-only and hybrid GUI-tool evaluation on a shared task suite. OpenMobile-2 performs competitively across established benchmarks, including AndroidWorld (79.9) and MobileWorld (50.4), while showing promising transfer to real-device mobile use, nearly doubling SPA-Bench performance from 31.9 to 59.6. All resources are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OpenMobile2-Home/.

</details>


### [905] [Agentic Evolution of SQL Test Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14161)
*Suyang Zhong,Manuel Rigger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出Gungnir方法，利用编码智能体演化DBMS测试生成器，通过"见证重放"机制验证新增能力，避免LLM幻觉，在SQLite、DuckDB、PostgreSQL上发现44个开发者确认缺陷（34个已修复）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DBMS自动化测试工具通常仅支持少数SQL方言及其部分特性。基于LLM的编码智能体可将额外SQL特性的语义编码进可复用的测试生成器，测试时无需再调用LLM，从而实现高效低成本。但关键挑战在于：在可能存在幻觉的情况下，如何验证新增能力的正确性。

Method: Gungnir的核心机制是"见证重放"：编码智能体提供生成见证，记录生成目标语句所需的数据库设置与语义选择；验证器将这些选择通过修改后的生成器重放，检查其能否复现目标语句。历史见证作为后续修改的回归测试。

Result: 在SQLite、DuckDB和PostgreSQL上评估Gungnir，共发现44个被开发者确认的缺陷，其中34个已被修复。

Conclusion: 见证重放可有效引导编码智能体扩展测试生成器，并有望从DBMS推广到其他系统。

Abstract: Automated testing has uncovered many logic bugs in Database Management Systems (DBMSs). Existing tools are typically limited to a few SQL dialects and a subset of these dialects' features. Coding agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs) could encode the semantics of additional SQL features into reusable test generators, requiring no additional LLM calls during testing and thus enabling high efficiency and low cost. However, a key challenge is validating the added capabilities in the presence of potential hallucinations. In this paper, we propose Gungnir, an approach for evolving DBMS test generators using coding agents. Our core mechanism is witness replay: the coding agent provides a generation witness recording the database setup and semantic choices needed to generate a target statement. A validator replays these choices through the modified generator and checks that it reproduces the target statement. Historical witnesses serve as regression tests for subsequent modifications. We evaluated Gungnir on SQLite, DuckDB, and PostgreSQL and found 44 bugs confirmed by developers, of which 34 have been fixed. Beyond DBMSs, witness replay could generalize to other systems to guide agents in extending test generators.

</details>


### [906] [AutoEnvScaling: Automating the Data Flywheel with Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14163)
*Simon Yu,Baolin Peng,Bo Liu,Zhengyan Shi,Zhaoyang Wang,Hao Cheng,Qianhui Wu,Wenlin Yao,Natasha Jaques,Weiyan Shi,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 AutoEnvScaling：将"环境设计"本身视为终端任务，用智能体自动生成强化学习环境，实现环境供给的数据飞轮，并向递归自我改进（RSI）迈进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体（在终端中执行命令完成软件工程与科研任务）的强化学习训练依赖大量多样化且可验证的环境，但现有环境主要由人类研究者手工设计，供给速度受限于人力，成为训练扩展的瓶颈。

Method: 把环境设计当作一个终端任务：提出者（proposer）智能体基于被训练求解者（solver）的 rollout 构建新的 RL 环境，求解者产生的新 rollout 又指导下一轮环境生成，从而形成自动化的数据飞轮；使同一模型可同时承担环境生成与任务求解两种角色并协同演化。

Result: 相比仅依赖提示词生成，有效环境率最高提升 25 倍，单个有效环境成本最多降低 75%；在 GPT-5.6-sol 生成的 AutoEnvScaling 环境上训练 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，Terminal-Bench 2.1 得分比匹配的 Tmax 基线提升 4.3 分；Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 同时担任两种角色时在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上提升 12.2 分，Terminal-Bench 4.0 从 1.6 升至 3.2；该流程还可泛化到软件工程、计算机使用、专业工作与 GPU 内核编程等智能体领域。

Conclusion: AutoEnvScaling 展示了智能体自主构建训练环境的可行路径，降低了对外部人工设计环境的依赖，是迈向递归自我改进（RSI）的关键一步。

Abstract: Terminal agents solve tasks in software engineering and scientific research by executing commands in a terminal. Training them via reinforcement learning (RL) requires diverse and verifiable environments, but these environments are still mostly designed by human researchers, so their supply grows only as fast as researchers can work. We introduce AutoEnvScaling, which treats environment design as a terminal task and uses agents to automate the data flywheel. A proposer agent builds new RL environments from the rollouts of the solver being trained, and the solver's new rollouts guide the next round. By turning environment generation into a terminal task, AutoEnvScaling increases the valid-environment rate by up to 25 times compared to prompt-only generation, at up to 75% lower cost per valid environment. We show that training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on AutoEnvScaling environments from GPT-5.6-sol improves its Terminal-Bench 2.1 score by 4.3 points over the matched Tmax baseline. The broader goal of AutoEnvScaling is to enable recursive self-improvement (RSI): by making both environment generation and solving terminal tasks, it lets one model co-evolve in both roles. We show that Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, acting in both roles, gains 12.2 points on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and raises its Terminal-Bench 4.0 score from 1.6 to 3.2. The pipeline also generalizes across agentic domains, generating environments for software engineering, computer use, professional work, and GPU kernel programming. Overall, these results show a path toward agents building their own training environments, reducing human reliance and taking a core step toward RSI.

</details>


### [907] [Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14216)
*Samuele Giampieri*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 Cortex，一个对"agent harness"（项目文件、skills、rules 等文本文件）变更进行实证检验的工具：把开发者会话中的纠正保存为可重放任务，识别反复出现的纠正，逐条写入 skill 或 rule，并仅在其能带来可重复净收益且不显著损害任何任务时保留；删除既有文本前也做同样测试，且不增删 agent 从未使用的文本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码 agent（如 Claude Code）会遵循开发者为它编写的文本文件（项目文件、可选打开的 skills、匹配文件时自动加载的 rules），这些文件构成 agent 的 harness。开发者每次纠正 agent 时就往其中添加内容，但单次成功说明不了什么：同一个 agent 可能这次通过任务、下次失败。因此需要一种不"信任"harness 变更、而是对其进行检验的方法。

Method: Cortex 的工作流程为：将开发者会话中的修复保存为可重放任务；挖掘反复出现的纠正；一次只写入一条 skill 或 rule；仅当带与不带该文本的重复运行显示净收益且没有任务明显变差时才保留；删除既有文本之前也以同样方式检验；并且既不添加也不删除 agent 从未使用的文本。

Result: 在专用构建的仓库上以 Claude Haiku 4.5 测试，仓库含模型易违背的约定、一个无可学习内容的对照区域，以及扮演开发者的脚本。在留出任务上，Cortex 构建的 harness 使 agent 遵循约定的频率远高于无 skill/rule 的情况，对照区域保持不变，且未增加每轮都会读取的文本。自动加载的 rules 贡献最大；skills 仅在随任务所涉文件一同提供时有用，而每轮都提供的 skills 很少被打开。Cortex 未保留任何植入的无用或有害建议，但 agent 从未打开无用的 skills 或有害的 skills，对有害 rules 也未给出结论，因此该测试只表明 Cortex 不保留未使用的文本，而非能检测损害。在更强的 Claude Sonnet 5 下，单次运行的 harness 增益很小；在真实开源项目中，agent 很少被纠正，Cortex 未发现可学习内容。

Conclusion: Cortex 提供了一套对 harness 变更进行可重放、逐条、带对照的实证检验机制，能有效筛选并保留有用的 rules/skills，避免保留未使用文本；但其对"有害文本"的检测能力尚未被验证，且在更强模型与真实低纠正场景下收益有限。作者开源了工具、实验环境及数据。

Abstract: Coding agents such as Claude Code also follow text files that developers write for them: a project file, skills the agent may choose to open, and rules that load automatically when the agent reads matching files. We call these files the agent's harness. Developers add to it whenever they correct the agent, but one success proves little: the same agent can pass a task once and fail it the next time.
  We present Cortex, a tool that tests changes to the harness instead of trusting them. It saves fixes from the developer's sessions as replayable tasks, finds the corrections that recur, writes one skill or rule at a time, and keeps it only if repeated runs with and without it show a net gain and no task made noticeably worse. Existing text is tested the same way before it is deleted, and Cortex neither adds nor deletes text the agent never used.
  We tested Cortex with Claude Haiku 4.5 on a repository built for the purpose, with conventions the model tends to break, one area with nothing to learn, and a script playing the developer. On held-out tasks, the harnesses it built made the agent follow the conventions far more often than no skills or rules did, left the comparison area unchanged, and added no text read on every turn. Rules, which load automatically, did most of the work; skills helped only when offered with the files a task touches, and those offered on every turn were rarely opened. Cortex kept none of the useless or harmful suggestions we planted, but the agent never opened the useless ones or the harmful skills, and it reached no verdict on the harmful rules, so the test shows that Cortex keeps no unused text, not that it detects damage. Under the stronger Claude Sonnet 5 a single run's harness added little, and on a real open-source project, where the agent was rarely corrected, Cortex found nothing to learn. We release the tool, the lab and its data.

</details>


### [908] [Diagnosing Generalization Boundaries in AI-Based Vulnerability Detection via Calibrated Embedding Distances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14296)
*Konstantin Ievtushenko,Ralf Lämmel,Jan Jürjens*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文利用校准的嵌入几何来揭示学习型漏洞检测模型在分布偏移下的隐藏泛化边界，通过对CodeBERT和Qwen2.5-Coder的严格配对评估，发现白化中间层嵌入的局部最近邻评分能有效区分分布外样本，且距离分数呈现偏移特异性可靠性梯度，假阳性与脆弱训练邻域的几何邻近度系统性相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型漏洞检测模型在基准测试上得分很高，但在分布偏移下性能严重退化，而这种退化被高分所掩盖；现有评估未能揭示模型真实的泛化边界，因此需要一种无需辅助模型、能直接映射表示几何到模型退化的诊断信号。

Method: 在严格配对的语法相似脆弱/修补代码对上，评估CodeBERT和Qwen2.5-Coder，考察模式偏移、项目偏移和时间偏移三类分布偏移；采用白化中间层嵌入结合局部最近邻评分，以校准的距离作为诊断信号，分析分布外可分性、可靠性梯度和假阳性与几何邻近度的关系（RQ1-RQ3）。

Result: RQ1：白化中间层嵌入配合局部最近邻评分可分离陌生样本，平均分布外AUROC达0.739。RQ2：距离分数揭示偏移特异性可靠性梯度，准确率下降超过35个百分点，跨项目偏移导致最严重退化，尽管时间偏移在几何上漂移最远。RQ3：修补代码上的假阳性与脆弱训练邻域的几何邻近度系统性相关，从最低风险十分位的9.4%升至最高风险十分位的58.8%。

Conclusion: 校准距离构成一种诊断信号，能够将表示几何直接映射到模型退化，无需辅助模型；该方法揭示了高基准分数所掩盖的泛化边界，为漏洞检测模型的可靠性评估提供了几何视角。

Abstract: High benchmark scores in learning-based vulnerability detection mask severe degradation under distribution shifts. This paper demonstrates that calibrated embedding geometry exposes these hidden generalization boundaries on syntactically similar vulnerable and patched code pairs. An evaluation of CodeBERT and Qwen2.5-Coder across pattern, project, and temporal shifts on a strictly paired dataset reveals three main findings. First, whitened intermediate-layer embeddings with local nearest-neighbour scoring separate unfamiliar samples with a mean out-of-distribution AUROC of 0.739 (RQ1). Second, distance scores reveal a shift-specific reliability gradient where accuracy drops by over 35 percentage points and cross-project shifts cause the sharpest degradation, even though temporal shifts drift geometrically farthest (RQ2). Third, false positives on patched code systematically correlate with geometric proximity to vulnerable training neighbourhoods, increasing from 9.4% in the lowest-risk decile to 58.8% in the highest (RQ3). These calibrated distances establish a diagnostic signal that maps representation geometry directly to model degradation without requiring auxiliary models.

</details>


### [909] [SPROUT: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Software Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14405)
*Mengyang Liu,Weiming Wang,Haixin Nan,Yu Wu,Peize Li,Shihong Huang,Xuning He,Xue Jiang,Yihong Dong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SPROUT是一个基于快照的智能体强化学习rollout框架，通过从中间状态恢复和分支来扩展长程编程任务的训练，在提升pass@k的同时显著降低token消耗和训练时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程软件工程任务中，成功轨迹极其稀缺，因为一个微小错误就会使整个rollout失效。反复从初始状态重启效率低下，而仅重置上下文并保留工作目录会遗漏已安装依赖等状态变化。因此需要从中间步骤分支，同时恢复智能体上下文和执行环境。

Method: SPROUT构建于轻量级基础设施之上，在每个助手回合后对文件系统和智能体上下文同时做检查点（快照）。随后采用验证器引导的回溯策略，决定从何处恢复失败尝试以及如何继续。

Result: 在长程编程任务上，SPROUT相比pass@k在不同LLM上最高提升23.6%，同时仅使用其32%–52%的token。对Qwen3.8-27B的RL训练中，SPROUT在三个长程编程基准上稳定超越标准GRPO达13.9个百分点，并将每步训练时间缩短39.5%。

Conclusion: SPROUT使长程编程任务的强化学习既更有效，又更易于低成本扩展。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has driven substantial progress in coding agents by relying on verified successful trajectories as learning signals. However, such trajectories are scarce in long-horizon software engineering tasks, where a minor error can invalidate the entire rollout. Repeatedly restarting from the initial state is commonly used yet inefficient, and resetting only the context with working directory misses state changes such as installed dependencies. Therefore, branching from intermediate steps to preserve earlier progress requires restoring both the agent context and execution environments. In this paper, we present SPROUT (SnaPshot-based RollOUT), an agentic RL rollout framework that scales long-horizon coding tasks by resuming and branching from intermediate states. Specifically, SPROUT was built on top of a lightweight infrastructure that checkpoints both the filesystem and the agent context after each assistant turn. A verifier-guided backtracking policy then selects where to resume a failed attempt and how to proceed. Extensive experiments on long-horizon coding tasks show that SPROUT achieves up to 23.6% improvement over pass@k across various LLMs, while using $32$--$52%$ of their tokens. For RL training of Qwen3.8-27B, SPROUT stably outperforms standard GRPO by $13.9$ points on three long-horizon coding benchmarks while cutting the time per training step by $39.5%$. SPROUT thus makes RL on long-horizon coding tasks both more effective and cheaper to scale.

</details>


### [910] [HoldSpec: A Machine-Checked Model and Conformance Suite for the Payment Authorization Hold Lifecycle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14419)
*Abhishek Sharma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文将支付卡授权/捕获的资金冻结生命周期形式化为 TLA+ 状态机，参数化于 PSP 能力配置，验证 8 项安全性与 3 项活性性质，并由同一模型生成黑盒一致性测试套件，在 61 个可区分缺陷上检出率 100%，显著优于随机序列（56%）和手写集成测试（69%），还通过跨提供方对比发现文档隐含的分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商户授权后延迟捕获时，资金处于双方都无法完全控制的中间状态：仍挂在持卡人账户、尚未扣款，且受卡组织设定的期限约束将自动失效。商户能否部分捕获、再次捕获、作废、追加金额或让其到期，属于各家支付服务提供商（PSP）实现略有差异却从未被形式化规定的业务逻辑，导致互操作性与测试缺乏可靠依据。

Method: 用 TLA+ 对授权/捕获生命周期建模为状态机，并以"提供商能力配置（capability profile）"作为参数；在 6 种配置上（其中 5 种依据 Stripe 与 Adyen 公开文档构建）检查 8 条安全不变式与 3 条活性性质；再由同一状态机自动生成一致性测试套件，对提供商 API 做黑盒执行；并以同一套件在两个提供商之间运行，将对比问题转化为分歧搜索。

Result: 针对 61 个与正确实现可区分的植入缺陷，生成套件检出率为 100%；相同调用预算下随机序列为 56%，手写集成套件为 69%；随机序列即便预算扩大十倍也仅达 67%。跨提供方对比给出了文档各自隐含却未明言的短小可执行分歧见证，其中包括一个反例：关闭冻结并释放剩余额度在某一提供方属于 capture、在另一提供方属于 cancel，从而打破"单一适配器接口可同时覆盖两家"的常见假设。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，以能力配置参数化的 TLA+ 状态机既能用于形式化验证支付冻结生命周期，也能高效导出高检出率的一致性测试，并可用于发现跨提供方文档层面的语义分歧。局限在于缺少提供商沙箱凭证，所有结论仅针对文档所述行为，而非真实系统；可对真实提供商进行测试的套件随工作一并发布。

Abstract: When a merchant authorizes a card and captures the funds later, the money sits in a state that neither party fully controls: held on the cardholder's account, not yet taken, and due to lapse on a deadline set by the card network. What a merchant may do to that hold, capture part of it, capture again, void it, raise it, let it expire, is business logic that every payment service provider implements slightly differently and none of them specifies formally. We give the lifecycle a state machine in TLA+, parameterized by a provider capability profile, and check eight safety invariants and three liveness properties over 6 profiles, five of them built from Stripe's and Adyen's published documentation. From the same machine we generate a conformance suite that runs black-box against a provider API. Against 61 seeded defects that are distinguishishable from a correct implementation, the generated suite detects 100%, where random sequences with the same call budget reach 56% and a hand-written integration suite reaches 69%; random sequences given ten times the budget still reach only 67%. Running the same suite between two providers turns the comparison into a search, and it returns short executable witnesses for divergences the two documentation sets imply but neither states, including one that breaks the common assumption that a single adapter interface can sit over both, because closing a hold and releasing its remainder is a capture on one provider and a cancel on the other. We report what we could not do: no provider sandbox credentials were available, so every result here concerns documented behavior, and the suite that would test the providers themselves is part of what we release.

</details>


### [911] [Specification-Based Testing of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14443)
*Kausar Moshood,Jace Bolante,Roshan Aditya Murali,Manish Motwani*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LEST将文档化安全声明作为规范驱动黑盒测试，对Claude Opus 4.8与GPT-5.5的系统卡进行评测，发现基准提示覆盖面不足且自动化失败检测严重高估行为违规。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
