Motivation: 现有LLM安全评测通常从预定义基准出发，而非追问这些基准究竟检验了哪些已文档化的安全声明，导致文档声明与可执行测试之间缺乏对应关系与可追溯性。

Method: LEST将每条安全声明视为规范：声明决定由哪个基准提示测试它，以及"拒绝-合规转换"（模型拒绝原提示却遵从变异版本）是否构成反例证据；随后对提示进行变异以搜索反例，人工验证每个候选，并将已验证反例回溯至其所违反的声明。实验使用Claude Opus 4.8与GPT-5.5的系统卡，以及SORRY-Bench中涉及心理健康与自残、有害与暴力内容、公平与偏见三个领域的97条种子提示。

Result: 在识别的56条安全声明中，29条（51.8%）可由提示测试，但仅17条（58.6%）被适用的基准提示实际覆盖。两个模型对超过95%的基准提示均予拒绝。对1,836条变异提示的评测中，自动响应分类器标记出312个候选拒绝-合规转换，而人工验证仅确认19个（6.1%）既保持意图又确实合规，表明自动化评测显著高估了行为失败。将这19个转换回溯到声明，在9条以拒绝为适用判定标准的已覆盖声明中，为其中6条找到了反例。

Conclusion: 基准提示可能不足以验证所有已文档化的LLM安全行为，自动化失败检测必须辅以人工验证。LEST实现了从自然语言安全文档到可执行测试与人工验证反例的端到端可追溯性。

Abstract: Model cards, system cards, and safety reports increasingly document LLM safety behaviors, yet safety evaluations typically start from predefined benchmarks rather than asking which documented claims those benchmarks actually test. We introduce LEST (LLM Evaluation through Specification-driven Testing), a framework that treats documented safety claims as specifications for black-box testing. In LEST, each claim determines which benchmark prompt tests it and whether a Refuse-to-Comply transition, where a model refuses a prompt but complies with its mutated version, counts as evidence against it. LEST mutates these prompts to search for counterexamples, manually validates each candidate, and traces validated counterexamples back to the claims they contradict. We evaluate LEST using the system cards of Claude Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 with 97 seed prompts from SORRY-Bench across Mental Health and Self-Harm, Harmful and Violent Content, and Fairness and Bias. Of 56 identified safety claims, 29 (51.8%) are prompt-testable, but only 17 (58.6%) are exercised by an applicable benchmark prompt. Both models refuse >95% of benchmark prompts. Evaluating 1,836 mutated prompts on both models reveals 312 candidate Refuse-to-Comply transitions flagged by automated response classifiers. However, human validation confirms only 19 (6.1%) as both intent-preserving and genuinely compliant, showing automated evaluation substantially overestimates behavioral failures. Tracing these 19 transitions back to the claims reveals counterexamples for 6 of 9 covered claims for which refusal is an applicable oracle. Our results show that benchmark prompts may not be sufficient to validate all documented LLM safety behavior, and automated failure detection requires manual validation. LEST provides end-to-end traceability from natural-language safety documentation to executable tests and human-validated counterexamples.

</details>


### [912] [Taylor-Approximation-Based Repair of High Floating-Point Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14444)
*Xin Yi,Liqian Chen,Hengbiao Yu,Shangwen Wang,Tao Tang,Chun Huang,Xiaoguang Mao,Ji Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NPTaylor：基于 Taylor 近似的框架，修复数值 C 例程中的局部高浮点误差，通过搜索 Taylor 阶数、展开中心、分段与浮点求值策略生成带守卫的 C 补丁，在 GSL 基准上比 AutoRNP 更快、更紧凑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数值库在局部病态输入（如根、极点、相消点、分支边界）上仍会丢失大量精度，需要针对局部高浮点误差的修复方法。

Method: 给定高误差输入、局部修复域、高精度 oracle 和误差阈值，NPTaylor 搜索 Taylor 阶数、展开中心、分段与浮点求值策略，生成带守卫的 C 补丁：修复域内使用生成的 Taylor 求值器，域外回退原例程；候选补丁需在记录的局部样本、守卫端点及修复前峰值输入上验证；求值器采用系数分裂与补偿 Horner 求值降低补丁自身舍入误差。

Result: 在 GSL 基准上，38 个单输入函数、三个精度阈值共 114 个配置，NPTaylor 与 AutoRNP 均全部修复；NPTaylor 离线修复时间几何平均快 3.33 倍，生成 C 字节数为 0.162 倍；最严格设置下中位修复时间 3.74s，AutoRNP 为 81.97s；并修复了超出 AutoRNP 单输入工作流的局部多输入基准案例。

Conclusion: 基于 Taylor 的守卫补丁可提供紧凑、高效的局部修复，但结论是验证相对的，而非全域证明。

Abstract: Numerical libraries can still lose many bits of accuracy on localized ill-conditioned inputs, such as roots, poles, cancellation points, and branch boundaries. This paper presents NPTaylor, a Taylor-approximation-based framework for repairing localized high floating-point errors in numerical C routines. Given a high-error input, a localized repair domain, a high-precision oracle, and an error threshold, NPTaylor searches over Taylor degree, expansion center, segmentation, and floating-point evaluation strategy. It emits guarded C patches that use a generated Taylor evaluator inside the repair domain and fall back to the original routine outside it. Candidate patches are accepted only after validating the emitted C code on recorded local samples, guard endpoints, and the pre-repair peak input. The generated evaluator uses coefficient splitting and compensated Horner evaluation to reduce rounding error introduced by the patch itself.
  We evaluate NPTaylor on GSL benchmark workloads. On 38 one-input functions, both NPTaylor and AutoRNP repair all 114 configurations across three accuracy thresholds. NPTaylor is 3.33x faster by geometric-mean offline repair time and emits 0.162x as many C bytes. In the strictest setting, its median repair time is 3.74s versus 81.97s for AutoRNP. NPTaylor also repairs localized multi-input benchmark cases beyond AutoRNP's implemented one-input workflow. These results show that Taylor-based guarded patches can provide compact, efficient local repairs, while the claims remain validation-relative rather than full-domain proofs.

</details>


### [913] [Re-executing Coding-Agent Evaluations: Unchanged Decisions and Unresolved Policy Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14460)
*Tianyu Ding,Yaocheng Tong,Muzhi Yang,Fei Jiang,Lei Yang,Boya Yu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 两项预注册的复现研究考察LLM编程智能体补丁评测的可靠性，均得到负面结果：SWE-bench Pro v1的离线选项未能识别任何一篇被接受但评测配置发生变化的补丁（59篇Go补丁），DARWIN Gödel Machine存档的复评虽保持了选择与排名结论，但暴露出判定的可复现性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可执行测试是LLM编程智能体补丁用于排行榜、奖励与自我改进的核心判据，但其评测结果是否稳定、可复现尚缺乏严格检验，因此作者通过预注册的复现研究检验评测器与存档判定的可靠性。

Method: 开展两项预注册的复评（re-execution）研究：其一，对SWE-bench Pro v1中59篇通过且评测配置被修改的Go补丁执行离线选项检验，并使用逆抽样概率加权的预注册估计量（另辅以候选独立假设下未加权置信上限）；其二，对Darwin Gödel Machine存档中的1929个智能体-版本/任务评测进行重跑，比较最佳智能体选择与系统变体排序，并做主机、镜像及改编评分器的探索性对比，另在选定分层中用依据参考解依赖重建的模块缓存复评四个模型的替代方案。

Result: 离线选项未拒绝任何一篇配置被改动的Go补丁；在候选独立假设下探索性未加权置信上限为4.95%，仍有3%的暴露补丁风险未解决，扩展实验无定论。依据参考解依赖重建的缓存拒绝了四个模型中被接受的替代方案（这些方案在自己的依赖下原本通过）。1929个重跑评测保持了最佳智能体选择与变体排序（未重跑评测的历史与分数固定），主机、镜像与改编评分器对比结果亦保持一致；但23项与存档判定不一致中有7项在第二主机上未复现，重建镜像在四CPU执行下改变了16个三跑多数判定（0.83%）。

Conclusion: 评测器与存档判定存在可复现性缺口：配置敏感的离线检验未能暴露问题，缓存依赖差异可导致误拒，镜像与主机差异会改变少数判定。作者给出证据到结论的对照总结、评分器审计经验及匿名复现包；结论仅适用于已接受补丁与固定历史决策，通用策略安全与自适应学习鲁棒性仍需更广泛评估。

Abstract: Executable tests grade large language model (LLM) coding-agent patches for leaderboards, rewards and self-improvement. Two preregistered re-execution studies returned negative results. SWE-bench Pro v1's offline option rejected none of 59 accepted Go patches whose grading configuration changed. Their exploratory, unweighted upper confidence limit is 4.95% under candidate independence, leaving a 3% exposed-patch risk unresolved; the preregistered estimator uses inverse sampling-probability weights. An extension was inconclusive. In a selected stratum, a reconstructed module cache built from the reference solution's dependencies rejected accepted alternatives from four models that passed with their own dependencies. Re-executing 1,929 selected agent-version/task evaluations from the Darwin Gödel Machine's archive preserved best-agent selection and system-variant ranking, with search history and scores of evaluations not rerun fixed. Exploratory host, image and adapted-grader comparisons also preserved them. Seven of 23 disagreements with archived verdicts did not recur on a second host; rebuilt images changed 16 three-run majority verdicts (0.83%) under four-CPU execution. We provide an evidence-to-claim summary, lessons for grader audits and an anonymous replication package. These results concern accepted patches and fixed-history decisions; general policy safety and adaptive-learning robustness require broader evaluations.

</details>


### [914] [Rethinking SZZ Search Strategies: Lessons from Claude Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14462)
*Inase Kondo,Masanari Kondo,Daniel M. German,Olivier Nourry,Yasutaka Kamei,Yoshiki Higo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探究不依赖代码追踪的搜索策略能否提升缺陷引入提交（BIC）识别效果。允许Claude Code在Git仓库中自主调查，在79个Java案例上F1达0.771，显著优于十个SZZ基线；修正数据集标注问题后F1升至0.938。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SZZ方法多依赖代码追踪，即从缺陷修复提交（BFC）中被修改的代码回溯查找BIC。但当引入缺陷的代码与修复缺陷所修改的代码不一致时，这类方法会漏掉真正的BIC，因而准确率受限。

Method: 不预设搜索流程、也不提供预定义候选提交，而是让编码智能体Claude Code在Git仓库中自主调查；在来自70个仓库的79个Java案例上评估其识别准确率与搜索行为，并与十个SZZ基线对比，同时开展失败分析并重构评估数据集。

Result: 在79.7%的运行中，Claude Code先审阅提交历史再查看具体代码差异，并利用提交信息挑选需细查的变更；其F1为0.771，显著优于全部十个SZZ基线。失败分析发现数据集存在错误的oracle标签及BIC定义歧义；修正后可获F1 0.938。

Conclusion: 改进SZZ搜索策略的关键经验是：先用语义信息定位相关提交，再检查其代码变更，而非直接以代码追踪为起点。

Abstract: Identifying bug-inducing commits (BICs) is important for studying software bugs and maintaining software, yet the accuracy of existing SZZ methods remains limited. Although various improvements have been proposed, many SZZ methods still rely on code tracing, which searches for BICs by tracing code changed in a bug-fixing commit (BFC) back to earlier commits. However, this approach may miss the actual BIC when the code responsible for introducing a bug differs from the code modified to fix it. To overcome this limitation, we investigate whether BIC identification can be improved by exploring search strategies that are not constrained to start with code tracing. We use Claude Code, a coding agent that has demonstrated high BIC identification accuracy in prior research, to explore such strategies. Rather than prescribing a search process or providing predefined candidate commits, we allow Claude Code to independently investigate a Git repository. We evaluate its identification accuracy and search behavior on 79 Java cases from 70 repositories. In 79.7% of runs, Claude Code reviewed commit histories before inspecting individual code diffs. It used commit messages to select changes for closer inspection. With this approach, Claude Code achieves an F1 score of 0.771, significantly outperforming all ten evaluated SZZ baselines. Our failure analysis also reveals incorrect oracle labels and ambiguities in BIC definitions in the studied evaluation dataset. After reconstructing the evaluation dataset to address these issues, Claude Code achieves an F1 score of 0.938. A key lesson from Claude Code for improving SZZ search strategies is to use semantic information to find relevant commits and then examine their code changes, rather than starting with code tracing.

</details>


### [915] [When Is a Reconciliation Break Real? A Temporal Correctness Contract for Streaming Financial Reconciliation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14470)
*Abhishek Sharma*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种时序正确性契约（temporal correctness contract），用于规范异步支付对账系统在部分证据下作出"资金缺失"判定的合法时机，并给出无需真实标签的检查器；实验证明该检查器可区分对账器过早判定、输入违反延迟界、资金真正丢失三类情形，且可用SQL表达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步流上的对账决策基于部分证据：未出现的入账可能是真的缺失，也可能只是尚未入账。现有部署管线用超时或水位线（watermark）来裁定，并把异常当作findings，但无法区分"对账器判早了""输入违反声明的延迟界""钱真的没了"这三种成因，运营者只能看到不断上升的break rate。

Method: 1) 提出时序正确性契约：在声明的每源延迟上界（per-source lateness bound）下，规定何种判定是可接受的；2) 设计无需ground truth的检查器；3) 在已发表支付模拟器的工作负载上，测试标准补救措施（idleness timeout）、四种基于identity的对账器、每源单一horizon、以及普通方式编写的Apache Flink interval join；4) 将该契约表达为对账系统已有表上的SQL，并与参考实现比对。

Result: 1) idleness timeout在5.42%的义务上引入契约违例（95% CI [3.94, 6.92]），而在无超时的同一作业上完全sound；当超时达到慢源的posting period时违例消失；2) 在延迟漂移下，四种对账器对银行已结算的入账产生18.3%–23.0%的虚假break，但其契约违例率≤1.01%，检查器将损失归因于240个银行侧和413个账本侧延迟界违例；3) 每源单一horizon平均降低break延迟12.7%，p99减半（224 vs 446 ticks），但并非在每个成本设置下都更便宜；4) 普通编写的Flink interval join在14.9%–20.1%的义务上违反契约；5) SQL表达与参考实现在全部4,395个判定上一致。

Conclusion: 时序正确性契约将运营者原本只能视为break rate上升的现象，分解为对账器过早判定、输入违反延迟界、资金真正丢失三类可归因原因；检查器无需ground truth即可运作，并可表达为SQL部署于既有对账表上，为异步流对账提供了可验证的正确性保证。

Abstract: Reconciliation systems decide, continuously, whether money the ledger expected has arrived at the bank. On an asynchronous stream that decision is taken against partial evidence: a credit that has not appeared may be missing, or may simply not have been posted yet. Deployed pipelines settle this with a timeout or a watermark, and the exceptions are treated as findings. We give a temporal correctness contract that says when such a verdict is admissible, relative to a declared per-source lateness bound, and a checker for it that needs no ground truth. The contract separates three things an operator otherwise sees only as a rising break rate: the reconciler decided too early, an input broke the bound it declared, or the money really is gone. On workloads from a published payment simulator, the standard remedy for a stalled streaming join, an idleness timeout, introduces contract violations on 5.42% of obligations (95% CI [3.94, 6.92]) on traffic where the same job without it is exactly sound, and violations vanish once the timeout reaches the slow source's posting period, as predicted. Under a lateness shift, all four identity-based reconcilers we test raise spurious breaks on between 18.3% and 23.0% of the credits the bank did settle, while their contract violation rate stays at or below 1.01%: the checker attributes the loss to 240 bank-side and 413 ledger-side bound violations rather than to the reconcilers. Tracking one horizon per source leaves break latency 12.7% lower on average and halves its tail (p99 224 against 446 ticks) at equal soundness, though it is not cheaper at every cost setting and we report where it loses. An Apache Flink interval join, written the ordinary way, violates the contract on 14.9--20.1% of obligations. The contract is expressible as SQL over the tables a reconciliation system already keeps, agreeing with the reference implementation on all 4,395 verdicts.

</details>


### [916] [What Counts as the Same Task? Executable Contracts for Robustness Evaluation of Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14477)
*Shaikh Akib Shahriyar,MD. Akil Raihan Iftee,Armon Barton,Matthew Wright*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出"可执行任务契约"（executable task contracts）作为工具使用型智能体鲁棒性测试中判断修改后测试用例有效性的方法，并通过对比实验证明现有弱规则（嵌入阈值、格式规则）在区分"改变任务"与"有效对抗笔记"上存在严重缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型智能体的鲁棒性测试通常通过修改环境（例如在发票中隐藏恶意笔记）来评估智能体行为，但只有当修改后的测试用例仍是原任务的有效测试时，结果才有意义。现有评估多用弱规则判定有效性，例如接受任何格式良好的编辑，或接受嵌入空间中接近原文的编辑，这可能导致误判任务的同一性，从而使结论不可靠。

Method: 提出可执行任务契约：契约明确规定定义任务的事实、允许的编辑以及任务完成的含义，并在智能体运行前对每个修改后的用例进行校验。用同一批14,336条存储的智能体运行记录，在四种编码器下比较不同有效性规则的评分表现，包括嵌入阈值法、重放已保存解法、以及允许修改基准字段等方法。

Result: 在四种编码器下，嵌入阈值允许了75%-100%实际上改变任务的编辑（如替换收款人），却拒绝了24%-45%的有效恶意笔记。使用MiniLM余弦阈值时，Mistral在全部64个任务上看似脆弱，但实际只有26个任务存在成功的有效攻击。重放保存解法与允许修改基准字段也会以类似方式失败。

Conclusion: 鲁棒性评估必须明确声明并校验"什么算作同一任务"，弱有效性规则会系统性高估或低估智能体的脆弱性，可执行任务契约提供了更严格、可验证的替代方案。

Abstract: Robustness tests for tool-using agents often change the agent's environment, for example by hiding a hostile note in an invoice, and then judge the agent by what it does. The result tells us about the original task only if the changed test case is still a valid test of that task. Many evaluations decide this with weak rules, such as accepting any well-formed edit or any edit that stays close to the original in embedding space. We propose executable task contracts. A contract states which facts define a task, which edits are allowed, and what finishing the task means, and it checks each changed test case before the agent runs. We compare validity rules by scoring the same 14,336 stored agent runs under each rule. Across four encoders, embedding thresholds allowed 75-100% of edits that changed the task, such as swapping the payee, yet rejected 24-45% of valid hostile notes. With a MiniLM cosine threshold, Mistral appeared vulnerable on all 64 tasks, but only 26 had a successful valid attack. Replaying a saved solution and allowing edits to benchmark fields fail in similar ways. Evaluations should state, and check, what counts as the same task.

</details>


### [917] [LASER: Defeasible Certificate Search for Long-Range Protocol Dependencies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14552)
*Zihan Tang,Huibiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: LASER是一种"证明携带"的稀疏可废止协议证据检索方法，将缺失支撑与未决更正显式表示为义务，由符号检查器判定行为是否被判证、被反驳或未决；在91个BehaviorCheck家族上以2K预算显著优于最强局部阅读器，并将虚假发现减少2–3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协议规范很少在单处为可执行行为提供依据：某状态转换可能从远程控制块继承源状态、事件仅以编号命名、且随后可能被更正。因此仅检索相邻条款不够，系统需要组装带来源链接的证明证书，并判断是否有更强规则适用。此前的检索或整篇阅读方法无法处理这种稀疏、可废止、长距离依赖的证据。

Method: LASER将缺失支撑与未解决更正建模为显式义务，搜索带类型的证据路径；是否判证、反驳或留作未决，仅由出现感知（occurrence-aware）的符号检查器裁决。消融与对照包括：参考路由、确定性引证扩展、整篇文档阅读（29–65K tokens）、两轮迭代检索以及oracle最小证书证据；另设权限损坏回放。

Result: 在匹配2K预算下于91个BehaviorCheck家族上，LASER在两个模型家族上提升Joint Edge+Proof（Δ=+.132，p=.017；Δ=+.198，p<.001），同时将虚假发现减少2–3倍。对照显示：参考路由与确定性引证扩展均未超过局部基线；整篇阅读、两轮迭代检索、oracle最小证书证据均未达到LASER，说明瓶颈在带类型义务闭合而非证据获取。权限损坏回放中，来源链接错误仅导致弃权；唯一不安全判证机制是把Held勘误误记为Verified，且仅限于该勘误所属家族。

Conclusion: LASER改善了长距离依赖恢复，并把不完整证据与不确定权威转化为显式残余义务，而非无依据行为；其优势来源被定位到带类型义务闭合机制。

Abstract: Protocol specifications rarely justify executable behavior in one place: a transition may inherit its source state from a remote control block, name its events only by number, and remain subject to a later correction. Recovering the nearby clause is therefore insufficient; the system must assemble a source-linked certificate and determine whether any stronger rule applies. We introduce LASER, a proof-carrying search method for sparse, defeasible protocol evidence. LASER represents missing support and unresolved corrections as explicit obligations, searches typed evidence routes, and lets an occurrence-aware symbolic checker alone decide whether a certificate warrants, refutes, or leaves a behavior unresolved. On 91 BehaviorCheck families under a matched 2K budget, LASER improves Joint Edge+Proof over the strongest local reader on two model families ($Δ=+.132$, $p=.017$; $Δ=+.198$, $p<.001$) while cutting false discoveries by 2--3$\times$. Controlled replays attribute the gain and its limits: neither reference routing nor deterministic citation expansion alone exceeds the local baseline; whole-document reading (29--65K tokens), two-round iterative retrieval, and even oracle minimal-certificate evidence all fail to reach LASER, localizing the bottleneck in typed obligation closure rather than evidence access. An authority-corruption replay shows source-link errors only cause abstention, while the only unsafe-warrant mechanism is mis-recording a Held erratum as Verified, confined to that erratum's family. LASER thus improves long-range dependency recovery while converting incomplete evidence and uncertain authority into explicit residual obligations rather than unsupported behavior.

</details>


### [918] [Executable but Unfaithful: Mock Object, Stub, and Assertion Generation by LLMs and Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14629)
*Hao Ning,Jiahui Dong,Zhen Yang,Guanda Yan,Yichen Sun,Xuanyu Zhu,Zheng Shen,Yifei Pei,Jacky Keung,Jie M. Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文构建了MockBench基准（165个来自真实Java/Python项目的mock工件生成任务），系统评估了6个LLM与3个编码智能体在可执行性、行为保真度与交互故障检测能力上的表现，并分析660个失败案例，归纳出10类错误类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mock是单元测试的基础实践，自动生成mock对象、stub与mock断言是长期研究目标。capture-and-replay方法依赖真实依赖的运行时记录，演化方法（如StubCoder）虽无需记录但受限于预定义符号池。LLM与编码智能体可从源码生成mock工件而无需执行记录或固定符号池，但目前尚无系统性研究评估其在三类mock工件上的能力，存在研究空白。

Method: 构建MockBench基准，包含165个源自真实Java与Python项目的mock工件生成任务，并提供经过验证的参考mock对象、stub与mock断言。评估6个LLM和3个编码智能体，维度涵盖可执行性、行为保真度与交互故障检测能力，并与现有工具对比，辅以敏感性分析；同时对LLM与智能体产生的660个失败案例进行错误分类分析。

Result: 实验表明LLM与编码智能体已成为基于mock的测试中的最先进技术。相较LLM，编码智能体显著提升可执行性，但该提升并未稳定转化为更高的行为保真度或更强的交互故障检测能力。通过对660个失败案例的分析，识别出跨三类工件的10种错误类型，揭示了可通过测试却掩盖的行为偏差。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了mock工件生成面临的挑战，指出仅凭可执行性与测试通过不足以反映行为正确性，并为开发者与研究者提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Mocking is a foundational practice in unit testing, enabling developers to isolate the code under test by replacing real dependencies with simulated alternatives. Automating the generation of mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions has been a long-standing research goal. However, capture-and-replay approaches rely on recording the runtime behavior of actual dependencies. Evolutionary approaches such as StubCoder overcome this requirement but constrain generation to predefined symbol pools. Large language models (LLMs) and coding agents offer an alternative by generating mocking artifacts from source code without requiring recorded dependency executions or fixed symbol pools. Yet, no systematic study has evaluated their capabilities across all three artifact types.
  To address this gap, we construct MockBench, a benchmark comprising 165 mock artifact generation tasks from real-world Java and Python projects, with validated reference mock objects, stubs, and mock assertions. We evaluate six LLMs and three coding agents in terms of executability, behavior fidelity, and interaction-fault detection capability, complemented by comparisons with existing tools and sensitivity analysis. Experimental results show that LLMs and coding agents indeed have been the state-of-the-art techniques in mock-based testing. More specifically, compared with LLMs, coding agents substantially improve executability, while these gains do not consistently translate into higher behavior fidelity or better interaction-fault detection. Furthermore, we analyze 660 failures from LLMs and coding agents, and identify ten error types across the three artifact categories, revealing behavioral deviations that passing tests can conceal. Our findings highlight the challenges of mock artifact generation and provide practical guidance for both developers and researchers.

</details>


### [919] [Does Failure Feedback Direct Agent Self-Modification?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14662)
*Rong He*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究检验“自改进智能体”是否真正实现了针对特定失败目标的定向修复与泛化。对公开 Darwin Gödel Machine 日志中145项合格修改的分析未发现可检测的目标特异性优势；受控指令修订实验显示相关反馈可提升目标修复（Qwen3-4B 提升20个百分点，Phi-4-mini 的7个百分点不显著），但目标修复并不稳定带来留出集改进，留出集增益集中于具有可识别、可修复失败机制的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自改进智能体利用失败反馈修改代码或指令，但“选择后被保留”的增益并不能证明其针对特定目标进行了修复或实现了泛化。因此需要区分定向修复、相关失败迁移与留出集净变化，以检验自改进是否真实有效。

Method: 1）以“随机选定目标失败的修复”对比“父代其他失败的修复”来度量定向性，分析公开 Darwin Gödel Machine 日志中145项合格修改；2）用小规模开源模型进行受控指令修订实验；3）开展带预注册分析计划的第二项研究，比较目标反馈与匹配的同类别反馈；4）比较编辑定位、回归筛选、八步修订循环与GEPA等不同设置下的留出集准确率。

Result: 在145项合格修改中未发现可检测的目标特异性优势。受控指令修订实验中，相关反馈可改善目标修复；在预注册研究里，目标反馈使Qwen3-4B的修复率相对匹配同类别反馈提高20个百分点，Phi-4-mini提高7个百分点但不显著。目标修复不能可靠地推断留出集改进。留出集增益集中于具有可识别、可修复失败机制的场景，如植入错误和自然工具接口失败。编辑定位与回归筛选的收益因设置而异；八步修订循环与GEPA的最终平均留出集准确率相近。

Conclusion: 自改进的收益不足以证明目标特异性修复或可靠泛化。评估应分别报告目标修复、对相关失败的迁移以及留出集净变化三项指标。

Abstract: Self-improving agents use failure feedback to revise their code or instructions, but gains after selection do not establish target-specific repair or generalization. We measure directedness by comparing repair of a randomly selected target failure with repair of the parent's other failures. Across 145 eligible modifications in public Darwin Gödel Machine logs, we find no detectable target-specific advantage. Controlled instruction-revision experiments with small open models show that relevant feedback can improve target repair. In a second study with a pre-specified analysis plan, target feedback raised repair by 20 percentage points for Qwen3-4B relative to matched same-category feedback; the 7-point increase for Phi-4-mini was not significant. Target repair did not reliably imply held-out improvement. Held-out gains were concentrated in settings with identifiable, repairable failure mechanisms, including planted errors and natural tool-interface failures. Benefits of edit localization and regression screening varied across settings, while eight-step revision loops and GEPA ended at similar mean held-out accuracy. Evaluations should report target repair, transfer to related failures, and held-out net change separately.

</details>


### [920] [TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14740)
*Xinyu Xiao,Zihe Song,Dezhi Ran,Wei Yang,Tao Xie*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出 TileCas——一个统一、可插拔的抽象层接口,使编码智能体能够在多个可编辑的抽象层级间开发 GPU/AI 加速器内核,通过跨层诊断、抽象调度和异构搜索树显著提升内核生成性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统编程抽象为人类设计,而如今代码生成越来越多由模型和自主智能体完成。高层 DSL 简化搜索但将实现细节委托给编译器,低层表示提供细粒度控制却带来更大更复杂的搜索空间。单一表示难以兼顾两者,因此需要为机器驱动的编程设计合适抽象。

Method: TileCas 是一个统一、可插拔的接口,允许智能体跨多个可编辑抽象层级开发内核,而非固定于单一表示。其核心组件包括:(1) Cross-Level Diagnosis(跨层诊断),将正确性与性能反馈映射为不同抽象层级的可操作控制;(2) Abstraction Scheduling(抽象调度),选择后续细化所依据的候选与表示;(3) Heterogeneous Search Tree(异构搜索树),保存并回溯跨多个表示的替代搜索轨迹。

Result: 将 TileCas 与两个编码智能体 AKO 和 KDA 集成,在 50 个端到端 KernelBench Level 3 工作负载上、跨两个加速器平台和两个语言模型进行评估。对四种加速器-模型配置等权平均,AKO+TileCas 取得算术平均加速比 4.84×,而最强基线为 3.75×,提升 29.0%。KDA 集成后平均加速比提升 69.2%,且在所有配置中均有收益。

Conclusion: 允许编码智能体跨编程抽象进行导航,可提升机器驱动的软件开发,且该接口可复用于不同的基础工作流。

Abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. Rather than committing to a single representation, TileCas allows an agent to transfer and refine candidates across levels through Cross-Level Diagnosis, which maps correctness and performance feedback to actionable controls at different abstraction levels; Abstraction Scheduling, which selects both the candidate and representation from which subsequent refinement should proceed; and a Heterogeneous Search Tree, which preserves and revisits alternative search trajectories spanning multiple representations. We integrate TileCas with two code agents AKO and KDA, and evaluate both integrations on 50 end-to-end KernelBench Level 3 workloads across two accelerator platforms and two language models. Giving equal weight to the four accelerator-model configurations, AKO with TileCas achieves an arithmetic-mean speedup of $4.84\times$, compared with $3.75\times$ for the strongest evaluated baseline without TileCas, an improvement of 29.0%. Integrating the same interface with KDA improves its mean speedup by 69.2%, with gains in every configuration. These results show that allowing coding agents to navigate across programming abstractions can improve machine-driven software development and can be reused across different base workflows.

</details>


### [921] [Do Modifications Made by Coding Agents Make Subsequent Software Maintenance Harder?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14768)
*Ruwei Pan,John Zhang,Linhao Wu,Yakun Zhang,Hongyu Zhang,Lu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 SWE-Maintain 基准，包含来自 50 个真实 Python 仓库的 100 个三事件维护序列，通过 Developer-History 与 Agent-History 的配对对比，发现智能体自写代码使后续任务解决率平均下降 5.6 个百分点，若要求累积测试全通过则差距达 14.0 百分点；主要成本来自继承的测试失败，而非代码本身的可维护性缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准要么从开发者编写的代码开始任务，要么无法将后续任务难度与智能体早期改动的影响分离开来。论文关注两个问题：智能体编写的代码是否使后续维护更难，以及这种代价究竟源自继承的测试失败，还是代码本身。

Method: 构建 SWE-Maintain 基准，含 50 个真实 Python 仓库的 100 个三事件维护序列，每个序列的隐藏测试均经过认证。每个后续任务由同一智能体和同一套测试评估两次：一次从开发者先前补丁出发（Developer-History），一次从智能体自身改动出发（Agent-History）。实验覆盖 5 个编码系统、2 个骨干模型、1,996 个配对的后续事件。

Result: Agent-History 使后续任务解决率平均下降 5.6 个百分点；当额外要求此前所有测试通过时，差距扩大到 14.0 个百分点。三分之二的 Agent-History 起始仓库已无法通过先前测试，且从这些状态出发的事件中仅有 1.9% 最终能使全部累积测试通过。当继承代码通过先前测试且下一任务尚未被解决时，劣势消失（+2.7 个百分点，95% CI [-0.5, +6.1]）。

Conclusion: 智能体改动的下游主要代价在于继承的测试失败，而非在保持既有已测行为的代码中存在可测量的维护劣势。因此，评测应纳入智能体产生的历史，编码智能体也应在改动中保持既有行为。

Abstract: Coding agents increasingly maintain repositories over time, where each change becomes the starting point for subsequent tasks. Yet existing benchmarks either start tasks from developer-written code or cannot separate later-task difficulty from the effects of an agent's earlier changes. We ask whether agent-written code makes subsequent maintenance harder and whether the cost stems from inherited test failures or the code itself. We introduce SWE-Maintain, comprising 100 three-event maintenance episodes from 50 real-world Python repositories, with hidden tests certified across each sequence. Each later task is evaluated twice with the same agent and tests: from the developers' preceding patches (Developer-History) and from the agent's own changes (Agent-History). Across five coding systems, two backbone models, and 1,996 paired later events, Agent-History reduces later-task resolution by 5.6 percentage points on average. When success additionally requires all earlier tests to pass, the gap reaches 14.0 points. Two-thirds of Agent-History starting repositories already fail earlier tests, and only 1.9% of events starting from those states end with all accumulated tests passing. When the inherited code passes earlier tests and the next task is not already solved, the disadvantage disappears (+2.7 points; 95% CI [-0.5, +6.1]). These findings suggest that the main downstream cost of agent-written changes lies in inherited test failures rather than a measurable maintenance disadvantage in code that preserves earlier tested behavior. Evaluations should therefore include agent-produced history, and coding agents should preserve earlier behavior across changes.

</details>


### [922] [Testuary: Agentic Test Generation with Zero-Shot Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14808)
*Kevin Kammler,Dominik Sobania*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Testuary通过并行的零样本请求生成多套初始测试，经确定性检查修复与结构合并，再用运行时加权的集合覆盖约简冗余，最后用两个智能体阶段补齐覆盖率和变异分数缺口，在更少模型请求下实现更小更快的测试套件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有面向自动化测试生成的智能体方法虽能获得高质量结果，但采用增量改进策略：若初始测试套件质量弱，会导致大量迭代或测试不足。因此需要一个更好的起始点来提升智能体阶段的效率与效果。

Method: Testuary首先通过独立的并行零样本请求生成多个测试套件，对其进行确定性检查与修复，并用新颖的结构化合并方法整合为单一套件；随后采用运行时加权的集合覆盖约简去除冗余测试，同时不损失已覆盖的行、分支或被杀死变异体；最后两个智能体阶段针对剩余覆盖率与变异分数缺口进行补足。

Result: 与主流搜索式和LLM测试生成方法对比：仅非智能体第一阶段就已显著超越当前最先进方法；加入智能体阶段后，Testuary平均达到超过99.9%的行覆盖率和分支覆盖率，以及98.6%的变异分数，显著优于所有基线；同时所需模型请求更少，测试套件平均更小、运行更快。

Conclusion: 为智能体测试生成提供高质量起始点并结合确定性合并、约简与针对性智能体补足，可在显著减少模型请求的前提下实现更高覆盖率、更高变异分数以及更小更快的测试套件，全面优于既有搜索式和LLM基线方法。

Abstract: Agentic approaches for automated test generation can reach high-quality results, but they improve a given test suite incrementally, so a weak starting point may lead to many iterations or insufficient tests. To address this, we present Testuary, which provides the agentic phases with an improved starting point. Testuary first generates multiple test suites through independent, parallel zero-shot requests, checks and repairs them deterministically, and combines them into a single suite with a novel structural merging approach. A runtime-weighted set-cover reduction removes redundant tests without losing covered lines, branches, or killed mutants. After that, two agentic phases target the remaining gaps in coverage and mutation score. We compare Testuary with established search and LLM-based test generation approaches. The non-agentic first phase alone already significantly outperforms the current state-of-the-art. After the agentic phases, Testuary achieves on average more than 99.9% line and branch coverage as well as a mutation score of 98.6%, significantly outperforming all compared baseline approaches. Testuary needs fewer model requests and its test suites are on average smaller and faster than those of the compared agentic approach.

</details>


### [923] [AI-Native Product Management: A Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14823)
*Ricardo Britto*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探讨在AI原生研发提升软件交付能力的背景下，产品管理应如何被重新构想。作者综合软件产品管理、产品学习、人机协作及产品管理与研发边界的研究，提出让AI成为产品工作中持续参与者的愿景，覆盖感知、探索、决策、实现与学习五个环节，并给出六项原则与基于人类专业人员、AI角色、智能体、技能和共享产品上下文的运营模型，进而提出四条需实证研究的AI专属方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI正日益用于支持产品管理任务，而AI原生研发可能提升软件实现能力，导致组织实现软件的速度快于其识别、筛选与反思"该实现什么"的速度，由此产生产品管理定位上的错配问题，促使作者追问产品管理应如何被重新构想。

Method: 概念性/愿景构建研究。通过综合软件产品管理、产品学习、人机协作以及产品管理与研发边界四个领域的既有研究，提出愿景、原则与运营模型，而非开展实证验证。

Result: 提出一项将AI视为产品工作持续参与者的愿景，覆盖感知、探索、决策、实现、学习；提出六项原则；构建以人类专业人员、AI角色（personas）、智能体、技能及共享产品上下文为基础的运营模型；论证AI原生产品管理与AI原生研发可构成连续的产品学习过程；并识别出四个亟待实证研究的AI专属方向。

Conclusion: 在AI原生研发条件下，产品管理需从间歇性人工决策转向AI持续参与的产品学习闭环；AI原生产品管理与AI原生研发的融合可形成连续的产品学习过程，但该愿景尚需针对所提出的四个AI专属方向开展实证检验。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to support product management tasks. At the same time, AI-native research and development (R&D) may increase software realization capacity. Organizations may realize software faster than they can identify, qualify, and reconsider what should be realized. This paper asks how product management should be re-envisioned under these conditions. We synthesize research on software product management, product learning, human-AI collaboration, and the Product Management and R&D boundary. We propose a vision in which AI becomes a persistent participant in product work. The vision covers sensing, exploration, decision-making, realization, and learning. We propose six principles and make the vision tangible through an operating model grounded in human professionals, AI personas, agents, skills, and a shared product context. We further argue that AI-native Product Management and AI-native R&D can form a continuous product-learning process. Finally, we identify four AI-specific research directions that require empirical investigation.

</details>


### [924] [Humans vs. Machines: A Comparison With AI Agents in Software Reverse Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14960)
*Samuele Doria,Stefano De Rosa,Ruoyu Wang,Zion Leonahenahe Basque,Eleonora Losiouk,Simone Aonzo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对比人类分析师与9个LLM智能体在两项静态分析逆向工程任务上的表现，发现顶尖智能体已达人类水平，但两者工作流不同（人类反复回访函数，智能体呈现"贪婪抓取"），且上下文窗口限制是规模化瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自主AI智能体能否像熟练人类分析师一样进行二进制逆向工程、是否采用相同策略，以及能否扩展到真实世界程序，从而评估LLM在软件逆向工程（SRE）中的竞争力与局限性。

Method: 设置两项紧凑的静态分析挑战任务，由9个模型与人类分析师共同攻克，采用统一的理解评分标准打分，并完整记录智能体与IDA Pro的交互过程，以对比恢复结果与调查行为；同时开展消融实验考察代码表示与工作流需求的影响，并在4000个真实二进制上测量上下文窗口饱和度。

Result: 最强智能体（GPT-5.5 Pro、Claude Opus 4.8、Kimi K3）在两任务上达到统计学意义上与人类相当的理解水平，弱模型差距明显。差距取决于代码表示与工作流需求而非模型能力本身：开放权重模型在更丰富代码表示下显著提升，前沿模型无显著变化。相似成功率背后工作流不同：人类反复回访函数、遵循局部程序结构；强智能体则跨二进制跳跃、广泛检索、很少回访，即"贪婪抓取"。提供语义更丰富的代码时智能体抓取减少且不失理解。4000个真实二进制测量显示，大窗口可容纳多数程序，但大型应用与低层表示会迅速耗尽窗口。

Conclusion: 自主逆向工程正变得具有竞争力且具显著速度优势，但规模化需要更好的导航、选择性检索与持久化的分析状态，而非仅扩大上下文窗口。

Abstract: Can an autonomous AI agent reverse engineer a binary as well as a skilled human analyst? Do they adopt the same strategy, and can agents scale to real-world programs? We compare human and LLM-based software reverse engineering (SRE): nine models tackle two compact static-analysis challenges previously solved by human analysts, scored with a common understanding rubric, and we record their complete interactions with IDA Pro. This lets us compare not only what humans and agents recover, but also how they investigate a binary. The best agents (GPT-5.5 Pro, Claude Opus 4.8, and Kimi K3) achieve statistically human-competitive understanding on both tasks, while weaker models remain far behind. Ablations show that the gap depends on code representation and workflow demands, not on model capability alone: open-weight models improve substantially with richer code representations, whereas frontier models show no significant change. Similar success rates hide different workflows. Humans repeatedly revisit functions and follow local program structure; strong agents jump across the binary, retrieve information broadly, and rarely return to inspected code, a behavior we call greedy fetching. This strategy is not fixed: given semantically richer code, agents fetch less without losing understanding. Because greedy fetching aggregates large amounts of code in the agent's context, we measure context-window saturation across 4,000 real-world binaries: large windows accommodate many programs, but larger applications and lower-level representations quickly exhaust them. Autonomous reverse engineering is becoming competitive, with a large speed advantage, but scaling it will require better navigation, selective retrieval, and persistent analysis state, not merely larger context windows.

</details>


### [925] [TurnCost: Turns, Not Observations: Cache-Aware Loop Engineering for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15093)
*Pramod Kumar,Raj Kumar Pandey*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 对600条公开编码智能体轨迹的实证分析表明：观测压缩与模型委派等主流效率优化机会有限，轮次数才是轨迹成本的主导因素，并发布重打分工具TurnCost。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体效率研究多聚焦于压缩工具观测或将部分轮次路由到更便宜的模型，但这些优化的实际收益空间缺乏数据支撑，作者希望量化"循环工程"（上下文管理、模型选择、压缩、终止）中各因素的相对重要性。

Method: 以"循环工程"为框架，分析跨2种智能体脚手架、2种语言模型的600条公开发布编码智能体轨迹；统计观测长度分布与输入token的缓存命中情况；推导并实验验证模型委派的闭式盈亏平衡条件；用回归比较轮次数与平均观测大小对轨迹对数成本的解释力；开发TurnCost工具。

Result: 观测中位数仅118–286 token，常用于论证压缩必要性的大型构建日志处于约第99百分位；98.6%的输入token由前缀缓存服务，在近理想缓存下扁平输入定价平均高估循环成本约7倍。模型委派在约一半评估设置中反而增加成本，与预测边界接近。轮次数解释了84%的轨迹对数成本方差，平均观测大小仅解释4%；最昂贵的轨迹轮次最多但观测反而最小。

Conclusion: 以观测为中心的方法针对的是次要成本因素，减少不必要的轮次是更大且基本未被探索的优化机会；但作者未证明在保持任务成功率不变的前提下可以移除轮次。发布TurnCost，用于在替代缓存、定价、压缩和路由策略下对轨迹语料重新打分。

Abstract: AI coding agents operate in iterative loops: they modify code, run tools, inspect the results, and decide what to do next. We call the design of this process loop engineering, which includes context management, model selection, compaction, and termination. Existing efficiency work mainly compresses tool observations or routes selected turns to cheaper models, but the practical opportunity for these optimizations remains unclear. We analyze 600 publicly released coding-agent trajectories spanning two agent scaffolds and two language models. Median observations contain only 118-286 tokens, while the large build logs commonly used to motivate compression occur near the ninety-ninth percentile. Moreover, 98.6% of input tokens are served from a prefix cache, so flat input pricing overestimates loop cost by roughly 7x on average under near-ideal caching.
  We derive and empirically validate a closed-form break-even condition for model delegation. Delegation increases cost in half of the evaluated settings, near the predicted boundary. More broadly, turn count explains 84% of the variance in log trajectory cost, compared with 4% for mean observation size; the most expensive trajectories have the most turns despite having the smallest observations. These associations suggest that observation-focused methods target a secondary cost factor, and identify unnecessary turns as the larger and largely unexamined opportunity, though we do not establish that turns can be removed while holding task success fixed. We release TurnCost, a tool for re-scoring trajectory corpora under alternative caching, pricing, compression, and routing policies.

</details>


### [926] [Verifying Autoware Controller Node by Combining Model Verification and Runtime Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15418)
*Daisuke Ishii*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合形式化模型验证与运行时监控的混合验证方法，针对Autoware轨迹跟随控制节点，在微分动态逻辑中建模并用KeYmaera X验证，同时通过仿真监控模型与实现的兼容性，实验表明监控可给出带精度界的目标跟随评估，实现的位置精度约0.2–0.4 m、速度精度约0.8 m/s。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶系统的形式化建模与验证面临运行空间庞大、控制逻辑复杂等挑战，单一验证手段难以兼顾模型层证明与实现层行为的一致性评估，因此需要模型验证与运行时监控结合的混合方法。

Method: 以开源自动驾驶平台Autoware的轨迹跟随控制节点为对象，将其形式化为微分动态逻辑（dL）中的混合系统，构建刻画核心控制动态的抽象模型，利用KeYmaera X证明助手验证模型的安全性与活性属性；并借助Autoware工具链在数值仿真中监控保证模型与实现兼容性的约束，量化实现行为被已验证模型涵盖的程度。

Result: 实验结果表明：(i) 监控能够对目标跟随给出可靠且带精度界的评估；(ii) Autoware实现到达目标的精度约为位置0.2–0.4 m、速度0.8 m/s。

Conclusion: 形式化模型验证与运行时监控相结合的混合验证框架可有效用于自动驾驶轨迹跟随控制器，既可在模型层证明安全与活性，又可量化实现层与模型的一致性，为自动驾驶系统的可信验证提供可行途径。

Abstract: Formal modeling and verification of autonomous driving systems remain challenging due to the vast operational space and the complexity of the control logic. We propose a hybrid verification approach that combines formal model verification and runtime monitoring for the trajectory-following control node of Autoware, an open-source autonomous driving platform. We formalize the controller as a hybrid system in differential dynamic logic (dL), and introduce an abstract model that captures the essential control dynamics. We then prove safety and liveness properties of the model using the KeYmaera X proof assistant. Complementarily, we monitor the constraints that assure the compatibility between the model and the Autoware implementation across numerical simulation runs using the Autoware toolchain, quantifying to what extent the implementation's behavior is subsumed by the verified model. The experimental results confirmed that (i) monitoring provides a sound evaluation of target following with accuracy bounds, and (ii) the Autoware implementation reaches the target with an accuracy of approximately 0.2-0.4 (m) in position and 0.8 (m/s) in velocity.

</details>


### [927] [PassSum: Leveraging Paths of Abstract Syntax Trees and Self-Supervision for Code Summarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15435)
*Changan Niu,Chuanyi Li,Vincent Ng,Jidong Ge,Liguo Huang,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出PassSum代码摘要方法，通过高效AST编码的输入表示与自监督预训练，解决现有方法AST编码低效和依赖大规模标注语料的问题，在Java、Python、Ruby上优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动代码摘要方法存在两大弱点：(1) AST编码效率低，导致模型过大、训练慢、信息损失和训练不稳定；(2) 依赖大规模标注语料，无法应用于仅有少量标注数据的编程语言。

Method: PassSum通过两方面改进：(1) 设计包含高效AST编码方法的新型输入表示；(2) 引入三个预训练目标，在自监督学习指导下利用大量易获取的无标注数据预训练模型。

Result: 在Java、Python和Ruby方法上的代码摘要实验表明PassSum优于当前最先进方法；输入表示在时间与空间效率上具有优势；预训练使模型在更少标注数据下更具泛化性，并加快训练收敛。

Conclusion: PassSum通过高效AST输入表示与自监督预训练有效克服了现有代码摘要方法的编码低效和标注依赖问题，兼具性能、效率与泛化性优势。

Abstract: Code summarization is to provide a high-level comment for a code snippet that typically describes the function and intent of the given code. Recent years have seen the successful application of data-driven code summarization. To improve the performance of the model, numerous approaches use Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) to represent the structural information of the code, which is considered by most researchers to be the main factor that distinguishes code from natural language. Then, such data-driven methods are trained on large-scale labeled datasets to obtain a model with strong generalization capabilities that can be applied to new examples. Nevertheless, we argue that state-of-the-art approaches suffer from two key weaknesses: (1) inefficient encoding of ASTs; (2) reliance on a large labeled corpus for model training. As a result, such drawbacks lead to (1) oversized model, slow training, information loss and instability; (2) inability to be applied to programming languages with only a small amount of labeled data. In light of these weaknesses, we propose PassSum, a code summarization approach that addresses the aforementioned weaknesses via (1) a novel input representation which contains an efficient AST encoding method; (2) introducing three pre-training objectives and pre-training our model with a large amount of (easy-to-obtain) unlabeled data under the guidance of self-supervised learning. Experimental results on code summarization for Java, Python and Ruby methods demonstrate the superiority of PassSum to state-of-the-art methods. Further experiments demonstrate that the input representation we use has both temporal and spatial advantages in addition to performance leadership. In addition, pre-training is also shown to make the model more generalizable with less labeled data, and also to speed up the convergence of the model during training.

</details>


### [928] [Comparing the Pre-trained Models of Source Code by Re-pre-training under a Unified Setup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15440)
*Changan Niu,Chuanyi Li,Vincent Ng,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对代码预训练模型（CodePTMs）实验设置不统一、难以公平比较的问题，提出标准化实验设置，并在统一架构与输入模态下重预训练与微调，系统比较不同预训练任务在各软件工程任务上的利弊。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年来CodePTMs在代码表示学习上成果显著，推动SE从任务专用方案走向任务无关的通用模型。但已有模型在预训练数据集、模型规模、评测任务与数据集等实验设置上差异较大，导致结果无法直接比较，也难判断不同预训练任务的真实影响。

Method: 首先回顾并总结既有工作的实验设置，提出一套标准化实验设置以支持CodePTMs间的公平比较；在该设置下，按各模型声明的模型架构、输入模态与预训练任务等进行重预训练，并针对每个评测SE任务分别微调与评估；最后汇总实验结果并对不同预训练任务在各SE任务上的相对优劣进行讨论。

Result: 在标准化设置下完成了CodePTMs的重预训练与逐任务微调评测，得到可横向对比的实验结果，并据此总结出不同预训练任务相对于各SE任务的优势与不足。原文未给出具体量化指标。

Conclusion: 统一且可控的实验设置是公平比较CodePTMs、厘清预训练任务作用的关键；作者希望该视角能为未来更强CodePTMs的研究提供启发与推动。

Abstract: Recent years have seen the successful application of large pre-trained models of source code (CodePTMs) to code representation learning, which have taken the field of software engineering (SE) from task-specific solutions to task-agnostic generic models. By the remarkable results, CodePTMs are seen as a promising direction in both academia and industry. While a number of CodePTMs have been proposed, they are often not directly comparable because they differ in experimental setups such as pre-training dataset, model size, evaluation tasks and datasets, etc. In this paper, we first review the experimental setup used in previous work and propose a standardized setup to facilitate fair comparisons among CodePTMs to explore the impacts of their pre-training tasks. Then, under the standardized setup, we re-pre-train CodePTMs using the same model architecture, input modalities, and pretraining tasks, etc., as they declared and fine-tune each model on each evaluation SE task for evaluating. Finally, we present the experimental results and make a comprehensive discussion on the relative strength and weakness of different pre-training tasks w.r.t. each SE task. We hope our view can inspire and advance the future study of more powerful CodePTMs.

</details>


### [929] [When Messages Go Wrong: Understanding Communication Faults in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15459)
*Jinhao Zhou,Xiaoyu Zhang,Jiongchi Yu,Fahao Chen,Jun Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文对LLM多智能体系统（LLM-MAS）的通信故障进行大规模实证研究，构建跨层故障分类体系与注入-追踪流水线，覆盖29,000+次执行，揭示故障静默传播规律及拓扑结构对任务成功率的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM-MAS依赖网络协议、远程工具和模型端点，通信易受消息丢失、延迟和上下文过期影响；由于智能体交换开放式自然语言，异常可能改变任务相关信息却仍使消息"可处理"，导致语义错误在后续交互中扩散。而针对智能体间通信故障的系统性研究仍然有限。

Method: 构建连接底层干扰与应用可见故障的跨层故障分类体系；开发故障注入与追踪流水线；在100个任务、5个领域、3种工作流拓扑、3种模型配置下开展超过29,000次执行的大规模评估；并评估执行侧与证据保护两类机制。

Result: 在有完整检测记录的失败中，20.7%无即时失败信号，部分内容故障下该比例高达76.2%。通信故障下Flat拓扑任务成功率为53.0%，而Sequential和Hierarchical仅为3.3%和3.2%。Flat的优势主要来自存在替代信息路径保留下游智能体所需证据时。执行侧与证据保护机制可恢复不同类型的失败案例，证据恢复依赖于是否仍能通过未受影响路径获取可信信息。

Conclusion: 研究为LLM-MAS的通信故障传播机制、工作流弹性及保护机制设计提供了实证依据，强调故障的静默性与信息路径冗余对系统韧性的关键作用。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) use specialized agents that exchange messages to accomplish complex tasks. Their reliance on networked protocols, remote tools, and model endpoints exposes communication to message loss, delay, and context expiration. Because agents often exchange open-ended natural language, anomalies can alter task-relevant information while leaving messages processable, allowing semantic errors to propagate through subsequent interactions. Systematic studies of faults in inter-agent communication remain limited. This paper presents a large-scale empirical study of how communication faults manifest, propagate, and affect task outcomes in LLM-MAS. We construct a cross-layer taxonomy linking lower-stack disturbances to application-visible faults and develop a fault-injection and tracing pipeline. Our evaluation covers more than 29,000 executions across 100 tasks, five domains, three workflow topologies, and three model configurations. We find that 20.7% of failures with complete detection records occur without an immediate failure signal, reaching 76.2% for partial-content faults. Flat maintains 53.0% task success under communication faults, compared with 3.3% and 3.2% for Sequential and Hierarchical, respectively. This advantage primarily arises when an alternative information path preserves the evidence required by downstream agents. We also evaluate execution-side and evidence protection mechanisms and find that they recover different failure cases. Evidence recovery depends on whether trustworthy information remains accessible through an unaffected path. These observations provide empirical insights into communication-fault propagation, workflow resilience, and protection design for LLM-MAS.

</details>


### [930] [Reviewing Beyond the Change: Repository Size and Existing Code Across Agent and Human Pull Requests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15567)
*Sabry E. Farrag*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 在2,034个GitHub仓库的92,042条代理PR评论中，6.5%的评论提及变更之外已存在的仓库条目；预设定log-linear模型显示代码文件数每增加十倍，比值比为1.35（区间1.15–1.59），大小匹配的阴性对照表明该上升并非偶然匹配所致。人类PR呈类似关联，但证据不足以确立稳健的代理特异性差异；工具存在漏检，故报告比例很可能低估真实流行度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审阅者有时会提及被审变更之外的既有仓库条目。作者希望检验此类引用是否在更大仓库中更常见，以及代理撰写与人类撰写的pull request之间该模式是否存在差异。

Method: 构建一个工具，将行内评审评论中的名称与基线提交（base-commit）仓库进行解析匹配；采用大小匹配的阴性对照估计偶然匹配概率。数据为2,034个GitHub仓库中代理PR的92,042条评论，并使用内部预设定的log-linear模型估计效应。

Result: 6.5%的评论提及变更之外的既有条目。log-linear模型显示代码文件数每增加十倍，比值比为1.35（区间1.15–1.59），阴性对照表明偶然匹配不能解释该上升。探索性分析提示该关联集中在小到中型仓库，在大型仓库中不精确。1,845个仓库中的人类PR也呈类似关联；预设定的比较发现仅在限定的集合内存在可忽略的微小代理超额，但证据未能确立稳健的代理特异性差异。

Conclusion: 仓库规模越大，审阅评论中提及变更外既有条目的现象越普遍，且该关联在代理与人类PR中均存在；但尚无稳健证据表明代理与人类之间存在特异性差异。由于工具会漏检许多引用，报告比例很可能低估真实流行度，且验证无法估计召回率如何随仓库规模变化。

Abstract: Reviewers sometimes name existing repository items outside the change under review. We ask whether such references are more common in larger repositories, and whether the pattern differs between agent-authored and human-authored pull requests. An instrument resolves names in inline review comments against the base-commit repository; size-matched negative controls estimate chance matches. Among 92,042 comments on agent pull requests in 2,034 GitHub repositories, 6.5 per cent name an existing item outside the change. An internally pre-specified log-linear model finds an odds ratio of 1.35 per tenfold increase in code files (interval 1.15 to 1.59), and size-matched negative controls indicate that chance matching does not account for the rise. Exploratory analyses suggest that the association is concentrated from small to mid-sized repositories and is imprecise among large ones. Human pull requests in 1,845 of these repositories show a similar association. A pre-specified comparison finds a small agent excess just within the bound set as negligible, but the evidence does not establish a robust agent-specific difference. The instrument misses many references, so reported shares likely understate prevalence, and the validation cannot estimate how recall changes with repository size.

</details>


### [931] [A Decade in a Day: Synthesizing Agent-Native Interfaces from Human-Oriented Software Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15765)
*Alan Wu,Wei Tao,Yiwen Guo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 DeskIF-Bench 基准，将软件版本迭代作为界面变量的自然来源，量化界面差异对 agent 操作桌面软件成功率的影响，并据此提出 agent-native 界面合成框架 ANIS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有桌面界面面向人类终端用户或应用开发者设计，agent 需要解释视觉控件或自行发现并组合底层软件操作，这种错配限制了 agent 表现。然而"哪些界面属性使桌面软件更易被 agent 使用"尚不明确，缺乏系统性研究手段。

Method: 1) 以软件演化作为界面差异的自然来源，构建 DeskIF-Bench：覆盖 6 个桌面应用、255 个经 artifact 验证的任务；2) 固定任务、agent 与验证器，仅改变软件发布版本，测量界面变化对 agent 性能的影响；3) 通过轨迹分析归纳出三项关键界面属性——可发现性、粒度、可观测性；4) 基于该属性设计 ANIS 框架，从已安装应用的能力中合成 agent-native 界面，支持原子级界面与目标级命令两种形式。

Result: 在 2 个模型、6 个应用上，最新版本一致优于最旧版本。扩展评估覆盖 8 个应用、368 个任务：原子界面相比直接使用原生 SDK，在 DeepSeek V4 Flash 与 Claude Haiku 4.5 上成功率分别提升 3.8 和 3.5 个百分点，同时在线 token 消耗降低约 73%；目标级命令将成功率进一步提升至 74.5% 和 67.4%。

Conclusion: 界面设计本身是影响 LLM agent 桌面软件可用性的独立因素；可发现性、粒度与可观测性是关键界面属性。ANIS 通过合成 agent-native 界面，在提升任务成功率的同时显著降低 token 开销，表明面向 agent 的界面重构是提升交互效率的有效路径。

Abstract: Large language model agents are emerging as an important new class of users of desktop applications. However, existing desktop interfaces were designed for human end users or application developers, leaving agents to interpret visual controls or discover and compose low-level software operations. This mismatch can hinder even capable agents, yet it remains unclear what interface properties make desktop software easier for agents to use. To study this question, we treat software evolution as a natural source of interface variation and introduce DeskIF-Bench, a benchmark of 255 artifact-verified tasks across six desktop applications. By holding the task, agent, and verifier fixed while varying the software release, we measure how interface changes affect agent performance. Across two models and six applications, the newest release consistently outperforms the oldest. Trajectory analysis identifies three relevant interface properties: discoverability, granularity, and observability. Guided by these properties, we develop ANIS, a framework that synthesizes agent-native interfaces from the capabilities of installed applications. On an expanded evaluation of 368 tasks across eight applications, atomic interfaces improve success over native SDK use by 3.8 and 3.5 percentage points with DeepSeek V4 Flash and Claude Haiku 4.5, respectively, while reducing online token usage by approximately 73%. Goal-level commands further raise success to 74.5% and 67.4%, respectively.

</details>


### [932] [Grounding Deep Learning Framework Testing in Data Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15808)
*Jiatao Ge,Yanzhou Mu,Yinglong Zou,Yibo Hu,Zhenyu Chen,Chunrong Fang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出张量流图（TFG）与基于数据流的变异测试方法FlowMuT，用于深度学习框架测试，在PyTorch和MindSpore上提交55个新bug报告，41个被确认，7个被修复，数据流多样性提升43.4%，合法变异体率96.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习框架测试方法主要以算子拓扑表示模型，忽略运行时张量值与属性以及算子输入要求，因而无法区分拓扑相似但数据流不同的模型，导致涉及数据流的bug（如自动微分、算子融合优化中的错误）被漏检。

Method: 提出张量流图（TFG）：节点表示算子及其输入要求，边记录张量值与属性，捕获运行时张量状态。基于TFG构建变异测试方法FlowMuT：变异表示为受约束的子图替换，变异算子来源于既有工作与可变数据流对象分析；每轮为种子模型构建TFG，将变异算子与TFG位点配对，用数据流约束过滤非法候选，采用LinUCB基于覆盖率和影响选择候选，执行变异体并更新反馈，将接受的变异体作为下一轮种子。

Result: 在PyTorch和MindSpore上使用多场景代表性模型评估。FlowMuT提交55个所有基线方法均遗漏的bug报告，开发者确认41个并修复7个。数据流多样性比最强基线高43.4%，合法变异体率为96.7%（无约束时为86.4%）。

Conclusion: 从数据流视角进行深度学习框架测试是实用且有效的，TFG与FlowMuT能有效发现现有方法漏检的数据流相关bug。

Abstract: Data flow underlies deep learning (DL) framework execution, including automatic differentiation and operator-fusion optimization. Bugs involving data flow can cause incorrect results or unexpected behavior. Existing testing methods represent models primarily by operator topology, omitting runtime tensor values and properties and operator input requirements. They therefore cannot distinguish data flows in models with similar topologies, even when these differences affect framework behavior. We introduce the Tensor Flow Graph (TFG) to capture runtime tensor states and operator input requirements. Its nodes represent operators and their input requirements, while its edges record tensor values and properties. Building on the TFG, we propose FlowMuT, a mutation-based testing method grounded in data flow. Mutations are represented as constrained subgraph replacements, with mutation operators derived from prior work and an analysis of mutable data flow objects. In each round, FlowMuT builds a TFG for the seed model, pairs mutation operators with TFG sites, and filters illegal candidates using data flow constraints. It uses LinUCB to select a candidate based on coverage and impact, executes the mutant, updates selection feedback, and uses each accepted mutant as the next seed. We evaluate FlowMuT on PyTorch and MindSpore using representative models from diverse application scenarios. FlowMuT submitted 55 bug reports for cases missed by all baseline methods; developers confirmed 41 reports and fixed the bugs described in 7 reports. FlowMuT achieves 43.4% higher data flow diversity than the strongest baseline and a legal mutant rate of 96.7%, compared with 86.4% without constraints. These results show that testing from a data flow perspective is practical and effective.

</details>


### [933] [BRQGen: Towards Adaptive Completeness Assessment and Follow-Up Question Generation for Bug Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15903)
*Tevfik Emre Sungur,Akif Emre Köşüş,Uğurcan Doğruçam,Eray Tüzün*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 BRQGen，一个迭代式框架，用于识别 bug 报告中缺失或模糊的信息，并仅在必要时生成有针对性的追问问题，同时评估报告完整性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多 bug 报告缺乏复现问题所需的关键信息。早期研究虽已使用大语言模型生成追问，但往往固定提问数量，无法根据报告是否不完整进行自适应判断。

Method: BRQGen 迭代识别报告中的信息缺口，仅在有缺口时生成追问；无缺口则判定为充分。作者回复后，框架评估回答是否提供了所需信息，并对新暴露的缺口继续生成问题。研究构建了来自 Home Assistant 和 Brave Browser 的 429 份不完整 bug 报告数据集，每份至少含一个维护者追问，并将问题与作者回答及模板可提供性标签关联。

Result: 早期维护者请求与作者回复相关，延迟请求则多无回复。一小时内请求的中位回复时间在 Home Assistant 为 0.52 小时、Brave 为 1.45 小时，而四小时后请求则分别增至 9.76 和 13.49 小时。BRQGen 覆盖了 1,073 个真实追问中的 35.4%（Qwen 3.8 Flash）至 51.8%（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 对详细问题和通用问题的覆盖率分别为 45.7% 和 63.9%。Gemini 3 Flash Preview 完整性评估宏 F1 最高为 49.3%，而仅保留高严重性缺口的后验分析下，Qwen 3.8 Flash 达到 73.6%。

Conclusion: 当至少一个识别缺口具有高严重性时，完整性评估显著提升；几乎所有真实追问都能在前两轮迭代中被捕获。

Abstract: Many bug reports lack the necessary information required to reproduce issues. In early studies, large language models have been employed to generate follow-up questions to enhance incomplete reports. However, they ask a fixed number of questions regardless of whether the report is incomplete. We propose BRQGen, an iterative framework that identifies missing or ambiguous information in bug reports and generates targeted follow-up questions, only if necessary. Reports with no identified gaps are classified as sufficient. When the author responds, BRQGen evaluates whether the answers provide the requested information and generates further questions for any exposed gaps. We curated a novel dataset of 429 incomplete bug reports from Home Assistant and Brave Browser, each containing at least one maintainer follow-up question. Each question is mapped to the author's answer and assigned a label indicating whether the requested information could have been provided directly through the issue template. Earlier maintainer requests were associated with author responses, whereas delayed requests were associated with no response. Among responding authors, requests within one hour received median replies after 0.52 hours in Home Assistant and 1.45 hours in Brave, versus 9.76 and 13.49 hours after four hours. BRQGen covered 35.4% (Qwen 3.8 Flash) to 51.8% (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) of the 1,073 ground-truth follow-up questions. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash managed to ask 45.7% of all detailed questions and 63.9% of all generic questions. Gemini 3 Flash Preview reached the highest macro-F1 for completeness assessment of 49.3%, but with a post-hoc analysis by getting only the gaps with high severities, Qwen 3.8 Flash reaches 73.6% macro-F1 score. Completeness assessment improved when at least one identified gap had high severity, and nearly all ground-truth questions were captured within the first two iterations.

</details>


### [934] [When Agent Evaluation Becomes Unreliable: An Empirical Study of Oracle Failures and Configuration-Dependent Measurement in an LLM Agent Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16067)
*Junjie Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"预言机完整性审计"方法，用5项状态完整性不变量与3项已知答案对照来检测Agent评测框架中的可靠性缺陷，并在注入缺陷、基准审计、配置消融和可移植性边界四个方面进行了实证研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent评测框架（评测集执行、输入生成、测试预言机判定）的可靠性缺陷无法通过分数表反映；仅看排行榜成绩会掩盖评测软件本身的错误，导致成功率和标签失真。

Method: 提出预言机完整性审计方法：定义5项状态完整性不变量和3项已知答案控制；在两个任务域加一个合成域注入7类预言机缺陷进行验证；随后将审计应用于某Agent基准，发现奖励函数在运行后评分前改变环境状态的缺陷，并用基于回放的纠正进行修正；再通过3,240个episode的组件消融考察策略文档、工具描述、工具错误字符串对轨迹可靠性的影响；最后测试该方法对第二个独立实现基准的可移植性。

Result: 所有注入缺陷类均被检出，修复后预言机无假阳性；基准审计中4,320个episode的数据库通过标签经回放纠正后从4,194降至2,883，实测成功率从94.3%降至65.5%；消融显示工具描述影响最大(-9.2 pp)、错误字符串最小(-5.3 pp)，第二任务域中语言效应符号反转；审计方法因无法从记录的API调用日志重建参考终态，不能验证第二个独立实现的基准。

Conclusion: 分数表不足以反映评测框架的可靠性，状态完整性不变量加已知答案控制可有效检出预言机缺陷并纠正虚高指标；测量结果对配置存在依赖且有边界，审计方法亦存在可移植性限制；论文开源不含网络、API密钥或模型调用的复现包（含审计套件、注入缺陷目录、冻结记录、偏差日志与离线分析入口）。

Abstract: Agent evaluation harnesses are software systems that run test suites, generate inputs, and decide outcomes with test oracles. This paper audits such software for reliability defects that score tables cannot reveal.
  We introduce an oracle-integrity auditing approach with five state-integrity invariants and three known-answer controls. We evaluate it by injecting seven oracle defect classes across two task domains and a synthetic domain. All injected defect classes are detected, and the repaired oracle has no false positives. Applied to an agent benchmark, the audit reveals a reward-function defect that changes the environment state before post-run scoring. Across 4,320 episodes, replay-based correction changes database-pass labels from 4,194 to 2,883 and reduces measured success from 94.3% to 65.5%.
  We also study configuration-dependent measurement effects. A component ablation over 3,240 episodes shows that the agent's policy documents, tool descriptions, and tool error strings influence observed trajectory reliability, with tool descriptions showing the largest exploratory effect (-9.2 pp) and error strings the smallest (-5.3 pp). A second task domain reverses the sign of the language effect, so the result is bounded to the tested configuration.
  Finally, we report a portability boundary: the auditing approach cannot validate a second independently implemented benchmark because the required reference terminal state cannot be reconstructed from its recorded API-call log.
  The paper releases a replication package containing the auditing suite, fault-injection catalogue, frozen records, deviation logs, and offline analysis entry points without network access, API keys, or model calls.

</details>


### [935] [Software Testing Meets Bayesian Workflow: A Literature-Driven Artifact Study of Probabilistic Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16594)
*Oleg Jarma,Maja Dall,Raúl Pardo,Mahsa Varshosaz,Andrzej Wąsowski*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文将贝叶斯数据分析教材《Statistical Rethinking》中的17条概率模型正确性性质提取为可自动化的测试预言，在59个学术与工业概率模型上验证，发现这些性质均有现实适用场景、测试基本不flaky，且标准变异算子无法刻画这些概率性质所追踪的缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化测试是有效的软件质量保障手段，却很少用于概率模型，而概率编程在数据分析中应用广泛且错误后果严重。核心障碍是oracle问题：概率模型常用于没有解析规格的场景，无法写出可测试的正确性性质。统计文献虽提供许多"部分/代理"正确性规格，但多为需人工判断的质量指南（如比较图、目视分布形状、判断参数是否"足够近"），未系统自动化。

Method: 从McElreath《Statistical Rethinking》中提取17条广泛适用的概率模型性质；为每条性质选择并实现一个测试oracle；构建包含59个来自学术与工业来源的概率模型作为被测种群，研究各性质自动测试的效用；并首次探究变异测试在概率模型上的有效性，检验标准变异算子能否刻画这些性质追踪的缺陷。

Result: 为全部17条性质都找到了现实的被测模型用例；实践中绝大多数测试不flaky，尽管理论上存在flaky可能；标准变异算子无法捕获概率性质所追踪的缺陷，表明现有变异测试不足以评估这类性质的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作使概率模型的正确性性质从人工质量指南转化为可自动执行的oracle，证明其在实际模型中普遍适用且测试稳定，同时揭示标准变异测试对概率性质的局限，为概率模型自动化测试奠定基础。

Abstract: Automated testing is an effective software quality assurance method, but it is rarely used for probabilistic models. This is despite the heavy use of probabilistic programming for data analytics in research and engineering, where the consequences of errors are dire. A key obstacle is the specification of testable correctness properties for probabilistic models, known as the oracle problem. Like machine learning, probabilistic programming is used precisely where no analytical specification exists: had we been able to write one, we would have written an algorithm instead of fitting a model. An alternative is partial, proxy correctness specifications. The statistics literature already offers many, but as quality guidelines that require human judgment: comparing plots, visually analyzing shapes of distributions, assessing whether parameter values are ''far'' or ''close enough''. These guidelines are not systematically automated. In this work, we elicit, implement, and study testable correctness properties of probabilistic models. We extract 17 broadly applicable properties for probabilistic models from one of the most widely used textbooks in Bayesian data analysis, Statistical Rethinking by McElreath. For each property, we select and implement a test oracle, and study its utility for automatic testing, using a population of 59 probabilistic models from academic and industrial sources. We find realistic use cases (models under test) for all the properties. We observe that the vast majority of tests are not flaky in practice, despite the theoretical potential for flakiness. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to investigate the effectiveness of mutation testing for probabilistic models, showing that standard mutation operators do not capture faults tracked by the probabilistic properties.

</details>


### [936] [Domain-Knowledge Driven Configuration Tuning of Kubernetes Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16651)
*Federico Imberti,Luca Cavagnis,Stefano Cereda,Giovanni Gibilisco,Claudio Menghi*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种领域知识驱动的Kubernetes应用配置调优方案，利用约束目录定制优化问题，并采用启发式与优化两类求解器，在工业工具中实现，相比基线平均节省11591与15874美元/月。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业软件部署平台需通过配置调优在保证应用性能的前提下降低成本，但可调参数众多，且生产环境无法随意评估不同配置（可能导致性能退化），导致最优配置难以寻找。

Method: 面向Kubernetes，提出领域知识驱动的配置搜索方法：基于领域专家在类似应用中积累的约束目录，工程师按当前应用选择相关约束以定制优化问题；采用两种求解器——基于启发式的方法与复用现有优化方案的优化型方法；并在某性能工程与优化软件公司的工业工具中实现。

Result: 与工程师预设配置值构成的基线相比，启发式方案与优化方案分别平均节省11591 USD/mo和15874 USD/mo每个Kubernetes，占成本的24.03%与32.90%；实际用时为启发式每次抽取0.71秒、优化型每次抽取45.54秒，均在实用时间内完成。

Conclusion: 领域知识驱动的约束定制结合启发式/优化求解器，可在实用时间内为工业应用找到高效Kubernetes配置，显著降低成本，验证了方案的有效性与工业可用性。

Abstract: Industrial software applications often require engineers to tune the software deployment platform. Configuration tuning identifies valuable configurations that minimize costs while ensuring the application performance. However, finding these configurations is difficult. The number of tunable configuration parameters in industrial applications is large, and engineers cannot assess different configurations in production because users may experience performance degradation. This work targets Kubernetes: A system for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. This paper proposes a domain-knowledge-driven solution for finding configurations of industrial applications in a practical time. The solution relies on a catalog of constraints encountered by domain experts in similar applications. Depending on the problem under analysis, engineers can customize the optimization problem by selecting the relevant constraints from the catalog for the application at hand. We rely on two alternative solvers to find an optimal configuration: The first is based on heuristics, while the second reuses existing optimization-based solutions. We implemented our solution within an industrial tool from a software company specializing in performance engineering and optimization. We compare our solution to a baseline, considering a set of predefined configuration values provided by engineers. Our results confirm the effectiveness of our solution: Compared to the baseline, the heuristic-based and optimization-based solutions provide significant average savings of 11591 USD/mo and 15874 USD/mo per Kubernetes, respectively, accounting for 24.03% and 32.90% of the costs, in practical time (0.71 seconds per extraction for the heuristic-based and 45.54 seconds per extraction for the optimization-based solution).

</details>


### [937] [DeepGroundRepair: From API-Grounded Generation to Shape-Aware Repair for Deep Learning Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16897)
*Xiangyue Ma,Zhen Wang,Xuhui Lu,Xiaoting Du,Chenglong Li,Jun Li,Haotian Li,Zheng Zheng*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出三阶段框架DeepGroundRepair，通过生成-定位-修复流程提升LLM生成深度学习程序的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的DL程序常因违反领域特定API使用约束和张量形状依赖而不可靠，导致API层语法问题和运行时失败；现有检索增强生成与反馈引导修复方法未能充分处理这些DL特有约束。

Method: DeepGroundRepair采用三阶段框架，构建生成-定位-修复工作流，核心思想是利用DL领域知识与运行时张量信息逐步缩小生成与修复空间：基于任务相关API知识约束生成，定位张量形状不匹配失败的上游成因，并利用运行时张量形状指导参数修复。

Result: 在DeepEval的100个模型级DL编程任务上，使用6个开放权重LLM覆盖TensorFlow、PyTorch和PaddlePaddle进行评估。与两个仅生成方法和两个结合回溯引导自调试的基线相比，API层语法问题合计平均每10个程序文件减少5.4个，代码可执行性平均相对提升85.3%；与两个自调试基线相比，语义一致性平均提升18.1%，token成本平均降低28.4%。

Conclusion: 利用DL领域知识和运行时张量信息进行生成与修复空间约束，可有效提升LLM生成DL程序的可靠性、语义一致性并降低token开销。

Abstract: Deep learning programs are fundamental to modern AI applications, and automatically generating them from natural language requirements can substantially reduce DL development effort. Large language models have demonstrated promising capabilities for this direction. However, generated DL programs often remain unreliable because they must satisfy domain specific API usage constraints and tensor shape dependencies, violations of which can cause API level syntactic issues and runtime failures. Existing retrieval augmented generation and feedback guided code repair methods do not adequately address these DL specific constraints.
  In this paper, we propose DeepGroundRepair, a three stage framework that establishes a generation localization repair workflow to improve the reliability of LLM-generated DL programs. Its key idea is to progressively narrow the generation and repair spaces using DL specific knowledge and runtime tensor information. Specifically, it grounds generation in task-relevant API knowledge, localizes the upstream causes of tensor shape mismatch failures, and uses runtime tensor shapes to guide parameter repair.
  We evaluate DeepGroundRepair on the 100 model-level DL programming tasks in DeepEval using six open-weight LLMs across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle. We compare it with four baselines: two generation-only methods and their counterparts incorporating traceback guided self debugging. The results show that, relative to these baselines, DeepGroundRepair reduces the combined number of API-level syntactic issues by an average of 5.4 per 10 program files and achieves an average relative improvement of 85.3% in code executability. Compared with the two self debugging baselines, it improves semantic consistency by an average of 18.1% and reduces token cost by an average of 28.4%.

</details>


### [938] [AIPOCH Open-Science: An Open-Source AI Research Workbench with Reproducible .science Packages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17110)
*Wen Ouyang,Bocheng Huang,Qianyu Yao,Fei Sun,Minying Deng,Haoyue Cheng,Wenwen Zhou,Lei Mou,Yusi Wei,Jiang Li,Kun Zhu,Lei Wang,Yi Feng,Jiaheng Dai,Ke Qian,Dan Wang,Yahui Wang,Chenyi Wang,Mingsheng Lyu,Yaqiang Zhang,Ping Zheng,Chunhua Tang,Xinge Ma,Xu Zhang,Youjia Fan,Can Lu,Zhijun Dai,Man Hu,Qiqi Xie,Beinan Liu,Yuanning Guo,Yunze Liu,Jinhong Jiang,Xianjun Fu,Mingwei Zhang,Yuanji Xu,Shilin Xia,Bowen Yang,Mingjun Yu,Jingdun Xie,Xuwei Chen,Xia Zou,Yuzhou Xue,Jianguo Zhou,Chunhao Cao,Donghao Tian,Lei Huang,Jinxiao Li,Shengrong Long,Zefeng Song,Honglin Li,Jiang Luo,Wenying Jiang,Shanshan Li,Lei Dai,Ning Jiang,Ying Cai,Chaohui Li,Chunyan Peng,Hetong Zhao,Angqing Li,Chunyan Yang,Chongyang Sun,Yong Li,Xinyu Shi,Wei Dai,Ming Peng,Chen Sang,Yuanyuan Han,Desong Qiu,Haixin Miao,Jian Xu,Yi Chen,Xiaoliang Shi,Tian Shen,Teng Hu,Shuhao Wang,Yingyong Hou,Huimei Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出开源科研工作台AIPOCH Open-Science及可移植.science会话包，并定义一套记录关系（版本、评估、审查、执行）的交换契约，通过受控实验验证完整/部分导出在导入后仍能保留测试版本与审查关联、区分未审查修订、将排除内容标记为不可用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助研究过程会留下指令、计算、工件修订与检查等多种记录，这些记录之间的关系对接收工作的研究者至关重要，但缺乏可移植的封装与交换规范来保证这些关系在转移过程中被正确保留和解释。

Method: 设计AIPOCH Open-Science开源工作台与.science会话包，并制定交换契约：版本与评估目标保持可归属，接收工作区标识符可重映射，符合条件的内容可显式省略，导入历史与可写分支分离。开展受控会话，涵盖错误初版、经审查的更正、未经审查的修订与计划但未执行的步骤；比较完整与部分导出（与独立于导出器的源记录对照），并检查同一安装内不同项目的导入情况；另设文档丰富的普通目录用于七项静态检查，并用注册表案例验证保留脚本与固定输入的离线重跑。

Result: 完整与部分导出两种条件下均保留了受测试版本与审查关联，未审查修订与先前评估保持区分，被排除内容表示为不可用；文档丰富目录为全部七项静态检查问题提供证据；注册表案例中离线执行保留脚本与固定输入逐字节重现两张已保存CSV表。

Conclusion: 本研究贡献了一套已实现的交换契约，以及对其保真规则、内容选择约束与解释边界的受控检验，为AI辅助研究成果的可移植交换与接收端可信解释提供了依据。

Abstract: AI-assisted research leaves instructions, computations, artifact revisions and checks whose relationships matter when another researcher receives the work. We present AIPOCH Open-Science, an open-source research workbench with portable .science session packages, and specify an exchange contract for these recorded relationships. Version and assessment targets remain attributable while receiving-workspace identifiers can be remapped, eligible contents can be omitted explicitly, and imported history remains separate from a writable fork. A controlled session tested an incorrect first version, a reviewed correction, an unreviewed revision and a planned but unexecuted step. We compared complete and partial exports with source records extracted independently of the exporter, then inspected imports into separate projects within the same installation. Both conditions retained the tested version and review associations, kept the unreviewed revision distinct from earlier assessments and represented excluded content as unavailable. A documentation-rich ordinary directory also supplied evidence for all seven static inspection questions. A separate registry case connected a table to its recorded task, execution and review; offline execution of its retained script and fixed input reproduced two saved CSV tables byte for byte. The study contributes an implemented exchange contract and a controlled examination of its preservation rules, content-selection constraints and interpretation boundaries.

</details>


### [939] [Deleting Code Without Losing Knowledge: Regenerative Software for Python Libraries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17197)
*Thomas Bartz-Beielstein*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该报告将Fowler提出的七项"再生式软件"原语首次应用于安全关键预测库spotforecast2-safe，由开源工具spotregen实现并提供GUI；因Orchestrator会话消耗超4300万token，架构转向本地模型，并通过确定性检查与维护者评审验证，报告含每个原语的可执行示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在"Software 3.0"时代，完整程序可被智能体在数分钟内重写，传统以代码为唯一真相源的做法受到质疑。Fowler提出七项原语以构建可再生软件框架，使程序可被删除并重建而不丢失知识，本文旨在首次将该框架应用于安全关键场景。

Method: 知识保存在受版本跟踪目录中的机器可读记录里，并为每个单元构建"再生包"（regeneration bundle）：单文件包含模块架构、意图、决策、公共契约、评估与消费者等信息但不含实现，外加其可能导入的唯一依赖模块。开源包spotregen实现这些原语并提供图形界面，实验在spotforecast2-safe仓库或其一次性副本上运行spotregen。

Result: 首次实验中，负责编排研究的Claude Code会话消耗超过4300万token，几乎全部为每次请求重复发送的自身上下文历史。结果由确定性检查与维护者共同判定。报告为每个原语提供了可执行示例。

Conclusion: 该应用验证了Fowler原语在安全关键库上的可行性，同时暴露出中心化会话架构的token成本问题，从而推动转向基于本地模型的架构。

Abstract: In the age of "Software 3.0", when a complete program can be rewritten in minutes by an agent, the traditional approach of relying on code as the sole source of truth becomes questionable. Fowler advocated for a set of seven primitives, which lay the framework for regenerative software, so that programs can be deleted and rebuilt without losing their knowledge. The knowledge lives in machine-readable records in a tracked directory, from which a *regeneration bundle* is built for each unit. The regeneration bundle is a single file with the module's architecture, intent, decisions, public contract, evaluations, and consumers, but no implementation, plus the one dependency module it may import. The open-source package spotregen implements these primitives and provides a graphical user interface. This report presents a first application of Fowler's primitives to the safety-critical forecasting library spotforecast2-safe. During the first experiments, the Claude Code session that orchestrated the study consumed more than 43 million tokens, almost all of them its own history re-sent with every request. This motivated the switch to an architecture that is built on local models. Deterministic checks and the maintainer judged the results. The report contains executable examples for every primitive. Each example runs spotregen against the repository or against a throw-away copy of it.

</details>


### [940] [VulnBump: A Benchmark for Fixing Vulnerable Dependencies in Real Projects While Keeping the Build and Tests Green](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17374)
*Gabija Pasiunaite,Ryan McMorrow,Brian Clark,Liran Tal,Luke Tu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 VulnBump 基准，用 307 个真实项目依赖升级任务评估智能体修复可修复漏洞的能力，并以容器内独立验证（依赖解析、重扫、构建、测试）作为通过标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SCA 工具报告的漏洞依赖远多于团队实际修复的数量：在 Snyk Open Source 生产数据中，94% 的漏洞发现存在已知修复版本，但仅约 10% 被解决。智能体编码工具可能弥合这一差距，但此前缺乏可在真实、可运行、跨生态项目中评估"漏洞驱动升级"且独立于智能体验证的基准。

Method: 构建 VulnBump：307 个升级任务，覆盖 6 个包管理器、43 个仓库中的 2,066 个可修复漏洞，任务分布与 Snyk Open Source 生产漏洞分布匹配。通过判定条件为在全新容器中同时满足四项：依赖可解析、重扫显示目标漏洞已修复、项目可构建、所有原本通过的测试仍通过。对比基线包括仅应用 Snyk 推荐版本的非智能体基线，以及在相同模型（Claude Sonnet 5.5）下的 Snyk Evo Remediation Agent、Claude Code + Snyk 扫描、Claude Code 无辅助三种配置。

Result: 非智能体基线通过率 46.9%；Evo Remediation Agent 90.2%；Claude Code + Snyk 扫描 77.5%；Claude Code 无辅助 59.6%。失败模式相反：Claude Code 多将漏洞原样保留，而 Evo Remediation Agent 的多数失败会破坏构建或测试。SCA 扫描器对智能体是关键工具：Snyk 指导使 Claude Code 通过率提升 17.9 个百分点，无指导时常停留在仍有漏洞的版本；但仅知道目标不够——在相同 Snyk 发现下，Evo Remediation Agent 的专用 harness 比 Claude Code + Snyk 扫描高 12.7 个百分点。大型框架迁移对所有 harness 仍然困难。

Conclusion: 各智能体 harness 维持项目可运行的比例相近，因此评估依赖升级中的修复质量必须同时验证"漏洞修复、构建成功、测试通过"三者，单看任一维度都会产生误导。

Abstract: Software composition analysis (SCA) tools report far more vulnerable dependencies than teams fix: in Snyk Open Source production data, 94% of vulnerability findings have a known fixed version, yet only about 10% are resolved. Agentic coding tools could close this gap, but no benchmark evaluates them on vulnerability-driven upgrades in real, runnable projects across ecosystems, verified independently of the agent. We present VulnBump: 307 upgrade tasks covering 2,066 fixable vulnerabilities in 43 repositories across six package managers, matched to Snyk Open Source production vulnerability distributions. An upgrade passes only if, in a fresh container, dependencies resolve, a rescan shows the targeted vulnerabilities fixed, the project builds, and every previously passing test still passes. A non-agentic baseline that only applies Snyk's recommended version passes 46.9% of upgrades; with the same model (Claude Sonnet 5.5), Snyk's Evo Remediation Agent passes 90.2%, Claude Code + Snyk scan 77.5% and Claude Code unaided 59.6%. The agents fail in opposite ways: Claude Code mostly leaves the vulnerability in place, whereas most of Evo Remediation Agent's failures break the build or tests. An SCA scanner is a key tool for agents: Snyk's guidance raises Claude Code's PASS rate by 17.9 percentage points; without it, Claude Code often settles on a still-vulnerable version. Yet knowing the target is not enough: given the same Snyk findings, Evo Remediation Agent's purpose-built harness passes 12.7 points more than Claude Code + Snyk scan. Major framework migrations remain hard for all harnesses. Because the agents keep projects working at similar rates, evaluating remediation quality in dependency upgrades requires verifying the fix, the build and the tests together.

</details>


### [941] [Why Agentic Workflows Fail: A Taxonomy Derived from Literature and Empirical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17418)
*Xin Li,Rami Bahsoon,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出面向智能体工作流的“来源感知”故障分类体系，通过工作流阶段（横轴）与智能体能力（纵轴）构成的二维定位矩阵，结合学术文献与GitHub实证证据，揭示文献侧重规划推理等机制、GitHub侧重执行与工具基础设施故障，指出可靠性应视为系统问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作流融合大模型、规划、记忆、工具、执行环境与迭代反馈，同一用户可见症状可能源于模型行为、工作流编排、外部工具、基础设施或交互，故障难以诊断。既有分类体系多按最终故障表象分类，缺乏对智能体运行内部中间过程的定位。

Method: 构建“来源感知”的智能体工作流故障分类体系，将来源归因与三个实证维度（具体故障类型词典、工作流阶段定位、智能体能力定位）结合；核心为二维定位矩阵（横轴为工作流阶段即过程轴，纵轴为智能体能力即功能轴），并应用于学术文献与GitHub证据的实证比较。

Result: 文献来源的故障集中在规划、推理、学习、感知与知识相关机制；GitHub来源的故障集中在执行阶段、驱动（actuation）相关、工具、API与基础设施故障。主导热点为迭代执行与actuation阶段。

Conclusion: 智能体工作流可靠性应作为系统问题而非仅模型输出问题处理；该分类体系为结构化评估、根因分析、故障注入与工程分流提供基础。

Abstract: Agentic workflows combine large language models with planning, memory, tools, execution environments, and iterative feedback. Their failures are difficult to diagnose because the same user-visible symptom may originate from model behavior, workflow orchestration, external tools, infrastructure, or their interaction. This paper presents a source-aware taxonomy of agentic workflow failures and applies it to evidence from academic literature and GitHub. The taxonomy combines source attribution with three empirical dimensions: a concrete failure-type dictionary, workflow-stage localization, and agent-capability localization. Its central structure is a two-axis localization matrix: workflow stages form the horizontal process axis and agent capabilities form the vertical functional axis. This design moves beyond taxonomies that mainly classify final failure manifestations by localizing intermediate process states inside agent operation. Our empirical comparison shows that literature-derived failures emphasize planning, reasoning, learning, perception, and knowledge-related mechanisms, whereas GitHub-derived failures concentrate on execution-stage, actuation-related, tool, API, and infrastructure failures.
