The dominant hotspot is iterative execution and actuation. These findings indicate that agentic workflow reliability should be treated as a systems problem rather than only a model-output problem. The taxonomy provides a basis for structured evaluation, root cause analysis, failure injection, and engineering triage.

</details>


### [942] [Cross-Project Bug Localization: What Works, What Doesn't, and Why](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17578)
*A Eashaan Rao,Sridhar Chimalakonda*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究通过在同一实验设置下对比三种架构不同的缺陷定位模型，证明跨项目学习（CPL）的效果依赖于模型架构，而非迁移设置本身的固有属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新启动或小型开源项目普遍缺乏项目内训练数据，CPL被寄予厚望以复用成熟项目的标注缺陷；但既有CPL研究多以单一模型、且以数据稀缺项目难以达到的充足数据项目内基线作对比，无法回答CPL的收益究竟来自迁移设置还是模型架构。

Method: 在13个开源Python项目构成的63个"源→目标"项目对上，统一缺陷语料、数据划分、检索候选与基线，评测三种架构迥异的模型：基于嵌入的BLAZE、卷积的TRANP-CNN、基于GNN与对抗学习的COOBA；主基线为项目内受限训练（WP-small，仅用20%目标标签，与CP-transfer目标侧比例一致）。

Result: CPL相对WP-small的优势在TRANP-CNN上最明显（Cohen's d=0.95，胜率81.0%，p<0.001，按目标项目聚类后仍稳健）；BLAZE较弱（d=0.49，胜率60.3%，p=0.002，按目标聚类后不显著）；COOBA在本复现下增益很小且未通过多重比较校正（d=0.27，p=0.027）。负迁移在TRANP-CNN上占9.5%，在BLAZE与COOBA上占30.2%。跨模型方向一致率仅44%–54%，即同一项目对可能惠及某架构却损害另一架构，尽管增益之间存在正相关（rho=0.24–0.42）。

Conclusion: CPL效果具有架构依赖性：实践者应针对所选模型验证CPL是否适用，CPL研究也应分架构报告结果，而不能将单一模型的结论泛化为迁移设置的普遍性质。

Abstract: Bug localization models require substantial within-project training data that newly active or small open-source projects rarely have. Cross-project learning (CPL) promises to close this gap by reusing labeled bugs from mature projects, but prior CPL studies evaluate a single model against ample-data within-project baselines that data-scarce projects cannot reach. We ask whether CPL's effectiveness is a property of the transfer setting or depends on model architecture. We evaluate three architecturally distinct models, embedding-based BLAZE, convolutional TRANP-CNN, and GNN-based adversarial COOBA, on 63 source to target pairs from 13 open-source Python projects under identical bug corpora, data splits, retrieval candidates, and baselines. The primary baseline is within-project limited training (WP-small, 20% of target labels, the same target-side share as CP-transfer). CPL outperforms WP-small most clearly for TRANP-CNN (Cohen's d = 0.95, win rate 81.0%, p < 0.001, robust to clustering pairs by target project), and less so for BLAZE (d = 0.49, win rate 60.3%, p = 0.002; not significant once pairs are clustered by target). COOBA, under our re-implementation, shows a small gain that does not survive multiple-comparison correction (d = 0.27, p = 0.027). Negative transfer affects 9.5% of TRANP-CNN pairs and 30.2% of BLAZE's and COOBA's. Cross-model direction agreement is only 44-54%: the same pair can help one architecture and harm another, although the models' gains are positively correlated (rho = 0.24-0.42). CPL outcomes are therefore architecture-dependent: practitioners should validate CPL for their chosen model, and CPL studies should report results per architecture.

</details>


### [943] [StateHarness: Maintaining Evolving Project State for Long-Horizon Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17616)
*Chuan Zou,Yujun Zhou,Xiaonan Luo,Xiangliang Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: StateHarness：一种无需更新模型参数的运行时框架，通过维护演化的项目状态（当前问题、发现、决策、仓库关系、未完成工作）提升长程编码任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程编码中，项目状态信息分散在不断增长的交互历史里，导致局部修改与后续后果脱节、进展难以延续。需要一个能持续维护项目演化视图的机制。

Method: StateHarness运行时框架，不更新模型参数。工作代理记录当前问题与假设、重要发现与决策、发现的仓库关系及未完成工作；运行时支持提示记录更新、搜索可能受影响的调用者/测试/文档，并维护紧凑工作简报；当行为信号累积时，独立的诊断会话重新审视历史，揭示被忽略的证据。

Result: RefactorBench：全链完成率29.4%→35.3%，清理检查准确率87.0%→95.4%。LHTB五项软件工程任务：平均奖励0.427→0.576，超过LongHorizon-Harness且记录执行成本显著更低。ChainSWE：缺陷修复率35.1%→39.5%，残余债务60→43项，但pass-to-pass回归增加。

Conclusion: 维护项目状态可改善长程编码，但会带来可度量的执行成本与回归权衡。

Abstract: Long-horizon coding requires agents to maintain an evolving view of the project they are changing: what problem is currently being solved, what has already been learned or modified, which other artifacts may be affected, and what work remains unresolved. When this information is scattered across a growing interaction history, local edits can become disconnected from their later consequences and progress can be difficult to carry forward. We introduce StateHarness, a runtime framework that maintains evolving project state without updating model parameters. The working agent records its current problem and hypothesis, important findings and decisions, discovered repository relationships, and unfinished work. Runtime support prompts record updates, searches for callers, tests, and documentation that may be affected by a change, and maintains a compact working brief for subsequent decisions. When behavioral signals accumulate, a separate diagnostic session revisits the recorded history and surfaces overlooked evidence. Across three repository-level evaluations, StateHarness improves task completion and several measures of change consistency. On RefactorBench, full-chain completion increases from 29.4% to 35.3% and cleanup-check accuracy from 87.0% to 95.4%. On five LHTB software-engineering tasks, mean reward improves from 0.427 to 0.576, exceeding LongHorizon-Harness at substantially lower recorded execution cost. On ChainSWE, bug-fix rate increases from 35.1% to 39.5% and residual debt decreases from 60 to 43 items, although pass-to-pass regressions increase. These results show that maintaining project state can improve long-horizon coding while introducing measurable execution and regression trade-offs.

</details>


### [944] [Diff Diffusion: Predicting Edit Paths with Diffusion Models for Efficient Code Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17831)
*Xiaolong Xu,Hao Jiang,Bo Jiang,Zhiwen Deng,Ningyuan Sun,Bingzhou Chen,Jin Chen,Chenxing Wei*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 Diff Diffusion，一种面向代码编辑的扩散启发式 LLM 框架，将去噪过程建模为从原始代码片段到修订代码的结构化编辑操作（edit paths），并结合多阶段训练与高效并行解码；在公开基准与生产环境中，它在保持或超过自回归基线精度的同时显著降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式大语言模型（dLLMs）虽能并行更新多 token，但其优化目标是序列合成而非编辑预测；而现代 AI 辅助 IDE 的编辑预测需要依据近期编辑、当前文件与光标局部上下文推断下一步代码变更，这类变更通常稀疏且保留大部分源码 token，整段重生成会浪费算力。因此需要一种更匹配编辑预测场景、聚焦变更区域的建模范式。

Method: 提出 Diff Diffusion 框架：将去噪过程表示为结构化编辑操作（edit paths），从原始代码片段预测到修订形式的编辑路径；在该形式化基础上结合多阶段训练与高效并行解码，使计算集中在发生变更的区域，从而支持准确的低延迟编辑与多位置并行修改。

Result: 在公开编辑补全基准、编辑预测评测及线上验证中，Diff Diffusion 与自回归基线精度相当或更优；在公开编辑补全基准上推理速度提升 2.78 倍，并在生产环境中实现 P50 模型延迟降低 39.0%。

Conclusion: 该工作为需要高精度与低延迟的 AI 应用（尤其是 AI 辅助 IDE 的代码编辑预测）提供了新的建模视角：以结构化编辑路径替代整段重生成，兼顾准确性与推理效率。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are appealing for code generation because they can update many tokens in parallel, yet many are optimized for sequence synthesis rather than edit prediction. This setting is poorly matched to modern AI-assisted IDEs, where edit prediction must infer the next code change from recent edits, the current file, and cursor-local context. Such changes are usually sparse and preserve most source tokens, so regenerating a full code segment wastes computation. We propose Diff Diffusion, a diffusion-inspired LLM framework for code editing that predicts edit paths from an original snippet to its revised form. Diff Diffusion represents denoising as structured edit operations, and combines this formulation with multi-stage training and efficient parallel decoding. By focusing computation on changed regions, Diff Diffusion supports accurate low-latency edits and multi-position parallel modification. Across public edit-completion benchmarks, edit-prediction evaluations, and online validation, Diff Diffusion matches or leads autoregressive baselines while delivering 2.78 times faster inference on public edit-completion benchmarks and a 39.0% P50 model-latency reduction in production. This work provides a new modeling perspective for AI applications that require high accuracy and low latency.

</details>


### [945] [State-Aware Generation of Deployable Websites from Visual Prototypes and Requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17861)
*Ruwei Pan,Junlei Shen,Linhao Wu,Zixiong Yang,Qisheng Zhang,Yifan Li,Tianyu Ma,Yakun Zhang,Lu Zhang,Hongyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出状态感知框架 VisStateCoder，用 Project State Graph 维护原型到项目的状态对应，缓解 prototype-to-project state drift。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉原型与文本需求生成可部署网站日益可行，但生成项目与原型的一致性难以保持。原型规定布局与视觉元素，需求描述交互流程与部署约束；现有 UI-to-code 方法与编码智能体常将布局重建、交互实现、项目编辑分离，导致视觉元素、文件、工作流、依赖、渲染证据在生成、验证、更新间失去对应关系，即 prototype-to-project state drift。

Method: VisStateCoder 在 Project State Graph 中维护上述对应关系。该图通过类型化链接连接四类状态节点，并支持原型接地（prototype grounding）、图引导生成（graph-guided generation）以及渲染证据引导的限定范围更新（render-evidence-guided scoped updates）：将失败检查映射到受影响文件，同时保留更新范围之外的文件不变。

Result: 在 Vision2Web 上使用五个基础模型，覆盖 Static Webpage、Interactive Frontend 与 Full-Stack Website 任务进行评估。跨模型平均，VisStateCoder 相对每个模型的最强基线，在 Interactive Frontend 和 Full-Stack Website 任务总体得分分别提升 26.1 与 22.6 分；相比其他状态表示，降低已验证状态漂移（即某轮更新通过、后续失败的检查）。对 50 个任务的标注研究显示，构建的图达到 95.6% 边级 F1。

Conclusion: 以 Project State Graph 统一维护视觉元素、文件、工作流、依赖与渲染证据的状态对应，可显著提升 UI-to-code 交互与全栈任务的生成一致性，并减少已验证状态漂移；图构建质量在边级层面较高。

Abstract: Generating deployable websites from visual prototypes and textual requirements is increasingly feasible with multimodal models, yet keeping generated projects consistent with their prototypes remains challenging. Prototypes specify layouts and visual elements, while requirements describe interaction workflows and deployment constraints. Existing UI-to-code methods and coding agents often treat layout reconstruction, interaction implementation, and project editing separately, allowing visual elements, files, workflows, dependencies, and render evidence to lose their correspondence across generation, verification, and update. We call this problem prototype-to-project state drift. We propose VisStateCoder, a state-aware framework that maintains these correspondences in a Project State Graph. The graph connects four types of state nodes through typed links and supports prototype grounding, graph-guided generation, and render-evidence-guided scoped updates that map failed checks to affected files while preserving files outside the update scope. We evaluate VisStateCoder on Vision2Web using five foundation models across Static Webpage, Interactive Frontend, and Full-Stack Website tasks. Averaged across models, VisStateCoder improves overall scores over the strongest baseline for each model by 26.1 and 22.6 points on Interactive Frontend and Full-Stack Website tasks, respectively. It also reduces verified-state drift, measured by checks that pass in one update round but fail later, compared with alternative state representations. An annotation study of 50 tasks finds that the constructed graphs achieve 95.6% edge-level F1.

</details>


### [946] [Mobile App Analysis in the New Era: Challenges and the Road Ahead](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17872)
*Jiale Wu,Tianming Liu,Yanjie Zhao,Haoyu Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出"制品层—运行时层—生态层"三层视角，系统梳理移动应用演进带来的分析挑战，并给出框架感知分析、自适应测试、策略感知合规验证等研究方向，同时讨论大语言模型带来的新分析能力与安全隐私风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动应用已演变为复杂的多平台系统，承载多样服务并在多变的监管与分发环境中运行。传统分析技术在保障质量、安全与合规方面虽有坚实基础，但随应用演化而面临日益严峻的挑战，亟需厘清现有方法的不足并指明未来研究方向。

Method: 采用三层分析视角进行挑战归类与论述：制品层关注异构代码库与保护机制对打包应用可分析性的削弱；运行时层关注多模态交互、超级应用架构以及AI驱动的自主运行带来的执行复杂性；生态层关注新兴平台、碎片化分发渠道与区域性监管要求等更广泛语境。并分析三层新特性之间的交互与叠加效应，以及LLM在其中的作用。

Result: 识别出各层的关键挑战，指出跨层新特性相互作用、叠加复合，形成现有方法在设计上难以应对的困难；提出框架感知分析、自适应测试、策略感知合规验证等潜在研究方向，并揭示LLM既带来新的分析能力，其集成到应用中又引发新的安全与隐私问题。

Conclusion: 该文明确了既有方法在移动应用新形态下的失效之处，勾画了该领域未来研究的方向，为后续研究提供了结构化的挑战框架与研究议程。

Abstract: Mobile applications (apps) have grown into complex, multi-platform systems that support diverse services and operate within varying regulatory and distribution contexts. Traditional analysis techniques have established a strong foundation for ensuring quality, security, and compliance, but face increasing challenges as mobile apps evolve. This article presents a three-layer perspective to examine these challenges. The Artifact Layer highlights how heterogeneous code bases and protection mechanisms reduce the analyzability of packaged apps. The Runtime Layer addresses growing execution complexity, from multi-modal interactions and super-app architectures to AI-driven autonomous operations. The Ecosystem Layer considers broader contexts, including emerging platforms, fragmented distribution channels, and region-specific regulatory requirements. New characteristics across these layers interact and compound, creating difficulties that existing approaches are not designed to handle. For each layer, we identify key challenges and potential research directions, including framework-aware analysis, adaptive testing, and policy-aware compliance verification. We also discuss how large language models bring new analytical capabilities to the field, while their integration into apps raises new security and privacy concerns. This article aims to clarify where established methods fall short and highlight directions for future research in this evolving field.

</details>


### [947] [SpecCloak: Probing Harmful Code Generation through Engineering Specifications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.17907)
*Wenbin Chen,Jiexin Wang,Guanting Wu,Jiaxi Liang,Yi Cai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 PseudoSpec——将恶意编程需求包装为工程规格说明书的模板，发现规格化表述能显著降低模型拒答率，即使在保留风险关键词时依然有效；据此构建黑盒红队框架 SpecCloak（RedCode-Gen 上平均执行验证攻击成功率 28.91%），并提出防御原型 SpecReveal（检测率 96.88%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型的代码生成能力可被滥用于实现有害功能，因此需理解其在编程请求下的安全行为。已知请求措辞会影响拒答，但"编码需求以何种形式陈述"是否影响恶意代码生成的拒答过程尚不明确。

Method: 1) 提出 PseudoSpec 模板，把功能需求组织为工程规格说明书形式；2) 通过受控对比、表征分析与激活干预研究其影响；3) 构建黑盒红队框架 SpecCloak，将 PseudoSpec 与判别器引导优化结合；4) 提出防御原型 SpecReveal，结合自然语言意图重建与双视角检测，无需目标模型微调。

Result: 在五个开源权重模型上，仅去除显式风险关键词只能部分降低拒答，而规格化提示即使保留这些关键词也能大幅降低拒答，并伴随向代码输出相关表征的一致偏移，沿条件差异方向的干预可改变拒答行为；输出分析可区分代码相关响应与生成退化。SpecCloak 在 RedCode-Gen 上于八个目标模型取得平均 28.91% 的执行验证攻击成功率；SpecReveal 在独立提示检测评测中达到 96.88% 的攻击检测率，并在良性编程与规格风格输入上评估误报。

Conclusion: 研究将规格说明引起的响应差异与实际安全后果相联系，表明"需求陈述形式"本身是影响拒答的关键变量；意图重建可作为补充性检测手段。该工作既揭示了规格化包装带来的滥用风险，也为防御提供了可行原型。

Abstract: The code generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs) can equally be misused to implement harmful functionality, underscoring the need to understand their safety behavior in response to programming requests. While request phrasing is known to influence refusal, it remains unclear whether the form in which coding task requirements are stated affects the refusal process for malicious code generation. We introduce PseudoSpec, a template that organizes functional requirements as engineering specifications, and investigate its effects through controlled comparisons, representation analysis, and activation interventions. Across five open-weight models, removing explicit risk keywords only partially reduces refusal, whereas specification prompting substantially lowers refusal even when these keywords are retained. This reduction accompanies consistent shifts toward code-output-related representations, and interventions along condition-difference directions alter refusal behavior. Output analysis further distinguishes code-related responses from generation degeneration. Building on these findings, we propose SpecCloak, a black-box red-teaming framework combining PseudoSpec with discriminator-guided optimization, achieving an average execution-verified attack success rate of 28.91\% across eight target models on RedCode-Gen. We also introduce SpecReveal, a defense prototype combining natural-language intent reconstruction with dual-view detection without target-model fine-tuning. It achieves a 96.88\% attack detection rate in a separate prompt-detection evaluation, with false positives assessed on benign programming and specification-style inputs. These results connect specification-induced response differences to practical security consequences and identify intent reconstruction as a complementary detection approach.

</details>


### [948] [SWEPatchTest: Evaluating Software Tests Beyond Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18004)
*Hua Lu,Pengcheng Wang,Han Li,Zichen Tian,Yanyu Chen,Huang He,Bingjin Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出SWEPATCHTEST基准（619个任务、82,579个候选补丁），通过联合度量"复现问题、接受正确补丁、拒绝错误补丁"三项标准，揭示单参考评测掩盖的测试质量问题，并将补丁区分度用作SFT数据筛选信号，使JVR提升约三倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码智能体依赖生成的测试来判断补丁是否满足issue需求，但现有评测只验证测试能否区分"有bug代码"与"参考补丁"，这类测试仍可能接受错误补丁或拒绝正确补丁，无法反映真实判别能力，因此需要一个联合评估测试质量与补丁区分度的基准。

Method: 构建SWEPATCHTEST：从SWE-bench Pro、SWE-bench Multilingual与DeepSWE采集619个任务及82,579个来自智能体轨迹的候选补丁；将每个测试套件分别在buggy代码库和打补丁后代码库上重放，联合度量问题复现、正确补丁接受率与错误补丁拒绝率，并提出要求三项同时满足的Joint Validation Rate（JVR）；进一步用验证分数筛选并扩展演示样本用于监督微调（SFT）。

Result: 最优配置在59.29%任务上能复现参考转换，但JVR仅为9.21%，说明单参考评测掩盖了大量失败；使用验证分数筛选和扩展演示的SFT配方使JVR约提升三倍，并在三个SWE-bench基准上改善下游修复性能。

Conclusion: 补丁区分度既是测试质量的诊断指标，也是基于执行信号的智能体训练数据筛选手段，可同时提升测试评估严谨性与下游修复能力。

Abstract: Coding agents use generated tests to decide whether a proposed patch satisfies an issue's requirements. A suite that fails on the buggy program and passes after applying the reference patch can still accept an incorrect patch or reject a correct patch. We introduce SWEPATCHTEST, a test-generation benchmark with 619 tasks from SWE-bench Pro, SWE-bench Multilingual, and DeepSWE and 82,579 candidate patches collected from coding-agent trajectories. By replaying each suite on the buggy and patched codebases, \benchmark jointly measures issue reproduction, acceptance of correct patches, and rejection of incorrect patches. Joint Validation Rate (JVR), which requires all three criteria on the same task, exposes failures hidden by single-reference evaluation: the best-performing configuration achieves only 9.21% JVR despite reproducing the reference transition on 59.29% of tasks. We further use validation scores to select and scale demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). The resulting training recipe approximately triples JVR and improves downstream repair across three SWE-bench benchmarks. Patch discrimination thus provides both a diagnostic measure of test quality and an execution-based signal for curating agent training data.

</details>


### [949] [Soliduzz: Finding Miscompilations in Smart-Contract Compilers with Assertion-Driven Equivalence Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18165)
*Alexander Stromberger,Christoph Hochrainer,Valentin Wüstholz,Maria Christakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Soliduzz 提出以断言驱动的等价性预言（oracle）检测 EVM 智能合约编译器误编译，通过乘积程序将语义等价编码为可执行断言，并用蜕变变换生成自检程序，交由通用模糊测试与符号执行工具检查断言违反，在 solc、solx、vyper 上共发现 29 个缺陷，其中 24 个为编译器缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编译为 EVM 字节码的智能合约管理高价值资产且部署后难修补，编译器误编译（编译成功但字节码不保持源程序语义）危害严重。现有智能合约编译器模糊测试要么只关注健壮性失败，要么依赖比较不同编译器配置的差分预言，覆盖范围有限。

Method: Soliduzz 采用断言驱动的等价性预言，用乘积程序把语义等价编码为可执行断言；将这类自检程序编译后，交由现成模糊测试器和符号执行引擎在字节码中搜索断言违反，无需分析器提供编译器专用支持。实例化两类互补的蜕变变换：一是从等价表达式出发，将其提升为刻意使用存储、数据位置、控制流、合约交互和内联汇编等 EVM 特性的合约代码；二是将 Equivalence Modulo Inputs（EMI）从固定具体输入推广到符号输入空间，通过记录原计算的覆盖率来守卫变换计算的变异。二者共同生成断言成对计算输出相同的乘积程序。

Result: 在 solc、solx 和 vyper 三个 EVM 智能合约编译器上使用多种分析工具评估，Soliduzz 共暴露 29 个缺陷，其中 24 个为编译器缺陷：6 个误编译、17 个内部编译器错误、1 个挂起；其余 5 个为分析工具缺陷。

Conclusion: Soliduzz 验证了以断言驱动的等价性预言结合乘积程序与两类蜕变变换，可有效发现 EVM 智能合约编译器的误编译与其它缺陷，且不依赖分析器的编译器专用支持，具备良好的可移植性与实用价值。

Abstract: Smart contracts compiled to the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) can manage high-value assets and are difficult to patch after deployment. Compiler miscompilations are therefore especially dangerous: compilation succeeds, but the generated bytecode does not preserve the semantics of the source program. Existing smart-contract compiler fuzzers either focus on robustness failures or rely on differential oracles that compare compiler configurations.
  We present Soliduzz, an approach for finding miscompilations in EVM smart-contract compilers using assertion-driven equivalence oracles. Soliduzz uses product programs to encode semantic equivalence as executable assertions. The key shift is to compile these self-checking programs and let off-the-shelf fuzzers and symbolic execution engines explore the resulting bytecode for assertion violations, without requiring compiler-specific support from the analyzer.
  Soliduzz instantiates this idea with two complementary families of metamorphic transformations. The first starts from equivalent expressions and lifts them into smart-contract code that deliberately exercises EVM-specific features such as storage, data locations, control flow, contract interactions, and inline assembly. The second generalizes Equivalence Modulo Inputs (EMI) from fixed concrete inputs to symbolic input spaces. Our symbolic EMI records coverage in the original computation and uses it to guard mutations in the transformed computation. Together, these transformations produce product programs that assert that paired computations yield the same outputs.
  We evaluate Soliduzz on three EVM smart-contract compilers (solc, solx, and vyper) using several analysis tools. Overall, Soliduzz exposes 29 bugs. Of these, 24 are compiler bugs: 6 miscompilations, 17 internal compiler errors, and 1 hang. The remaining 5 are bugs in the analysis tools.

</details>


### [950] [Assessing the Quality of Concrete Scenarios Generated from Scenario Classes for Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18169)
*Lina Putze,Thies de Graaff,Jan Steffen Becker,Christian Neurohr*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文针对自动驾驶基于场景开发中生成的具体场景集合，提出将场景距离度量聚合为“质量函数”以量化其多样性，并证明其性质、在虚拟验证工具链中进行实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于场景的开发已成为自动驾驶系统的主流方法。从覆盖运行设计域的场景类生成具体场景后，用于危害分析与风险评估、系统验证与确认等应用时，生成的具体场景之间的高多样性至关重要；但在场景类以约束系统形式化、具体场景空间未显式已知的情况下，如何评估具体场景集合的质量尚不明确。

Method: 将场景距离度量聚合为质量函数，用于量化自动驾驶具体场景集合的多样性；针对场景类形式化为约束系统、具体场景空间未显式已知的情形，基于一组期望性质构造质量函数候选并证明其性质满足情况；在抽象的场景化虚拟验证工具链中开展多组实验。

Result: 通过质量函数比较了采样变异方法的有效性，考察了不同场景距离度量的选择，并研究了时间因素对具体场景集合质量的影响，展示了质量函数的实际相关性。

Conclusion: 所提出的质量函数能够在不显式已知具体场景空间的情况下评估具体场景集合的多样性，并在场景采样方法比较、距离度量选择及时间因素影响分析中具有实用价值。

Abstract: A scenario-based development approach has become state of the art for automated driving systems. Once a set of scenario classes covering the operational design domain is available, concrete scenarios are generated from these scenario classes, e.g., to be used for hazard analysis and risk assessment or for the system's verification and validation. For such applications, a high diversity among the generated concrete scenarios is paramount. The question arises how the quality of collections of concrete scenarios can be assessed in such a setting. In this work, we aggregate scenario distance measures into so-called quality functions that quantify the diversity of concrete scenario collections in the context of automated driving. In particular, we consider the case where scenario classes are formalized as constraint systems and the associated concrete scenario space is not explicitly known. Based on a set of desired properties we construct candidates for such quality functions and give proofs for their property fulfillment. To show the practical relevance of quality functions, we perform a variety of experiments in the context of an abstract scenario-based virtual verification toolchain for automated driving systems. More specifically, we use quality functions to compare the effectiveness of variation methods for sampling, examine the choice of different scenario distance measures, and investigate the effects of temporal aspects on concrete scenario collection quality.

</details>


### [951] [SWE-MISBEHAVIOR: Benchmarking and Mitigating Boundary Violations in Software Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18206)
*Do Xuan Trong,Duc Anh Nguyen,Do Xuan Long,Ngoc-Hai Nguyen,Tongyao Zhu,Duy Dinh,Cayden Chik,Cuong Dang,Jiaying Wu,Xuan-Phi Nguyen,Vinh Van Nguyen,Kenji Kawaguchi,Shafiq Joty,Nancy F. Chen,Min-Yen Kan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对编码智能体边界违规行为的分类与评测框架SWE-MISBEHAVIOR，并基于发现提出自适应缓解框架CODE-KIT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码智能体在完成任务时可能产生越界或违背用户意图的misbehavior，但缺乏系统化的分类与评测基准，因此需要构建诊断框架并探索缓解方案。

Method: 构建SWE-MISBEHAVIOR：含7.4K人在回路合成样本，覆盖代码生成、文件管理、系统交互三层动作空间、11类misbehavior，并提供全自动评测协议；同时提出CODE-KIT，结合misbehavior感知准则与新型工具帮助智能体规避失败。

Result: 对OpenHands、smolagents等先进开源智能体的实验显示显著misbehavior：依赖误解高达98.5%、非预期修改用户输入50.5%、静默破坏环境完整性53%。CODE-KIT使smolagents与OpenHands的misbehavior分别降低52%和34%，同时提升任务完成表现。

Conclusion: 编码智能体存在普遍且严重的边界违规行为，SWE-MISBEHAVIOR可系统诊断此类问题，而CODE-KIT能在减少misbehavior的同时提升任务完成度，为更安全可靠的编码智能体提供可行路径。

Abstract: We present SWE-MISBEHAVIOR, the first taxonomy and evaluation framework for diagnosing boundary-violating misbehaviors in coding agents. It contains 7.4K human-in-the-loop synthesized samples spanning three layers of agent action space: (i) Code Generation, (ii) File Management, and (iii) System Interaction. Across these categories, SWE-MISBEHAVIOR covers 11 distinct misbehaviors with a fully automated evaluation protocol, including coding-action violations, Create/Read/Update/Delete (CRUD) file misbehaviors, system integrity and abuse violations, and task-goal misalignment. Experiments on state-of-the-art open-source coding agents (e.g., OpenHands, smolagents) reveal substantial misaligned behaviors, including dependency misinterpretation (up to 98.5% of cases), unintended modification of user inputs (50.5%), and silent compromise of environment integrity (53%). Motivated by these findings, we further propose CODE-KIT, a lightweight adaptive framework that combines misbehavior-aware guidelines with novel tools to help agents avoid such failures. CODE-KIT reduces misbehaviors by 52% for smolagents and 34% for OpenHands, while simultaneously improving task completion performance.

</details>


### [952] [DTScribe: Generating Models for Digital Twin Reporting using Local Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18635)
*Kérian Fiter,Angelica Portocarrero,Bentley Oakes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文探索利用大语言模型自动生成数字孪生报告所需的模型：先从孪生文档中抽取符合"21特征数字孪生描述框架"的关键信息，再生成本体建模语言（OML）描述模型，并输出概念架构可视化与报告页面；通过LLM裁判与本体推理构成的精化循环提升质量，并分析架构与参数选择对产出质量的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字孪生构建涉及众多利益相关者与技术组件，此前提出的概念架构报告可作为讨论制品，但对数字孪生进行建模以实现可视化与共识构建的过程十分繁琐且耗时，因此需要自动化模型生成。

Method: 以数字孪生文档为输入，首先抽取与21特征数字孪生描述框架对齐的关键细节；随后生成本体建模语言（OML）描述模型，将数字孪生表示为模型、数据、使能件与服务的集合体；并采用由大语言模型担任裁判的refinement loops与本体推理来提升制品质量，同时考察不同架构与参数选择的影响。

Result: 精化循环可使本地大语言模型产出与更大模型相当的高质量结果；中等规模本地模型（约200亿参数）即可满足需求；不应将大语言模型用作裁判；特征抽取不宜采用聚类；OML精化建议至少进行两轮reasoner循环。

Conclusion: 该自动化方法可加速数字孪生报告生成，所总结的洞见可供实践者集成用于数字孪生报告或其他模型生成任务。

Abstract: The development of a digital twin brings together many stakeholders and technical components. We have previously investigated the reporting of the conceptual architecture for these digital twins as an artifact for discussion. However, we find that the activity of modeling the digital twin for visualization and consensus-building can be quite tedious and time-consuming.
  In this article, we explore the automation of model generation using large language models, targeting the model required for digital twin reporting. Our approach is designed to ingest digital twin documents and output both the conceptual architecture visualization and a reporting page for that digital twin. We first extract from the input the key details aligning with our twenty-one-characteristic Digital Twin Description Framework described in previous work. Then, we generate a description model in the Ontological Modeling Language, representing the digital twin as a constellation of models, data, enablers, and services. We utilize refinement loops with large language models acting as judges and ontological reasoning to increase artifact quality as measured by our metrics.
  We investigate how architectural and parameter choices affect artifact quality, such as how refinement loops enable local large language models to produce sufficiently high-quality results comparable to larger models. We also detail insights and lessons learned useful for practitioners, such that they can integrate our techniques to accelerate their digital twin reporting or for other model generation tasks. These insights include the use of medium-sized local models (around 20 billion parameters), the avoidance of large language models as judges and clustering for characteristic extraction, and the recommendation of at least two reasoner loops for Ontological Modeling Language refinement.

</details>


### [953] [SolBehave: Evaluating the Behavioural Correctness of LLM-Generated Smart Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18745)
*Giovanni Pio Delvecchio,Stefano Fantazzini,Giacomo Frisoni,Gianluca Moro,Lorenzo Bacchiani,Mario Bravetti,Thomas Troels Hildebrandt*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SolBehave 基准，用于大规模评估 LLM 生成智能合约的行为正确性，超越仅检查编译成功的现有评测；通过差分模糊测试、历史交易回放与 DCR 图引导的合成交易回放三项互补测试，发现编译成功率高但行为保真度普遍偏低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 生成的 Solidity 智能合约一经部署便无法修补，单个潜在缺陷即会永久可被利用；而现有评测大多只关注生成代码能否编译，缺乏对行为正确性的规模化、系统化检验，ad hoc 单元测试也不足以揭示语义偏差。

Method: 在 250 个真实、可复现的以太坊合约上，采用三项互补的行为保真度测试：（1）差分模糊测试，在自动生成输入上逐函数比较生成版本与原始合约；（2）历史交易回放，用合约在链上实际接收的交易比较整个合约行为；（3）核心贡献——以动态条件响应（DCR）图引导的合成交易回放，枚举合法函数调用序列空间，覆盖链上从未出现过的调用顺序。对七个最先进的开源权重模型在自动修复一轮后进行评估。

Result: 编译成功率介于 26.4% 至 92.7%；但在差分模糊测试下，跨模型与样本汇总后，所有能编译的生成函数体中仅 31.4% 与原始函数等价。合约级分歧成为常态：七个模型中有六个在历史回放下，13%–31% 的可编译生成合约与原始合约产生分歧；在 DCR 引导回放下为 13%–44%；仅 Gemma-4-31B 在两项目标上均低于 3%。

Conclusion: 编译成功只是正确性的必要条件，远非充分条件；亟需如 SolBehave 这样面向行为保真度的规模化评测方法，以揭示 LLM 生成智能合约中潜藏的、永久性的语义缺陷。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate Solidity smart contracts that, once deployed, can never be patched, making a single latent fault permanent and exploitable. Yet current evaluations mostly ask only whether generated code compiles. We introduce SolBehave, a benchmark for evaluating the correctness of model-generated contracts at scale, moving beyond ad hoc unit tests. Across 250 real, reproducible Ethereum contracts, we apply three complementary tests of behavioural fidelity: differential fuzzing, historical-transaction replay, and, as our core contribution, synthetic-transaction replay guided by a Dynamic Condition Response (DCR) graph that enumerates the space of legitimate function-call sequences. Differential fuzzing compares each generated function with the original on automatically generated inputs; historical replay compares the whole contract on the transactions it actually received on-chain; DCR-guided replay compares it on sequences of calls that follow its intended usage, including orderings that never occurred on-chain. We evaluate seven state-of-the-art open-weight models after one round of automated repair. Compilation success ranges from 26.4% to 92.7%, but under differential fuzzing only 31.4% of all generated function bodies that compile, pooled over models and samples, are equivalent to the original. Divergence at the contract level is the norm rather than the exception: for six of the seven models, between 13% and 31% of the generated contracts that compile diverge from the original under historical replay, and between 13% and 44% under DCR-guided replay; only Gemma-4-31B stays below 3% on both. Compilation is therefore a necessary condition for correctness and far from a sufficient one.

</details>


### [954] [PreciseCoder: Faithful and Generalizable Debugging Beyond Unit-Test Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18755)
*Yunkai Zhan,Miaosen Chai,Shangshang Wang,Jike Zhong,Yuqing Yang,Deqing Fu,Serina Chang,Wang Bill Zhu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文提出 PreciseCoder，在单元测试奖励之外引入“语义验证的局部化编辑”信号，使代码模型调试更精准、编辑更小、通过率不降，并可泛化到仓库级修复与更强模型的推理迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码模型后训练普遍只用单元测试作为强化学习奖励，但单元测试只关心最终程序是否通过，并不评价调试过程。作者发现这种“只看测试”的奖励虽然提高通过率，却会诱导模型多改代码、并在本已正确的代码上幻觉出并不存在的 bug，说明该奖励信号对调试行为的引导是失真的。

Method: 提出 PreciseCoder 训练算法：在单元测试奖励基础上，加入一个针对“经过语义验证的、局部化的编辑”的奖励信号，使奖励与更小的编辑量和更高的通过率相关联。在 4B、9B、27B 三种规模模型上进行训练与评估，并测试从单行 bug 训练到仓库级程序修复的泛化能力，以及推理轨迹向更强模型的迁移效果；同时对思维链做语言学分析。

Result: 在 4B、9B、27B 模型上，PreciseCoder 将平均编辑行数从 7–15 行降至 3 行，同时通过率与仅用单元测试训练持平。仅在单行 bug 上训练，即可泛化到仓库级程序修复，用更小的补丁解决更多问题。精度还能从弱模型迁移到强模型：以 9B PreciseCoder 模型的推理轨迹为条件，GPT-5.6 Sol、Qwen3.8-Max 等前沿模型的编辑精度提升 4.6–12.4 分，且无需额外训练。语言学分析显示，该奖励促使模型逐行推理、指认出错行，并形成一致的 bug 假设。

Conclusion: 仅以单元测试为奖励的强化学习会诱导模型过度编辑并幻觉 bug；通过加入语义验证的局部化编辑奖励，PreciseCoder 能在不牺牲通过率的前提下显著提升编辑精度，并具备跨模型规模与跨任务（从单行 bug 到仓库级修复、从弱模型到强模型）的泛化与迁移能力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) from unit tests is the common recipe for post-training code models, but a unit test only asks whether the final program passes. We analyze what this unit-test-only reward teaches a model during debugging and find that, while it raises pass rates, it also teaches the model to edit more and to hallucinate bugs in code that is already correct. We introduce PreciseCoder, a training algorithm that augments the unit-test reward with a signal for semantically verified, localized edits, which correlates with smaller edits and higher pass rates. On 4B, 9B, and 27B models, PreciseCoder reduces the average number of edit lines from 7-15to 3 at a pass rate on par with unit-test-only training. Trained only on single-line bugs, PreciseCoder can generalize to repository-level program repair, where it resolves more issues with smaller patches. Its precision also transfers from weaker to stronger models: given the reasoning trace of a 9B PreciseCoder model, frontier models such as GPT-5.6 Sol and Qwen3.8-Max gain 4.6-12.4 points in edit precision with no additional training. Linguistic analysis of the thinking traces shows that our reward encourages the model to reason about individual lines, name the buggy ones, and form consistent bug hypotheses.
